title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
summary: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼Hodge消息传递（RHMP），将拓扑与几何严格分离：固定由定向关联确定的细胞上边界算子，学习对称正定的余链度量用于几何相关传播，并通过共链框架等变性实现精确的拓扑恒等式与最优物理基准性能。
AI.motivation: 物理场在网格上的建模需要拓扑与几何的分离——守恒律是拓扑性的应保持精确，而几何、材料响应及各向异性耦合需从数据中学习。现有神经代理模型常在无约束的消息传递中混淆这些角色，导致拓扑结构被破坏、物理规律未被严格满足。
AI.method: RHMP将分离原则转化为架构设计：1) 固定由定向关联决定的细胞上边界算子d_k（无需学习，保证拓扑精确）；2) 学习对称正定余链度量H_k以建模几何相关传播；3) 以度量加权的Hodge块（d_k^T H_{k+1} d_k）实现消息传递；4) 通过共链框架等变性实现对正交特征基变化的不变性。
AI.result: 在涵盖流体、电磁学、规范场及变网格CFD的七个物理基准上，RHMP取得整体最优性能；当拓扑、学习几何与场结构相互作用时，增益最为显著。该方法同时保证了精确的余链复形恒等式d_{k+1}d_k=0、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子及精确的Abel曲率不变性。
AI.conclusion: RHMP验证了将拓扑与几何分离作为架构性原则的有效性：通过固定拓扑算子并仅学习度量部分，可以同时获得严格的物理结构保证（守恒、正定性、不变性）和优秀的预测性能，为物理感知的神经算子设计提供了新范式。

title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
summary: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Forward-Pass-Only (FPO)训练方法，仅通过前向传播适配大型语言模型，无需反向传播，实现了2.7-3.2倍的标准微调吞吐量，同时减少约40%的峰值训练内存，且在域外基准上保持与基线相当的种子噪声水平。FPO基于一个实证观察：在Transformer晚期层，输出层预测误差与真实梯度的余弦相似度达到0.47-0.59。该方法引入两分钟诊断工具评估各层的近似质量，并仅在前向传播中计算单一误差信号应用于目标层。
AI.motivation: 传统全网络微调（SFT）虽然有效，但计算开销大且内存需求高，且容易在域外基准上产生不可靠的退化。研究者希望找到一种既高效又稳定的适配方法，在保持域内性能提升的同时，避免全网络微调带来的域外性能不稳定问题。
AI.method: FPO基于"晚期层输出层预测误差可近似真实梯度"这一实证观察，设计如下流程：(1) 引入两分钟诊断工具，逐层量化预测误差与梯度的近似程度，确定晚期层适配可行性；(2) 在输出层计算单一误差信号，将其直接应用于每一个目标层；(3) 层间不传递任何信号，全程不构建autograd计算图，从而完全避免反向传播。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B）上评估，FPO均实现了域内困惑度改善，同时MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande基准保持在基线种子噪声范围内。吞吐量为标准微调的2.7-3.2倍，峰值训练内存减少约40%。对比实验显示，将SFT局部化到FPO目标层也能达到类似效果，但墙钟成本是FPO的2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: FPO证明了纯前向传播即可有效适配大语言模型，为高效、内存友好的模型适配提供了新范式。其核心贡献在于发现了输出层误差信号可作为梯度的有效替代，并通过诊断工具保证了方法的可移植性。该方法在效率和域外稳定性上均优于局部化SFT，具有实际应用价值。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems
summary:
Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MR-Traj，一种多分辨率扩散框架，用于大规模合成轨迹生成。该框架将轨迹建模为粗粒度里程碑与细粒度片段的组合，以捕获多尺度的时空依赖关系。实验表明其在全局分布相似性上达到SOTA水平，在细粒度移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务上表现更优，且通过多分辨率随机性增强了轨迹多样性并降低了轨迹链接风险。
AI.motivation: 城市人群移动分析对交通管理、疫情防控、城市规划等至关重要，但大规模公开轨迹数据因隐私问题十分稀缺。现有合成轨迹生成方法主要注重全局分布相似性匹配，忽略了跨空间和时间分辨率的移动模式，而后者对实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: MR-Traj采用多分辨率扩散框架，将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑（milestones）与细粒度片段（segments）的组合，以捕获多个分辨率下复杂的时空依赖关系。通过在多分辨率层面引入随机性，增强生成轨迹的多样性。
AI.result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面达到与现有最先进方法相当的性能，并在细分辨率移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务中持续优于现有方法。此外，多分辨率随机性提升了轨迹多样性，在种子引导的数据发布设置下经验性地降低了轨迹链接（linkage）风险。
AI.conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率扩散建模有效地平衡了全局分布匹配与细粒度模式捕获，同时兼顾轨迹效用与隐私保护，为大规模合成轨迹生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation
summary: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了PGD攻击的轨迹级诊断指标（损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数）在评估对抗鲁棒性时的可靠性。实验发现，这些指标不能独立衡量鲁棒性，其中损失轨迹和梯度对齐在鲁棒性差异明显的对抗训练模型间表现相似，而失败步数分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性等级。轨迹级分析应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充工具。
AI.motivation: PGD攻击通常仅通过最终对抗准确率评估鲁棒性，无法捕捉攻击过程中模型的行为动态。近期工作提出轨迹级诊断（如损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数）以提供更深入的对抗优化动力学洞察，但尚不清楚这些诊断指标是否可靠地反映鲁棒性强弱，本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 在Fashion-MNIST数据集上对卷积神经网络进行轨迹级PGD攻击研究。对比干净训练和对抗训练模型的不同鲁棒性区间，使用20步PGD、随机初始化和多重重启进行鲁棒性测量，并采用单初始化的轨迹记录获取诊断数据。每个模型记录3000个干净正确样本的完整PGD轨迹，分析损失演化、梯度对齐和失败时机的迭代变化。
AI.result: 研究揭示了模型间清晰的鲁棒性层级，但不同轨迹指标对层级识别的贡献不均。均损轨迹和梯度对齐模式在鲁棒性差异显著的对抗训练模型间定量上相似；相比之下，失败步数分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性区间，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能抵抗能力。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何特性，而非独立的对抗鲁棒性度量。其可解释性取决于鲁棒性区间、攻击强度和多种指标的综合评估。轨迹级分析应作为补充性诊断工具并结合上下文解读，而非替代标准鲁棒性测量。

title: Xemo-Talker: Unlock Emotions Explicitly for Audio-Driven Talking Portrait Synthesis
summary: Precise emotion control in audio-driven talking heads remains a challenge due to the reliance on implicit emotion regulation in existing systems, which often leads to indirect and insufficient control. Additionally, training with explicit emotion-related losses across the entire motion space poses significant difficulties due to the inherent trade-off between accurate lip synchronization and fine-grained emotion control. In this paper, we reveal a key finding: although emotional cues are distributed throughout the motion space, concentrating discriminative supervision on less-principal components achieves a better emotion-lip synchronization balance, as principal components mainly encode high-energy articulation and pose variations. Building on this insight, we propose Xemo-Talker, which first learns a neutral speech-to-motion mapping for stable articulation and lip synchronization, and then introduces a lightweight emotion branch guided by less-principal subspace supervision. To enhance emotion control, we design a Tri-Loss consisting of inter-class separation, intra-class compactness, and less-principal contrastive learning. Given an audio input, a reference image, and an emotion label, Xemo-Talker achieves state-of-the-art emotion classification accuracy while maintaining competitive lip synchronization and high inference efficiency, with performance approaching that measured on real videos.The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/chaolongy/Xemo-Talker.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Xemo-Talker，一种基于少主成分（less-principal）子空间监督的音频驱动说话人头像情感控制方法，通过先学习中性语音到动作映射保证口型同步，再引入轻量级情感分支并在少主成分子空间施加判别性监督，实现情感分类准确率SOTA的同时保持竞争性口型同步与高推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动说话人系统中的情感控制依赖隐式情感调节，导致控制间接且不充分；同时在全运动空间上施加显式情感损失会因口型同步与细粒度情感控制之间的固有权衡而面临显著困难。作者发现情感线索分布在整个运动空间，但在少主成分分量上集中判别性监督能在情感与口型同步之间取得更好平衡，因为主成分主要编码高能量发音和姿态变化。
AI.method: Xemo-Talker包含两阶段：首先学习中性语音到动作映射以稳定发音和口型同步；随后引入由少主成分子空间监督引导的轻量情感分支。为增强情感控制，设计了Tri-Loss，包含类间分离、类内紧致和少主成分对比学习三个损失项。
AI.result: 在给定音频输入、参考图像和情感标签的条件下，Xemo-Talker在情感分类准确率上达到SOTA，同时保持竞争性口型同步和高推理效率，性能接近在真实视频上测量的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将判别性情感监督从主成分空间转移到少主成分子空间，Xemo-Talker有效缓解了口型同步与情感控制之间的权衡，实现了精确、高效且可控的情感化音频驱动说话人生成。

title: SpotlessGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting under Dynamic Illumination for Robotic Perception
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Robots operating in dark or poorly lit environments rely on onboard lights, which often produce uneven illumination that degrades downstream perception tasks. Prior approaches based on 2D image enhancement lack reliable supervision and fail to preserve multi-view geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we extend Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS) toward a more accurate and flexible relightable 3D reconstruction framework. First, we eliminate the need for explicit light parameter calibration by jointly optimizing lighting parameters within the Gaussian Splatting framework. Second, we introduce a low-frequency illumination model based on spherical harmonics (SH) to capture spatially varying residual and ambient lighting effects. Third, we incorporate an MLP-based Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) to model non-Lambertian reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates illumination artifacts while improving rendering quality and quantitative performance over prior approaches. We further validate its benefits for robotic perception through a downstream task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向暗环境/低光照条件下机器人感知的可重照明3D重建框架，扩展Dark Gaussian Splatting，通过联合优化光照参数、基于球谐函数的低频光照模型以及MLP-BRDF模型，无需显式光参标定即可实现非朗伯反射建模，在合成与真实数据集上优于先前方法，并验证了其对下游机器人感知任务的提升。
AI.motivation: 在黑暗或光线不足环境中运行的机器人依赖机载光源，但通常产生不均匀照明，损害下游感知任务。先前的基于2D图像增强的方法缺乏可靠的监督信号且无法保持多视角几何一致性，因此需要更准确的3D重建框架来解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出三点改进：(1) 在Gaussian Splatting框架内联合优化照明参数，消除显式光参校准需求；(2) 引入基于球谐函数(SH)的低频光照模型，捕捉空间变化的残余光照和环境光效果；(3) 引入MLP基双向反射分布函数(BRDF)模型来建模非朗伯反射。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上有效缓解了照明伪影，提高了渲染质量和定量性能，超越先前方法；并通过下游任务验证了对机器人感知的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将光照参数、低频SH光照模型和基于MLP的BRDF整合到3DGS框架中，实现了更准确、更灵活的可重照明3D重建，为暗环境机器人感知提供了一种无需光参标定的有效解决方案。

title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

AI.tldr: LACE是一个AutoML框架，通过进化循环维护scikit-learn兼容的Python类种群，并使用大型语言模型作为变异算子，在完整的可执行流水线程序空间中进行搜索，而非受限于预定义的组件空间。在68个OpenML分类任务上，LACE显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与AutoGluon性能相当，并能覆盖完整基准。
AI.motivation: 传统AutoML系统只能在预定义的空间内选择和调优已知组件，无法产生该空间之外的新结构。作者希望突破这一限制，使AutoML能够搜索完整的可执行流水线程序，从而获得更大的表达能力和灵活性。
AI.method: LACE采用进化算法框架：维护一个scikit-learn兼容Python类的种群，由LLM（GPT-4.5-mini）作为变异算子生成新候选。每次搜索生成的流水线是普通Python代码，可直接检查和编辑。组件集合的扩展通过编辑提示词实现，而非修改框架本身。
AI.result: 在68个OpenML分类任务上，使用泄漏控制协议（隐藏数据集身份）：LACE显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线；与AutoGluon无显著差异；能覆盖完整基准。较新的表格基础模型在支持的任务子集上更准确，但输出固定预训练预测器而非可编辑的程序。
AI.conclusion: LACE的贡献不在于原始精度，而在于以代码定义的搜索空间：完整覆盖率、可直接复用的流水线、以及通过编辑提示词而非框架扩展组件集合的能力。这是首个以这种方式形式化通用表格流水线AutoML的研究。

title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
summary: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将退役GPU重组为"垃圾场集群"(DumpsterCluster)用于现代LLM推理的可行性与可持续性。作者实际搭建了一个128-GPU的二手V100集群并运行一年，发现其在成本上具有巨大优势（$22K vs $600K），且通过流水线并行优化可实现与LLaMA-70B相当的吞吐量。但研究表明其可持续性高度依赖部署环境：仅在电价低廉且使用清洁能源的地区，这种硬件再利用才在经济和环境上均可行；否则老旧GPU在碳排放上可能比新一代硬件高4倍（8B模型）甚至40倍（70B模型）。
AI.motivation: 随着AI数据中心大规模退役功能完好的GPU，大量仍具算力的加速器流入二级市场。作者希望探究这些退役GPU是否可以形成"垃圾场集群"来服务现代LLM推理，并明确在什么条件下这种再利用在经济上可行且环境上可持续，填补了硬件循环经济在AI推理领域的研究空白。
AI.method: 作者从零开始仅使用二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster（基于V100），并持续运行一整年进行实证研究。采用流水线并行(pipeline-parallel)优化技术来提升LLM推理吞吐量，同时对比当前一代硬件（8-GPU B200系统）进行经济成本分析、单位token能耗分析以及碳排放分析，考察在不同电价和电网碳强度场景下的总拥有成本(TCO)和环境影响。
AI.result: 在硬件成本上，DumpsterCluster（$22K）相比8-GPU B200系统（$600K）具有压倒性经济优势；通过流水线并行优化，V100为基础的集群在LLaMA-70B推理上达到具有竞争力的吞吐量。然而，老旧GPU单位token能耗显著更高：在电网平均碳强度下，8B模型总碳排放约为新硬件的4倍，70B模型则超过40倍。总拥有成本仅在高性价比电力的地区才具有优势。
AI.conclusion: GPU的"二次生命"并非普遍可持续——硬件再利用必须与低碳能源策略性结合。在电价便宜且使用清洁能源的地区，二手GPU集群是扩展AI算力、提升可负担性、保障能源安全并承担环境责任的有效路径；而在其他场景下，过度依赖老旧硬件反而会放大碳排放问题。

title: Periocular Soft Biometrics: A Survey and Applications to Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection
comment: Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD2026)
summary: Soft-biometric attributes such as gender, age, and ethnicity provide valuable ancillary evidence when full identity recognition is not feasible, supporting applications in forensic investigation, identity verification, surveillance, or detection of synthetic and manipulated media. Among biometric modalities, the periocular region is a robust source of soft-biometric cues, as it often remains visible when other parts of the face are occluded, a frequent condition in forensic evidence and surveillance footage, and can be captured across a wide range of acquisition conditions. In this paper, we provide a survey of demographic attribute estimation from periocular images, covering publicly available datasets, methodological trends from handcrafted descriptors to deep learning architectures, and the state of the art in gender, age, and ethnicity prediction. We discuss use cases relevant to multimedia forensics and disinformation-detection applications, including demographic filtering in surveillance footage, age verification, and the detection of demographic inconsistencies in synthetic data. We also highlight open challenges, including dataset bias, cross-domain generalisation, fairness, ethical aspects, and the lack of forensic-oriented benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了从眼周区域（periocular region）图像中估计人口统计学属性（性别、年龄、种族）的研究现状，涵盖公开数据集、从手工特征到深度学习的方法演进、最新技术水平，以及在多媒体取证和虚假信息检测中的应用。同时指出了数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性、伦理问题及缺乏取证导向基准等开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 软生物特征（性别、年龄、种族）在全身份识别不可行时提供关键的辅助证据，支持法医调查、身份验证、监控及合成媒体检测等应用。眼周区域是稳健的软生物特征来源，在面部其他部位被遮挡时仍可见，适合取证与监控场景。然而该领域缺乏系统性的综述来整合数据集、方法和应用，特别是针对多媒体取证和虚假信息检测的角度。
AI.method: 本文采用文献综述方法，系统梳理了：(1) 用于眼周图像人口统计属性估计的公开数据集；(2) 从手工特征描述子到深度学习架构的方法论发展趋势；(3) 性别、年龄和种族预测的最新技术水平（SOTA）结果；(4) 相关应用场景（监控中的人口统计过滤、年龄验证、合成数据中人口统计不一致性检测）；(5) 开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.result: 综合总结了当前眼周人口统计属性估计的研究版图，识别了该领域方法从传统手工特征向深度学习方法演进的趋势，概括了性别/年龄/种族预测的现有最佳性能水平，并整理出多媒体取证与虚假信息检测场景中的实际应用案例。同时揭示了数据集偏见、跨域泛化能力不足、公平性与伦理隐患，以及取证导向基准缺失等关键缺口。
AI.conclusion: 眼周人口统计属性估计在取证和虚假信息检测领域具有重要应用价值，但目前仍面临数据集偏差和跨域泛化等核心挑战。未来需要开发专门的取证导向基准数据集，关注算法公平性和伦理边界，以推动该技术在实际取证场景中的可靠应用。

title: MISTac: A Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Minimally Invasive Surgery
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Minimally invasive and robot-assisted surgery offer many advantages over traditional open surgery, but deprive surgeons of tactile feedback and the ability to palpate tissue with their fingers. To address this lack of tactile feedback, we introduce the MISTac, a high resolution vision-based tactile sensor specifically designed for palpation in MIS. The sensor has a replaceable sensor tip with a diameter of 8 mm which allows it to fit through the trocars used in minimally invasive surgery. Its modular 3D-printed case design allows the use of bulky off-the-shelf illumination and imaging hardware that can easily be exchanged and upgraded. The sensor has an optical resolution of 176.68 $μm$, a tactile resolution of 250 $μm$, and can resolve forces as little as 24.3 mN. An in vivo study with the sensor shows its usability in minimally invasive surgery. We trained a machine learning model with the tactile data collected in the trial on a tissue classification task achieving an aggregate accuracy of ~84% in a leave-one-out cross validation. Tactile sensors have the potential to one day aid surgeons during minimally invasive surgery with tasks such as tissue classification or intra-operative tumor localization; MISTac is a small step towards this vision. We open-source MISTac at https://github.com/lasr-lab/mistac

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MISTac，一种专为微创手术（MIS）设计的高分辨率视觉触觉传感器。该传感器具有8mm直径的可更换探头，可穿过微创手术套管；模块化3D打印外壳支持使用现成的照明和成像硬件。传感器光学分辨率为176.68μm，触觉分辨率250μm，最小可分辨力24.3mN。通过体内实验验证可用性，并利用采集的触觉数据训练机器学习模型进行组织分类，leave-one-out交叉验证准确率约84%。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 微创和机器人辅助手术相比传统开放手术有许多优势，但剥夺了外科医生的触觉反馈和用手指触诊组织的能力。为了解决这一缺乏触觉反馈的问题，作者提出了MISTac传感器。
AI.method: 设计了一种高分辨率视觉触觉传感器，采用8mm直径可更换探头以适配微创手术套管；模块化3D打印外壳允许使用可轻松更换和升级的现成照明与成像硬件。进行了体内实验验证传感器的可用性，并利用收集的触觉数据训练机器学习模型进行组织分类任务。
AI.result: 传感器光学分辨率176.68μm，触觉分辨率250μm，可分辨最小力24.3mN。体内实验验证了其在微创手术中的可用性。在组织分类任务中，leave-one-out交叉验证实现了约84%的聚合准确率。
AI.conclusion: 触觉传感器有潜力在未来辅助外科医生进行微创手术中的组织分类或术中肿瘤定位等任务；MISTac是朝着这一愿景迈出的一小步。传感器已开源发布。

title: Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion
summary: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了一种将多种不确定性工具（证据图、贝叶斯赔率、Dempster-Shafer融合、保形预测）融合进法律判决预测管道的方案，使用10,000起欧洲人权法院真实案件及两个前沿大语言模型进行约4,750次实验。结果发现：融合管道在判别力上无提升（大模型直接使用最佳）；朴素组合导致校准误差翻倍以上；Dempster-Shafer融合在长链上不安全应移除；管道真正价值在于操作层——通过保形选择性预测实现自动清结与人工升级的决策，调优后自动案件准确率达96.8%，错误逃逸仅0.5%。结论：此类管道在法律中的贡献是校准后的信任，而非更锐利的预测。
AI.motivation: 法律AI领域反复有人提议通过融合多种不确定性工具（证据图、贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合、保形预测）构建统一管道来改进案件结果预测。作者旨在实证检验这一提议：此类融合是否真的能提升预测精度，还是可能引入新的风险（如校准退化、不安全融合），同时考察管道是否在其他维度（如操作决策）具有价值。
AI.method: 使用1,000起欧洲人权法院真实案件（来自LexGLUE和FairLex数据集），以事实段落为输入预测是否存在《公约》违反。将Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5两个前沿LLM作为每事实证据估计器，比较三个家族：(A)原始LLM直接预测，(B)LLM接入融合管道（证据图+贝叶斯赔率+Dempster-Shafer+保形预测），(C)词频基线接入同一管道。共约4,750次测试，测量AUROC和期望校准误差(ECE)，并在全面调优（移除Dempster-Shafer、重新校准、类别条件风险控制）后评估操作性能。
AI.result: (1)歧视案件上（AUROC约0.83）管道不优于原始LLM或基线，前沿LLM直接使用时是最强判别器。(2)LLM朴素组合贝叶斯赔率与Dempster-Shafer融合使ECE从约0.16升至0.46（翻倍以上），归因于先验不匹配机制，两种模型均复现。(3)Dempster-Shafer融合在长链上不安全，以低于随机的准确率自信地提交错误标签，建议移除。(4)调优后系统自动清结达96.8%准确率，仅0.5%错误逃逸，96.3%被捕获审查；未调优基线为85.9/3.8/72.1。
AI.conclusion: 融合不确定性的管道在法律场景中并不能提升预测判别力——前沿LLM直接使用即是最强判别器。工程上需要移除不安全的Dempster-Shafer融合并重新校准。管道的真正价值体现在操作层：通过保形选择性预测实现自动化与人工升级的信任校准决策。因此，此类管道对法律的贡献是"校准后的信任"而非"更锐利的预测"。

title: Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs
comment: Master's thesis, Rochester Institute of Technology, 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Code and demo: https://github.com/EtonMu/deep-analog
summary: Film emulation reproduces the look of an analog film stock on a new digital photograph. We target its open-set form -- matching any reference film frame from a single example -- with a 3D lookup table (LUT) predicted from that reference. Real-time image enhancement predicts per-image weights over a fixed bank of 3D LUTs and blends them. We show this is a gated mixture of experts and inherits its failure: trained end-to-end against reconstruction, the gate collapses onto a single expert, so a bank of K LUTs delivers the capacity of one. An entropy term, the enhancement-setting analogue of mixture-of-experts load balancing, restores utilization and recovers about 1 dB PSNR. The deeper constraint survives: a fixed LUT basis is closed-set, freezing the achievable looks at training time. We therefore discard the basis and predict a single 3D LUT as a residual from a reference image (StyleLUTNet), trained by self-supervision on procedurally generated color transforms. The conditional design removes the gate and generalizes open-set to unseen film stocks without paired data or retraining. Around this color backbone we build Deep Analog, a film-emulation pipeline that adds histogram-based tone matching and a physics-informed optical renderer -- multi-scale grain and per-channel halation driven by parameters an inverse network regresses from the reference. On 350 self-supervised pairs the color stage reaches 22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM and the full pipeline 21.72 dB / 0.923; the color path runs in 5.2 ms at 1080p (192 FPS) and exports a portable .cube LUT for standard editing tools. A second degeneracy in conditional LUT training -- residual-scale collapse -- shares the root cause and yields a general principle: auxiliary regularization must stay subordinate to reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Analog，一种针对胶片仿真的开放集（open-set）方法。它摒弃了传统的固定3D LUT基座，改为从单张参考图像直接预测单个3D LUT（StyleLUTNet），并通过程序化生成的颜色变换进行自监督训练，从而能泛化到未见过的胶片。该流程还包含基于直方图的色调匹配和物理启发的光学渲染器（包含多尺度颗粒和逐通道光晕）。实验表明颜色阶段达到22.05 dB PSNR/0.925 SSIM，全流程21.72 dB/0.923，1080p下颜色路径运行5.2ms（192 FPS）并可导出便携.cube LUT。
AI.motivation: 现有的实时图像增强方法依赖固定3D LUT基座并通过门控混合专家进行融合，但存在两个根本缺陷：其一，端到端训练时门控发生坍缩只使用单个专家，导致K个LUT只发挥一个的容量；其二，固定LUT基座是封闭集，在训练时冻结了可实现的观感，无法适配未见过的胶片风格。因此需要设计开放集、单样本泛化的胶片仿真方案。
AI.method: 首先证明固定LUT基座的加权混合本质上是门控混合专家，并指出门控坍缩问题，通过引入熵正则项（混合专家负载均衡的模拟）恢复LUT复用率，提升约1 dB PSNR。但封闭集的根本限制仍然存在，因此作者弃用LUT基座，改为条件式单LUT预测：StyleLUTNet从参考图像回归单一3D LUT作为残差，在程序化生成的颜色变换上进行自监督训练。围绕该颜色主干构建Deep Analog管线，增加直方图色调匹配和物理启发光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒、逐通道光晕），参数由逆向网络从参考图像回归。文章还揭示条件LUT训练的第二个退化模式——残差尺度坍缩，并提出一般原则：辅助正则必须从属于重建目标。
AI.result: 在350对自监督样本上，颜色阶段达到22.05 dB PSNR/0.925 SSIM，完整管线达到21.72 dB/0.923；颜色路径在1080p下仅需5.2ms（192 FPS），并可导出标准.cube LUT兼容常用编辑工具。熵正则恢复LUT利用率并带来约1 dB的PSNR提升；条件设计实现开放集泛化，无需配对数据或重训练即可适配未知胶片。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上剖析了固定LUT基座方法的门控坍缩与封闭集双重缺陷，提出一种无条件基座的条件LUT预测架构，结合自监督与物理渲染实现单样本开放集胶片仿真。文章同时抽象出条件LUT训练中的残差尺度坍缩问题，归纳出"辅助正则须保持对重建目标的从属性"这一通用设计原则。

title: Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have improved the flexibility and generality of robotic manipulation, yet they remain fragile to online disruptions, such as changes in task goal, scene configuration, or robot state. Existing recovery methods often require failure data, policy retraining, or external corrective agents, introducing additional data requirements and execution risks. We propose Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe), a training-free framework that recovers a frozen VLA at inference time without failure data. Upon detecting a deviation, CoRe imagines how the policy would continue toward the current goal from a recent viable state, using synthesized observations in place of physical execution, and then minimally realigns the robot and scene to rejoin this imagined continuation before returning control to the policy. Recovery is therefore planned without physical trial-and-error, preserves completed task progress, and handles both mid-episode instruction changes and physical perturbations in a unified manner. Extensive experiments across multiple simulators, VLA backbones, and real-world settings show that CoRe improves success rates by up to 85.0 percentage points to near-nominal levels while reducing physical restorations by 42.2%, without policy fine-tuning or failure-specific recovery training.

AI.tldr: CoRe是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过在推理时想象策略从近期可行状态向当前目标继续执行的合成观测，对冻结的VLA模型进行反事实重对齐，实现在线扰动（指令变化、场景或机器人状态变化）下的统一恢复，无需失败数据或策略重训练。实验表明在多种模拟器、VLA骨干和真实场景中将成功率提升最多85.0个百分点，同时减少42.2%的物理恢复操作。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在应对在线扰动（如任务目标变化、场景配置变化或机器人状态变化）时仍然脆弱。已有的恢复方法通常需要失败数据、策略重训练或外部纠正智能体，这些方法引入了额外的数据需求和执行风险。作者希望提出一种无需训练、无需失败数据的推理时恢复框架，能够在检测到偏差后无需物理试错即可规划恢复。
AI.method: CoRe的核心在于反事实重对齐：当检测到偏差时，从一个最近的可行状态出发，利用合成观测（而非物理执行）来"想象"冻结策略会如何继续朝当前目标执行；然后对机器人和场景进行最小化重对齐，使其重新加入这个想象中的延续轨迹，之后再将控制权交还给策略。该方法统一处理mid-episode指令变化和物理扰动，无需策略微调或针对失败的特殊恢复训练。
AI.result: 在多个模拟器、多种VLA骨干以及真实世界设置中，CoRe将成功率提升最多85.0个百分点，恢复到接近名义水平，同时将物理恢复操作减少42.2%。
AI.conclusion: CoRe证明了一种无需训练、无需失败数据的推理时恢复框架可以显著增强冻结VLA模型对在线扰动的鲁棒性，在保持已完成任务进度的同时统一处理指令变化和物理扰动，且不引入额外的数据需求或执行风险。

title: PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function
summary: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的可解释神经算子框架——物理信息核函数神经算子（PIKFNO），通过将源自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构中，使算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开保持一致。相比传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，PIKFNO通过物理信息核函数约束主干网络，并提出了两种构建策略：直接从数据学习核函数（可视为非奇异基本解），以及通过对解析基本解进行变换构建核函数。数值实验表明，PIKFNO在有限训练数据下实现了高预测精度、显著提升的可解释性和优越的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且与经典数值方法（如无网格配点法）之间的理论联系不明确。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，通过将物理信息核函数显式地整合到神经算子架构中，构建一个既保持高精度又具备物理一致性和可解释性的神经算子框架。
AI.method: PIKFNO通过源自控制方程的物理信息核函数约束神经算子中的主干网络，使算子结构模仿无网格配点法中的核展开形式。具体提出了两种核函数构建策略：(1) 直接从数据学习核函数，将学习到的核视为非奇异基本解；(2) 通过对解析基本解进行变换来构建核函数。与传统DeepONet隐式学习基函数的方式形成对比。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在有限的训练数据条件下实现了高预测精度，并且相比传统方法具有显著提升的可解释性和优越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PIKFNO为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了新的途径，架起了神经网络与现代数值方法（无网格配点法）之间的一座桥梁。

title: On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers
summary:
Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em
  absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-18 on all datasets, Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) on RSNA). On the medical datasets, every point estimate favored cross-validation over both holdout protocols, with reductions in AEE largest at small sample sizes and diminishing as $n$ increased. This pattern remained robust under conservative family-wise adjustment. On Tiny ImageNet, AEE was negligible under all three protocols. Test AUROC was generally similar among protocols. Fixed holdout had lower mean AEE than reshuffled holdout in 11 of 12 medical conditions, although this secondary finding was less uniformly supported. For small-sample medical image classification, we recommend cross-validation-based HPO when computational resources permit because it trades additional computation for a more reliable development-time estimate of subsequent test performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地比较了三种超参数优化（HPO）协议——固定留出法（F）、重洗留出法（R）和5折交叉验证（C）——在深度学习图像分类器中的绝对性能估计误差（AEE）。在三个公共数据集（医学影像和自然图像）上，交叉验证在医学数据集上始终优于两种留出法，尤其在小样本场景下优势最明显；而在Tiny ImageNet上三种协议差异可忽略。作者建议在小样本医学影像分类中，当计算资源允许时优先采用交叉验证进行HPO。
AI.motivation: 超参数优化对深度学习图像分类器的性能有实质性影响，但在小样本场景（如医学影像）下，如何选择验证信号来驱动HPO缺乏经验性指导。现有文献对固定留出、重洗留出和交叉验证这三种协议在绝对性能估计误差上的系统比较甚少，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者在保持搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集完全一致的前提下，系统地比较了三种HPO协议（固定留出、重洗留出、5折交叉验证）。使用三个数据集覆盖两类场景：二元医学影像（RSNA肺炎X光和二值化HAM10000皮肤病变）及200类自然图像（Tiny ImageNet），在不同开发集规模n和两种骨干网络（ResNet-18全部数据集，ViT-S/16仅在RSNA上）下进行评估。核心指标是AEE（获胜配置的验证AUROC与测试AUROC的绝对差），并进行保守的家庭-wise多重比较校正。
AI.result: 在医学数据集上，所有点估计均倾向于交叉验证优于两种留出协议，且小样本时AEE降幅最大，随n增大而递减；此模式在保守校正下依然稳健。在Tiny ImageNet上，三种协议的AEE均可忽略不计。测试AUROC在协议间总体相似。固定留出在12个医学条件中的11个中平均AEE低于重洗留出，但该次要发现支持力度较不一致。
AI.conclusion: 对于小样本医学影像分类任务，当计算资源允许时，推荐使用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为它用额外计算换取在开发阶段更可靠的测试性能估计。固定留出可视为优于重洗留出的次优选择。

title: Modeling and Control of an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot for Design Optimization
summary: Anguilliform locomotion is a highly efficient swimming mode; the advent of new materials for soft robots enables the development of an eel-inspired soft robot. This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot designed for anguilliform swimming. This model can aid in design optimization and the development of model-based estimation, reasoning, and control systems. A Finite Element Method (FEM) model of an elastic rod is used to capture the soft materials of the robotic fish, which makes it particularly amenable to variation over time as the material properties change. The material model is coupled with a hydrodynamic force model to simulate the behavior of a soft, elongated robot in water. The model is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approaches in achieving desired swimming behaviors. It also provides insights into design decisions, including the robustness of different system configurations and the impact of material degradation and failure. The results show that slightly asymmetric designs are advantageous, offering comparable swimming velocities but greater maneuverability. This model can be used to guide future robotic design decisions aimed at optimizing performance for specific tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于有限元方法（FEM）的鳗鲡式仿生软体机器人游泳仿真模型，该模型将弹性杆材料模型与水动力模型耦合，用于设计优化和基于模型的估计、推理与控制系统的开发。
AI.motivation: 鳗鲡式（anguilliform）游动是一种高效游泳模式，新型软体材料为开发鳗鱼启发的软体机器人提供了可能，但需要有效的仿真模型来辅助设计优化和控制系统的开发。
AI.method: 采用有限元方法（FEM）对弹性杆进行建模以捕捉软体机器人的软材料特性（该模型特别适合材料特性随时间变化的情况），并将材料模型与水动力模型耦合，以模拟软体细长机器人在水中的行为。
AI.result: 模型展示了所提出的控制方法在实现期望游泳行为方面的有效性；提供了关于设计决策的见解，包括不同系统配置的鲁棒性以及材料退化和失效的影响。结果表明，略微不对称的设计具有优势，既能提供相当的游泳速度，又能提供更大的机动性。
AI.conclusion: 该模型可用于指导未来面向特定任务优化性能的机器人设计决策。

title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems
comment: Accepted in the 20th Colombian Computing Congress. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EARL，一个用于在强化学习（RL）环境中生成反事实解释的Python库。该库通过探索"What-if"场景来阐明智能体行为，并支持在真实RL自适系统中生成反事实解释，以解决深度RL策略缺乏透明度和可解释性的问题。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略依赖神经网络，缺乏透明度和可解释性，导致用户信任度降低，并使得系统验证变得困难。虽然反事实解释在心理学研究中已被证明直观且用户友好，但在RL领域的探索尚处于早期阶段，现有实现通常局限于玩具示例和基准测试，缺乏在真实自适系统中的支持。
AI.method: EARL库通过支持"What-if"场景探索来产生反事实解释，允许用户比较不同可能结果以阐明智能体行为。该库特别针对基于RL的自适应系统进行了设计，并通过对CitiBikes（一种自适应共享单车系统）的仿真演示了其应用。
AI.result: 作者在CitiBikes共享单车系统的仿真环境中演示了EARL的应用，并提供了评估证明其在实际应用中的表现。
AI.conclusion: EARL填补了RL反事实解释在真实自适系统中应用的空白，提供了一个用户友好的Python库来生成反事实解释，从而增强RL策略的透明度和用户信任。

title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
summary: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)，一种无需噪声水平条件化的简化视频去噪生成框架，通过解耦去噪场学习与采样过程，实现数据自适应的闭环推理，在自回归视频生成基准上超越标准噪声条件化方法。
AI.motivation: 标准基于扩散和流匹配的自回归视频生成算法依赖刚性训练目标和静态采样调度，限制了推理过程对数据的自适应能力，导致生成质量和一致性难以提升。
AI.method: EqF提出无噪声水平条件化的视频去噪生成框架，通过模块化设计与去噪场学习和采样的解耦，使推理时算法能够根据样本反馈进行闭环自适应，动态调整生成过程。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上，EqF显著提升了视频质量和时序一致性，且通过去除噪声水平条件化实现了优于标准噪声条件化去噪视频方法的数据依赖推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 去除噪声水平条件化是EqF实现数据自适应推理能力的关键设计，为噪声无条件生成模型的训练与推理模块化设计提供了新范式，拓宽了视频生成推理算法的灵活性。

title: Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health (REACH) on an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot
summary: An actuator health estimation algorithm for a soft swimming robot that can perform anguilliform swimming is developed. Due to harsh operational environments of underwater robots, and the common degradation of soft robot materials and actuators, accurate estimation of actuator functionality is necessary for robots to perform their missions as well as return to base in the event of actuator degradation and failure. Termed REACH (Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health), the architecture employs a soft robot model, sigma point filter, and a formal statistical hypothesis test to adequately capture the nonlinearities and changes over time. The performance of REACH using three sensor types (GPS, IMU, and Bend Sensor) with one sensor on each actuator is compared, demonstrating that both bend sensor and IMU are adequate choices. Sensor quantity and placement are evaluated for IMU and bend sensor, showing two sensors are sufficient for IMU, whereas three sensors are needed for bend sensor. Three swimming gaits (linear swimming, wide turning, tight turning) are compared, demonstrating that REACH can successfully predict actuator health for all three gaits, with minimal differences in performance. A filter validation method shows the fault estimation algorithm is statistically consistent in finding the correct degradation. The approach is experimentally evaluated using bend sensor data collected from a fish robot, demonstrating that REACH can successfully estimate actuator health with noisy data and variations in manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种名为REACH的软体游泳机器人执行器健康估计算法，该算法结合软体机器人模型、sigma点滤波器和形式化统计假设检验，能够实时估计执行器的控制与健康状态，并通过实验验证其在噪声数据下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人在恶劣环境中工作，软体机器人材料和执行器容易退化，准确估计执行器功能状态对于完成任务和故障时安全返航至关重要。
AI.method: REACH架构由三部分组成：软体机器人模型用于描述系统动态，sigma点滤波器捕捉非线性特性，形式化统计假设检验用于检测随时间变化的退化。研究比较了三种传感器类型（GPS、IMU、弯曲传感器），评估了传感器数量与位置的影响，并针对三种游泳步态进行了测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：弯曲传感器和IMU都是合适的传感器选择；IMU需要两个传感器即可，而弯曲传感器需要三个；REACH在三种游泳步态（直线游泳、大转弯、急转弯）下均能成功预测执行器健康，且性能差异极小；滤波器验证方法证明了故障估计算法的统计一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过鱼形机器人弯曲传感器数据的实验评估，REACH能够在存在噪声数据和制造差异的情况下可靠地估计执行器健康状态，为软体水下机器人在线健康监测提供了有效方案。

title: Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning
summary: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

AI.tldr: SynGAP是一种基于自适应梯度预条件的无任务持续学习框架，通过维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均来模拟生物突触可塑性，在优化过程中将动态元可塑性状态转化为有界乘法掩码，选择性衰减对关键历史参数的更新，从而在不依赖任务标签和大量内存开销的情况下缓解灾难性遗忘。在Split CIFAR-100和CORe50基准上分别取得显著优于EWC++和ER的效果。
AI.motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）理论和突触元可塑性（突触的连续、历史依赖的神经营养调节）自然避免灾难性遗忘，而人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境。现有解决方案通常需要任务标签或产生巨大内存开销，偏离生物现实。
AI.method: SynGAP将局部化的突触神经调节重新定义为优化驱动的过程：维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均以实时模拟元可塑性；在优化步骤中，将这些动态元可塑性状态转化为有界乘法掩码来预处理原始梯度，选择性地衰减对关键历史参数的更新。
AI.result: 在Split CIFAR-100基准上，相比EWC++准确率提升4倍，相比Experience Replay (ER)提升近10%，遗忘度量降低超过10%；在CORe50基准上达到约68%的准确率，较优化器基线提升10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将连续的生物元可塑性数学化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，SynGAP提供了一种高度鲁棒且内存高效的边缘自适应智能解决方案，在无任务标签条件下有效缓解灾难性遗忘。

title: PE-CSNet: An equivariant network architecture with learnable patch-based sparse representation
summary: Compressive sensing (CS) enables accurate signal reconstruction from sparse measurements and is widely applied in medical imaging, remote sensing, and image compression. However, designing an effective, task-specific sparse transform and the corresponding optimization procedure for high-quality CS remains challenging. This process typically requires expert domain knowledge and laborious parameter tuning. To address this issue, we present a Patch-based Equivariant deep unrolling architecture, termed PE-CSNet, for accurate CS recovery. While traditional CS methods generally use predefined patch-based transform sparsity, we generalize this idea by incorporating learnable transform sparsity that adapts to the specific CS task through an optimization-driven process. Specifically, we first establish a generalized patch-based CS model, which we solve via a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm. The BCD solver is then unrolled into a deep neural network, where all parameters of both the CS model and solver are learned through end-to-end training. To improve data efficiency, we introduce a stochastic equivariant training strategy that exploits the patch-wise structure of the network, enabling PE-CSNet to learn effectively even from limited data. We further provide a simpler, parameter-shared version of PE-CSNet and briefly discuss its convergence as an iterative solver. For practical applications, the network uses stage-specific (non-shared) parameters to enhance its expressive power and thereby improve its performance. On the tasks of CS magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) and CS coded diffraction patterns (CS-CDP), PE-CSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fast computational speed, outperforming traditional methods and existing deep unrolling methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于补丁等变深层展开架构的压缩感知重建网络PE-CSNet，通过将块坐标下降算法展开为深度神经网络，引入可学习的变换稀疏性，并采用随机等变训练策略提升数据效率，在CS-MRI和CS-CDP任务上达到最先进的精度和速度。
AI.motivation: 传统压缩感知方法需要专家领域知识和费力地参数调优来设计任务特定的稀疏变换和优化过程，这限制了其在实际应用中的效果和推广性。本文旨在通过深度展开网络自动学习任务特定的稀疏表示，消除手工设计的负担。
AI.method: 首先建立广义的基于补丁的CS模型，使用块坐标下降（BCD）算法求解，然后将BCD求解器展开为深度神经网络，所有参数通过端到端训练学习。为提升数据效率，引入随机等变训练策略利用网络的补丁结构。同时提供参数共享的简化版本并讨论其收敛性，实际应用中使用阶段特定参数增强表达能力。
AI.result: 在CS-MRI和CS-CDP两类任务上，PE-CSNet达到最先进的精度且计算速度快，性能优于传统方法和现有的深层展开方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将优化驱动的展开框架与可学习的补丁稀疏变换相结合，并辅以等变训练策略，PE-CSNet有效解决了传统CS中稀疏变换设计困难的问题，实现了高精度、高效率的压缩感知重建。

title: Geometry-Aware Online Mapping for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient photorealistic view synthesis and is rapidly being adopted in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) systems for online mapping. In these systems, a Gaussian map must be expanded and refined incrementally while tracking runs in real time, so initialization and density control directly determine where limited computation and iterations are spent. This contrasts with offline 3DGS reconstruction, where such heuristics can be amortized over long optimization schedules. However, most 3DGS-SLAM pipelines inherit initialization and density-control heuristics from offline reconstruction, which can become brittle under the strict per-keyframe optimization budgets and incremental map growth of online SLAM. In this work, we revisit these heuristics in a decoupled 3DGS-SLAM setting and propose three geometry-aware methods that operate in the mapping thread: transmittance-preserving densification, camera-aware scale initialization from depth and intrinsics, and error-guided densification that focuses new primitives on high-residual regions. Our results show consistent improvements in rendering quality with negligible overhead, highlighting the coupling between photometric residuals and pose uncertainty in online SLAM. We will open-source our code to the community to foster growth and validate reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对3DGS-SLAM系统中直接继承离线重建的初始化和密度控制启发式方法在在线SLAM严格优化预算下表现脆弱的问题，提出了三种几何感知方法：透射率保持的稠密化、基于深度和内参的相机感知尺度初始化、以及基于误差引导的稠密化，在解耦式3DGS-SLAM设置中实现了渲染质量的持续提升且开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 3DGS正在被快速应用于SLAM系统进行在线建图，但大多数3DGS-SLAM管线直接继承了离线3DGS重建的初始化和密度控制启发式方法。离线重建可以通过长时间优化来摊销这些启发式方法的开销，而在在线SLAM中，受限于每关键帧严格的优化预算和地图的增量增长，这些启发式方法变得脆弱，导致建图质量和跟踪性能下降。
AI.method: 在解耦式3DGS-SLAM设置中提出三种几何感知方法，均运行在建图线程：(1) 透射率保持的稠密化（transmittance-preserving densification），在稠密化时考虑光线透射率以避免不必要的新基元；(2) 利用深度和内参进行相机感知的尺度初始化（camera-aware scale initialization），使新高斯基元具有与相机几何一致的合适尺度；(3) 误差引导的稠密化（error-guided densification），将新基元聚焦在高残差区域以更有效地分配计算资源。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的三种方法在渲染质量上取得了持续一致的改进，且额外的计算开销可忽略不计，同时揭示了在线SLAM中光度残差与位姿不确定性之间的耦合关系。
AI.conclusion: 重新审视在线SLAM中的3DGS初始化和密度控制启发式方法是必要的且有效的，几何感知的方法能够在严格的在线优化预算下提升建图质量。作者将开源代码以促进社区发展并验证实验的可复现性。

title: Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network
comment: Quite extensive paper, more than 100 pages
summary: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一实验框架下研究了分数阶优化方法与分形激活函数之间的交互作用。作者在Ackley和Himmelblau基准曲面（含标准形式和Weierstrass型扰动）以及十个分类数据集的前馈神经网络上，系统比较了分数阶优化器家族与常规/分形激活函数的组合。结果表明两者存在有用的但具选择性的配对：正则化型分数阶缩放与特定分形激活在网络训练中表现良好，而Grünwald–Letnikov记忆在扰动曲面上最相关；自适应记忆在多种场景下优于普通记忆替代，表明可控分数阶记忆是有前景的方向而非普适替代方案。
AI.motivation: 分数阶优化方法和分形激活函数是两条独立的改进神经网络训练的路径，但此前缺乏对二者交互作用的系统性研究。作者希望通过统一实验框架探究这两种技术是否互补、在何种条件下能够协同增效，从而为神经网络的优化策略提供更具针对性的指导。
AI.method: 构建统一的实验框架，包括：(1) 在Ackley和Himmelblau基准曲面（标准形式及添加Weierstrass型扰动）上评估各类分数阶优化器；(2) 在十个分类数据集上训练前馈神经网络，对比常规与分形激活函数；(3) 比较的方法涵盖标准优化方法、正则化型优化器、显式和自适应记忆的分数阶优化器以及其他具有代表性的文献方法。
AI.result: 分数阶优化与分形激活的组合显示出选择性：正则化型分数阶缩放与选定的分形激活在网络训练中表现良好；Grünwald–Letnikov记忆在扰动曲面上效果最显著；自适应记忆在多个场景中优于普通记忆替代方案。但二者并未在所有组合中普遍表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 可控的分数阶记忆机制是一个有前景的研究方向，但不应被视为普适替代方案。分数阶优化与分形激活的配对需要根据具体任务和数据特性进行选择，二者的协同作用具有条件性。

title: Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.

AI.tldr: Path2ST是一个将H&E染色图像预测空间基因表达的层次化自回归框架，通过显式建模细胞-组织生物学层级，实现跨模态语义翻译，在三个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有H&E到空间转录组预测方法将H&E图像视为通用视觉输入，忽略了其内在的生物学层级结构——空间组织的细胞类型共同构成功能性的组织微环境，进而调控局部基因表达程序。这种忽略导致预测缺乏生物学一致性。
AI.method: 将H&E-to-ST预测建模为跨模态语义翻译任务，提出Path2ST框架，包含三个关键组件：(i) 层次化细胞-组织条件机制，融合显式/隐式细胞特征与组织级语义表征构建层次化条件信号；(ii) 尺度自适应自回归生成过程，基于层次化语义词汇表实现由粗到细的生物学一致表达合成；(iii) SpectraLoss全频谱损失，联合施加序数保真、建模转录爆发、并对齐语义结构与细胞类型。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明Path2ST达到最先进性能，生成高度准确且空间连贯的转录组谱。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模H&E图像的生物学层级结构（细胞→组织微环境→基因表达），Path2ST有效弥合了形态学与转录组学之间的语义鸿沟，为空间转录组预测提供了更具生物学可解释性的方案。

title: From Continuous Design to Delay-Aware Discrete Synthesis: Guaranteed High-Bandwidth Joint Control for PMSM Drives
summary: The increasing dynamic demands of modern robotic joints require current controllers to achieve high bandwidth over wide operating ranges of speed, acceleration, and torque, where communication, computation, and discrete-time effects can no longer be neglected. Conventional PMSM current controllers are typically designed in continuous time and subsequently discretized, leaving the sampling frequency and the impact of implementation delays largely to heuristic selection and iterative validation. This paper introduces a task-aware, delay-extended discrete-time joint model that explicitly accounts for physical communication and computation delays and enables direct synthesis of a discrete PI current controller with prescribed bandwidth and delay guarantees throughout the operating envelope. The framework analytically determines the minimum required sampling frequency, controller gains, and DC-link voltage needed to satisfy the specified motor and joint performance. Simulations across a range of dynamic requirements validate the methodology and demonstrate substantially reduced sampling-frequency and DC-link-voltage requirements compared with conventional continuous-time-based design. Experiments on a newly developed custom robotic joint further validate the proposed framework under real embedded implementation conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向任务的、考虑延迟的离散时间关节模型，用于机器人关节PMSM电流控制器的直接综合，能够解析地确定最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压需求，并在仿真和定制机器人关节实验中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现代机器人关节的动态需求日益增长，要求电流控制器在宽速度、加速度和扭矩工作范围内保持高带宽，然而传统PMSM电流控制器在连续时间域设计后再离散化，采样频率和实现延迟的影响主要依赖启发式选择和迭代验证，缺乏系统的设计框架。
AI.method: 论文引入了一个任务感知的、延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，显式建模物理通信和计算延迟；基于该模型直接综合具有指定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器；通过解析方法确定满足电机和关节性能所需的最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压。
AI.result: 仿真覆盖了多种动态需求场景，验证了方法论的有效性，并表明与传统基于连续时间的设计相比，该方法能显著降低采样频率和直流母线电压需求。在定制研发的机器人关节上的嵌入式实验进一步验证了该框架在实际实现条件下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种从连续时间离散化设计转向直接离散域综合的完整方法论，能够更高效地满足机器人关节高动态性能需求，同时降低系统资源（采样频率）和硬件（直流母线电压）要求。

title: Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1
summary: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowBD-E1框架，一种早期循环生成式预测方法，仅用最初9个循环即可预测工业级33 kW铁铬液流电池未来完整的充电V/I轨迹，在289个循环中实现了0.731%的联合V/I MAPE和低于1%的SOH估计误差。
AI.motivation: 长时间静态储能需要能够在显著容量损失累积前检测电池退化的方法。铁铬液流电池因使用丰富廉价的活性物质而具有吸引力，但其操作受缓慢铬动力学、析氢、膜交叉和电解液不平衡等耦合过程影响。现有研究多聚焦锂离子电池或将退化压缩为标量容量/SOH标签，缺乏对完整V/I轨迹演化的早期预测能力。
AI.method: FlowBD-E1采用多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器组成的生成式架构，从早期循环中预测完整未来充电V/I轨迹。比较了三种部署策略：单步潜空间外推(SLE)、递归潜空间预测(RLF)和教师强制更新(TFU)。
AI.result: 使用289个循环中的前9个循环，RLF策略在剩余生命周期上实现了0.731%的联合V/I MAPE，SOH估计误差低于1% MAPE。消融实验和独立序列测试表明，年龄感知生成架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，在工业验证条件下保持亚百分比误差。
AI.conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可以将短暂的调试记录转化为液流电池管理的长期诊断信号，为实现基于V/I轨迹形态的早期退化检测提供了可行途径。

title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. An ancillary analysis-ready package supports exact aggregate reproduction without model inference. Code and reproduction package: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/query-interaction-reproduction
summary:
A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.
  The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport.
  Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究查询-关系删除在改善已编辑槽位的同时降低包含该槽位的预测集效用的张力。基于两个ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点、每个检查点710个配对图像-关系单元的选择条件证据，发现目标减对照的复合对比在局部为正、固定分配为负，DETR与DINO在重新匹配后表现出不同的跨读数持久性，结论是选择条件删除敏感性，其持久性取决于读数和干预算子。
AI.motivation: 编辑模型中的特定槽位（查询-关系删除）会改善目标槽位，但可能降低整个预测集的效用，即存在局部编辑成功与全局实用性之间的张力。作者希望系统性地量化这种张力，并在两个DETR家族检查点上验证其是否存在、是否一致、以及是否依赖具体干预和读数方式。
AI.method: 使用两个ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点（DETR与DINO），每个检查点采集710个配对图像-关系单元。主要对比采用"目标删除减去匹配的主动对照"的复合对比设计——对照删除同一主导源但在不同的记录接收者处。在重新匹配前后分别统计对比符号，使用固定赋值/固定映射分析，并比较硬删除与质量保持编辑两种干预算子。
AI.result: 目标减对照对比在两个检查点均表现出局部为正、固定分配为负的反号模式：DETR中302/710单元、DINO中460/710单元呈现该模式；重新匹配后分别为285/710和433/710。重新匹配和原生选择性吸收了足够DETR的均值损失使其区间跨越零，而DINO区间仍为负，表明跨读数持久性因检查点而异。
AI.conclusion: 局部干预成功并不决定联合解码集的后果。受支持的结论是选择条件删除敏感性，其持久性取决于读数和干预算子。研究未识别出干预不变的边缘机制、检测器级退化、群体患病率或训练时正则化器的价值。

title: SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Humanoids 2026
summary: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.

AI.tldr: SkillComposer是一个交互式自然语言机器人编程系统，采用生成-测试架构，让LLM迭代生成并修订机器人程序，并将成功程序压缩为可复用的宏技能，以支持复杂多步任务的编程。通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究验证了其在操作与照护任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自然语言接口可以降低机器人编程门槛，但现有系统在处理复杂任务时存在局限：LLM在简单命令上表现良好，却难以生成多步任务代码、分解高层指令或复用已有解决方案，需要一种能持续学习可复用程序抽象的系统。
AI.method: SkillComposer采用生成-测试（generate-test）架构：LLM迭代生成并修订机器人程序直至成功执行；成功程序通过在线库学习算法处理，将重复出现的函数序列压缩为可复用的宏技能（macro skills），供未来任务重用。
AI.result: 通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究，在机器人操作和照护任务上验证了系统效果。结果表明，评估者引导的生成过程和学习到的抽象能够提升任务成功率与可用性，同时减少用户在自然语言机器人编程中的投入。
AI.conclusion: SkillComposer证明了结合LLM迭代生成与在线库学习的系统可以显著改善复杂机器人任务的自然语言编程体验，持续积累的可复用技能是提升系统能力的关键。

title: Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos
summary:
In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自编码器的固定点特性与边缘混沌（Edge-of-Chaos, EoC）的概念。作者针对自编码器引入局部与全局EoC，分别控制输入的小扰动和任意扰动，并分别利用随机矩阵理论的谱技术和Sudakov-Fernique不等式（针对高斯过程）进行分析。
AI.motivation: 自编码器作为一类特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可通过固定点刻画，这自然引出固定点的存在性、稳定性和吸引域问题。边缘混沌作为深度神经网络理论中描述有序与混沌信号传播临界状态的重要概念，此前已在多类神经网络中通过平均场方法引入，但尚未针对自编码器进行专门研究。本文旨在将EoC概念适配到自编码器，以研究其稳定性。
AI.method: 本文基于自编码器的压缩映射性质来研究固定点的稳定性。具体方法包括：(1) 利用随机矩阵理论（RMT）的谱技术分析局部EoC，控制输入的小扰动；(2) 利用Sudakov-Fernique不等式（针对高斯过程）分析全局EoC，控制输入的任意扰动。文章将EoC分为局部和全局两个层次，分别对应不同的扰动规模。
AI.result: 作者成功为自编码器定义了局部和全局两种EoC概念，并分别给出了相应的数学分析框架。局部EoC借助RMT谱方法处理，全局EoC则通过Sudakov-Fernique不等式研究，从而在理论上刻画了自编码器固定点的稳定性与临界行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文为自编码器的稳定性分析提供了一种基于固定点与EoC视角的新理论框架。通过将EoC概念从一般DNN适配到自编码器，并区分局部与全局扰动情形，建立了自编码器在临界状态下的稳定性理论基础，拓展了RMT和非线性分析在深度学习理论中的应用。

title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.

AI.tldr: VideoGAIA是一个全新的智能体视频理解基准，将视频理解从单轮问答转变为多轮、工具增强的交互过程，要求模型迭代感知视频、调用外部工具并整合多模态证据。271个由模型与人类共同设计的任务中，包含GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3在内的前沿模型准确率均低于60%，证明该基准能够有效评估下一代多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准（如Video-MME）上先进模型已达约90%准确率，单轮视频理解任务日趋饱和，难以区分不同模型的智能水平，迫切需要更复杂的基准来评估高级MLLM的能力。
AI.method: 将视频理解形式化为多轮、工具增强的智能体交互过程，模型需迭代感知视频、调用外部工具、收集补充信息、跨轮整合多模态证据。共构建271个模型与人协作设计的任务，每个实例由三位人类专家独立验证正确性与难度。
AI.result: 所有评估的MLLM（包括GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3等前沿模型）在VideoGAIA上的准确率均低于60%，远低于其在Video-MME上的表现，验证了该基准的高难度和区分度。
AI.conclusion: VideoGAIA作为高质量、及时的基准，能够有效推动视频理解从传统单轮问答向智能体式视频理解范式转变，为评估下一代MLLM提供重要工具。

title: Evidence of Absence: Cross-Modal Abductive Risk Perception to Sustain World Models When Vision Fails
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Working draft prepared for journal submission
summary: A structured world-state (entities, relations, context, and predictive cues) is designed to preserve prediction-critical content when perception degrades, but it presumes observations to populate it; when the primary visual modality is occluded or degraded, those observations may be missing. We address how to sustain the world model from a complementary modality by treating the absence of expected co-evidence as evidence of a hidden cause. The abductive framework is modality-agnostic; this article instantiates it acoustically. A microphone-array front-end estimates the bearing of engine and tire sources and extracts approach-rate evidence (Doppler when a stable tone exists, a broadband looming readout otherwise); the event "signature present, visual co-evidence absent" then triggers abductive inference of a hidden road user, emitting a calibrated risk advisory rather than a control command. Recoverability of the hidden state is analyzed as an identifiability question separating shared from modality-unique information, and cueing is cast as Neyman-Pearson detection under an explicit false-alarm budget. On real occluded-approach recordings at blind junctions, the method warns a mean 1.7 seconds before line-of-sight entry, matches the sustained-window variant of the published acoustic baseline's detection rate with 42% fewer false alarms, localizes to 3.4 degrees median once in view, is well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.034), and keeps hazard awareness above 0.87 under staged vision degradation that collapses a vision-only channel to 0.03. We also measure the method's limits: calibration transfers to an unseen junction almost losslessly, the signature classifier does not, and moving-ego noise is the binding deployment constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文针对主视觉模态被遮挡或退化时结构化世界状态无法被观测填充的问题，提出了一种跨模态的溯因推理框架：将“预期共证据缺失”视为“隐藏原因存在”的信号。该框架以声学方式实现，利用麦克风阵列估计引擎和轮胎声源方位、提取接近率信息，当检测到声学签名但缺乏视觉共证据时，溯因推断隐藏的道路使用者并发出校准过风险提示。在真实盲路口遮挡接近录音上，该方法在视线进入前1.7秒发出警告，以少42%的误报达到基准检测率，中位定位误差3.4度，校准误差0.034，并在视觉退化下保持0.87以上的危险感知（对比视觉单通道跌至0.03）。作者还测量了方法局限：校准可近乎无损迁移到未见路口，但签名分类器不能；移动本车噪声是部署的关键约束。
AI.motivation: 结构化世界状态（实体、关系、上下文、预测线索）的设计初衷是在感知退化时保留预测关键内容，但它假设有观测来填充这些状态。当主视觉模态被遮挡或退化（如盲路口）时，观测可能缺失，导致世界模型无法维持。核心动机是解决如何从互补模态维持世界模型的问题，特别是将缺失的视觉共证据转化为隐藏原因的推理信号。
AI.method: 提出一个模态无关的溯因框架，本文以声学模态实例化。麦克风阵列前端估计引擎和轮胎声源的方位，提取接近率证据（有稳定音调时用多普勒，否则用宽带逼近读数）；当出现"声学签名存在、视觉共证据缺失"的事件时，触发对隐藏道路使用者的溯因推理并发出校准的风险提示而非控制指令。隐藏状态的可恢复性被建模为可辨识性问题（区分共享信息与模态特有信息），提示被建模为在显式误报预算下的Neyman-Pearson检测。
AI.result: 在真实遮挡接近录音（盲路口）上：在视线进入前平均1.7秒发出警告；与已发表声学基线的持续窗口变体检测率持平但误报少42%；一旦入视中位定位误差3.4度；校准良好（期望校准误差0.034）；在使视觉单通道跌至0.03的分阶段视觉退化下仍保持0.87以上的危险感知。局限测量：校准几乎无损迁移到未见路口，但签名分类器不能迁移；移动本车噪声是部署的关键制约。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态溯因推理能够有效解决视觉缺失条件下的世界模型维持问题。该方法的校准性能具有迁移稳健性，但签名分类器的泛化性和移动本车噪声抑制是有待克服的关键瓶颈，是实际部署的主要约束。

title: Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays
comment: 14 pages. Seed-pinned, regression-gated harness (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/verifydoc . Companion benchmark paper: VerifyDocBench
summary: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断了文档提取系统中"逐字段接受/审查"流程在真实文档上违反选择性风险控制的问题，识别出三种失败模式（文档聚类、分数重拟合泄漏、平票病理），并提出"有效性阶梯"（validity ladder）框架。通过拟合/验证集分裂协议恢复预期选择性风险控制，Mondrian Learn-then-Test提供逐组PAC证书，并进行了盲审标注员黄金审计验证。相关工作已Apache-2.0开源。
AI.motivation: 文档提取系统需要一种信任契约：仅当接受字段的错误率受控（选择性风险≤α）时才接受该字段。然而现实文档中，自然的程序会静默违反这一保证。作者在大量真实Claude-sonnet-5字段数据上发现系统化失败，需要设计严格的统计保证框架。
AI.method: 在13,859个真实字段上诊断出三种失败模式：文档聚类（设计效应1.84-2.45）、分数重拟合泄漏（覆盖率0.416而风险0.127，违反α=0.10）、平票病理（退化分数导致阈值网格坍缩）。提出"有效性阶梯"框架，按层级规定保证形式：拟合/验证集分裂协议恢复预期选择性风险控制；Mondrian Learn-then-Test使用精确二项尾部给出逐组PAC证书（含字段iid、聚类校正、文档iid三种变体）；支持箱（support-bin）作为预指定的来源分类学在各严格层级上获胜。最后通过冻结配置确认和三个盲审标注员的黄金审计验证实际层级的接受集风险。
AI.result: 拟合/验证协议在α=0.10处恢复覆盖率0.318、风险0.096（生产变体0.326），但这是按平均意义的点估计，47.5%的重分割中实际风险超过α。Mondrian Learn-then-Test给出逐组PAC证书：字段iid 0.171@0.068，聚类校正0.140，文档iid 0.060——最后者才是唯一匹配文档结构的层级。支持箱在sonnet CORD捕获上赢得所有严格层级（p<1e-4，Bonferroni校正），但在haiku/qwen上不复制；高精度语料上池化阈值胜出。冻结配置确认在claude-haiku-4-5上两个风险水平均成立，盲审审计中接受集实际风险1.3%远低于10%预算（Fleiss' kappa=0.83）。
AI.conclusion: 文档提取的逐字段选择性风险控制需要明确的保证层级，现实中应从期望控制升级到PAC证书，且必须考虑文档聚类结构。没有任何单一方法在所有语料上普适：学习方法在高精度语料上更优，条件化方法在低精度且池化方法无法证明时发挥作用。系统已开源，采用种子固定和回归门控流程确保可复现性。

title: DeCo-MIL: Debiased Counterfactual Reasoning for Long-Tailed Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, under long-tailed distributions, MIL-based WSI analysis faces a nested dual long-tail: an inter-slide class long tail and an intra-slide long tail of instance-level discriminative evidence. The two long tails are coupled: tail classes have few training slides, while their limited diagnostic evidence is concentrated in a few patches and obscured by abundant within-bag redundancy. This coupling biases models toward head classes and degrades rare-class recognition. To address this, we propose DeCo-MIL for long-tailed WSI analysis, which jointly alleviates the nested dual long-tail through frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning. For the inner long tail, DeCo-MIL clusters patches into tissue-morphology anchors, replaces each anchor with its matched normal prototype to perform a counterfactual intervention, and estimates its counterfactual contribution to the ground-truth class using class-frequency-corrected predictions. These contributions guide redundancy masking to preserve scarce discriminative instances. For the outer long tail, DeCo-MIL constructs anchor-stratified pseudo-bags from redundancy-reduced bags and combines tail-aware oversampling with consistency regularization, increasing effective supervision for tail classes while preserving tissue-morphology composition. Extensive experiments on three long-tailed WSI benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tail-class recognition and overall classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeCo-MIL，一种针对长尾分布下全切片图像（WSI）弱监督多实例学习（MIL）分析的方法。它通过频次去偏的反事实推理，联合缓解嵌套式双重长尾问题（类别层面的长尾和实例层面的证据长尾），在三个长尾WSI基准上取得了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 长尾分布下MIL-based WSI分析面临嵌套式双重长尾：类别层面存在类别间长尾，实例层面存在判别性证据的长尾，且两者相互耦合——尾类训练切片少，其有限的诊断证据集中在少数patch中并被袋内冗余掩盖，导致模型偏向头类、尾类识别性能下降。
AI.method: DeCo-MIL通过频次去偏的反事实推理联合缓解嵌套式双重长尾。内层长尾处理：将patch聚类为组织形态锚点，用匹配的正常原型替换每个锚点进行反事实干预，并用类别频次校正的预测估计其对真实类别的反事实贡献，据此指导冗余掩码以保留稀缺判别实例。外层长尾处理：从冗余减少后的袋构建锚点分层伪袋，结合尾类感知过采样与一致性正则化，增加尾类有效监督同时保持组织形态组成。
AI.result: 在三个长尾WSI基准上的大量实验表明，DeCo-MIL在尾类识别和整体分类性能上均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: DeCo-MIL通过反事实推理和频次去偏机制有效解决了长尾WSI分析中嵌套式双重长尾的耦合问题，验证了联合缓解双层长尾对提升尾类识别能力的重要性。

title: GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what it sees, but actively learn how to remember--discovering which objects to track precisely, how aggressively to update them, and what to discard, all learned end-to-end without hand-designed rules. Crucially, this active paradigm is realized by unifying memory update and readout as two sides of the same cognitive process, enabling bidirectional flow where task needs shape update strategies and vice versa. To instantiate this vision, we introduce GaussMemory, which leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent geometric substrate. On LIBERO, GaussMemory outperforms MemoryVLA on Goal and Long-10; on VLABench, it surpasses $π_0$-FAST by +5.2% (Track 1) and +6.0% (Track 6).

AI.tldr: 本文提出GaussMemory，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的主动式任务驱动空间记忆系统，将记忆从被动存储转变为主动学习如何记忆，统一记忆更新与读取为双向认知过程，在LIBERO和VLABench基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D空间记忆系统仅作为被动记录器，使用固定的手工规则存储观测，对所有场景元素一视同仁（如抓取目标和背景墙同等对待），缺乏任务驱动性。作者认为机器人记忆不应仅记录所见，而应主动学习如何记忆——发现哪些对象需要精确追踪、如何激进更新、丢弃什么，无需手工设计规则。
AI.method: 提出从被动存储到主动任务驱动空间记忆的范式转变。核心思想是将记忆更新与读取统一为同一认知过程的两个侧面，实现双向信息流——任务需求塑造更新策略，更新策略反过来影响任务读取。具体实例化为GaussMemory，使用3D高斯泼溅作为持久几何基底。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，GaussMemory在Goal和Long-10任务上超越MemoryVLA；在VLABench基准上，相比π0-FAST分别提升+5.2%（Track 1）和+6.0%（Track 6）。
AI.conclusion: 通过端到端学习的主动记忆范式，机器人能够自主决定记忆什么、如何更新以及丢弃什么，显著提升长时程操作任务的性能，验证了从"记录所见"到"学习如何记忆"这一范式转换的有效性。

title: BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials
summary: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion.
