We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一个机器学习框架，用于高效构建和预测堆叠双层材料的结构与性质。该框架包含基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程，可低成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；以及BDIP-Net图神经网络，通过显式区分层内和层间相互作用来提升性质预测精度。在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA三个数据集上的实验表明，结构优化结果接近DFT-PBE-D3，BDIP-Net在性质预测上优于现有GNN和势函数方法。
AI.motivation: 堆叠双层材料表现出丰富的依赖于堆叠方式的性质，但其计算发现面临双重挑战：高精度的结构生成依赖昂贵的DFT优化，而现有机器学习模型在性质预测时未能显式区分层内强共价键与层间弱范德华相互作用这两种不同的相互作用类型。
AI.method: 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程，从单层构建模块和堆叠构型出发，以显著降低的计算成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；(2) BDIP-Net（Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network），一种图神经网络，通过相互作用特异的势表示和自适应消息融合，显式建模层内与层间相互作用。在两个数据集（BiDB、HetDB、SAMBA）上覆盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层体系进行评估。
AI.result: 基于MatterSim-D3的流程能够紧密复现DFT-PBE-D3优化的结构；BDIP-Net在双层材料性质预测上持续优于现有图神经网络和基于势函数的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过显式区分层内与层间相互作用，为堆叠双层材料的机器学习辅助发现提供了一条兼具结构生成效率和性质预测精度的有效路径。

title: AeroGround: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Aerial-Ground Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely employed in understanding and reasoning tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Existing UAV benchmarks primarily focus on aerial-view scenarios. However, whether current VLMs can perform well on understanding and reasoning tasks in aerial-ground collaborative scenarios which are practical in real-world applications like rescue and infrastructure inspection remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AeroGround, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning. AeroGround is built upon a simulated aerial-ground dataset containing approximately 29,000 multimodal observation groups from diverse open environments, and provides 2,250 high-quality question-answering instances covering cross-view correspondence, spatial understanding, and reasoning. Experiments on 16 pretrained VLMs, together with two domain-adapted variants, reveal a substantial gap between current models and human performance: the best model achieves an average accuracy of 54.4%, whereas humans reach 93.3%. By systematically revealing the strengths and limitations of existing models in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning, AeroGround provides a foundation for developing more capable aerial-ground collaborative embodied intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: AeroGround是一个针对航地协同推理场景的VLM基准测试，包含约29,000个多模态观测组和2,250个问答实例。当前最佳模型准确率仅54.4%，与人类93.3%的水平存在显著差距，揭示了现有VLM在航地协同任务上的能力不足。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV基准测试主要聚焦于纯空中视角场景，而航地协同场景（如救援、基础设施巡检）在实际应用中十分普遍，当前VLM在此类协同理解和推理任务上的表现尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 构建基于仿真的航地协同数据集，包含约29,000组多模态观测数据和2,250个高质量问答实例，涵盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理三类任务；对16个预训练VLM及2个领域自适应变体进行系统评估。
AI.result: 最佳模型在AeroGround上的平均准确率仅为54.4%，而人类可达93.3%，表明现有VLM在航地协同推理方面存在巨大性能差距。
AI.conclusion: AeroGround系统性地揭示了现有VLM在航地协同推理中的优势与局限，为开发更强的航地协同具身智能系统提供了基础。

title: HP2-SLAM: Adaptive Hybrid ICP for Robust and Efficient LiDAR SLAM
summary: Achieving robustness, accuracy, and efficiency simultaneously remains a central challenge in light detection and ranging (LiDAR) simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). While learning-based approaches deliver strong benchmark performance, they often require extensive training, substantial computational resources, and struggle to generalize to unseen or degenerate environments. Geometry-based methods are efficient and interpretable, yet their performance degrades in planar or repetitive scenes due to limitations of standard iterative closest point (ICP) formulations. We present HP2-SLAM, a minimalist yet robust LiDAR SLAM framework built around a neighborhood-size adaptive hybrid ICP. Our key insight is a planarity-aware adaptive threshold that dynamically classifies correspondences based on local geometric structure and density, thereby enabling a principled balance between point-to-plane and point-to-point residuals. This formulation stabilizes alignment in both structured and degenerate environments without feature engineering, learning modules, or dataset-specific tuning. Integrated into a complete SLAM pipeline with submap management, loop closure detection, and pose graph optimization, HP2-SLAM consistently outperforms strong geometry-based baselines across publicly available datasets while maintaining real-time performance on commodity hardware. Our results demonstrate that carefully designed geometric adaptation can achieve strong generalization and robustness without sacrificing simplicity or efficiency.

AI.tldr: HP2-SLAM 是一个基于邻域尺寸自适应混合ICP的极简LiDAR SLAM框架，通过平面感知的自适应阈值动态分类匹配点，在点-面与点-点残差间实现平衡，在不依赖特征工程、学习模块或数据集调参的情况下，在多种公开数据集上超越强几何基线方法，并在商用硬件上保持实时性能。
AI.motivation: 在LiDAR SLAM中同时实现鲁棒性、精度和效率仍是核心挑战。基于学习的方法虽有强基准表现，但需要大量训练和计算资源，且难以泛化到未见或退化环境；基于几何的方法高效可解释，但在平面或重复场景中因标准ICP公式的局限而性能下降。论文旨在通过几何自适应设计，在不牺牲简洁性和效率的前提下获得强泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出HP2-SLAM框架，核心是邻域尺寸自适应混合ICP。关键洞察是引入平面感知的自适应阈值，基于局部几何结构和点云密度动态分类对应点，从而在点-面（point-to-plane）残差和点-点（point-to-point）残差之间实现原则性平衡。该方法在结构化环境和退化环境（如平面、重复场景）中均能稳定配准。整个系统集成了子图管理、回环检测和位姿图优化，构成完整SLAM管线，无需特征工程、学习模块或特定数据集的参数调优。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上与强几何基线方法对比，HP2-SLAM在精度和鲁棒性方面持续超越基线，同时在商用硬件上保持实时运行性能。实验证明了精心设计的几何自适应方法能够在无需复杂学习模块的情况下实现强泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过平面感知的自适应阈值设计，纯几何方法可以在退化环境中获得显著的鲁棒性提升，并在精度、效率和泛化性之间达到良好的平衡。该工作验证了"谨慎设计的几何自适应"是LiDAR SLAM中一种兼具简洁性与竞争力的技术路线。

title: Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何在强化学习（RL）智能体中嵌入伦理行为，指出仅基于平均奖励训练会导致智能体在少数坏情节中集中违反伦理规范。作者在Craftax基准上比较了四种训练方法（标量惩罚+终止、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应Lagrangian约束、基于ESR准则的每情节非补偿性效用优化），发现在均值前沿上四种方法无差异，但按每情节分布评估时显著区分——ESR方法能在每个情节中严格守住违规预算（最差十分位1.04次），而权重扫描方法最差情节违规翻倍（2.20次）。作者主张当伦理违规不能在情节间平均化时，训练与评估都应针对每情节分布而非均值。
AI.motivation: RL智能体基于单一奖励信号训练时，会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距。在伦理行为的场景下，智能体可以通过在少数坏情节中集中违规而"平均看起来"合乎伦理，但这无法被接受——因为在一个情节中伤害的个体不会因另一个情节的良好行为而恢复。因此需要比较不同的训练方法，看哪种方法能在无关平均表现的情况下，提供每情节层面的伦理保障。
AI.method: 在Craftax开放式生存基准上比较四种伦理训练方法：(1)标量惩罚加终止；(2)线性多目标权重扫描；(3)自适应Lagrangian约束；(4)基于Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR)准则的每情节非补偿性效用优化。所有方法均采用统一的基于检测器的协议进行评估，统计每个情节中的每次违规而不加删减。并设置了观察增强对照组，以区分训练目标和观察信息的影响。
AI.result: 在平均回报对平均违规率的边界上，四种方法难以区分；但在每情节层面它们显著分离。在匹配的平均回报下，ESR智能体在几乎所有情节中都守住了一次违规的预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07次），Lagrangian方法泄漏超出预算（1.14±0.03次），权重扫描方法最差情节违规数翻倍（2.20±0.20次）。观察增强对照组表明这种分离源于训练目标而非观察信息，且每情节保证在均值前沿上不产生额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 当伦理违规不能在情节间平均化时，训练和评估都必须针对每情节分布而非均值。ESR准则下的非补偿性效用优化能够提供可靠的每情节伦理保证，而传统方法（如权重扫描和Lagrangian）虽然在平均指标上看似等效，但在每情节分布上存在实质性的违规泄漏。

title: Braided Vision Transformer for Stroke Detection in Multi-view Retinal Fundus Imaging
summary: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, emphasizing the importance of its accurate and immediate assessment. Retinal fundus imaging has emerged as a promising modality for stroke assessment, as the retina reflects cerebrovascular and neurological risk factors. Contrary to conventional neuroimaging techniques, retinal fundus imaging offers a non-invasive, cost-effective, and portable alternative for rapid screening. This paper explores the feasibility of retinal fundus imaging for stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) detection using macula-centric and optic nerve head-centric views captured from both eyes. Our study introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first vision transformer model for retinal fundus imaging in stroke assessment, offering a novel approach for capturing retinal patterns. Thereby, we propose the Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) model, which extracts representative features from the given multi-view images while simultaneously capturing inter-view relationships across both eyes, enabling a more informative understanding of retinal biomarkers associated with cerebrovascular events. Experiments conducted on our collected Stroke-Data dataset demonstrate that BViT achieves an AUC score of 0.75 for stroke detection, outperforming regular vision transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于视网膜眼底成像中风评估的视觉Transformer模型——Braided Vision Transformer (BViT)，利用双眼多视角（黄斑中心与视神经盘中心）眼底图像进行中风和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）检测，在Stroke-Data数据集上达到0.75的AUC，优于常规视觉Transformer。
AI.motivation: 中风是全球致死致残的主要原因，需要快速准确的评估手段。传统的神经影像技术虽有效但昂贵且不便携，而视网膜眼底成像作为一种非侵入性、低成本、便携的替代方案，能够反映脑血管和神经风险因素，因此被探索用于中风的快速筛查。
AI.method: 提出Braided Vision Transformer (BViT)模型，采用双眼多视角（macula-centric和optic nerve head-centric）视网膜眼底图像，通过编织机制同时提取多视图特征并捕捉双眼之间的跨视图关系，以更全面地理解与脑血管事件相关的视网膜生物标志物。这是首个将视觉Transformer应用于视网膜眼底成像中风评估的研究。
AI.result: 在自建Stroke-Data数据集上的实验表明，BViT在中风检测任务中取得0.75的AUC分数，性能优于常规视觉Transformer模型。
AI.conclusion: BViT模型验证了利用多视角视网膜眼底图像进行中风检测的可行性，通过捕捉双眼之间的跨视图关系提升了检测性能，为视网膜眼底成像在中风快速筛查中的应用提供了新的技术路径。

title: NPU Offloading of a Frozen Visual Encoder for Robot Policy Training
summary: When a robot policy is trained for a new task or dataset, its visual encoder can be frozen and only its action generation module trained, reducing training cost. Freezing removes the encoder's backward pass, but its forward pass must still run at every training step because the input images change, so it keeps consuming GPU compute. We therefore ask whether moving this computation to a low power AI accelerator such as an NPU can reduce total energy despite the added data transfer and longer training time, and how it affects policy performance. We built an asynchronous training pipeline that uses both a GPU and an NPU for the AR-Actor specialist. The frozen visual encoder runs in A8W8 INT8 on a Mobilint Aries2 NPU, while the FP32 action expert is trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU. We compared a GPU-only baseline with four conditions, L1 to L4, which gradually extend NPU offloading from one to four Transformer encoder layers. Each condition was trained for 30,000 steps with three random seeds. We measured GPU board power for the GPU-only condition and combined GPU and NPU board power for the NPU conditions. Energy per sample decreased by 17.1% in L1, which offloaded ResNet18 and the first encoder layer, and by 27.9% in L4, which offloaded ResNet18 and all four encoder layers. In contrast, training time per sample increased by 15.2% in L1 and 37.7% in L4, and peak allocated GPU memory decreased by 19.8 to 20.7%. The 15 resulting policies were each evaluated with the same 300 environment seeds, for a total of 4,500 simulator rollouts. The combined success rate was 93.33% for GPU-only and 91.44 to 92.89% for the NPU conditions. These results show that NPU offloading of a frozen visual encoder can reduce training energy, but it increases training time and lowers policy success rate by 0.44 to 1.89 percentage points compared with GPU-only training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在机器人策略训练中将冻结的视觉编码器计算从GPU卸载到NPU（Mobilint Aries2）以降低训练能耗。通过异步训练流水线，在AR-Actor模型上将ResNet18及1至4层Transformer编码器以INT8精度部署在NPU上，训练30,000步后，能耗每样本降低17.1%~27.9%，但训练时间增加15.2%~37.7%，GPU显存峰值降低约20%，成功率下降0.44~1.89个百分点。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉编码器虽消除了其反向传播，但其前向传播仍需在每个训练步骤中运行并消耗GPU计算资源。作者探究能否将该计算迁移到低功耗AI加速器（NPU）上，以在增加数据传输和延长训练时间的前提下仍降低总能耗，并评估对策略性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个GPU与NPU异步训练的流水线，用于AR-Actor机器人策略。冻结的视觉编码器以A8W8 INT8精度运行在Mobilint Aries2 NPU上，FP32的动作专家网络在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU上训练。设计了四种条件L1~L4，逐步将1至4层Transformer编码器从GPU卸载到NPU，每个条件训练30,000步并采用3个随机种子，同时测量GPU/NPU板级功耗、训练时间、显存占用及成功率。
AI.result: 与仅GPU基线相比：每样本能耗在L1（卸载ResNet18+1个编码器层）降低17.1%，在L4（卸载ResNet18+全部4个编码器层）降低27.9%；每样本训练时间分别增加15.2%和37.7%；GPU显存峰值降低19.8%~20.7%。共训练15个策略并在300个环境种子上评估（总计4,500次模拟），GPU-only成功率为93.33%，NPU条件为91.44%~92.89%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，将冻结视觉编码器卸载到NPU可以有效降低训练能耗（最多27.9%），同时节省约20%的GPU显存，但代价是训练时间显著增加和策略成功率小幅下降（0.44~1.89个百分点）。该方案在能耗敏感或显存受限场景下具有实用价值，但需在时间成本与性能损失之间做权衡。

title: DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance
summary: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

AI.tldr: 提出DUET，一种token级选择性on-policy蒸馏方法，通过在"可见禁令"与"不可见禁令"两个同权重教师间的token分歧作为监督信号，实现拒绝合规（prohibition compliance），在1.5B-8B Qwen模型上达到72.3-85.2%违规合规率同时保留88-93%正常效用。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的LLM部署依赖运行时注入的禁令（企业策略、PII红线、工具边界），这些禁令随请求和租户动态变化。传统后训练方法结构上不适用：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，DPO的序列级偏好与token局部化的违规不匹配。需要一种能从在线禁令中提取干净监督信号的方法。
AI.method: DUET由三个核心要素构成：(1) 双教师架构——一个看到禁令的positive教师与一个看不到禁令的negative教师，两教师权重相同，仅禁令可见性不同，因此token级分歧隔离了禁令的因果效应；(2) 信号清洗——丢弃一致token（冗余或前缀污染）；(3) 偏好引导学习——在token粒度将学生从negative教师推开、向positive教师拉近，将DPO式优化直接嵌入on-policy distillation，无需离线偏好数据。同时构建了包含五个任务族（显式拒绝、释义鲁棒性、过度拒绝）的工业级Prohibition-Compliance基准。
AI.result: 在1.5B-8B Qwen系列模型上，DUET实现72.3-85.2%的违规合规率，同时保持88-93%的正常效用，显著优于教师模型和其他蒸馏基线。在SysBench外部评估中确认了改进的安全性对齐，且GSM8K和MATH-500上仅有最小退化。
AI.conclusion: DUET通过双教师token级分歧提供了干净的禁令监督信号，弥合了传统序列级RLHF方法与token局部化违规之间的鸿沟，是在线、逐请求、逐租户禁令合规场景下的有效方案，兼具安全性与正常能力保持。

title: A Vision Transformer for ECG-Based Detection of Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction Across Multiple Clinical Sites
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material with 3 additional figures
summary: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is frequently asymptomatic and often detected only after advanced heart failure develops. Electrocardiograms are recorded routinely yet underused for this condition, because reduced LVEF has no single diagnostic waveform. We trained an ensemble of vision transformers from scratch to detect reduced LVEF ($\leq$40%) from 12-lead ECGs, analyzing each heartbeat individually, using 10,142 patients across seven sites in three US health systems. In a held-out external cohort of 4,092 patients from three geographically independent US clinical sites at a real-world reduced-LVEF prevalence of 8.72%, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.88 (95% CI 0.86-0.89), sensitivity 81.2%, specificity 81.0%, and negative predictive value 97.8%. Sensitivity remained high across sex, race, ethnicity, and comorbidity subgroups, while specificity was lower in older patients and those with atrial fibrillation or cardiomyopathy. Beat-level attention maps provided interpretability into the model's predictions, showing consistent focus on the QRS complex rather than the P wave. These findings support the potential of routine ECGs as a scalable first-pass triage step to identify patients who should undergo echocardiography for reduced ejection fraction across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Vision Transformer（ViT）集成模型的方法，从12导联心电图（ECG）中检测左心室射血分数降低（LVEF≤40%）的患者。模型在包含10,142名患者的七个临床中心数据上从零开始训练，在外部队列（4,092名患者，真实患病率8.72%）中达到0.88的AUROC、81.2%的敏感性和97.8%的阴性预测值，证明常规ECG可作为大规模筛查心衰高风险人群的第一步分诊工具。
AI.motivation: 左心室射血分数降低（reduced LVEF）往往无症状，常常在晚期心衰发展后才被诊断。心电图（ECG）虽被常规记录却因没有单一的诊断波形而未被充分利用于该疾病的检测，因此需要一种能够从常规ECG中准确检测reduced LVEF的方法，以实现早期识别和筛查。
AI.method: 研究者从零开始训练了一个Vision Transformer（ViT）集成模型，对每个心跳单独分析，从12导联ECG中检测reduced LVEF（≤40%）。训练数据来自美国三个医疗系统的七个临床中心共10,142名患者，模型通过逐心跳分析与集成策略提升检测性能，并利用beat-level注意力图提供可解释性。
AI.result: 在来自三个地理独立美国临床中心的外部验证队列（4,092名患者，reduced LVEF真实患病率为8.72%）中，模型取得AUROC为0.88（95% CI 0.86-0.89），敏感性81.2%，特异性81.0%，阴性预测值97.8%。敏感性在性别、种族、民族及合并症亚组中均保持高水平，而在老年患者及合并房颤或心肌病的患者中特异性有所降低。注意力图显示模型热点集中于QRS波群而非P波。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，常规ECG结合ViT集成模型可作为规模化的一线分诊手段，帮助在多样化患者群体中识别应接受超声心动图检查的reduced LVEF患者，具有较强的临床推广潜力。

title: ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning
summary: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForceU-VLA，一个力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于自主具身超声扫描。通过力-超声协同融合模块（FUSFM）和阶段自适应调制机制（SAMM），结合一个包含450条专家轨迹、约10万帧多模态同步数据的真实世界力感知数据集ForceU-VLA-Data，有效提升了超声扫描的接触稳定性和探头压力调节能力。
AI.motivation: 现有具身超声扫描方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是力与超声模态之间的耦合建模松散，无法充分捕捉动态的探头-组织交互；二是缺乏对扫描阶段（如定位、按压、采集等不同阶段）的感知，导致模型难以适应不同阶段的任务需求。这两大局限制约了自动化超声扫描的准确性和质量。
AI.method: 提出ForceU-VLA框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM)，将超声视觉信息与力反馈信息进行协同融合，为探头运动提供稳定可靠的引导；（2）Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM)，根据扫描阶段自适调节多模态特征表示，以满足不同阶段的任务需求；（3）ForceU-VLA-Data数据集，采集自真实世界的具身超声数据，覆盖两个器官的五种代表性临床扫描视角，包含450条专家轨迹和约10万帧视觉-力-动作同步多模态帧。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ForceU-VLA显著改善了具身超声扫描中的接触稳定性和探头压力调节能力，有效提升了任务执行质量和系统整体可靠性。
AI.conclusion: ForceU-VLA通过将力信号与超声图像反馈贯穿整个扫描过程并引入阶段自适应机制，为自主具身超声扫描提供了一种可行的技术路线，同时开源了代码和数据集以推动该领域的研究发展。

title: Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing
summary: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于前馈多层感知器（MLP）的辐射传输（RT）代理模型，用于高效准确地预测CO₂弱波段的星载顶部大气辐射，并耦合NanoCarb成像干涉仪仪器响应，以支撑低成本卫星星座对CO₂和CH₄排放的高重访、高空间覆盖监测。通过联合辐射和RT雅可比矩阵的MAE损失训练，兼顾光谱精度与对地球物理参数的敏感性，为CO₂浓度反演提供高效精密的正向模型。
AI.motivation: 气候变化研究需要降低CO₂和CH₄排放估算的不确定性，以更好区分人为与自然源，这推动了具备更高重访频率和空间覆盖能力的星载观测需求。然而全物理反演算法依赖重复的高分辨率逐线（line-by-line）RT模拟，计算成本极高，难以支撑高重访与高空间覆盖场景下的浓度估算，亟需高效替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一个前馈多层感知器（MLP）代理模型，替代计算昂贵的逐线RT模型，用于预测CO₂弱波段的顶部大气（TOA）辐亮度。训练采用联合MAE损失，同时约束辐亮度预测误差与RT雅可比矩阵（对地球物理参数的敏感性），以确保光谱精度与物理敏感性。随后将该MLP-RT代理与NanoCarb成像干涉仪的仪器响应耦合，构建面向NanoCarb测量系统的正向模型。
AI.result: MLP代理模型结合NanoCarb仪器响应所构成的正向模型在精度和效率上均表现良好，在CO₂浓度反演中展现出有前景的结果，验证了该代理方法在低成本星座场景下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 基于MLP的RT代理模型能够以较低计算成本实现高精度的NanoCarb正向模拟，为SCARBOn项目中的CO₂浓度反演提供了高效可行的技术路径，有望支持未来低成本卫星星座对温室气体排放的持续监测。

title: Privacy-Preserving Dataset Curation for Kuala Lumpur Urban Traffic: Grounded Vision-Language Detection with Spatial Vehicle-Context Filtering
summary: The rapid advancement of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving relies heavily on multi-modal urban traffic datasets. However, curating high-fidelity video imagery in complex tropical urban environments---specifically Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia---presents severe challenges for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) anonymization due to high motorcycle density, dark acrylic license plates, dynamic camera tilt, and extreme tropical glare. We propose an automated anonymization framework tailored for the Kuala Lumpur Road Dataset, captured via a mobile cycling platform at 2 FPS. We document how legacy Haar cascades and YOLOv8 fail under these conditions---generating false positives on background elements while missing rotated or occluded targets. Our architecture resolves this by integrating Grounding DINO---a zero-shot open-set vision-language transformer---with a novel Spatial Vehicle Region of Interest (ROI) Containment Engine. By requiring license plate centroids to reside within validated vehicle boundaries, the pipeline suppresses environmental false positives while automatically obfuscating faces, heads, and license plates. An initial evaluation on 1,266 frames demonstrates a $\sim$95\% success rate, with remaining failures restricted to small, heavily occluded, oblique, or ambiguous targets. Coupled with temporal persistence mechanisms and an automated quality-control auditor, the framework minimizes privacy-related false negatives while preserving scene context for downstream vision tasks. While formal legal compliance depends on broader governance procedures, this publicly available pipeline and demonstration notebook provide an auditable preprocessing stage for privacy-aware dataset curation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向吉隆坡道路数据集（KL Road Dataset）的自动化隐私匿名化框架，通过整合Grounding DINO零样本视觉-语言变换器与空间车辆感兴趣区域（ROI）包含引擎，解决热带城市复杂环境下（高摩托车密度、深色亚克力车牌、动态相机倾斜、热带眩光）带来的PII匿名化挑战。该管道抑制环境假阳性并自动模糊人脸、头部和车牌，在1,266帧初始评估中实现约95%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 复杂的吉隆坡热带城市环境中，传统方法（Haar级联、YOLOv8）在PII匿名化任务上表现不佳，产生背景元素假阳性并漏检旋转或遮挡目标。多模态城市交通数据集对于智能交通系统和自动驾驶至关重要，但高保真视频的PII匿名化面临严重挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化匿名化框架，核心整合Grounding DINO零样本开放集视觉-语言变换器，并引入新颖的空间车辆感兴趣区域（ROI）包含引擎。该引擎要求车牌质心位于经验证的车辆边界内，从而抑制环境假阳性。同时集成时间持久性机制和自动化质量控制审计器，分别用于减少隐私相关的漏检并保证输出质量。数据通过移动骑行平台以2 FPS采集。
AI.result: 在1,266帧上的初始评估显示约95%的成功率；剩余失败案例仅限于小尺寸、重度遮挡、倾斜或模糊的目标。框架有效克服了Haar级联和YOLOv8在深色亚克力车牌、高摩托车密度、动态相机倾斜和热带眩光条件下的失效问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供公开可用的可审计预处理阶段，用于隐私感知的数据集策划，在最小化隐私假阴性的同时保留场景上下文以供下游视觉任务使用。但作者也指出正式的法规合规性仍需依赖更广泛的治理程序。

title: MotionGS-SLAM: Event-Modulated Gaussian Splatting for Motion-Blur Robust SLAM
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Published in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
summary: Current Vision-based SLAM systems fail catastrophically when motion blur corrupts the visual input, as they attempt the ill-posed inverse problem of recovering sharp content from degraded observations. We present MotionGS-SLAM, which fundamentally reimagines motion blur handling through a paradigm shift: rather than removing blur artifacts, we reformulate the challenge as a well-constrained forward problem that generatively models blur formation within the rendering pipeline. By leveraging event cameras' microsecond temporal resolution and immunity to motion blur, we introduce a novel event-modulated Gaussian kernel that dynamically adapts each Gaussian's rasterization based on precise motion cues. Our dual-modulation mechanism transforms 2D Gaussian projections from isotropic dots into anisotropic, motion-aligned elliptical brush strokes (spatial modulation) while adaptively varying exposure integral sampling density based on local velocity (temporal modulation). This physics-based approach enables joint optimization of intra-exposure camera trajectories and 3D scene geometry through blur-aware photometric and event-based constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods in trajectory accuracy and map quality under severe high-motion conditions.

AI.tldr: MotionGS-SLAM将运动模糊处理从"去除模糊"的逆向求解范式转变为"生成模糊"的正向建模范式，利用事件相机的微秒级时间分辨率，通过事件调制的高斯核在渲染管线内建模模糊形成过程，联合优化曝光内相机轨迹和3D场景几何，在剧烈运动条件下显著提升轨迹精度和地图质量。
AI.motivation: 传统基于视觉的SLAM系统在运动模糊下会灾难性失效，因试图求解"从退化观测中恢复清晰内容"这一病态逆问题。作者希望从根本上重新设计运动模糊处理方式，避开逆问题求解的固有困难。
AI.method: 提出范式转变：将运动模糊建模为良约束的正向问题，在渲染管线内生成式地模拟模糊形成。核心技术包括：(1) 利用事件相机微秒级时间分辨率及其抗运动模糊特性；(2) 引入事件调制高斯核，根据精确运动线索动态调整每个高斯的栅格化；(3) 双调制机制——空间调制将2D高斯投影从各向同性点转换为各向异性、沿运动对齐的椭圆形笔触，时间调制根据局部速度自适应调整曝光积分采样密度；(4) 通过模糊感知的光度约束和事件约束联合优化曝光内相机轨迹和3D场景几何。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在剧烈高运动条件下，该方法在轨迹精度和地图质量上均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将模糊生成过程融入渲染管线的物理建模方法，结合事件相机的优势，有效解决了视觉SLAM在严重运动模糊场景下的鲁棒性问题，实现了更精确的相机轨迹估计和更高质量的场景重建。

title: iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration
summary: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta，一个可解释的模糊规则学习框架，将人类可理解的推理结构嵌入现代神经架构中，通过元学习分析规则跨任务重组机制，并引入知识引导的正则化实现自上而下与自下而上的整合，最终实现可解释推理与稳定的跨领域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络虽然性能强大但推理过程不透明，缺乏可解释性。如何在保持高性能的同时让模型能够解释自身推理过程，是可解释表示学习中的关键难题。现有方法往往在性能与可解释性之间权衡，缺乏将人类可理解规则与现代神经计算有机整合的范式。
AI.method: iFuzz-Meta框架的核心包括：1) 每条模糊规则对应原始特征空间中一个语义与空间原型，确保推理透明且可直接解释；2) 引入元学习范式，系统分析可解释规则如何跨任务和领域重组，将算法适应与认知表示建立联系；3) 设计知识引导的正则化机制，实现自上而下（理论先验作为软归纳偏置）与自下而上（数据驱动学习）的双向整合，确保适应过程沿语义和生理学上有意义的轨迹演进。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，iFuzz-Meta在实现可解释推理的同时保持了稳定的跨领域泛化能力，证明了模糊规则系统与现代神经架构结合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: iFuzz-Meta为可解释且知识感知的模糊系统提供了一条潜在的通向一般性路径，展示了可解释规则学习与元学习分析及知识引导正则化的融合能够实现透明推理与稳定泛化的统一。

title: Spatial Attention Noise Masking for Causally Sufficient Interpretability
summary: We present a novel causal approach to interpretability for computer vision models that dynamically masks the input image prior to classification. The interpretability of deep learning predictions is critical in high-stakes fields such as medical imaging, security, and autonomous driving. Most interpretability methods are applied passively to already trained models, which typically result in correlational rather than causal explanations. Existing causal interpretability methods are limited to post hoc analysis, weakening the causal claims. Additionally, existing active methods generally lack explanations that explicitly assign responsibility to input features. This work proposes a spatial attention noise masking framework that provides causal explanations about the features sufficient for the prediction. The proposed framework consists of: 1) a UNet-style mask generator, and 2) a Resnet18 encoder and linear classifier that classifies both masked and unmasked versions of an input image. The generated masks are regularized to be sparse and spatially smooth, while masked image embeddings are constrained to remain consistent with embeddings from the corresponding unmasked images. The resulting masks can be interpreted as feature attribution maps that are competitive with related interpretability methods while additionally providing strong causal explanations of model predictions. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate mask faithfulness, near-baseline classification performance across five classification tasks despite substantial masking of image information, and robustness to distribution shifts such as background swapping and natural adversarial examples. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate mask behavior and competitive interpretability relative to state-of-the-art feature attribution methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的因果可解释性方法，通过空间注意力噪声掩码框架动态遮蔽输入图像，生成的特征归因图既能与现有方法相媲美，又能提供关于预测的强因果解释，而非仅仅相关解释。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多被动应用于已训练模型，只能提供相关性的解释而非因果解释；已有的因果可解释方法局限于事后（post hoc）分析，因果主张较弱；主动方法缺乏将责任明确分配给输入特征的解释。
AI.method: 提出了包含两部分的框架：1）UNet风格掩码生成器；2）ResNet18编码器和线性分类器，同时对掩码版和未掩码版图像进行分类。生成的掩码被正则化为稀疏且空间平滑，同时掩码图像的嵌入与未掩码图像的嵌入保持一致约束。
AI.result: 掩码具有高保真度；在五个分类任务中尽管大量遮蔽图像信息，分类性能仍接近基线；对背景交换和自然对抗样本等分布偏移具有鲁棒性；定性比较显示其行为与最先进的特征归因方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: 生成的掩码可视为特征归因图，与相关可解释性方法竞争力相当，同时提供模型预测的强因果解释，在医学影像、安全、自动驾驶等高风险领域具有重要应用价值。

title: PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation
summary: Post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models typically relies on expert demonstrations and policy interaction trajectories. However, in long-horizon manipulation, a single episode often spans hundreds of control steps and multiple phases, while success or failure is only revealed at episode termination. Policy improvement therefore requires step-level credit signals to distinguish behaviors that advance the task from those that stall or regress. We present PACE, a credit-assignment framework for post-training on long-horizon manipulation, centered on a phase-progress-aware critic. PACE consists of two key modules: (1) the Global-Local Cooperative Value-Correction Critic (GLC-Critic) aggregates visual and motion-difference features within local temporal windows to infer the phase and intra-phase progress of each step, and applies residual correction to a discretized remaining-cost distribution accordingly, enabling step-level credit assignment; (2) Progressive Policy Distillation (PPD) converts credit into positive and negative conditions via task-wise thresholds and trains a credit-conditioned action generation policy: it first protects the pretrained policy with high-credit positive samples, then incorporates all positive and negative credits to learn the quality boundary, and at inference amplifies high-credit behaviors through the difference between conditional outputs. Extensive simulation experiments and diverse real-world robotic-arm experiments demonstrate that PACE consistently achieves significant improvements over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: PACE是一个面向长视界操作任务的后训练信用分配框架，通过相位进度感知的评论家网络（GLC-Critic）实现步骤级信用分配，并利用渐进式策略蒸馏（PPD）将信用转化为条件策略训练信号，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均显著超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 长视界操作任务中单次episode横跨数百控制步骤和多个相位，但成功/失败仅在episode终止时才显现，导致策略改进缺乏步骤级信用信号来区分推进任务的行为与停滞或倒退的行为。
AI.method: PACE由两大模块组成：(1) 全局-局部协作值修正评论家（GLC-Critic），在局部时间窗口内聚合视觉和运动差异特征，推断每步的相位及相位内进度，并对离散化的剩余成本分布进行残差修正，实现步骤级信用分配；(2) 渐进式策略蒸馏（PPD），通过任务级阈值将信用转化为正负条件，训练信用条件化的动作生成策略：先用高信用正样本保护预训练策略，再融入全部正负信用学习质量边界，推理时通过条件输出的差值放大高信用行为。
AI.result: 广泛的仿真实验和多样的真实机械臂实验表明，PACE在多个任务上相较最强基线均取得显著一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PACE通过相位进度感知的信用分配机制有效解决了长视界操作中信用稀疏的问题，验证了步骤级信用信号对VLA模型后训练的关键作用，并展示了在真实世界机器人操作中的实用价值。

title: SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.

AI.tldr: SMOPD是一种用于多轮on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）的loss-only稳定化方法，通过对中间轮回复按token熵排名并移除最低熵20%的token（从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中），解决了dirty-history rollout导致的训练脆弱性问题。该方法在LiC任务上与Qwen3模型相比，SHARDED-view准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多轮on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）中，student一旦发出错误的中间回复，后续轮次的训练会基于该错误回复进行条件化（即dirty-history问题），而统一蒸馏会对携带很少纠错信号的token也分配loss，导致训练过程脆弱不稳定。已有方法缺乏对token级不确定性的细粒度处理。
AI.method: SMOPD的核心做法是：(1) 对每个生成的中间轮回复，按student的token级熵对token位置进行排序；(2) 从裁剪的generalized Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除熵最低的20%的token（这些token置信度高、纠错信号弱）；(3) 最终答案和FULL-preservation损失保持不变；(4) 不增加任何参数，推理时零开销。同时对比了一个正确性缩放变体，该变体使用最终答案正确性作为共同的detached可靠性代理来乘loss。
AI.result: 在LiC（Language in Code？）任务上使用Qwen3模型：SMOPD在1.7B、4B、8B单种子对比中将SHARDED-view准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点；4B多种子验证显示平均提升+1.7pp（p=0.022）。加入outcome scalar在无masking时对1.7B有害（-4.0pp），与masking结合时仍依赖模型规模（4B +1.3pp，1.7B中性，8B -0.5pp）。
AI.conclusion: token级不确定性比标量的最终答案正确性更可靠地作为OPSD的稳定化信号。但因果机制测试和更广泛的基准验证留待未来工作。

title: Low Cost Two-Stage Fabric Defect Detection at the Edge
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. Deployment study on NVIDIA Jetson Nano with TensorRT FP16. Includes a decomposition showing the measured 1.36x end-to-end speedup is dominated by data-path overlap rather than by the cascade. Dataset available on Roboflow Universe
summary: Fabric inspection in the garment industries of low-income economies remains largely manual, and commercial vision systems are priced beyond most small and medium mills. Because defects are sparse under controlled production, a natural response is a cascade: screen every frame with a cheap anomaly detector and invoke a full detector only on suspicious frames. We build such a cascade for four knit-fabric defect classes and deploy it end-to-end on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano with TensorRT FP16. Stage 1 is a compact convolutional autoencoder with decoder attention gates, an edge-weighted reconstruction loss, and feature-level distillation from a frozen YOLOv5n teacher; Stage 2 is YOLOv5n, invoked only on flagged frames. On a 249-image benchmark disjoint from detector training (20 defective, 229 non-defective), Stage 1 at a recall-prioritised threshold flags all 20 defective images (95% CI 0.83-1.00) at a false-positive rate of 49.3% (113/229), reducing false positives by 19.3% relative to a plain autoencoder (p=0.011). The parallel pipeline reaches 13.45 FPS against 9.86 FPS for a sequential YOLO-only loop. Our central finding comes from decomposing that 1.36x: 91% of it is attributable to overlapping JPEG decode with inference rather than to the cascade, which contributes only a 5.1% inference reduction at the measured forwarding rate p = 0.534. We further show that forwarding here is false-positive-limited rather than prevalence-limited - 85% of forwarded frames are false alarms - and quantify the 29-45% inference reduction attainable under tighter calibration. We report this as a caution for cascade speedups measured without controlling the data path, and position the system as AI-assisted triage rather than autonomous acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并部署了一个两阶段织物缺陷检测级联系统：Stage 1为带注意力门控和特征蒸馏的紧凑自编码器异常检测器（筛选可疑帧），Stage 2为YOLOv5n完整检测器（仅处理标记帧）。在Jetson Nano + TensorRT FP16上端到端部署，召回优先阈值下检出全部20张缺陷图（FPR 49.3%）。关键发现：1.36x加速中91%来自JPEG解码与推理的流水线重叠，级联本身仅贡献5.1%推理削减（p=0.534），且转发是假阳性受限而非流行率受限。
AI.motivation: 低收入经济体服装厂的面料检测仍以人工为主，商用视觉系统价格超出中小型工厂承受范围。缺陷在生产受控条件下稀疏分布，天然适合级联架构——用廉价异常检测器筛选每帧，仅对可疑帧调用完整检测器，以降低成本并提高吞吐。
AI.method: 构建两级级联：Stage 1为紧凑卷积自编码器，含解码器注意力门控、边缘加权重建损失、以及从冻结YOLOv5n教师模型进行特征级蒸馏；Stage 2为YOLOv5n完整检测器，仅被调用于被标记帧。系统在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上以TensorRT FP16端到端部署，并在249图像基准（20缺陷+229正常）上评估，同时测量并行流水线性能并分解加速来源。
AI.result: Stage 1在召回优先阈值下标记全部20张缺陷图（95%CI 0.83-1.00），假阳性率49.3%（113/229），比普通自编码器减少19.3%假阳性（p=0.011）。并行流水线达13.45 FPS vs 顺序YOLO循环的9.86 FPS。分解1.36x加速发现：91%归因于JPEG解码与推理的流水线重叠，级联本身仅贡献5.1%推理削减（p=0.534）。85%的转发帧为假警报，转发受假阳性限制而非缺陷流行率限制；更紧校准下可实现29-45%的推理削减。
AI.conclusion: 级联系统的真实加速收益需在控制数据路径的前提下测量，否则易将解码重叠误归因于级联架构本身。系统应定位为AI辅助分诊（triage）而非自主验收工具。研究对精度-吞吐权衡、级联效益分解及自编码器异常检测器的实际部署价值提供了谨慎而量化的评估。

title: Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning
summary: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) online reinforcement learning for real robots must absorb human interventions quickly while continuing to improve beyond the human prior. We present a training method for this setting based on two components. First, an \emph{MC Q-chunk} critic regresses chunk-level action values onto Monte Carlo returns from the replay buffer, performing sample-average (behavior) policy evaluation so that intervention trajectories are credited directly rather than diluted by current-policy TD backups. Second, \emph{max-Q selective imitation} updates the actor by imitating, at each state, the higher-$Q$ action between the current policy action and a buffer sample under a hard winner-take-all rule. This rule automatically switches between learning from interventions and on-policy self-improvement: when the autonomous policy is stronger, targets align with the policy distribution, reducing the policy--target-sample gap that otherwise induces execution-time distribution shift. In practice we score candidates with a standard critic ensemble mean to reduce comparison noise, without softening targets or introducing score-gap thresholds. On a real USB pick-and-insertion task with 20 demonstrations, ACT QChunk-MCBC attains 99\% success within 30 minutes of HIL training, whereas HIL-SERL requires about 5 hours to converge. In simulation on Peg Insertion and Square, ACT/Flow Q-chunk variants similarly reach $\ge$96\% success within roughly half an hour of effective training, outperforming HIL-SERL, EXPO, and E2HiL on the success--time frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于真实机器人人机协同在线强化学习（HIL RL）的训练方法，由两个核心组件构成：MC Q-chunk评论家（将分块动作价值回归到回放缓冲区中的蒙特卡洛回报，进行行为策略评估）和max-Q选择性模仿（在每状态下，在当前策略动作与缓冲区样本之间选择Q值更高的动作进行硬赢者通吃式模仿更新）。该方法可自动在从人类干预中学习与策略自我改进之间切换。在真实USB插拔任务中，20个演示+30分钟HIL训练即可达到99%成功率；在仿真任务中，Q-chunk变体在约半小时有效训练内达到≥96%成功率，优于HIL-SERL、EXPO和E2HiL。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人上的HIL在线强化学习需要快速吸收人类干预，同时继续超越人类先验知识持续改进。现有方法存在两方面问题：干预轨迹被当前策略的TD备份稀释而未被直接赋信；以及当自治策略强于人类时，策略分布与目标样本之间存在分布差距，导致执行时分布偏移。
AI.method: 方法由两部分构成：（1）MC Q-chunk评论家：将分块级别（chunk-level）的动作价值回归到从回放缓冲区采样的蒙特卡洛回报，执行样本平均（行为）策略评估，使干预轨迹得到直接赋信而非被当前策略TD备份稀释。（2）max-Q选择性模仿：在每个状态下，在当前策略动作与缓冲区样本之间选择Q值更高的动作进行硬赢者通吃式的模仿更新。该规则自动在"从干预中学习"和"策略自我改进"之间切换：当自治策略更强时，目标与策略分布对齐，减少执行时分布偏移。实际中用标准评论家集成均值来减少比较噪声，但不软化目标，也不引入分数差距阈值。
AI.result: 在真实USB取放插入任务上，ACT QChunk-MCBC仅用20个演示加30分钟HIL训练即达到99%成功率，而HIL-SERL需要约5小时才收敛。在仿真Peg Insertion和Square任务上，ACT/Flow Q-chunk变体在约半小时有效训练内即达到≥96%成功率，在成功率-时间前沿上优于HIL-SERL、EXPO和E2HiL。
AI.conclusion: MC Q-chunk评论家与max-Q选择性模仿的组合能够显著加速真实机器人HIL在线强化学习的收敛速度，同时保持甚至提升最终任务成功率。该方法通过直接赋信人类干预轨迹和自动切换学习模式，有效平衡了从人类先验中学习和超越人类先验的自改进需求。

title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers
summary:
We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出dLLM-SetScore，一种无需训练的离散掩码扩散语言模型多标签文本分类方法。方法对每个候选标签提出简短的是/否问题，并比较一个掩码位置两个答案token的概率。无需任务特定微调。实验发现所有标签置于同一提示中会产生槽位位置不对称（首个答案槽在GoEmotions上99.4%被预测为正，Reuters上100%），而逐标签打分使所有标签处于相同语法位置，实现预测对标签顺序不变。在六个数据集上的评估中，指令微调检查点在扩散模型家族中多数比较中优于基座模型。
AI.motivation: 多标签文本分类通常依赖任务特定微调，而训练自由的方法（如NLI模型和自回归LLM）虽可迁移但受限于模型特性。作者旨在探索离散掩码扩散语言模型（如LLaDA和Dream）作为多标签分类器的潜力，同时克服将多个标签置于同一提示中时产生的槽位位置偏差问题。
AI.method: 方法包含几个核心组件：(1) 对每个候选标签单独构造一个短的是/否提示，在单一掩码位置比较yes/no两个答案token的概率作为该标签的预测分数；(2) 使用200个有标注的验证样本选择阈值、温度参数和提示措辞；(3) 证明了排列不变性（预测对标签顺序不变），刻画了阈值化决策在加权汉明损失下的性质，并推导了短列表的天花板上界；(4) 探索性地尝试了局部联合集合精炼步骤以提升性能，但未能改善F1，被作为负结果保留。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，与NLI模型、自回归LLM、SetFit和监督分类器对比。在两个扩散模型家族共享的五个数据集上，指令微调检查点在10次比较中9次提升macro-F1、8次提升micro-F1。在LLaDA-Instruct协议下，Reuters和ECtHR上取得了最高的训练自由值。同时揭示了多标签同提示设置的强槽位位置不对称现象。
AI.conclusion: 离散掩码扩散语言模型在训练自由的多标签分类中展现出竞争力，尤其是指令微调检查点。逐标签打分策略有效规避了槽位位置偏差，保证了标签顺序不变性。局部联合集合精炼被证明无效并作为负结果记录，表明在该框架中这类后处理步骤不具价值。

title: Do CNNs Internally Represent Real and Fake Images Differently? A Hidden-Layer Analysis
summary: Fake/synthetic images are increasingly prevalent, but it remains unclear whether Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) process real and fake images in the same internal manner. This work examines the hypothesis that CNNs represent real and fake images differently, such that fake images induce different hidden-layer activation patterns even when semantic content is preserved. The hypothesis is evaluated in scene recognition settings using trained CNN models. Dense-layer activations are extracted, and neurosymbolic methods assign semantic labels to selected neurons. For each real test image, corresponding fake images are generated with similar semantic content using object-label-guided text-to-image and image-to-image generation based on Stable Diffusion variants. Paired real-fake activation patterns are then compared statistically. Additional experiments with another dataset, CNN architecture, generative model, and JPEG/blur degradation analysis assess robustness. Results suggest that fake images evoke different hidden-neuron activations, and these differences are not explained only by simple image degradation. Overall, the findings indicate that real and fake images differ in CNN hidden-layer activation behavior at least in some settings, which opens the door for follow-up work on making use of this different behavior to improve fake image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究卷积神经网络（CNN）是否以不同方式内部表征真实图像和伪造图像，通过提取隐藏层激活并使用神经符号方法进行语义标注，统计比较配对真实-伪造图像的激活模式，发现伪造图像确实引发不同的隐藏神经元激活，且这种差异不能仅由简单图像退化解释。
AI.motivation: 伪造/合成图像日益普遍，但尚不清楚CNN是否在内部以相同方式处理真实与伪造图像。理解这一差异对于改进伪造图像检测具有重要价值。
AI.method: 在场景识别任务中使用训练好的CNN模型，提取稠密层激活；采用神经符号方法为选定神经元赋予语义标签；通过目标标签引导的文本生成图像和基于Stable Diffusion变体的图像生成方法，为每张真实测试图像生成语义内容相似的伪造图像，对配对图像激活模式进行统计比较；同时用不同数据集、CNN架构、生成模型以及JPEG/模糊退化分析来验证稳健性。
AI.result: 结果表明伪造图像会引发不同的隐藏神经元激活，且这些差异不能仅由简单图像退化（如JPEG压缩或模糊）来解释。
AI.conclusion: 真实图像与伪造图像在CNN隐藏层激活行为上至少在某些设置下存在差异，这为后续利用这种差异行为改进伪造图像检测的研究打开了方向。

title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are now widely used for continuous robotic manipulation, and online reinforcement learning (RL) is emerging as a key technique for adapting them to new tasks. Existing RL methods typically inject stochasticity inside the denoising chain, often through isotropic or temporally independent noise. However, effective robot exploration calls for structured noise: temporally smooth and scaled differently across action groups. We show that simply switching the in-chain noise to a structured form does not suffice: noise added at an intermediate flow time can be weakened by the remaining denoising steps before execution, a phenomenon we call \emph{Structured Noise Dilution}. We propose \textbf{StructRL}, which avoids dilution by relocating policy stochasticity to the action space via three coupled choices: (i) a deterministic ODE decoder, (ii) structured noise injected directly in the action space, and (iii) last-step replay, where policy-gradient updates avoid assigning likelihoods to intermediate denoising states. This keeps structured exploration tied to the executed action while providing a tractable training signal for the flow decoder. Across three flow-based VLA models on multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and two real-world tasks, StructRL improves exploration efficiency and OOD performance over prior in-chain baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured action-space exploration for adapting flow-based VLA with RL. \textbf{Project page:} https://flyfaerss.github.io/structrl/

AI.tldr: 本文提出StructRL，解决流式VLA模型在在线强化学习中注入结构化噪声会被后续去噪步骤稀释的问题，通过确定性ODE解码器、动作空间直接注入结构化噪声以及最后一步回放三个耦合设计，将策略随机性迁移到动作空间，从而提升探索效率和分布外性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的VLA模型在线RL方法通常在去噪链内注入随机性（多为各向同性或时间上独立的噪声），但有效的机器人探索需要结构化噪声（时间平滑、不同动作组缩放不同）。然而文中发现，在中间流时间点添加的结构化噪声会在剩余去噪步骤中被削弱，即"结构化噪声稀释"现象，这导致现有方法无法有效实现结构化探索。
AI.method: StructRL通过三个耦合选择将策略随机性从去噪链迁移到动作空间：(i) 采用确定性ODE解码器；(ii) 在动作空间中直接注入结构化噪声；(iii) 采用最后一步回放，使策略梯度更新仅对最终执行动作分配似然，避免为中间去噪状态分配似然。
AI.result: 在三种流式VLA模型上，于多个仿真操作基准和两个真实世界任务中，StructRL相比先前的链内基线方法提升了探索效率和分布外（OOD）性能，验证了结构化动作空间探索对用RL适配流式VLA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将策略随机性迁移到动作空间（而非去噪链内部）是适配流式VLA模型进行RL的有效方案，结构化动作空间探索能显著提升探索效率与OOD泛化能力。

title: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade
summary: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个狭义问题：在成对的物理重置状态下，Medium派生接口能否预测何时切换到独立的Full预测器以改善任务特定决策损失并证明顺序推理开销的合理性。在PushT V106（1,600状态、39任务、三组检查点对）和确认集V107上，预测接口路由器在计入开销后降低了决策成本，但仅在低计算价格下优于固定策略，且不具因果充分性、计算节约或跨族泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应推理和世界动作模型系统利用廉价阶段输出或预测的未来来分配额外计算，但缺乏在精确重置物理结果下的严格成对评估。本文旨在回答一个更狭义的问题：在成对精确重置的前提下，预测接口是否能提供增量路由信息以决定是否切换到完全预测器，并能否证明顺序推理开销的合理性。
AI.method: 提出成对评估与审计协议：所有候选动作从相同重置状态执行，Medium和Full作用于相同候选集和任务，以成对物理损失差作为路由目标。使用冻结预测接口路由器，在PushT V106上训练评估，并在V107上进行前瞻性封存确认，以维度匹配的DINO特征投影、任务和五个候选动作为对照。另通过受控PyBullet审计验证复合任务-预测-机制路由器。
AI.result: V107确认集上预测接口将定价物理决策成本降低0.002549（状态聚类95%区间[-0.002867, -0.002238]；单侧95%上界-0.002286），三个检查点对均为负效应。但顺序路由器仍比固定策略慢，优势仅限于低计算价格。受控PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-机制路由器。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持所测预测接口在超越一个刻意偏好的当前DINO对照方面具有增量路由信息，但不支持因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨族泛化性。结论强调了该贡献是成对评估与审计协议而非通用的路由规则。

title: IP Protection in the Era of Visual Generative AI: A Survey
summary: The rapid evolution of visual generative AI has introduced a wide range of intellectual property risks, spanning the unauthorized learning, reproduction, extraction, misuse, and redistribution of protected data and model assets. To address these risks, a growing body of technical defenses has been proposed. However, existing surveys typically organize this literature by lifecycle stage or technical mechanism, which can obscure the protective intent of different methods. This survey presents a two-dimensional taxonomy for IP protection in visual generative models. The primary axis is a Control Logic View, which classifies methods into Information Exposure Control, Generative Behavior Constraint, and Attribution & Accountability according to the risk variable they regulate. The secondary axis distinguishes Data IP from Model IP as cross-cutting asset dimensions. Under this framework, we systematically review protection methods, align evaluation protocols with protection objectives, and discuss open challenges including proactive model-level safeguards, standardized evaluation, robustness against adaptive attacks, and explainable evidence. This survey aims to offer a principled, systematic, and easy-to-follow overview for both new and experienced researchers in visual generative AI IP protection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向视觉生成模型知识产权保护的二维分类法，主维度为控制逻辑视角（信息暴露控制、生成行为约束、归属与问责），副维度为资产类型（数据IP与模型IP），并基于此框架系统综述了现有保护方法、评估协议及开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成式AI的快速发展带来了广泛的知识产权风险（未经授权的学习、复制、提取、滥用和再分发受保护数据与模型资产），而现有综述通常按生命周期阶段或技术机制组织文献，难以体现不同方法的保护意图，因此需要一个以保护目的为导向的系统性分类框架。
AI.method: 提出了一个二维分类法：主维度是控制逻辑视角，将方法分为信息暴露控制、生成行为约束、归属与问责三类，依据其调控的风险变量进行划分；副维度是数据IP与模型IP的跨切面资产维度。在此框架下系统性综述保护方法，并将评估协议与保护目标对齐。
AI.result: 系统梳理了视觉生成模型IP保护的现有方法，建立了与保护目标对齐的评估协议体系，并识别出开放挑战，包括主动式模型级防护、标准化评估、对自适应攻击的鲁棒性以及可解释的证据。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在为视觉生成AI知识产权保护领域的新老研究者提供一个有原则、系统且易于理解的全面概览。

title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models
summary: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在循环世界模型中，是否能通过小规模、可直接寻址的隐藏状态变化（低秩补丁）将模型引导到预期的反事实轨迹上。在192维隐藏状态的双物体碰撞环境中，发现秩为4的补丁足以重定向12步自主展开的未来预测，且无需观察值注入或教师强制。位置编辑压力测试提供了对照，表明仅成功编辑并不足够，需满足"动力学有效"标准。
AI.motivation: 世界模型能够预测未来，但人们不清楚隐藏状态中哪些部分实际驱动这些预测。作者希望探究是否可以用一个小的、可直接寻址的隐藏状态变化将学习到的世界模型置于预期的反事实轨迹上，并让模型自主延续该未来，从而识别出控制预测的紧凑干预接口。
AI.method: 使用192维隐藏状态的循环世界模型，在受控的双物体二维碰撞环境中研究。方法包括：(1) 验证模型能原生表示和展开编辑后的未来；(2) 从训练中仅用事实到反事实的隐藏差异构造候选低秩载体；(3) 学习从事实状态和请求编辑到载体系数的映射；(4) 在注册的秩网格上测试，确定满足开发面板标准的最小秩为4；(5) 通过预注册复制规则、对照实验（随机等范数、错误物体、错误时间）以及位置编辑压力测试进行验证。
AI.result: 唯一秩4补丁足以将12步自主展开重定向到预期反事实轨迹，不需要未来观测、教师强制或重复纠正。冻结流程在独立训练的检查点间满足预注册复制规则，且在相邻干预时间仍可用。随机等范数、错误物体和错误时间对照组无法解释该效应。位置编辑压力测试提供了阴性对照：位置补丁虽能通过原始展开标准，但无补丁和随机对照组同样能通过，错误物体特异性无法确立。
AI.conclusion: 仅成功编辑并不足够，需要用"动力学有效"来描述干预在自主展开下以持续且目标特异的方式改变模型未来计算。秩4结果识别了所测速度编辑族的一个紧凑干预接口，但不是封闭的四维状态，也不代表内在状态维度。

title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
summary: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

AI.tldr: 针对0.1°高分辨率全球天气预报模型缺乏高分辨率训练数据的问题，本文提出BaguanHR框架，将分辨率迁移的焦点从模型转移到数据。通过变量级超分辨率（SR）将大量的0.25°粗分辨率ERA5再分析数据合成为0.1°高分辨率数据，使模型在合成+真实数据集上超越ML方法和IFS-HRES，在72小时内超过85%的预报时效上表现更优。研究还发现数据规模存在幂律缩放效应，数据量翻倍可使72小时和120小时预报的RMSE分别降低4.6%和4.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有0.25° ML预报模型在有限0.1°数据上微调的迁移方式受限于粗分辨率预报中固有的不可逆信息损失，导致高分辨率天气预报模型的扩展受到数据瓶颈的制约。作者认为核心问题不在于模型迁移，而在于高分辨率训练数据的稀缺性。
AI.method: BaguanHR框架：（1）首先论证超分辨率比预报具有更低的条件熵和输入放大，因此更适合作为分辨率迁移的载体；（2）通过变量级超分辨率（variable-wise SR）将ERA5的0.25°粗分辨率数据合成为大量0.1°高分辨率数据；（3）在合成数据和真实高分辨率数据的联合数据集上训练0.1°全球天气预报模型。
AI.result: BaguanHR在合成+真实数据集上的性能超越了已有的ML方法和IFS-HRES，在72小时预报内超过85%的时效上表现更优。同时发现数据规模存在幂律缩放效应：数据量翻倍可使72小时预报RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预报RMSE降低4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率ML天气预报的扩展本质上主要受数据瓶颈制约，而变量级超分辨率提供了一种简单且通用的解决方案，能够解锁长期积累的粗分辨率再分析资料用于高分辨率模型训练。这一发现为突破ML天气预报的分辨率扩展瓶颈提供了新思路。

title: Emergence of Transfer Learning towards Specific Identification of Alzheimer's Disease A Prospective Approach
summary: Worldwide, millions of senior citizens are suffering from Alzheimer disease abbreviated as AD, a well- versed form of dementia. AD is featured by amnesia, intellectual disability, and difficulty with consciousness. DL and ML models are undoubtedly explored to identify AD related patterns on large dimensional neuroimaging data but they need global optimization and are suffering from overfitting issue that might yield dissatisfactory result in testing data set. DL overcomes the issue by convolution of input image with kernel but any sudden change in the MRI image or human manipulation, limited pre- processing of the images can mislead CNN in achieving highly accurate detection. Transfer Learning (TL) has proved itself in AD diagnosis by utilizing pre-trained models on large data sets to guide novice model in a new neuroimaging dataset. This review provides an inclusive glimpse of TL implication in classification, identification including the conversion of AD. Keeping in view, we have assessed the strengths and limitations of TL in improvising diagnostic accuracy even with limited data. The uniqueness of the present review is the incorporation of explainable AI in TL based AD diagnosis system. Finally, it can be claimed that the review will guide the new re-searchers in the area of TL induced neurodegenerative disease detection.

AI.tldr: 本文对迁移学习（TL）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断中的应用进行了综述，涵盖TL在AD分类、识别及病程转化预测中的作用，评估了TL在有限数据条件下提升诊断准确性的优势与局限，并创新性地引入了可解释人工智能（XAI）用于TL驱动的AD诊断系统。
AI.motivation: 全球数百万老年人受阿尔茨海默病困扰，传统深度学习和机器学习模型在大规模神经影像数据上存在过拟合和全局优化问题，CNN对MRI图像的突变或人工操作及有限的预处理敏感，需要更稳健的诊断方法。TL利用预训练模型引导新数据集可望缓解这些问题，但缺乏系统性综述，尤其是在结合可解释AI方面的综述。
AI.method: 本文采用综述（review）研究方式，系统性地评估TL在AD诊断中的应用，包括分类、识别和AD转化预测，分析了TL在有限数据条件下提升诊断准确性的优势与局限性，并特别整合了可解释人工智能（XAI）在TL驱动的AD诊断系统中的应用，形成独特的综述视角。
AI.result: 综述评估了TL在AD诊断中的优势和局限性，指出TL即使面对有限的数据也能改善诊断准确性，同时总结并整合了可解释AI在TL诊断系统中的关键作用。作者声称该综述将为TL诱导的神经退行性疾病检测领域的新研究者提供指导。
AI.conclusion: TL在AD诊断中具有克服数据有限性、提升准确率的潜力，结合可解释AI是其独特贡献点；该综述可作为TL在神经退行性疾病检测领域研究者的入门指导，但具体定量结论和系统比较仍需参考全文内容。

title: LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset
summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous navigation in complex outdoor environments, where dynamic conditions and mission requirements require intelligent adaptive decision-making. Existing optimization-based, Machine Learning (ML), and Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches often rely on predefined models or task-specific training, limiting their generalization and adaptability in uncertain scenarios. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted approaches offer promising reasoning capabilities but remain constrained by limited agentic functionality, including insufficient memory, planning, and tool interaction mechanisms.This paper proposes an LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder (LAPF) framework for autonomous UAV navigation in town-scale outdoor environments. LAPF extends LLM-assisted navigation by integrating perception, memory, planning, and action modules into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. The proposed agent leverages prior navigation experiences, performs Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, couples each detected hazard to a bounded corrective action, and dynamically refines waypoint decisions based on environmental feedback.The three independent trials per method demonstrate that LAPF achieves mean path lengths of 512.83 m and 506.37 m, compared to the straight-line optimum of 497.33 m, corresponding to path length reductions of 17.2% and 15.6% relative to CoT prompting and absolute path efficiencies of 97.1% and 98.1% in open-field and obstacle-injected scenarios, respectively. Furthermore, LAPF is the only evaluated approach that couples every detected hazard to a bounded, metric-neutral corrective action while maintaining near-goal stability, with zero clamp events in both scenarios, whereas CoT prompting increases from 9.7 to 14.0 events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM代理的路径规划框架（LAPF），用于城市场景下的自主UAV导航。LAPF通过集成感知、记忆、规划与动作模块构建闭环认知架构，结合思维链推理和危险-动作耦合机制，在开放场地和障碍物场景中分别实现了97.1%和98.1%的路径效率，相比CoT提示方法路径长度分别缩短17.2%和15.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV自主导航方法存在局限：优化方法、机器学习与强化学习方法依赖预定义模型或任务特定训练，泛化能力不足；LLM辅助方法虽具备推理能力，但缺乏记忆、规划和工具交互等代理功能，难以适应不确定的复杂户外环境。
AI.method: LAPF框架采用闭环认知架构，集成了感知、记忆、规划与动作四个模块。代理利用过往导航经验，执行思维链（CoT）推理，将每个检测到的危险与有界的纠正动作进行耦合，并根据环境反馈动态优化航路点决策。
AI.result: 在每种方法进行三次独立试验的条件下，LAPF在开放场地和障碍物注入场景中分别实现平均路径长度512.83米和506.37米（直线最优为497.33米），路径长度相对CoT提示分别缩短17.2%和15.6%，绝对路径效率分别达97.1%和98.1%。LAPF是唯一将每个检测到的危险与有界且度量中性的纠正动作耦合的方法，在两个场景中均保持近目标稳定性且零钳制事件，而CoT提示的钳制事件从9.7增加到14.0。
AI.conclusion: LAPF通过LLM代理架构有效提升了UAV在城镇规模户外环境中的自主导航能力，在保持高路径效率和稳定性的同时克服了现有LLM辅助方法在代理功能上的局限，验证了将大型语言模型与闭环认知控制结合用于真实场景导航的可行性。

title: Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms
summary:
Prediction uncertainty is a widely adopted metric for quantifying model confidence, with downstream applications spanning model explanation, data selection, and prediction rollback. Despite its demonstrated utility, the potential of uncertainty quantification to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) remains largely underexplored, raising a critical question: to what extent can uncertainty serve as an effective signal for improving LLM-based code generation?
  To answer this question, we study uncertainty-aware rollback decoding, an inference-time strategy that uses uncertainty signals to identify unreliable generation regions and roll back to earlier valid prefixes without retraining the model. We evaluate this framework on seven code LLMs, five code generation benchmarks, and eight token-level uncertainty signals under a unified decoding setup.
  Our results show that the complete rollback framework improves over equal-budget restart across the evaluated benchmarks and model settings, with gains of up to 0.26 in pass@1 and 0.35 in AvgTestPassRate on functional code generation benchmarks, and an absolute improvement of up to 6.4\% in Patch-Aligned Safe Rate on Dsec-Python. Among the evaluated signals, information-theoretic measures such as token entropy and negative log-likelihood show the most favorable overall trend, frequently achieving the best or near-best results on standard benchmarks. A component-controlled ablation further shows that feedback-guided rollback provides the main improvement, while uncertainty localization provides an additional gain when checking, budget, rollback, and branch decay are held fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不确定性信号在LLM代码生成中的应用，提出不确定性感知的回滚解码（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding）推理时策略，在七个代码LLM、五个代码生成基准和八种token级不确定性信号上进行了统一评估。结果表明该框架优于等预算重启方法，在pass@1上最高提升0.26，在AvgTestPassRate上最高提升0.35，在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate最高提升6.4%。信息论指标（token熵和负对数似然）表现最好，消融实验表明反馈引导回滚是主要改进来源，不确定性定位在控制其他组件时提供额外增益。
AI.motivation: 尽管预测不确定性已广泛应用于模型解释、数据选择和预测回滚等领域，但其在LLM代码生成中的应用潜力尚未被充分探索。本文旨在回答一个关键问题：不确定性信号能在多大程度上作为有效信号改进基于LLM的代码生成？
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知回滚解码（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding），这是一种推理时策略，利用不确定性信号识别不可靠的生成区域，并回滚到较早的有效前缀，无需重新训练模型。在统一的解码设置下，对七个代码LLM、五个代码生成基准和八种token级不确定性信号进行了系统评估，并进行了组件控制的消融实验。
AI.result: 完整的回滚框架在功能代码生成基准上优于等预算重启方法，pass@1最高提升0.26，AvgTestPassRate最高提升0.35，在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate绝对提升达6.4%。token熵和负对数似然等信息论度量表现最优。消融实验显示反馈引导回滚提供主要改进，不确定性定位在固定其他组件时提供额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性信号能够有效增强LLM代码生成，不确定性感知的回滚解码是一种无需重新训练即可提升代码生成质量的有效推理时策略。信息论类不确定性指标是最可靠的不确定性信号来源，回滚框架中的反馈引导机制是性能提升的核心驱动因素。

title: From Dense Prediction to Visual Editing: Structured Supervision for Unified Image and Video Creation
summary: Unified image and video creation requires a model to follow diverse instructions while preserving identity, geometry, and temporal structure from visual context. However, semantic-only conditioning and creation-only training do not explicitly supervise the local structure needed for precise, temporally consistent editing. We therefore formulate depth and surface-normal prediction as image-form denoising targets, using these dense tasks as structured visual supervision within the same creation interface. Our framework decouples semantic interpretation from spatially aligned visual injection while sharing one multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) backbone across all tasks. Mutual Context Attention (MCA), a paired-video data-construction procedure, and a progressive training curriculum then connect the learned structural cues to temporally localized editing and reference-conditioned creation. A single checkpoint obtains the highest overall score in the reported comparison of unified systems (4.15); adding dense supervision improves OpenVE Overall from 3.98 to 4.06 and Local Add from 3.92 to 4.18. These results support a deliberately bounded conclusion: perception-oriented dense supervision transfers useful structural knowledge to downstream creation, especially editing locality and preservation; we do not claim superiority as a standalone dense predictor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将深度与表面法线预测作为图像形式的去噪目标，在同一多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）骨干网络内为统一图像/视频创建提供结构化视觉监督。通过互上下文注意力（MCA）、配对视频数据构造流程和渐进训练课程，将结构线索连接到时间局部编辑与参考条件创建。单一检查点在统合系统对比中获得最高总分（4.15），稠密监督显著提升编辑局部性（OpenVE Overall 3.98→4.06，Local Add 3.92→4.18），但作者刻意限定结论：稠密监督传递结构知识到下游创建任务，而非宣称其作为独立稠密预测器的优越性。
AI.motivation: 统一图像和视频创建需要模型在遵循多样指令的同时保持身份、几何和时间结构的一致性。然而，现有的语义条件与纯创建训练并未显式监督局部结构，难以实现精确且时间一致的编辑。这一洞察促使作者将稠密几何任务融入创建框架作为结构化监督。
AI.method: 将深度和表面法线预测公式化为图像形式的去噪目标，作为同一创建接口内的稠密任务监督。框架解耦语义解释与空间对齐的视觉注入，共享单一MMDiT骨干。引入互上下文注意力（MCA）机制、配对视频数据构造流程以及渐进训练课程，连接学习到的结构线索与时间局部编辑和参考条件创建。
AI.result: 单个检查点在统合系统对比中获得最高总分（4.15）。添加稠密监督将OpenVE Overall从3.98提升至4.06，Local Add从3.92提升至4.18，验证了稠密监督对编辑局部性和保存性的结构性知识迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 感知导向的稠密监督能够将有用的结构知识迁移至下游创建任务，尤其在编辑局部性和身份/几何保持方面表现出明显收益。作者刻意限定结论范围：该框架的优势在于稠密监督对创建的辅助作用，而非将其定位为独立的稠密预测器。

title: Remember Smarter: Visual History Compressor and Hyperbolic Experience Space for Robotic Memory
summary:
Long-horizon robot policies require compact access to recent observations and
  reusable experience without expanding the vision-language-action (VLA)
  context. We introduce Remember Smarter (RS), a plug-and-play module with
  complementary visual-history and hyperbolic experience-memory branches. Its
  visual branch compresses multi-view patch histories using bidirectional
  spatial Mamba and causal temporal Mamba, then exposes the resulting memory to
  action-facing hidden states through residual cross-attention while leaving the
  VLM visual-token stream unchanged. Its experience branch stores successful
  final-layer VLM states in a Poincare VAE space, organizes them hierarchically,
  and asynchronously converts retrieved experience into geodesic prompt tokens
  without blocking action inference. When adapted to pi0, RS increases total
  success on LIBERO-Plus from 53.6% to 70.6% and
  achieves substantial
  performance gains in real-robot experiments designed to evaluate memory
  retention and experience utilization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Remember Smarter (RS)，一个即插即用的模块，为长时程机器人策略提供紧凑的视觉历史压缩和可复用的经验记忆。通过双向空间Mamba和因果时间Mamba压缩多视角patch历史，并用Poincaré VAE空间存储成功经验，在LIBERO-Plus上从53.6%提升至70.6%的成功率，并在真实机器人实验中验证了记忆保持和经验利用能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人策略需要紧凑地访问近期观测和可复用的经验，但视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的上下文窗口有限，难以在扩展上下文中同时容纳历史观测和过往经验，因此需要一个在不扩大VLA上下文的前提下高效管理记忆与经验的机制。
AI.method: RS是一个即插即用模块，包含两个互补分支：(1) 视觉历史分支，使用双向空间Mamba和因果时间Mamba压缩多视角patch历史，并通过残差交叉注意力将记忆暴露给面向动作的隐藏状态，同时保持VLM视觉token流不变；(2) 经验记忆分支，在Poincaré VAE空间中存储成功的VLM最终层状态，进行层次化组织，并异步将检索到的经验转换为测地线提示token，不阻塞动作推理。
AI.result: 在pi0上适配RS后，LIBERO-Plus的总成功率从53.6%提升到70.6%，并在针对记忆保持和经验利用设计的真实机器人实验中取得了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RS通过将视觉历史压缩与层次化经验记忆结合，为VLA策略提供了高效的长时程记忆扩展方案，在不改变VLM视觉token流且不阻塞动作推理的前提下显著提升了任务成功率，验证了其在实际机器人操作中的有效性。

title: FedImp: Enhancing Federated Learning Convergence with Impurity-Based Weighting
comment: Accepted author manuscript (AAM) to appear in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is a collaborative paradigm that enables multiple devices to train a global model while preserving local data privacy. A major challenge in FL is the non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) nature of data across devices, which hinders training efficiency and slows convergence. To tackle this, we propose Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp), a novel algorithm that quantifies each device contribution based on the informational content of its local data. These contributions are normalized to compute distinct aggregation weights for the global model update. Extensive experiments on EMNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets show that FedImp significantly improves convergence speed, reducing communication rounds by up to 64.4%, 27.8%, and 66.7% on EMNIST, and 44.2%, 44%, and 25.6% on CIFAR-10 compared to FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAdp, respectively. Under highly imbalanced data distributions, FedImp outperforms all baselines and achieves the highest accuracy. Overall, FedImp offers an effective solution to enhance FL efficiency in non-IID settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedImp算法，通过量化各设备本地数据的信息含量（即"杂质权重"）来计算聚合权重，解决联邦学习中的非IID数据挑战，在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上显著提升收敛速度并减少通信轮次。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中设备间数据呈非独立同分布（non-IID）特性，严重阻碍训练效率和收敛速度，现有方法（如FedAvg、FedProx、FedAdp）在非IID场景下表现有限，需要更有效的加权聚合策略。
AI.method: 提出Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp)算法：基于各设备本地数据的信息含量（informational content）量化每个设备的贡献，并将这些贡献归一化以计算全局模型更新的不同聚合权重。
AI.result: 在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上的广泛实验表明：FedImp显著提升收敛速度，相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp，通信轮次分别减少高达64.4%、27.8%、66.7%（EMNIST）以及44.2%、44%、25.6%（CIFAR-10）。在高度不平衡的数据分布下，FedImp超越所有基线并达到最高准确率。
AI.conclusion: FedImp为联邦学习在非IID场景下提供了一种有效的解决方案，能够显著提升训练效率并保持高精度。

title: PolyComp: A Polycube-based Benchmark for Compositional 3D Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Models
summary: We introduce PolyComp, a procedurally generated and verified benchmark that stresses visual recognition and compositional spatial reasoning. In each problem, a model must identify which of four options shows a pair of polycube components that can be combined to form a target solid. The benchmark contains 120 problems across four geometry families, and each problem has three different presentation formats using either a single image or multiple images. The random guessing baseline is 25%. Across the three presentations (360 presented problems per model), GPT-5.6 Sol with max effort attains 50.0% accuracy (95% problem-cluster CI 43.3-56.7%) at a mean cost of \$0.951 per presented problem, Claude Fable 5 with max effort attains 39.4% (33.1-46.1%) at \$0.701, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with thinking level high attains 27.5% (22.8-32.5%), near the 25% random guessing baseline, at \$0.350. The observed accuracy spread across geometry families is larger than across presentation formats. We present a problem development and evaluation protocol, cost and token accounting, and release the 120 problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PolyComp基准测试，包含120个程序化生成并验证的几何问题，测试多模态大模型的视觉识别与组合空间推理能力。结果显示GPT-5.6 Sol达到50%准确率，Claude Fable 5为39.4%，Gemini 3.1 Pro仅27.5%（接近25%随机猜测基线），表明当前模型在此类组合空间推理任务上仍有显著提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉推理基准往往缺乏程序化生成的可验证问题，且难以评估模型在组合空间推理（即判断多个部件如何组合成目标形状）方面的能力。作者希望构建一个高难度的、可验证的基准，以测试前沿多模态大模型的组合几何推理极限。
AI.method: PolyComp基准包含120个程序化生成并验证的问题，涵盖四个几何家族。每个问题要求模型从四个选项中识别出能组合形成目标实体的多立方体（polycube）部件对。每种问题有三种呈现格式（单图或多图），共360个呈现问题/模型。提供随机猜测基线25%，并报告准确性、成本及分词统计，同时发布问题开发与评估协议。
AI.result: GPT-5.6 Sol（最大努力）达到50.0%准确率（95%CI 43.3-56.7%），平均每个问题成本0.951美元；Claude Fable 5达到39.4%（33.1-46.1%），成本0.701美元；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview（高思考级别）仅27.5%（22.8-32.5%），接近25%随机基线，成本0.350美元。几何家族间的准确率差异大于呈现格式间的差异。
AI.conclusion: PolyComp揭示了当前最强多模态模型在组合空间推理上的显著不足——即便是最好模型也仅达50%，且不同模型间差距巨大（Gemini接近随机猜测水平）。该基准可用于持续追踪模型在此类视觉-空间推理任务上的进展，并发布全部120个问题以促进后续研究。

title: VTInstructor: Visual Trajectory Prompting for Navigation Instruction Generation in Continuous Environments
summary: Navigation instruction generation from ego-centric RGB video in continuous environments is an important yet challenging task for human-robot interaction and scalable dataset construction. Prior instruction generators assume discrete viewpoint graphs with panoramic observations, where trajectory structure is explicit; in continuous environments, however, the agent receives only a dense RGB stream, making trajectory cues difficult to recover. We propose VTInstructor, the first VLN instruction generation framework for continuous environments. Our key idea is to convert implicit trajectory geometry into explicit visual trajectory prompts: EDTC condenses long RGB trajectories into navigation-critical keyframes, VTP overlays path, turn, and goal cues onto these anchors, VTMod injects the resulting trajectory signals into the visual encoder, and VT-GRPO further calibrates this spatial injection during training, all without requiring a navigation graph, pre-built map, or scene reconstruction. On the challenging R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val Unseen benchmarks, VTInstructor sets a new state of the art across all standard NLG metrics, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.357 CIDEr and +0.109 CIDEr, respectively. Beyond automatic metrics, VTInstructor-generated instructions raise a frozen follower's success rate to 63.3%, a +14.7 percentage-point gain over the best competing instruction source, and provide consistent data augmentation gains of +3 SR points on downstream navigation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了VTInstructor，这是首个面向连续环境的VLN指令生成框架。它通过EDTC将长RGB轨迹转换为关键帧、VTP在这些锚点上叠加路径/转向/目标线索、VTMod将轨迹信号注入视觉编码器、VT-GRPO在训练中校准空间注入，无需导航图、预建地图或场景重建。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上刷新SOTA，超越最强基线+0.357和+0.109 CIDEr，生成指令使冻结follower成功率提升至63.3%（+14.7个百分点），并在下游导航任务上提供+3 SR的数据增强收益。
AI.motivation: 连续环境下从第一视角RGB视频生成导航指令是重要但具有挑战性的任务。先前的指令生成器假设离散视角图和全景观测，轨迹结构显式；而连续环境中智能体仅接收稠密RGB流，轨迹线索难以恢复。核心挑战是将隐式的轨迹几何转换为可利用的信号。
AI.method: 提出VTInstructor框架，包含四个关键组件：(1) EDTC将长RGB轨迹压缩为导航关键帧；(2) VTP在这些关键帧锚点上叠加路径、转向和目标的视觉提示；(3) VTMod将轨迹信号注入视觉编码器；(4) VT-GRPO在训练阶段对空间注入进行校准。整个框架无需导航图、预建地图或场景重建。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val Unseen基准上，VTInstructor在所有标准NLG指标上刷新SOTA，超越最强基线分别+0.357和+0.109 CIDEr。生成指令使冻结follower的成功率达到63.3%，比最佳竞争指令来源高+14.7个百分点，并在下游导航任务上带来+3 SR的数据增强增益。
AI.conclusion: VTInstructor是首个面向连续环境的VLN指令生成框架，通过将隐式轨迹几何显式化为视觉轨迹提示，有效解决了连续RGB流中轨迹结构难以恢复的问题，在自动指标和下游导航任务上都取得了显著提升。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
summary: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD) to track microscopic distribution shifts. We also curate CausalMSBench, a diagnostic dataset isolating language priors. Benchmarking reveals that popular Omni-LLMs exhibit critically low CMS, showing negligible distribution shifts even when key modalities are removed. To rectify this, we propose Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), a training-free inference-time framework that uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to estimate modal activation strengths. MSA dynamically balances modal projections in the last hidden state, effectively restoring CMS across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLMs）中存在"感知-决策错位"（PDM）问题，提出了因果模态敏感性（CMS）的形式化定义及双视角诊断框架（ARR + LAD），构建了CausalMSBench诊断数据集，并提出了无需训练、推理时的模态子空间激活（MSA）方法，通过SVD估计模态激活强度并动态平衡隐状态中的模态投影，有效恢复了模型的CMS。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLMs在复杂多模态推理中表现出色，但其决策本质上往往并未忠实基于多模态感知，而是过度依赖语言先验，导致"感知-决策错位"（PDM）问题被强性能所掩盖。现有评估缺乏对此类错位的系统化诊断手段。
AI.method: (1) 形式化定义因果模态敏感性（CMS）；(2) 提出双视角诊断框架：宏观行为层的答案保留率（ARR）和微观分布层的对数几率角差异（LAD）；(3) 构建隔离语言先验的CausalMSBench诊断数据集；(4) 提出无需训练的推理时方法——模态子空间激活（MSA），利用SVD估计模态激活强度，在最后一层隐状态中动态平衡模态投影。
AI.result: 基准测试表明主流Omni-LLMs的CMS极低，即使移除关键模态，分布几乎无变化；应用MSA后，各基准上CMS显著恢复。
AI.conclusion: 当前Omni-LLMs存在严重的感知-决策错位问题，MSA作为一种轻量级推理时干预方案可有效增强模型对多模态感知的忠实度，为提升多模态推理可靠性与可解释性提供了新方向。

title: Beyond Boundary Noise: Aggregated Aleatoric Uncertainty Fails to Capture Presence Ambiguity in 3D Lung Nodule Segmentation
summary: Uncertainty estimation is critical for the safe clinical deployment of deep learning in medical image segmentation, with aleatoric uncertainty theoretically designed to capture irreducible data ambiguity. However, whether entropy-based measures reflect clinically meaningful ambiguity, i.e. case-level disagreement about whether a pathology is present at all, remains poorly understood.
