Contrary to most prior work, which focused on pixel-wise boundary disagreement, we systematically evaluate how well aleatoric uncertainty captures presence ambiguity. Our evaluation spans 3D lung nodule segmentation across four architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, on LIDC-IDRI and an external validation cohort (LNDb). We find that entropy-based uncertainty maps align with boundary noise and minor drawing variation but carry insufficient discriminative signal for presence ambiguity. In contrast, a lightweight supervised ambiguity head trained on frozen segmentation features substantially outperforms all entropy-aggregation-based baselines across architectures, metrics, and both cohorts, and matches or exceeds methods that explicitly model ambiguity under disagreement supervision (Probabilistic U-Net, Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet). A qualitative feature-space analysis shows that presence ambiguity is already encoded in the frozen encoder features of pixel-wise-trained networks, only to be discarded by the segmentation output and its entropy aggregation. Our findings expose a fundamental mismatch between the theoretical promise of aleatoric uncertainty and its practical behavior, and suggest that practitioners should not rely on entropy-based uncertainty as a proxy for clinical ambiguity in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了熵基偶然不确定性是否能捕获医学图像分割中的"存在性模糊"（即病例层面关于病理是否存在的分歧），发现熵基不确定性只能反映边界噪声，无法区分存在性模糊；而基于冻结分割特征训练的轻量级监督模糊头在所有架构、指标和两个队列上均显著优于熵聚合基线，甚至匹配或超越显式建模模糊的复杂方法。
AI.motivation: 偶然不确定性在理论上被设计用于捕获不可约的数据歧义，但熵基度量是否真正反映临床上有意义的模糊（即病理是否存在）仍不清楚。此前研究多聚焦于像素级边界分歧，而对存在性模糊的系统评估缺失，这对安全关键的临床部署至关重要。
AI.method: 在3D肺结节分割任务中，跨四种架构（采用Monte Carlo dropout和深度集成），在LIDC-IDRI及外部验证队列（LNDb）上系统比较熵基不确定性度量与存在性模糊的一致性。提出一个轻量级监督模糊头，基于冻结的分割编码器特征进行训练，并与熵聚合基线及Probabilistic U-Net、Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet等显式建模模糊的方法对比，同时进行特征空间定性分析。
AI.result: 熵基不确定性图与边界噪声及轻微绘制差异对齐，但对存在性模糊缺乏足够的判别信号。轻量级监督模糊头在所有架构、指标和两个队列上显著优于所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超过显式建模模糊的复杂方法。特征空间分析显示存在性模糊已编码在冻结编码器特征中，但在分割输出及其熵聚合过程中被丢弃。
AI.conclusion: 熵基偶然不确定性的理论承诺与实际行为之间存在根本性不匹配，实践者不应在安全关键应用中依赖熵基不确定性作为临床模糊性的代理指标。存在性模糊信息已在像素级训练网络的编码器特征中编码，设计更有效的解码方式可以更好地利用这些信息。

title: PhaseLoRA: Control-Regime-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation for Continuous-Action Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is a natural way to adapt pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but most adapter designs apply temporally static updates throughout a control rollout, overlooking the phase-dependent nature of continuous-action manipulation. Such policies traverse distinct regimes, including approach, contact transition, grasping, transport, and placement, each requiring different adaptation behaviors. We propose \textbf{PhaseLoRA}, a lightweight LoRA parameterization that conditions adaptation at each action-chunk prediction step using two weakly supervised descriptors: fine-control tendency and event/boundary intensity. PhaseLoRA modulates the LoRA left factor in the action expert, allowing the effective low-rank update direction to vary over time while keeping the backbone largely frozen. On LIBERO, PhaseLoRA improves average success rate by 12.2 points over a matched-parameter high-rank LoRA baseline and outperforms stronger LoRA variants. Ablations show that random temporal modulation and scalar gating do not reproduce the performance of the full model, while update-direction analyses reveal structured temporal variation associated with the predicted control descriptors. These results establish within-trajectory conditioning as an effective lightweight PEFT axis for continuous-action VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhaseLoRA，一种轻量级LoRA参数化方法，通过在动作专家模块中利用两个弱监督描述符（细粒度控制倾向和事件/边界强度）在每次动作块预测步骤动态调制LoRA左因子，使有效低秩更新方向随时间变化，从而适应连续动作操作中依赖阶段的行为。在LIBERO基准上，相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线，平均成功率提升12.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大多数现有的PEFT适配器设计在控制rollout过程中应用时间静态的更新，忽略了连续动作操作中固有的阶段依赖性。操作策略会经历接近、接触过渡、抓取、运输和放置等不同状态，每种状态需要不同的适应行为，静态适配无法有效应对。
AI.method: PhaseLoRA使用两个弱监督描述符（细粒度控制倾向和事件/边界强度）来条件化每次动作块预测步骤的适应。具体地，该方法在动作专家模块中调制LoRA左因子，使得有效低秩更新方向能够随时间变化，同时保持骨干网络大部分冻结。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，PhaseLoRA相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线平均成功率提升12.2个百分点，并优于更强的LoRA变体。消融实验表明，随机时间调制和标量门控无法复现完整模型的性能。更新方向分析揭示了与预测控制描述符相关联的结构化时间变化。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果确立了轨迹内条件化作为连续动作视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的有效轻量级PEFT轴，表明在控制轨迹内动态调节适配参数可以显著提升操作任务的成功率。

title: P2E-VQ: ECG-linked representation augmentation for PPG via discrete patch retrieval
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in consumer wearables because of its low cost and ease of acquisition. However, unlike electrocardiography (ECG), PPG measures peripheral pulse dynamics rather than cardiac electrical activity, limiting its ability to predict cardiac conditions that rely on ECG-specific morphological cues. Existing methods attempt to bridge this gap by reconstructing ECG signals from PPG signals. However, this inverse mapping is inherently ill-posed, and faithful waveform reconstruction does not necessarily translate into improved downstream performance. To address this challenge, we propose P2E-VQ, a retrieval-augmented framework that replaces ECG waveform reconstruction with ECG-linked representation retrieval. Specifically, P2E-VQ converts PPG patches into discrete tokens and retrieves ECG-linked information from a memory bank constructed exclusively from the training data. This process augments PPG representations while requiring only PPG signals during inference. Extensive experiments on five public datasets covering six downstream tasks, including clinical endpoint prediction and affective state recognition, demonstrate that P2E-VQ consistently outperforms pretrained baselines under a unified frozen-feature linear-probing protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出P2E-VQ框架，通过检索增强的方式将PPG转换为离散token并从训练集中检索ECG关联信息，替代传统的PPG到ECG波形重建方法，在五个公开数据集的六个下游任务中优于预训练基线。
AI.motivation: PPG信号虽然成本低且易于获取，但由于测量的是外周脉搏动力学而非心脏电活动，难以直接依赖ECG特有的形态学线索来预测心脏状况。现有方法尝试从PPG重建ECG信号，但这种逆向映射本质上是不适定问题，且忠实的波形重建并不一定能转化为更好的下游任务表现。
AI.method: P2E-VQ框架将PPG块转换为离散token，从仅由训练数据构建的记忆库中检索ECG关联信息，以此增强PPG表征。推理阶段仅需PPG信号即可完成。
AI.result: 在五个公开数据集上覆盖六个下游任务（包括临床终点预测和情感状态识别）的实验中，P2E-VQ在统一冻结特征线性探测协议下持续优于预训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 用ECG关联表示检索替代ECG波形重建是更有效的PPG-ECG桥接策略，检索增强框架能在仅使用PPG信号进行推理的前提下提升下游任务性能。

title: NARRATE: A Multimodal Real-World Australian Driving Dataset for Human-Centred Explanations in Automated Driving
comment: Accepted at The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) DriveX Workshop (Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving)
summary: Automated vehicles must explain their decisions in ways that passengers can understand, monitor, and trust. Existing language-annotated driving datasets are mostly observer-written, post-hoc, simulation-based, or generated from sensor inputs, rather than elicited from the driver performing the action. We introduce NARRATE, a multimodal real-world Australian driving dataset comprising 2,050 annotated events from 35 experienced drivers and driving instructors on public roads. Each event is grounded in synchronised visual, localisation, motion, and LiDAR streams and paired with in-vehicle and/or post-drive free-text explanations. NARRATE provides action labels, scenario-context labels spanning six high-level and 32 fine-grained categories, and span-level Situational Awareness (SA) annotations over driver explanations for Perception, Comprehension and Projection. Four benchmark tasks (SA, scenario-context, driver-action classification, and explanation generation) show that this structure is learnable from driver language, while fine-grained context recognition and explanation generation remain challenging. NARRATE paves a path towards more human-centred and domain-aware explanation models for automated driving.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍NARRATE，一个多模态真实世界澳大利亚驾驶数据集，包含35名经验丰富驾驶员和驾驶教练在公共道路上采集的2,050个带注释事件，每个事件同步视觉、定位、运动、LiDAR数据流，并配有车内/车后自由文本解释，还提供行动标签、场景上下文标签（6个高层、32个细粒度类别）和驾驶员解释的情景意识（SA）跨度级标注（感知、理解、预测）。四个基准任务显示该结构可从驾驶员语言中学习，但细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆需要以乘客能理解、监控和信任的方式解释其决策，但现有语言注释驾驶数据集大多是观察者编写的、事后性的、基于仿真的或源于传感器输入，而非来自执行动作的驾驶员本身。缺乏由驾驶员主动引发的自然语言解释数据，阻碍了更人性化的自动驾驶解释模型开发。
AI.method: 构建NARRATE数据集：在公共道路上从35名经验驾驶员和驾驶教练处收集2,050个注释事件；每个事件融合同步视觉、定位、运动、LiDAR多模态流，并配对车内和/或车后的自由文本解释；提供行动标签、6个高层和32个细粒度类别的场景上下文标签，以及基于驾驶员解释的跨度级情景意识（SA）标注（感知、理解、预测）；设定四个基准任务（SA、场景上下文、驾驶员行动分类、解释生成）。
AI.result: 四个基准任务表明从驾驶员语言中可学习该注释结构；但细粒度上下文识别和解释生成任务仍然具有挑战性，说明该领域仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: NARRATE为自动驾驶领域更人性化、更具领域意识的解释模型铺平了道路，为后续研究提供了高质量的自然驾驶员语言数据资源。

title: SCORE: Shape-Conforming Regions for Flight in Enclosed, Degraded Environments
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Technical appendix available on request
summary: Autonomous UAVs enter enclosed environments such as caves and collapsed structures that confine the vehicle and degrade perception. Conformal prediction provides a distribution-free guarantee by calibrating how far an obstacle keep-out must expand to absorb perception error at a target coverage level. However, existing keep-out regions use convex primitives whose bulges consume narrow passages and grow as perception degrades. Our main contribution defines the nonconformity score on a signed distance field (SDF). This produces a non-convex keep-out that tightly follows obstacle geometry and avoids the unnecessary bulging of equal-margin convex regions. Two supporting components keep this geometry usable as perception degrades. First, a voxelwise union of complementary sensor observations certifies voxels that any single sensor misses. Second, the margin around the obstacle adapts to measured visibility without weather labels or the online ground-truth feedback that single-pass flight cannot provide. Results on real subterranean data show that the resulting distribution-free, shape-conforming keep-out retains more usable free space than convex baselines at the same certified coverage, and produces safer closed-loop flight.

AI.tldr: 提出基于符号距离场(SDF)定义非一致性得分的共形预测方法，生成紧贴障碍物几何的非凸保持区（keep-out），相比凸基元方法在相同认证覆盖率下保留更多可用自由空间，并使闭环飞行更安全。
AI.motivation: 自主无人机进入洞穴、坍塌结构等密闭环境时，感知会退化。现有保持区使用凸基元，其凸起会占用狭窄通道，且随感知退化而膨胀扩大，导致可用空间减少。
AI.method: 1) 将非一致性得分定义在符号距离场(SDF)上，生成非凸且紧贴障碍物几何的保持区，避免等裕度凸区域的冗余膨胀；2) 采用体素级并集融合互补传感器观测，认证单一传感器遗漏的体素；3) 根据测量能见度自适应调整障碍物周围裕度，无需天气标签或在线真值反馈。
AI.result: 在真实地下数据上的结果表明，所提出的无分布假设、形状贴合的非凸保持区在相同认证覆盖率下比凸基线保留更多可用自由空间，并产生更安全的闭环飞行。
AI.conclusion: 基于SDF的共形非凸保持区有效解决了感知退化环境下的安全空间分配问题，兼顾了覆盖率保障与空间利用率，为密闭环境中的自主无人机导航提供了更优的分布无关安全保障方案。

title: LUNG-KGMM: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Learning for Lung Cancer Incidence Prediction
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, accepted by PRCV Oral
summary: Early identification of lung cancer risk is critical for timely intervention, yet existing prediction models are limited by their reliance on single data modalities and their inability to leverage structured clinical knowledge. We propose LUNG-KGMM, a knowledge-guided multimodal framework that integrates longitudinal electronic health records, radiology reports, chest radiograph representations, and guideline-derived knowledge for 1-to-6-year incident lung cancer prediction. To address modality heterogeneity and potential data leakage, we develop a leakage-sanitized report processing pipeline and a horizon-masked cumulative training objective that handles incomplete follow-up. We further introduce a knowledge-graph representation of clinical guidance that encodes report-triggered finding-attribute-action relations as an auditable knowledge stream. We build a multimodal development cohort from the publicly available MIMIC databases and construct a real-world validation cohort from the Xiamen Medical Big Data Platform. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC cohort demonstrate that LUNG-KGMM achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods, and validation on the Xiamen cohort further characterizes its cross-cohort portability and the need for local adaptation. The MIMIC development cohort is publicly accessible; the Xiamen cohort is governed by local data privacy regulations.

AI.tldr: 提出LUNG-KGMM，一个知识引导的多模态框架，整合纵向电子健康记录、影像报告、胸片特征和结构化临床知识，用于1-6年肺癌发病风险预测，在MIMIC队列上优于现有方法并在外部队列验证了跨队列可移植性。
AI.motivation: 肺癌风险的早期识别对及时干预至关重要，但现有预测模型局限于单一数据模态，且无法利用结构化的临床知识，限制了预测性能与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出LUNG-KGMM，融合电子健康记录、放射学报告、胸片表征及指南衍生知识；通过泄漏净化报告处理流水线和水平线掩蔽累积训练目标解决模态异质性和数据泄漏问题；引入临床指南的知识图谱表示，将报告触发的发现-属性-行动关系编码为可审计的知识流。
AI.result: 在MIMIC开发队列上超越SOTA方法；在厦门真实世界队列上验证了跨队列可移植性并揭示本地适配的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的多模态融合能有效提升肺癌发病预测性能，但跨机构部署需进行本地适配以应对数据分布差异。

title: Uncertainty Identifies Difficult Samples Across Methods: A Multi-Task Study on a Heterogeneous Skin Lesion Dataset
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, UNSURE 2026 @ MICCAI camera ready
summary: Skin lesion classifiers can be confidently wrong on the cases that matter most, so knowing when a prediction should not be trusted is clinically as useful as the prediction. We study uncertainty quantification on a dataset pooled from many ISIC sources, with a shared backbone and two jointly learned heads: a binary malignant versus non-malignant head and a five-class diagnostic head. Five UQ methods (MC Dropout, DropConnect, Flipout, Deep Ensembles, DUQ) are compared on accuracy, calibration, uncertainty decomposition, and risk-coverage. Difficulty is largely method-agnostic: even methods with narrow entropy distributions rank the same samples as hard (per-sample entropy correlations of $0.54$ to $0.91$). The choice of method matters more for calibration and uncertainty decomposition, where Deep Ensembles is the clear winner, than for finding difficult cases. The ranking is also good enough that deferring the most uncertain cases removes a disproportionate share of errors, supporting uncertainty-based selective referral, evaluated here in-distribution only.

AI.tldr: 本文研究皮肤病变分类器的不确定性量化（UQ）方法。在多源ISIC数据池上，用共享骨干网络和双头结构（二分类恶性/非恶性头+五分类诊断头），比较了五种UQ方法（MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles、DUQ）在准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖方面的表现。研究发现样本难度大多与具体方法无关，各方法对同一批样本的困难排序高度相关（熵相关系数0.54-0.91）；方法选择对校准和不确定性分解影响更大，Deep Ensembles表现最佳；基于不确定性的选择性转诊可有效移除不成比例的误差（仅在分布内评估）。
AI.motivation: 皮肤病变分类器在关键病例上可能自信地犯错，因此知道何时不应信任预测与预测本身同样具有临床价值。作者旨在系统研究不同不确定性量化方法在该领域的效果，以支持临床上的选择性转诊决策。
AI.method: 采用从多个ISIC来源池化的数据集，使用共享骨干网络和两个联合学习的头部（二分类恶性/非恶性头与五分类诊断头）。对五种UQ方法（MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles、DUQ）进行系统比较，从准确性、校准、不确定性分解（认知/偶然不确定性）和风险覆盖四个方面评估。
AI.result: 样本难度在大体上是方法无关的，即使熵分布窄的方法也能对相同样本排出相似的困难度（每样本熵相关性0.54-0.91）。方法选择对校准和不确定性分解影响更大，其中Deep Ensembles明显最优。基于不确定性排序的转诊能够不成比例地移除误差，支持基于不确定性的选择性转诊（仅在分布内评估）。
AI.conclusion: 在皮肤病变分类中，不同UQ方法在识别困难样本方面高度一致，但Deep Ensembles在校准和不确定性分解上表现最优。不确定性排名的可靠性支持将其用于选择性转诊，从而提升临床安全性，但需要进一步在分布外场景中验证。

title: MM-BEV: Enhancing Timeliness by Computing Where and When it Matters
summary: Multimodal bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception combines LiDAR depth accuracy with dense camera semantics, but its high computational cost and imperfect sensing conditions make real-time deployment challenging. Existing methods largely compress individual detectors and overlook three opportunities: structured sparsity within camera and LiDAR inputs, timing misalignment between modalities, and the fact that many detected objects do not affect the planner's immediate action. We present MM-BEV, a real-time multimodal BEV system guided by a simple principle: compute where and when it matters. MM-BEV divides perception into mandatory work for safety-critical objects within braking distance of the ego vehicle and with short time-to-collision (TTC), and optional work for less urgent regions. It prioritizes mandatory work and reduces or sheds optional work under tight compute budgets. MM-BEV integrates four mechanisms: (1) a criticality-ranked temporal ROI selector based on motion-extrapolated detections from prior frames; (2) sparse, ROI-aware feature extraction using shared-shape camera crops at context-adaptive resolution and ROI-aware LiDAR voxelization; (3) a latency-aware coordinator that adapts LiDAR sweeps, image resolution, and keyframes according to scene dynamics and TTC; and (4) an asynchronous scheduler that decouples sensing from inference and skips stale frames. On nuScenes, MM-BEV reduces inference latency by 1.96x and end-to-end latency by 2.93x, with no loss in geometry-critical recall and only a 0.2 percentage-point drop in safety-critical recall. On a Clearpath Husky A300 equipped with an Ouster-128 LiDAR, BEV cameras, and a Jetson AGX Orin, MM-BEV further reduces mean latency by 2.11x, demonstrating its potential for real-world autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: MM-BEV是一个实时的多模态鸟瞰图(BEV)感知系统，基于"按需计算"原则（即"在需要的地方和时间进行计算"），将感知任务分为安全关键（必须完成）和可选（可裁剪）两类，通过时间ROI选择、稀疏特征提取、延迟感知协调器和异步调度器四个机制，在nuScenes数据集上减少1.96倍推理延迟和2.93倍端到端延迟，且在真实机器人平台上减少2.11倍平均延迟，同时几乎不损失检测召回率。
AI.motivation: 多模态BEV感知虽然结合了LiDAR深度精度和相机密集语义的优势，但计算成本高且传感条件不完善，难以实时部署。现有方法大多只是压缩单个检测器，忽视了三个关键机会：相机和LiDAR输入内的结构化稀疏性、模态间的时间错位、以及许多被检测对象并不影响规划器当前行动这一事实。
AI.method: MM-BEV将感知分为两类工作：针对制动距离内且TTC短的物体的安全关键（强制）工作，和针对较不紧急区域的（可选）工作。在紧凑计算预算下优先处理强制工作，减少或丢弃可选工作。系统整合四个机制：(1)基于运动外推检测的临界度排序时间ROI选择器；(2)使用上下文自适应分辨率的共享形状相机裁剪和ROI感知LiDAR体素化的稀疏ROI特征提取；(3)根据场景动态和TTC自适应调整LiDAR扫描、图像分辨率和关键帧的延迟感知协调器；(4)将感知与推理解耦并跳过过期帧的异步调度器。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，MM-BEV将推理延迟降低1.96倍，端到端延迟降低2.93倍，几何关键召回率无损失，安全关键召回率仅下降0.2个百分点。在配备Ouster-128 LiDAR、BEV相机和Jetson AGX Orin的Clearpath Husky A300平台上，平均延迟进一步降低2.11倍，展示了其在真实自主系统中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: MM-BEV通过"按需计算"原则实现了多模态BEV感知的实时化，在显著降低延迟的同时几乎不牺牲安全关键检测性能，证明了结构化稀疏性、时间错位管理和动态资源分配是解决多模态BEV实时部署难题的有效途径，为真实自主系统的实时感知提供了可行方案。

title: pico-type: A 1.5M-Parameter Byte-Level Multi-Head Content Classifier
summary: We introduce pico-type, a byte-level multi-head content classifier with approximately 1.5 million parameters that simultaneously predicts seven content properties from raw UTF-8 bytes in a single forward pass. Operating directly at the byte level -- no tokenizer, no subword vocabulary, no pretrained embeddings -- pico-type classifies coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), file MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-label multi-label: API keys, JWTs, passwords, emails, phone numbers, SSH keys). The architecture combines a learned byte embedding, three convolutional blocks with growing receptive fields, two bidirectional attention layers with rotary position encodings, and a statistical pooling layer feeding seven Matryoshka-style classification heads. Four tiered variants (tiny/small/base/pro) share the same trunk with sliced representations from 16 to 576 dimensions, yielding ONNX exports under 210 KB and CPU inference under 10 ms. Trained on a mixture of synthetic templates and real-world data (8709 GitHub code samples, 5000 Wikipedia articles), pico-type achieves 60.3 percent code language accuracy on The Heap benchmark (24 languages) and 98.2 percent text language accuracy on Wikipedia (30 languages) -- improvements of +57 and +79 percentage points respectively over the synthetic-only baseline. Format-based heads (coarse, modality, subtype, file_mime, risk) maintain 100 percent accuracy on synthetic benchmarks. The model, code, and pretrained weights are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍pico-type，一个约150万参数的字节级多任务内容分类器，直接在原始UTF-8字节上运行（无需分词器、子词表或预训练嵌入），通过单次前向传播同时预测7种内容属性：粗粒度类型（12类）、模态（8类）、子类型（24类）、代码语言（62类）、文本语言（30类）、文件MIME类型（90类）及风险标志（6标签多标签）。模型共4个变体，ONNX导出小于210KB，CPU推理低于10ms。在The Heap基准上代码语言准确率60.3%，Wikipedia文本语言准确率98.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有内容分类器通常依赖分词器、预训练嵌入或大规模模型，在资源受限场景（边缘设备、低延迟应用）中部署困难。作者希望构建一个极轻量、无需tokenizer、可直接在字节层面工作的多任务分类器，同时保持对多种内容属性的分类能力。
AI.method: pico-type架构包括：学习的字节嵌入层、三个感受野递增的卷积块、两层带旋转位置编码的双向注意力层、统计池化层，以及7个Matryoshka风格分类头。四个变体（tiny/small/base/pro）共享相同的主干网络，仅表示维度从16到576切片。训练数据混合合成模板与真实数据（8709个GitHub代码样本、5000篇Wikipedia文章）。
AI.result: 在The Heap基准上，代码语言准确率达60.3%（24种语言），较纯合成基线提升+57个百分点；Wikipedia文本语言准确率达98.2%（30种语言），较基线提升+79个百分点。格式相关头（coarse、modality、subtype、file_mime、risk）在合成基准上保持100%准确率。模型参数约150万，ONNX导出小于210KB，CPU推理低于10ms。
AI.conclusion: pico-type展示了字节级、无tokenizer的极轻量多任务分类器可在真实数据上取得良好效果，特别是格式类属性分类准确率极高（100%），代码和文本语言分类在加入真实数据训练后显著提升。模型、代码和预训练权重均以Apache 2.0开源发布。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Tool for Combating Child Labour: A Real-Time Edge Vision Pipeline for Child Detection and Age Estimation
summary: An estimated 138 million children remain in child labour worldwide, and the monitoring systems used by affected sectors, built on periodic household visits and interviews, systematically under-detect them. We present a real-time computer-vision pipeline, built and operated solely as a research prototype, that studies the feasibility of giving Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation Systems (CLMRS) a continuous, presence-based evidence channel. The pipeline combines a multi-task person and face detector (YOLO26x backbone in the CerberusDet framework), cascaded age estimation pairing MiVOLO v2 with a child-specialist model for ages 0-12, ByteTrack tracking, ArcFace and DINOv2 re-identification, and track-level fusion producing reviewable per-person records. The detector raises person mAP@0.5 from 0.390 to 0.683 over the previous-generation baseline; the child specialist reaches 1.944 years MAE on children-only validation, where widely used open-source stacks err by 18-23 years. FP8 TensorRT compilation yields a 1.77x speedup at +0.002 years MAE, bringing the pipeline above twice real-time on embedded hardware. On 26.8 hours of proxy video the system finds 634 unique child candidates versus 285 for its predecessor. We further report a seventeen-day unattended field pilot on a farm in Zimbabwe (38.7 million frames, six cameras) evaluated against a daily attendance register: software tuning improved detection yield 36-fold, and identity consolidation under a simultaneity veto cut over-reporting from 9.1x to 1.8-3.9x with zero proven-false merges. We document training and quantisation failures alongside successes, and the data-protection and human-in-the-loop safeguards such a system requires.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个纯研究用途的实时计算机视觉流水线，为儿童劳动监测与补救系统（CLMRS）提供基于持续在场证据的监测通道。该系统整合多任务检测（CerberusDet/YOLO26x）、级联年龄估计（MiVOLO v2 + 儿童专家模型）、ByteTrack追踪、ArcFace与DINOv2重识别及轨迹级融合，生成可审查的个人记录。检测器mAP@0.5从0.390提升至0.683；儿童专用年龄模型MAE达1.944年（开源栈误差18-23年）；FP8 TensorRT编译带来1.77倍加速并在嵌入硬件上超过两倍实时。在津巴布韦农场17天无人值守试点（6台相机、3870万帧）中，软件调优使检测产量提升36倍，身份合并（同时性否决）将过度报告从9.1倍降至1.8-3.9倍且零确证错误合并。
AI.motivation: 全球仍有约1.38亿儿童处于童工状态，而现有基于周期性家访和访谈的监测系统系统性漏检。作者旨在探索为CLMRS提供连续、基于在场证据的实时监测通道，以弥补传统监测方法覆盖不足的缺陷。
AI.method: 构建端到端计算机视觉流水线：采用CerberusDet框架中YOLO26x骨干的多任务人体与人脸检测器；级联年龄估计（MiVOLO v2结合针对0-12岁儿童的专门模型）；ByteTrack目标追踪；ArcFace与DINOv2跨时空重识别；轨迹级融合以生成可人工审查的个人记录。额外包含FP8 TensorRT量化加速及在津巴布韦农场的多相机长期部署验证。
AI.result: 检测器相较上一代基线mAP@0.5从0.390升至0.683；儿童专用年龄估计模型MAE为1.944年（而广泛使用的开源栈误差达18-23年）；FP8 TensorRT编译实现1.77倍加速且MAE仅增加0.002年；嵌入硬件上运行速度超过实时两倍。在26.8小时代理视频上检测出634个儿童候选（前一版本为285个）。17天野外试点中软件调优使检测产量提升36倍；在同时性否决下过度报告从9.1倍降至1.8-3.9倍，且零确证错误合并。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了在嵌入式硬件上、以超过实时速度运行连续童工监测视觉流水线的技术可行性，展现了显著的检测性能提升。同时作者如实记录了训练与量化失败案例，并强调此类系统必须具备数据保护与人在回路（human-in-the-loop）保障机制，指出技术部署与社会伦理约束需同步推进。

title: Accelerating Mixed Discrete-Continuous Motion Planning via Neural Graphs of Convex Sets
summary:
Motion planning problems such as collision-free navigation and contact-rich manipulation can be naturally formulated as optimization problems that couple discrete decisions with continuous trajectories. The Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) framework offers a practical solution to these problems. It represents discrete decisions as nodes of a graph and encodes continuous trajectories in the edges connecting them. However, the resulting optimization subproblems can become computationally prohibitive for online replanning.
  In this work, we propose a learning-based strategy to mitigate this limitation. Specifically, we replace the costly convex relaxation step required by nominal GCS with a single forward pass through a Graph Attention Network that predicts a set of highly probable candidate paths through the graph. A lightweight ranking network then orders these candidates by their estimated trajectory cost. Evaluating them in this order, we terminate our search early while still recovering a near-optimal motion plan. We validate the resulting pipeline across diverse robotic tasks, including collision-free motion planning for a 3D quadrotor and a 7-DoF manipulator, and planning through contact for planar pushing. Across both convex and non-convex cost and constraint settings, our approach yields up to two orders of magnitude speedup over nominal GCS while maintaining a 100% success rate, at the cost of some suboptimality in the recovered solutions. Code implementations and video demonstrations can be found at https://neural-gcs.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neural-GCS，一种基于图注意力网络的学习策略来加速图的凸集（GCS）运动规划框架。该方法用一个前向传播的GAT网络替代GCS中计算昂贵的凸松弛步骤，预测高度可能的候选路径，再用轻量级排序网络按估计轨迹成本排序并提前终止搜索，在保持100%成功率的同时实现比原始GCS快两个数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: GCS框架将运动规划问题表述为离散决策与连续轨迹耦合的优化问题，虽然实用，但其凸松弛步骤的计算成本高，难以支持在线重规划场景。作者旨在通过学习方法来缓解这一计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 用图注意力网络（Graph Attention Network）的前向传播替代GCS中昂贵的凸松弛步骤，预测一组高度可能的候选路径；2) 设计轻量级排序网络按估计轨迹成本对候选路径排序；3) 按成本顺序评估候选路径，提前终止搜索，仍能恢复近最优的运动规划方案。
AI.result: 在多种机器人任务（3D四旋翼无碰撞规划、7自由度机械臂规划、平面推挤接触规划）上验证，涵盖凸和非凸成本/约束设置。相比原始GCS实现高达两个数量级的加速，同时保持100%成功率，代价是解存在一定次优性。
AI.conclusion: Neural-GCS通过图注意力网络与排序网络的结合，有效解决了GCS框架在线重规划的计算瓶颈，在大幅提升计算效率的同时维持了任务成功率，为学习驱动的运动规划提供了可行方案。

title: Ring-based Spatial Transformer: Learning Non-linear Spatial Interactions between Building Distribution and Pedestrian Flow
summary: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer to learn how building uses at different distances from a railway station interact to generate pedestrian flow. Concentric ring buffers at 100-meter intervals up to 800 meters were defined around 100 randomly selected stations in Tokyo, treating each ring as a spatial token. Self-Attention was applied to learn inter-zone interactions directly from data, without prior structural assumptions. GPS-derived walking trip counts served as the target variable and Geographically Weighted Regression as the baseline. Across 30 independent trials, the SpatialTransformer consistently outperformed GWR in predictive accuracy. SHAP analysis revealed that mid-to-outer distance zone features dominate pedestrian flow prediction, while features from the 0-100m zone contributed little. The attention matrix showed that each distance zone attends most strongly to spatially distant zones, demonstrating that pedestrian flow is regulated by structural interactions across the entire catchment area rather than by any single zone in isolation. These findings challenge the compact city assumption that station-proximate development maximizes pedestrian flow, and suggest that land use distribution across the full walkable catchment area deserves greater consideration in urban planning practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于环形缓冲区的SpatialTransformer模型，将车站周边800米范围内每100米间隔的同心环视为空间token，利用Self-Attention学习不同距离区域间的土地利用交互对行人流量的影响。模型在30次独立试验中持续优于地理加权回归（GWR）基线，SHAP分析显示中远距离区域特征主导预测，注意力矩阵表明各区域与空间远端区域关联最强，挑战了"紧凑城市"假设中站点邻近开发最大化的观点。
AI.motivation: 传统方法（如GWR）通常假设行人流量主要由车站邻近区域的土地利用决定，且依赖预先设定的空间结构假设，难以捕捉整个步行集水区内不同距离区域间的复杂交互作用。作者希望直接从数据中学习这些交互，而非依赖强先验假设，以检验"紧凑城市"理论是否真实成立。
AI.method: 在东京随机选取100个车站，围绕每个车站定义间隔100米、最高800米的同心环形缓冲区，将每个环视为一个空间token；对环内土地利用特征应用Self-Attention机制学习跨区域交互；以GPS采集的步行出行次数为回归目标，使用GWR作为基线模型对比，并通过SHAP和注意力矩阵进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: SpatialTransformer在30次独立试验中预测精度一致优于GWR；SHAP显示中至外距离区域（而非0-100米核心区）的特征对行人流量预测贡献最大；注意力矩阵揭示每个距离区间与其空间远端区域产生最强注意力权重，表明行人流量受整个集水区结构性交互的调节。
AI.conclusion: 行人流量并非由车站紧邻区域单独决定，而是由整个步行集水区的土地利用结构交互共同生成。这一发现对"紧凑城市"假设提出质疑，提示城市规划应将完整步行可达范围内的土地利用分布纳入综合考量，而非仅关注站前高密度开发。

title: AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions
summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20\% to >70\%. The standardized LI-RADS criteria establish a biopsy-free, fully imaging-based framework that can serve as a foundation for automating HCC diagnosis with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality labels has limited the development of AI models for LI-RADS characterization. We introduce the \textbf{AMPLIFAI} dataset, the first public dataset of multiphase abdominal CT scans annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. Following the \emph{Datasheets for Datasets} format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation process, and annotation pipeline to facilitate transparent, reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AMPLIFAI数据集，这是首个公开的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，包含LI-RADS分类标注以及三个主要LI-RADS特征（动脉期强化、廓清、强化包膜）的分割标注，旨在填补AI辅助肝癌（HCC）诊断研究中高质量公开数据的空白。论文遵循Datasheets for Datasets规范，详细记录了数据集的组成、整理流程和标注流程。
AI.motivation: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是全球癌症相关死亡的第三大原因，早期检测可将生存率从低于20%提升到超过70%。LI-RADS标准建立了无需活检、完全基于影像的诊断框架，可作为AI自动化HCC诊断的基础。然而，缺乏带有高质量标注的大规模公开数据集，严重限制了LI-RADS表征AI模型的发展。
AI.method: 作者构建了AMPLIFAI数据集，这是首个公开的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，包含LI-RADS分类标注以及三个关键LI-RADS特征（动脉期高强化、廓清、增强包膜）的病灶分割标注。论文遵循Datasheets for Datasets格式，详细说明数据集的组成、整理流程和标注流程，以促进透明且可复现的研究。
AI.result: 该论文主要贡献是发布了AMPLIFAI数据集——首个公开的、包含LI-RADS类别标注及三大LI-RADS特征分割标注的多期腹部CT数据集，为AI肝癌诊断研究提供了标准化、可复现的公开数据资源。
AI.conclusion: AMPLIFAI数据集填补了LI-RADS AI研究领域公开数据集的空白，通过提供透明、可复现的数据集文档（遵循Datasheets for Datasets规范），为后续AI模型的开发、验证和比较奠定了数据基础，有望推动肝癌影像诊断自动化的发展。

title: GUIDER: Evaluating Goal-Free Human Intent Inference for Teleoperated Manipulation on Real-Robot Data
summary: This paper presents an evaluation of a goal-free probabilistic framework for human intent inference during robotic manipulation. We deploy the Global User Intent Dual-phase Estimation for Robots (GUIDER) on data collected from a robotic arm to test the manipulation phase across various assistance scenarios, including making tea and fetching medicine. To support operation, we add online probability updates, workspace limits, support-plane filtering, and a grasping mode that prioritizes feasible grasp regions, all of which are tested on the recorded data while preserving its original temporal conditions. Across 20 manipulation steps in three scenarios, GUIDER estimated human intent within the correct grasp-candidate set in all cases and achieved a time to confident prediction of 3.7 s, a remaining time before first grasp of 49.6 s, a prediction stability of 96.4%, and a runtime of 4.857/4.474 s (mean/median) per perceptual phase of intent.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一种用于机器人操纵过程中人类意图推断的无目标概率框架GUIDER，在制作茶和取药等协助场景中部署于机械臂，并结合在线概率更新、工作空间限制、支撑面过滤和抓取模式等增强模块。在三个场景的20个操纵步骤中，GUIDER在所有情况下都将人类意图估计在正确的抓取候选集内，置信预测时间为3.7秒，抓取前剩余时间为49.6秒，预测稳定性达96.4%，每个感知阶段意图的运行时间为4.857/4.474秒（均值/中位数）。
AI.motivation: 在机器人辅助操纵中，准确推断人类意图对于实现流畅、稳健的人机协作至关重要，但现有方法往往依赖目标先验或缺乏实时性。作者旨在提出并评估一种无需目标预设的概率性意图推断框架，以在真实机器人数据上验证其有效性和实用性。
AI.method: 采用GUIDER（Global User Intent Dual-phase Estimation for Robots）概率框架，包含推理和操纵双阶段。引入四项增强技术：在线概率更新、工作空间边界限制、支撑面过滤以及优先考虑可行抓取区域的抓取模式。实验基于机械臂采集的数据，在保持原始时间条件的前提下测试多个协助场景（如泡茶、取药）。
AI.result: 在三个场景共20个操纵步骤中，GUIDER在所有测试案例中均将人类意图估计在正确的抓取候选集内。量化指标包括：达到置信预测的时间为3.7秒，首次抓取前剩余时间为49.6秒，预测稳定性96.4%，每个意图感知阶段的运行时间为均值4.857秒/中位数4.474秒。
AI.conclusion: GUIDER作为一种无目标概率意图推断框架，在多种机器人协助场景中展现出高准确率（所有案例均落入正确候选集）、强稳定性（96.4%）和可接受的实时性能（约4.5-4.9秒/感知阶段），证明了该方法在辅助操纵任务中推断人类意图的可行性。

title: An automatic-differentiation framework for time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography inversion of hydrologic dynamics
comment: Main text: 10 figures. Supplementary Information: 2 figures and 2 tables
summary: Time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography (TL-ERT) provides spatially distributed information on subsurface hydrologic changes. However, inversion of long monitoring sequences is computationally demanding. Modifying the data misfit, regularization, model parameterization, or petrophysical transformation may also require new gradient derivations and separate implementations. Here, we present AD-TLERT, a unified, GPU-accelerated framework for time-lapse ERT inversion based on automatic differentiation. The framework integrates model parameterization, differentiable petrophysical transformations, forward modeling, data misfit, regularization and auxiliary constraints into a single computational chain. Alternative inversion formulations can therefore reuse the same PDE derivative implementation without re-deriving the complete ERT sensitivity for each case. Comparisons with pyGIMLi showed close agreement in the forward responses, gradients, and recovered resistivity models. Under the tested configuration, AD-TLERT achieved an approximately 51-fold speedup. Synthetic experiments showed that inversion choices affect the amplitude, geometry, and temporal behavior of recovered anomalies. By propagating gradients through the embedded petrophysical relationship, AD-TLERT enabled direct water-content inversion and yielded more accurate estimates than post-inversion conversion for the tested model. A field application further demonstrated how ERT, temperature, and soil-moisture observations can be combined to image snowmelt-driven hillslope wetting. AD-TLERT provides an efficient and flexible framework for time-lapse ERT inversion and hydrologic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AD-TLERT，一个基于自动微分、GPU加速的统一时移电阻率层析成像（TL-ERT）反演框架。该框架将模型参数化、可微分的岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据拟合、正则化和辅助约束整合到单一计算链中，避免了为每种反演公式重新推导ERT敏感性。在测试配置下实现了约51倍加速，并通过嵌入岩石物理关系实现直接含水量反演，比后处理转换更准确。
AI.motivation: 长时间监测序列的TL-ERT反演计算开销巨大；修改数据拟合项、正则化、模型参数化或岩石物理变换时，通常需要重新推导梯度并进行独立的代码实现，导致开发效率低且灵活性差。
AI.method: 基于自动微分构建统一的GPU加速反演框架，将模型参数化、可微岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据拟合、正则化和辅助约束整合为单一计算链，使不同反演公式共享PDE导数实现，无需为每种情况重新推导完整ERT灵敏度。
AI.result: 与pyGIMLi对比，前向响应、梯度和恢复电阻率模型高度一致；在测试配置下获得约51倍加速。合成实验表明反演选择影响恢复异常振幅、几何形状和时间行为；通过嵌入岩石物理关系进行梯度传播，直接含水量反演比后处理转换更准确。野外应用展示了ERT、温度和土壤湿度观测联合成像融雪驱动山坡湿润过程。
AI.conclusion: AD-TLERT为时移ERT反演和水文解释提供了高效、灵活的统一框架，能够显著加速计算并支持多样化的反演方案和直接水文参数反演。

title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
comment: 12 pages, 6 pages appendix, 13 figures, technical report
summary: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.

AI.tldr: MegaParts是一个可扩展的自回归3D生成框架，通过结合结构化序列建模和token高效的向量量化形状分词器，解决了高复杂度部件感知3D物体生成中token长度和内存开销过大的问题，支持多达300个部件和256k token序列长度，在网格质量和可控性上均优于现有自回归和扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的部件感知3D生成方法在面对高度复杂物体时扩展性不足，随着部件数量增加，生成详细几何结构在token长度和内存方面变得极为昂贵，限制了可处理的物体复杂度。
AI.method: 提出MegaParts框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) token高效的向量量化形状分词器，学习部件级几何的离散潜在表示，通过最小化token使用量同时保证高保真重建，实现基于几何复杂度的自适应长度token化；(2) 基于该紧凑表示训练大语言模型，在统一结构化序列中生成物体包围盒、部件包围盒和部件形状token，并结合高效长上下文训练策略。
AI.result: 该方法可扩展到300个部件和256k token长度，相比基线自回归和扩散模型实现了更高的网格质量，表明压缩的离散部件token不仅提升了可扩展性，还提升了生成几何的可达保真度。
AI.conclusion: LLM原生的token高效自回归建模是面向大规模部件感知3D生成中扩散模型的一种有竞争力的替代方案，能够在大幅扩展部件规模的同时保持组合结构并实现细粒度的部件级控制。

title: Detachable Wire Drive : Reconfigurable Robot Architecture with Shared Actuators
summary: Reconfigurable robots offer significant potential for adapting to diverse tasks; however, conventional centralized architectures often require dedicated actuators for each module, leading to substantial increases in overall system weight, volume, and cost. To address these challenges, this paper presents the "Detachable Wire Drive," a reconfigurable robotic system that enables the sharing of heavy and expensive actuators across various morphologies. The core of this system is the "Wire Detach Unit," a mechanism designed to physically split and reconnect wire drive paths, allowing motors to be consolidated into a common base unit. We demonstrate the versatility of this approach by developing a 2-DOF rigid arm, a continuum arm, and two distinct grippers, all of which are interchangeably attached to, and driven by, a single shared actuator set. Experimental results validate the mechanical reliability of the detachment process and the control framework's ability to seamlessly manage transitions between configurations, highlighting a path toward more efficient and multi-functional robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Detachable Wire Drive"的可重构机器人系统，通过"Wire Detach Unit"机制实现线驱动路径的物理拆分与重连，使重型且昂贵的执行器能够在多种形态之间共享，从而降低系统整体重量、体积和成本。
AI.motivation: 传统集中式可重构机器人架构通常需要每个模块配备专用执行器，导致系统重量、体积和成本大幅增加，限制了可重构机器人在多任务场景中的实际应用。
AI.method: 设计"Wire Detach Unit"机制物理拆分和重连线驱动路径，将电机集中容纳于公共基座单元；基于该系统开发了2自由度刚性臂、连续体臂和两种不同的夹爪，并通过单一共享执行器组实现交替驱动。
AI.result: 实验验证了分离过程的机械可靠性以及控制框架在配置之间无缝管理过渡的能力，证明了该方法的可行性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了共享执行器架构在可重构机器人中的潜力，为构建更高效、多功能的机器人系统提供了一条可行路径。

title: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
summary: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique demographic of older adults with knee osteoarthritis or a history of falls, TabPFN achieved a macro F1 score of 54.89% for walkability perceptions categorized as Low, Neutral, and High using equal-width binning. This result outperformed optimized, grid-searched baseline models, including Random Forest (45.85%) and XGBoost (50.56%). To interpret these results, we employed Shapley Interaction Quantification (SHAP-IQ) to identify the hierarchical importance of feature interactions. Preliminary results revealed that the model's predictive logic was primarily driven by higher-order interactions. For example, the interaction between average street circuity and the ratio of drivable roads emerged as the primary discriminator of perceived walkability. Neighborhood greenery was found to have substantial predictive importance only when combined with an individual's fear of falling or perception of age-friendliness. Overall, ICL using TabPFN demonstrates superior performance on small-scale datasets, enhancing the fidelity of the resulting interpretive insights. Furthermore, SHAP-IQ provides a synergistic perspective on how higher-order feature interactions drive the model's predictions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN进行上下文学习（ICL），在小规模数据集（N=257，膝骨关节炎或跌倒史老年人）上预测感知步行性，达到54.89%的宏F1分数，优于网格搜索优化的Random Forest（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。通过SHAP-IQ解释，发现高阶特征交互（如街道曲率与可驾驶道路比率的交互）是模型预测的主要驱动力。
AI.motivation: 全球人口老龄化背景下，需要通过包容性城市设计提升社区步行性，以减少阻碍老年人身体活动和社会参与的建成环境（BE）障碍。然而，小规模数据集上传统机器学习模型的预测性能和可解释性有限，需要探索更优的建模与解释方法。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN进行上下文学习（ICL），在N=257的小规模数据集上预测老年人对步行性的感知（依据NEWS-A量表，通过等宽分箱分为低/中/高三类）。使用宏F1作为评估指标，与网格搜索优化的Random Forest和XGBoost基线模型对比，并采用Shapley Interaction Quantification（SHAP-IQ）识别特征交互的层级重要性。
AI.result: TabPFN在预测步行性感知方面达到54.89%的宏F1分数，显著优于Random Forest（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。SHAP-IQ揭示了模型预测逻辑主要由高阶特征交互驱动，其中平均街道曲率与可驾驶道路比率的交互是最主要判别特征；邻里绿化仅在结合个体跌倒恐惧或年龄友好性感知时才具有显著预测重要性。
AI.conclusion: ICL框架下的TabPFN在小规模数据集上展现出色性能，提升了可解释洞察的保真度。SHAP-IQ提供了关于高阶特征交互如何驱动模型预测的协同视角，为理解建成环境因素与老年人步行性感知之间的关系提供了新的方法论路径。

title: Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model
summary: Instruction-based video editing is commonly built on video-pretrained generative backbones: a video diffusion transformer is adapted, at considerable cost, to condition on a source video and an editing instruction. In this report we explore a different route and show that a strong instruction-based image editing model can edit videos by operating directly on video-VAE latents. Starting from Qwen-Image-Edit, we arrange the latent frames of a Wan~2.1 video VAE as tiles of one large virtual image, reuse the editor's image positional encoding for every tile, and bridge the two latent spaces with a pair of lightweight input/output projections warm-started from the editor's own patchify and unpatchify layers, so that at initialization a (static) video is embedded exactly as an image the model already understands. The whole system is then fine-tuned on the public Ditto-1M editing triplets, and a few denoising steps of Wan~2.2 serve as an optional temporal enhancer. We motivate the design with a chain of zero-training observations: the stock image editor already edits a video presented as a contact sheet; it is indifferent to whether the sheet's tokens come from one joint encode or from per-frame encodes stitched in latent space; and it even edits genuine video latents zero-shot to a clearly recognizable degree, leaving fine-tuning only a fidelity gap to close. Our results suggest that, despite the large investment in training video latent spaces, per-frame video latents remain close enough to the image domain that mature image editing priors transfer with minimal adaptation. Project Page: https://yunpeng1998.github.io/Qwen-Video-Edit-Page; Code: https://github.com/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit; Model: https://huggingface.co/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一种视频编辑新范式：不训练视频生成骨干，而是将视频VAE的潜变量帧排布成一张虚拟大图，直接复用强大的图像编辑模型Qwen-Image-Edit进行视频编辑。通过轻量输入/输出投影桥接两个潜空间，并在Ditto-1M数据集上微调，以Wan 2.2作为可选的时间增强器。
AI.motivation: 传统基于指令的视频编辑通常需要在视频预训练生成骨干（如视频扩散Transformer）上进行高成本的适配。作者探索另一条路径：证明一个强图像编辑模型通过直接操作视频VAE潜变量即可编辑视频，大幅降低训练成本，利用成熟的图像编辑先验迁移到视频领域。
AI.method: 将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜变量帧排列成一张大虚拟图像的tile，复用Qwen-Image-Edit的图像位置编码到每个tile，用轻量输入/输出投影（从编辑器自身的patchify和unpatchify层热启动）桥接两个潜空间，使静态视频初始时与图像嵌入完全一致。在Ditto-1M编辑三元组上微调，Wan 2.2的少量去噪步骤作为可选时间增强器。设计基于一系列零训练观察：图像编辑器可直接编辑以联系表（contact sheet）形式呈现的视频；对联合编码或逐帧拼接编码不敏感；甚至可零样本编辑真实视频潜变量，微调仅用于弥补保真度差距。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管视频潜空间训练投入巨大，但逐帧视频潜变量仍与图像域足够接近，成熟的图像编辑先验仅需极少适配即可成功迁移，取得了可识别的视频编辑效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明强大的图像编辑模型可通过桥接潜空间直接用于视频编辑，无需昂贵的大型视频生成骨干训练，为指令式视频编辑提供了低成本、高效的新范式。

title: Vision-Based Tactile Intelligence for Robotics: Sensing, Learning, and Embodied Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for robots in contact-rich tasks, yet many tactile sensors still provide sparse, low-dimensional signals that do not capture sufficient information for complex robotic perception and interaction. Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTSs) offer a powerful alternative by con-verting contact-induced deformation of a soft interface into im-ages. The image-based formulation gives VBTSs high-resolution, information-rich tactile observations that enable complex robotic tasks. This review surveys the full VBTS pipeline and treats sensing hardware, learning methods, simulation, and datasets as an integrated sensing-and-learning system. We 1) organize representative VBTSs into a hardware taxonomy structured by deformable elastomer design, sensor size and shape, and optical system design to guide future sensor development; 2) present a hierarchical view of learning-based tactile intelligence from low-level signal understanding to task-level policies and foundation models; and 3) examine simulation platforms and tactile datasets as a scaling layer, together with sim-to-real transfer and cross-sensor adaptation for training, benchmarking, and deployment. Finally, we identify open challenges and future directions for VBTSs in robotics. By providing a holistic view of how hardware, AI architectures, simulation, and datasets interact, this review aims to advance tactile intelligence for contact-rich robotic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了基于视觉的触觉传感器（VBTSs）的全流程，将传感硬件、学习方法、仿真平台和数据集视为一个集成的感知与学习系统，提出了硬件分类学、分层学习智能体系以及仿真与数据扩展层的架构化综述框架。
AI.motivation: 许多触觉传感器仅提供稀疏、低维的信号，难以满足复杂机器人感知与交互需求。基于视觉的触觉传感器通过将软界面接触变形转化为图像，提供了高分辨率、信息丰富的触觉观测，但现有文献缺乏对硬件、学习、仿真和数据之间相互作用关系的系统整合性综述。
AI.method: 本文围绕VBTS全流程展开综述：1) 按可变形弹性体设计、传感器尺寸形状和光学系统设计三个维度建立硬件分类学；2) 从低级信号理解到任务级策略和基础模型的分层视角呈现基于学习的触觉智能；3) 将仿真平台和触觉数据集作为扩展层，结合sim-to-real迁移和跨传感器适应进行训练、基准测试与部署分析。
AI.result: 本文提供了VBTS的硬件分类框架、分层触觉学习智能体系，以及仿真与数据集的扩展层分析，系统梳理了硬件、AI架构、仿真和数据四者之间的交互关系，并识别了开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 通过提供硬件、AI架构、仿真与数据集如何相互作用的全景视图，本综述旨在推进面向高接触密集型机器人任务的触觉智能发展。

title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
summary: How can we determine whether a trained neural network is already deep enough? We study this under a fixed function-preserving residual-growth protocol specifying insertion locations, residual families, zero-output initializations, and zero-state first-order updates. We define first-order residual depth saturation as the absence of a strict local decrease from every admissible insertion. We prove residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: additional depth has first-order value exactly when conditional activation gradients have a nonzero projection onto at least one admissible residual tangent space. This boundary is shared by descent-compatible zero-state updates and invariant under regular local reparameterizations preserving that tangent space. Under residual-signal realizability, raw activation-gradient vanishing exactly certifies saturation. Across ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continued-pretrained Pythia checkpoints, the maximum activation-gradient norm decreases toward a low-signal regime with depth. Function-preserving growth also achieves converged performance competitive with training from scratch. These results support activation-gradient magnitude as a conservative diagnostic of the remaining empirical first-order value of residual depth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何判断已训练的神经网络是否已具有足够的深度。在函数保持的残差增长协议（指定插入位置、残差族、零输出初始化和零状态一阶更新）下，定义了"一阶残差深度饱和"概念。证明了残差非退化是深度继续增加具有一阶价值的充要条件，且该边界对下降兼容的零状态更新共享，并对保持切线空间的正则局部重参数化不变。在ResNet、GPT-2风格模型和持续预训练的Pythia检查点上，最大激活梯度范数随深度增加而降至低信号区域，函数保持增长能达到与从零训练相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 深层网络在实际应用中被广泛使用，但如何定量判断一个已训练网络是否已达到足够的深度、继续加深是否还能带来收益，是一个缺乏严谨理论框架的开放问题。现有方法难以给出可操作的深度饱和判据。
AI.method: 在函数保持的残差增长协议下开展理论分析：定义了第一阶残差深度饱和，通过条件激活梯度在可容许残差切线空间上的投影是否非零来判定深度增长的边际价值；证明了残差非退化性与该判据的充要关系，并验证了对重参数化的不变性。在多种模型（ResNet、GPT-2、Pythia）上进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论结果表明残差非退化是深度具有一阶价值的充要条件。在残差信号可实现性下，原始激活梯度消失恰好可以证明饱和。大规模实验中，最大激活梯度范数随深度增加呈下降趋势并进入低信号区域；函数保持增长可达到与从零开始训练相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 激活梯度幅值可作为判断残差深度是否仍具有经验一阶价值的保守诊断指标。这为实践中决定是否继续加深网络提供了理论支撑和可操作的工具。

title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation
summary:
Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?
  We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM requires a spatial prompt, so we evaluate bounding-box and point-click strategies across 75 patients of the Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation dataset (2,621 slices).
  On the 20-patient held-out test set, the pipeline reduces mean boundary-distance error by 45% (Dice 0.749+/-0.043 to 0.865+/-0.029; HD95 217.2+/-36.9 to 120.1+/-26.1 px), reaching Dice 0.859 across the cohort. Its mean overlap shows no significant difference from the three non-expert rater groups (p>0.19), while segmenting 38-52% more consistently (lower inter-patient standard deviation). Point-click prompts fail regardless of placement (best Dice=0.350), because speckle gives no stable local contrast. Only an approximate bounding box is required, so any clinic can deploy it without data collection, annotation, or retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对微超声（29 MHz）前列腺分割的零样本流水线：使用MedSAM基础模型定位前列腺，结合CLAHE锐化、二值膨胀和傅里叶平滑优化边界。在75例患者、2621张切片上测试，框选提示在20例留出测试集上使平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749提升至0.865），其分割重叠与非专家医师无显著差异（p>0.19），且一致性更高（高出38-52%）。点选提示因散斑缺乏稳定对比而失效（最佳Dice仅0.350）。该流水线无需数据采集、标注或重训练，任何诊所均可直接部署。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌每80秒夺走一条生命，早期检测至关重要，而PSA密度计算和活检决策依赖精确的腺体边界。传统超声（6-12 MHz）边界模糊，会漏掉三分之一的高危癌症；微超声（29 MHz）分辨率提升三倍但引入密集声学散斑，导致不同临床医生勾画面积差异超过10%。监督学习方法成本高且跨扫描仪泛化差，亟需无需训练数据的零样本分割方法。
AI.method: 使用预训练于150万张以上医学图像的MedSAM基础模型定位前列腺（需空间提示），随后依次应用CLAHE锐化外壁、二值膨胀恢复遗漏像素、傅里叶平滑（4模态，s=1.05）细化边界。评估两种提示策略：包围盒提示和点选提示，在75例患者的微超声前列腺分割数据集（2621张切片）上进行验证。
AI.result: 在20例留出测试集上，流水线将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749±0.043提升至0.865±0.029；HD95从217.2±36.9降至120.1±26.1像素），整个队列Dice达到0.859。分割重叠与三组非专家评分者无显著差异（p>0.19），且一致性高38-52%（更低的患者间标准差）。点选提示无论如何放置均失败（最佳Dice=0.350）。
AI.conclusion: 仅需一个大致的包围盒，该零样本流水线即可实现与临床医师相当的前列腺分割性能，无需数据收集、标注或重新训练，任何诊所均可直接部署，为微超声前列腺分割提供了实用且低成本的解决方案。

title: Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (Early Access). Project page: https://lotus-website.github.io/
summary: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. We further introduce a more effective update mechanism that treats the LTL encoder as a policy, thereby improving representation capacity. To enhance stability and robustness, LOTUS leverages the bisimulation metric, which provides theoretical guarantees for LTL representation, including behavioral equivalence, optimality fidelity, and trajectory robustness. Experimental results show that LOTUS outperforms most existing methods in learning efficiency, generalization capability, and representation quality. Specifically, LOTUS accelerates convergence over 20% in single-task scenarios, achieves a 15%-45% higher success rate in unseen manipulation tasks, and improves generalization performance over 25% in complex multi-task environments with increased sub-goal depth or conjunctions. The corresponding code, videos, and appendix are available at: https://lotus-website.github.io/.

AI.tldr: LOTUS是一个基于时序逻辑(LTL)启发的通用任务表征框架，可无缝集成到任何强化学习算法中，通过将LTL编码器视为策略来更新权重，并利用双模拟度量提供理论保证，在单任务、多任务和未见任务场景中均显著提升了学习效率、泛化能力和表征质量。
AI.motivation: 现有任务表征算法通常针对特定情境设计，难以跨场景泛化；且依赖强化学习控制器的梯度信号更新权重，导致表征质量和学习效率下降。作者旨在提出一个通用的、可无缝集成到任意RL算法的任务表征框架，以克服这些局限性。
AI.method: LOTUS框架：(1)设计了一种新颖的任务表征架构，能够从LTL公式中建模关系并提取任务语义；(2)引入更有效的更新机制，将LTL编码器视为策略以提升表征能力；(3)利用双模拟度量(bisimulation metric)提升稳定性和鲁棒性，为LTL表征提供行为等价性、最优保真度和轨迹鲁棒性的理论保证。
AI.result: 实验显示LOTUS在多数方法中表现更优：单任务场景收敛加速超过20%；未见操纵任务中成功率提升15%-45%；在子目标深度或合取数增加的复杂多任务环境中泛化性能提升超过25%。
AI.conclusion: LOTUS作为时序逻辑启发的通用任务表征框架，能够有效提升RL代理在多样化任务环境中的学习效率、泛化能力和表征质量，并具备坚实的理论保证，是可广泛应用的通用解决方案。

title: When Does the Best Sampling Temperature Rise with the Budget? Sufficient Conditions for Pass@k
comment: Theory paper, 13 pages, 1 analytical figure. Deterministic verification code is included as ancillary material. No new language-model experiment
summary: The temperature that maximizes pass@$k$ is often low for a small sampling budget and higher for a large budget. This pattern has been reported from Codex through recent multi-sample inference studies. It is not an algebraic property of pass@$k$: as Slocum et al. (ICLR 2025) observe, for one fixed task the maximizing temperature is independent of $k$. Building on that fixed-task observation and the hard/easy-task explanation, we give a formal population-level sufficient condition for the aggregate pattern. For task $X$, let $p_t(X)$ be one-sample success probability at temperature $t$, and define the conditional log-success response $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$. If $m_t(u)$ is nonincreasing in current success probability, then the normalized temperature derivative of aggregate pass@$k$ is nondecreasing in $k$. Consequently, derivative signs are nested across budgets; if each temperature-performance curve is strictly single-peaked, its unique maximizer is nondecreasing in $k$. The proof identifies the mechanism as a monotone-likelihood-ratio power tilt toward lower-success tasks. We derive a closed-form two-stratum phase diagram, including upward and downward regimes, and show that the marginal temperature derivative admits an exact $\mathrm{Beta}(2,k)$ kernel representation whose kernel concentrates at one-sample success of order $1/k$. Interpreting that scale as task-level localization additionally requires a regular, nonvanishing density-response factor near zero. A signed-moment representation yields diagnostic shape restrictions, while a short appendix records exact discrete refinements of the existing multi-configuration allocation formulation. No language model is trained, and no model query is used as an experimental measurement: the contribution is a conditional theory of an established empirical phenomenon, with assumptions that can be tested in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文为“温度越高，pass@k越大所需的抽样预算越大”这一经验现象提供了正式的群体层面充分条件。基于单任务最优温度与k无关的观察，作者定义了条件对数成功响应函数m_t(u)，证明了若m_t(u)对当前成功概率非增，则聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数随k非减，从而导出最优温度随k非降，并通过单调似然比功率倾斜机制、两阶层相图和Beta(2,k)核表示进行刻画。
AI.motivation: 在代码生成等多项采样推理场景中，已知最优温度随抽样预算k增大而升高，但此前对这一现象缺乏形式化的理论解释，且已知pass@k的代数性质（单任务最优温度与k无关）并不能直接解释聚合层面的模式。需要建立严格的群体层面充分条件来揭示该现象背后的机制。
AI.method: 定义条件对数成功响应m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X) | p_t(X)=u]/u，证明其在当前成功概率u上非增时，归一化温度导数随k非减。证明基于单调似然比功率倾斜机制（趋于低成功任务）。进一步推导两阶层封闭形式相图、Beta(2,k)核表示（核集中于一阶1/k的单样本成功率）以及有符号矩表示的诊断形状约束，并附上离散多配置分配的精确细化。
AI.result: 给出了聚合pass@k最优温度随k非降的严格充分条件；最优温度非降由导数符号嵌套性推出；构造了包含向上和向下机制的两阶层相图；得到了边际温度导数的精确Beta(2,k)核表示；提供了有符号矩的诊断约束。理论为条件性贡献，无需训练语言模型或查询模型。
AI.conclusion: 作者建立了从单任务性质到聚合pass@k温度-预算关系的形式化桥梁，明确了该经验现象成立的群体层面充分条件（m_t非增），并提供了多种可检验的理论特征。未来工作可实证检验这些假设条件。

title: Where the Cost Falls: A Deployment-Aware Adoption Order for Stability Enhancements to Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
summary: Teams that adopt cycle-consistent adversarial networks for unpaired image-to-image translation meet the same obstacles: adversarial training oscillates or collapses, cycle consistency preserves coarse layout while finer texture drifts, and a single discriminator judging global realism misses local artifacts. Four enhancements address these failures, and they are usually compared on output quality alone. We show that they also divide sharply by where their cost falls, and that this division, which follows from the architecture and not from any particular run, yields an adoption order for teams under a compute or latency budget. A Wasserstein objective with gradient penalty, a VGG19 perceptual loss on the cycle reconstruction, and multi-scale discriminators change training only, so a team can adopt or drop them without altering what ships. Self-attention alone persists into the deployed generator, with memory growing as the square of the feature-map size, which makes it the one component a resource-constrained team should defer. We integrate all four onto a lightly tuned baseline for horse-to-zebra translation, introduced one at a time on a fixed control and then combined, and for each we give the failure mode it targets and how it integrates. We document the collapse and reconstruction-artifact modes the baseline produced, report what visual inspection of saved samples showed for each variant, and report Fréchet Inception Distance and Kernel Inception Distance for the combined model. We specify the protocol still needed, covering the individual variants, perceptual similarity, and downstream segmentation, to rank these enhancements on measured evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于CycleGAN进行无配对图像翻译时所面临的四大改进（Wasserstein对抗目标+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力），并指出这些改进按成本来源（训练期vs部署期）可明确分为两类，进而为计算或延迟受限的团队提供采用顺序建议。自注意力是唯一持续存在于部署生成器中的组件，其内存随特征图尺寸平方增长，因此最应被延迟采用。作者在Horse-to-Zebra基准上逐一集成并组合了四种改进，给出各改进针对的失败模式及FID/KID指标，并指出尚需更完整评测协议。
AI.motivation: CycleGAN类模型在无配对图像翻译中常遭受对抗训练振荡或崩溃、循环一致性保持粗布局但细纹理漂移、以及单一判别器忽略局部伪影等问题。已有工作通常仅比较输出质量，忽略了不同改进在成本归属（训练期vs部署期）上的本质差异，这使得资源受限团队难以做出合理的选择。
AI.method: 选择四种增强技术：Wasserstein目标+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失用于循环重建、多尺度判别器、以及自注意力。以马到斑马翻译为基准，在固定对照组基础上逐一加入各改进再组合集成，并针对每种记录其失败的偶发模式及集成方式。
AI.result: Wasserstein+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器三种仅影响训练过程，不影响部署产物；自注意力则深入部署生成器，内存开销随特征图尺寸平方增长，因此资源受限团队应最后采用。作者报告了基线产生的崩溃与重建伪影模式、每个变体的视觉检查结果，并给出了组合模型的FID和KID指标。
AI.conclusion: 四种改进按成本落点可以架构性地划分为训练期组件与部署期组件，这一划分与具体运行无关，而由架构决定，进而为团队提供了明确的采用顺序。未来仍需针对各变体单独、感知相似度及下游分割任务制定完整评测协议，以基于实证证据对四种改进进行排序。

title: Degenerate in Whose Frame? An Equivariance Condition for Degeneracy Detection in LiDAR Registration
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Degeneracy detectors for LiDAR registration commonly return six per-axis binary labels. We ask whether these labels are properties of the scene. Under a body-frame change, the point-to-plane information matrix transforms by congruence, H' = Ad(T)^T H Ad(T), not similarity. Congruence preserves nullity and, through the adjoint reparameterization, identifies the same physical twist subspace; the per-axis footprint and a thresholded spectrum need not be invariant. In a noise-free circular tunnel, shifting the origin by one metre changes which degrees of freedom are flagged. A generalized criterion Hv = lambda Mv is universally frame-independent over positive-semidefinite information forms if and only if its metric rule is equivariant. No fixed metric qualifies, while a rig-adapted one exists only at zero screw pitch, met in one of nineteen surveyed calibrations. The equivariant point-displacement metric M = sum_i J_i^T J_i yields dimensionless, scene-scale-invariant generalized eigenvalues. They are invariant to body frame, consistent changes of length unit and scene scales; the threshold also transfers empirically across sequences. Across 365 frame pairs from four public sequences, labels rarely change at practical extrinsic magnitudes, yet a remapping estimator's correction differs between body-frame choices on 44.5-69.5% of pairs, with a median of 0.7-4.0 mm and a maximum of 0.87 m. The per-axis footprint changes even under the equivariant metric, placing the fundamental issue in the reported quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LiDAR配准的退化检测器输出的六轴二元标签是否真正反映场景属性。通过数学分析和实验证明，这些标签并非场景固有属性，而取决于参考系选择。作者提出一个等变点位移度量M = sum_i J_i^T J_i，可生成无因次、场景尺度不变的广义特征值，但即便使用该度量，逐轴标签仍会变化，根本问题在于报告的量本身。
AI.motivation: LiDAR配准退化检测器通常返回六个逐轴二元标签，但这些标签是否真正是场景的固有属性尚不清楚。作者质疑这些标签在刚体变换（body-frame change）下的不变性，因为点对面信息矩阵以协议变换（congruence）而非相似变换转换，这可能导致标签随参考系改变而变化，从而影响退化检测和下游估计器的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者从数学上分析信息矩阵在身体坐标系变换下的变换规律（H' = Ad(T)^T H Ad(T)），证明协议变换保持零空间但在逐轴标签和阈值谱上不保持不变。提出广义准则Hv = lambda Mv的框架不变性条件（度量规则的等变性），证明不存在固定度量满足条件但零螺旋节距（zero screw pitch）下存在支架适配度量。提出等变点位移度量M = sum_i J_i^T J_i，并设计实验验证这些度量的性质和标签在实际数据中的变化。
AI.result: 等变点位移度量产生无因次、场景尺度不变的广义特征值，对身体坐标系、长度单位一致变化和场景尺度均具有不变性，阈值可跨序列迁移。但在365对来自四个公开序列的数据中，虽然实际外参幅度下标签很少变化，重映射估计器的修正值在44.5-69.5%的帧对中因身体坐标系选择不同而有差异，中位数为0.7-4.0mm，最大可达0.87米。即使使用等变度量，逐轴标签仍会改变。
AI.conclusion: 逐轴退化标签从根本上并非场景固有属性。虽然等变度量使广义特征值具有框架不变性，但报告逐轴二元标签这一形式本身存在根本性问题。作者建议转向其他能真正反映场景信息的内容报告方式，因为当前的方式即使在理论上自洽的度量下也无法消除参考系依赖。

title: ARGUS: Attention-Guided Transformers for Scalable Person Identification Using Wi-Fi Telemetry
summary: Passive, device-free person identification offers an alternative to camera- and wearable-based biometrics, yet existing wireless approaches rely largely on gait or activity cues and are rarely evaluated at scale. In this paper, we present \emph{Argus}, a passive Wi-Fi sensing system that identifies people from commodity Channel State Information (CSI) without requiring an attached device or a prescribed motion. Argus converts short CSI spans into compact \emph{statgrams}: statistical maps built from the channel views available on a given device. A lightweight decoder-only Transformer then reads coarse statgram patches as tokens, and segment-level logit aggregation combines evidence over time. On a 154-subject CSI dataset evaluated with a strict physical-segment split, Argus reaches $78.88\% \pm 1.62\%$ Top-1 accuracy on 6-second windows and $84.85\% \pm 1.31\%$ after aggregating 19 overlapping windows over a 60-second segment; Top-3 and Top-5 reach $98.61\%$ and $99.26\%$. For a 60-second statgram, Argus improves over a raw-CSI Transformer baseline by 7.75 points while using $4.4\times$ fewer FLOPs per window. Attention-guided compression preserves full single-window accuracy with only half of the EHealth patches. On WiMANS, a multi-user benchmark across three rooms and two Wi-Fi bands, Argus remains within 1.23 percentage points of the strongest per-configuration baselines on average while using $27\times$ fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that compact CSI statistics can scale passive identification while also exposing deployment limits in open-set rejection and cross-room transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Argus，一种基于商用Wi-Fi CSI的无源设备无关人员识别系统。Argus将短CSI片段转换为紧凑的statgrams统计图，结合轻量级decoder-only Transformer和segment级logit聚合。在154名受试者的数据集上，60秒窗口下Top-1准确率达84.85%，Top-3达98.61%，同时相比原始CSI基线节省4.4倍FLOPs。在WiMANS多用户基准上，Argus在保持高准确率的同时推理FLOPs降低27倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于无线信号的无源人员识别方法主要依赖步态或活动特征，且很少在大规模场景下评估。作者旨在开发一种不依赖特定动作、无需携带设备即可识别人员的Wi-Fi感知系统，并探索其在真实多用户环境下的扩展性和部署限制。
AI.method: Argus由三部分组成：(1) statgrams：将短CSI片段从设备可用信道视图转换成的紧凑统计图；(2) 轻量级decoder-only Transformer：将粗粒度statgram补丁视为token进行读取；(3) segment级logit聚合：在时间维度上聚合证据。此外还引入了注意力引导的压缩策略，仅保留一半EHealth补丁即可保持完整单窗口准确率。
AI.result: 在154受试者数据集上（严格物理段分割），6秒窗口Top-1准确率78.88%±1.62%，60秒段（19个重叠窗口聚合）Top-1达84.85%±1.31%，Top-3和Top-5分别达98.61%和99.26%。相比原始CSI Transformer基线提升7.75个百分点，FLOPs减少4.4倍。在WiMANS多用户基准上，仅比最强逐配置基线平均低1.23个百分点，推理FLOPs减少27倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的CSI统计特征（statgrams）能够在保持高识别精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，使无源人员识别具备规模化能力。但实验同时揭示了在开放集拒绝和跨房间迁移方面的部署局限，为未来工作指明了方向。

title: OvDSGG: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Dynamic Scene Graph Generation
summary: Dynamic scene graphs (DSGs) capture spatio-temporal interactions across videos as $\langle$subject, predicate, object$\rangle$ triplets, and underpin downstream tasks such as video captioning, video question answering, and action analysis. However, end-to-end dynamic scene graph generation (DSGG) methods are closed-set: they recognize only objects and predicates from a fixed training vocabulary and struggle with the long-tailed distribution of rare concepts, severely limiting their real-world applicability. Existing open-vocabulary models typically inherit pretrained large language models, resulting in multi-stage training and inference with substantial cost. We introduce OvDSGG, the first end-to-end framework for open-vocabulary DSGG. OvDSGG builds on top of an open-vocabulary Spatial Backbone and a Temporal Backbone; we further propose a Triplet Feature Extraction Module that bridges them, and a Visual-Language Alignment Module that preserves open-vocabulary recognition by learning an adaptive decision boundary in the joint visual-language feature space, without expensive knowledge distillation in existing methods. We further introduce a rigorous open-vocabulary DSGG benchmark adapted from Action Genome, with disjoint Base/Novel splits for both objects and predicates. OvDSGG significantly outperforms open-vocabulary baselines across all metrics, with zero-shot Recall@$K$ scores 10.0--20.4 percentage point higher than the next-best baseline, while on closed-set DSGG remaining competitive with state-of-the-art models. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/jhelsby/OvDSGG/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OvDSGG，首个端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成框架，基于开放词汇空间主干和时间主干，通过三元组特征提取模块和视觉-语言对齐模块实现开放词汇识别，并用Action Genome构建基准评测。
AI.motivation: 现有动态场景图生成（DSGG）方法均为闭集模型，只能识别固定训练词汇中的对象和谓词，难以应对长尾分布的现实世界场景；已有的开放词汇模型通常依赖预训练大语言模型，训练和推理阶段多且成本高。
AI.method: OvDSGG基于开放词汇的空间主干和时间主干构建；提出三元组特征提取模块桥接两者；提出视觉-语言对齐模块，在联合视觉-语言特征空间中学习自适应决策边界以保持开放词汇识别能力，无需现有方法中的昂贵知识蒸馏。同时构建了基于Action Genome的开放词汇DSGG基准，包含对象和谓词的Base/Novel不相交划分。
AI.result: OvDSGG在开放词汇指标上全面超越基线，零样本Recall@K比次优基线高10.0-20.4个百分点；在闭集DSGG上仍与最先进模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: OvDSGG证明了无需知识蒸馏即可实现端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成，且兼顾开放词汇与闭集性能，代码和基准已开源。

title: Contact Modes Are Strata: What Geometric Structure Buys in Discrete-Continuous Planning
comment: Submitted to IROS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Representations in Robotics
summary: Contact-rich manipulation poses a discrete question and a continuous one at once, namely which contacts are active and how to move while they hold. The two are coupled by a change of dimension, since each contact that a robot maintains confines its motion to a lower-dimensional manifold. We make that coupling the explicit object of planning by observing that a contact mode is not merely analogous to a stratum of the configuration space; it is one. A plan is then a walk over strata whose within-stratum segments are geodesics. On two contact-rich manipulation tasks in simulation, pushing a T-shaped block around obstacles and reorienting a cube in a dexterous hand, our planner returns solutions within seconds with no mode, contact sequence, or stratum given in advance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将接触丰富的操控问题视为在接触构型空间的层（strata）上行走的规划方法，其中接触模式本身就是构型空间的层，规划即是在这些层上寻找测地线段构成的路径。在两个仿真任务（推动T形块穿越障碍、灵巧手内重定向立方体）中，无需预先给定接触模式或接触序列即可在数秒内求解。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操控同时涉及离散问题和连续问题：哪些接触处于激活状态，以及接触保持时如何运动。二者由维度变化耦合——每个保持的接触将机器人运动约束到更低维流形上。已有方法通常需要事先指定接触模式或序列，本文旨在将这种耦合作为规划的核心对象显式处理，消除对预先给定接触信息的依赖。
AI.method: 核心洞察是：接触模式不仅仅是构型空间的层的类比，它本身就是构型空间的一个层（stratum）。因此，规划问题被重新表述为在层上的行走（walk over strata），其中层内段为测地线。这一视角将离散的接触选择与连续的流形运动统一到同一几何框架中。
AI.result: 在两个接触丰富的仿真操控任务上（推动T形块绕过障碍物、在灵巧手中重定向立方体），该规划器无需事先给定接触模式、接触序列或层信息即可在数秒内返回可行解，验证了方法的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将接触模式识别为构型空间的层并将规划建模为层间行走，本文提供了一种统一处理接触丰富操控中离散-连续耦合的规划框架，能在无需先验接触信息的情况下高效求解复杂操控任务。

title: Take it Personally: The Limits of General SSL Representations for Real-Life PPG Emotion Detection
comment: 9 pages, 4 Figures, 2 Tables, Accepted as the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: While Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) effectively extracts general representations from noisy, unconstrained physiological signals such as photoplethysmography (PPG), its suitability for highly subjective tasks remains unproven. In this work, we evaluate the efficacy of PPG-based SSL for real-life intense emotion detection. First, we pretrain a Real-Life PPG encoder (RL-PPG) on unconstrained, real-life data. As a rigorous sanity check, we demonstrate that these representations transfer exceptionally well to an objective physical activity recognition task, yielding almost 5-fold increase in performance over baselines in a leave-one-subject-out evaluation (LOSO). However, when applied to a~subjective real-life emotion detection task, these same general representations fail to surpass naive baselines under the LOSO protocol. Using an Across-Time validation strategy, we establish that incorporating an individual's personal data during fine-tuning is the main driver of predictive performance, outweighing the benefits of population-level pretraining. Ultimately, our findings indicate that in the evaluated scenario, general SSL representations may be insufficient for subjective affective inference, suggesting that personalization is likely a key component for real-world emotion recognition. To support future research, we share the code and pretrained RL-PPG~encoder~weights.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于PPG的自监督学习（SSL）在真实生活中强烈情绪检测任务中的适用性。研究发现，预训练的通用表征在客观的体力活动识别任务中表现优异（LOSO评估中较基线提升近5倍），但在主观情绪检测任务中无法超越朴素基线。通过Cross-Time验证策略发现，在微调过程中加入个人数据是预测性能的主要驱动因素，超过了群体级预训练带来的收益，表明通用SSL表征不足以支撑主观情感推断，个性化是真实世界情绪识别的关键。
AI.motivation: 虽然SSL能从无约束的真实生理信号（如PPG）中有效提取通用表征，但其在高主观性任务（如情绪检测）中的适用性尚未得到验证。作者旨在检验SSL表征是否足以应对具有高度个体差异性的情感推断任务。
AI.method: 首先在无约束的真实生活数据上预训练RL-PPG编码器，然后在两个任务上进行评估：(1) 客观的体力活动识别任务作为健全性检查（使用LOSO评估）；(2) 主观的真实生活情绪检测任务（使用LOSO和Across-Time两种验证策略）。通过比较不同验证策略下的性能，分析个人数据微调与群体预训练对预测性能的相对贡献。
AI.result: 预训练表征在体力活动识别任务上表现优异（LOSO下较基线提升近5倍），但在主观情绪检测的LOSO协议下无法超越朴素基线。Across-Time验证表明，微调阶段引入个人数据是预测性能的主要驱动因素，其贡献超过了群体级预训练的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的场景中，通用SSL表征可能不足以支撑主观情感推理，个性化（结合个人数据进行微调）是真实世界情绪识别中不可或缺的关键组件。作者公开了代码和预训练模型权重以支持后续研究。

title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general video understanding, their capability in fine-grained and motion-centric tasks remains limited. This limitation is particularly critical in micro-gesture recognition (MGR), where micro-gestures (MGs) - subtle, short-duration, and spatially localized human movements - serve as key discriminative signals for implicit affective analysis, yet are easily neglected following common prompting practices. Although MGR has been intensively studied by many discriminative approaches, the use of MLLMs for MGR is underexplored, with notably poor performance. We hypothesize that the motion-sensitive representation ability of MLLMs is constrained by their inherent single-pass forward inference, which can be substantially enhanced through carefully designed test-time guidance. Motivated by this, building on our prior findings regarding temporal insensitivity in Video LLMs, we diagnose zero-shot MGR errors in the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) space. We observe that MLLMs suffer from two bottlenecks: 1) insufficient localized evidence and 2) severe score biases driven by language and motion-agnostic appearances. Thus, we propose a novel test-time evidence calibration framework that improves both reasoning details and prediction reliability. Specifically, we introduce a tree search mechanism to progressively acquire localized, fine-grained visual evidence, coupled with a test-time calibration module to mitigate score biases. The multi-cue fusion module then integrates evidence from multiple cues without relying on a single cue for final prediction. Our framework achieves mean-class accuracies of 26.84\% on iMiGUE and 22.10\% on MA-52, significantly outperforming the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, which produces 16.15\% and 10.20\%, respectively. The code will be available at https://zero-melo.github.io/Zero-MELO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个名为Zero-MELO的测试时证据校准框架，用于提升多模态大语言模型在微手势识别中的表现。通过树搜索机制逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据，并配合测试时校准模块缓解语言和外观驱动的分数偏差，在iMiGUE和MA-52数据集上分别达到26.84%和22.10%的均值类别准确率，显著超越Qwen2.5-VL基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解上表现出色，但在细粒度、以运动为中心的微手势识别任务上能力有限。尽管微手势是隐含情感分析的关键判别信号，MLLMs在零样本MGR任务中表现很差。作者假设MLLMs的运动敏感表征能力受限于其单次前向推理机制，可以通过精心设计的测试时引导来显著增强。
AI.method: 该框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 树搜索机制，用于逐步获取局部化的细粒度视觉证据；(2) 测试时校准模块，用于缓解由语言和运动无关外观导致的分数偏差；(3) 多线索融合模块，整合多个线索的证据而非依赖单一线索进行最终预测。作者通过负对数似然空间诊断零样本MGR错误，识别出两个瓶颈：局部证据不足和严重的分数偏差。
AI.result: 在iMiGUE数据集上达到26.84%的均值类别准确率，在MA-52数据集上达到22.10%，显著超越Qwen2.5-VL基线（分别为16.15%和10.20%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的测试时证据校准，可以有效缓解MLLMs在微手势识别中的运动敏感性不足问题，无需额外训练即可显著提升零样本MGR性能，验证了测试时引导对增强MLLMs细粒度运动理解能力的重要价值。

title: MistyPilot: Enabling Social-Robot Control through Multi-Agent LLM Skill Orchestration
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 ACVR Workshop
summary: Programming small social robots from natural-language instructions requires more than invoking isolated APIs. Interactive tasks combine reactive physical behaviors with stateful social behaviors, while existing interfaces often require developers to manually compose APIs into skills, configure their parameters, bind sensor events to skills, and manage task states at runtime. We present MistyPilot, a multi-agent LLM framework that interprets high-level natural-language instructions and orchestrates the corresponding skills on the Misty social robot. A Task Router dispatches each instruction to one of two specialized agents: a Physically Interactive Agent for sensor-triggered robot control and direct skill invocation, and a Social Interaction Agent for dialogue-oriented task-state management and context-dependent multimodal response generation. To improve efficiency, the Social Interaction Agent reuses previously generated results when applicable and invokes full generation otherwise. We evaluate MistyPilot on five component-level suites, with sensor bindings and skill invocations executed on the physical Misty robot, and a preliminary user study with 12 participants. MistyPilot attains high accuracy on routing, sensor-skill binding, task-state parsing, result reuse, and skill extension up to 100 skills, and lower variance than an otherwise identical single-agent baseline, while participants report positive perceptions of usability and interaction quality. The code will be made publicly available via the project page.

AI.tldr: MistyPilot是一个多智能体LLM框架，用于将自然语言指令翻译并编排到Misty社交机器人的技能上。它通过Task Router将指令分派给物理交互智能体（负责传感器触发的机器人控制和直接技能调用）和社交交互智能体（负责对话式任务状态管理和多模态响应生成），在五个组件级评估套件和12名用户的初步研究中取得了高准确率和低方差表现。
AI.motivation: 小型社交机器人的自然语言指令编程不能仅通过调用孤立的API实现。交互式任务需要将反应性物理行为与有状态社交行为结合，而现有接口往往要求开发者手动组合API成为技能、配置参数、绑定传感器事件到技能并在运行时管理任务状态，缺乏高层自然语言到机器人技能编排的自动化方案。
AI.method: 提出MistyPilot，一个多智能体LLM框架。Task Router将每条指令分派到两个专门智能体之一：Physically Interactive Agent负责传感器触发的机器人控制和直接技能调用；Social Interaction Agent负责面向对话的任务状态管理和上下文相关的多模态响应生成。社交智能体在可应用时复用先前生成的结果，否则触发完整生成以提升效率。
AI.result: 在五个组件级评估套件上（在物理Misty机器人上执行传感器绑定和技能调用）以及12名参与者的初步用户研究中，MistyPilot在路由、传感器-技能绑定、任务状态解析、结果复用和最高100个技能的技能扩展上达到了高准确率，且相比相同的单智能体基线方差更低，参与者对可用性和交互质量报告了正面感知。
AI.conclusion: MistyPilot证明了多智能体LLM架构能够有效弥合自然人语言指令与社交机器人物理/社交行为编排之间的鸿沟，在准确性和稳定性上优于单智能体基线，用户感知良好。代码将通过项目页面公开。

title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.

AI.tldr: RouteTS是一个统一的时序预测框架，通过幅度路由将频率谱分区，把主频分量交给频域的复值线性预测器处理以保持周期结构，而将残差谱能量转回时域由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。实验表明其在多样数据集上取得有竞争力的预测精度，同时具备显著的计算效率优势。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的时间序列将全局周期结构与局部非平稳变化交织在一起。现有方法在单一计算域中处理这些异质动态存在根本性局限：时域模型在长视界上遭受周期失配问题，而频域模型会对瞬态尖峰过度平滑。作者认为最优计算域不是模型的属性，而是数据本身的属性。
AI.method: RouteTS通过幅度路由机制划分频率谱：将主导频率分量分配给频域中的复值线性预测器以保留周期结构；将残差谱能量转回时域，由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。路由决策由底层频谱特征引导，实现计算域的自适应分配。
AI.result: 在多样的真实世界数据集上，RouteTS取得了有竞争力的预测精度，路由决策由底层频谱特征引导。此外，其轻量级设计带来了显著的计算效率优势，解决了全局周期性与局部瞬变性之间的长期困境。
AI.conclusion: 最优计算域应取决于数据本身而非模型。通过将信号分量路由到各自数学上最优的领域进行处理，RouteTS提供了一个既能保持全局周期结构又能捕捉局部非平稳变化的统一框架，为时序预测中计算域选择提供了原则性解决方案。

title: Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Background subtraction is a key preprocessing step for infrastructure-based LiDAR perception, enabling efficient isolation of dynamic traffic participants without semantic annotations. However, systematic cross-sensor evaluations and reproducible studies for static roadside LiDAR are missing. This paper presents a comparative benchmark of beam-wise statistical background subtraction for statically mounted LiDAR sensors. We formulate background estimation as a per-beam temporal modeling problem and investigate complementary statistical strategies that capture dominant as well as multi-modal background structures, combined with spatial filtering in the angular and 3D domain. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce HighwayScene, a new multi-LiDAR dataset recorded in a static roadside setup, and extend the public CoopScenes dataset with static/dynamic point-wise annotations. Across multiple scenes and heterogeneous sensing technologies, we demonstrate that beam-wise statistical modeling provides a robust and transferable solution. Combining lightweight per-beam models with spatial consistency filtering substantially improves precision while maintaining high recall and real-time capability. All datasets, annotations, and implementations are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向静态路侧LiDAR的逐束（beam-wise）统计背景减除对比基准。作者将背景估计建模为逐束时间序列问题，研究捕获主模态与多模态背景结构的统计策略，并结合角度与3D域的空间滤波。为支持可复现评估，引入了新的多LiDAR路侧数据集HighwayScene，并为公开的CoopScenes数据集补充了静态/动态点级标注。实验证明逐束统计建模在多种异构传感技术下具有鲁棒性和可迁移性，轻量逐束模型结合空间一致性滤波可显著提升精度，同时保持高召回率和实时性。
AI.motivation: 基础设施型LiDAR感知中，背景减除是提取动态交通参与者的关键预处理步骤，无需语义标注即可高效分离目标。然而，静态路侧LiDAR缺乏系统性的跨传感器评估和可复现研究，现有方法难以在不同传感器配置下验证其泛化能力。
AI.method: 将背景估计形式化为逐束（per-beam）时间建模问题，探索可捕获主导背景结构与多模态背景结构的互补性统计策略；同时结合角度域和3D空间域的空间滤波；构建新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene记录于静态路侧场景，并为CoopScenes数据集添加静态/动态点级标注以支持基准评估。
AI.result: 在多个场景和异构传感技术下，逐束统计建模表现出鲁棒且可迁移的性能。轻量级逐束模型与空间一致性滤波相结合，在保持高召回率和实时能力的同时，显著提升了检测精度。所有数据集、标注与实现均已公开。
AI.conclusion: 逐束统计背景减除是一种鲁棒、可迁移且实时的解决方案，适用于静态路侧LiDAR感知，填补了该领域缺少系统性跨传感器基准和可复现研究的空白。

title: ReForce: Learning Force-aware Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations offer a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, but transferring them to robot actions remains challenging due to the embodiment gap. Today's retargeting is mostly kinematic, yet manipulation is decided by force, which governs how the hand interacts with the object and how the object moves. In this paper, we present ReForce, a Force-aware Retargeting method that turns human motion and forces into robot actions that reproduce the intended contact. ReForce predicts a residual on the kinematically retargeted action to reach the desired force, using a general force tracker trained on large-scale simulation interactions. It supports both online force-aware teleoperation and offline data translation.
