In simulation and on real hardware, ReForce achieves lower force-tracking error and stronger multi-finger contact engagement on contact-rich tasks such as paper-cup grasping and tongs manipulation.

AI.tldr: ReForce是一种力感知的重定向方法，将人类演示中的运动与力信息转化为机器人动作，通过训练在大量仿真交互上的通用力跟踪器，对运动学重定向的动作预测残差以达到期望的接触力，支持在线力感知遥操作和离线数据转换。
AI.motivation: 人类演示是灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但将其转化为机器人动作面临具身鸿沟（embodiment gap）的挑战。现有重定向方法大多是纯运动学层面的，然而操作本质上由力决定——力控制着手与物体的交互以及物体的运动。因此需要一种能够将人类运动与力都纳入重定向的方法。
AI.method: ReForce提出力感知重定向方法：(1) 在大规模仿真交互上训练一个通用力跟踪器；(2) 对运动学重定向后的动作预测一个残差项，以逼近期望的接触力；(3) 同时支持在线力感知遥操作和离线数据翻译两种模式。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实硬件上，ReForce在接触密集型任务（如纸杯抓取和镊子操作）中实现了更低的力跟踪误差和更强的多指接触参与度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明引入力感知的重定向方法能够弥补纯运动学重定向在接触力复现上的不足，有效提升灵巧操作任务中的力跟踪精度和接触质量，为基于人类演示的机器人学习提供了更完整的解决方案。

title: One Score, Two Decisions: Selective Prediction on the Rare-Disease Tail
summary: Given a patient's clinical findings, a diagnostic system ranks possible diseases and must decide when to endorse its first prediction or defer it for review. This decision is usually made by thresholding the top score. Selective prediction over ranked outputs begins with two checks. First, the ranker must produce enough correct top-ranked predictions to make the target feasible. Across 2,000 patient records stratified by disease prevalence, eight small open-weight LLMs achieve at most 4.6% Recall@1 on ultra-rare diseases. At 10% coverage, even a perfect confidence ranking of their existing predictions therefore cannot reach 50% selective accuracy. More accurate models pass the same check, showing that the limit is regime-specific. Second, the confidence signal must match the decision being made. For fixed-candidate rankers, the top-two margin cancels components shared across candidates. On phenotype-only Exomiser, it selects 10% of cases at 29.0% accuracy, compared with 13.3% overall, while the top score provides no reliable gate. Yet that cancellation can remove information needed to detect whether the candidate list contains an answer. SciFact retrieval and biomedical entity linking confirm this distinction. Finally, we prove that unlabelled scores alone cannot determine whether switching to the margin will help.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究诊断系统在排名输出上何时采用首个预测或延迟审查的决策问题，提出两个关键检查：一是排序器在罕见病上是否产生足够正确的首位预测（八个小开源LLM在超罕见病上Recall@1至多4.6%，10%覆盖率下无法达到50%选择性准确率）；二是置信度信号是否与决策匹配（top-two margin比top score更有效，但margin的相消效应可能丢失信息）。最后证明无标签分数本身无法判断切换至margin是否有益。
AI.motivation: 诊断系统需要对可能的疾病进行排名，并决定何时认可其首选预测或将其推迟人工审查。传统方法通常通过对top score设置阈值来做此决策，但这一做法是否合理、哪些条件下有效，缺乏系统性的分析与证明。
AI.method: 作者提出选择性预测的两个检查：(1) 可行性检查——排序器必须生成足够多的正确首位预测才能达到目标（在2,000个按疾病患病率分层的患者记录上评估八个小开源LLM）；(2) 置信度匹配检查——置信度信号必须与所做的决策一致。通过对比top score与top-two margin在表型Exomiser、SciFact检索和生物医学实体链接等不同任务上的表现进行验证，并从理论上证明无标签分数无法确定切换margin是否有帮助。
AI.result: 八个小开源LLM在超罕见病上Recall@1至多4.6%；在10%覆盖率下即使有完美的置信度排序也无法达到50%选择性准确率。在表型Exomiser上，top-two margin在10%覆盖下的准确率为29.0%（总体13.3%），而top score不可靠。更强的模型能通过可行性检查，表明限制是特定机制域的。在SciFact和生物医学实体链接中确认了top-two margin的相消效应可能丢失判断候选列表是否含答案所需的信息。
AI.conclusion: 选择性预测在诊断场景中需要同时满足两个条件：排序器具备达成目标的基本能力，以及置信度信号与具体决策对齐。top-two margin虽然在固定候选排序器上表现更优，但其相消效应会丢失判断列表是否含答案所需的信息。此外，仅凭无标签分数无法先验判断切换置信度信号是否有益。

title: SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has recently expanded to Vision Transformers (ViTs), with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) increasingly used as post-hoc tools to decompose internal representations into sparse and more interpretable features. However, because post-hoc SAEs are trained on frozen representations after the ViT has already been optimized, their latent features are not directly aligned with the downstream classification objective. We introduce SpIn-ViT, a framework that jointly trains a pretrained ViT and a modified SAE end-to-end, directly aligning sparse patch-level representations with image classification. SpIn-ViT learns semantically coherent neuron activations that localize meaningful image regions while maintaining competitive predictive performance. We evaluate SpIn-ViT across nine image-classification benchmarks using classification accuracy, quantitative interpretability metrics, AI-based and Human evaluations. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art post-hoc SAE method, SpIn-ViT achieves 8.84% higher average classification accuracy, an AI-based interpretability score nearly four times as high, and a human-evaluation score more than twice as high. We further extract interpretable rule-sets using the SAE neurons to create neurosymbolic models which achieve 5.97% higher average classification accuracy while requiring a 58.8\% smaller rule-set than the neurosymbolic models created from the SOTA post-hoc SAE method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpIn-ViT框架，将预训练ViT与改进的稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行端到端联合训练，使稀疏的patch级表示直接与图像分类目标对齐。相比先前最优的后训练SAE方法，SpIn-ViT在九个图像分类基准上实现更高的分类精度、更好的可解释性得分和人类评估得分，并能提取更紧凑、精度更高的神经符号规则集。
AI.motivation: 以往的可解释性研究使用后训练SAE在冻结的ViT表示上训练，其潜在特征未与下游分类目标直接对齐，导致特征与分类目标之间存在脱节，可解释性与预测性能无法兼顾。
AI.method: SpIn-ViT框架：将预训练ViT与改进的SAE进行端到端联合训练，直接对齐稀疏patch级表示与图像分类目标，学习语义连贯的神经元激活以定位有意义图像区域，同时保持竞争性预测性能。还可利用SAE神经元提取可解释规则集以构建神经符号模型。
AI.result: 在九个图像分类基准上，相比先前最优的后训练SAE方法：分类准确率平均提升8.84%；基于AI的可解释性得分提高近4倍；人类评估得分提高2倍以上；生成的神经符号模型分类准确率平均提升5.97%，且规则集缩小58.8%。
AI.conclusion: SpIn-ViT证明将ViT与SAE端到端联合训练可以有效弥合可解释特征与下游任务目标之间的对齐鸿沟，在提升可解释性的同时不牺牲甚至提升分类性能，为可解释视觉模型提供了新的研究方向。

title: Not All History Helps: Velocity-Aware Selective Memory for Long-Horizon End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Reliable long-horizon planning remains a key challenge in end-to-end autonomous driving. By accounting for future motion evolution and potential consequences, it provides forward-looking guidance for safe and consistent driving in evolving traffic environments. Existing methods use historical planning states as temporal context. Self-generated history may become stale or conflict with the current motion stage, introducing unreliable priors. We propose StableDrive to address cross-cycle historical reliability and within-horizon motion-stage evolution. Selective Momentum Memory (SMM), implemented with a Mamba selective state-space operator, controls the influence of the preceding self-predicted planning state on the current cycle. Motion-Stage Training Scaffold (MSTS) uses motion-stage, long-horizon trajectory, and longitudinal-motion supervision to guide stage-aware future motion learning and is removed before inference. A fixed parameter midpoint between two architecture-aligned endpoints yields a single deployable SMM planner without model ensembling or extra inference-time computation. On nuScenes under the MomAD evaluation protocol, StableDrive achieves SOTA performance across all reported planning metrics from 1 to 6 s, reducing average collision rate by 23.3%, TPC by 30.9%, and L2 by 11.8% over the best previously reported value for each metric. On the curated Longitudinal-Transition nuScenes (LT-nuScenes), StableDrive reduces 6-s collision rate by 23.81%, TPC by 10.90%, and L2 by 6.37%. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, StableDrive achieves the highest PDMS/EPDMS in all three reported settings, including a 5.7-point EPDMS gain on v2 navhard over the previous best.

AI.tldr: StableDrive是一个面向端到端自动驾驶的长时域规划方法，通过选择性动量记忆（SMM）解决跨周期历史预测的可靠性问题，利用运动阶段训练脚手架（MSTS）在训练阶段引导阶段感知的未来运动学习，在推理时移除。在nuScenes、LT-nuScenes和NAVSIM v1/v2等多个基准上达到SOTA性能，显著降低了碰撞率、轨迹预测错误率和横向偏差。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶中的长时域规划仍具挑战性。现有方法利用历史规划状态作为时序上下文，但自生成的历史可能过时或与当前运动阶段冲突，引入不可靠的先验信息。论文旨在解决跨周期的历史可靠性和时域内的运动阶段演化两个核心问题。
AI.method: 提出两个关键模块：1) 选择性动量记忆（SMM），基于Mamba选择性状态空间算子，控制前一周期自预测规划状态对当前周期的影响；2) 运动阶段训练脚手架（MSTS），通过运动阶段、长时域轨迹和纵向运动监督引导阶段感知的未来运动学习，推理时移除。通过两个架构对齐端点之间的固定参数中点，获得单一可部署的SMM规划器，无需模型集成或额外推理计算。
AI.result: 在nuScenes MomAD评估协议下，所有1-6秒规划的指标均达到SOTA，平均碰撞率降低23.3%，TPC降低30.9%，L2降低11.8%。在LT-nuScenes上，6秒碰撞率降低23.81%，TPC降低10.90%，L2降低6.37%。在NAVSIM v1和v2上，所有三个设置的PDMS/EPDMS均最高，其中v2 navhard的EPDMS较此前最优提升5.7个点。
AI.conclusion: StableDrive通过选择性历史记忆控制和运动阶段感知训练，有效解决了端到端规划中历史预测不可靠和运动阶段演化两个关键问题，在多个主流基准上展现了显著的性能提升，证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts when evaluated under rubric sets of varying composition. We develop a measurement framework that probes interference through four controlled operations: rubric set expansion, subsetting, reordering, and noise injection. To mitigate interference without external supervision, we propose Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA). SARA uses a model's own single-rubric judgments as stable anchors and aligns multi-rubric reasoning with these anchors through on-policy self-distillation. We validate SARA on three datasets (HealthBench, FLASK, ResearchQA) and two model families (Qwen3, Llama-3.1). SARA consistently improves evaluation consistency while maintaining agreement with both base models and GPT-4.1 as a reference judge. Furthermore, the learned consistency transfers across datasets, confirming that SARA teaches a general capability rather than fitting dataset-specific patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM评估中多评估标准（rubric）单次推断时的"评分标准干扰"问题，并提出Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA)方法，通过将模型自身的单标准判断作为稳定锚点，并结合on-policy自蒸馏来对齐多标准推理，从而在不依赖外部监督的情况下提升评估一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM judges通常按细粒度评分标准清单逐条评估，每个标准需要一次独立的推断调用。将所有标准在一次推断中完成虽然更高效，但会引入评分标准干扰（rubric interference），即某一标准的判定结果会因其他共存标准的不同而发生偏移。初步研究发现，在不同标准组合下仅三分之一的样本得到完全一致的判定，说明这一干扰问题严重且亟待解决。
AI.method: 作者首先构建了一个测量框架，通过四种受控操作（标准集合扩展、子集化、重排序、噪声注入）来探测评分标准干扰。随后提出SARA方法：利用模型自身的单标准判断作为稳定锚点，通过on-policy自蒸馏将多标准推理与这些锚点对齐，从而在不依赖外部监督（如人工标注或更强模型）的情况下缓解干扰。
AI.result: SARA在三个数据集（HealthBench、FLASK、ResearchQA）和两个模型家族（Qwen3、Llama-3.1）上验证，一致性地提升了评估一致性，同时保持与基座模型及GPT-4.1参考判断的一致性。此外，学到的评估一致性可以跨数据集迁移，表明SARA教导的是通用能力而非数据集特定的模式。
AI.conclusion: SARA能在不引入外部监督的前提下有效缓解多标准评估中的评分标准干扰问题，提升评估一致性，且其效果具备跨数据集泛化能力，证明这是一种可迁移的通用评估能力提升方法。

title: PaSTel: Anchoring Histology in Spatial Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Hierarchical Bio-Prior Contrastive Pretraining
comment: This paper was accepted to the 3rd ICML 2026 Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) links tissue morphology with molecular programs, motivating multimodal pretraining methods that align histology images with gene expression. However, existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: spatially informative gene selection is often dominated by ubiquitous housekeeping genes, leading to weakly discriminative representations, and independent spot-patch alignment fails to capture spatial dependencies that are critical for tissue organization. To address these challenges, we introduce PaSTel, a hierarchical multimodal pretraining framework that integrates biological priors at three levels. At the spot level, TF-IDF reweighting is used to identify spatially informative genes; at the functional level, curated KEGG pathways serve as anchors for encoding global biological semantics; and at the regional level, spatial clustering aggregates neighboring spots to model meso-scale tissue structure. Across multiple downstream tasks, PaSTel consistently outperforms existing vision and vision-omics encoders, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale biological priors yields more informative and transferable representations for spatial transcriptomics.

AI.tldr: PaSTel是一个层次化的多模态预训练框架，通过三个层级（斑点级TF-IDF基因筛选、KEGG通路功能锚定、空间聚类区域建模）整合生物学先验，以改进空间转录组学中组织学图像与基因表达的对齐，在多任务下游评测中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有空间转录组学多模态预训练方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是空间信息基因的选择常被管家基因主导，导致表征判别力弱；二是独立的斑点-补丁对齐无法捕捉对组织构架至关重要的空间依赖性。
AI.method: PaSTel提出三层级层次化多模态预训练框架：1) 斑点级——利用TF-IDF重加权识别空间信息丰富的基因；2) 功能级——以KEGG通路为锚点编码全局生物学语义；3) 区域级——通过空间聚类聚合邻近斑点建模中尺度组织结构。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务上，PaSTel一致性地优于现有的视觉编码器和视觉-组学编码器，表明融入多尺度生物学先验能产生更具信息量和可迁移性的空间转录组学表征。
AI.conclusion: 层次化地整合多尺度生物学先验（从基因到通路再到空间区域）是提升空间转录组学表征质量的有效策略，为多模态预训练在该领域的应用提供了新方向。

title: Algorithm-Architecture Co-Design for Efficient VLA Inference via Speculative Inference and Verification
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in the field of embodied AI, but their high computational cost and limited predicted action length hinder real-time deployment. Although Dadu-Corki, a dedicated accelerator for efficient embodied AI, has been introduced, it does not exploit the inherent interaction patterns between the robot and its environment, which results in a relatively short predicted action length. We observe that robotic environments naturally alternate between active states-where precise actions are crucial-and inactive states-where actions have limited impact on task success. This insight enables a new scheduling opportunity: long-action-length speculative prediction in inactive states, paired with selective verification in active states.
  We propose SpecVLA, an algorithm-system co-design framework that adaptively balances action length, inference latency, and task reliability. On the algorithm side, SpecVLA introduces a state-aware VLA inference execution paradigm and a hardware-friendly construction of a smaller verification model (sVLA) using differential residuals and block-wise mixed-precision quantization. On the system side, we develop a heterogeneous architecture consisting of a GPU and a robotic-specific hardware module, along with a speculative dataflow that decouples VLA and sVLA through parallel execution. Comprehensive evaluations on OpenVLA and RDT across LIBERO and ManiSkill benchmarks show that SpecVLA reduces end-to-end latency significantly while preserving task success rate. By enabling long-action-length speculative prediction with timely verification, SpecVLA achieves real-time robotic manipulation with both high efficiency and reliability.

AI.tldr: SpecVLA是一个面向具身智能的算法-系统协同设计框架，通过利用机器人环境中主动/非主动状态的交替模式，在非主动状态下进行长动作长度的投机预测，在主动状态下进行选择性验证，从而实现实时机器人操作。该框架在算法侧引入状态感知的VLA推理执行范式和硬件友好的轻量验证模型（sVLA），在系统侧构建GPU+机器人专用硬件的异构架构和投机数据流。在OpenVLA和RDT上通过LIBERO和ManiSkill基准评估，显著降低了端到端延迟，同时保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在具身AI领域表现出色，但其高计算成本和有限的预测动作长度阻碍了实时部署。已有的专用加速器Dadu-Corki未利用机器人与环境之间的内在交互模式，导致预测动作长度较短。作者观察到机器人环境自然地在主动状态（精确动作至关重要）和非主动状态（动作对任务成功影响有限）之间交替，这一洞察启发了新的调度机会：在非主动状态进行长动作长度的投机预测，在主动状态进行选择性验证。
AI.method: SpecVLA采用算法-系统协同设计方法。算法侧：(1) 提出状态感知的VLA推理执行范式，根据环境状态动态调整动作长度；(2) 利用差分残差和块级混合精度量化构建硬件友好的小规模验证模型sVLA。系统侧：开发由GPU和机器人专用硬件模块组成的异构架构，以及通过并行执行解耦VLA和sVLA的投机数据流。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA和RDT模型上，通过LIBERO和ManiSkill基准的全面评估表明，SpecVLA在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低了端到端延迟。通过启用长动作长度的投机预测和及时验证，实现了高效且可靠的实时机器人操作。
AI.conclusion: SpecVLA通过状态感知的投机执行策略，有效解决了VLA实时部署中延迟与可靠性之间的权衡问题。利用环境状态交替的固有特性，在保证任务可靠性的前提下大幅提升推理效率，为实时具身智能部署提供了新的范式。

title: Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, but existing objectives often struggle to balance faithful imitation and robust generation. In particular, existing methods mainly combine FKL and RKL, overlooking that RKL itself provides a mechanism for adjusting the student's imitation strength. Motivated by this, we revisit on-policy Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) distillation and decompose its objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, without introducing an explicit FKL branch. We show theoretically that the token-level optimal student distribution corresponds to a tempered variant of the teacher distribution, where the adaptive weight controls the trade-off between mode-seeking and uncertainty preservation. Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)}, which uses the teacher's entropy to dynamically calibrate token-level imitation strength. Experiments on instruction-following and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that AED achieves superior overall performance and generally improves teacher--student distributional and entropy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应熵蒸馏（AED），通过重新审视on-policy反向KL蒸馏，将其目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项，利用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度，在指令跟随和数学推理基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏目标（如结合FKL和RKL）难以在忠实模仿和稳健生成之间取得平衡，且忽视了RKL本身已具备调整学生模仿强度的机制。
AI.method: 将on-policy RKL蒸馏目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项；理论证明token级最优学生分布是教师分布的温度变体，其自适应权重控制模式寻找与不确定性保持之间的权衡；据此提出AED方法，使用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度。
AI.result: 在指令跟随和数学推理基准上，AED取得了优越的整体性能，并普遍改善了师生分布对齐和熵对齐。
AI.conclusion: AED通过利用教师熵动态调节模仿强度，在不引入显式FKL分支的情况下有效平衡了忠实模仿与稳健生成，为LLM知识蒸馏提供了更优的目标函数。

title: Looks Can be Deceiving: Annotator and Reviewer Performance Across Imagery Sources in Crowd-Sourced Aerial Damage Assessment
summary: This paper presents the first known empirical investigation of annotator and reviewer performance across multi-source remotely sensed imagery, evaluating human labeling across drone, crewed aviation, and satellite views. Because existing aerial imagery datasets rely predominantly on single-source imagery, there is no currently established state of practice for efficiently allocating human labor to curate large-scale, multi-source aerial datasets. This work addresses this limitation by analyzing annotator and reviewer performance within a post-disaster building damage assessment dataset of 9 disasters, where 20041 buildings in drone, 20695 buildings in crewed aviation, and 33392 buildings in satellite imagery were labeled. These labels, provided by 187 annotators, were then refined through two successive quality-control stages: a single-reviewer pass followed by a consensus-committee review. Our analysis reveals two findings that raise questions for standard crowd-sourcing practices. First, initial annotations were revised by the final committee at rates that rise steeply from higher- to lower-resolution sources (25.27% for crewed aviation and 36.95% for satellite), with the same ordering at every observed workflow stage. Second, a single individual review reduced but did not resolve this disagreement: after review, the committee still revised 6.85% of drone, 14.05% of crewed, and 20.86% of satellite labels. These observations suggest that, in workflows like this one, uniform review allocation leaves the most residual disagreement in lower-resolution imagery. Based on this evidence, and consistent with prior work on adaptive task assignment and budget-aware quality control, this paper offers three recommendations for multi-source dataset curation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究了多源遥感影像（无人机、有人机、卫星）中标注者与审核者的表现差异，发现低分辨率影像中的标注分歧率显著更高，且统一审核策略无法消除这种残余分歧，据此提出针对多源数据集标注劳动力分配的三条建议。
AI.motivation: 现有航拍数据集主要依赖单一来源影像，缺乏在多源遥感数据上高效分配人工标注劳动力的既有实践规范。为填补这一空白，本文对灾后建筑损伤评估数据集中的标注与审核表现进行实证分析。
AI.method: 基于包含9场灾害、3种影像来源（无人机20041栋、有人机20695栋、卫星33392栋建筑）的标注数据集，187名标注者进行初始标注，随后经过单人审核和共识委员会审核两阶段质量控制，系统统计各阶段标注修订率以比较不同影像来源间的表现差异。
AI.result: 发现两项关键结果：(1) 初始标注被委员会修订的比例随影像分辨率降低而急剧上升（有人机25.27%，卫星36.95%），且该排序在所有工作流阶段保持一致；(2) 单人审核降低了但未消除分歧，审核后委员会仍修订了6.85%的无人机、14.05%的有人机和20.86%的卫星标注。这表明统一审核分配会在低分辨率影像中遗留最多的残余分歧。
AI.conclusion: 基于实证证据并结合自适应任务分配与预算感知质量控制方面的既有工作，作者为多源数据集策展提出了三条建议，核心指向应根据影像来源差异化分配审核资源。

title: Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models improve robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to compounding errors, scene changes, and off-trajectory states. Reinforcement learning can refine pretrained VLA policies, yet sparse success signals hinder exploration, while engineered dense rewards are costly and task-specific. Existing learned visual reward models often rely on static before-after observations, causing temporal ambiguity and weak discrimination between robustness-preserving variations and task-invalid failures under out-of-distribution (OOD) execution. We introduce Robo-Dopamine 2.0, a history- and OOD-aware process reward model with a pairwise prediction interface. It combines (1) history-conditioned pairwise rewards that use source-aligned reference panels for synthetic OOD queries and observed rollout history for online queries, while preserving the queried endpoints, and (2) an OOD-aware signed progress space that represents valid progress, robustness, failure, and recovery. A Signed-Hop Curriculum with transition-aware replay learns coarse execution ordering before fine-grained progress calibration. We also construct an OOD trajectory dataset and a five-family benchmark. Reference panels improve mean visual order consistency (VOC) from 0.967 to 0.986 and OOD-robust VOC from 0.906 to 0.958. With the same 400K pairwise-reward budget, Signed-Hop training with 25% replay reaches 0.9872 mean VOC, compared with 0.9858 for a matched-pool shuffled control. In downstream reinforcement learning, the full model achieves 86.8% mean RoboTwin success and 71/80 successful real-world insertions.

AI.tldr: Robo-Dopamine 2.0 是一个历史感知和OOD感知的过程奖励模型，用于细化预训练的VLA策略。它通过历史条件的成对奖励和OOD感知的有符号进度空间，加上Signed-Hop Curriculum训练，显著提升了奖励模型的视觉顺序一致性和下游强化学习的机器人操控成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操控中容易产生复合误差、场景变化和偏离轨迹的状态。强化学习虽可细化策略，但稀疏成功信号阻碍探索，而手工设计的密集型奖励成本高且任务特定。现有的学习式视觉奖励模型多依赖静态前后观测，导致时间歧义和对OOD执行下鲁棒性保持变化与任务无效失败之间的弱区分能力。
AI.method: 提出Robo-Dopamine 2.0，包含：(1) 历史条件成对奖励机制，使用源对齐参考面板处理合成OOD查询，使用观测的rollout历史处理在线查询，同时保留查询端点；(2) OOD感知的有符号进度空间，表征有效进度、鲁棒性、失败和恢复；(3) Signed-Hop Curriculum，通过转换感知的重放学习粗略执行排序再细化进度校准；(4) 构建OOD轨迹数据集和五族基准。
AI.result: 参考面板将平均视觉顺序一致性(VOC)从0.967提升至0.986，OOD鲁棒VOC从0.906提升至0.958。在相同的400K成对奖励预算下，带25%重放的Signed-Hop训练达到0.9872的平均VOC，优于匹配池洗牌对照的0.9858。下游强化学习中，完整模型实现86.8%的平均RoboTwin成功率以及71/80次真实世界插入成功。
AI.conclusion: Robo-Dopamine 2.0通过历史条件和OOD感知的成对奖励设计，以及Signed-Hop Curriculum训练，有效解决了现有视觉奖励模型在时间歧义和OOD场景下的区分力不足问题，显著提升了VLA策略细化的RoboTwin仿真和真实世界插入任务的成功率。

title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
summary:
Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters).
  I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection, or both. Across all experiments, removing the attention residual (FFNOnly) consistently causes deterministic collapse to the No-Residual performance floor. In contrast, removing the feed-forward residual (AttnOnly) exhibits a reproducible recovery effect at 10M scale under a controlled 8-seed deterministic study, while its behavior at 124M remains unresolved because of substantial seed variance.
  During the investigation, I identified and corrected an experimental measurement confound in runtime gain scaling and document both the failed intermediate reproduction and the subsequent controlled replication. Based on the empirical results, I propose a cross-position routing hypothesis to explain the observed asymmetry while explicitly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved questions.
  To support reproducibility, I release the complete source code, experiment configurations, checkpoints, training logs, and all experimental results, including intermediate non-reproducing runs.

AI.tldr: 本文对Pre-LN GPT风格Transformer中注意力残差连接和前馈残差连接的部分消融进行了可重复性研究，在10M和124M两种规模的模型上比较四种架构配置。发现去除注意力残差（FFNOnly）会导致确定性坍缩到无残差性能下限，而去除前馈残差（AttnOnly）在10M规模下表现出可复现的恢复效应，但在124M规模下因种子方差过大而无法定论。研究还识别并修正了运行时增益测量中的混淆因素，并提出跨位置路由假说解释观测到的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 残差连接是Transformer架构的基本组件，但对注意力残差路径和前馈残差路径在独立考虑时的作用仍缺乏深入理解。作者希望通过系统的部分残差消融研究，厘清两条残差通路各自的贡献，并构建可复现的实验框架来验证这些观察结果。
AI.method: 在两种规模（10M和124M参数）的Pre-LN GPT风格Transformer上进行部分残差消融实验，比较四种架构配置：完整模型、去除注意力残差（FFNOnly）、去除前馈残差（AttnOnly）、两者都去除（No-Residual）。10M规模采用8个种子受控确定性研究，124M规模探索较大种子方差下的行为。实验过程中识别并修正了运行时增益测量中的混淆因素，并记录了失败的中期复现尝试及后续受控复现。
AI.result: 去除注意力残差（FFNOnly）在所有实验中都一致地导致模型确定性坍缩到无残差性能下限；去除前馈残差（AttnOnly）在10M规模的8种子受控研究中表现出可复现的恢复效应，但在124M规模下由于种子方差较大而结论不明确。此外，发现并修正了运行时增益缩放中的测量混淆。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出跨位置路由假说以解释注意力与前馈残差通路之间的不对称性，同时明确区分了已确认的发现与未解决的问题。作者强调完整释放源码、配置、检查点、训练日志及所有实验结果（包括未复现的中间运行）以支持可重复性。

title: Benchmarking Frontier Text-to-Image Models on Image-Description Prompts
summary: Text-to-image models are typically reported on average-case prompts, which understates the gap between systems on compositionally demanding requests involving precise object counts, multi-object attribute binding, legible embedded text, and explicit spatial constraints. We evaluate four production text-to-image systems: Hunyuan 3.0, Gemini 3 Pro Image ("Nano Banana Pro"), Black Forest Labs FLUX.2, and Ideogram 3.0. The evaluation uses the 48 hardest prompts drawn from the DataSeeds.AI Sample Dataset (DSD), selected through an automated complexity-scoring pass over the full corpus. Every generated image is graded using an independent-judge rubric. GPT-5.4-Pro authors an atomic, weighted, mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive (MECE) evaluation rubric, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview independently determines whether each criterion is satisfied. Gemini 3 Pro Image ranks first with a score of 84.8/100, narrowly ahead of FLUX.2 at 82.3/100. Ideogram 3.0 and Hunyuan 3.0 score 65.7/100 and 63.3/100, respectively. Failure analysis shows that the leading systems primarily lose points through object miscounting and geometric artifacts, whereas the trailing systems more frequently produce garbled text. Ideogram 3.0 also frequently omits requested elements. Full per-sample rubrics, scores, and failure annotations are available from the authors upon request.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了四个生产级文生图系统（Hunyuan 3.0、Gemini 3 Pro Image、FLUX.2、Ideogram 3.0）在48个高复杂度提示词上的表现。使用GPT-5.4-Pro生成MECE评估标准，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview独立评分。结果显示Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8分居首，FLUX.2以82.3分紧随其后，Ideogram 3.0和Hunyuan 3.0分别得65.7和63.3分。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型的评测通常基于平均难度的提示词，无法充分体现系统在组合性高难任务（如精确物体计数、多对象属性绑定、嵌入式文本可读性、显式空间约束）上的性能差距。作者希望通过针对最困难提示词的评测来揭示系统间的真实差异。
AI.method: 从DataSeeds.AI Sample Dataset（DSD）中通过自动化复杂度评分筛选出48个最难的提示词，对四个生产级文生图系统进行评测。采用独立评委评审框架：GPT-5.4-Pro编写原子化、加权、相互排斥且完全穷尽（MECE）的评估标准，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview独立判断每条标准是否满足。
AI.result: Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8/100位列第一，FLUX.2以82.3/100紧随其后，Ideogram 3.0（65.7/100）和Hunyuan 3.0（63.3/100）显著落后。失败分析显示：领先系统主要在物体计数错误和几何伪影上失分，落后系统更频繁产生乱码文本，Ideogram 3.0还经常遗漏所要求的元素。
AI.conclusion: 在高难度组合性提示词上，领先的文生图系统与落后系统之间存在显著差距（约20分）。主要失分点集中于物体计数和几何表现，而文本生成是部分系统的关键短板。完整评分数据可从作者处获取。

title: GAINS: Leveraging Inconsistent Human Intervention Signals in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Correcting robot manipulation policies through human intervention holds great promise for real-world deployment, yet human operators are inherently imperfect in both the actions they provide and the timing of their intervention signals. While the former has been extensively discussed in reinforcement learning (RL), the latter remains underexplored. At high control frequencies, human intervention signals are often delayed and inconsistent across time and state space. In this work, we present GAINS, a framework for leveraging inconsistent human intervention signals in RL. At the core of GAINS, we employ distributional RL with quantile Q-networks to model the return variability induced by sparse task rewards and inconsistent human interventions. Building on this distributional representation, we introduce a pessimistic exploration strategy that promotes safe and sample-efficient learning under human corrections. We evaluate GAINS on four diverse simulated manipulation tasks and two challenging real-world scenarios against state-of-the-art intervention-based methods. GAINS achieves a 22% higher task success rate than RLIF and improves recovery success by up to 43% in failure scenarios. These results highlight the importance of modeling return variability induced by human imperfection for real-world deployment of intervention-based learning.

AI.tldr: GAINS是一个利用不一致的人类干预信号进行强化学习的框架，通过分布强化学习（分位数Q网络）建模任务稀疏奖励和人类干预不一致性带来的回报变异性，并引入悲观探索策略来促进安全和样本高效的学习。在四个仿真操作任务和两个真实世界场景中，GAINS比RLIF在任务成功率上高22%，在失败场景中恢复成功率高43%。
AI.motivation: 人类操作员在干预机器人操作策略时，不仅提供的动作不完美（这在强化学习中已被广泛研究），而且其干预信号的时序也是不完美的——在高控制频率下，人类的干预信号常常是延迟的，并在时间和状态空间上不一致。这种干预信号的不一致性此前未被充分探索，阻碍了基于干预学习的真实世界部署。
AI.method: GAINS框架的核心包括：(1) 使用分布强化学习中的分位数Q网络来建模稀疏任务奖励和不一致人类干预所带来的回报变异性；(2) 基于该分布表示，引入悲观探索策略，在人类纠正下促进安全和样本高效的学习。
AI.result: 在四个多样的仿真操作任务和两个具有挑战性的真实世界场景中，与最先进的基于干预的方法相比，GAINS比RLIF在任务成功率上提升了22%，在失败场景中恢复成功率最多提升43%。
AI.conclusion: 建模由人类不完美性（动作和干预时序）引起的回报变异性对于基于干预学习的真实世界部署至关重要，GAINS通过分布强化学习有效地解决了这一问题。

title: The Quantum Shortcut: Complex Phase-State Dynamics Reduce the Optimization Steps of Sequence Models
summary: Sequence models are conventionally distinguished by their backbone, the mechanism that routes information across positions, such as attention or recurrence. This paper varies a choice that is prior to the backbone and shared by nearly all current models: the \emph{substrate}, the number system in which the hidden state is represented together with the form of the map from state to prediction. The prevailing substrate is a real-valued state with an affine--softmax readout; we study a complex-valued alternative drawn from the mathematics of quantum theory, in which information is carried by the phases of the state and scores are quadratic Born forms. Prior work proved an idealized version of this substrate representationally stronger than any real model with a linear readout; we ask whether it also trains faster. Relaxing the two properties that block deployment, exact unitarity and the Born vocabulary readout, we instantiate it in the Mamba state-space model and an attention-based Transformer. At 253M parameters, matched to within $0.02\%$ and trained under one fixed protocol on three byte-level corpora, the complex models reach every measured validation loss in approximately one third (state-space) and one half (attention) of the optimization steps of their real counterparts. The two backbones then diverge. Once the learning-rate warmup ends, the state-space advantage continues to widen, from $0.321$ to $0.354$ bits per character on OpenWebText and from $0.368$ to $0.396$ on FineWeb, which an artifact of the warmup ramp would not do; the attention advantage instead decays toward zero on every corpus, and is therefore an effect of early training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了序列模型的一个先前被忽视的选择——"基底"（substrate），即隐藏状态表示所用的数系统及其到预测的映射形式。作者将传统实数状态+仿射-softmax读出替换为源自量子理论的复数状态（信息由相位承载，得分为二次Born形式），并将其应用于Mamba状态空间模型和基于注意力的Transformer中。在253M参数、三种字节级语料库上，复数模型达到相同验证损失所需的优化步数约为实数模型的三分之一（状态空间）和二分之一（注意力）。但两者的后续表现不同：状态空间模型的优势持续扩大，而注意力模型的优势在早期训练后衰减到零。
AI.motivation: 先前工作已经证明，在理想化设定下，复数基底（复数状态+Born二次读出）在表示能力上强于任何使用线性读出的实数模型，但这一优势能否转化为实际训练中的加速尚不清楚。作者希望放宽阻止部署的两个属性（精确幺正性和Born词汇读出），在实际模型中验证复数基底是否训练更快。
AI.method: 作者将复数基底实例化为两种主流backbone：Mamba状态空间模型和基于注意力的Transformer。具体做法是放宽两个阻碍实际部署的属性——精确幺正性（exact unitarity）和Born词汇读出（Born vocabulary readout）。在253M参数规模下，匹配到0.02%以内，采用固定的训练协议，在三个字节级语料库上对比复数模型与实数模型的训练速度。
AI.result: 复数状态空间模型达到每个测量验证损失所需的优化步数约为实数模型的三分之一，复数注意力模型约为二分之一。在warmup结束后，状态空间模型的优势持续扩大（OpenWebText上从0.321扩大到0.354 bits/char，FineWeb上从0.368扩大到0.396 bits/char），说明这不是warmup的伪影；而注意力模型的优势在每种语料上都逐渐衰减至零，属于早期训练效应。
AI.conclusion: 复数基底（源自量子理论的相位信息编码和Born二次读出）在实践中确实比传统实数基底训练更快，但其收益的持久性取决于backbone：状态空间模型的复数优势是持续且不断扩大的，而注意力模型的复数优势仅是早期训练的暂时现象。这表明基底与backbone之间存在重要的交互作用，且早期训练动态值得进一步研究。

title: Risk-Adaptive Edge--Cloud Visual Reasoning for Communication-Efficient Autonomous Driving
summary: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) offer greater contextual reasoning capabilities than smaller onboard models, but frequent visual uploads increase communication overhead and add network and inference latency to tactical decisions. We present a risk-adaptive edge-cloud architecture in which onboard traffic assessment determines when cloud reasoning is requested. An onboard VLM and a lightweight detector capture temporal traffic conditions and path-relative hazards for conservative local response and selective cloud access. The cloud model provides tactical advice, while validation, vehicle control, and automatic emergency braking remain local. In CARLA experiments, our method matched the task success rate of periodic cloud access while reducing cloud requests by 54.1% and recording fewer automatic emergency braking (AEB) activations. In a delayed-roadwork ablation, semantic events triggered requests before the next scheduled audit. Across three emulated network profiles, the method continued to reduce cloud traffic, although lane changes took longer than with periodic access. Onboard traffic assessment therefore served as a practical trigger for selective VLM inference in these experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种风险自适应的边缘-云架构，通过车载交通评估决定何时请求云端VLM推理，在CARLA实验中实现了与周期性云访问相当的任务成功率，同时将云请求减少54.1%，并减少自动紧急制动（AEB）触发次数。
AI.motivation: 云端的视觉语言模型（VLM）比车载小模型具有更强的上下文推理能力，但频繁上传视觉数据会增加通信开销、网络延迟和推理延迟，影响战术决策的实时性。因此需要一种机制来决定何时请求云端推理，以平衡推理能力与通信开销。
AI.method: 提出风险自适应的边缘-云架构：车载VLM与轻量级检测器捕获时序交通状况和路径相对危险，用于保守的本地响应和有选择性的云端访问；云端模型提供战术建议，而验证、车辆控制和自动紧急制动保持本地执行。
AI.result: 在CARLA实验中，该方法与周期性云访问的任务成功率相当，但云请求减少54.1%，且自动紧急制动（AEB）触发次数更少。在延迟道路施工消融实验中，语义事件在预定审计之前就触发了请求。在三种仿真网络配置下，该方法继续减少云流量，但变道耗时比周期性访问更长。
AI.conclusion: 车载交通评估可作为选择性VLM云推理的实用触发器，在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下显著降低云通信开销。

title: Some Modifications to Our End-to-End UAV Planner
summary: The one-stage planner YOPO maps a single depth image and the robot state directly to a set of candidate trajectories, trained by backpropagating through differentiable trajectory costs. This yields dense, geometrically informative supervision, but inherits the pathologies of soft-constrained optimization: the safety cost competes with the smoothness and goal-reaching terms, is non-convex across homotopy classes, and the single-piece polynomial is limited in expressiveness. In this report, we summarize several effective modifications. We adopt a two-piece MINCO parameterization, trading time for smoothness without altering the trajectory's spatial profile. We further lift YOPO's multi-modal prediction to span distinct homotopy classes, treating each motion primitive as a homotopy anchor that confines the trajectory to a feasible basin - without explicit safe-flight-corridor construction or front-end search. For dynamic feasibility, we impose barrier penalties on velocity and acceleration together with a curvature-dependent speed limit whose gradient acts only on the velocity, producing an adaptive-speed behavior that decelerates in cluttered regions or sharp turns. We replace score regression with a ranking loss, preventing small score errors from reordering the candidate set. These yield richer trajectory representations, safer obstacle avoidance, and more direct flight paths.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了在单阶段规划器YOPO基础上的一系列有效改进：采用两段MINCO参数化提升轨迹表达能力，将多模态预测扩展至不同同伦类以增强避障能力，引入基于曲率的自适应速度限制与势垒惩罚保障动态可行性，并用排序损失替代分数回归以稳定候选排序。
AI.motivation: YOPO这类单阶段端到端规划器虽能通过可微轨迹代价回传获得密集几何监督，但继承了软约束优化的固有问题：安全代价与平滑性、目标到达项相互竞争，且代价在跨越同伦类时非凸，单段多项式表达力受限，导致轨迹安全性、平滑性和直观性不足。
AI.method: 提出四项改进：(1)采用两段MINCO参数化替代单段多项式，以时间换取平滑而不改变空间轮廓；(2)将YOPO的多模态预测扩展为覆盖不同同伦类的运动基元，每个基元作为同伦锚点将轨迹约束在可行盆地内，无需显式安全飞行走廊或前端搜索；(3)对速度和加速度施加势垒惩罚，并结合曲率相关的速度限制（梯度仅作用于速度），实现自适应减速行为；(4)以排序损失替代分数回归，防止小的分数误差导致候选集重新排序。
AI.result: 这些修改带来了更丰富的轨迹表示、更安全的避障能力以及更直接的飞行路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过在参数化、同伦建模、动态可行性和排序训练损失四个方面的系统性改进，有效缓解了YOPO软约束优化的病理问题，显著提升了单阶段规划器的轨迹质量与安全性。

title: Tail-Aware Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective paradigm for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student is trained to align its next-token distribution with the teacher's along its own trajectories. To provide dense supervision at tractable cost, many works minimize the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the student and teacher's normalized distributions over the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. However, this normalized objective discards the information about tail probability: the total probability outside the teacher's top-$k$ tokens. As a result, the optimization can steadily increase the student's tail probability and entropy, empirically degrading downstream accuracy. To address this issue, we propose Tail-Aware Top-$k$ OPD (\textbf{TA-OPD}), a novel distillation method that restores the missing tail probability signal. In particular, TA-OPD minimizes the reverse KL divergence over the top-$k$ tokens plus a tail token that carries the tail probability. In effect, TA-OPD better aligns the student's next-token distribution with the teacher's, preventing the increase in tail probability and entropy caused by top-$k$ normalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of TA-OPD, improving Avg@8 by up to 8.05 points on common benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuipengHuang/TA-OPD.

AI.tldr: 针对同策略蒸馏（OPD）中top-k归一化丢失尾部概率信息的问题，提出Tail-Aware Top-k OPD（TA-OPD），通过在top-k token之外额外引入一个携带尾部概率的tail token来恢复丢失的尾部概率信号，防止学生模型尾部概率和熵的异常增长，提升下游任务精度。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD方法在教师top-k token上进行归一化的逆KL散度优化，丢弃了top-k之外的总概率（即尾部概率）信息。这导致优化过程中学生模型的尾部概率和熵持续增加，最终损害下游任务的准确率。
AI.method: TA-OPD在top-k token的逆KL散度目标基础上，额外引入一个携带剩余尾部概率的tail token（即第k+1个虚拟token），使得目标函数同时覆盖top-k token与尾部概率，从而在可承受的计算开销下提供完整的分布对齐信号。
AI.result: 大量实验表明TA-OPD具有优越性，在常见基准上Avg@8最多提升8.05个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TA-OPD通过恢复被top-k归一化丢弃的尾部概率信息，有效防止学生模型熵和尾部概率的异常增长，实现了更准确的师生分布对齐和更优的下游性能。

title: Registration-Free Hyperspectral Reconstruction from RGB via a Permutation-Invariant Gram-Matrix Principle
comment: 11 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Reconstructing a spatially and spectrally high-resolution hyperspectral image (HR-HSI) from a low-resolution HSI (LR-HSI) and a high-resolution RGB image (HR-RGB) usually assumes precise registration and a known camera response function (CRF). Both assumptions are difficult to satisfy with different sensors. We remove both through a permutation-invariant supervision principle: the Gram matrix of an unmixed abundance map depends on shared material composition but not on pixel ordering. Matching abundance Gram matrices therefore allows RGB-to-HSI mapping to be learned without spatial correspondence and without a predefined CRF. Under a full random permutation of HR-RGB pixels, a state-of-the-art fusion method collapses, whereas our reconstruction is unchanged after inverse reindexing for evaluation. Building on this principle, a residual spectral super-resolution function maps HR-RGB directly to HR-HSI without registration, known CRF, or paired supervision. Across indoor, natural-scene, and remote-sensing benchmarks, the method achieves accuracy comparable to approaches that require these assumptions while remaining robust when they are violated. Loss ablations further show that reconstruction accuracy is largely insensitive to the specific discrepancy used to match the Gram matrices, indicating that performance arises primarily from the permutation-invariant principle rather than loss tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于置换不变监督原则的高光谱图像融合方法，通过匹配丰度Gram矩阵实现RGB到HSI的无配准、无CRF映射，无需配对监督，在室内、自然场景和遥感基准上达到与需要强假设方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有LR-HSI与HR-RGB融合方法通常假设精确配准和已知相机响应函数（CRF），但不同传感器难以满足这些假设。作者希望移除这两个强假设，使融合方法在实际多传感器场景中更加鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出置换不变监督原则：未混合的丰度图的Gram矩阵仅取决于共享的材料组成而不依赖于像素排序。通过匹配丰度Gram矩阵，可以在无空间对应、无预定义CRF、无配对监督的情况下学习RGB到HSI的映射。在此基础上构建残差光谱超分函数，直接将HR-RGB映射到HR-HSI。
AI.result: 在RGB像素完全随机置换下，现有最优融合方法崩溃，而该方法在反索引求值后重建结果不变。在室内、自然场景和遥感基准上，该方法达到与需要配准和CRF假设的方法相当的精度，且在假设被违反时保持鲁棒。损失消融实验表明重建精度对Gram矩阵匹配的具体差异度量不敏感，性能主要来源于置换不变原则本身。
AI.conclusion: 置换不变原则是解决无配准、无CRF的RGB到HSI融合问题的关键，性能来源于该原则而非损失函数调优，为多传感器高光谱图像重建提供了无需严格先验假设的新路径。

title: Making two action heads agree: coordination mechanisms and a runtime collapse certificate for flow-matching policies
summary: A dual-representation flow-matching policy decodes each predicted motion into joint and end-effector spaces, and the residual between the two kinematically equivalent decodings provides a physically interpretable runtime signal. On multimodal tasks, however, independently sampled branches may choose different valid modes, causing false alarms. We study how to coordinate the two branches and at what cost. Across two robot environments and a non-robotic testbed, the tested mechanisms fall into four classes. An auxiliary latent shared by both branches but absent from the flow-matching construction is erased at the population optimum, a provable dead end confirmed within a prespecified 2% equivalence band. Sharing source noise can coordinate or anti-coordinate: its effect changes sign with the representation map and tracks the alignment of decoder mode basins. Consistency regularization gives intermediate coordination but reduces the valid-pair rate, while training-supported discrete partitions achieve near-ceiling coordination robustly. We further derive a chance-corrected coordination bound based only on each branch's Gini-Simpson diversity, yielding an attainable region and a label-free certificate that separates coordination from collapse when zero mismatch is ambiguous. On LIBERO-Plus, benign multimodality adds 1.57 percentage points of false alarms to the residual, which remains the strongest evaluated failure signal; the preregistered token intervention does not meet its false-alarm criterion or produce a seed-robust detection change. Code, models, and per-run configurations are available at https://github.com/kimo423/dual-head-coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双表示流匹配策略中如何协调两条独立解码分支（关节空间与末端执行器空间），以避免在多模态任务中因分支选择不同有效模态而产生的误报问题。作者测试了四类协调机制，发现共享潜变量在群体最优时被擦除（证明为死胡同），共享源噪声的效应随表示映射改变符号，一致性正则化会降低有效配对率，而训练支持的离散划分能稳健地接近上限协调。文中还推导了一个基于Gini-Simpson多样性的随机校正协调界，并提供了无标签证书以区分协调与塌缩。
AI.motivation: 双表示流匹配策略将每个预测运动分别解码到关节空间和末端执行器空间，两者之间的残差可作为物理可解释的运行时信号。但在多模态任务中，独立采样的分支可能选择不同的有效模态，导致误报。因此需要研究如何协调两条分支以及协调需要付出的代价。
AI.method: 在两类机器人环境和一类非机器人测试平台上，测试了四类协调机制：共享辅助潜变量（但被证明在群体最优时被擦除）；共享源噪声（其协调/反协调效应随表示映射改变符号）；一致性正则化（带来中等协调但降低有效配对率）；训练支持的离散划分（实现了接近上限的稳健协调）。同时推导了基于各分支Gini-Simpson多样性的随机校正协调界。
AI.result: 共享潜变量在群体最优处被擦除，在预设的2%等价区间内被证实为死胡同。共享源噪声的效应会随表示映射改变符号并与解码器模态盆地对齐相关。一致性正则化带来中等协调但降低有效配对率。训练支持的离散划分实现接近上限的稳健协调。在LIBERO-Plus上，良性多模态性为残差增加了1.57个百分点的误报，但残差仍是最强的失败信号；预注册的令牌干预未达到误报标准也未产生种子稳健的检测变化。
AI.conclusion: 双分支间的协调需要训练机制的支持而非简单的构造性共享；推导出的随机校正协调界可作为无标签证书来区分真实协调与塌缩，特别是在零失配时具有歧义的情形下。该工作为多模态流匹配策略的协调问题提供了系统化的理论分析与实证验证。

title: A Novel Fourier Feature Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations
summary: Building on the foundation of single-hidden-layer neural networks, Fourier Feature Networks (FENs) are proposed, which incorporate Fourier features using $\cos$, $\sin$, or a combination of both. Similar to Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs), FENs employ a single-hidden-layer architecture to generate a set of basis functions. The target function is then approximated as a linear combination of these basis functions, with the coefficients determined using the least squares method. However, unlike ELMs, which often rely on affine transformations to improve representational power, FENs can achieve high-precision solutions without requiring such transformations on the input variables. To evaluate the representational capacity of these networks, we search for an optimal scaling factor within a predefined range for the randomly initialized and fixed weights and biases. By adjusting this scaling factor, we ensure a fair comparison between FENs and ELMs using various activation functions, such as $\text{sigmoid}$, $\tanh$, and $\text{swish}$. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that FENs consistently achieve higher accuracy than ELMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了傅里叶特征网络（FENs），在单隐层神经网络基础上结合cos、sin傅里叶特征，通过最小二乘法求解线性组合系数来逼近目标函数。与极限学习机（ELMs）相比，FENs无需仿射变换即可实现高精度求解。通过搜索最优缩放因子进行公平比较，实验表明FENs在多种激活函数下精度均优于ELMs。
AI.motivation: 在单隐层神经网络和极限学习机（ELMs）的基础上，探索一种不需要仿射变换来提高表示能力、却能实现高精度求解的网络结构，即傅里叶特征网络（FENs），并对其进行系统评估和公平比较。
AI.method: 提出的FENs采用单隐层架构，结合cos、sin或其组合生成傅里叶特征作为基函数集，用最小二乘法确定线性组合系数。为公平比较，在预定义范围内搜索随机初始化权重和偏置的最优缩放因子，并将该缩放因子调整机制应用于FENs和ELMs，使用sigmoid、tanh和swish等多种激活函数进行对比。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，在多种激活函数下，FENs一致地获得了比ELMs更高的精度。
AI.conclusion: FENs作为一种基于傅里叶特征的单隐层网络，能够在无需仿射变换的条件下实现优于ELMs的求解精度，展现出更强的表示能力和更高的数值精度。

title: FZ-VLM: A Two Stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model Framework for Pulmonary Nodule Characterization and Clinical Decision Making
summary: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and Computed Tomography (CT) is a primary imaging tool for screening and followup assessment. After pulmonary nodule detection, radiologists manually assess anatomical location, diameter, margin characteristics, and attenuation type to support risk assessment and clinical decision-making. However, this post-detection workflow is time-consuming and can be affected by inter-observer variability. Existing Artificial Intelligence methods often focus on isolated tasks, limiting their use as a unified, clinically grounded interpretation framework. This study presents FZ-VLM, a two-stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model framework for unified structured pulmonary nodule characterization in lung CT. The framework uses a fine-tuned Florence-2 model to extract radiological attributes from expert-annotated 2D axial CT slices, while a Zephyr-7B model uses these attributes to generate nodule descriptions, follow-up recommendations, and longitudinal analyses. Results showed that the Stage 1 model achieved 77.18\% accuracy for anatomical location, 67.96\% accuracy for margin characteristics, and 79.13\% accuracy for attenuation type, with a Mean Absolute Error of 2.58 mm for diameter estimation, outperforming evaluated GPT-4-based baselines as well as the human baseline. Expert radiologist evaluation of Stage 2 showed 93.9\% accuracy, 98.6\% completeness score, 76.1\% clinical relevance, and an overall score of 89.5\%. Safety analysis showed that most outputs were clinically safe, although some follow-up recommendations still required expert review. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents the first two-stage Vision-Language Model framework for structured nodule characterization and clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FZ-VLM，一个两阶段的Florence-Zephyr视觉语言模型框架，用于肺CT中肺结节的结构化联合表征。第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型提取放射学属性，第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B模型基于这些属性生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。实验结果显示第一阶段各属性准确率在67.96%-79.13%之间，直径估计MAE为2.58mm，优于GPT-4基线和人类基线；第二阶段专家评估准确率93.9%，完整性98.6%。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球主要癌症死亡原因之一，CT是主要筛查工具。结节检测后的放射科医生手动评估流程耗时且存在观察者间差异，而现有AI方法通常只关注孤立任务，缺乏统一的临床解释框架。
AI.method: 提出两阶段FZ-VLM框架：第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型从专家标注的2D轴向CT切片提取放射学属性（解剖位置、直径、边缘特征、衰减类型）；第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B模型基于这些属性生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。
AI.result: 第一阶段模型在解剖位置上准确率77.18%，边缘特征准确率67.96%，衰减类型准确率79.13%，直径估计MAE为2.58mm，优于GPT-4基线和人类基线。第二阶段专家评估：准确率93.9%，完整性98.6%，临床相关性76.1%，总体评分89.5%。安全性分析显示大多数输出临床安全，部分随访建议仍需专家审查。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个用于结构化结节表征和临床决策的两阶段视觉语言模型框架，统一了肺结节表征流程，展现出良好的临床应用潜力，但部分随访建议仍需专家审查以确保安全性。

title: Tac4Loco: Learning Spatiotemporal Plantar Pressure Representations for Humanoid Locomotion
summary:
Humanoid robots are expected to traverse complex terrains, where the plantar support may vary dramatically due to foot placement errors, ground properties, and transient dynamics.
  To achieve robust locomotion, the robots are required to adapt to uneven terrain and uncertain foot--ground interactions.
  Existing locomotion policies rely primarily on proprioception or exteroceptive terrain perception, where the former provides only indirect evidence of plantar support, while the latter predicts contact conditions before touchdown but cannot observe the actual support in real-time.
  Although some studies incorporate plantar contacts as an auxiliary perception, they rely mainly on summary statistics, overlooking the spatial topology of plantar pressure, which provides a more direct characterization of the realized contact state.
  To bridge this gap, we present Tac4Loco, a tactile-perceptive framework that incorporates multi-array plantar pressure as direct feedback for humanoid locomotion.
  We formulate a topology-preserving ordinal representation to map simulated and physical sensor signals into a shared observation space,
  with a dual-branch encoder for extracting their spatial and temporal representations. Subsequently, the learned spatiotemporal features are integrated with augmented proprioception including terrain estimation cues, and provided to an asymmetric actor-critic architecture for policy learning.
  Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved tracking performance and support adaptation on terrains with inclined, partial, asymmetric, and changing support. We further demonstrate its zero-shot deployment on unseen compliant and unstructured terrains, including a foam platform and a gravel road. All code and experimental configurations will be released as open-source to facilitate reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tac4Loco框架，将多阵列足底压力作为直接反馈用于人形机器人运动控制，通过拓扑保持的序数表示将仿真和物理传感器信号映射到共享观测空间，并结合双分支编码器提取时空特征与增强本体感知，实现复杂地形上的鲁棒运动。
AI.motivation: 现有人形机器人运动策略在复杂地形上仅依赖本体感知或外部地形感知，前者对足底支撑仅提供间接证据，后者无法实时观测实际接触状态；虽有些研究引入足底接触作为辅助感知，但主要依赖汇总统计量，忽略了足底压力的空间拓扑结构，而这更直接地表征了实际接触状态。
AI.method: Tac4Loco框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 拓扑保持的序数表示，将仿真和物理传感器信号映射到共享观测空间；(2) 双分支编码器，分别提取空间和时间表征；(3) 非对称actor-critic架构，将学习到的时空特征与包含地形估计线索的增强本体感知集成进行策略学习。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，该框架在倾斜、部分、不对称和变化的支撑地形上提升了跟踪性能和支持适应能力；并在未见的柔性和非结构化地形（泡沫平台和碎石路）上实现了零样本部署。
AI.conclusion: Tac4Loco通过利用足底压力的空间拓扑信息作为直接反馈，显著增强了人形机器人在不确定足-地交互条件下的运动鲁棒性，并展示了良好的泛化能力。代码和实验配置将开源以促进可复现性。

title: Unraveling the Size Determination Mechanism of Nanocrystal Synthesis via Interpretable Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning models of nanocrystal synthesis enable the prediction of size and shape by encoding precursors and reaction conditions. However, their black-box nature hinders gaining deep insights into the underlying synthetic mechanisms. Here, we develop the Nanocrystal Equation Learner (NanoEQL), a fully white-box neural network to unravel the size determination mechanisms of nanocrystal synthesis. Building on the EQL architecture, eight operators are introduced to replace standard activation functions to fit the mathematical equations in nanocrystal synthesis. Among these operators, three smoothed operators address the gradient explosion of singular operators at zero. To evaluate the weights of different precursors, we develop a temperature-gated attention pooling strategy that encodes concentration-driven and reactivity-driven chemical synthesis mechanisms into the temperature gate. The NanoEQL model illustrates that the final nanocrystal size can be described by a linear equation composed of three scalars representing nanocrystallization capability (-Zp), growth capability (Zrea), and external input potential (-Zops). These interpretable scalars not only advance the rational design of nanocrystal synthesis but also establish a generalizable paradigm for deciphering chemical reaction mechanisms through white-box machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NanoEQL，一种全白盒神经网络模型，通过引入八个数学算子替代标准激活函数，并结合温度门控注意力池化策略，将纳米晶合成中尺寸决定机制解析为线性方程，从而实现纳米晶合成机制的可解释性学习。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的纳米晶合成预测模型（如预测尺寸和形状）虽然精度高，但属于黑盒模型，无法揭示合成的潜在机理，阻碍了对纳米晶合成机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 在EQL架构基础上引入八个算子替代标准激活函数以拟合纳米晶合成中的数学方程；其中三个平滑算子解决奇异算子在零点的梯度爆炸问题；开发温度门控注意力池化策略，将浓度驱动和反应性驱动的化学合成机制编码到温度门中，用于评估不同前驱体的权重。
AI.result: NanoEQL模型表明最终纳米晶尺寸可由三个标量组成的线性方程描述：纳米晶化能力(-Zp)、生长能力(Zrea)和外部输入势(-Zops)。
AI.conclusion: 这些可解释的标量不仅推进了纳米晶合成的理性设计，还建立了通过白盒机器学习解读化学反应机制的普适性范式。

title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems
summary: Although visual reasoning is crucial for solving complex geometry tasks, existing vision-language models rely heavily on text-only reasoning. Some recent methods introduce intermediate visual states to facilitate reasoning, but they are often hindered by inaccurate geometric representations and low rendering fidelity, ultimately leading to unreliable outputs. To address these limitations, we propose MetaReason, a framework for multimodal reasoning in plane geometry that leverages structured meta-information to enable accurate auxiliary-line construction. The framework first parses geometric images into meta-information, performs controllable edits with predefined tools to synthesize high-fidelity visual states, and then conducts reasoning based on these augmented views. To support this framework, we construct TutorGeo, a comprehensive dataset containing 17k image-to-meta conversion samples, 60k text-only reasoning traces, and 60k interleaved multimodal reasoning traces. Using this dataset, we combine supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to develop robust multimodal reasoning capabilities. We also introduce ExamGeo, a benchmark derived from real-world examination problems that enables systematic evaluation across varying difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaReason significantly outperforms existing open-source models and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models.

AI.tldr: MetaReason是一个面向平面几何多模态推理的框架，通过解析几何图像为结构化元信息，利用预定义工具进行可控编辑以合成高保真视觉状态，从而支持准确的辅助线构造和推理。结合TutorGeo数据集（17k图像到元信息转换样本、60k文本推理轨迹和60k交错多模态推理轨迹），采用监督微调和强化学习训练模型，并在ExamGeo基准上显著优于现有开源模型，接近专有模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在几何任务中过度依赖纯文本推理，虽然已有方法引入中间视觉状态辅助推理，但受限于几何表示不准确和渲染保真度低，导致输出不可靠。
AI.method: MetaReason框架包含三个步骤：1) 将几何图像解析为结构化元信息（meta-information）；2) 使用预定义工具对元信息进行可控编辑，合成高保真视觉状态（辅助线视图）；3) 基于增强视觉视图进行多模态推理。同时构建TutorGeo数据集，并采用监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）相结合的训练策略。
AI.result: MetaReason显著优于现有开源模型，并在与专有模型的对比中达到具有竞争力的性能。同时构建了支持系统性评测的ExamGeo基准，涵盖不同难度级别。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化元信息驱动的高保真视觉状态合成方法，MetaReason有效解决了现有几何多模态推理中几何表示不准确和渲染保真度低的问题，验证了辅助线构造在平面几何推理中的关键作用。

title: Reliable Piezoresistive Strain Sensing Through Physical Limits and Uncertainty Monitoring
summary: Soft piezoresistive strain sensors are one of the most common sensing solutions for wearable and soft robotic applications due to their flexibility and compliance. However, their resistance response is nonlinear and hysteretic, and a sensor can be pushed past its calibrated workspace or misbehave inside it, carrying that error into a decision or control loop. Probabilistic regressors track confidence but ignore those limits. A predictive mean can look unremarkable even when the reading comes from a sensor outside its admissible range or already failing internally, so a confident-looking estimate is not the same as a trustworthy one. This paper proposes a reliability framework pairing a physics-informed probabilistic inverse model, built on physics-guided input features, with a risk factor fusing uncertainty with strain and strain-rate limits into a three-state monitor. Tests on a Nitinol wire and a silver-coated polyamide thread with a Gaussian Process raised fit scores to 0.90-0.95 (RMSE 0.26%-0.15%) and a 96% empirical coverage against the 95% target. The monitor caught 95% of out-of-range and 100% of abnormal conditions while staying reliable under nominal operation. A sensor that reports confidence alongside its estimate lets a system withhold action instead, since it needs no labeled failure examples, which are hard to collect for soft materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于软压阻应变传感器的可靠性框架，结合基于物理信息的概率逆模型（融合物理引导输入特征的高斯过程）与融合不确定性及应变/应变率限制的三态风险监测器，在无需标注故障样本的情况下，实现高拟合精度（R² 0.90-0.95，RMSE 0.15%-0.26%）与高可靠性（96%经验覆盖率对95%目标，捕获95%超范围及100%异常工况）。
AI.motivation: 软压阻应变传感器虽具柔顺性，但其电阻响应具有非线性和迟滞特性，且可能被推至标定工作空间之外或在内部异常工作，导致误差传入决策或控制环路。现有概率回归器虽能跟踪置信度，却忽略工作范围限制——当传感器读数来自允许范围之外或内部失效时，预测均值仍可能看似正常，使"高置信度估计"不等于"可信估计"，且软材料难以收集标注失效样本。
AI.method: 提出可靠性框架：(1) 构建基于物理引导输入特征的物理信息概率逆模型（高斯过程回归）进行应变估计；(2) 设计一个风险因子，将模型不确定性与应变和应变率限制相融合，输出三态监测器（正常/超范围/异常）；该框架无需任何标注故障样本即可运行。
AI.result: 在Nitinol（镍钛）丝和镀银聚酰胺线上测试，拟合分数提升至0.90-0.95（RMSE 0.26%-0.15%），经验覆盖率达96%（目标95%）；监测器在标称工况下保持可靠，捕获95%超范围条件和100%异常条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架使传感器在报告估计值的同时报告置信度与可靠性状态，系统在读数超出可信范围时可主动抑制动作而非盲目执行，从而提升软传感系统的整体安全性与可信度，且免除了对难以获取的标注失效数据的依赖。

title: Generative Learning of Separatrices
summary:
The identification and reconstruction of the boundaries separating basins of attraction in multistable, multidimensional dynamical systems presents a fundamental challenge in computational dynamics. These structures govern transition pathways and other important large timescale behavior, yet they remain typically under-sampled since their neighborhood does not get routinely visited during direct simulations. Traditional computational approaches face computational limitations in high-dimensional systems and require a priori knowledge of the dynamical system and its equations. Simplistic sampling methods such as random or uniform sampling of the phase space typically fail to quantitatively approximate separatrices and their structure altogether.
  We introduce and implement a framework that combines supervised classification with generative modeling to address this challenge. Our approach first trains neural network classifiers on uniformly or randomly sampled initial conditions labeled by their corresponding basins of attraction in the system of interest. Using uncertainty metrics of the trained classifier to quantify decision boundaries, the method then identifies these high uncertainty regions and boundaries of the classifier as preliminary approximate separatrices. Subsequently, score-based generative models are trained specifically on samples from high-uncertainty regions, ultimately generating densities of samples consistent with the empirical density of samples on or close to the manifold that constitutes the separatrix between basins in the sampled region. This approach leverages the complementary strengths of (a) discriminative models for global phase space partitioning and (b) generative models for detailed geometric sampling, resulting in a systematic, iterative, data-driven framework that produces empirically consistent reconstructions of (approximate) separatrix manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合监督分类与生成模型的框架，用于重建多稳态动力系统中吸引盆地的分界流形（separatrix）。该方法首先用神经网络分类器对相空间样本进行分类，利用分类器的不确定性度量识别高不确定性区域作为初步分界线，随后在這些区域上训练基于评分的生成模型，以生成与分界线流形上经验密度一致的样本，实现迭代式、数据驱动的分界面重建。
AI.motivation: 多稳态高维动力系统中吸引盆地边界的识别与重建是计算动力学的基本挑战。这些结构支配着转变路径等大时间尺度行为，但由于直接模拟中分界面邻域很少被访问而采样不足。传统方法在高维系统中面临计算瓶颈，且需要先验的动力学方程知识；简单的随机或均匀采样方法无法定量逼近分界面及其结构。
AI.method: 框架分两步：(1) 在均匀或随机采样的初始条件上训练神经网络分类器，根据吸引盆地标签对相空间进行全局划分；利用分类器的不确定性度量（如softmax概率熵或深度集成方差）量化决策边界，识别高不确定性区域作为初步的近似分界面。(2) 专门在高不确定性区域上训练基于评分的生成模型（score-based generative models），生成与分界面附近经验密度一致的样本点，从而精细重建分界流形的几何结构。该方法通过迭代方式结合判别模型的全局划分能力和生成模型的局部精细采样能力。
AI.result: 该框架能够在不依赖动力学方程解析知识的前提下，系统性地产生与经验一致的（近似）分界流形重建结果。通过判别模型与生成模型的互补结合，克服了传统方法在高维系统中的计算局限，并优于随机/均匀采样无法定量逼近分界面的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了判别式模型（全局相空间划分）与生成式模型（局部几何精细采样）互补结合的有效性，为多稳态高维动力系统的分界面重建提供了一种系统化、迭代式、完全数据驱动的计算框架。

title: DualMiT-Net: Local-Global Transformer-Convolutional Fusion for Breast Mass Segmentation in Mammographic Regions of Interest
summary: Breast mass segmentation is an important step in computer-aided mammography, but it remains difficult because masses can have low contrast, irregular shapes, and boundaries that blend with surrounding breast tissue. To address this problem, we present DualMiT-Net, a dual-branch network that uses both a focused view of the mass and a wider view of the surrounding tissue. The local branch uses a Mix Transformer (MiT-B5) encoder to learn mass shape, texture, and boundary information, while the global branch uses an EfficientNet-B5 encoder to learn surrounding breast context. Features from the two branches are shared at the deeper encoder levels and are then progressively fused in a single decoder. A spatial gate controls how much global information is added during decoding. We also evaluated four input representations and selected a percentile-windowed mammogram combined with a Gabor texture response. The model was trained and evaluated on the mass subset of the Curated Breast Imaging Subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography (CBIS-DDSM) using a patient-level split. Across three training runs, DualMiT-Net with exponential moving average weights achieved a mean Dice coefficient of 0.9375 and a mean Intersection over Union of 0.8834. It also achieved better Dice and IoU scores than six standard encoder-decoder baselines trained using the same data and training settings. These results show that combining local mass information with wider breast context can provide accurate and consistent breast mass segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出DualMiT-Net，一种双分支网络用于乳腺肿块分割。局部分支使用MiT-B5编码器学习肿块形状、纹理和边界信息，全局分支使用EfficientNet-B5编码器学习周围乳腺组织背景。通过空间门控在解码阶段渐进融合两个分支的特征，在CBIS-DDSM数据集上取得0.9375的Dice系数和0.8834的IoU，优于六种标准编码器-解码器基线。
AI.motivation: 乳腺肿块分割是计算机辅助乳腺X线摄影中的重要步骤，但由于肿块往往具有低对比度、不规则形状、边界与周围乳腺组织融合等特点，分割难度较大。现有方法难以同时兼顾肿块局部细节和周围组织背景信息，因此需要一种能融合局部精细特征与全局上下文信息的网络架构。
AI.method: DualMiT-Net采用双分支架构：局部分支使用Mix Transformer（MiT-B5）编码器学习肿块的形状、纹理和边界信息；全局分支使用EfficientNet-B5编码器学习周围乳腺组织背景。两个分支在深层编码器层共享特征，并在单一解码器中渐进融合。空间门控机制控制解码过程中全局信息的加入量。此外，评估了四种输入表示，最终选用百分位窗口化乳腺X线图像结合Gabor纹理响应作为输入。
AI.result: 在CBIS-DDSM肿块子集上，采用患者级划分进行训练和评估。三次训练运行中，使用指数移动平均权重的DualMiT-Net达到平均Dice系数0.9375、平均IoU 0.8834，优于六种在相同数据和训练设置下训练的标准编码器-解码器基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结合局部肿块信息与更广泛的乳腺背景可以有效提升乳腺肿块分割的准确性和一致性，验证了双分支融合架构在该任务中的有效性。

title: ViTaR: Visuo-Tactile Residual Adaptation for Foundation VLA Manipulation
summary: As Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models scale toward real-world deployment, contact-rich manipulation exposes a critical blind spot: these policies encode broad visual-semantic priors yet remain unaware of local contact events, producing identical actions whether contact is established, lost, or destabilized. Existing remedies either modify VLA internals, risking catastrophic forgetting, or demand online reinforcement under near-failure contact conditions. Both grant tactile unbounded influence over action generation, conflicting with the priors that make VLAs generalizable. We introduce ViTaR, which reframes tactile feedback from an action-generating perceptual input to an execution modulator that selects and scales bounded residual corrections atop a frozen VLA, preserving pretrained capabilities by construction. ViTaR decomposes adaptation into two stages: Effect-Guided Modeling determines whether and which correction is locally justified via outcome-grounded preference evidence, and Residual Action Modulation converts this evidence into a residual choice with continuously scaled gain from real-time visuotactile observations. On the UniVTAC benchmark spanning seven contact-rich tasks, ViTaR achieves 61.3% average success, a 30.6 percentage-point improvement over its frozen VLA base that also surpasses purpose-built tactile baselines. Physical-robot experiments confirm that bounded tactile modulation transfers to real sensor noise and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViTaR框架，将触觉反馈从"动作生成型感知输入"重定义为"执行调制器"，在冻结的VLA模型上选择并缩放有界的残差修正，从而在不破坏预训练泛化能力的前提下提升接触丰富操作任务的性能。ViTaR在UniVTAC基准的七个接触丰富任务上取得61.3%平均成功率，比冻结VLA基线提升30.6个百分点，并在真实机器人实验中验证了其迁移动力学的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在接触丰富操作中缺乏局部接触事件感知，无法区分接触建立、丢失或不稳定等状态，导致输出相同动作。现有解决方案要么修改VLA内部结构（有灾难性遗忘风险），要么在接近失败的接触条件下进行在线强化学习。两者的共同问题是赋予触觉对动作生成无限的影响力，这与VLA赖以泛化的先验知识相冲突。
AI.method: ViTaR将触觉反馈的作用从动作生成输入重构为执行调制器，在冻结VLA之上选择和缩放有界的残差修正。框架分为两个阶段：(1) 效果引导建模（Effect-Guided Modeling）：通过结果偏好的证据判断是否需要进行局部修正以及修正何种内容；(2) 残差动作调制（Residual Action Modulation）：将修正证据转化为带连续缩放增益的残差动作选择，该增益由实时视觉-触觉观测驱动。
AI.result: 在UniVTAC基准的七个接触丰富任务上，ViTaR平均成功率达61.3%，较其冻结VLA基线提升30.6个百分点，并超越专门的触觉基线方法。真实机器人实验确认有界触觉调制能够迁移到真实的传感器噪声和动力学环境中。
AI.conclusion: 将触觉从感知输入重构为有界的执行调制器，可以在保留VLA预训练能力的前提下有效增强接触丰富操作的性能，为VLA在物理世界中安全可靠地部署提供了一条可行路径。

title: Iterative Refinement Diffusion for Super-Resolved Data Assimilation of Multiscale Physical Systems
summary: Recovering high-resolution states from sparse, low-resolution observations is a central challenge in scientific machine learning and data assimilation. Classical data assimilation exploits temporal information through forecast-analysis cycles, but often requires repeated access to expensive high-resolution forecast models. Generative super-resolution can recover unresolved structure from coarse observations, but is commonly used as a one-shot mapping that does not fully exploit constraints from past states. We introduce Iterative Refinement (IR), a learned data assimilation framework that combines these perspectives. Instead of performing a single coarse-to-fine reconstruction, IR decomposes the task into resolution-wise forecast-analysis operations across a multiresolution hierarchy. At each stage, a shared neural operator with resolution-dependent spectral mode slicing provides a dynamical prior, while a shared conditional diffusion corrector uses the current coarser-resolution state to produce a refined posterior at the next finer resolution. We evaluate IR on one-dimensional stochastically forced Burgers dynamics and two-dimensional Kraichnan turbulence. On the challenging 256x256 Kraichnan benchmark, IR achieves an RMSE of 0.184 and an SSIM of 0.836, outperforming spectral upsampling, one-shot diffusion super-resolution, enhanced deep super-resolution, and an autoregressive forecaster. On the more constrained Burgers testbed, IR remains competitive with one-shot diffusion, which achieves the lowest RMSE. These results show that one-shot generative reconstruction can be effective for simpler settings, while hierarchical forecast-analysis refinement becomes advantageous in strongly multiscale and underdetermined regimes. Overall, IR combines temporal priors, generative correction, and multiresolution reconstruction for learned data assimilation in complex physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代精炼（Iterative Refinement, IR）框架，将生成式超分辨率与经典数据同化中的预测-分析循环结合，通过多分辨率层级上的神经算子和条件扩散校正器实现从稀疏低分辨率观测恢复高分辨率状态。在256×256 Kraichnan湍流基准上，IR取得RMSE 0.184和SSIM 0.836，优于多种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 经典数据同化依赖高分辨率预报模型且计算昂贵，而生成式超分辨率通常作为一次性映射，未能充分利用历史状态的时序约束。现有方法难以同时兼顾时序信息利用和多尺度结构恢复，特别是在强多尺度和欠定问题中。
AI.method: IR将任务分解为多分辨率层级上的逐分辨率预测-分析操作。每阶段使用带有分辨率相关谱模式切片的共享神经算子作为动力学先验，同时使用共享的条件扩散校正器，利用当前粗分辨率状态生成下一细分辨率的精炼后验分布。
AI.result: 在256×256 Kraichnan湍流基准上，IR的RMSE为0.184、SSIM为0.836，优于谱上采样、一次性扩散超分辨率、增强深度超分辨率和自回归预测器。在一维Burgers动力学上，IR与取得最低RMSE的一次性扩散方法表现相当。在简单场景中一次性生成重构有效，而在强多尺度与欠定问题中层级式预测-分析精炼更具优势。
AI.conclusion: IR成功融合了时序先验、生成式校正和多分辨率重构，为复杂物理系统中的学习型数据同化提供了有效框架。结果表明层级式预测-分析精炼在强多尺度和欠定场景中优于一次性生成方法，而简单场景下一次性生成重构仍具竞争力。

title: Geometry-Calibrated Closed-Form Shrinkage for SAR Despeckling
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is an inverse-recovery problem in which multiplicative non-Gaussian noise must be suppressed without erasing scattering structures. We revisit a nonlocal sparse estimator that applies a log--Yeo--Johnson transformation, stacks similar patches into groups, codes each group on its own left singular basis, and shrinks the resulting coefficients. Three quantities usually treated as tunable are shown to be fixed by this construction. First, the group dictionary is orthonormal, so the weighted Lasso admits an exact coefficient-wise soft-threshold solution: the iterative inner solver is unnecessary, and the two apparent weighting matrices are the numerator and denominator of a single threshold field rather than independent modules. Second, because the dictionary is estimated from the noisy group itself, its retained subspace absorbs speckle in proportion to the group aspect ratio $γ=p^2/K$; a random-matrix argument converts the corresponding regularization constant into a geometry-calibrated correction and collapses patch size, group size, and shrinkage scale into one analytically determined degree of freedom. Third, singular projection makes the coefficient noise nearly Gaussian at every tested look number, which locates the point at which an exact speckle likelihood ceases to be informative. The resulting estimator is deterministic, training-free, and applies one set of analytically determined settings to every image and sensor. It ranks first in 18 of 24 PSNR/SSIM comparisons against twelve published methods on three synthetic benchmarks, and attains the lowest mean deviation of the ratio image from the theoretical speckle model over six real-SAR configurations from five sensors. Code is available \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/Geometry-Calibrated-Closed-Form-Shrinkage-for-SAR-Despeckling}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了一种基于非局部稀疏估计的SAR去斑方法，证明了三个通常需要调参的量其实由该方法的结构自动确定：正交字典使加权Lasso退化为精确的系数级软阈值解；基于随机矩阵理论可将正则化常数转化为由组纵横比校准的几何修正；奇异投影使系数噪声近似高斯分布。最终得到一个确定性、免训练、全分析设定的估计器，在24个PSNR/SSIM对比中18个排名第一。
AI.motivation: SAR去斑是一个逆恢复问题，需要在抑制乘性非高斯噪声的同时保留散射结构。现有方法通常包含多个需要手工调参的超参数（如正则化权重、字典选择、收缩尺度），缺乏理论指导。作者希望证明一个特定的非局部稀疏估计器中这些参数并非自由变量，而是由方法的结构（正交字典、奇异基投影、组纵横比）内在决定的，从而得到一个无调参、可解析确定的估计器。
AI.method: 方法基于log-Yeo-Johnson变换，将相似块堆叠成组，在每组的左奇异基上编码并对系数进行收缩。作者通过三个关键理论分析确立参数自动确定：(1) 组字典天然正交，使加权Lasso的迭代求解不必要，两个权重矩阵实为同一阈值场的分子分母；(2) 用随机矩阵理论证明字典保留子空间吸收散斑噪声与纵横比γ=p²/K成正比，从而将正则化常数转化为几何校准修正，把块大小、组大小和收缩尺度合并为单一解析自由度；(3) 奇异投影使系数噪声在不同look数下近似高斯，确定了精确散斑似然失效的临界点。
AI.result: 该估计器是确定性的、免训练且无需人工调参。在三个合成基准上对12种已发表方法进行24组PSNR/SSIM对比中，18组排名第一；在来自5个传感器的6个真实SAR配置上，其比值图像与理论散斑模型的平均偏差最低。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析揭示非局部稀疏去斑估计器中三个表观自由参数实际上被构造本身固定，从而将参数调整空间压缩为一个解析确定的几何校准自由度，实现了真正"可复现、零调参"的SAR去斑，并在合成与真实数据上均取得领先性能。

title: Scaling Manual-Grounded Appliance Manipulation with Data Synthesis and Unified Planning
summary: Operating household appliances requires long-horizon planning that is state-dependent and robust to disturbances, yet existing large models fall short, as no sufficiently diverse, task-oriented dataset exists to support such planning. To bridge this gap, we propose MAGE, a scalable data synthesis pipeline that introduces a novel Hierarchical Appliance Graph (HAG) to automatically generate part grounding, long-horizon planning, and closed-loop recovery data from appliance manuals. With MAGE, we build UseAppliance, the first large-scale dataset for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning, spanning 22 appliance categories with 89K+ part annotations, 53K+ manipulation tasks, and 33K+ closed-loop adjustment steps. Built on UseAppliance, we develop AppliancePlan, an end-to-end model for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning. On RealAppliance-Bench, AppliancePlan with only 7B parameters achieves over 10x the best baseline on open-loop planning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across all tasks. Real-robot experiments on six household appliances further confirm effective sim-to-real transfer, marking an important step toward general-purpose household robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAGE数据合成流水线，基于层级家电图谱（HAG）从说明书自动生成部件标注、长程规划与闭环恢复数据，构建首个大规模家电操作规划数据集UseAppliance（22类家电、89K+部件标注、53K+操作任务、33K+闭环调整步骤）。基于此开发7B参数的AppliancePlan模型，在RealAppliance-Bench上开环规划性能超过最佳基线10倍以上，并在真实机器人实验中验证了有效的仿真到真实迁移。
AI.motivation: 操作家用电器需要依赖状态的长程规划并具备抗干扰能力，但现有大模型在此方面表现不足，根本原因是缺乏足够多样化、面向任务的数据集来支撑此类规划学习。
AI.method: 提出MAGE可扩展数据合成流水线，核心创新为层级家电图谱（HAG），可从电器说明书中自动生成三类数据：部件级grounding、长程规划数据、闭环恢复数据。基于此构建UseAppliance大规模数据集，并训练端到端模型AppliancePlan用于说明书驱动的家电操作规划。
AI.result: AppliancePlan仅用7B参数，在RealAppliance-Bench的开环规划任务上超过最佳基线10倍以上，并在所有任务上一致超越最先进模型。在六个真实家用电器上的机器人实验进一步验证了有效的仿真到真实迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作填补了家电操作规划领域大规模数据集的空白，证明了以说明书为知识来源的数据合成与端到端模型相结合是实现通用家用机器人操作规划的有效路径，是迈向通用家庭机器人服务的重要一步。

title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research
summary: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and required count at each level; a hierarchy with n companies, m employees per company, and k sources per employee requires n x m x k records. This structure supports diverse workflows such as market mapping, due diligence, literature review, product comparison, and talent sourcing, with targets ranging from dozens to thousands of records. WANDR replaces static gold answer sets with task-specific judges that refetch cited pages and verify each record against its evidence, allowing evaluation of current and changing facts. Record verdicts are aggregated into soft and hard precision, recall, and F1 scores that distinguish factual quality, coverage, and hierarchical completeness. The tasks are derived from de-identified product-usage logs and produced through a semi-automated pipeline with automated checks, empirical audits, and human review where needed. We evaluate six production research systems and find that the benchmark is far from saturated: at high effort, the strongest system reaches only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1. Performance degrades as target volume and hierarchy depth increase, with incomplete discovery, missing enrichment, and incomplete evidence construction remaining major bottlenecks. The benchmark and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/perplexityai/wandr.

AI.tldr: WANDR是一个包含500个真实且具有挑战性的数据收集任务的研究智能体基准测试，每个任务要求系统在广度上发现大量符合标准的实体、在深度上通过多次协调的网页搜索调查每个实体，并返回带有可核实来源和摘录的记录。任务以资格键层级表示，评估采用任务特定裁判而非静态金标准答案集，通过软/硬精度、召回率和F1分数来衡量。在六个生产研究系统的评估中，最强系统仅达到0.363软F1和0.133硬F1，表明该基准远未饱和。
AI.motivation: 现有研究智能体基准测试通常局限于简单的单轮问答或静态答案集，无法反映真实世界中进行深度、多层次的网络数据收集任务的复杂性。研究需要覆盖大量实体、多源交叉验证、可验证证据链的真实场景基准，以推动研究智能体在广度覆盖、深度调查和证据构建方面的发展。
AI.method: 构建500个真实数据收集任务的基准WANDR，任务以资格键层级表示（n家公司→m名员工→k个来源，共nxmxk条记录）。不同于静态金标准答案集，WANDR使用任务特定裁判重新抓取引用页面并验证每条记录与证据，聚合出软/硬精度、召回率和F1分数。任务通过半自动流水线从去标识化产品使用日志中生成，包含自动化检查、实证审计和人工审查。评价了六个生产研究系统。
AI.result: 在高强度设置下，最强系统仅达到0.363软F1和0.133硬F1，表明基准远未饱和。性能随目标数量和层级深度增加而下降，实体发现不完整、信息丰富度不足和证据构建不完全成为主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: WANDR提供了一个具有挑战性且可持续演进的真实研究任务基准，动态裁判机制使其能适应事实变化，当前最强系统与人类水平差距显著，表明研究智能体在广度发现、深度调研和证据构建方面仍有巨大的提升空间。基准和评估工具已开源。

title: Generation of Synthetic Fingerphotos with GANs
summary: Contactless fingerprinting is an emerging approach to biometric authentication that allows users to scan their fingerprints without touching a scanner. Due to the limited amount of contactless fingerprint data available and the security risks associated with sharing real individuals' fingerprints, it is valuable to explore methods of generating synthetic data that can be used in place of - or in conjunction with - real data to develop and evaluate contactless fingerprinting systems. In this paper, we present and evaluate synthetic fingerphotos generated using StyleGAN2-ADA and StyleGAN3, existing image generation architectures. We evaluate the realism, privacy preservation, and variety of the synthetic fingerphotos by comparing their biometric feature statistics to those of real fingerphotos, computing match scores between real and synthetic fingerphotos, and computing match scores between different synthetic fingerphotos. This paper provides a quantitative comparison point for future evaluations of synthetic fingerphotos. The evaluation code is made available at https://github.com/cmillerlynch/fingerphoto-gan.

AI.tldr: 本文使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3两种生成架构生成合成非接触式指纹照片（fingerphotos），并通过真实性、隐私保护和多样性三个维度对合成数据进行定量评估，为未来合成指纹照片的评估提供了量化基准。
AI.motivation: 非接触式指纹识别是一种新兴的生物识别认证方式，但由于真实非接触指纹数据量有限且共享真实指纹存在隐私安全风险，因此有必要探索生成合成数据的方法，以替代或补充真实数据用于开发和评估非接触式指纹识别系统。
AI.method: 使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3两种图像生成架构生成合成指相照片；通过比较合成与真实指纹照片的生物特征统计量来评估真实性；通过计算真实与合成指纹照片之间的匹配分数来评估隐私保护程度；通过计算不同合成指纹照片之间的匹配分数来评估多样性。
AI.result: 本文对合成非接触式指纹照片在真实性、隐私保护和多样性三个维度上的表现进行了定量评估，提供了可用于未来合成指纹照片评估的量化对比基准，并公开了评估代码。
AI.conclusion: StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3能够用于生成合成非接触式指纹照片，本文的定量评估框架为后续研究提供了可复用的比较基准，有助于在保护隐私的前提下推进非接触式指纹识别技术的发展。

title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become a dominant paradigm for generalist embodied agents, demonstrating strong complex and long-horizon task completion in structured settings. Yet it remains an open question whether current VLA systems can benefit from more effective architectural design, scale to substantially larger and more heterogeneous data regimes, and achieve broader generalization across tasks and embodiments. To this end, we present GigaBrain-0.7, an embodied foundation model with substantially improved generalization across diverse robot embodiments. Specifically, GigaBrain-0.7 unifies understanding, prediction, and action through a three-system architecture, scales pretraining to over 37,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, and introduces one-stage alignment training that jointly optimizes vision-language understanding and multi-embodiment action generation. Compared with the preceding GigaBrain-0 series and prior state-of-the-art models including $π_{0.5}$, GigaBrain-0.7 achieves substantial improvements in foundation zero-shot capabilities, language-conditioned instruction following, and post-training task success rates. In particular, on our in-house Maker H01 platform and mainstream robot embodiments, GigaBrain-0.7 demonstrates strong task adaptability and completion ability across both home and industrial scenarios. All training code and pretrained model weights will be released.

AI.tldr: GigaBrain-0.7是一个面向多样化机器人本体的具身基础模型，通过三系统架构统一理解、预测与动作，在超过37,000小时的异构具身数据上预训练，并引入单阶段对齐训练，在零样本能力、语言指令跟随和任务成功率上显著超越前代GigaBrain-0系列及π₀.₅等SOTA模型。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型在结构化环境中虽表现良好，但尚未明确是否能通过更有效的架构设计、更大规模异构数据以及跨任务、跨本体的泛化来获得进一步提升。作者旨在探索这些开放问题，构建一个跨多种机器人本体泛化能力显著增强的具身基础模型。
AI.method: 采用三系统架构统一理解、预测和动作生成；在超过37,000小时的异构具身数据上进行大规模预训练；引入单阶段对齐训练，联合优化视觉语言理解与多本体动作生成。
AI.result: 相比前代GigaBrain-0系列及π₀.₅等SOTA模型，GigaBrain-0.7在基础零样本能力、语言条件指令跟随和任务成功率上均获得显著提升；在自研Maker H01平台及主流机器人本体上展现出较强的任务适应性和完成能力，覆盖家庭与工业场景。
AI.conclusion: GigaBrain-0.7验证了更有效的三系统架构、大规模异构预训练数据及单阶段对齐训练能够有效提升VLA模型的多本体泛化能力，并将在家庭与工业场景中展现出广泛适用性。训练代码与预训练权重将全部开源。

title: Real-Time State-of-Health Estimation and Online Degradation Prognosis from Partial Battery Discharge Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: With the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems have become essential, making the accurate estimation of their State of Health (SOH) and degradation behavior critical. In this work, we propose a physics-informed deep learning approach for lithium-ion battery SOH prediction using incomplete discharge curves extracted from arbitrary voltage ranges, thereby reflecting realistic and heterogeneous operating conditions. The proposed method combines data-driven learning with physically motivated degradation dynamics to ensure consistent and reliable SOH estimation from partial discharge information, achieving a MAPE below 4$\%$. In addition, a real-time degradation trend estimation strategy is introduced to detect key aging transitions without requiring prior knowledge or historical data, making it applicable to a wide range of batteries. Overall, our approach enables SOH estimation from arbitrary discharge segments and a real-time degradation forecast that continuously integrates all usage, overcoming previous methods that rely on fixed protocols or early, non-adaptive predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理信息深度学习方法来预测锂离子电池的健康状态（SOH），可利用任意电压范围内的不完整放电曲线进行估计，MAPE低于4%；同时引入实时退化趋势估计策略，无需先验知识即可检测关键老化转变。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源的大规模并网，储能系统变得至关重要，精确估计电池SOH和退化行为变得尤为关键。传统方法依赖固定协议或早期非自适应预测，无法适应真实世界中异构、多变的运行条件。
AI.method: 采用物理信息深度学习框架，将数据驱动学习与物理启发的退化动力学相结合，利用从任意电压范围提取的不完整放电曲线进行SOH估计；同时提出实时退化趋势估计策略，用于检测关键老化转变点。
AI.result: 在部分放电信息条件下实现了MAPE低于4%的SOH估计精度；实时退化趋势估计能够检测关键老化转变，无需先验知识或历史数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可从任意放电片段估计SOH，并提供持续整合所有使用情况的实时退化预测，克服了以往依赖固定协议或早期非自适应预测方法的局限性，适用于广泛的电池类型。

title: MOSS-VL Technical Report
summary: We present MOSS-VL, an open vision-language model family that treats real-time interaction -- perceiving while it speaks -- as a first-class capability. It is co-designed across the stack: the language decoder attends to vision only through gated cross-attention, so the model can naturally see incoming frames while generating; a synthesized interaction corpus supervises when to speak, when to stay silent, and when to revise; and a staged curriculum concentrates all real-time-specific training in one light final stage over a strong offline foundation. Offline, MOSS-VL-Instruct is competitive at comparable scale and leads temporal-reasoning video sets. Across four streaming benchmarks, MOSS-VL-Realtime posts the best average on three (second on the fourth) among open-source streaming models, sweeping the three subsets that squarely test proactive behavior -- 66.0 vs. 37.5 for the best baseline on OmniMMI Proactive Alerting.
