With 11.3B parameters but visual tokens outside the decoded sequence, MOSS-VL widens its time-to-first-token advantage over same-backbone Qwen3-VL-8B from 2.8x to 5.1x as visual context grows. We release all five checkpoints, the training curriculum, and the real-time inference code at https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-VL.

AI.tldr: MOSS-VL 是一个开源的视觉语言模型家族，将实时交互（边感知边说话）作为一等能力进行设计。通过门控交叉注意力让语言解码器在生成时自然感知视觉输入，配合合成交互语料和分级课程训练，在离线任务上与同规模模型竞争，在流式基准上表现优异（4个基准中3个最佳），且通过将视觉token置于解码序列之外，显著扩大了首token延迟优势（2.8x提升至5.1x）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型大多将"看到-思考-回答"视为分离的步骤，缺乏在生成过程中持续感知视觉流的能力，难以胜任实时对话、主动提醒等交互场景。作者希望通过全栈协同设计，使模型将实时交互作为一等的、原生的能力而不是后加的扩展。
AI.method: 方法包含三个关键组件：(1) 架构层面——语言解码器仅通过门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）关注视觉信息，使模型在生成文本时能自然接收新到达的视觉帧；(2) 数据层面——合成交互语料监督模型何时该说话、何时保持沉默、何时修正已有表述；(3) 训练层面——分级课程设计，将全部实时交互特定训练集中在一个轻量的最终阶段，建立在强离线基座之上，不伤害离线能力。
AI.result: 离线方面，MOSS-VL-Instruct在同等规模下具有竞争力，并在时间推理视频数据集上领先。流式方面，在4个流式基准中平均成绩3个最佳（第4个排第二），全面领先主动行为相关测试集——在OmniMMI主动提醒子集上达到66.0 vs 最佳基线37.5。以11.3B参数量且视觉token位于解码序列之外的设计，相比相同骨干的Qwen3-VL-8B，首token延迟优势从2.8倍扩大到5.1倍。
AI.conclusion: MOSS-VL证明了将实时交互作为一等能力进行全栈协同设计是可行且有效的：它既能保持离线任务的竞争力，又显著提升了在线流式场景的表现和推理效率。作者开源了全部5个检查点、训练课程和实时推理代码，推动领域进一步发展。

title: Grouping Auction-Consensus Algorithm for Decentralized Task Allocation in Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Decentralized multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) is essential for scalable and resilient autonomous systems. The Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm (CBBA) is a widely adopted decentralized baseline. However, its individual task-level bidding is poorly aligned with the min-sum objective of minimizing total team travel distance, leading to suboptimal allocations in spatially distributed environments. This paper introduces the Grouping Auction-Consensus Algorithm (GACA). This decentralized MRTA framework adopts the two-phase auction-consensus architecture of CBBA while fundamentally redesigning its bidding mechanism to reason over groups of spatially proximate tasks. A nearest-neighbor preprocessing step partitions tasks into spatially coherent groups before allocation. Agents then iteratively propose structured group-level actions: claiming unassigned groups, acquiring partial groups, or contesting groups held by other agents. Competing actions are resolved through a consensus phase. Operating in the MT-SR-IA problem class, GACA is evaluated against CBBA using a Mixed-Integer Linear Program as the ground-truth optimality reference. Across four swarm sizes and 4,000 test worlds, GACA achieves a median percent optimality of approximately 97% compared to 81--84% for CBBA, while converging in equal or fewer iterations. A scalability evaluation over 3,280 additional problem instances spanning swarm sizes of 5 to 20 agents and task counts of 10 to 50 confirms that these gains generalize robustly across a wide range of problem configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分组拍卖-共识算法（GACA），一种基于CBBA架构的分布式多机器人任务分配框架。GACA通过最近邻预处理将任务分区为空间连贯的分组，并在拍卖阶段引入分组级动作（认领、部分获取、竞争），显著提升了求解质量。在4,000个测试世界中，GACA的中位数最优性约97%，远超CBBA的81-84%，且在更多规模的实例上验证了其泛化性。
AI.motivation: CBBA作为广泛采用的分布式任务分配基线，其逐任务的独立竞标机制与最小化总队旅行距离的min-sum目标不一致，在空间分布环境下容易产生次优分配。因此需要一种在保持CBBA分布式架构优势的同时，能更好地对齐min-sum目标的投标机制。
AI.method: GACA采用与CBBA相同的两阶段拍卖-共识架构，但从根本上重新设计了投标机制：1）最近邻预处理将任务划分为空间连贯的分组；2）智能体通过迭代提出结构化分组级动作，包括认领未分配分组、获取部分分组、竞争其他智能体持有的分组；3）通过共识阶段解决冲突。问题定位于MT-SR-IA问题类别。
AI.result: 在4,000个测试世界中（四种群体规模），GACA中位数最优性约为97%，而CBBA为81-84%，且GACA收敛迭代数等于或少于CBBA。在额外的3,280个实例（5-20个智能体，10-50个任务）中验证了这些增益在不同问题配置下的稳健泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将投标粒度从单个任务提升到空间分组的任务集合，GACA显著提升了分布式MRTA的求解最优性，同时保持了CBBA的分布式架构优势和相等或更快的收敛速度，在广泛的规模范围内展现出稳健性能。

title: ER-KANs: Efficient and Robust Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Data-Scarce Scientific Machine Learning
comment: 22 pages, 20 figures, 8 tables; code and data at https://github.com/harshillodhiya/ER-KANs
summary:
The efficient-KAN literature---covering Chebyshev, wavelet, and radial-basis-function variants of the original Kolmogorov-Arnold Network---has been benchmarked almost entirely on clean data. We show that this choice conceals a large capability difference between architectures: ChebyKAN's test MSE (evaluated against clean ground truth) increases by a factor of 10.6x when training data is corrupted with sigma=0.1 noise, versus 7.9x for vanilla KAN, 1.7x for a standard MLP, and just 1.4x for our proposed ER-KAN.
  ER-KAN combines three design choices targeting the noisy, data-scarce setting: shared Gaussian RBF bases across all edges in a layer (providing locality and efficient parameterisation), curriculum noise injection during training (explicitly teaching noise robustness), and entropy-weighted adaptive regularisation (preventing overfitting at small N). The result is a 595-parameter network that matches MLP accuracy at moderate noise while degrading far more gracefully as noise grows.
  We evaluate on eight analytic functions (N in {50, 200, 500}, sigma in {0, 0.03, 0.1}), on a damped harmonic oscillator physics-informed neural network where ER-KAN achieves 4.2x lower solution MSE than MLP, and on a Burgers' equation PINN where all models fail to converge---a genuine limitation we report rather than suppress. We introduce the noise degradation ratio as a simple complementary metric and recommend it become a standard reporting requirement for efficient-KAN papers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有效率KAN文献几乎全部在干净数据上评测，掩盖了不同架构在噪声下的巨大能力差异。作者提出ER-KAN，通过共享高斯RBF基、课程噪声注入和熵加权自适应正则化三个设计选择，在噪声数据和小样本场景下显著优于ChebyKAN、vanilla KAN和MLP，并引入噪声退化比作为标准评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有高效KAN（Chebyshev、wavelet、RBF等变体）的基准测试几乎全部基于干净数据，这掩盖了不同架构在含噪数据下的能力差异。在sigma=0.1噪声下，ChebyKAN的测试MSE退化10.6倍而MLP仅1.7倍，表明该领域需要一个针对噪声、数据稀缺场景的鲁棒架构。
AI.method: ER-KAN包含三个核心设计：1) 层内所有边共享高斯RBF基函数，提供局部性和高效参数化；2) 训练期间注入课程式噪声，显式教导模型噪声鲁棒性；3) 熵加权的自适应正则化，在小样本N下防止过拟合。模型仅595个参数。
AI.result: 在8个解析函数上（N∈{50,200,500}，sigma∈{0,0.03,0.1}），ER-KAN在中等噪声下匹配MLP精度，噪声增大时退化更平缓（退化比1.4x vs ChebyKAN的10.6x、vanilla KAN的7.9x、MLP的1.7x）。在阻尼谐振子PINN上实现比MLP低4.2x的解MSE；在Burgers方程PINN上所有模型均不收敛（如实报告）。
AI.conclusion: 噪声场景下架构间能力差异巨大，ER-KAN通过特定设计组合实现了对噪声的优雅退化。作者提出噪声退化比作为简单互补指标，建议将其列为高效KAN论文的标准报告要求；同时诚实报告了Burgers方程上的失败案例。

title: Frequency and Edge-Guided Segment Anything Model for Remote Sensing Image Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE TGRS 2026
summary: Remote sensing image semantic segmentation (RSISS) has attracted significant attention due to the growing demand for fine-grained land cover information. The Segment Anything Model (SAM), proposed as a foundation vision model, offers strong segmentation performance and generalization capabilities for RSISS tasks. However, existing SAM-based approaches face two limitations: (1) Insufficient adaptation of SAM's features to the diverse characteristics of land cover types. (2) Semantic ambiguity at object boundaries, which hinders accurate delineation. To address these limitations, we propose Frequency and Edge-guided SAM (FE-SAM), a scalable and efficient framework for RSISS. Specifically, we introduce a Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA) that adaptively decomposes and modulates frequency-domain features based on the input data. It selectively enhances informative high- and low-frequency components corresponding to different land cover types. Furthermore, to improve SAM's ability to capture fine-grained details, we design EGRefiner, which integrates multi-scale edge-enhanced information extracted from the input image. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that FE-SAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The source codes are available at: https://github.com/oucailab/FE-SAM.

AI.tldr: 提出FE-SAM框架，通过频率调制适配器（FMA）自适应分解和调节频域特征以适配不同地物类型，并结合边缘增强细化器（EGRefiner）整合多尺度边缘信息以解决目标边界语义模糊问题，在三个基准数据集上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SAM的遥感图像语义分割方法存在两个局限：(1) SAM的特征难以充分适配不同地物类型的多样特性；(2) 目标边界处的语义模糊问题阻碍了精确的边界描绘。本文旨在解决这两大缺陷。
AI.method: 提出FE-SAM框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA)，根据输入数据自适应地分解和调制频域特征，选择性地增强对应不同地物类型的高频和低频信息分量；(2) EGRefiner，整合从输入图像提取的多尺度边缘增强信息，提升SAM捕获细粒度细节的能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FE-SAM的性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: FE-SAM作为一种可扩展且高效的遥感图像语义分割框架，通过频率调制和边缘引导有效地提升了SAM在RSISS任务中的性能，解决了特征适配不足和边界语义模糊两大问题。

title: Tactile Sim2Real without Tactile Simulation via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction
summary: Robot sensor designs, particularly tactile sensors, are highly diverse and evolve rapidly. Modeling each sensor in simulation demands substantial domain expertise and computational approximations can degrade the fidelity of the simulated signals. We propose Sim2Real via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction (SBLR), a framework that avoids sensor-specific simulation entirely by (1) training policies on a simulator-native oracle sensor that is easy to construct without modeling any particular sensor (e.g. we use a point-cloud and finger-tip forces as a tactile oracle), and (2) aligning real sensor latent embeddings to those of the oracle sensor at inference time. Policy training proceeds in two-stage: the policy first learns from the oracle sensor latents, then a bottlenecked latent reconstruction adapts it to the information loss expected when using the real sensor instead of the oracle. The alignment between oracle and real sensor is learned from unpaired random-play data collected in both simulation and the real world, using rectified-flow-based transformation networks trained on nearest-neighbor pseudo-pairs. Simulation experiments on three contact-rich tasks show that SBLR matches or approaches the performance of an oracle with direct access to tactile simulation. Hardware experiments on Peg Insertion and Gear Meshing with GelSight Mini and DIGIT sensors demonstrate 85-97.5% zero-shot success without requiring any sensor-specific modeling or calibration, outperforming a physics-based tactile simulation baseline by 7.5-15%.

AI.tldr: 提出SBLR框架，通过瓶颈潜在重建将真实触觉传感器对齐到模拟器内置的"神谕"传感器，完全避免对具体传感器建模，在三个接触密集型任务中达到或接近神谕性能，硬件实验中实现85-97.5%的零样本成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人触觉传感器种类繁多且迭代迅速，逐一在仿真中建模需要大量专业领域知识，且计算近似会降低仿真信号保真度，导致Sim2Real迁移困难。
AI.method: 整体框架分为两步：一是使用模拟器原生、无需建模具体传感器的"神谕"传感器（如点云+指尖力作为触觉神谕）训练策略；二是在推理时将真实传感器的潜在嵌入对齐到神谕传感器的潜在嵌入。策略训练采用两阶段：先用神谕传感器潜在表示学习策略，再通过瓶颈潜在重建适应真实传感器相对神谕的信息损失。对齐过程利用仿真和真实世界收集的无配对随机操作数据，基于最近邻伪配对构建rectified-flow变换网络进行学习。
AI.result: 在三个接触密集型任务的仿真实验中，SBLR达到或接近直接使用触觉仿真的神谕性能；在GelSight Mini和DIGIT传感器的轴孔插入和齿轮啮合硬件实验中，实现85-97.5%的零样本成功率，无需任何传感器特定建模或标定，比基于物理的触觉仿真基线高出7.5-15%。
AI.conclusion: SBLR证明可以通过潜在空间对齐替代传统的传感器物理仿真，实现跨传感器的Sim2Real迁移，为触觉机器人提供了一种无需传感器特定建模的通用解决方案。

title: p-Spin Glass Network Efficient Single-Batch Continual Learning
summary: Modern sequence models heavily rely on massive memory footprints and large-batch stochastic optimization, barriers that restrict sample efficiency and continual learning. We introduce the $p$-Spin Glass Network, a novel architecture that overcomes these limitations, structurally manages optimization variance and yields four noticeable capabilities: 1. It enforces memory efficiency: native ternary quantization compresses internal parameters by $8\times$, while exact implicit gradients strictly bound activation memory to $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot T \cdot D)$. 2. it demonstrates sample efficiency, matching the asymptotic performance of a Transformer baseline while utilizing $8\times$ fewer training sequences. 3. Method enables single-batch stability and smooth, monotonic convergence at a stochastic micro-batch size of $1$. 4. Finally, this stability proves modality-agnostic, maintaining robust temporal credit assignment across both discrete subword and long horizon uncompressed raw byte streams. Ultimately, this work removes large batch requirement for stable deep learning, establishing a foundation for continuous learning and edge AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出p-Spin Glass Network架构，通过原生三元量化和精确隐式梯度约束内存占用，实现单batch稳定训练，在样本效率上比Transformer基线提升8倍，支持连续学习与边缘AI。
AI.motivation: 现代序列模型依赖大量内存和大型batch随机优化，这限制了样本效率和持续学习能力。作者旨在消除大batch训练的硬性要求，为连续学习和边缘AI奠定基础。
AI.method: 引入p-Spin Glass Network架构：1) 原生三元量化将内部参数压缩8倍，精确隐式梯度将激活内存严格限制为O(B·T·D)；2) 通过结构化管理优化方差实现单batch（微batch大小为1）下的稳定平滑单调收敛；3) 该稳定性具有模态无关性，可同时支持离散子词和未压缩的原始字节流。
AI.result: 1) 内存效率：参数压缩8倍，激活内存界限为O(B·T·D)；2) 样本效率：仅需Transformer基线1/8的训练序列即可匹配其渐近性能；3) 单batch稳定性：微batch大小为1时仍能平滑单调收敛；4) 跨模态稳定：在离散子词和长时域原始字节流上均保持稳健的时间信用分配。
AI.conclusion: 本工作消除了深度学习稳定训练对大batch的需求，为连续学习和边缘AI建立了基础。

title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring
summary: Frame selection is a fundamental component of multimodal large language models, enabling long videos to be processed under limited visual-token and computational budgets. Uniform sampling preserves temporal coverage but may miss informative content that appears only briefly. To alleviate this limitation, query-dependent methods can retrieve question-relevant frames. However, because the selected frames depend on the current question, the same visual input cannot be directly shared across different questions, and frame selection must be repeated in multi-turn video dialogue. This motivates us to seek a query-independent frame selection method that preserves the reusability of a fixed visual input while improving the coverage of informative events beyond uniform sampling. We propose Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring (MEDR), a training-free and query-independent frame selection method. Multi-Signal Event Modeling organizes complementary visual, motion, and text signals into signal-specific temporal events. Dynamic Rescoring then iteratively reevaluates each candidate relative to the current selected set, updating its score according to frame-level signal strength, additional event coverage, and temporal proximity. The resulting fixed frame set is constructed without observing the query and can be reused across different questions. On the standard benchmark evaluations, MEDR improves model accuracy by 0.63%-0.89% on Video-MME. On the long-video subset of LongVideoBench, it improves accuracy by up to 1.23% with Qwen3-VL-8B. MEDR further improves overall accuracy by 0.53%, while reusing exactly the same frame set for every question about a video.

AI.tldr: MEDR是一种无需训练、与查询无关的帧选择方法，通过多信号事件建模和动态重评分来选择固定帧集，与均匀采样相比在视频理解基准上取得了显著提升，同时保持视觉输入的可复用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的帧选择方法存在两难：均匀采样虽保持时间覆盖但会遗漏短暂的包含信息帧；查询依赖方法虽能检索相关问题帧，但选帧需随问题重复执行，无法在多轮视频对话中复用同一固定视觉输入。因此，需要一种同时兼顾信息事件覆盖度和查询无关可复用性的帧选择方法。
AI.method: MEDR包含两个核心组件：1) 多信号事件建模（Multi-Signal Event Modeling），将互补的视觉、运动、文本信号组织成特定信号的时间事件；2) 动态重评分（Dynamic Rescoring），迭代地相对于当前已选帧集重新评估每个候选帧，根据帧级信号强度、额外事件覆盖度和时间邻近度更新打分，最终在未见查询的情况下构建固定帧集。
AI.result: 在标准基准评估中，MEDR在Video-MME上提升模型精度0.63%-0.89%；在LongVideoBench的长视频子集上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B时精度最高提升1.23%；整体精度提升0.53%，且对视频的每个问题复用完全相同的帧集。
AI.conclusion: MEDR证明了无需查询信息即可实现优于均匀采样的事件覆盖，同时保持帧集的固定可复用性，为多轮视频对话场景中的帧选择提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
summary: Large-scale pre-training has made robot policy fine-tuning increasingly data-efficient, but this progress has largely been driven by datasets and embodiments built around simple parallel-jaw grippers. Dexterous, multi-fingered hands remain comparatively data-starved because real teleoperation is costly to scale, while human hand video is off-embodiment and requires lossy pose estimation and retargeting. We introduce Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD), a pre-training framework for dexterous manipulation that uses data entirely collected in simulation. In SPD, humans manipulate virtual objects inside a VR headset, enabling on-embodiment trajectories and robot-free collection. With the help of five operators, we collect 75 hours of multi-task dexterous manipulation over one week, and use it to pre-train a causal transformer on a sequence modeling objective. We study the benefits of simulation pre-training on real-world tasks by fine-tuning on 1-2 hours of physical demonstrations on a 56-DoF bimanual dexterous setup. We find that our approach outperforms training behavior cloning policies from scratch, showing that simulation teleoperation is a viable pre-training source for real-world dexterous manipulation. We perform ablation studies, measuring the benefits of history conditioning and short action chunks for reactive control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模拟预训练（SPD）框架，通过VR头显让人类在仿真环境中操作虚拟物体，收集75小时的多任务灵巧操作数据，用于预训练一个因果Transformer，然后在56自由度双臂真实灵巧操作平台上微调1-2小时的物理演示数据，相比从零训练的行为克隆策略表现更优。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练使机器人策略微调越来越数据高效，但这一进展主要依赖围绕简单平行夹爪构建的数据集和本体。多指灵巧手因真实遥操作扩展成本高、人类手部视频存在跨本体和姿态估计/重定向损失而数据匮乏，需要寻找更高效的预训练数据来源。
AI.method: SPD框架利用VR头显让人类在仿真中操作虚拟物体，收集本体重合（on-embodiment）且无需真实机器人参与的高质量轨迹数据；使用五位操作员一周内收集75小时多任务数据；用序列建模目标预训练因果Transformer；最后在56自由度双臂真实灵巧操作平台上用1-2小时物理演示数据微调，并进行了历史条件与短动作块对反应式控制的消融研究。
AI.result: 在真实世界的灵巧操作任务中，SPD的预训练+微调方法优于从零训练的行为克隆策略，表明仿真遥操作是真实灵巧操作可行的预训练来源。消融实验揭示了历史条件与短动作块对反应式控制的收益。
AI.conclusion: 仿真环境中的遥操作数据可以作为灵巧操作预训练的有效来源，弥补多指灵巧手真实数据匮乏的短板，为灵巧操作领域提供可扩展的数据收集与预训练范式。

title: NRCD: An Open Database of Collegiate Running with Unified Performance Standardization
comment: Accepted to CIKM'26 Resources Paper - Main Conference
summary: Collegiate running in the United States generates thousands of race results annually in cross country and track and field, yet no large-scale dataset has been publicly available for research. Existing websites such as Athletic.net, MileSplit, and TFRRS host results but do not support bulk download, restricting prior analyses to ~500 performances, often skewing studies toward male athletes. We introduce the National Running Club Database (NRCD), the first openly available collegiate running dataset at scale: 128,963 approved performances from 28,913 athletes across 1,336 meets in four sports (cross country (XC), indoor and outdoor track, and road races), 36.3% women, spanning 2004 through 2026. Within that single export, meets from August 2023 onward carry comprehensive course distance, elevation gain and loss, weather at race time, and track venue metadata (97.7% of XC rows with weather fields); earlier seasons back to 2004 are included with sparser metadata. NRCD is community-governed through open submission and expert approval and is maintained as a live database whose meet volume has grown yearly. We release a unified performance standardization framework that operationalizes established distance, elevation, and heat adjustments in one pipeline. Furthermore, we recommend gender-stratified modeling. On XC, full standardization lowers median within-athlete cross-meet variability by 51.0% (women) and 34.4% (men) versus raw times. We release the dataset and pipeline with a python package `nrcd' under FAIR principles, supporting longitudinal athlete modeling, environmental-confounder studies, and gender-equity research in collegiate sport.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个大规模公开的大学跑步数据集NRCD（National Running Database），包含128,963条经批准的跑步成绩，覆盖28,913名运动员、1,336场赛事、四个运动项目（越野、室内外田径、公路跑），时间跨度2004-2026年，其中36.3%为女性运动员。同时发布了一个统一的成绩标准化框架，可整合距离、海拔和温度调整，在越野项目中可将运动员内部跨赛事成绩变异降低51.0%（女性）和34.4%（男性）。数据集和标准化流程以FAIR原则通过Python包`nrcd`发布。
AI.motivation: 美国大学跑步每年产生数千场比赛成绩，但缺乏可供研究的大规模公开数据集。现有网站（Athletic.net、MileSplit、TFRRS）不支持批量下载，以往研究仅局限于约500条成绩且偏向男性运动员，严重制约了纵向运动员建模、环境混杂因素研究和性别平等研究。
AI.method: 构建NRCD数据库：通过社区化治理（开放提交+专家审批）收集128,963条比赛成绩，涵盖四个运动项目，并补充课程距离、海拔升降、比赛时天气和场地元数据。发布统一的成绩标准化框架，将距离、海拔和温度调整整合到单一流水线中，并建议采用按性别分层建模。
AI.result: NRCD为迄今最大规模的公开大学跑步数据集（128,963条成绩，较之前约500条扩大两个数量级）。完整的标准化流程在越野项目中使运动员内部跨赛事成绩变异降低51.0%（女性）和34.4%（男性）；2023年8月以后的比赛有97.7%的越野赛事带完整天气字段。数据库逐年增长且在持续更新。
AI.conclusion: NRCD及其标准化流程以FAIR原则和Python包形式公开发布，为大学体育领域的纵向运动员建模、环境混杂因素研究和性别平等研究提供了大规模数据基础设施，弥补了该领域长期缺乏公开数据集的空白。

title: EgoTac: In-the-wild Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Vision
summary: Touch is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet most egocentric human data increasingly used for robot learning lacks tactile information. Directly collecting large-scale tactile data is challenging due to sensor limitations, while human video data is abundant, contact-rich, and easily scalable. This motivates a natural question: can tactile signals be inferred purely from vision? To address this, we introduce EgoTac, a generalizable model that predicts rich tactile information directly from egocentric human videos. EgoTac is trained on a unified corpus of over 5.7M image-tactile pairs, covering both continuous force measurements and binary contacts. By learning from this diverse dataset, EgoTac captures nuanced touch dynamics across varied interactions. Experiments demonstrate strong performance: in-domain prediction achieves an average force error below 0.06N. On out-of-domain contact prediction benchmarks, EgoTac consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art contact estimator. It also captures the rise and fall patterns of real tactile data and enables zero-shot predictions on unconstrained real-world videos. Scaling analyses further reveal that both data diversity and volume improve performance steadily. Overall, EgoTac provides a scalable pathway to extract tactile priors from egocentric human videos, enabling broadly applicable tactile-aware robot learning.

AI.tldr: EgoTac是一个从第一人称人类视频中直接预测丰富触觉信息（连续力测量和二元接触）的泛化模型，基于超过570万图像-触觉对训练，在域内预测中力误差低于0.06N，在域外接触预测中优于最先进的接触估计器，并能对无约束的真实世界视频进行零样本预测，为机器人学习提供可扩展的触觉先验提取通路。
AI.motivation: 大多数用于机器人学习的以自我为中心的人类数据缺乏触觉信息，而直接大规模采集触觉数据因传感器限制而困难重重；相比之下，人类视频数据丰富、接触密集且易于扩展。因此作者提出一个自然问题：能否仅从视觉中推断触觉信号？
AI.method: EgoTac模型基于超过570万图像-触觉对的统一语料库进行训练，覆盖连续力测量和二元接触两种类型的触觉信号，通过多样化数据学习捕捉不同交互中的细微触觉动态。该模型从第一人称人类视频中直接预测丰富的触觉信息。
AI.result: 域内预测的平均力误差低于0.06N；在域外接触预测基准上持续优于最先进的接触估计器；能够捕捉真实触觉数据的上升和下降模式；支持对无约束真实世界视频的零样本预测；缩放分析显示数据多样性和数据量均能稳步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: EgoTac提供了一条从第一人称人类视频中提取触觉先验的可扩展途径，能够实现广泛适用的触觉感知机器人学习。

title: RAPAC-DP: Response-Aligned Pending-Action Compensation for Diffusion Policies under Delayed Execution
summary: Cloud-side inference gives imitation-learning policies access to greater computational resources, but communication and computation delays can degrade control performance. To compensate for these delays, we propose RAPAC-DP, a response-aligned pending-action compensation framework designed for both diffusion- and flow-based action generators. RAPAC-DP encodes the actions already scheduled for execution before the cloud response arrives into a pending-action sequence that serves as the conditioning input to a parameter-efficient compensation pathway. When delay effects are negligible, bypassing this pathway exactly recovers the frozen base policy. For training, RAPAC-DP constructs delay-conditioned samples from delay-free demonstrations, requiring neither explicit system dynamics nor additional delayed demonstrations. At the largest fixed delay tested on Kinetix, RAPAC-DP retained 81.4% of its overall delay-free performance. At the largest fixed delay tested on each RoboMimic task, it achieved a mean success rate of 0.633 across the three tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pending-action compensation for cloud-deployed imitation-learning policies.

AI.tldr: 提出RAPAC-DP框架，通过将已调度的动作编码为待执行动作序列作为条件输入，补偿云侧推理在通信和计算延迟下对模仿学习策略性能的削弱，在Kinetix和RoboMimic基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 云侧推理虽然能为模仿学习策略提供更强的计算资源，但通信和计算延迟会显著降低控制性能，现有方法缺乏对延迟影响的有效补偿机制。
AI.method: RAPAC-DP框架将云端响应到达前已调度执行的动作编码为待执行动作序列，作为参数高效补偿路径的条件输入。该补偿路径支持扩散模型和流模型两类动作生成器；当延迟可忽略时旁路该路径可精确恢复冻结的基础策略。训练时从无延迟演示中构造延迟条件样本，无需显式系统动力学模型或额外延迟演示。
AI.result: 在Kinetix最大固定延迟下保留81.4%的无延迟性能；在RoboMimic三个任务的最大固定延迟下平均成功率达0.633。
AI.conclusion: 待执行动作补偿对云部署的模仿学习策略在延迟环境下是有效的，RAPAC-DP展示了良好的补偿能力和对冻结基础策略的无损恢复特性。

title: Is Grokking a Loss of Normal Hyperbolicity of the Interpolation Manifold?
summary: A recent line of work recasts the post-memorization phase of grokking as constrained optimization: once a network interpolates the training set, weight decay drives a slow drift along the zero-loss manifold toward lower norm. In the language of dynamical systems, this is a fast-slow system in which the interpolation manifold plays the role of a slow manifold. We ask a question that this framing makes natural but the existing literature does not address: is the sharp generalization transition a loss of normal hyperbolicity of that manifold: a fold- or bifurcation-like event in which a normal restoring direction goes flat? Or does the manifold stay uniformly attracting while generalization happens by smooth drift? We propose a simple, optimizer-agnostic diagnostic: the smallest nonzero singular value $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ of the residual Jacobian, which, for the squared loss, equals the slowest normal restoring rate of the manifold. On a two-layer ReLU network trained to grok modular addition under squared loss, $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ does not collapse at the transition; it is near zero only before memorization and attains its largest values during the transition. The result holds across five seeds, and the six smallest singular values behave identically; there is no subspace-local collapse either. This is preliminary evidence against the bifurcation hypothesis and in favor of the smooth-contraction picture. We are explicit that a single-setting, gradual-transition experiment under Adam optimizer does not prove the absence of a bifurcation; it constrains where one could hide.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入一个与优化器无关的诊断指标——残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min⁺(J)，检验grokking中急剧泛化转变是否源于慢流形失去正常双曲性（分岔事件）。在平方损失下训练的两层ReLU网络（模加法任务）中，该奇异值在转变期并未塌缩，反而达到最大值，初步支持平滑收缩图景而非分岔假说。
AI.motivation: 已有的grokking研究将记忆后阶段刻画为约束优化（沿零损失流形向低范数漂移），但这引出一个自然且尚未被回答的问题：急剧的泛化转变究竟是慢流形正常双曲性丧失（折叠/分岔事件，法向恢复方向变平），还是流形始终保持均匀吸引而泛化由平滑漂移实现。作者希望用简单、优化器无关的诊断来区分这两种机制。
AI.method: 提出残差Jacobian J的最小非零奇异值σ_min⁺(J)作为诊断量；对于平方损失，该值等于流形最慢的法向恢复速率。在两层的ReLU网络（训练grok模加法，平方损失）上追踪此指标，并跨5个种子验证，同时检查六个最小奇异值的整体行为以排除子空间局部塌缩。
AI.result: σ_min⁺(J)在实际转变期并未塌缩：仅在记忆化之前接近零，而在转变期间达到最大值。结果在5个种子上一致，六个最小奇异值行为相同，不存在子空间局部塌缩。这为反对分岔假说、支持平滑收缩图景提供了初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 作者明确承认该实验的局限性：单一设置、渐进式转变且在Adam优化器下，不足以绝对否定分岔的存在，但显著约束了分岔可能隐藏的区域。该诊断提供了区分grokking两种机制的新工具，为后续更全面验证奠定基础。

title: Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and project page: https://github.com/TarunTomar122/attention-is-all-you-need-for-vlms
summary: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] in favor of S4), but A8 recovers it and finishes 0.26 points above S4. Official FineCops levels do not show a monotonic increase in the gap. A4 reduces trainable decoder parameters by 44.4% and cached-decoder latency by 10.1%, although end-to-end latency remains backbone-dominated. These results concern the trainable grounding decoder, not a complete attention-only VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉定位（visual grounding）解码器中前馈网络（FFN）的必要性。在预训练VLM特征上比较四种架构：四块纯注意力解码器（A4）、四块注意力加FFN解码器（S4）、八块纯注意力参数控制（A8）。结果显示A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上表现与S4相当或略优，在FineCops-Ref上A4略逊0.52个百分点（但置信区间接近），而A8超过S4。A4减少44.4%可训练解码器参数和10.1%缓存解码器延迟。
AI.motivation: 探究当预训练视觉语言模型已经编码了图像和语言上下文后，视觉定位解码器中的前馈网络是否仍提供必要的计算，即验证FFN在解码器中的必要性问题。
AI.method: 在冻结的VLM特征上比较三种解码器架构：四块纯注意力（A4）、四块注意力加FFN（S4，参数匹配）、八块纯注意力（A8，参数控制），并在RefCOCOg、Ref-Adv-s和FineCops-Ref三个基准上评估。
AI.result: A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上与S4持平或略优；FineCops-Ref上A4略逊于S4（0.52个百分点，IoU@0.5），但A8超越S4 0.26个百分点。A4将可训练解码器参数减少44.4%，缓存解码器延迟降低10.1%，但端到端延迟仍由主干网络主导。
AI.conclusion: 视觉定位解码器中的前馈网络并非严格必要——纯注意力解码器在多数基准上表现相当，且显著减小参数和延迟。但需注意结论仅限于可训练定位解码器，不适用于完整的纯注意力VLM。

title: Revisiting Open-Loop Execution in Robotics: Toward Reactive, Higher-Performing Policies
summary: Action chunking --- the practice of predicting a sequence of actions and executing a prefix open-loop --- has emerged as a key enabler of recent progress in imitation learning for robotic manipulation. However, executing long open-loop prefixes reduces reactivity, limiting policies' ability to correct for errors. Further, the mechanisms underlying these performance benefits remain poorly understood: prior works cite mitigating compounding errors, absorbing inference latency, or smoothing motions, but provide limited controlled evidence or guidance for preserving reactivity. In this work, we argue that long open-loop execution primarily helps short-context policies imitate "non-Markovian demonstrations". Across four simulation and two real-world tasks, we show that expert non-Markovianity strongly shapes the relationship between task success and open-loop execution horizon. Further, we investigate the impact of compounding errors --- the prevailing explanation for long open-loop execution in prior work --- and find that while they matter, expert non-Markovianity has a much stronger impact in our experimental setting. Finally, we show that when policies are provided with a sufficiently long context, open-loop execution is no longer beneficial and the most reactive, closed-loop policies perform best. While imitation learning has seen great success using long open-loop execution, our findings motivate long-context, reactive policies as a more principled and performant paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了模仿学习中动作分块（action chunking）长开环执行的优势机制，提出其核心作用并非先前认为的缓解复合误差，而是帮助短上下文策略模仿"非马尔可夫演示"。实验表明专家非马尔可夫性对任务成功率与开环执行时长关系的影响远大于复合误差，且当策略具备足够长的上下文时，开环执行不再有益，闭环反应式策略表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 动作分块在机器人操控模仿学习中取得显著进展，但长开环执行降低反应性、限制纠错能力；同时其性能优势的底层机制未被充分理解——先前工作归因于缓解复合误差、吸收推理延迟或平滑运动，但缺乏受控实验证据，也没有为保持反应性提供指导。
AI.method: 通过四个仿真任务和两个真实世界任务，系统性地操控开环执行时域（open-loop execution horizon），对比分析专家非马尔可夫性（expert non-Markovianity）与复合误差（compounding errors）对任务成功率的影响，并考察不同上下文长度的策略在开环与闭环执行下的性能差异。
AI.result: 实验发现：1) 专家非马尔可夫性强烈影响任务成功率与开环执行时域之间的关系；2) 复合误差虽有一定影响，但其效应远弱于专家非马尔可夫性；3) 当策略具备足够长的上下文时，开环执行不再带来收益，闭环反应式策略达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 长开环执行的主要价值在于弥补短上下文策略对非马尔可夫演示的建模不足，而非缓解复合误差。这为模仿学习提供了更具原则性的研究范式：开发长上下文、闭环反应式策略，而非依赖长开环执行。

title: Disentangling Homophily and Rarity: Explaining Failure in Graph Neural Networks
comment: 9 pages of main text, 33 pages total, 11 figures, 17 tables
summary: Are heterophilic nodes in a graph harder to classify because they are heterophilic or because they are rare? Some existing work frames classification of such nodes as a subgroup generalisation problem, where a model performs well on the majority group at the expense of the rare group. Others explain this as a problem of neighbourhood aggregation in graph neural networks (GNNs). We assess these two viewpoints through a detailed evaluation of six GNNs on five datasets of varying homophily, and find that homophilic nodes tend to be easier to classify, even when they are rare---challenging the subgroup framing. However, our findings also nuance existing beliefs about how GNNs misrepresent heterophilic nodes. We demonstrate that the information needed to classify heterophilic nodes correctly is often recoverable by retraining the classification head of a model, or even just the final linear classification layer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比同质性与异质性节点在六个GNN上的分类表现来探究异质性节点难以分类的根本原因。研究发现同质性节点即使数量稀少也更容易分类，但异质性节点所需的信息通常可以通过重新训练分类头或最后一层线性层来恢复。
AI.motivation: 异质性节点在图神经网络中通常更难被正确分类，但现有文献对这一现象有两种不同解释：(1) 视为子群体泛化问题，即模型偏向多数群体而牺牲少数群体；(2) 视为GNN邻域聚合机制的问题。作者希望分辨这两种观点哪个更准确。
AI.method: 对六个GNN模型在五个具有不同同质性水平的数据集上进行详细的系统性评估，通过控制同质性/异质性属性与样本稀有性这两个变量，分离它们各自对分类难度的影响，并采用重新训练分类头（包括仅重新训练最后一层线性分类层）的消融实验来检验信息是否可恢复。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) 同质性节点即使稀有也倾向于更容易分类，这挑战了子群体泛化框架的解释；(2) 异质性节点分类困难并非完全源于GNN邻域聚合导致的信息丢失，因为通过重新训练分类头或仅最后线性层即可恢复大部分所需信息。
AI.conclusion: 异质性节点难以分类的原因既不是简单的子群体稀有性问题，也并非邻域聚合造成了不可恢复的信息损失，而是深层表示中已包含足够信息但分类头未充分利用，因此改进表示学习或分类层训练策略可能是更有效的方向。

title: SA-GEM: Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning for Efficient Remote Sensing Large Vision-Language Models
summary: RS-LVLMs have advanced multimodal understanding of Earth observation imagery, yet their performance is fundamentally constrained by high-resolution processing, as visual token counts grow quadratically with linear input resolution while important visual evidence is inherently sparse and increasingly diluted across the expanded sequence. Existing token pruning methods largely rely on scale-agnostic resolution policies and isolated importance cues, limiting task-aligned granularity adaptation and holistic evidence preservation. To address this, we present Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning (SA-GEM), a plug-and-play framework that unifies task-adaptive token granularity allocation with holistic geospatial token importance modulation. Specifically, a lightweight router selects the resolution based on query-dependent token granularity, while a token importance modulator jointly models task relevance, spatial structure, and local redundancy to preserve holistic geospatial evidence. We show that higher resolution is not universally beneficial and, once sufficient granularity is reached, token quality matters more than token quantity. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that SA-GEM achieves consistent gains in both accuracy and efficiency over existing pruning methods. On XLRS-Bench, it surpasses GeoLLaVA-8K by 2.3% in accuracy with a 2.4 times total inference speedup.

AI.tldr: SA-GEM是一个即插即用的框架，通过尺度自适应分辨率选择和地理空间证据调制令牌剪枝，解决了遥感大视觉语言模型（RS-LVLMs）在高分辨率处理中视觉令牌激增、重要证据稀释的问题，在精度和效率上均超越现有剪枝方法。
AI.motivation: RS-LVLMs的遥感影像理解能力受高分辨率处理制约：视觉令牌数量随线性分辨率呈二次方增长，而重要视觉证据本质稀疏且被稀释在扩展的序列中。现有令牌剪枝方法依赖与尺度无关的分辨率策略和孤立的显著性线索，缺乏任务对齐的粒度自适应和整体证据保持能力。
AI.method: SA-GEM包含两个核心模块：（1）轻量级路由器（lightweight router）根据查询依赖的令牌粒度选择分辨率；（2）令牌重要性调制器（token importance modulator）联合建模任务相关性、空间结构和局部冗余，以保持整体地理空间证据。两者统一实现任务自适应的令牌粒度分配与整体地理空间令牌重要性调制。
AI.result: 实验表明更高分辨率并非普遍有益，一旦达到足够粒度，令牌质量比令牌数量更重要。SA-GEM在多个基准上相较现有剪枝方法在精度和效率上均取得一致提升。在XLRS-Bench上，相比GeoLLaVA-8K精度提升2.3%，总推理速度提升2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: SA-GEM验证了"充足粒度后质量优先于数量"的核心观点，通过即插即用的方式为RS-LVLMs提供了一种兼顾精度与效率的令牌剪枝新范式，具有广泛的实用价值。

title: Rotate Disks to Reach Farther: Design and Modeling of a Novel Reconfigurable Tendon Driven Manipulator
summary: Rerouting the tendon path in tendon driven continuum manipulators (TDCMs) enables a broad range of deformation modes. This work presents a Reconfigurable TDCM design which allows independent rotation of intermediate spacer disks, thereby locally rerouting the tendon and achieving non-trivial backbone spatial deformations. Two such designs, (a) Manual Disk Locked (MDL) and (b) Continuous Disk Rotor (CDR) manipulators are presented to achieve disk rotations before and during operation, respectively. A predictive static model based on the piecewise constant strain (PCS) assumption is developed within a potential energy minimization framework, incorporating (a) disk rotations, (b) discrete tendon paths between disk segments, (c) rigid thickness of spacer disks, and (d) elasticity of the tendons. The model is validated against experimental results, demonstrating an average tip error of $1.2\%$ of the manipulator's total length for parallel tendon routing and around $3\%$ for the case when multiple disks are rotated. The computation time is an order of magnitude lower than the state of the art Cosserat rod solver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可重构的腱驱动连续体机械臂（TDCM）设计，通过独立旋转中间间隔盘来实现肌腱路径的局部重定向，从而获得非平凡的骨干空间变形。开发了基于分段常数应变（PCS）假设的预测静态模型，并验证了其高精度和低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 传统腱驱动连续体机械臂中肌腱路径固定，限制了可实现的变形模式。通过重新路由肌腱路径可以拓宽变形范围，但现有方法缺乏系统的设计和建模方案，因此需要一种可重构的设计及其精确高效的预测模型。
AI.method: 提出两种可重构TDCM设计：(a)手动锁定盘（MDL）和(b)连续盘转子（CDR）机械臂，分别在操作前和操作中实现盘旋转。基于分段常数应变（PCS）假设，在势能最小化框架下建立预测静态模型，综合考虑盘旋转、盘段间离散肌腱路径、间隔盘的刚性厚度以及肌腱的弹性。
AI.result: 模型与实验结果吻合良好：平行肌腱路径下的平均尖端误差为机械臂总长度的1.2%，多个盘旋转时误差约为3%。计算时间比最先进的Cosserat杆求解器低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该可重构TDCM方案及其基于PCS的预测静态模型能够实现多种非平凡变形模式，同时保持高精度和显著的计算效率优势，为连续体机械臂的灵活变形控制提供了有效途径。

title: M-LINKX: Multiview Graph Learning for Brain Cognitive Disease Detection
comment: Accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive and relatively low-cost procedure that measures brain electricity for the detection of cognitive diseases. EEG-based classification of dementia-related conditions, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), remains challenging because EEG signals are noisy, non-stationary, and vary across subjects. Segment-based learning provides a practical way to model long EEG recordings by converting them into fixed-length inputs. For each segment, discriminative information may be explored by using signals within each channel (i.e. electrode), as well as interactions between EEG channels. In this paper, we propose M-LINKX, a multi-view graph learning framework for EEG-based dementia classification. For each segment, we extract channel-level node features and construct multiple functional-connectivity (FC) graph views, where each view is defined by a specific combination of connectivity metric, frequency band, and topology filter, respectively. Instead of relying on message passing over the constructed graphs, M-LINKX follows a simple design in modeling node features and adjacency-based connectivity representations. The graph-view representations are fused using global trainable view weights, and subject-level prediction is obtained by averaging segment-level probabilities. Experiments on two three-class EEG datasets with different diagnostic groups, CAUEEG (HC/MCI/Dementia) and AHEAP (HC/AD/FTD), show that M-LINKX achieves the best subject-level performance under the main experimental settings. Our study suggests that multi-view functional connectivity can improve EEG-based dementia classification when integrated with an appropriate graph-learning architecture. Code and data are available at https://github.com/anphantt/MLINKX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M-LINKX，一种基于多视图图学习的EEG痴呆分类框架。该方法针对每个EEG片段构建多个功能连接（FC）图视图，每个视图由连接度量、频带和拓扑滤波器的特定组合定义，使用简单设计建模节点特征和邻接连接表示，通过全局可训练视图权重融合图视图表示，并平均片段级概率获得受试者级预测。在CAUEEG（HC/MCI/Dementia）和AHEAP（HC/AD/FTD）两个三分类EEG数据集上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: EEG信号具有噪声大、非平稳、受试者间差异大的特点，导致基于EEG的痴呆相关疾病（AD、MCI、FTD）分类具有挑战性。现有方法未能充分利用EEG片段内的多通道信息以及通道间交互，需要一种能够同时建模通道内判别信息和通道间功能连接的多视图学习框架。
AI.method: M-LINKX框架包括：1）将长EEG记录分割为固定长度片段，为每个片段提取通道级节点特征；2）构建多个功能连接图视图，每个视图由连接度量、频带和拓扑滤波器的特定组合定义；3）采用简单设计而非消息传递机制，直接建模节点特征和邻接连接表示；4）使用全局可训练的视图权重融合各图视图表示；5）通过平均片段级概率得到受试者级预测。
AI.result: 在两个三分类EEG数据集（CAUEEG：HC/MCI/Dementia；AHEAP：HC/AD/FTD）上的实验表明，M-LINKX在主要实验设置下取得了最佳受试者级分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将多视图功能连接与合适的图学习架构相结合，可以有效提升EEG痴呆分类的性能。该方法的代码和数据已公开发布。

title: Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection
summary: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. We evaluate three detectors on 120 point-defect images from three ISP-AD modalities and three fixed data splits. Of 378 alarms, 230 overlap the matched mask. Paired and crossed rates are nevertheless similar in eight of nine detector--modality cells; only DINOv2--ASM has a positive 95\% bootstrap lower bound (lift 0.259, 95\% interval 0.159--0.347). On the independent Magnetic Tile Defect dataset, the same analysis gives lifts of 0.203 (0.169--0.236) for Wide ResNet-50 (WRN50) patch memory and 0.231 (0.202--0.262) for Vision Transformer B/16 (ViT-B/16) patch memory, with one-sided permutation $p=10^{-5}$ for both. When crossed masks are restricted to the same defect class, the lifts remain 0.185 and 0.210. Exact sample planning shows that, with 150 calibration normals, a 95\%-confidence distribution-free claim is supported only for target false-positive rates of 1.98\% or higher; a 1\% target requires at least 299 normals. The results support reporting operating-point performance and chance-corrected spatial evidence alongside AUROC and raw mask overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合无分布上容忍阈值与"配对-交叉"空间检验的方法，用于评估工业视觉检测算法的误报率与空间证据提升度。在120张点缺陷图像、9个检测器-模态组合的评测中，大多数组合的配对率与交叉率相似，仅DINOv2-ASM具有显著正提升；在独立数据集上两种补丁记忆方法均表现出显著的空间证据提升，并给出了精确的样本量规划（150个正常样本仅支持1.98%以上的目标假阳性率，1%目标需至少299个样本）。
AI.motivation: 现有工业视觉检测评估主要依赖AUROC和缺陷掩膜重叠率，这两项指标均未指定特定阈值下的误报率，且重复出现的缺陷位置和掩膜几何形状可能虚增重叠率。需要一种能校正偶然重叠、同时报告操作点性能的评估方法。
AI.method: 结合无分布上容忍阈值与配对-交叉空间检验：通过配对检验比较检测器得分贡献位置与匹配缺陷掩膜的匹配率，通过交叉检验比较得分位置与其他图像掩膜的匹配率，两者的差异定义为相对于经验偶然重叠率的空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift）。使用bootstrap置信区间和单侧置换检验验证显著性，并通过精确样本规划确定支持特定目标假阳性率所需的正常样本数。
AI.result: 在120张点缺陷图像、9个检测器-模态组合中，378个警报中230个与匹配掩膜重叠，但配对率与交叉率在8/9的单元格中相似，仅DINOv2-ASM有显著正提升（lift 0.259，95%区间0.159-0.347）。在独立Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上，WRN50和ViT-B/16补丁记忆分别获得0.203和0.231的提升（置换p=10^-5），相同缺陷类别交叉掩膜限制下仍有0.185和0.210。样本规划显示150个校准正常样本仅支持1.98%以上的目标假阳性率，1%目标需299个正常样本。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在报告AUROC和原始掩膜重叠之外，还应报告操作点性能和偶然校正的空间证据。现有大多数检测器在点缺陷任务上与偶然重叠率无明显差异，表明AUROC与掩膜重叠指标可能高估了检测器的实际空间定位性能。

title: Tabletop Pen Manipulation With a Vision-Guided 4-DoF Arm
summary: Low-cost four-degree-of-freedom (DoF) arms are among the most accessible robotic platforms. But they are, in theory, underactuated for picking up in situations where objects are at arbitrary orientations, a task that appears to require five degrees of freedom: the planar position (x and y), the height (z), a wrist rotation to align the gripper with the object, and gripper actuation, of which a four-DoF arm lacks the wrist rotation. This work shows that perception and motion planning can enable such an arm, a roughly $200 Waveshare RoArm-M2-S, under a fixed overhead camera to detect and color-sort writing utensils without that joint. A YOLO11n-OBB (You Only Look Once, oriented bounding box) detector locates each writing utensil; camera intrinsics and an ArUco reference pose convert its pixel coordinates to robot coordinates; and a color classifier labels it. The detected orientation angle determines the motion strategy: utensils close to the arm's fixed approach direction are picked up directly, and those at steeper angles are reoriented via corrective sweeps until they are graspable, after which they are picked up and sorted into the assigned color bin. Across 326 logged motions on seven writing utensils, the arm made 196 direct grasps and 130 corrective sweep passes, correcting misalignments up to 90 degrees, suggesting that clever task-informed engineering can compensate for a missing degree of freedom on tasks like this one.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何利用感知和运动规划，使一个约200美元的四自由度（DoF）机械臂在固定顶置摄像头下完成无需腕部旋转关节的彩色书写工具检测与分拣任务，通过YOLO11n-OBB检测、ArUco定位、颜色分类及纠偏清扫策略，补偿缺失的自由度。
AI.motivation: 低成本四自由度机械臂是最易获取的机器人平台之一，但从理论上讲，当物体处于任意姿态时，拾取任务需要五个自由度（平面位置x、y、高度z、腕部旋转和夹爪驱动），四自由度机械臂缺少腕部旋转关节，属于欠驱动。作者希望证明：通过感知和运动规划，可以在没有腕部旋转关节的情况下完成这类任务，从而降低硬件成本门槛。
AI.method: 采用约200美元的Waveshare RoArm-M2-S四自由度机械臂配合固定顶置摄像头。首先使用YOLO11n-OBB（定向边界框）检测器定位每个书写工具，结合相机内参和ArUco参考位姿将像素坐标转换为机器人坐标，并通过颜色分类器标记物体。检测到的朝向角度决定运动策略：接近机械臂固定进给方向的工具直接拾取，陡峭角度的工具通过纠偏清扫运动重新定向直至可抓取，最后放入对应颜色分类箱。共记录了326次运动。
AI.result: 在七个书写工具上记录了326次运动，其中196次直接抓取成功，130次纠偏清扫通过，成功纠正了高达90度的未对准偏移，证明该系统的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，巧妙的、任务感知的工程方法可以补偿机器人在此类任务中缺失的自由度，使得低成本四自由度机械臂在特定分拣任务中可以达到五自由度机械臂的效果，无需额外的硬件投资。

title: Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
summary: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced normalized regret by 31.7% relative to ignoring it. However, model-guided action did not significantly outperform a direct empirical-memory policy, and powered CIFAR-10/ResNet validation showed no robustness advantage over equal-budget direct repair search. These results support SIL as an intervention-driven framework for learning predictive knowledge about a network's own functional organization, while showing that the self-model remains incomplete and is not universally superior to simpler direct strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自干预学习（SIL）框架，让神经网络通过扰动自身功能结构、观察后果来学习预测性自模型，并利用该模型指导后续结构操作。在合成系统中SIL能恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性但对协同性恢复不佳；增加干预预算可显著降低预测误差并提升相关性；消融实验验证了正确干预-后果映射的重要性及自模型用于行动可降低31.7%的遗憾值，但模型引导的行动并未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，且在CIFAR-10/ResNet验证中也无鲁棒性优势。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习系统仅建模外部数据，其内部功能组织由外部观察者分析。本文旨在引入一种范式转变：让系统通过干预自身结构来学习关于自身功能组织的预测性知识，从而赋予系统自我理解与自我指导的能力。
AI.method: 提出Self-Interventional Learning (SIL)框架，核心包括：(1) 扰动自身功能结构；(2) 观察干预后果；(3) 学习预测性自模型；(4) 泛化到未执行的干预；(5) 利用预测指导后续结构行动。实验设计包括构造已知的合成系统、30个新鲜确认种子上的干预预算扫描、匹配消融实验（验证干预-后果映射的重要性）、以及CIFAR-10/ResNet上的大规模验证。
AI.result: 在合成系统中SIL成功恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但协同性恢复不可靠；干预预算从4增至56时，留出预测误差从0.0335降至0.0148，Spearman相关系数从0.629升至0.883；正确映射干预-后果可减少81.3%的前瞻预测误差；自模型用于行动降低31.7%的归一化遗憾值；但模型引导行动未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，CIFAR-10/ResNet验证也显示无鲁棒性优势。
AI.conclusion: SIL为学习网络自身功能组织的预测性知识提供了一种干预驱动的可行框架，但自模型仍然不完整，且并非普遍优于更简单的直接策略。该方法为系统自我理解开辟了新方向，同时揭示了其局限性与更简单策略之间的性能差距。

title: MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MODAL框架，基于耦合稀疏编码理论和差分抑制原理，通过多模态特征稀疏解耦模块显式分解单模态特有、双模态及三模态共享表示，并利用模态感知子空间激活缓解不完整模态下的性能退化，同时通过文本-图像差分过滤模块抑制任务无关响应，在四个数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态目标重识别方法缺乏有原则的特征解耦和连贯的多模态集成，导致表征纠缠、引入跨模态冲突、模糊判别线索，且在模态缺失条件下遭受分布偏移。
AI.method: MODAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于多模态耦合稀疏编码的模型驱动深度展开方式构建的多模态特征稀疏解耦模块，将特征分解为单模态特有、双模态和三模态共享表示；(2) 模态感知子空间激活机制，在不完整模态场景下选择性激活一致的共享子空间；(3) 文本-图像差分过滤模块，利用粗粒度文本语义自适应抑制解耦视觉表示中的任务无关响应。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，MODAL达到最先进的性能，同时具有优越的透明性。
AI.conclusion: MODAL通过有原则的特征解耦和差分抑制，实现了更透明有效的多模态目标重识别，自然缓解了模态缺失下的性能退化问题。

title: Learning Varying Physical Therapist-Patient Interactions for Robot-mediated Upper Limb Task-Specific Training
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables Submitted to:IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
summary: Upper extremity motor function recovery is positively linked to Task-Specific Training (TST) and sufficient therapy dosage. Rehabilitation robots can increase TST dosage via controlled, repetitive treatment and free therapists to simultaneously manage other patients, but it has yet to demonstrate significant benefits over conventional treatment. This is potentially linked to inaccurate robotic representation of personalised physical therapist-patient interaction and lack of practice variability during TST. Hence, we advocate for robotic interventions that preserve the personalised physical therapist-patient interactions when delivering TST for patients across varying practise conditions. We propose a Learning-from-Demonstration framework using Task-Parameterised Gaussian Mixture Models (TPGMM) to learn personalised physical therapist-patient interaction in Task-Specific exercises, mapping patient joint kinematics to therapist-applied torques using few demonstrations. The model is generalised to reconstruct therapist torques in new task variations. The framework was evaluated on physical interactions from 14 mock "therapist-patient" pairs over three tasks of increasing complexity, each with six variations. A benchmark comparison against a Look-Up Table was conducted. The results show both methods reproducing interactions in unseen task variations that deviate slightly from the actual interaction, with TPGMM slightly outperforming LUT. Both methods reproduced interactions that gets increasingly closer to the actual interaction as task complexity increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于任务参数化高斯混合模型（TPGMM）的示范学习框架，用于从少量演示中学习个性化物理治疗师-患者交互关系（将患者关节运动学映射到治疗师施加的力矩），并泛化到新任务变化中。在14组模拟"治疗师-患者"对、三个递进复杂度任务（每个任务六种变化）上评估，结果显示TPGMM在重建未见任务变化中的交互关系上略优于查表法，且两种方法在任务复杂度增加时重建精度均提升。
AI.motivation: 康复机器人虽能增加任务特异性训练（TST）剂量并解放治疗师，但尚未展现出优于传统治疗的显著效果。这可能源于机器人缺乏对个性化物理治疗师-患者交互的准确建模，以及TST中缺乏练习变异性。因此需要开发能保留个性化治疗师-患者交互且支持多种练习条件的机器人干预方法。
AI.method: 提出基于任务参数化高斯混合模型（TPGMM）的学习-示范框架：利用少量示范数据学习个性化治疗师-患者交互（将患者关节运动学映射至治疗师施加力矩），并通过TPGMM的任务参数化特性将模型泛化至新的任务变化场景，从而在TST中重建治疗师力矩。
AI.result: 在14组模拟"治疗师-患者"对上，针对三个复杂度递增任务（每个六种变化）进行评估，并与查表法（LUT）基准对比。结果显示两种方法在未见任务变化中均能重建交互关系（与真实交互略有偏差），TPGMM略优于LUT；随着任务复杂度增加，两种方法重建出的交互关系越来越接近真实交互。
AI.conclusion: TPGMM框架能够以少量示范有效学习并泛化个性化治疗师-患者交互，在康复机器人TST应用中具有可行性，且在高复杂度任务中表现更佳。这为开发能保留个性化交互的机器人康复干预提供了有前景的技术路线。

title: Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence
summary: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. We establish the temperature threshold for determining the exact degeneracy and identify a second, lower threshold that provides a temperature window to count near-degenerate minima within a user-defined energy tolerance. By confining measurement to S, the protocol replaces tomography over the exponentially large problem Hilbert space with tomography over a small probe represented by only four qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTPQsd#算法，利用规范热纯量子（CTPQ）态中的退相干测量来确定经典优化问题全局最优解的数量，无需逐个寻找最小值，仅需测量一个小探针S（仅四个量子比特），避免了对指数规模Hilbert空间的层析。
AI.motivation: 计算经典优化问题的全局最优解数量是#P-hard问题，传统方法需要对指数规模的问题空间进行搜索或层析，计算代价极高。本文旨在开发一种仅通过小探针测量即可高效计算退化度（全局最优解数量）的量子算法。
AI.method: 算法利用S与P共同处于CTPQ态时，S的消相干度量与P的退化度之间的微扰关系。通过将经典优化问题编码为对角随机能量Hamiltonian（作为无结构测试平台），对CTPQ态的温度、能量范围、问题规模和退化度进行敏感性分析，并仅用四量子比特探针进行层析测量而非全空间层析。
AI.result: 在多达20个问题量子比特的经典模拟中，量化了算法对CTPQ态温度、Hamiltonian能量范围、问题规模和退化度变化的敏感性。确定了获得精确退化度的温度阈值，并识别出第二个较低阈值，提供温度窗口以在用户定义的能量容差内计数近简并最小值。
AI.conclusion: 该协议将指数大问题Hilbert空间上的层析替换为四量子比特小探针上的层析，首次数值证明了退相干测量与问题退化度之间的关系可用于计数全局最小值，为#P-hard的全局最优计数问题提供了实用的量子途径。

title: ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.

AI.tldr: ProjFormer提出一种跨模态点云补全框架，通过显式投影和自适应特征路由实现几何一致的2D-3D交互，在轻量设计下取得有竞争力的性能并改善结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 点云补全因部分观测的严重稀疏性和歧义而本质上不适定。现有多视角方法虽然引入2D语义缓解问题，但常依赖学习式注意力与固定融合策略，缺乏几何一致性和适应性。
AI.method: 提出ProjFormer跨模态框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Projective Guided View Attention模块，通过确定性投影将3D点与多视角特征对齐，实现高效且几何一致的聚合；(2) 几何感知路由网络，对结构特征与观测驱动特征进行逐点自适应融合，实现渐进式细化。
AI.result: 在轻量级设计条件下，ProjFormer在多视角点云补全任务上取得有竞争力的性能，同时显著提升了结构的完整度。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式投影替代学习式注意力并结合自适应特征路由，ProjFormer在保证几何一致性的同时提升了点云补全的结构完整性与适应性，验证了轻量跨模态框架的可行性。

title: Benchmarking Identity-Sensitive LLM Outputs for Surveillance and Security Robots
comment: Accepted to the Foundation Models in the Ro-Man Age (FoRMA) Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate textual robot design specifications, interaction policies, and risk assessments during early-stage robot development. Such outputs may influence how surveillance and security robots are conceptualized, documented, and ultimately implemented. This paper evaluates whether identity-conditioned prompts produce systematic differences in LLM-generated surveillance and security robot design descriptions. Using 236 demographic identity labels across single-label and model-augmented prompt conditions, we analyze readability as an initial benchmark for evaluating accessibility and identity-conditioned variation in generated robot design descriptions. The results show significant differences in readability across prompt conditions, design dimensions, and demographic identities. Although readability cannot determine whether an output is fair or socially appropriate, it provides an interpretable baseline within a broader benchmarking framework that also includes lexical, semantic, sentiment, syntactic, and fairness-focused analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了身份条件化提示是否会导致LLM生成的监控与安防机器人设计描述产生系统性差异。使用236个身份标签，分析生成文本的可读性作为基准，发现不同提示条件、设计维度和身份之间可读性存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于生成机器人设计规范、交互策略和风险评估，可能影响监控与安防机器人的设计决策。因此需要评估LLM是否因用户身份不同而产生有偏见的输出，这关系到机器人开发早期阶段的公平性问题。
AI.method: 使用236个人口统计身份标签，在单标签和模型增强提示条件下生成监控与安防机器人设计描述，并以可读性作为初始基准指标进行分析，比较不同提示条件、设计维度和身份类别之间的差异。
AI.result: 不同提示条件、设计维度和人口统计身份之间，LLM生成的机器人设计描述在可读性上存在显著差异，表明身份条件化提示确实会引入可度量的输出变异。
AI.conclusion: 可读性虽无法直接判定输出是否公平或社会适当，但可作为更广泛基准框架中的可解释基线，该框架还包括词汇、语义、情感、句法和公平性分析。

title: PathFinder: Joint Decompositions of Linked Multimodal Datasets
summary: Low-rank matrix decompositions can uncover patterns and structure in data and have a number of different applications across many disciplines. Extensions to "joint" low-rank decompositions have been proposed to link datasets from different modalities. While these methods enable the discovery of common patterns across modalities, they require that all the multimodal data share one or more dimensions. We propose a new analysis method, PathFinder, that enables co-analysis of datasets that do not necessarily all share a dimension. The key insight is that as long as pairs or subgroups of matrices do share some dimension, and that there are one or more paths that link across the data matrices, a global joint decomposition can be sought out. This enables the joint estimation of common patterns across different modalities, species, or scales, where a one-to-one mapping across all data along some dimension is not necessarily available. We show that PathFinder is a general umbrella under which many matrix decomposition methods fall as special cases. It can be used to discover common patterns across disparate datasets and to make predictions for missing data or modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出PathFinder方法，允许对不完全共享维度但通过路径连接的多模态数据集进行联合低秩分解，涵盖多个现有矩阵分解方法作为特例，并可预测缺失数据。
AI.motivation: 现有的联合低秩分解方法要求所有多模态数据共享一个或多个维度，这限制了它们对异质数据集的适用性。实际中不同模态、物种或尺度的数据往往不具有完整的一对一维度映射。
AI.method: PathFinder的核心思想是：只要矩阵对或子组之间共享某个维度，且存在一条或多条路径将这些数据矩阵链接起来，就可以寻求全局联合分解，无需所有数据在所有维度上共享。
AI.result: PathFinder作为一般性框架，涵盖了多种矩阵分解方法作为特例；可发现不同数据集间的共同模式，并能对缺失数据或模态进行预测。
AI.conclusion: PathFinder是一种更通用的联合低秩分解分析框架，放宽了对维度共享的严格限制，通过路径连接实现跨模态、跨物种或跨尺度的联合分析。

title: CETalk: Continuous Valence-Arousal Control for Audio-Driven 3D Talking Head Generation
summary: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features via an adaptive gating network. To support training and evaluation, we construct 3D-VA-MEAD, a large-scale dataset with automatically estimated VA annotations and reconstructed 3D facial motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CETalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both lip-sync accuracy and emotional expressiveness, while enabling smooth and controllable emotion transitions.

AI.tldr: 提出CETalk框架，基于连续效价-唤醒(VA)表征的音频驱动3D面部动画生成方法，通过动态情感调制、多尺度时域建模和动态融合机制，实现精细情感控制与准确唇形同步，并在构造的3D-VA-MEAD数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D说话人头像生成方法依赖离散情感类别，无法捕捉情感的连续演化过程，同时忽略了音频发音与情感表达之间的时间频率不匹配问题，导致情感表达不自然、不够精细。
AI.method: 提出CETalk框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 动态情感调制模块(Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module)，利用音频线索自适应调整情感强度；2) 多尺度时域建模机制(Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling)，采用并行分支解耦高频发音运动与低频情感动态；3) 动态融合机制(Dynamic Fusion Mechanism)，通过自适应门控网络整合多尺度特征。此外构建了带自动VA标注和3D面部运动重建的大规模数据集3D-VA-MEAD。
AI.result: 在唇形同步准确性和情感表现力两个维度均优于现有最先进方法，并支持平滑可控的情感过渡。
AI.conclusion: 基于连续VA表征的CETalk框架有效解决了现有方法在连续情感建模和音频-情感频率失配问题上的不足，为情感3D说话头生成提供了更精细、更自然可控的解决方案。

title: ScenarioCharacterization: A Modular Toolkit for Characterizing Safety across Trajectory Datasets
summary:
We introduce ScenarioCharacterization, an open-source framework for automated, dataset-agnostic profiling of driving scenarios in trajectory datasets. Our framework is packaged as a modular, configuration-driven pipeline of three layers: a dataset adapter that maps custom datasets onto an open Scenario representation, a characterizer that performs feature extraction, behavior probing, and criticality scoring at scenario and agent levels, and an analysis layer for scenario visualization and feature, score, and probe analyses. Because the layers communicate only through Pydantic-validated schemas composed via configurations, a new dataset can easily plug in without rewriting the characterization and analysis stack.
  This technical report describes the design and APIs, shows example outputs on Waymo Open Motion, Argoverse2, and nuPlan, and discusses downstream uses of the approach. The framework is available at https://github.com/navarrs/ScenarioCharacterization.

AI.tldr: 提出了ScenarioCharacterization，一个开源、数据集无关的驾驶场景自动刻画框架。该框架采用模块化、配置驱动的三层流水线（数据集适配层、特征刻画层、分析层），各层通过Pydantic校验模式通信，使得新数据集可以快速接入而无需重写刻画与分析堆栈。报告展示了在Waymo Open Motion、Argoverse2和nuPlan上的示例输出及下游用途。
AI.motivation: 轨迹数据集中驾驶场景的刻画通常依赖特定数据集进行定制化处理，缺乏通用、可复用的工具，导致在不同数据集间迁移分析工作成本高昂，难以进行标准化比较。
AI.method: 将框架设计为三个分离的解耦层：1) 数据集适配层（dataset adapter），将自定义数据集映射到开放的Scenario表示；2) 刻画层（characterizer），执行特征提取、行为探测和场景/智能体级别的关键性评分；3) 分析层（analysis layer），支持场景可视化以及特征、评分和探测结果分析。各层仅通过配置驱动的Pydantic校验模式通信，保证模块可插拔。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Motion、Argoverse2和nuPlan三个公开数据集上展示了框架的示例输出，验证了其跨数据集通用性和即插即用的扩展能力，并演示了特征、评分和探测分析的实际产出。
AI.conclusion: ScenarioCharacterization提供了一个数据集无关的标准化驾驶场景刻画方案，降低了研究人员在多数据集间进行场景分析和比较的门槛，其开源发布便于社区复现与扩展。

title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts
summary: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system description prompt using the agentic LLM used for generating plausible facts. Inconsistencies in plausible facts lead to incorrect PDEVS statecharts having logical structure and behavioral inaccuracies. A controlled-correction mechanism is developed to verify the logical consistency of the plausible facts. The agentic LLM is used to generate key behavioral conditions from the system description prompt. The plausible facts are then verified against the behavioral conditions using propositional logic entailment for a finite number of times. The verification results enable the generation of modification prompts that can reduce errors in generated plausible facts, resulting in more accurate PDEVS statecharts. To verify a statechart's logical correctness, its Timed Automata counterpart is manually created and verified for deadlock and reachability properties. The human modeler may regenerate plausible facts and PDEVS statecharts iteratively and incrementally. A basic correctness metric is introduced to quantify the completeness and accuracy of the expected behavioral traits of the PDEVS statechart models. A collection of example systems with varying levels of complexity is developed to demonstrate the capabilities and limitations of LLMs. The evaluation of the proposed verification mechanism shows a substantial improvement in the logical consistency of generated statecharts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种agentic PDEVS-LLM框架，利用大语言模型辅助人类建模者生成和验证PDEVS状态图，通过受控纠正机制和命题逻辑蕴含验证确保生成事实的逻辑一致性，从而生成更准确的原子PDEVS模型状态图。
AI.motivation: 开发准确的模型需要建模与仿真知识和领域知识，而PDEVS模型的生成往往存在逻辑结构和行为不准确的问题。现有方法缺乏系统化的机制来确保生成状态图的逻辑正确性和可验证性，因此需要引入智能体LLM框架来辅助建模者生成并验证PDEVS状态图。
AI.method: 该框架采用agentic LLM从系统描述提示中生成可信事实和关键行为条件；通过受控纠正机制利用命题逻辑蕴含对可信事实进行有限次验证，检测逻辑不一致性；根据验证结果生成修改提示以减少事实错误；状态图的逻辑正确性通过手动创建其Timed Automata对应物并验证死锁和可达性属性来保证；引入基本正确性度量来量化状态图模型的完整性和准确性。
AI.result: 在多种复杂度级别的示例系统上评估表明，所提出的验证机制显著提高了生成状态图的逻辑一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持人类建模者迭代式地重新生成可信事实和PDEVS状态图，通过受控验证机制有效改善了LLM生成PDEVS状态图的质量，同时展示了LLM在此类任务中的能力与局限性。

title: Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression
summary: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. Our study reveals an Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory (AAT) property in LIC systems: transitioning from adversarial to benign regions is significantly easier than the reverse process, where adversarial examples can often be roughly recovered within only 1-2 steps. We provide a two-dimensional Tube Model to explain this phenomenon. Based on AAT, we propose a Fast Test-Time Refinement (FTTR) framework for practical and robust LIC systems. We establish that the robustness arises from the contraction of adversarial regions induced by the Input-as-Label property of LIC systems, rather than from obfuscated gradients. Extensive evaluations with diverse strong adaptive attacks across multiple LIC systems demonstrate the promise of the proposed FTTR framework. The code is available at https://github.com/chinaliangjiaming/FTTR.git.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了学习图像压缩（LIC）系统的对抗鲁棒性，发现了一种名为"非对称对抗轨迹"（AAT）的性质：从对抗区域回到良性区域比反向过程容易得多，通常仅需1-2步即可大致恢复。基于此提出快速测试时精化（FTTR）框架，通过收缩对抗区域来实现鲁棒性（而非梯度混淆），并在多种LIC系统和强自适应攻击下验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 学习图像压缩虽在良性场景下取得了优异的率失真性能，但深度神经网络赋予的高表征能力也带来了更高的对抗脆弱性，阻碍其作为可信标准化编解码器的采用。已有的测试时精化（TTR）防御存在两大问题：大量迭代带来高昂开销，且其鲁棒机制缺乏理论理解；同时TTR尚未在白盒设置或超越l2-有界速率和无目标失真目标的攻击下评估。本文旨在填补这些空白。
AI.method: 首先通过系统性研究揭示LIC系统中非对称对抗轨迹（AAT）性质，即从对抗区域过渡到良性区域远易于反向过程。提出二维Tube模型来解释该现象。基于AAT提出快速测试时精化（FTTR）框架，利用LIC系统的Input-as-Label属性，通过少量（1-2步）迭代实现对抗区域的收缩，从而获得鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多类LIC系统上，采用多种强自适应攻击进行全面评估，结果表明FTTR框架在显著降低开销的同时能够有效抵御攻击，并证明其鲁棒性来源于对抗区域在Input-as-Label属性下的收缩，而非梯度混淆。
AI.conclusion: FTTR为LIC系统提供了一种实用且高效的对抗防御方案，兼具理论解释和实际可行性，推动了LIC系统向可信标准化编解码器方向的发展。代码已开源。

title: SurgVIL: Scaling Surgical Robot Imitation Learning with Open-source Surgical Videos
summary: Learning-based surgical robot autonomy requires large-scale demonstrations with synchronized videos and robot actions, but such data are exceedingly rare in clinical or realistic tissue settings because robot kinematics are typically inaccessible outside controlled research systems. In contrast, phantom data collected on research platforms provide accurate action labels but lack the visual diversity of real tissue. We propose SurgVIL, a framework for scaling surgical robot imitation learning using open-source surgical videos. SurgVIL combines kinematically labeled phantom robot demonstrations with surgical videos from open-source datasets and online sources for policy learning. Since these videos lack robot motion labels, we estimate approximate kinematics as weak supervision. We evaluate SurgVIL on two da Vinci robot tasks: needle pick-up and cholecystectomy cutting. Across ACT, $π_0$, and GR00T-H backbones, adding surgical videos substantially improves generalization to real-tissue and out-of-distribution settings, suggesting a scalable path from phantom training toward generalizable surgical robot policies.

AI.tldr: SurgVIL是一个利用开源手术视频和带运动标签的幻影机器人演示数据来扩展手术机器人模仿学习的框架，通过弱监督估计视频中的运动学信息，在达芬奇机器人的缝针拾取和胆囊切除手术任务上显著提升了对真实组织和分布外场景的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的手术机器人自主性需要大量同步的视频和机器人动作演示数据，但此类数据在临床或真实组织环境中极为稀缺，因为机器人运动学数据通常只能在受控研究系统中获取。幻影数据虽提供精确动作标签但缺乏真实组织的视觉多样性，存在数据可扩展性的根本瓶颈。
AI.method: SurgVIL框架结合两类数据源：一是带运动学标签的幻影机器人演示，提供精确动作监督；二是来自开源数据集和在线来源的手术视频，通过运动学估计作为弱监督补充。这种数据混合策略在多个策略学习骨干（ACT、π0、GR00T-H）上进行统一训练。
AI.result: 在da Vinci机器人的两个任务（缝针拾取和胆囊切除切割）上，使用ACT、π0和GR00T-H三种骨干网络进行评价，加入手术视频后均显著提升了对真实组织和分布外场景的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了从幻影训练走向可泛化手术机器人策略的可扩展路径，表明开源手术视频可以作为有效的弱监督信号来弥补真实数据稀缺的问题。

title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate PCN explanations as return-command interventions, using a return-only PCN variant that avoids the added ambiguity of horizon-conditioning. Second, we adapt adversarial machine learning methods to reinforcement-learning explanations. Third, we introduce a boundary-seeded directional search that improves over purely local optimization in the command-action landscape, resulting in our proposed approach CF-ZOO. The resulting explanations are actionable and intuitively expressed in the user's own preferences: "If your trade-off had shifted slightly towards X, the agent would have chosen Y."

AI.tldr: 本文针对Pareto条件网络（PCN）在多目标强化学习中的可解释性问题，提出了一种黑盒设置下的命令空间反事实解释方法CF-ZOO。该方法通过在固定状态下搜索最小改变的期望回报命令，使训练好的策略选择给定目标动作，从而生成"如果偏好略微偏向X，智能体就会选择Y"这样直观可操作的解释。
AI.motivation: PCN通过条件化单一策略于期望回报命令来学习多种多目标强化学习行为，但其从命令和状态到动作的局部映射是不透明的（opaque），缺乏可解释性，用户难以理解偏好参数如何影响智能体的决策。
AI.method: 1) 将PCN解释形式化为回报命令干预问题，使用仅回报的PCN变体以避免水平条件化的额外歧义；2) 将对抗机器学习方法适配到强化学习解释任务中；3) 提出边界种子定向搜索（boundary-seeded directional search），在命令-动作景观中改进纯局部优化的不足，构成所提出的CF-ZOO方法。
AI.result: 提出了CF-ZOO这一黑盒反事实解释方法，能够在命令空间中搜索最小改变的期望回报命令，使得同一训练策略在固定状态下选择给定目标动作（foil），生成的解释以用户自身偏好语言直观表达。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为PCN提供了可操作且直观的反事实解释框架，让用户能够理解"偏好改变如何导致行为改变"，提升了多目标强化学习在实用场景中的透明度和可信度。

title: Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples
summary: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing, overlooking global perspective transformations that naturally arise from viewpoint changes. In this work, we propose a Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA), which introduces a multi-DOF vertex sampling strategy that systematically covers the perspective transformation hierarchy from 2-DOF translation to 8-DOF projective mapping. By generating geometrically diverse input variations, PIA effectively reduces overfitting of adversarial perturbations to the surrogate model, thereby improving adversarial transferability. We further propose PIA-Mix, a generic extension that maintains a complementary transformation pool and efficiently combines our perspective transformation with auxiliary methods for improved transferability. Extensive experiments involving various DNN architectures, advanced defense mechanisms, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) demonstrate that PIA and PIA-Mix outperform state-of-the-art transfer-based attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于透视不变攻击（PIA）的对抗样本迁移攻击方法，通过多自由度顶点采样策略系统覆盖从2-DOF平移到8-DOF射影映射的透视变换层次，生成几何多样的输入变体以降低对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而提升跨模型迁移攻击成功率。并进一步提出PIA-Mix扩展，将透视变换与辅助方法组合进一步提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有输入变换方法主要依赖自由度有限的局部操作（如块级打乱和缩放），忽视了由视角变化自然产生的全局透视变换。这限制了对抗样本跨模型迁移性的提升空间，需要探索更具几何多样性的输入变换方式来减少对替代模型的过拟合。
AI.method: （1）提出多自由度顶点采样策略，系统覆盖从2-DOF平移到8-DOF射影映射的透视变换层次；（2）基于该策略提出PIA，通过生成几何多样的输入变体减少对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合；（3）提出PIA-Mix，维护互补变换池，将透视变换与辅助方法高效组合以提升迁移能力。
AI.result: 在多种DNN架构、先进防御机制以及多模态大语言模型（LLMs）上的大量实验表明，PIA和PIA-Mix在迁移攻击性能上均优于现有的最先进攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 透视变换作为一种全局几何变换，能有效补充现有局部输入变换方法的不足，显著提高对抗样本的跨模型可迁移性；PIA-Mix的互补变换组合策略进一步扩展了该方法的适用范围和攻击效果。

title: US-VLA: An Ultrasound Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Abdomina
summary: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound scanning enhances diagnostic reliability and efficiency by providing real-time guidance for standardized image acquisition and reducing operator dependence. However, existing reinforcement learning and learning-assisted ultrasound scanning methods typically rely on carefully designed reward functions or extensive interaction data, which limits their generalization ability and stability across different devices, patient populations, and complex clinical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an ultrasound vision-language-action model (US-VLA) for automated ultrasound scanning that explicitly encodes clinical semantic goals and generates sequential probe manipulation actions under real-time ultrasound feedback. In particular, we first design an ultrasound-aware expert fusion module to jointly integrate ultrasound observations with auxiliary contextual information, enabling semantic ultrasound feedback to effectively guide the scanning process. Then, we construct US-VLA-Data, a real-world dataset covering liver and kidney examinations, which includes five clinically defined standard planes and comprises 320 expert scanning trajectories with approximately 80,000 synchronized timesteps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that US-VLA achieves competitive performance in ultrasound probe manipulation tasks, indicating its effectiveness and promising generalization within the evaluated abdominal ultrasound setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出US-VLA，一种用于自动化超声扫描的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过显式编码临床语义目标并生成实时探测操作序列，解决现有RL和辅助学习方法中奖励函数设计复杂、依赖大量交互数据导致泛化性差的问题。
AI.motivation: AI辅助超声扫描虽能提升诊断可靠性和效率，但现有强化学习和学习辅助扫描方法通常依赖精心设计的奖励函数或大量交互数据，限制了其在不同设备、患者群体及复杂临床场景中的泛化能力和稳定性。
AI.method: 提出US-VLA框架，核心包括：(1)超声感知专家融合模块，联合整合超声观测与辅助上下文信息，使语义超声反馈有效引导扫描过程；(2)构建US-VLA-Data真实数据集，涵盖肝脏和肾脏检查，包含5个临床定义标准平面，320条专家扫描轨迹，约80,000个同步时间步。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，US-VLA在超声探头操作任务中取得有竞争力的性能，在评估的腹部超声场景中展现出有效性和良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: US-VLA通过视觉-语言-动作建模实现了自动化超声扫描中的语义目标编码和序列动作生成，为腹部超声检查提供了可靠的自动化方案，代码已开源。

title: A Physiology-Informed Digital Twin Framework for Simulating Liver Health Progression
comment: This paper is under review at IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
summary: We present a physiology-informed digital twin of the human liver designed for longitudinal simulation of liver function and early-stage disease progression. The model, referred to as HEPATWIN, integrates key hepatic processes, including carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism, bilirubin conjugation, bile production, and detoxification, within a unified systems-level framework to generate clinically observable biomarker trajectories. Unlike purely data-driven approaches, HEPATWIN incorporates mechanistic representations of liver physiology and patient-specific inputs such as diet, activity, and baseline biomarkers to simulate disease evolution over time. To ensure consistency with clinical progression patterns, we introduce a stage-transition-driven calibration mechanism that aligns simulated outputs with population-level biomarker distributions across disease stages, including NAFLD, fibrosis, and cirrhosis. Validation using the NIDDK NAFLD dataset demonstrates that HEPATWIN produces longitudinal biomarker estimates within clinically acceptable ranges and can forecast trajectories over multi-year horizons. Furthermore, simulated biomarkers retain sufficient clinical signal to support downstream NASH detection with competitive performance relative to models using ground-truth laboratory data. These results highlight the potential of physiology-informed digital twins for personalized, non-invasive diagnosis and prediction of organ health in general and liver health monitoring in particular.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于生理学信息的人体肝脏数字孪生模型HEPATWIN，用于纵向模拟肝功能及早期疾病进展。该模型将碳水化合物、脂质、蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成和解毒等关键肝脏过程整合到统一的系统级框架中，生成临床可观测的生物标志物轨迹。通过阶段转换驱动的校准机制，使模拟输出与不同疾病阶段（NAFLD、纤维化、肝硬化）的人群生物标志物分布对齐。在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上的验证表明，HEPATWIN能在临床可接受范围内生成纵向生物标志物估计，并可预测多年时间跨度的轨迹，且模拟数据支持下游NASH检测的性能与使用真实实验室数据相当。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的方法缺乏对肝脏生理机制的建模，难以进行可靠的多年前瞻性生物标志物预测和个性化疾病进程模拟。研究者希望通过融合生理学机制表示与患者特异性输入，构建能够生成临床可观测生物标志物轨迹的数字孪生模型，实现个性化、非侵入性的肝脏健康监测和早期疾病诊断。
AI.method: HEPATWIN采用统一的系统级框架整合肝脏多类关键代谢过程（糖、脂、蛋白代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成及解毒），结合患者特定输入（饮食、活动、基线生物标志物）进行机制性纵向模拟。引入阶段转移驱动的校准机制，将模拟输出与不同疾病阶段的人群生物标志物分布对齐，确保模拟结果符合临床进展模式。模型在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上进行验证评估。
AI.result: 在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上，HEPATWIN生成的纵向生物标志物估计值处于临床可接受范围内，能够预测多年时间跨度的疾病轨迹；模拟生物标志物保留了足够的临床信号，在下游NASH检测任务中达到了与使用真实实验室数据模型相当的竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: 生理学信息驱动的数字孪生模型在个性化和非侵入性器官健康诊断与预测方面具有显著潜力，尤其适用于肝脏健康监测，为超越纯数据驱动方法的疾病建模与预测提供了可行路径。

title: HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation
summary: Diffusion-based methods have dominated the HOI generation, as they enable critical contact fusions or signals to guide the diffusion process. However, they often result in high artifacts and unstable interaction quality due to error accumulation during iterative denoising. In this work, we propose HOIMask, the first generative masked framework for modeling HOI motion in discrete space. HOIMask first encodes both motion sequences and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D human and object token maps via HOI Vector Quantization (VQ), preserving fine-grained spatial-temporal structure beyond conventional 1D representations. On this basis, a generative masked modeling framework is employed to jointly capture human-object interaction dynamics, leveraging a transformer architecture designed to model complex spatial-temporal and interaction dependencies. To generate more coherent and physically plausible motions, we further introduce a novel contact-aware reconstruction guidance in discrete space during inference, which fuses contact signals to optimize HOI tokens that forces the generated motion with higher spatio-temporal consistency. With craftily designed motion interaction tokens, dedicated architecture and guidance strategy, HOIMask outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, generating more realistic and semantically aligned HOI motions. Please refer to https://jyhflash.github.io/HOIMask/ for more results.

AI.tldr: HOIMask是首个在离散空间中建模人-物交互（HOI）运动的生成式掩码框架。它通过HOI向量量化将运动和接触感知信号编码为离散的2D人体和物体token图，采用掩码生成建模与transformer架构联合捕获交互动态，并引入接触感知重建引导以提升运动的时空一致性和物理合理性，在性能上超越了基于扩散的SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的方法虽然在HOI生成中占据主导，但迭代去噪过程中的误差累积会导致严重的伪影和不稳定的交互质量。因此需要一种能够避免误差累积、生成更稳定且物理合理的人-物交互运动的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出HOI向量量化（VQ），将运动序列和接触感知信号编码为离散2D人体与物体token图，保留细粒度时空结构；2) 采用生成式掩码建模框架，结合transformer架构联合建模人-物交互的空间-时间依赖关系；3) 在推理阶段引入离散空间的接触感知重建引导，通过融合接触信号优化HOI token，提升生成运动的时空一致性与物理合理性。
AI.result: HOIMask在多个基准上超越基于扩散的SOTA方法，生成更真实、语义对齐更准确的HOI运动，减少了伪影并提高了交互质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的运动交互token、专用架构和引导策略，HOIMask验证了离散掩码生成范式在人-物交互运动建模中的优越性，为HOI生成提供了一条替代扩散模型的有效路径。

title: Unified Condition-Action Modeling for Accurate One-Step Action Generation
summary: Robot manipulation requires policies that are both accurate and efficient, as robot control must respond to changing observations under tight latency constraints. Recent diffusion and flow policies are promising, but they often treat conditions as auxiliary signals rather than jointly evolving them with action trajectories. We find that this limitation can be effectively mitigated by a \textbf{simple yet effective unified condition-action modeling design} that represents conditions and actions in a shared token space, allowing a compact model to achieve high performance while improving both inference speed and accuracy.
