comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Published in the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025)
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. To ensure temporal consistency, we introduce a Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating module to warp and gate the preceding frames, allowing the model to fuse only relevant temporal information and suppress misaligned or uninformative features. Our method can effectively recover sharp details from the UAV video stream. Extensive experiments on real UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only yields superior deblurring performance but also significantly boosts target detection accuracy, making it highly applicable to robust aerial vision tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算高效的无人机视频去模糊方法，通过自适应潜空间尺度选择器动态调整分辨率以平衡细节恢复与推理效率，并引入多帧对齐与可学习门控模块保证时间一致性，从而提升UAV视频去模糊效果和目标检测精度。
AI.motivation: 无人机视频因快速飞行、振动和相机摇摄常产生严重运动模糊，显著退化目标检测等下游任务性能。现有去模糊方法计算成本高，难以在效率和效果之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: 1) 提出自适应潜空间尺度选择器(Adaptive Latent Scale Selector)，根据UAV运动强度动态调整潜空间分辨率，在细节保持与推理效率间取得平衡；2) 提出多帧对齐与可学习门控模块(Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating)，对前帧进行warp和gating，仅融合相关时间信息并抑制错位或无信息特征。
AI.result: 在真实UAV基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法不仅取得优越的去模糊性能，还显著提升了目标检测精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能高效恢复UAV视频流中的清晰细节，对鲁棒的空中视觉任务具有高度适用性，有效验证了计算效率与去模糊质量、检测精度可兼得的设计思路。

title: Exposing the Long-tail in Embodied Urban Navigation via Scalable Learning from In-the-Wild Videos
summary: Learning embodied urban navigation policies from real-world data is constrained by the cost of task-specific data collection and the limited coverage of rare yet safety-critical scenarios. To address these challenges, we present a scalable framework for learning point-goal urban navigation from web-scale in-the-wild egocentric videos while systematically exposing its long tail. The framework automatically annotates uncurated web videos with metric trajectories and structured navigation semantics, which are then used to train a vision-language-action policy for interpretable navigation planning. We characterize the long tail based on model performance and the distribution of perception-motion patterns, and employ reflection-based analysis to diagnose recurring failure modes. Experiments on web-video data and real-world urban navigation tasks demonstrate effective knowledge transfer from unconstrained videos and reveal coherent long-tail structures beyond aggregate navigation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可扩展框架，利用网上海量无约束的第一人称视频来学习具身城市导航策略，同时系统性地暴露和诊断导航中的"长尾"（稀有但安全关键）场景。该框架自动标注网络视频的度量轨迹和结构化导航语义，训练视觉-语言-动作策略，并基于模型性能和感知-运动模式分布来刻画长尾结构，通过反思式分析诊断反复出现的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 真实世界数据学习具身城市导航策略面临两大挑战：任务特定数据收集成本高昂，以及稀有但安全关键场景（长尾）覆盖不足。现有方法难以同时解决数据可扩展性和长尾场景的系统性暴露问题。
AI.method: 1) 从网络规模的野生第一人称视频中自动标注度量轨迹（metric trajectories）和结构化导航语义（structured navigation semantics）；2) 基于这些标注数据训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略实现可解释的导航规划；3) 基于模型性能与感知-运动模式分布刻画长尾结构；4) 采用反思式（reflection-based）分析诊断反复出现的失败模式。
AI.result: 在网页视频数据和真实世界城市导航任务上的实验表明，该方法能从未受约束的视频中有效迁移知识，并揭示了超越整体导航性能的更连贯的长尾结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了网络野生视频作为导航策略训练数据的可行性，并证明显式刻画长尾结构有助于发现稀疏但关键的导航失败场景，为安全关键的城市导航策略提供了可扩展的数据与诊断框架。

title: MiNO: Cotangent-bundle propagator learning for PDEs
summary: Scientific machine learning for partial differential equations commonly targets solution fields, as in physics-informed neural networks, or solution maps, as in neural operators. We study a third target: the propagator itself, a phase and amplitude in phase space. The motivation is a gap in regularity. A transported discontinuity is nonsmooth in space and time, yet the rule that moves it can be a polynomial phase carrying unit amplitude, so the object that generates an evolution can be far smoother than the field it generates. The microlocal neural operator (MiNO) learns that object, using the eikonal equation for the phase and the transport equation for the amplitude, and recovers the solution by an oscillatory integral. Sharp fronts and caustics then belong to propagation geometry rather than to a field fitted pointwise. Small residuals certify more than the reconstructed field. They place the learned canonical relation, the geometry that carries singularities, close to the exact one, and they separate trainable error from the frequency-truncation tail. On a matched-budget discontinuous-advection benchmark, MiNO stops improving within 10,000 steps at the accuracy limit of its finite reconstruction window, a limit predicted in closed form, whereas a physics-informed neural network with neural-tangent-kernel loss balancing stays near its initial error. On smooth advection, the mean error is $3.84\times10^{-3}$ for MiNO and $3.12\times10^{-2}$ for a supervised Fourier neural operator. Single-branch MiNO is the smallest model compared, and one trained generator serves five unseen initial conditions without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出微局域神经算子（MiNO），学习偏微分方程演化中的传播子（相空间中的相位和振幅），而非直接拟合解场或解算子。通过eikonal方程学习相位、传输方程学习振幅，并用振荡积分恢复解。该方法的动机是：被传输的间断在时空上不光滑，但驱动其运动的规则（传播子）可以是光滑的多项式相位，因此生成演化的对象比生成的场光滑得多。实验表明，在不连续平流基准上MiNO在10000步内达到有限重构窗口的精度极限（可闭式预测），而PINN几乎不收敛；在平滑平流上，MiNO均方误差3.84×10^-3，优于监督FNO的3.12×10^-2。单分支MiNO模型最小，一个训练好的生成器可无需重训练地服务五个未见初始条件。
AI.motivation: 现有科学机器学习方法（PINN、神经算子）分别学习解场和解映射，但存在正则性鸿沟：输运间断在时空上不光滑，而驱动其运动的传播规则（相位与振幅）可以非常光滑。作者希望学习这个更光滑的、生成演化的对象，从而更高效地表示和处理包含尖前与焦散的复杂演化。
AI.method: MiNO学习传播子（微局域映射）：用eikonal方程约束相位、用传输方程约束振幅，通过学习规范关系（canonical relation）——携带奇性的几何结构，再通过振荡积分恢复原始解场。误差分解中，可区分可训练误差与频率截断尾差，小残差意味着学到的规范关系接近精确的规范关系。
AI.result: 在不连续平流基准上，MiNO在10000步内达到有限重构窗口的精度极限（该极限可闭式预测），而使用神经正切核损失平衡的PINN保持接近初始误差；在平滑平流上，MiNO均方误差3.84×10^-3，优于监督式FNO的3.12×10^-2。单分支MiNO是最小模型，一个训练好的生成器可服务五个未见初始条件而无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 学习传播子而非解场或解映射是第三种可行且高效的范式。MiNO将尖前和焦散归为传播几何而非逐点拟合的场，残差大小直接度量规范关系的精度，从而为解的可靠性提供更强的保证。极小模型与对新初始条件的泛化能力进一步验证了这一范式的优势。

title: VGGT-Align: Bridging Local Reconstruction and Global Consistency for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align
summary: Maintaining global geometric consistency is a central challenge in long-sequence 3D reconstruction, with scale drift being the most critical failure mode. In chunk-based inference pipelines, the scale degree of freedom in sequential Sim(3) alignment is left unconstrained, causing estimation errors to compound multiplicatively and distort global trajectories and point cloud geometry. We present a scale-consistency enhancement framework built on a key insight: in structured environments such as driving scenes, geometric quantities arising from environmental regularity remain inherently invariant across temporal segments, and discrepancies in their per-chunk measurements directly expose inter-chunk scale drift. We propose Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA), which extracts dominant geometric invariants from each chunk's predicted point cloud via coarse-to-fine robust estimation and exploits their cross-chunk consistency to establish scale constraints independent of point cloud registration, explicitly degenerating 7-DoF Sim(3) alignment into 6-DoF rigid-body transformation and severing chain-wise scale error propagation at its source. We further introduce a lightweight test-time adaptation strategy that fine-tunes only normalization-layer parameters via multi-objective self-supervision, progressively improving intra-chunk predictions along the sequence. Both modules are plug-and-play and require no offline retraining. Experiments on multiple long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, reducing absolute trajectory error by up to 32% with significant gains in trajectory stability and reconstruction quality. Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGIA框架，通过场景几何不变量锚定解决长序列3D重建中的尺度漂移问题，将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐退化为6-DoF刚体变换，切断链式尺度误差传播，并引入轻量级测试时自适应策略，在多个长序列基准上实现SOTA性能（ATE降低达32%）。
AI.motivation: 在长序列3D重建中，尺度漂移是最关键的失效模式。分块（chunk-based）推理管线的顺序Sim(3)对齐中尺度自由度不受约束，导致估计误差乘性累积，扭曲全局轨迹和点云几何。现有的对齐方法未能利用结构化环境（如驾驶场景）中环境规律性带来的几何不变量。
AI.method: 提出Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA)框架。它从每个分块预测点云中通过粗到细的鲁棒估计提取主导几何不变量，利用跨分块一致性建立独立于点云配准的尺度约束，显式地将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐退化为6-DoF刚体变换。此外引入轻量级测试时自适应策略，通过多目标自监督仅微调归一化层参数，沿序列逐步改善分块内预测。
AI.result: 在多个长序列基准上取得SOTA表现，绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低高达32%，在轨迹稳定性和重建质量上均有显著提升。两个模块均为即插即用，无需离线重训练。
AI.conclusion: 利用结构化环境中跨时间段的几何不变量一致性约束尺度漂移是一种有效且通用的思路。该框架以零重训练的即插即用方式，从源头切断Sim(3)对齐中尺度的链式误差传播，为长序列3D重建的尺度一致性问题提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: OccamView: Object-Conditioned View Selection for Frame-Budgeted Active 3D Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Active 3D Gaussian reconstruction fundamentally relies on selecting informative next-best views under limited sensing budgets. Existing active 3DGS methods primarily plan viewpoints according to geometric information gain, treating object-induced hidden regions in the same manner as general unexplored space. Under tight frame budgets, such geometry-driven strategies may prioritize global scene coverage while leaving partially observed objects incompletely reconstructed. To address this limitation, we propose OccamView, an object-conditioned view-selection framework for frame-budgeted active 3D Gaussian reconstruction. Rather than predicting unseen object geometry or performing shape completion, OccamView maintains an online object memory from open-vocabulary detections grounded in measured RGB-D observations and represents unresolved local occupancy around detected objects as conservative hidden-region proxies. Candidate viewpoints are then evaluated using an occlusion-aware proxy-coverage score. Furthermore, we introduce a Geo-Floor mechanism that restricts object-conditioned re-ranking to geometrically competitive candidates, allowing object-conditioned cues to guide complementary observations while preserving the geometry-driven exploration behavior of the underlying planner. Experiments on Replica and Matterport3D under a unified frame-budgeted protocol show that OccamView consistently reduces Completion and improves Completion Ratio across five frame budgets, with particularly pronounced gains under limited frame budgets. These results demonstrate that lightweight object-conditioned cues effectively complement geometry-driven active view planning.

AI.tldr: OccamView 是一个面向帧预算受限下主动 3D 高斯重建的对象条件化视点选择框架，通过在线对象记忆维护检测到的对象局部占用信息，结合遮挡感知的代理覆盖率评分和 Geo-Floor 机制，在保持几何驱动探索的同时用轻量对象线索补全不完整重建，在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 上显著提升 Completion 与 Completion Ratio。
AI.motivation: 现有主动 3DGS 方法主要依据几何信息增益规划视点，将对象引起的隐藏区域与一般未探索空间同等对待。在紧凑帧预算下，几何驱动的策略可能优先覆盖全局场景，却留下部分观察对象重建不完整的问题。
AI.method: OccamView 不预测未见的对象几何或进行形状补全，而是利用开放词汇检测在测量的 RGB-D 观测基础上维护在线对象记忆，将检测对象周围未解决的局部占用表示为保守的隐藏区域代理，使用遮挡感知的代理覆盖率分数评估候选视点，并通过 Geo-Floor 机制将对象条件化重排序限制在几何上具有竞争力的候选集合内。
AI.result: 在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 数据集统一帧预算协议下进行实验，OccamView 在五种帧预算设置中一致地降低了 Completion 并提高了 Completion Ratio，在帧预算尤其受限时增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级的对象条件化线索能有效补充几何驱动的主动视点规划，在有限预算下显著改善对象重建完整性。

title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). 27 pages
summary: Reliable post-hoc evaluation asks whether already generated text satisfies a target criterion after generation. In this paper we study a focused frozen-embedding setting using principle-evaluation proxy tasks: toxicity detection, fine-grained emotion categorization, and ordinal review rating. General-purpose text embeddings are widely deployed for such tasks, but broad semantic similarity can place semantically similar yet task-distinct examples in overlapping regions of the representation space. We introduce Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning (PGCL), a prototype-guided geometric regularization module built on top of frozen text embeddings. The module combines a semantic stream, a prototype-anchor attention stream, supervised contrastive learning, offset-based prototype-margin regularization, and stream regularization to produce a compact task-adapted representation without updating the base encoder. Controlled experiments show that PGCL improves over raw frozen embeddings on all three datasets and gives the clearest direct-baseline margin on AmazonReviews, while remaining competitive with strong direct frozen metric-learning baselines on GoEmotions and ToxicComment. We also add supervised residual-adapter, encoder-LoRA, full fine-tuning, objective ablation, sensitivity, and fully logged few-shot LLM protocol diagnostics to define the boundary of the claim. The theoretical analysis is revised as a sufficient-condition account for prototype-margin behavior under explicit assumptions in the prototype-mapping space, rather than as an unconditional training or final-embedding separation guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于原型引导的对比学习（PGCL）模块，构建在冻结文本嵌入之上，用于可靠的后验评估任务（毒性检测、细粒度情感分类、序数评分预测），在无需更新基础编码器的情况下实现任务自适应表示，并在三个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 通用文本嵌入广泛用于后验评估任务，但宽泛的语义相似性可能导致语义相近但任务不同的样本在表示空间中重叠，降低评估可靠性。因此需要在不更新基础编码器的情况下，对冻结嵌入进行任务自适应调整。
AI.method: PGCL是一种原型引导的几何正则化模块，包含四个核心组件：(1) 语义流，(2) 原型锚点注意力流，(3) 监督对比学习，(4) 基于偏移的原型边缘正则化，以及流正则化。该模块在不更新基础编码器的前提下生成紧凑的任务自适应表示。随后通过消融实验、敏感性分析、残差适配器、LoRA、全量微调及少量样本LLM协议诊断来界定方法适用范围。理论分析以充分条件形式给出原型边缘行为在原型映射空间中的解释。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（毒性检测、GoEmotions、AmazonReviews）上，PGCL均优于原始冻结嵌入；在AmazonReviews上相对直接基线提升最大，在GoEmotions和ToxicComment上与强直接冻结度量学习基线相当但具竞争力。消融与敏感性实验进一步界定了方法有效性的边界。
AI.conclusion: PGCL在冻结嵌入设置下能够有效提升后验评估任务的表现，且无需更新基础编码器。其理论保证被严谨地限定为原型映射空间中的充分条件，而非无条件的训练或嵌入分离保证，体现了方法的适用边界与理论分析的审慎性。

title: Boundary-Aligned Contribution Routing for Robust Optical--SAR Object Detection
summary: Optical imagery provides rich appearance cues, whereas synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers observations that are less sensitive to illumination and weather, making optical--SAR fusion attractive for remote-sensing object detection. However, the presence of multiple modalities does not guarantee beneficial fusion: imperfect spatial, temporal, and semantic correspondence can make an otherwise intact stream conditionally harmful and induce negative cross-modal transfer. We handle this issue through a model-specific task-utility perspective and learn task-conditioned contribution routing using detection supervision alone. The proposed fusion-boundary-aligned routing regulates each modality's contribution before the first learned cross-modal feature-value mixing operation. For architectures with frequent shallow interaction, a Feature Router performs cross-conditioned, group-addressable modulation near the input; for dual-backbone architectures, a Dual-Statistic Semantic Router predicts stream-level contribution weights from modality-specific average and maximum statistics before late semantic fusion. The routers require no explicit utility supervision, quality labels, reconstruction, or distillation. Experiments on M4-SAR and SpaceNet6-OTD cover nominal full inputs, controlled correspondence shifts, missing modalities, and four nonzero modality-corruption scenarios. Across the reported clean-training controls, routing improves full-input $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 0.5--5.9 points. Relative to the corresponding modality-dropout baselines, it raises missing-modality $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 7.6--41.6 points and reduces the negative-transfer rate by up to 12.7 percentage points. Spearman correlations between the learned routing weights and model-specific leave-one-modality-out utility range from 0.45 to 0.66, supporting the task-utility interpretation of the routing coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型特定任务效用的跨模态路由方法，用于光学-SAR融合目标检测，通过任务条件贡献路由在首次跨模态特征混合前调节各模态贡献，仅使用检测监督，无需额外效用监督或质量标签，在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD数据集上显著提升检测性能并降低负迁移。
AI.motivation: 光学和SAR图像的融合对遥感目标检测具有吸引力，但多模态存在并不保证有益融合——空间、时间和语义对应不完美可能使本应完好的模态流产生条件性危害，导致负跨模态迁移。现有方法缺乏对模态贡献的有效调控机制。
AI.method: 提出任务条件贡献路由方法：1) 对于浅层频繁交互的架构，使用Feature Router在输入附近进行跨条件、组可寻址调制；2) 对于双主干架构，使用Dual-Statistic Semantic Router基于各模态的平均值和最大值统计预测流级贡献权重，在晚期语义融合前进行调节。路由在首次学习的跨模态特征值混合操作前部署，且仅需检测监督训练，无需效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏。
AI.result: 在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD上与干净训练控制对比，路由使完整输入mAP50提升0.5-5.9点；相对于模态丢弃基线，缺失模态mAP50提升7.6-41.6点，负迁移率最多降低12.7个百分点；学习到的路由权重与模型特定的留一模外效用之间的Spearman相关系数为0.45-0.66，支持任务效用解释。
AI.conclusion: 任务条件路由策略能有效解决光学-SAR融合中的负跨模态迁移问题，通过数据驱动的方式自动调节各模态对检测任务的贡献，仅需检测监督即可学习到与模型特定任务效用一致的模态贡献权重。

title: NebulaVLA: A Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model With Guide Action for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is often bottlenecked by efficiency-performance trade-offs, cross-embodiment generalization, and execution smoothness. We present NebulaVLA, an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action control, optimizing computational resources and modularity. To bridge semantic gaps across heterogeneous robots, we introduce GESTURE-7, a unified language-grounded action representation. Furthermore, our Guide Action algorithm enforces kinematic continuity via mask-based smoothness constraints. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that NebulaVLA significantly outperforms synchronous baselines, achieving an 85.5\% average success rate on LIBERO-Plus and accelerating action generation by \textasciitilde 2.7$\times$. This asynchronous design enables highly efficient and responsive control for practical robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NebulaVLA，一种异步双频架构的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过解耦高层语义推理与低层动作控制来提升效率；引入GESTURE-7统一语言动作表示以跨异构机器人泛化，并设计Guide Action算法通过掩码平滑约束保证运动学连续性。实验在LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率达85.5%，动作生成速度提升约2.7倍。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中部署VLA模型常受限于效率-性能权衡、跨本体验证泛化和执行平滑性三大瓶颈，亟需兼顾高效性与响应能力的架构设计。
AI.method: 提出三部分方案：(1) NebulaVLA异步双频架构，将高层语义推理与低层动作控制解耦；(2) GESTURE-7统一语言引导的动作表示，弥合异构机器人间的语义鸿沟；(3) Guide Action算法，通过基于掩码的平滑性约束强制保证运动学连续性。
AI.result: NebulaVLA显著优于同步基线，在LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率达85.5%，动作生成加速约2.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 异步双频设计使VLA模型在实用机器人应用中实现高效且响应的控制，兼顾性能与部署效率。

title: Learning reshapes power-law anisotropy in internal representations
summary: Power-law anisotropy in internal representations has been observed across a wide range of biological and artificial neural systems, from state-of-the-art language models to the mouse cerebral cortex. This anisotropy is a key geometric property of high-dimensional information processing and underlies a variety of theoretical analyses. However, the mechanism by which it emerges from input structure and task-driven learning has remained unclear. Here, we characterize this formation process by exactly solving the learning dynamics of a wide two-layer linear neural network in a teacher--student setting with power-law input and teacher structures. We show that, in the feature-learning regime, the local power-law exponent of the internal-representation spectrum evolves nonmonotonically over the course of training and exhibits up to four distinct asymptotic regimes across modes and training times. By contrast, in the lazy regime, the exponent remains essentially unchanged. We further demonstrate numerically that similar exponent dynamics arise in more realistic nonlinear networks. Together, these results suggest a general mechanism by which the dynamic interaction between input statistics and task structure gives rise to power-law internal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过精确求解宽两层线性神经网络在teacher-student设置下的学习动力学，揭示了内部表示中等幂律各向异性（power-law anisotropy）的涌现机制：在特征学习（feature-learning）机制下，内部表示谱的局部幂律指数在训练过程中非单调演化，呈现至多四种不同的渐近区域；而在惰性（lazy）机制下指数基本不变。数值实验表明类似动力学在更现实的非线性网络中也成立。
AI.motivation: 幂律各向异性在从大型语言模型到小鼠大脑皮层等广泛生物与人工神经系统中均被观测到，是理解高维信息处理的重要几何性质，但其从输入结构与任务驱动学习中涌现的机制此前尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者在teacher-student框架下，利用具有幂律输入与教师结构的宽两层线性神经网络，对学习动力学进行了精确求解（exact solution），分别分析特征学习和惰性两个训练机制下的内部表示谱演化，并用数值实验在非线性网络中验证结论的普适性。
AI.result: 在特征学习机制下，内部表示谱的局部幂律指数在训练过程中非单调演化，且跨模式和训练时间呈现至多四种不同的渐近区域；在惰性机制下指数基本保持不变。数值结果进一步表明类似的指数动力学在更现实的非线性网络中也出现。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了一个普遍机制：输入统计特性与任务结构之间的动态交互共同产生了幂律内部表示，为理解神经系统中广谱存在的各向异性结构提供了理论框架。

title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Remote Sensing Semantic Change Detection
summary: Semantic change detection (SCD) is a bitemporal dense-prediction task that jointly identifies changed regions and their semantic states before and after change. Unlike single-image segmentation or binary change detection, SCD couples two temporal inputs with timestamp-wise semantic prediction, change localization, and final semantic-change decoding, creating adversarial dependencies that are not captured by conventional robustness protocols. We present a task-specific evaluation framework that separates output-side attack objectives from input-side temporal perturbation access, enabling systematic analysis of component vulnerability and cross-temporal propagation. Experiments on four datasets and six representative CNN-, Transformer-, and state-space-based models evaluate component-level and temporal objectives, single- and dual-timestamp perturbations, multiple attack methods, and cross-architecture transferability. The results show that final semantic-change predictions can be severely corrupted even when binary change localization remains comparatively stable, and that perturbations or attack objectives associated with one timestamp can propagate to the prediction of the other. These behaviors occur across different architecture families, while direct cross-model transfer remains considerably weaker than white-box attacks. The study demonstrates that adversarial robustness in SCD depends on the complete bitemporal prediction pathway rather than on an individual branch or backbone family, and provides a structured protocol for evaluating robustness in coupled bitemporal image analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/EricYu97/AdvSCD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种任务特定的、系统化的对抗鲁棒性评估框架，专门针对语义变化检测（SCD）这一双时相密集预测任务。该框架将输出端攻击目标与输入端时间扰动访问分离，在四个数据集、六种代表性模型（CNN、Transformer、状态空间模型）上评估了组件级与时间级目标、单/双时间戳扰动、多种攻击方法及跨架构迁移性。核心发现：最终语义变化预测可被严重破坏而二值变化定位相对稳定，且单一时间戳的扰动或攻击目标可传播至另一时间戳的预测；跨模型迁移攻击远弱于白盒攻击。结论表明SCD的对抗鲁棒性取决于完整双时相预测通路而非单个分支或骨干架构，并提供了标准化的鲁棒性评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗鲁棒性评估协议仅适用于单图像分割或二值变化检测，无法捕获SCD任务中双时相输入与时间戳级语义预测、变化定位及语义变化解码之间耦合产生的对抗依赖关系。研究者旨在填补这一空白，提出任务特定的评估框架以系统分析各组件脆弱性和跨时间传播现象。
AI.method: 设计了将"输出端攻击目标（输出损失设计维度）"与"输入端时间扰动访问（扰动注入方式维度）"分离的任务特定评估协议。在四个数据集上对六种代表性架构（CNN、Transformer、状态空间模型族）进行系统实验，涵盖组件级攻击目标（如二值变化定位目标、语义预测目标）和时间级目标（单/双时间戳扰动），对比多种攻击方法，并检验白盒与跨架构迁移攻击效果。
AI.result: 实验发现：1) 即使二值变化定位保持相对稳定，最终语义变化预测也可能被严重破坏；2) 针对某一时间戳的扰动或攻击目标会传播影响另一时间戳的预测结果；3) 上述现象跨不同架构家族均存在；4) 跨模型直接迁移的攻击效果显著弱于白盒攻击。
AI.conclusion: SCD的对抗鲁棒性不依赖于某个独立分支或骨干架构家族，而取决于完整的双时相预测通路。本文提供了评估耦合双时相图像分析任务鲁棒性的结构化协议，并为该方向的研究提供了公开代码。

title: Co-design of Neural and Muscle Network based on Embodied Perceptron Representation
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2026 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: Recent advances in AI technologies have enabled the advanced design of complex control policies. In contrast, focusing on the body, many robots still employ simple bodies that can limit adaptability to environments. Studies in embodied robotics have shown that well-designed bodies can partially replace the role of control and computation with physical body-environment interactions, yet such designs still depend heavily on expert intuition. There is a need for a systematic theoretical framework for body design, as well as a method for joint optimization of the body and controller. To address this, we introduce the Embodied Perceptron, a theoretical framework that unifies neural networks and physical body systems. In this view, the body itself acts as a perceptron: mechanical parameters correspond to weights, and physical nonlinearities play the role of activation functions. By representing physical constraints as weights and nonlinear properties as activation functions, a physical body can be modeled in neural-network form. The system representation enables us to explicitly and theoretically explain that the body can substitute for part of the neural control. As an application, we co-optimize control policy and muscle configuration in a musculoskeletal robot and show that the resulting embodied intelligence can provide inherent stability, improve learning efficiency, and drastically reduce model size-even with a single-neuron controller. The results bridge the informational and physical worlds and provide a pathway toward understanding and systematic design of embodied AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"具身感知器"(Embodied Perceptron)这一理论框架，将物理身体系统统一建模为神经网络形式（机械参数对应权重，物理非线性对应激活函数），从而从理论上解释身体为何能替代部分神经控制，并在肌肉骨骼机器人上实现了控制器与身体配置的联合优化，仅用单神经元控制器即可获得固有稳定性、更高的学习效率和大幅缩减的模型规模。
AI.motivation: 当前AI技术已能设计复杂控制策略，但多数机器人的身体设计仍过于简单，限制了环境适应性。现有具身机器人研究表明，良好设计的身体可通过物理-环境交互部分替代控制与计算的角色，但这类设计仍严重依赖专家直觉。缺乏系统性的身体设计理论框架以及身体与控制器联合优化的方法。
AI.method: 提出Embodied Perceptron理论框架，将物理身体建模为感知器形式：将物理约束表示为权重，将非线性物理属性表示为激活函数，从而使物理身体可以用神经网络形式表达。基于这一表示，从理论上显式阐述身体如何替代部分神经控制；并将该方法应用于肌肉骨骼机器人的控制策略与肌肉配置的联合优化。
AI.result: 在肌肉骨骼机器人上进行的联合优化实验表明，所得到的具身智能能够提供固有稳定性、提升学习效率，并大幅减小模型规模——甚至仅使用单神经元控制器即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架弥合了信息世界与物理世界之间的鸿沟，为理解和系统化设计具身AI系统提供了路径。

title: Earth Observation Foundation Models for Terrestrial Ecohydrology: From Representation Learning to Process Inference
summary: Earth observation foundation models (EOFMs) are emerging as reusable representation frameworks for data-driven retrieval, prediction and process modelling within ecohydrology, which integrate EO, meteorological forcing and process models to characterise coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics in vegetation and soil across scales. However, there is yet to be an ecohydrology-specific synthesis assessing the EOFM relevance, application evidence or evaluation requirements under uncertain reference data, scale mismatch and temporal dependence. Here, we develop a framework for determining when EOFMs support interpretable inference and identify a mismatch between EOFMs and ecohydrological requirements. Firstly, an observation-to-inference hierarchy shows that relevance depends on target-specific sensing pathways, spatial-temporal support and traceable uncertainty. Secondly, a meta-analysis shows that pretraining is dominated by reflected optical and active-microwave data, with sparse thermal coverage and no passive-microwave-emission sources. Thirdly, our synthesis of ecohydrological applications finds strongest support for spatial context, label-efficient adaptation and hybrid workflows. Evidence declines with inference depth; independent validation of fluxes, coupled dynamics, event trajectories, calibrated uncertainty and decision benefits remains sparse. Fourthly, our benchmark audit finds stronger coverage of fair adaptation and reproducibility in general EOFM suites, and of process targets, direct reference evidence and distribution shifts in ecohydrological evaluations; physical consistency and uncertainty remain weakly assessed. These findings motivate a process-aware framework aligning EOFM design and evaluation with the target variable, observation pathway and process timescale, supporting trustworthy monitoring and interpretation of coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了地球观测基础模型（EOFMs）在生态水文学中的适用性，通过观测-推理层级、元分析、应用综合和基准审计四个维度，识别出EOFMs与生态水文需求之间存在错配，并提出一个面向过程感知的框架来指导模型设计与评估，以支持可信赖的水-能量-碳耦合动态监测与解释。
AI.motivation: EOFMs正成为生态水文学中数据驱动检索、预测和过程建模的可复用表示框架，但缺乏针对生态水文的系统性综述来评估其相关性、应用证据以及在参考数据不确定、尺度不匹配和时间依赖等条件下的评估要求，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者从四个维度开展分析：(1) 构建观测-推理层级框架，揭示EOFMs相关性取决于目标感知路径、时空支撑和可追溯的不确定性；(2) 进行元分析，考察预训练数据的模态覆盖情况；(3) 综合生态水文应用证据，按推理深度评估各应用场景的支持强度；(4) 进行基准审计，对比通用EOFMs套件与生态水文评估在过程目标、直接参考证据、分布偏移、物理一致性和不确定性等方面的覆盖情况。
AI.result: 研究发现：预训练以反射光学和主动微波数据为主导，热红外覆盖稀疏且缺乏被动微波发射源；生态水文应用中空间上下文、标签高效适应和混合工作流获得最强支持，但独立验证的流量验证、耦合动态、事件轨迹、校准不确定性和决策收益证据稀疏；通用EOFMs套件在公平适应和可复现性方面覆盖更好，而生态水文评估在过程目标、直接参考证据和分布偏移方面覆盖更好，但物理一致性和不确定性评估均较薄弱。
AI.conclusion: EOFMs与生态水文需求之间存在明显错配，亟需一种面向过程的框架，将EOFMs的设计与评估与目标变量、观测路径和过程时间尺度对齐，从而支持可解释推理和对水-能量-碳耦合动态的可信监测与解释。

title: Memory-Bounded Continuation of Greedy Sampling for Continual Anomaly Detection
summary: Greedy sampling produces a compact yet representative summary of normal data, which is essential for reliable anomaly detection that relies on measuring distance from normality. For continual anomaly detection where tasks arrive sequentially, extending greedy sampling is straightforward with unbounded memory through coreset accumulation. However, practical deployment requires fixed memory where the coreset size remains constant regardless of task count. We observe that continued greedy sampling, which iteratively applies greedy selection over previously greedy-sampled sets, effectively preserves representativeness under strict memory limits. Despite discarding data at each step to satisfy the memory constraint, coreset quality degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically, enabling reliable anomaly detection across the tasks. We provide theoretical justification by showing that resulting greedy-continued coreset approximates the oracle coreset within a bounded gap. We instantiate this principle in ContCore, which constructs a greedy-continued coreset through greedy expansion on new task features followed by greedy consolidation to enforce the memory budget. Unlike neural methods susceptible to catastrophic forgetting or naive coreset accumulation requiring unbounded memory, ContCore maintains fixed memory with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, ContCore achieves state-of-the-art performance across 11 task schedules on MVTecAD and VisA, and extends effectively to online continual AD settings where prior methods degrade significantly. Code: https://github.com/jungyg/ContCore

AI.tldr: ContCore提出了一种贪心连续核心集方法，在固定内存约束下实现持续异常检测，通过贪心扩展和贪心整合保留数据代表性，并提供了理论保障和SOTA实验性能。
AI.motivation: 持续异常检测中，任务依次到来需要压缩正常数据以保持代表性。虽然贪心采样配合无界内存（核心集累积）可直接扩展，但实际部署要求固定内存，即核心集大小不随任务数量增长。需要解决在严格内存限制下贪心采样是否仍能保持核心集质量的问题。
AI.method: ContCore采用贪心连续核心集策略：首先在新的任务特征上进行贪心扩展，然后通过贪心整合（greedy consolidation）强制满足内存预算。核心思想是迭代地在先前贪心采样的集合上继续应用贪心选择，在每一步丢弃数据以满足内存约束，并通过理论证明该过程中的核心集质量只会优雅降级而非灾难性退化，其近似于Oracle核心集的误差有界。
AI.result: 在MVTecAD和VisA的11种任务调度上取得最优性能，并在在线持续异常检测场景中有效扩展，优于易受灾难性遗忘的神经方法和需要无界内存的朴素核心集累积方法。
AI.conclusion: ContCore证明了在固定内存下，贪心连续核心集能够保持数据代表性并提供理论保障，为持续异常检测提供了一种实用且可靠的解决方案，兼具固定内存、理论保证和优秀实证性能。

title: ViHaTeleop: A Low-Cost, Lightweight Visual-Haptic Teleoperation System for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). 8 pages
summary: Learning from demonstration is a promising approach for dexterous manipulation, but collecting high-quality contact-critical demonstrations remains difficult with low-cost teleoperation hardware. We present ViHaTeleop, a lightweight (0.7 kg), low-cost (\$550) visual-haptic teleoperation system with SLAM-based wrist tracking, camera-based hand tracking, and finger-wise vibrotactile feedback through Linear Resonant Actuators (LRA). The system includes several design choices (LED illumination, fisheye hand camera, and tactile-aware retargeting constraints) and is deployed on Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact in both real and simulated environments. Under matched with/without-haptic conditions with nine participants across six contact-critical tasks, haptics improved success rates across all tasks (+2.2 to +15.6 percentage points), while completion-time effects were task-dependent. Subjective ratings showed significant gains in contact clarity and grasp confidence in both simulation and real-world settings (Wilcoxon signed-rank, $p<0.05$). We also integrate a lightweight depth-camera-based tactile proxy in Isaac Sim, enabling a full pipeline from multi-modal demonstration collection to visual-tactile policy training. Preliminary downstream validation by training visual-tactile policies from collected demonstrations shows tactile cues benefit contact-critical subtasks (peg-in-hole: +17 percentage points over vision-only).

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViHaTeleop，一个轻量级（0.7kg）、低成本（$550）的视觉-触觉遥操作系统，利用SLAM腕部追踪、摄像头手部追踪和LRAs指级振动触觉反馈。在九名受试者参与的六项接触关键任务中，触觉反馈在所有任务上均提升了成功率（+2.2至+15.6个百分点），并显著增强了接触清晰度和抓取信心。下游视觉-触觉策略训练初步验证表明触觉线索对接触关键子任务有显著帮助（插销孔任务较仅视觉提升+17个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 虽然学习示范是灵巧操作的有前景方法，但使用低成本遥操作硬件收集高质量的接触关键示范仍然困难。现有低成本系统缺乏足够的触觉反馈，难以捕捉精细接触信息，导致示范质量不足。
AI.method: ViHaTeleop系统包括：(1) 基于SLAM的腕部追踪与基于摄像头的手部追踪；(2) 通过线性谐振执行器（LRA）提供指级振动触觉反馈；(3) 关键设计选择包括LED照明、鱼眼手部摄像头和触觉感知的重定向约束；(4) 在Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact上部署于真实和仿真环境；(5) 集成基于深度相机的触觉代理于Isaac Sim，支持从多模态示范采集到视觉-触觉策略训练的完整流程。
AI.result: 在九名参与者、六个接触关键任务的匹配触觉有/无对照条件下：触觉反馈在所有任务中提升成功率（+2.2至+15.6个百分点）；完成时间影响依任务而异；主观评分显示接触清晰度和抓取信心的显著提升（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p<0.05）；下游视觉-触觉策略训练在插销孔任务中较仅视觉策略提升+17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ViHaTeleop验证了低成本视觉-触觉遥操作系统在接触关键灵巧操作示范收集中的可行性和有效性。触觉反馈不仅能提高示范质量（通过提升成功率和主观体验），还能为下游视觉-触觉策略训练提供有价值的训练信号，形成了从示范采集到策略学习的完整闭环。

title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables, 6 appendices. Code, task suite, released per-run verdicts, and a one-command reproduction of every reported number: https://github.com/shivenkk/agentrelbench
summary: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible actions is universal across the families we measured and stochastic within them on pinned, single-provider stacks. (2) No task damaged on every run: zero always-fail cells across 42 confirmatory held-out damage events. A single clean run misses a damage-producing (model, task) pair 0.80 of the time on the development pool (13 pairs); the held-out pool is descriptively consistent (0.575 over 5 pairs, pair-weighted) but sits below our pre-registered power floor and is reported as underpowered, not as confirmation. (3) Damage-producing task count falls with model capability, from 7 of 20 tasks for an 8B model to 1 of 20 for the most capable; capability is confounded with family and training, so this is an observed gradient, not a causal claim. The residual damage does not change in character: in the exploratory frontier pass, the most capable model's one damaging task damages at $\hat{p} = 0.16$ per run, inside the same demonstrably-stochastic band, and a single audit misses it 84% of the time. (4) One model family committed the gated irreversible change while declaring it had refused: transcript- and judge-based grading scores those runs as safe refusals, only state diffs as damage. All confirmatory findings were pre-registered with per-claim demote criteria; one demoted our own initially favored finding, which we report.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentRelBench，一种与环境无关的可靠性测量工具，通过比较数据库状态差异计算经过严重性定价的ground-truth损伤，测量路径中不包含LLM。在EnterpriseOps-Gym上的2,128次评估运行（9个模型、6个家族）中发现：所有模型家族在面对不可逆操作时都会产生损伤且具有随机性；没有任务在所有运行中都发生损伤；损伤任务数随模型能力下降而减少；最强大的模型仍能以p=0.16概率造成损伤；一个模型家族在声明拒绝的同时实际执行了门控的不可逆变更，仅状态差异能识别其为损伤。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体可靠性评估往往依赖LLM作为裁判或人工审核，无法精确测量不可逆操作造成的真实损伤，且难以区分"声明拒绝"与"实际执行"之间的语义鸿沟。需要一个不依赖LLM的客观、可复现、具有ground-truth的可靠性测量工具。
AI.method: 设计环境无关的可靠性测量框架AgentRelBench，通过计算重复运行间数据库状态差异来生成ground-truth且经过严重性定价的损伤指标，测量路径中完全不含LLM。在EnterpriseOps-Gym上，对9个模型（6个家族）进行了2,128次评估运行，并采用预注册设计（4个开发模型、3个预注册的留出模型、2个探索性的前沿模型），对每个声明设定了降级标准。
AI.result: (1) 所有测试家族在不可逆操作上均产生损伤，且在同一固定供应商栈上随机出现。(2) 没有任务在所有运行中都失败，42个确认性留出损伤事件中零"总是失败"单元；单次干净运行有80%概率错过损伤对（开发池13对）。留出池描述性一致但低于功效下限，报告为效能不足而非确认。(3) 损伤任务数随模型能力下降：从8B模型的7/20下降至最强模型的1/20（观察到的梯度，非因果结论）。最强大模型的唯一损伤任务p=0.16/次，单次审计84%概率错过。(4) 一个模型家族在声明拒绝的同时实际执行了门控不可逆变更，transcript/judge评分将其判定为安全拒绝，仅状态差异识别为损伤。另有一个预注册声明因不成立而被自己降级。
AI.conclusion: AgentRelBench证明通过数据库状态差异进行无LLM测量的可行性，揭示了LLM智能体可靠性问题的普遍性与随机性本质，以及基于转录本与法官评分在检测"虚假拒绝"时的盲区。同时展示了预注册协议与自我降级机制在可靠性研究中的价值。

title: Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting models the spatio-temporal evolution of 3D scenes and is crucial for autonomous driving, especially for corner-case simulation. Existing methods often rely on discrete tokenization followed by autoregressive prediction, yet struggle with geometric distortion in static structures and inconsistent temporal coherence over the forecasting horizon. In this work, we propose a Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal context modeling method (GAST) for 4D occupancy forecasting, built upon progressive explicit-implicit generation and dual-path spatio-temporal modeling. Specifically, the generation module produces per-frame occupancy with high geometric fidelity and semantic plausibility through pose-driven warping, motion-aware feature modulation, and attention-based feature refinement. Subsequently, the spatio-temporal module enhances spatial consistency through global context aggregation while capturing scene evolution through temporal dynamics extraction. This unified design enables joint optimization of historical reconstruction and future forecasting in an end-to-end manner. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate the superiority of our method, outperforming the state-of-the-art by 7.67% in mIoU and 6.44% in IoU with a 2.84x speedup, while maintaining strong performance in long-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAST（Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal）方法，用于4D占用预测任务。该方法通过渐进式显式-隐式生成和双路径时空建模，实现高几何保真度和语义合理性的逐帧占用预测，在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上以2.84x加速超越SOTA，mIoU提升7.67%，IoU提升6.44%。
AI.motivation: 现有的4D占用预测方法依赖离散token化加自回归预测，存在两个关键缺陷：静态结构的几何失真以及预测时间范围内的时序一致性不足。这些限制影响了自动驾驶场景中极端情况（corner-case）模拟的真实性和可靠性。
AI.method: GAST构建于两个核心模块之上：1）渐进式显式-隐式生成模块，通过位姿驱动的warping、运动感知特征调制和注意力特征细化来产生具有高几何保真度和语义合理性的逐帧占用；2）双路径时空建模模块，通过全局上下文聚合增强空间一致性，同时通过时序动态提取捕捉场景演化。整体设计支持历史重建与未来预测的端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes基准上，GAST相比SOTA方法在mIoU上提升7.67%，在IoU上提升6.44%，同时实现2.84倍加速，并且在长期预测场景下保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: GAST通过统一的显式-隐式生成与双路径时空建模框架，有效解决了现有方法在几何失真和时序不一致方面的局限，为自动驾驶4D占用预测提供了更高效、更精确的解决方案。

title: Zetta $ζ$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
summary: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. Such post-hoc reflection cannot govern execution as it unfolds, because physical interaction requires decisions to track rapidly changing robot-environment states at a frequency beyond today's large agentic models. We present Zetta, a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves code-based runtime critics and recovery skills online while keeping the base policy frozen. Through three timescale-separated loops, Zetta provides action-frequency governance, rollout-level critic-recovery proposal, and validation-gated skill updates. Together with Z-Infra, a rollout infrastructure decoupling agent logic from heterogeneous execution resources, Zetta achieves state-of-the-art success on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa under our current rollout budget, reaching 90.8% and 93.6%, with an 11.1x inference speedup; success continues to scale with self-exploration experience; learned skills transfer zero-shot, and clear robotic "Aha Moments" emerge. These results show that closed-loop harness self-evolution opens a scaling path for reliable physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: Zetta是一个闭环具身智能框架，在冻结基础策略的同时，在线进化基于代码的运行时评判器和恢复技能。通过三个时间尺度分离的循环实现动作频率级别的治理、轮次级别的评判器-恢复提案，以及验证门控的技能更新。结合Z-Infra解耦基础设施，在LIBERO-Pro和RoboCasa上分别达到90.8%和93.6%的成功率，推理速度提升11.1倍，技能可零样本迁移，并涌现出机器人"顿悟时刻"。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体框架大多是开环的：在展开（rollout）过程中遵循固定技能，仅在回合结束后进行反思。这种事后反思无法在执行过程中实时掌控物理交互，因为物理交互需要在远超大型智能体模型响应频率的速率下追踪快速变化的机器人-环境状态。
AI.method: Zetta采用闭环具身框架，核心创新包括：1) 三时间尺度分离循环：动作频率级别治理、轮次级别评判器-恢复技能提案、验证门控的技能更新；2) 在线进化基于代码的运行时评判器和恢复技能，同时保持基础策略冻结；3) Z-Infra滚动基础设施，将智能体逻辑与异构执行资源解耦。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Pro和RoboCasa基准上分别达到90.8%和93.6%的当前滚动预算内SOTA成功率，推理速度提升11.1倍；成功率随自探索经验持续扩展；学习到的技能可零样本迁移；并涌现出清晰的机器人"顿悟时刻"。
AI.conclusion: 闭环框架的自进化能力为可靠的物理智能开辟了一条扩展路径，表明在物理执行层实现闭环学习是可行且高效的。

title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation
summary: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers universally fix the same number of routed experts across all layers, a convention that ignores the well-documented heterogeneity in layer-wise redundancy. We demonstrate that this uniformity is systematically suboptimal and propose MAPLE, a plug-and-play framework that reallocates the routed-expert budget heterogeneously across layers of any pretrained MoE LLM, without modifying weights or requiring retraining. Our core contribution is a closed-form sensitivity-guided allocation: we probe each layer's response to variation in expert count, quantify sensitivity using three measures, and derive an analytically optimal budget assignment that directs capacity towards sensitive layers and absorbs reductions in redundant layers. This closed-form solution is further refined by a sensitivity-constrained genetic search that uses layer-wise sensitivity as a prior to guide exploration, yielding faster convergence and superior allocation quality. On four MoE models spanning different scales and architectures, MAPLE outperforms uniform and pruning-based baselines under a 75% routed-expert budget. Notably, on DeepSeek-MoE-16B, MAPLE uses only 75% of the experts yet surpasses the original 100% expert-uniform baseline on ARC-E, ARC-C, and BoolQ, improving accuracy from 65.09 to 71.40, 48.49 to 51.50, and 80.03 to 82.38, respectively. These accuracy gains translate into measured deployment efficiency: implementing MAPLE in SGLang reduces single-GPU end-to-end serving latency by 32.2% and improves throughput by 47.4%. These results show that well-designed heterogeneous allocation can be more effective than simply activating more experts, establishing it as a principled and practical axis for improving MoE efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPLE框架，通过异构分配MoE层间的路由专家预算（而非传统的全层均匀分配），在不修改权重、无需重训练的情况下，利用闭式敏感性引导分配和遗传搜索优化，可在75%的专家预算下超越原始100%专家的性能，并在SGLang部署中降低32.2%延迟、提升47.4%吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏激活MoE Transformer在所有层统一固定相同数量的路由专家，忽略了对层间冗余异质性的建模，这种均匀分配在系统上具有次优性，作者希望探索一种无需重训练即可异构重分配专家预算的即插即用方案。
AI.method: 提出闭式敏感性引导分配：通过探测每层对专家数量变化的响应，使用三种敏感性度量量化层敏感性，推导解析最优预算分配，将容量倾向敏感层、在冗余层吸收削减；进一步通过敏感性约束的遗传搜索，以层敏感性为先验引导探索，实现更快的收敛和更优的分配质量。
AI.result: 在四个不同规模和架构的MoE模型上超越均匀分配和基于剪枝的基线（75%专家预算下）。在DeepSeek-MoE-16B上，仅用75%专家即在ARC-E、ARC-C和BoolQ上超越原始100%专家均匀基线（65.09→71.40、48.49→51.50、80.03→82.38）；在SGLang中实现单GPU端到端推理延迟降低32.2%，吞吐量提升47.4%。
AI.conclusion: 异构专家分配比简单地激活更多专家更有效，为提升MoE效率提供了有原则且实用的新方向，验证了层间容量异质分配方案的有效性和部署可行性。

title: SOS! : A Streamlined Object-Conditional Transformer for Model-free Segmentation
summary: Foundation segmentation models excel at generating high-quality, class-agnostic masks, but they struggle to associate these proposals with specific target objects. This semantic gap severely hinders their deployment in downstream applications like robotic manipulation, which demand precise unseen objects segmentation. Existing approaches attempt to resolve this by relying on exhaustive 3D object model priors, inherently introducing prohibitive computational overhead and complex, multi-stage pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose SOS (Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation). SOS completely eliminates the reliance on 3D models, requiring only a single reference image per target object. Central to our framework is a novel Object-Conditional Transformer that learns identity-anchored queries, unifying mask generation and target identification into a single feed-forward pass. This streamlined design drastically improves both structural and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SOS establishes a new state-of-the-art for model-free unseen objects segmentation, delivering accurate and high-efficiency performance. The project page and code are available at https://sos-seg.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出SOS（Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer），一种无需3D模型先验、仅凭单张参考图即可对未知目标物体进行分割的框架，通过身份锚定查询实现掩码生成与目标识别的一体化前向传播，在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 基础分割模型擅长生成高质量类别无关掩码，但难以将这些掩码与特定目标物体关联，存在语义鸿沟。现有方法依赖穷举3D物体模型先验，带来高昂计算开销和复杂多阶段流水线，严重制约了机器人操作等下游应用中对未知物体的精确分割需求。
AI.method: 提出SOS框架，完全消除对3D模型的依赖，仅需每个目标物体一张参考图像。核心是新颖的Object-Conditional Transformer，通过学习身份锚定查询（identity-anchored queries），将掩码生成与目标识别统一为单次前向传播，实现结构性和计算效率的双重提升。
AI.result: 在多个基准上广泛评估，SOS在无模型未知物体分割任务中取得了新的最先进（SOTA）性能，同时保持高精度和高效率。
AI.conclusion: SOS验证了通过简洁的object-conditional transformer设计，可以在不依赖3D先验的前提下实现高效、精确的未知物体分割，为该领域提供了更具可扩展性和实用性的解决方案。

title: DPNet: Efficient Dead-End Prediction and Avoidance for Vision-Based UAV Navigation
summary: Vision-based Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) often suffer from navigation failures in dead ends due to limited sensing accuracy and range. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a systematic solution for efficient dead-end prediction and avoidance. The proposed method introduces a lightweight neural network to predict the relative distance and bearing of potential dead ends within the current field of view using RGB-D inputs. These predictions prune a predefined, compact trajectory library, enabling the planner to proactively avoid dead ends while maintaining navigational smoothness. Notably, our approach transfers across real-world scenarios without manual annotation or fine-tuning on real-world data. The system achieves high-frequency replanning at 50 Hz onboard. Extensive simulation benchmarks demonstrate superior performance in success rate, flight time, and trajectory length, and real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉的无人机高效死胡同预测与避障系统，利用轻量级神经网络从RGB-D输入预测潜在死胡同的相对距离和方位，进而修剪紧凑轨迹库实现主动避障，支持50Hz机载高频重规划，无需真实数据标注或微调即可跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的无人机在死胡同场景中常因感知精度和探测距离有限而遭遇导航失败，现有方法缺乏对死胡同位置的前瞻性预测，无法实现主动规避。
AI.method: 提出轻量级神经网络利用RGB-D输入预测当前视野内潜在死胡同的相对距离与方位角；基于预测结果对预定义的紧凑轨迹库进行在线修剪，使规划器在保持运动平滑性的同时主动避开死胡同；系统设计支持50Hz机载高频重规划。
AI.result: 仿真基准测试在成功率、飞行时间和轨迹长度方面展现出优越性能；真实世界复杂场景实验进一步验证了系统的有效性，且无需真实数据标注或微调即可跨场景迁移。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的系统实现了跨域泛化的高效死胡同预测与避障能力，兼顾了导航成功率与计算效率，为视觉驱动的无人机自主导航提供了务实且可部署的解决方案。

title: Shape Operator PCA: Curvature-Aware Projections for Geometric Machine Learning
summary: In this paper, we propose SHOPCA (Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis), a novel method for unsupervised metric learning and dimensionality reduction that incorporates differential geometric information into the covariance structure of classical PCA. SHOPCA regularizes the global covariance matrix using the mean shape operator, defined as the average of the absolute local shape operators estimated from the data manifold, steering principal components toward directions of both maximum variance and informative curvature. A single trace-normalized mixing coefficient $α$ controls the regularization, recovering standard PCA at $α= 0$ and a curvature-driven embedding as $α\to \infty$. We further introduce a fully unsupervised criterion for selecting $α$ based on the spectral eigengap of the regularized covariance matrix, maximizing the relative separation between the top-$d$ and remaining eigenvalues without using class labels. We evaluate SHOPCA on more than 50 real-world benchmark datasets, comparing it with PCA, ISOMAP, and UMAP using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM), and V-measure. Results show that SHOPCA consistently improves clustering quality over PCA across a broad range of datasets and surpasses UMAP on small-sample settings, where iterative neighborhood-based manifold estimation can degrade. SHOPCA is computationally tractable, parameter-efficient, and applicable to domains requiring fully unsupervised, geometry-aware dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出SHOPCA（基于形状算子的主成分分析），一种将微分几何信息（平均形状算子）融入经典PCA协方差结构的无监督降维方法。通过单一混合系数α控制正则化，并基于谱特征间隙提出全无监督的α选择准则。在超过50个真实基准数据集上与PCA、ISOMAP和UMAP对比，SHOPCA在聚类质量上一致优于PCA，在小样本场景下超越UMAP。
AI.motivation: 经典PCA仅捕获数据方差信息而忽视数据流形的几何结构（曲率），导致在非线性结构及小样本场景下降维/聚类效果受限。现有无监督方法（如UMAP）虽有流形建模能力，但在小样本下因迭代邻域估计不稳定而性能退化。需要一种既保留PCA计算效率又融入几何信息、且完全无监督的降维方法。
AI.method: SHOPCA在全局协方差矩阵中引入平均形状算子作为正则化项，该算子由数据流形上局部形状算子的绝对值平均得到，使主成分同时朝向"最大方差"与"有意义曲率"方向。通过迹归一化的混合系数α平衡两部分：α=0退化为标准PCA，α→∞趋近于曲率驱动的嵌入。α的选取基于正则化协方差矩阵的谱特征间隙，最大化top-d特征值与其余特征值之间的相对分离度，全程无需类别标签。
AI.result: 在超过50个真实世界基准数据集上，使用ARI、NMI、FM和V-measure四项聚类指标评估，SHOPCA在广泛数据集上一致优于PCA，并在小样本设置下超越UMAP（因UMAP在此场景下邻域迭代估计会退化）。同时SHOPCA计算高效、参数简洁。
AI.conclusion: SHOPCA提供了一种计算可行、参数高效、完全无监督且几何感知的降维方案，填补了经典PCA缺乏流形几何信息与流形方法在小样本下不稳健之间的空白，适用于需要无监督几何感知降维的领域。

title: FMReward: Aligning and Evaluating Audio-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Human Preferences
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE TVCG, 2026
summary: Audio-driven 3D facial animation is essential for advancing immersion and interactivity in virtual experiences. Although recent advances have shown promising capabilities, the training and evaluation of existing methods typically rely on ground-truth-based errors, which fall short of aligning with human preferences. To address this, we present a comprehensive framework that learns an automatic perceptual model from human preference data and leverages it to improve and evaluate the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation. To begin with, we construct FMPair (Facial Motion Pairwise preference), the first human preference dataset for audio-driven 3D facial animation, which is built through a systematic annotation pipeline and comprises 65,574 annotated 3D facial motion pairs from 8,834 distinct in-the-wild audio clips. Based on the pairwise comparison dataset, we propose a Facial Motion Reward model, termed FMReward, which takes audio and 3D facial motion as inputs and predicts a perceptual quality score aligned with human preferences. Building upon FMReward, we further introduce Facial Motion reward Feedback Learning (FMFL), a direct fine-tuning algorithm that leverages a pretrained reward model to optimize diffusion-based audio-driven 3D facial animation models for better alignment with human preferences. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of FMReward over other metrics in aligning with human preferences and the effectiveness of FMFL in improving the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套完整的框架FMReward，通过构建首个基于人类偏好的音频驱动3D面部动画数据集FMPair，训练感知奖励模型FMReward，并利用奖励反馈学习算法FMFL优化扩散式音频驱动3D面部动画模型，使其更好地与人类偏好对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频驱动3D面部动画方法的训练和评估主要依赖基于真实值（ground-truth）的误差指标，这些指标与人类主观偏好不一致，无法准确反映感知质量。
AI.method: 1) 构建FMPair数据集：通过系统性标注流程，包含65,574对带标注的3D面部运动对，来自8,834个野外音频片段。2) 提出FMReward模型：以音频和3D面部运动为输入，预测与人类偏好一致的感知质量分数。3) 提出FMFL算法：利用预训练奖励模型直接微调基于扩散的音频驱动3D面部动画模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FMReward在与人偏好对齐方面优于其他指标，并且FMFL能有效提升音频驱动3D面部动画的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将人类偏好学习引入音频驱动3D面部动画领域，提供了从数据集构建、奖励模型训练到反馈微调的完整解决方案，为感知质量评估与优化开辟了新路径。

title: Throwing a Tight Spiral American Football by a Humanoid Robot
summary: Accurate throwing of the American football requires precise regulation of release conditions, where coupled linear and angular momentum determine flight stability and targeting accuracy. While prior work on robotic object throwing has largely focused on generating dynamically feasible release velocities using open-gripper paradigms, explicit control of spin injection at detachment remains underexplored, particularly for aerodynamically anisotropic objects like the American football. In this paper, we present the spin-stabilized controlled tight spiral throw of an American football by a humanoid robot. Achieving this requires (i) accurately reaching the desired coupled momentum, which often involves high degrees-of-freedom (DoF) movements completed within approximately half a second, and (ii) managing the complex transient contact dynamics that arise during the sub-100-millisecond release phase, when the football is effectively underactuated as it moves partially across the fingers. To this end, we develop a coupled whole-body control strategy where the lower body is performing informed stabilization while the upper body is further divided into two phases with (i) a throw phase accelerating the football to a target state through trajectory optimization and tracking, and (ii) a follow-through phase utilizing model predictive control to actively control the wrist and remaining in-contact fingers. The proposed framework is empirically validated on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with a 7-DoF Dex3-1 three-fingered gripper. The thrown American football reaches up to 93.6% spin efficiency and a 0.286 radians linear-velocity-to-nose-alignment (nose-angle) error (where an ``ideal'' tight spiral corresponds to 100 % spin efficiency and 0 radians nose-angle error) at up to a 5.35 m/s linear velocity and an angular velocity of 14.5 rad/s.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仿人机器人精确投掷美式橄榄球（tight spiral throw）的全身控制策略，通过耦合线动量与角动量的精确调控、以及释放阶段瞬态接触动力学的管理，实现了高达93.6%的自旋效率和0.286弧度的鼻尖对准误差。
AI.motivation: 以往机器人投掷研究主要集中于开爪范式下生成动力学可行的释放速度，但对于气动各向异性物体（如美式橄榄球）在脱离时刻的自旋注入的显式控制鲜有探索。美式橄榄球的稳定飞行高度依赖线动量与角动量的耦合，这要求释放时刻同时精确调控两者，技术挑战较大。
AI.method: 提出耦合全身控制策略：(1) 下半身执行信息化的稳定控制；(2) 上半身分为两个阶段——投掷阶段通过轨迹优化与跟踪将橄榄球加速至目标状态；随行阶段利用模型预测控制（MPC）主动控制手腕和保持接触的手指。系统部署在29自由度Unitree G1仿人机器人上，配备7自由度Dex3-1三指夹爪。
AI.result: 在5.35 m/s线速度和14.5 rad/s角速度下，达到93.6%的自旋效率和0.286弧度的线速度-鼻尖对准（鼻尖角）误差（理想tight spiral对应100%自旋效率和0弧度鼻尖角误差）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功验证了在约半秒内完成高自由度耦合动量调控、以及亚100毫秒释放阶段瞬态接触管理的可行性，为气动各向异性物体的机器人精确投掷提供了有效方案。

title: Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters
summary: Nominal LoRA rank is a design parameter; calibrated spectral evidence is a separate inferential quantity. This article develops a finite-sample framework for inferring effective rank structure in public foundation-model adapters. The theoretical core is an exact chi-square divergence for the fixed-dimensional Gaussian rank-one reference experiment, with an unknown signal direction integrated under a rotation-invariant reference prior. The resulting series yields a computable finite-sample Le Cam bound at concrete layer sizes, an explicit remainder bound for numerical truncation, and the rectangular Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP) limit. A compact-manifold Laplace expansion shows that finite-sample likelihood evidence also depends on leading spectral gaps through the factor $s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$, motivating joint calibration of clustered singular values. Building on these results, we introduce an empirical-null workflow for PEFT LoRA adapters: factor reconstruction, Monte Carlo $p$-values, stagewise and block testing, and module-wise and corpus-level BH reporting. In an audit of 26 public adapters, 684 modules, six architecture families, and 31,770 public-checkpoint spectra rows, calibrated effective rank is typically much smaller than nominal rank and differs systematically from 95\% energy retention. A measured RoBERTa-RTE slice on $n=24$ examples illustrates the measurement path from calibrated ranks to task evaluation, without treating the slice as a utility study. The main empirical finding is that calibrated effective rank is usually far below nominal rank, and that energy retention and statistical surprise answer different questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种有限样本框架，用于推断公共基础模型适配器（尤其是PEFT LoRA）的有效秩结构。理论上基于固定维高斯秩一参考实验的精确卡方散度，推导出有限样本Le Cam界、截断误差界及矩形BBP极限，并证明有限样本似然证据依赖主要谱间隙。实证上对26个公共适配器、684个模块、6个架构家族、31,770条谱数据行进行审计，发现校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，且与95%能量保留存在系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 名义LoRA秩是一个设计参数，而校准后的谱证据是独立的推断量。现有方法缺乏在有限样本条件下对适配器有效秩结构的精确推断框架，无法区分统计显著的信号与噪声，亟需建立从谱数据到有效秩的严格推断方法。
AI.method: 核心方法是固定维高斯秩一参考实验下的精确卡方散度，在旋转不变参考先验下积分未知信号方向。由此得到可计算的有限样本Le Cam界、数值截断的显式余项界以及矩形BBP极限。通过紧流形Laplace展开揭示有限样本似然证据依赖谱间隙因子s_1^{|m-n|}∏(s_1^2-s_i^2)。在此基础上构建经验零假设工作流：因子重建、Monte Carlo p值、分段与分块检验、模块级和语料级BH报告。
AI.result: 对26个公共适配器、684个模块、6个架构族、31,770条谱数据行的审计表明：校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，且与95%能量保留系统性不同。以RoBERTa-RTE在n=24个样本上的切片为例展示了从校准秩到任务评估的完整测量路径。主要实证发现是校准有效秩通常远低于名义秩，且能量保留与统计显著性回答的是不同的问题。
AI.conclusion: 校准有效秩与名义秩存在系统性偏离，能量保留标准和统计推断回答了不同问题。本文的有限样本框架为公共适配器审计提供了严格的推断工具，可用于更可靠地评估和校准PEFT模型的复杂度与信号结构。

title: TinyDETR-Pose: Towards End-to-End Real-Time Single-Stage 6DoF Object Pose Estimation with Lightweight Transformers
summary: Real-time 6DoF object pose estimation on resource-constrained hardware remains challenging, as accurate correspondence-based and refinement pipelines typically rely on non-differentiable PnP/RANSAC stages or costly iterative refinement, while recent foundation-model-based approaches incur inference costs that are prohibitive for edge deployment. We present TinyDETR-Pose, a lightweight, end-to-end, single-stage framework that jointly detects objects and regresses their full 6D pose in a single forward pass. Built on the efficient LW-DETR architecture, TinyDETR-Pose formulates detection and pose estimation as a set-prediction problem and attaches dedicated MLP heads for rotation, monocular depth, and projected object center regression to each decoder query, eliminating the need for PnP, NMS (non-maximum suppression), or iterative pose refinement. Object symmetries are handled through a ADD-S loss applied uniformly to all objects, without the need for object-specific loss schedules or separate geodesic/ADD supervision. In addition, predictions are assigned to ground truth using a symmetry-safe Hungarian matcher based on class and 2D spatial cues, yielding stable assignment under symmetry and depth ambiguity. On YCB-V, TinyDETR-Pose achieves a comparable ADD-S AUC of 85.9, while requiring up to 72.7% fewer parameters than other DETR-based single-stage pose-estimation approaches. Due to its compact design, TinyDETR-Pose runs in real time and achieves an inference latency of only ~4.5 ms per frame on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano using TensorRT, demonstrating that accurate end-to-end transformer-based 6D pose estimation can be made practical for edge deployment.

AI.tldr: TinyDETR-Pose是一个轻量级、端到端的单阶段Transformer框架，用于在资源受限的边缘设备上实现实时6DoF物体姿态估计。它基于LW-DETR架构，将检测和姿态估计统一为集合预测问题，无需PnP、NMS或迭代优化，在YCB-V数据集上达到85.9的ADD-S AUC，参数减少高达72.7%，在Jetson Nano上推理延迟仅约4.5ms/帧。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限硬件上进行实时6DoF物体姿态估计仍然具有挑战性：现有的基于对应关系和优化的方法依赖不可微的PnP/RANSAC阶段或昂贵的迭代优化，而基于基础模型的方法推理成本过高，不适合边缘部署。需要一个轻量、端到端且无需复杂后处理流程的解决方案。
AI.method: TinyDETR-Pose基于高效的LW-DETR架构，将检测和姿态估计建模为集合预测问题。每个解码器查询附加专门的MLP头，分别回归旋转、单目深度和投影物体中心。通过ADD-S损失统一处理所有物体的对称性，无需物体特定的损失调度或额外的测地线/ADD监督。使用基于类别和2D空间线索的对称安全匈牙利匹配器进行预测与真值分配，在对称性和深度模糊情况下保持稳定匹配。
AI.result: 在YCB-V数据集上，TinyDETR-Pose实现了与SOTA相当的ADD-S AUC 85.9，参数比其他基于DETR的单阶段姿态估计方法减少多达72.7%。在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上使用TensorRT推理，延迟约4.5ms/帧，实现实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了基于Transformer的端到端6D姿态估计可以在边缘设备上实现实用的实时性能，通过紧凑的网络设计消除了对PnP、NMS和迭代优化的依赖，为资源受限场景下的6D姿态估计提供了可行方案。

title: Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents
comment: 4 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to AP-GARSS 2026. Project page: https://zhijianli2003.github.io/Orbit_Planner/
summary: Satellite agents for on-orbit navigation tasks need to predict collision risks using limited onboard observations. However, conventional planners often rely on predefined maps and fixed environmental assumptions, limiting their adaptability in dynamic on-orbit scenarios. In this paper, we propose Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model for on-orbit obstacle avoidance. Orbit-Planner learns action-conditioned spacecraft dynamics to perform future-state rollouts in latent space, and introduces a Physics Probe to decode physical state changes from imagined latent trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that Orbit-Planner can perform long-horizon latent rollouts and recover physical states from imagined trajectories. In closed-loop obstacle-avoidance navigation in Isaac Sim, it attains a success rate of 91.7%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/Orbit_Planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Orbit-Planner，一种两阶段潜在世界模型，用于在轨卫星的避障导航任务。该模型在潜在空间中学习动作条件下的航天器动力学以进行未来状态推演，并引入Physics Probe从想象轨迹中解码物理状态变化。在Isaac Sim闭环避障导航实验中达到91.7%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统在轨规划器依赖预定义地图和固定环境假设，难以适应动态在轨场景中对碰撞风险的实时预测需求，缺乏在有限机载观测条件下的适应能力。
AI.method: 采用两阶段潜在世界模型架构：(1) 在潜在空间学习动作条件下的航天器动力学，实现未来状态的长期推演；(2) 引入Physics Probe模块，从想象的潜在轨迹中解码物理状态变化，实现物理可解释性。
AI.result: 实验表明Orbit-Planner能够执行长时域潜在推演并从想象轨迹中恢复物理状态；在Isaac Sim封闭环路的避障导航任务中获得了91.7%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 潜在世界模型结合物理解码探针可有效提升在轨避障导航的适应性，为动态空间环境中卫星自主导航提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

title: SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has substantially reduced the hardware cost of adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decreasing the number of trainable parameters, recent studies have sought to further improve PEFT through parameter sharing. However, these approaches either employ uniform parameter sharing across layers, which can delay convergence, or rely on dynamic masking strategies, which add computational overhead. The potential of sharing patterns inspired by the inherent hierarchical structure of Transformer architectures remains unexplored in PEFT. To address this gap, we introduce SAPE (Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency), a PEFT framework based on a sandwich-style hard weight-sharing topology. SAPE routes intermediate Transformer layers through balanced shared group adapters while strictly isolating the input embedding and final projection boundary transformations to prevent gradient interference. This design significantly reduces memory consumption while eliminating the computational overhead associated with dynamic parameter-sharing methods. Extensive evaluations across encoder-only and causal decoder architectures demonstrate that SAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-parameter regimes. On natural language understanding, SAPE outperforms proPETL on RoBERTa-large while utilizing only 10% of the baseline's parameter budget. On natural language generation and world knowledge reasoning with LLaMA-3.2 (3B) under a strict ~0.6M parameter constraint, SAPE outperforms AdaLoRA, yielding absolute improvements of +4.85% on GSM8K and +3.11% on CommonsenseQA. Furthermore, through comprehensive topological ablations, we formalize an inherent capacity trade-off: while hard parameter sharing strongly regularizes semantic generalization, it slightly smooths the sharp layer-wise transformations required for rigid multi-step arithmetic reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAPE是一种基于三明治式硬权重共享拓扑的PEFT框架，通过将中间Transformer层路由到平衡的共享组适配器，同时严格隔离输入嵌入和最终投影的边界变换以防梯度干扰，显著降低内存消耗并消除动态参数共享方法的计算开销。在低参数预算下实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT参数共享方法要么采用跨层均匀共享导致收敛缓慢，要么依赖动态掩码策略带来额外计算开销。Transformer架构固有的层次结构启发式的共享模式尚未在PEFT中得到探索。
AI.method: 提出SAPE框架，采用三明治式（sandwich-style）硬权重共享拓扑：中间Transformer层通过平衡的共享组适配器进行路由，同时严格隔离输入嵌入层和最终投影层的边界变换以防止梯度干扰。这种设计大幅减少内存使用，同时避免动态参数共享方法的计算开销。
AI.result: 在编码器-only和因果解码器架构上的广泛评估表明SAPE在低参数机制下达到SOTA性能。在NLU任务上，使用仅10%的参数预算超过proPETL在RoBERTa-large上的表现；在NLG和世界知识推理中，LLaMA-3.2(3B)在~0.6M参数约束下，较AdaLoRA在GSM8K上获得+4.85%绝对提升，在CommonsenseQA上获得+3.11%绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过全面的拓扑消融实验，作者形式化了一个固有的容量权衡：硬参数共享强烈正则化语义泛化，但会略微平滑刚性多步算术推理所需的尖锐逐层变换。

title: Image Denoising via the Adaptive Rank-Cluster Filter
summary: A spatial-local image-denoising filter is proposed, and its performance metrics are evaluated in comparison with baseline filtering algorithms, including the median, adaptive median, Gaussian, bilateral, Wiener, anisotropic diffusion, and non-local means. The developed filter is based on aligning the intensity value of the central pixel in a 3x3 window with the statistical majority intensity of one of the two clusters formed by optimal Otsu's partitioning of a pixel set sorted by intensity and trimmed to seven elements. This is followed by a fuzzy fusion of the calculated value with the median intensity of the pixels within the window. The proposed filter demonstrates the highest robustness to variations in image noise levels, particularly when processing mixed noise consisting of salt-and-pepper impulse noise and additive Gaussian noise in various proportions

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Otsu全局阈值分割与模糊融合的空间局部图像去噪滤波器，在混合噪声（椒盐脉冲噪声与高斯噪声）环境下鲁棒性优于七种主流基线算法。
AI.motivation: 现有经典去噪滤波器（如中值、高斯、双边、维纳、各向异性扩散、非局部均值等）在处理混合噪声（同时包含椒盐脉冲噪声和高斯噪声）时性能有限，缺乏一种能够在噪声类型和比例变化下仍保持稳定性能的鲁棒去噪方法。
AI.method: 滤波器基于3x3窗口：首先将窗口内像素按强度排序并修剪为7个元素，然后利用Otsu方法将其最优划分成两个簇，将中心像素强度与其中一个簇的统计多数强度对齐；随后将所得值与窗口内像素的中值强度进行模糊融合，得到最终去噪输出。
AI.result: 与中值滤波、自适应中值滤波、高斯滤波、双边滤波、维纳滤波、各向异性扩散和非局部均值等基线算法对比，所提滤波在对图像噪声水平变化方面表现出最高的鲁棒性，尤其在处理不同比例的椒盐脉冲噪声与加性高斯噪声混合的噪声时效果最为突出。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的空间局部去噪滤波器在混合噪声场景下相较经典算法具有更优的鲁棒性，验证了Otsu聚类与模糊融合策略在图像去噪中的有效性，尤其适用于噪声类型和强度多变的应用场景。

title: H-PAC Hand: Control-Oriented Modeling and Tendon-Elasticity Compensation for an Underactuated Robotic Hand
summary:
Underactuated tendon-driven hands offer compact actuation and passive compliance, but tendon elongation under restoring-spring loading introduces configuration-dependent joint deviations. This paper presents H-PAC, a modular 6-actuator, 15-DoF robotic hand with a control-oriented modeling and implementation framework. A sparse analytical actuator-joint model is derived from the tendon-routing geometry, and a mechanics-based compensation model is developed to account for tendon-elasticity-induced joint errors.
  The proposed method is implemented in a hierarchical architecture: a host computer performs workspace-constrained posture mapping and compensation, while an ESP32 generates synchronized commands for six position-controlled servos. The same control parameters and execution strategy are used across all tasks without task-specific retuning.
  Monotonic servo-sweep experiments show that the compensation substantially improves joint-angle prediction. The MAE of the index DIP joint decreases from 1.15 degrees to 0.18 degrees, and all nine evaluated joints achieve an MAE below 0.23 degrees. Representative postures and grasping configurations are further executed using the same control pipeline without external joint or force sensing in the control loop. The results demonstrate a practical approach to improving posture reproducibility in compact underactuated robotic end-effectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H-PAC，一个模块化的6驱动器、15自由度欠驱动腱驱动机器人手，构建了从腱路由几何推导的稀疏解析驱动器-关节模型，以及基于力学的腱弹性补偿模型。在分层架构（主机进行姿态映射与补偿，ESP32同步控制六个位置伺服）下，无需任务特定调参即可统一执行所有任务。实验表明补偿显著提升关节角预测精度（如食指DIP关节MAE从1.15°降至0.18°，九个关节MAE均低于0.23°），证明了在紧凑欠驱动末端执行器中提升姿态可重复性的实用方案。
AI.motivation: 欠驱动腱驱动机器人手虽然具有紧凑驱动和被动柔顺的优势，但恢复弹簧加载下的腱伸长会引入与位形相关的关节偏差，导致姿态预测不准确、可重复性差。现有方法缺乏对该系统性误差的有效建模与补偿，亟需一种控制导向的建模和实现框架来改善姿态可重复性。
AI.method: 从腱路由几何推导稀疏解析的驱动器-关节模型，建立基于力学的补偿模型以处理腱弹性引起的关节误差。系统采用分层架构：主机执行工作空间约束的姿态映射与补偿计算，ESP32微控制器向六个位置控制伺服生成同步命令。所有任务使用相同的控制参数和执行策略，无需任务特定重调。
AI.result: 单调伺服扫描实验表明，补偿模型显著改善了关节角预测精度：食指DIP关节的平均绝对误差从1.15°降至0.18°，全部九个评估关节的MAE均在0.23°以下。代表性姿态和抓取构型在无外部关节/力传感闭环的情况下通过同一控制管线成功执行。
AI.conclusion: H-PAC展示了在紧凑欠驱动机器人末端执行器中，通过解析建模与力学补偿相结合，可以有效提升姿态可重复性和预测精度，且无需任务特定调参或外部传感，为欠驱动腱驱动机器人手提供了一种实用且可推广的控制框架。

title: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
summary: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic bandits by analyzing the failure probability $\operatorname{Err}_t$, defined as the probability that the empirical best arm determined by the cumulative importance-weighted loss estimates of 1/2-Tsallis-INF differs from the true optimal arm. The main difficulty is that, at the logarithmic-regret scale, suboptimal arms are sampled with probability heuristically of order $1/t$. Consequently, importance weighting causes the cumulative estimator to fluctuate on the same linear scale as its mean separation. To overcome this obstacle, guided by a diffusion toy model, we construct a Lyapunov function for the gap process between the estimated cumulative loss of the optimal arm and that of the best competing arm. This leads to polynomial upper bounds on $\operatorname{Err}_t$: for learning rate $η_t=α/\sqrt t$, $\operatorname{Err}_t$ decays at rate $t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}$ for any $ρ>0$, where $μ_{i_*}$ denotes the mean loss of the true optimal arm. We also establish a lower bound $Ω(t^{-2-\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$, showing that the exponent $2$ is essentially tight.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1/2-Tsallis-INF这一经典的最优两世界（best-of-both-worlds）遗憾最小化算法在随机 bandit 环境下自带的经验最优臂识别能力，证明其错误概率（经验最优臂与真实最优臂不一致的概率）呈多项式衰减，速率约为t^{-2}，并通过上下界表明该指数2本质上是紧的。
AI.motivation: 遗憾最小化（RM）与最优臂识别（BAI）是多臂bandit中的两个基本目标。1/2-Tsallis-INF是一个在不预先知道环境类型的情况下同时实现随机bandit对数伪遗憾和对抗bandit极小极大最优遗憾的典范算法。自然的问题是：这一算法在不额外探索的情况下，能否也可靠地识别最优臂？
AI.method: 作者从扩散（diffusion）玩具模型中获得启发，针对最优臂与最佳竞争臂之间估计累积损失差的gap过程构造李雅普诺夫函数，从而克服了在对数遗憾尺度下子优臂以~1/t概率被采样所导致的重要性加权估计量波动与其均值差同阶的困难，建立了Err_t的多项式上界。
AI.result: 对于学习率η_t=α/√t，错误概率Err_t以t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}速率衰减（任意ρ>0），其中μ_{i_*}为真实最优臂的平均损失；同时建立了Ω(t^{-2-ε})（任意ε>0）的下界，说明指数2基本是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 1/2-Tsallis-INF在无需额外探索的条件下，其经验最优臂识别错误率以接近t^{-2}的多项式速率衰减，遗憾最小化与最优臂识别可以在同一算法中兼容实现，且该指数的上界本质上不可进一步改进。

title: LightLoc++: Sensor-Robust Representation Learning for Efficient Outdoor LiDAR Localization
summary: Scene coordinate regression (SCR) achieves strong performance in outdoor LiDAR localization, but it usually requires scene-specific training that can take days, limiting practical deployment. Recent works improve training efficiency by decoupling SCR into a scene-agnostic backbone and scene-specific prediction heads, where the backbone is pretrained on source datasets and frozen for new scenes, and only lightweight heads are optimized. However, we find that this paradigm heavily depends on the pretrained backbone. Existing decoupled methods can match conventional SCR methods fully optimized for each new scene when LiDAR configurations are similar to those used during backbone pretraining, but their accuracy drops noticeably on datasets collected with different LiDAR sensors. This suggests that efficient LiDAR localization requires representations that capture stable scene geometry across LiDAR configurations. Motivated by this observation, we propose LightLoc++, a sensor-robust and efficient outdoor LiDAR localization framework. To support sensor-robust representation learning, we introduce SULID, a synchronized urban multi-LiDAR dataset with representative 32-, 64-, and 128-beam rotating LiDARs, extensive cross-sensor overlap, and diverse urban scenes. Using SULID, we pretrain a sensor-robust backbone through cross-sensor consistency learning. LightLoc++ further preserves efficient new-scene learning by incorporating sample classification guidance and redundant sample downsampling, which reduce regression ambiguity and computational redundancy in large-scale outdoor scenes. Extensive experiments on multiple outdoor LiDAR localization benchmarks demonstrate that LightLoc++ achieves state-of-the-art localization performance with the lowest new-scene training cost among compared methods. Code and dataset will be made available at https://github.com/liw95/LightLoc-PlusPlus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightLoc++，一种对传感器鲁棒且高效的室外LiDAR定位框架。通过引入SULID多传感器LiDAR数据集进行跨传感器一致性学习，预训练传感器鲁棒的骨干网络，并结合样本分类引导和冗余样本下采样，实现最高的定位精度和最低的新场景训练成本。
AI.motivation: 场景坐标回归（SCR）在室外LiDAR定位中性能优异，但场景特定训练耗时数天，限制实际部署。现有解耦方法（场景无关骨干+场景特定轻量头）在源域LiDAR配置相似时表现良好，但当测试数据来自不同LiDAR传感器时精度显著下降，说明需要能够跨LiDAR配置捕获稳定场景几何的表示。
AI.method: 1) 提出SULID数据集，包含32/64/128线旋转LiDAR的同步城市多传感器数据，具有跨传感器重叠和多样城市场景；2) 基于SULID通过跨传感器一致性学习预训练传感器鲁棒骨干网络；3) 引入样本分类指导和冗余样本下采样，减少大规模室外场景中的回归歧义与计算冗余，保持高效的新场景学习。
AI.result: 在多个室外LiDAR定位基准上，LightLoc++实现了最先进的定位性能，并在所有对比方法中拥有最低的新场景训练成本。
AI.conclusion: 跨传感器一致性学习能够有效提升LiDAR定位骨干网络对传感器配置变化的鲁棒性，为高效且实用的室外LiDAR定位提供了新的解决方案。代码和数据集将公开。

title: MatchingPolicy: Correspondence-Aware Policy Enables Cross-Object In-Context Learning
summary: In-context imitation learning enables few-shot policy generalization but struggles to maintain performance on unseen objects and novel scenarios. To address this, we introduce MatchingPolicy, a correspondence-driven framework that explicitly decouples demonstration-to-scene matching from policy learning. Central to our method is a correspondence-aware diffusion policy that conditions robotic actions directly on dense semantic correspondences. This architectural separation resolves the inherent conflict between correspondence identification and action adaptation, enabling robust out-of-distribution transfer. Our framework integrates vision foundation models with a novel two-stage matching algorithm to dynamically establish reliable correspondences. Extensive evaluations on RLBench and real-world manipulation tasks confirm that MatchingPolicy achieves superior few-shot performance, generalizing reliably across unseen object instances and semantic categories.

AI.tldr: 提出了MatchingPolicy，一种基于对应关系（correspondence）驱动的框架，通过显式地将演示到场景的匹配与策略学习解耦，并采用对应感知的扩散策略，实现了少样本策略泛化，在RLBench和真实世界操控任务上表现出卓越的少样本性能和跨不可见对象及语义类别的可靠泛化。
AI.motivation: 上下文模仿学习虽然能实现少样本策略泛化，但在面对未见过的对象和新型场景时性能下降，这源于对应关系识别与动作适应之间的固有冲突，阻碍了分布外迁移能力。
AI.method: MatchingPolicy的核心是将演示到场景的匹配与策略学习显式解耦，提出对应感知的扩散策略（correspondence-aware diffusion policy），直接将机器人动作条件化在稠密语义对应关系上；同时集成视觉基础模型与新颖的两阶段匹配算法来动态建立可靠的对应关系。
AI.result: 在RLBench基准和真实世界操控任务上的广泛评估表明，MatchingPolicy取得了优越的少样本性能，并能跨未见对象实例和语义类别进行可靠的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构上的分离设计，MatchingPolicy解决了对应识别与动作适应的冲突问题，实现了鲁棒的分布外迁移，验证了对应关系驱动方法在机器人少样本模仿学习中的有效性。

title: Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error
comment: Preprint with supplementary appendix. 26 pages, 3 figures
summary: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile minimum. Endpoint consistency then tests whether joint training delivers that preference under the same final view. Across three synthetic one-dimensional, scalar-parameter PDEs, matched-forward mean absolute relative error ranges from 2.34 percent to 17.46 percent. The displacement tracks frozen-profile minima across locked seeds, architectures, and fresh-noise retraining (r from .945 to .982), and it tracks delivered signed log-error in 240 fresh-noise RBA runs (r = .994; 237/240 correct directions). A coupled two-parameter Darcy check validates the full matrix calculation. The axes are complementary diagnostic coordinates, not additive error components or a deployable oracle-free estimator. Together, they route follow-up work toward observations, residual evidence, or endpoint delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文针对逆向物理信息神经网络(PINNs)在准确重建场但返回错误物理参数的问题，提出了一种双轴事后诊断方法，分离有限样本分辨率问题与参数偏好编码问题。通过匹配前向估计器、冻结场与残差视图计算局部得分位移，并测试端点一致性来定位问题来源。在三个一维标量参数PDE上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 逆向PINNs在重建物理场时可以表现良好，但返回的物理参数可能是错误的。这一现象说明"重建场"与"参数识别"之间存在潜在脱节，需要一种系统化的诊断框架来区分问题根源，究竟是观测数据不足导致的分辨率限制，还是学习过程对参数产生了系统性偏差。
AI.method: 提出双轴事后诊断方法：(1) 第一条轴使用匹配的正向估计器重复拟合含噪观测，评估在给定观测与估计协议下有限样本的分辨率能力；(2) 第二条轴冻结最终学习得到的场与残差视图，计算局部得分位移（toward nearby residual-profile minimum），以提取场编码的参数符号偏好；(3) 通过端点一致性测试检验联合训练是否在相同最终视图下交付该偏好。
AI.result: 在三个一维标量参数PDE上，匹配前向估计器的平均绝对相对误差范围为2.34%至17.46%。位移指标在锁定种子、架构和新鲜噪声重训练下与冻结轮廓最小值高度相关（r=0.945至0.982），在240次新鲜噪声RBA运行中与交付的符号对数误差相关r=0.994（237/240方向正确）。两参数Darcy耦合检验验证了完整矩阵计算。
AI.conclusion: 两条轴是互补的诊断坐标而非可加的误差分量，也不是可直接部署的无Oracle估计器。二者结合可将后续工作路由到观测数据、残差证据或端点交付三个问题来源之一，为改进逆向PINNs提供系统化的诊断框架。

title: SAGE-OR: Semi-supervised Adaptive Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Current surgical scene graph generation methods depend on dense multi-modal supervision and specialized hardware (synchronized RGB-D sensors, calibration rigs), making dataset construction expensive and restricting all existing benchmarks to simulated environments. We propose SAGE-OR, a feature-centric framework that replaces the traditional detect-then-reason paradigm with a decoupled representation-reasoning paradigm in which localization is derived from frozen foundation models, encoded implicitly in pre-computed features, and used without any localization supervision, while a lightweight graph transformer performs relational reasoning over cached features. We employ a semi-supervised formulation with general-purpose segmentation prompts to eliminate localization supervision while enabling unsupervised context augmentation through additional prompt-driven entities, such as hands, which are absent from annotations. General-purpose prompts are used to induce near-perfect recall, while precision is delegated to downstream attention-based reasoning, enabling simple adaptation to new entities via prompt-level modification. This design enables a lightweight 15M-parameter graph transformer that trains in 1.4 hours and runs relational inference at $\sim$1ms per frame with peak memory under 2GB, suitable for edge hardware used in the operating room; feature extraction runs offline as a separate caching stage (4.27s per frame). On the 4D-OR benchmark, the core model achieves 76% F1, matching the fully supervised 4D-OR baseline while eliminating all localization annotations, and unsupervised hand augmentation raises this to 86%, within 4 points of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring dense multi-modal supervision, providing a practical pathway for adaptation to new surgical settings without annotation other than relationship and class labels.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE-OR框架，用特征中心化的解耦"表示-推理"范式替代传统"检测-推理"范式，通过冻结基础模型隐式编码定位信息、轻量图变换器进行关系推理，结合半监督提示驱动上下文增强，在无需定位标注的情况下匹配全监督基线的性能，并接近需密集多模态监督的SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有手术场景图生成方法依赖密集多模态监督（同步RGB-D传感器、标定装置）和专用硬件，导致数据集构建成本高昂，且所有现有基准仅限于模拟环境。需要一个无需定位监督、可在边缘硬件上运行的实用方案，以降低数据集构建门槛并支持新手术场景的快速适配。
AI.method: 1) 采用解耦的表示-推理范式：定位信息由冻结的基础模型隐式编码在预计算特征中，不使用任何定位监督；2) 轻量图变换器（15M参数）在缓存特征上进行关系推理；3) 半监督公式，利用通用分割提示消除定位监督，并通过额外提示驱动实体（如手）实现无监督上下文增强；4) 通用提示保证高召回率，精度交由下游注意力推理处理；5) 特征提取为离线缓存阶段，推理阶段适合边缘硬件。
AI.result: 在4D-OR基准上，核心模型达到76% F1，与全监督的4D-OR基线持平且消除了所有定位标注；无监督手部增强将F1提升至86%，仅比需密集多模态监督的SOTA方法低4个点。模型训练仅需1.4小时，推理约1ms/帧，峰值内存低于2GB，特征提取4.27s/帧离线进行。
AI.conclusion: 特征中心化的解耦范式为手术场景图生成提供了无需定位监督的实用路径，仅需关系和类别标签即可适配新手术场景，为手术室边缘硬件部署开辟了可行方案。

title: Design Optimization for Large High-Force Soft Robot Manipulators Under Gravitational Loads
summary: Designing large soft robots capable of generating high forces for physical human-robot interaction remains a significant challenge in soft robotics. Prior work in large soft robots has focused on proof-of-concept prototypes, and no systematic framework exists for determining the suitability of a design paradigm for a desired task. This manuscript introduces a method for optimizing the geometry of a soft robot limb, maximizing its blocking force subject to an anti-bucking constraint under its own gravitational loading. We demonstrate that an explicit solution exists to the proposed optimization problem under certain assumptions. Experiments with three geometries of a large, soft, pneumatically-actuated manipulator demonstrate that the method correctly predicts which designs meet constraints and which produces the largest end-effector forces. This method, with its closed-form solution, can allow designers to determine a-priori if an intended class of soft manipulators is an appropriate choice for physical interaction at large size scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种优化大型软体机器人肢体几何形状的方法，在自重载荷下的抗屈曲约束条件下最大化其阻塞力，并证明在特定假设下该优化问题存在解析解。通过三种几何形状的大型软体气动操纵器实验验证了该方法能正确预测哪些设计满足约束以及哪种设计产生最大的末端执行器力。
AI.motivation: 大型软体机器人能够产生高力以用于物理人机交互，但此前的相关研究仅停留在概念验证原型阶段，缺乏一个系统性的框架来判断某种设计范式是否适合特定任务。这一空白阻碍了软体机器人在大规模物理交互场景中的应用。
