AI.method: 提出一种优化软体机器人肢体几何形状的方法，以在自重载荷下的抗屈曲约束条件下最大化阻塞力为优化目标。该方法在特定假设下给出了优化问题的解析（闭式）解，并设计了三种不同几何形状的大型软体气动操纵器进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够准确预测哪些设计满足约束条件，以及哪种几何形状能够产生最大的末端执行器力，验证了该优化方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该闭式解方法使设计者能够事先（a-priori）判断某类软体操纵器在大尺寸物理交互场景中是否合适，为大型软体机器人的系统化设计提供了理论工具。

title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

AI.tldr: ExactMoE是一种针对稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的推理设计，仅对路由专家应用对称的group-128四比特权重量化，将其以MARLIN形式存储在锁定主机内存中，并通过可配置的GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核执行所有选中的专家。在OLMoE-1B-7B上，16槽配置将GPU峰值内存降低87.04%而保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐；64槽全驻留配置达到更高吞吐（31.9 vs 21.7 tokens/s），同时保持99.23%的零样本准确率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE语言模型虽然通过仅激活少量专家来减少算术计算量，但部署时仍需存储和移动完整的专家库，导致显著的内存和带宽开销。作者希望在不剪枝、不替换、不强制CPU执行任何专家的前提下，实现完整的专家可用性和不变的top-k路由流程，从而探索内存传输吞吐的边界。
AI.method: ExactMoE采用以下核心设计：(1) 仅对路由专家应用对称group-128四比特权重量化，其余组件（路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化层、语言模型头）保持BF16；(2) 量化后的专家以内核原生的MARLIN格式存储在锁定主机内存中；(3) 通过可配置的GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核执行所有选中的专家。通过调整槽位数，可在完全GPU驻留和按需加载之间权衡。
AI.result: 在OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct上、单块NVIDIA L4上进行评估：16槽配置将峰值保留GPU内存从14.168降至1.836 GiB（降低87.04%），保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐；64槽全驻留配置达到31.923 tokens/s（vs BF16的21.662 tokens/s），保留4.061 GiB内存；在12,450道零样本多项选择题中，准确率为70.3534%（vs BF16的70.8996%），保留99.23%的基线准确率；16-token消融实验中，融合分组执行比顺序W4参考快1.97倍。
AI.conclusion: ExactMoE识别出了完整专家MoE推理中的内存-传输-吞吐权衡前沿，证明通过仅对路由专家进行四比特量化并结合槽缓存与融合内核方案，可以在大幅降低内存占用的同时保持高吞吐和高准确率，为MoE模型的实用化部署提供了有效路径。

title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space. We propose a lightweight Text Encoder Alignment framework (TEA) that fine-tunes only the text encoder while keeping the generative backbone fully frozen. Given concept--anchor prompt pairs, our method trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from those of safe anchor prompts, while updating the text encoder to make these representations indistinguishable. TEA introduces zero inference-time overhead and requires only a small number of fine-tuning steps, making it highly efficient to deploy at scale. Despite this efficiency, TEA achieves state-of-the-art erasure robustness against black-box and white-box adversarial attacks on Stable Diffusion v1.4, while preserving generation quality on benign prompts. Furthermore, TEA is model-agnostic and achieves the lowest attack success rate on Stable Diffusion v3.5, extending concept erasure to a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture with T5 conditioning where prior methods remain largely unexplored. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEA（文本编码器对齐框架）框架，将概念擦除形式化为文本表示空间中的域对齐问题，仅微调文本编码器而保持生成骨干完全冻结，通过判别器对齐概念提示与安全锚定提示的token级表示，实现零推理开销、少步微调即可达最强对抗鲁棒性的概念擦除效果，并扩展到Stable Diffusion v3.5的Rectified Flow Transformer架构。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型易被对抗性或改写提示绕过安全机制生成有害内容。已有概念擦除方法存在三大局限：对对抗提示的鲁棒性有限、损害良性生成质量、或依赖推理时干预带来持续计算开销。作者旨在设计一种同时克服这三方面缺陷的高效概念擦除方法。
AI.method: TEA将概念擦除建模为文本表示空间中的域对齐问题。具体来说：(1) 仅微调文本编码器，保持生成骨干完全冻结；(2) 给定概念-锚定提示对，训练一个判别器来区分包含概念的提示与安全锚定提示的token级表示；(3) 同时更新文本编码器使这两类表示变得不可区分。这种方法只需少量微调步骤且无推理时额外开销。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4上，TEA在对抗黑盒和白盒攻击时达到最先进的擦除鲁棒性，同时保持良性提示的生成质量。在Stable Diffusion v3.5上，TEA取得了最低的攻击成功率，将该方法扩展到了带T5条件的Rectified Flow Transformer架构，而该架构此前在此方向上几乎未被探索。此外TEA具有模型无关性。
AI.conclusion: TEA通过仅微调文本编码器并将概念擦除转化为域对齐问题，实现了零推理开销、高训练效率、强对抗鲁棒性和良性生成质量保持的多种最优特性，且可推广到更先进的多模态Diffusion架构中，为大规模部署安全概念擦除提供了实用方案。

title: Semantic- and Density-Aware Planning for Accessibility-Preserving Multi-Object Placement
summary: Long-term manipulation planning requires robots to reason not only about immediate task success but also about how current decisions affect future interactions with the environment. In this context, household service robots may need to organize groceries in partially occupied shelves while using limited storage space efficiently and preserving access for subsequent placements. In this paper, we consider an online multi-object shelf-placement setting in which future objects arrivals are unknown. Existing approaches do not jointly address semantic organization, dense space utilization, and manipulator accessibility during sequential shelf filling. To address this gap, we propose Semantic-Dense Placement Planning (SDPP), an accessibility-preserving approach that ranks candidate poses using a semantic-density score combining inter-object semantic similarity with spatial proximity. An Accessibility Map (AM) further filters candidates unlikely to be reachable before motion planning and penalizes placements that reduce the remaining accessible workspace. Simulation experiments show that SDPP significantly improves semantic placement quality over state-of-the-art baselines and achieves the highest average shelf density, while the AM substantially reduces the time required to identify feasible placement poses. A qualitative real-world experiment demonstrates the applicability of our pipeline in a domestic shelf-storage scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义-密集放置规划（SDPP）方法，用于在线多物体货架放置任务。该方法通过语义-密度评分（结合物体语义相似度与空间邻近度）对候选位姿排序，并利用可达性地图（AM）在运动规划前过滤难以到达的候选位姿、惩罚减少剩余可达工作空间放置。仿真和实物实验表明SDPP显著提升语义放置质量和货架密度，同时AM大幅减少可行位姿识别时间。
AI.motivation: 长期操作规划要求机器人不仅考虑即时任务成功，还需考虑当前决策对未来环境交互的影响。家庭服务机器人在部分占用的货架上整理物品时，需高效利用有限存储空间并保留后续放置的可达性。然而现有方法未联合处理语义组织、密集空间利用和机械臂可达性这三个方面，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 提出SDPP框架，核心包括两部分：1）语义-密度评分函数，用于对候选放置位姿进行排序，该评分综合了物体间语义相似度与空间邻近度；2）可达性地图（Accessibility Map, AM），在运动规划之前过滤掉不可达的候选位姿，并对会减少剩余可达工作空间的放置施加惩罚，从而保持后续操作的可达性。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，SDPP在语义放置质量上显著优于现有最先进基线方法，并达到最高的平均货架密度；AM模块大幅减少了识别可行放置位姿所需的时间。此外，定性实物实验验证了该流水线在家庭货架存储场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: SDPP方法有效融合了语义组织、空间密集利用和机械臂可达性保持，在线多物体货架放置场景中优于现有方法，且在真实家庭环境中具备实用性，为长期操作规划中的空间管理问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning
summary: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. Via an extensive set of experiments across many datasets and liftings, we show that several of these metrics correlate with downstream model performance, suggesting they can help inform TDL preprocessing design. Our perspective reframes the TDL workflow from lift-train to lift-look-design-train, enabling more principled, interpretable, and efficient model development. TopoExplorer is hosted at https://topoexplorer.pagekite.me, and its source code is available at github.com/geometric-intelligence/topoexplorer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TopoExplorer，一种基于严格增广Hasse图形式的拓扑深度学习可视化诊断工具，使从业者能够直观地查看拓扑数据集中的关联与邻接邻域，并读取描述其结构和特征景观的关键图指标。实验表明多个指标与下游模型性能相关，从而将TDL工作流从"提升-训练"重构为"提升-查看-设计-训练"。
AI.motivation: 拓扑深度学习方法依赖将原始数据提升到高阶离散域（如单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图），但这一提升步骤在实践中常被视为黑盒：从业者盲目选择提升方式并调整架构，缺乏对诱导的高阶连通性对下游任务是否有意义的可视化诊断手段。
AI.method: 提出TopoExplorer可视化技术，利用拓扑数据集的严格增广Hasse图形式进行探索性数据分析。该方法能可视化定义提升数据集的关联和邻域邻接结构，并读取描述结构及特征景观的关键图指标，通过跨多个数据集和提升方式的广泛实验验证这些指标与下游模型性能的相关性。
AI.result: 通过大量数据集和多种提升方式的实验表明，多个图指标与下游模型性能存在相关性，证明这些指标能为TDL预处理设计提供参考依据。工具已部署于线上平台并提供开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 本文将TDL工作流从"提升-训练"重构为"提升-查看-设计-训练"，使模型开发更加有原则性、可解释且高效，填补了拓扑深度学习缺乏诊断层的空白。

title: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion for Extreme CT Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) from severely constrained projections is highly ill-posed. Sparse angular sampling, restricted angular coverage, and low photon counts can occur individually or jointly, obscuring global anatomy and local tissue detail. Many learned CT reconstruction methods are tailored to a single dominant degradation. Existing diffusion and Gaussian approaches commonly recover global structure and local detail within a shared representation. We propose HiGDiff, a feed-forward hierarchical Gaussian diffusion framework that decomposes reconstruction both spatially and from structure to detail. Physics-conditioned anatomical anchors and a foreground capacity field allocate learnable Gaussian primitives to informative regions. A structure diffusion stage first recovers global attenuation geometry, and its learned representation conditions a detail diffusion stage for residual boundaries and tissue transitions. The resulting Gaussian banks are rendered as attenuation fields and further refined by a gradient-isolated residual module. Experiments on three distinct CT benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across isolated, paired, and joint degradation settings, including improvements of 5.81 dB in macro-average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 0.113 in structural similarity index measure (SSIM) on the Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-PD) collection. Code and experimental configurations are openly available at https://github.com/Bean-Young/HiGDiff.

AI.tldr: HiGDiff是一个前馈式分层高斯扩散框架，用于从严重受限的投影重建三维CT图像。它通过空间和"结构到细节"两个维度分解重建过程，利用物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场分配高斯原语，先经结构扩散阶段恢复全局衰减几何，再用其表示条件化细节扩散阶段恢复残余边界和组织过渡，最后由梯度隔离残差模块精细化生成衰减场。在三个CT基准数据集上，其在孤立、配对和联合退化场景下均达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型CT重建方法大多针对单一主导退化设计，而实际的稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖和低光子计数可能单独或联合出现。此外，已有的扩散和高斯方法通常在全球结构与局部细节的共享表示中同时恢复两者，缺乏分层分解机制，难以同时保证全局解剖结构和局部组织细节的重建质量。
AI.method: HiGDiff采用分层Gaussian扩散框架，包含结构扩散和细节扩散两个阶段。物理条件化的解剖锚点与前景容量场指导可学习Gaussian原语分配到信息丰富区域；结构扩散阶段恢复全局衰减几何，其学习表示作为条件输入细节扩散阶段，用于恢复残余边界和组织过渡；最终通过梯度隔离残差模块将Gaussian库渲染为衰减场并进一步精细化。
AI.result: 在三个不同的CT基准数据集上实现最先进的重建性能，覆盖孤立、配对和联合退化设置。在LDCT-PD数据集上，宏观平均PSNR提升5.81 dB，SSIM提升0.113。
AI.conclusion: HiGDiff通过空间与"结构到细节"的双重分层分解，有效应对多种退化的单独或联合出现，验证了分层Gaussian扩散框架在极端受限CT重建任务中的优越性，并且代码已开源。

title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
summary: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号智能体框架，将长时程家庭任务分解为任务导向的视觉探索与受限符号规划两个阶段：先由视觉语言模型从第一人称观测中获取符号初始状态，再由PDDL转移模型约束解码、配合蒙特卡洛树搜索生成可执行计划。在VirtualHome与ALFWorld中，4B-27B的开源模型成功率均超90%，约束与搜索互补组合可将ALFWorld任务求解率提升至95%以上，且残留失败主要源于状态获取而非计划生成。
AI.motivation: 语言与视觉语言模型虽能生成看似合理的具身计划，但无法保证可执行性——输出可能违反环境动态或作用于错误grounding的实体。现有方法缺乏对环境约束的显式建模与推理，亟需将符号约束嵌入生成过程以保障计划的可执行性。
AI.method: 两阶段神经符号智能体：(1) 视觉探索阶段，VLM配合探索机制从第一人称观测和grounding交互中获取任务相关谓词与实例绑定，构建符号初始状态；(2) 符号规划阶段，PDDL转移模型将解码受限为仅能扩展合法动作的token，蒙特卡洛树搜索结合领域无关规划启发式评估可执行延续。计划在转移模型下按构造可执行，向环境迁移取决于视觉grounding的正确性。
AI.result: 在VirtualHome与ALFWorld上，4B-27B开源模型在两个环境中成功率均超过90%；最小的智能体在每个环境中都大幅优于27B直接视觉策略。ALFWorld中约束与搜索具有互补性：单独任一方法仅能解决不到三分之一的任务，组合后解决超过95%。方法所需生成token比扩展思考方式少数倍，所需模型可见图像也远少于直接交互；残余失败定位于状态获取而非计划生成，且无需专门训练。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号结合是保障具身计划可执行性的有效路径：符号约束（PDDL解码限制与搜索）与神经感知（VLM grounding）互补协作，可在较小模型规模下超越更大规模的直接端到端策略，并将错误集中于可诊断的状态获取阶段。

title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards
summary: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak learner) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong learner that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probability. Our problem is formulated as learning from scratch --- everything is learned from data rather than assuming access to a good reward estimate, and thus differs from the existing inference-time alignment theory. Our model shares similarity to the recent work of arXiv:2510.15464, where for each prompt, there could be multiple good responses. Our definition of the alignment learnability follows the PAC learning principle. We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability --- a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite. The core of our learning procedure works by invoking the ordinary one-inclusion graph algorithm to run a tournament over all pairs of label sets satisfying that neither is a subset of the other. We believe our results might shed light on establishing a complete theoretical understanding towards alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将生成模型推理时对齐问题正式化为一个弱到强的学习问题，提出了"对齐维度"(alignment dimension)这一组合维度概念，并证明它完全刻画了对齐可学习性——奖励类可对齐学习当且仅当其对齐维度有限。核心学习过程调用普通的一包含图算法对满足非子集关系的标签集对进行锦标赛式比较。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成模型对齐在监督微调和推理时计算方面取得了显著进展，但从统计学习理论视角对齐问题仍未得到充分理解。现有推理时对齐理论通常假设可以获得良好的奖励估计，而现实中往往需要从数据中学习一切，因此需要一种从零开始学习（learning from scratch）的统计学习框架。
AI.method: 将推理时对齐形式化为弱到强学习问题：参考策略（弱学习器）假定已经相当不错，目标是产生一个强学习器在测试时以任意高概率预测良好响应。遵循PAC学习原则定义对齐可学习性，引入奖励类上一种新的组合维度"对齐维度"，并证明其完全刻画对齐可学习性。核心学习程序通过调用普通的一包含图算法，对所有互不为子集的两两标签集对执行锦标赛比较。
AI.result: 证明了奖励类是对齐可学习的当且仅当其对齐维度是有限的，即对齐维度完整刻画了对齐可学习性。该工作与arXiv:2510.15464中的设定存在相似性，即每个提示可能存在多个好响应。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为生成模型对齐提供了统计学习理论的坚实基础，可能为建立完整对齐理论理解铺平道路。

title: ENAF: A Multi-Exit Network with an Adaptive Patch Fusion for Large Image Super Resolution
summary: To accelerate single image super-resolution (SISR) networks on large images (2K-8K), many recent approaches decompose an image into small patches and dynamically determine an execution path according to its difficulty (referred to as a dynamic network). To quantify the hardness of a patch, they mainly rely on a handcrafted assessment score, e.g., edge, which weakly associates a patch's texture with the computational complexity of a SISR model. To address the problem, we introduce ENAF - a dynamic network for SISR with an adaptive patch fusion. Built on top of a backbone, ENAF incorporates multiple early exits (EEs) to tackle the over-parameterized SISR model. More importantly, ENAF plugs a tiny network that estimates PSNR to associate data texture with a computation cost at an EE. Based on the scores, ENAF effectively assigns image patches to an exit, enhancing the quality-complexity trade-off. Extensive experiments on common datasets with popular SISR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of ENAF in various settings. The source code is provided in https://github.com/nmduonggg/ENAF

AI.tldr: ENAF是一种用于单图像超分辨率（SISR）的动态网络，通过基于PSNR估计的早期退出机制，自适应地将图像补丁分配到不同复杂度的执行路径，从而在大图像上实现更好的质量-复杂度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态SISR网络通常依赖手工设计的评估分数（如边缘检测）来判断图像补丁的困难程度，但这种分数与SISR模型实际计算复杂度之间的关联较弱，导致质量-复杂度权衡不理想。
AI.method: ENAF构建在现有SISR骨干网络之上，引入多个早期退出（EEs）来处理过参数化的SISR模型，并嵌入一个轻量级网络在早期退出处估计PSNR值，以此将数据纹理特征与计算成本关联起来。基于估计的PSNR分数，ENAF有效地将图像补丁分配给合适的退出路径，优化质量和计算复杂度的平衡。
AI.result: 在常见数据集和主流SISR骨干网络上的大量实验表明，ENAF在各种设置下均能有效提升质量-复杂度权衡，优于依赖手工评估分数的方法。
AI.conclusion: ENAF通过数据驱动的方式学习补丁难度与计算成本之间的关联（以PSNR为代理指标），替代了传统的手工设计分数，为动态SISR网络提供了一种更有效的自适应补丁分配策略。

title: When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks. Traditional LLM Agents typically obtain information through webpages, documents, databases, or external tools and generate corresponding invocation sequences according to user goals; when this technology is further integrated with robotic systems, large language models begin to undertake functions such as task understanding, high-level planning, and behavioral decision-making. SayCan combines the task reasoning capability of language models with the affordances of robotic skills, while Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot task plans through policy code and programmatic prompting, respectively, and VoxPoser uses language models and vision-language models to construct three-dimensional value maps to guide robotic manipulation \cite{6,7,8,9}. Vision-language-action models such as PaLM-E, RT-2, and GR00T N1 further strengthen the connection among language, visual perception, and robotic actions \cite{10,11,12}. In such LLM-driven embodied agents, the model not only needs to understand user instructions, but also needs to combine scene states, object attributes, spatial relations, and execution feedback to complete task grounding, and then hand the generated action plan to skill libraries, motion planners, or controllers for execution.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了大型语言模型（LLMs）从文本生成模型向具身智能代理（Embodied Agents）核心组件的演化过程，介绍了LLM驱动的具身代理中模型所需承担的任务理解、高级规划与行为决策等核心功能。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在上下文学习、任务分解、逐步推理和代码生成等能力上的突破，其正从纯文本生成模型演进为能够感知环境、调用工具和执行任务的智能代理核心。本文旨在梳理这一技术发展趋势及其与机器人系统融合的现状。
AI.method: 本文通过综述方式介绍了LLM代理的技术路径，包括传统LLM Agent的信息获取与命令生成方式，以及LLM与机器人系统集成后的多种代表性方法：SayCan（语言模型推理能力与机器人技能可供性的结合）、Code as Policies（策略代码生成）、ProgPrompt（程序化提示）、VoxPoser（三维价值图引导操作），以及PaLM-E、RT-2、GR00T N1等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。
AI.result: 展示了LLM驱动具身代理的核心工作流程：模型需理解用户指令，结合场景状态、物体属性、空间关系和执行反馈进行任务落地（task grounding），将生成的行动计划交由技能库、运动规划器或控制器执行。
AI.conclusion: LLM已从单纯的文本生成工具发展为具身智能系统中的关键决策与规划组件，通过视觉-语言-动作模型的融合进一步强化了语言、视觉感知与机器人动作之间的联系，推动了具身智能代理的发展。

title: FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime
summary: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. A spectral-only branch sharing the same basis separates the two paths: the fixed spectral path carries the improvement on Navier--Stokes and Darcy, while terminal wave prediction requires the residual path together with its directional penalty. FAST-DeepONet targets coordinate-query architectures and trains on solution values alone.

AI.tldr: FAST-DeepONet通过结合固定谱路径与正则化残差投影的分支表示，解决了深度算子网络在强相关传感器高维观测但样本量少时的统计不稳定问题，在Navier-Stokes、Darcy流和终端波场预测任务上显著降低了均方L2误差且大幅减少了可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 当PDE输入在数千个强相关传感器上被观测但算子样本数量很少时，深度算子网络会变得统计不稳定。例如在Navier-Stokes中，普通DeepONet随着分支坐标从129增长到8193，均方相对L2误差从0.0394恶化到0.1556，表明传感器网格细化会带来统计惩罚。
AI.method: 提出FAST-DeepONet分支表示：将固定谱路径与正则化的正交残差投影相结合。方向性惩罚作用于每一行归一化后的有效残差映射上，从而对高维强相关输入施加统计正则化。
AI.result: 在Navier-Stokes中，FAST-DeepONet在分支从129增长到8193时误差保持约0.04，而普通DeepONet从0.0394恶化到0.1556。在Navier-Stokes、Darcy流和终端波场预测的独立测试集上，均方相对L2误差降低4.7%至37.0%，且可训练参数减少3至7倍。
AI.conclusion: 固定谱路径与残差路径在功能上可分离：谱路径主导了Navier-Stokes和Darcy任务的改进，而终端波预测需要残差路径及其方向性惩罚。FAST-DeepONet面向坐标查询架构设计，仅依赖解值进行训练。

title: Decomposing Whole Slide Image Report Generation with Graph-Constrained Multiple Instance Learning Workflows
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 REG Challenge
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) report generation requires recognizing spatially distributed pathological features and organizing them into a coherent diagnostic narrative. Although direct vision-to-text models can yield fluent reports, they obscure the contributions and failure modes of visual recognition, structured reasoning, and language generation. We propose a decomposed framework in which frozen Virchow2 tile embeddings are aggregated by multiple-instance learning (MIL) classification heads that answer organ-specific diagnostic questions. An organ-conditioned graph constrains the assembly of these answers into a structured reasoning chain, which a language model realizes as a pathology report. On the REG2026 held-out set of 2,028 slides, the proposed workflow achieved a chain-Jaccard score of 0.702. Performance fell to 0.420 without graph-based chain construction, 0.398 when the organ-specific graphs were replaced by a single organ-agnostic graph, and 0.371 when the language model constructed the chain freely from MIL predictions. Using the same report generator, graph-structured chains improved the report score from 0.330 to 0.495. On 350 external TCGA WSIs spanning the seven REG organs without fine-tuning, the expected organ graph was selected in 64.0% of cases and ranked among the top three in 86.6%. Providing the correct organ graph increased agreement with coarse TCGA primary-diagnosis labels from 61.8% to 92.6%, identifying organ routing as a main bottleneck under domain shift. Overall, organ-conditioned, graph-constrained chain assembly improves structured reasoning and report generation while enabling stage-specific error localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式的全切片图像(WSI)报告生成框架：冻结的Virchow2 tile嵌入通过多实例学习(MIL)分类头回答器官特异的诊断问题，再由器官条件图约束将答案组装成结构化推理链，最后由语言模型生成病理报告。在REG2026留出集上，链式Jaccard得分达0.702；相比无图组装(0.420)、单一通用图(0.398)和自由链构建(0.371)均有显著提升。在350例外部TCGA切片上，正确器官图选择率64.0%，提供正确器官图后与粗粒度原发诊断标签的一致性从61.8%提升至92.6%，证实器官路由是领域偏移下的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 直接的vision-to-text模型虽然能生成流畅报告，但掩盖了视觉识别、结构化推理和语言生成各自的贡献与失败模式。作者希望将报告生成过程分解为可审计的模块，以便进行阶段特异性的错误定位和分析。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：(1) 冻结的Virchow2 tile嵌入通过MIL分类头回答器官特异的诊断问题；(2) 器官条件图约束这些答案的组装，形成结构化推理链；(3) 语言模型将推理链实现为病理报告。
AI.result: REG2026留出集(2028张切片)上链式Jaccard得分0.702；去掉图约束降至0.420，用通用图替代器官特异图降至0.398，语言模型自由构建链降至0.371。报告得分从0.330提升至0.495。在350例外部TCGA切片上，正确器官图选择率64.0%，top-3覆盖86.6%；提供正确器官图后与粗粒度TCGA诊断标签一致性从61.8%提升至92.6%。
AI.conclusion: 器官条件、图约束的链式组装能同时提升结构化推理与报告生成质量，并支持阶段特异性的错误定位。但实验也揭示了器官路由在领域偏移场景下是主要瓶颈。

title: Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering for Foraging Robot Swarms
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, The 18th International Symposium on Distributed Autonomous Robotic Systems
summary: The Central Place Foraging Algorithm (CPFA) combines site fidelity, pheromone-guided navigation, and uninformed random search to enable decentralized resource collection in robot swarms. However, CPFA often revisits previously explored regions while leaving other areas insufficiently searched, reducing efficiency as resources become scarce. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering (ARPC), a bio-inspired method in which robots deposit repulsive pheromone waypoints to mark previously explored locations. These waypoints are clustered around the nest to estimate low-value search regions, allowing robots to be redirected toward likely unvisited areas. By integrating the exploitation of known resources with systematic avoidance of redundant exploration, ARPC improves search diversity and resource discovery efficiency. Extensive simulations in ARGoS across varying arena sizes, resource densities, and clustered, random, and power-law spatial distributions demonstrate that ARPC consistently outperforms CPFA and the Grid-Based CPFA (GPFA). In particular, ARPC yields significant gains during both early discovery (10\%) and late-stage (up to 60\%) collection, where conventional methods typically degrade. These results indicate that ARPC provides a scalable and robust strategy for large-scale heterogeneous swarm foraging environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应排斥性信息素聚类（ARPC），一种基于生物启发的机器人集群觅食算法。ARPC通过让机器人在巢穴附近沉积排斥性信息素路标点，并对其进行聚类以估计低价值搜索区域，从而将机器人重定向至未探索区域。ARPC融合了已知资源的开发利用与冗余探索的系统性规避，在ARGoS仿真中相比CPFA和GPFA在早期发现（10%）和后期收集（最高60%）阶段均取得显著提升，为大规模异构集群觅食提供了可扩展且鲁棒的战略。
AI.motivation: 现有中央位置觅食算法（CPFA）结合了位点忠诚、信息素引导导航和随机搜索来实现分散式资源收集，但经常重复访问已探索区域，同时使其他区域搜索不足，导致资源稀缺时效率下降。
AI.method: 提出自适应排斥性信息素聚类（ARPC）：机器人在已探索位置沉积排斥性信息素路标点；这些路标点围绕巢穴进行聚类以估计低价值搜索区域；通过将已知资源的开发利用与冗余探索的系统性规避相结合，引导机器人转向可能未访问的区域。
AI.result: 在ARGoS平台上针对不同arena尺寸、资源密度以及聚类、随机和幂律空间分布进行了广泛仿真。ARPC始终优于CPFA和基于网格的GPFA，在早期发现阶段提升10%，后期收集阶段提升高达60%，而传统方法在这两个阶段通常性能退化。
AI.conclusion: ARPC为大尺度异构集群觅食环境提供了一种可扩展且鲁棒的策略，有效提高了搜索多样性和资源发现效率。

title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations
summary: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baselines, two downstream tasks, and four datasets, together with a minimal code-only continued pretraining recipe that closes much of it. Our method, invariant pretraining (InvPT), applies semantic-preserving transformations to the corpus and combines masked language modeling with multi-positive supervised contrastive learning that treats all augmentations of the same source function as positives, mixing self-contrast pairs (same code, different masks) with invariant-contrast pairs (transformed code) for positives of varying difficulty. Unlike prior contrastive code encoders, InvPT does not require paired natural-language data. Across our evaluation, InvPT improves robustness on transformed test sets by up to 11 percentage points on clone detection and 19 on code classification while matching or improving standard accuracy, and our ablations isolate multi-positive invariant contrast as the main source of the gains. Our aim is not a new objective but a careful measurement of where encoder robustness breaks and how far a simple, code-only recipe can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于编码器的代码表示模型在语义等价但语法形式不同的程序（不变程序）上表征退化的问题，提出了一种仅依赖代码的持续预训练方法 InvPT，通过语义保持变换结合掩码语言建模与多正样例监督对比学习，在克隆检测和代码分类任务上将鲁棒性提升最高达 11 和 19 个百分点，同时保持或提升标准准确率。
AI.motivation: 编码器类代码表示模型因体积小、推理成本低而在克隆检测、代码分类等判别任务中被广泛使用，但其鲁棒性脆弱：面对语义等价但语法形式不同的程序（即不变程序），学习到的表示严重退化。作者旨在系统地度量这一鲁棒性差距，并探索仅靠代码、无需自然语言配对数据的简单持续预训练方案能在多大程度上弥补该差距。
AI.method: 作者提出不变预训练（InvPT）：对语料库施加语义保持的变换，将掩码语言建模与多正样例监督对比学习相结合。所有来自同一源函数的增强都被视为正样本，混合了自对比对（同一代码、不同掩码）和不变对比对（变换后代码）以提供不同难度的正样本。该方法不依赖任何配对的自然语言数据，并且是一种最小化的仅代码持续预训练方案。
AI.result: 在四个编码器基线、两个下游任务、四个数据集上评估，InvPT 在变换后的测试集上使克隆检测鲁棒性提升最高达 11 个百分点，代码分类提升最高达 19 个百分点，同时标准准确率保持或提升。消融实验表明多正样例不变对比学习是收益的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 作者并非提出全新的训练目标，而是通过仔细测量编码器鲁棒性在何处失效，并证明一个简单、仅依赖代码的配方可以大规模恢复该鲁棒性，为社区提供了理解和不增加额外复杂度（无需自然语言配对数据）即可改善代码编码器鲁棒性的实证依据。

title: A Multi-Annotator Study of Segmentation Noise and Uncertainty in Turbid Underwater Images
comment: accepted at ECCVW'26 - 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Label uncertainty and annotator disagreement are common challenges in the field of computer vision, yet their study has largely been confined to the medical domain or to generic image-recognition datasets. Underwater datasets are particularly susceptible to these issues due to the need for domain expertise, degraded visibility conditions, and the inherent difficulty of establishing reliable ground truth in inaccessible environments. Despite these challenges, annotation uncertainty in underwater imagery remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic multi-annotator study of segmentation in real underwater scenes, with over 100 participants, and across varying, controlled levels of turbidity. We show that underwater datasets face many of the same annotation challenges as other vision tasks, while turbidity introduces additional systematic errors. We further investigate the main factors driving label noise and explore ways to improve annotation quality in turbid underwater environments, including privileged information, individual effort and annotator ensembles. All (meta-) data collected in this study will be available on the project page: https://vap.aau.dk/tubcertainty

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了真实水下场景中图像分割的标注不确定性与标注者分歧问题，涉及100多名参与者在不同可控浊度水平下的标注实验，发现水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，且浊度会引入额外的系统性误差，并探索了特权信息、个人努力和标注者集成等改善标注质量的方法。
AI.motivation: 标注不确定性和标注者分歧是计算机视觉中的常见挑战，但相关研究主要局限于医学领域或通用图像识别数据集。水下数据集因需要领域专业知识、能见度低以及难以在不可达环境中建立可靠真值而更容易受到这些问题的影响，但该领域至今缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 组织了超过100名参与者的多标注者分割标注研究，在受控的、多级浊度水平的真实水下场景中进行实验；系统地分析了标注不确定性、浊度对标注误差的影响，并调查了驱动标签噪声的主要因素；探索了特权信息、个体努力程度和标注者集成等手段以提升浊水环境下的标注质量。
AI.result: 研究表明水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务相似的标注挑战，同时浊度会引入额外的系统性标注误差。研究识别了驱动标签噪声的关键因素，并验证了特权信息、个人努力和标注者集成等方法在提高浊水下标注质量方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了水下图像标注不确定性研究的空白，提供了系统性多标注者数据集，所有（元）数据将在项目页面公开发布，为水下视觉任务的标注质量改进和不确定性问题研究提供了重要基础资源。

title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
summary: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. The high dimensionality and interdependence of humanoid motions make it challenging for conventional single-stage VLA architectures to coordinate locomotion, waist posture, and dual-arm manipulation effectively. Moreover, policies trained through offline behavior cloning can remain suboptimal during real-world deployment. Although online reinforcement learning can refine policies through real-world interaction, directly tuning large VLA backbones demands excessive computation and may introduce safety risks during real-robot exploration. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework), a two-part framework consisting of HAF-VLA and HAF-Steer that transfers off-the-shelf generalist VLA foundation models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. HAF-VLA is a hierarchical action-flow generator built on a pretrained flow-matching VLA. It splits full-body action denoising into three sequential stages with stage embeddings and cross-stage KV caches that retain kinematic dependencies, avoiding incoherent whole-body actions from one-shot generation. On top of the frozen HAF-VLA, HAF-Steer is a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline that leverages flow-matching invertibility and DCT-based dimensionality reduction to restrict RL optimization to a compact noise subspace and train a regularized SAC policy. This avoids updating the large VLA backbone and enables efficient real-world policy refinement. Evaluated on seven real-world humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, HAF surpasses vanilla single-stage VLA baselines and improves whole-body coordination and task performance. Project website: https://grange007.github.io/HAF .

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAF框架，包含HAF-VLA（层次化动作流生成器）和HAF-Steer（潜在离线到在线强化学习管道），将现成的通用VLA基础模型迁移到人形机器人全身移动操控任务中，在七项真实世界任务上超越单阶段VLA基线。
AI.motivation: 通用VLA基础模型难以直接应用于人形机器人全身移动操控。原因在于：人形运动高维度且各关节高度耦合，传统单阶段VLA架构难以有效协调 locomotion、躯干姿态和双臂操控；纯离线行为克隆训练的policy在真实部署中表现次优；而直接对大规模VLA骨干进行在线RL微调计算开销过大且存在真实机器人探索的安全风险。
AI.method: HAF由两部分组成：(1) HAF-VLA：基于预训练的flow-matching VLA构建层次化动作流生成器，将全身动作去噪分为三个顺序阶段，通过阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存保留运动学依赖，避免一次性生成导致的不连贯全身动作。(2) HAF-Steer：在冻结的HAF-VLA之上，利用flow-matching可逆性和DCT降维将RL优化限制在紧凑噪声子空间中，训练正则化SAC策略，避免更新大规模VLA骨干，实现高效的真实世界policy精炼。
AI.result: 在七项真实世界人形机器人移动操控任务上，HAF优于vanilla单阶段VLA基线，显著改善了全身协调性和任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化动作生成与潜在空间离线到在线RL相结合，HAF有效解决了将通用VLA基础模型迁移到人形全身移动操控中的高维动作协调和在线策略优化难题，为通用VLA在人形机器人上的落地提供了可行的范式。

title: SAGA: Structure-Attended Generative Action Embedding Model that encodes Multi-Surface User Action Sequences
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to ACM RecSys 2026 Context-Aware Recommender Systems (CARS) workshop
summary: Prior embedding models for sequential recommendation typically operate within a homogeneous action space, limiting their ability to capture cross-surface behavioral signals spanning distinct behavioral domains. We present SAGA, a generative action embedding model that encodes multi-surface user interaction sequences across a Financial Service organization's ecosystems, from checkout, peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions, in-app engagement, email to account actions, into a unified user representation for downstream recommendation tasks. Central to SAGA is a per-field tokenization schema that decomposes each action event into multiple field-level tokens (e.g. product, interaction, surface), enabling field-level attention and per-field training objectives that fused single-token approaches cannot support. Through an offline ablation study on loss formulation, tokenization granularity and training data scope, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. A downstream model integrated with SAGA-generated user embeddings delivers the strongest overall click and conversion lift across diverse downstream touchpoints, compared to all ablated and alternative architectures.

AI.tldr: SAGA是一个生成式动作嵌入模型，将跨多平台（结账、P2P交易、应用内互动、邮件、账户操作）的用户交互序列编码为统一用户表示，用于金融服务组织的下游推荐任务。该模型通过逐字段分词方案将每个动作事件分解为多个字段级token，支持字段级注意力机制和逐字段训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有的序列推荐嵌入模型通常在同质动作空间中运作，无法捕获跨越不同行为域的跨表面行为信号，限制了模型在多样化生态系统中对用户行为的建模能力。
AI.method: SAGA采用生成式动作嵌入方法，核心是逐字段（per-field）分词方案，将每个动作事件分解为多个字段级token（如产品、交互类型、表面/平台），从而支持字段级注意力机制和逐字段训练目标，克服了单token方法无法支持的表示融合问题。
AI.result: 离线消融实验隔离了损失函数形式、分词粒度和训练数据范围等设计选择的贡献。集成SAGA生成用户嵌入的下游模型在多样化的下游触点中实现了最强的整体点击和转化提升，优于所有消融变体及替代架构。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过将异构动作空间统一为字段级token化的生成式嵌入，有效捕获跨表面用户行为信号，显著提升了下游推荐任务的点击与转化性能，验证了逐字段分词方案相对于单token方法的优势。

title: JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the AI4VA Workshop at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://obvious-research.github.io/jolt/
summary: Although text-to-image generative models produce impressive results, they struggle to generate densely detailed, high-resolution (HR) images. Current literature addresses this issue with a low-to-high-resolution approach. First, a low-resolution (LR) image is generated. Then, an upsampled version is generated using the LR image as an additional cue. In this paper, we present Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT). To generate an image, JoLT uses two streams that jointly denoise LR and HR latent images at each sampling step. The LR latent controls the overall layout, while the HR latent controls the details. We interconnect both branches to jointly integrate their information. We extensively validate our method, demonstrating its advantages over competing baselines. The resulting images are not only richly detailed but also visually pleasing, opening new avenues for artistic creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT)，一种双流联合去噪的文本到图像生成方法，通过同时去噪低分辨率和高分辨率潜变量来生成高细节的高分辨率图像，其中LR潜变量控制整体布局，HR潜变量控制细节，并在采样过程中互联两个分支以整合信息。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型虽然效果出色，但在生成细节丰富的高分辨率图像方面仍有困难。当前主流方案采用低到高分辨率的级联方法，先生成低分辨率图像再以上采样方式生成高分辨率版本，这种方式存在信息传递和细节保真方面的局限。
AI.method: JoLT采用双流并行架构，在每一步采样过程中同时去噪LR和HR的潜变量图像。LR潜变量负责控制整体布局，HR潜变量负责控制细节，两个分支在采样过程中相互连接（interconnect），实现低分辨率全局信息与高分辨率细节信息的联合整合。
AI.result: 通过大量实验验证，JoLT在与竞争基线的对比中展现出明显优势。生成的图像不仅细节丰富，而且在视觉上令人愉悦，为艺术创作开辟了新途径。
AI.conclusion: JoLT通过双流联合潜变量轨迹的方式有效解决了高分辨率详细图像生成的问题，相比传统的低-高分辨率级联方法能生成更丰富细节且更具视觉吸引力的图像，展现了在艺术创作领域的应用潜力。

title: Security of Foundation-Model-Powered Embodied Agents: Attack Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
summary: Foundation models are increasingly used for perception, reasoning, planning, and action generation in embodied agents, creating security risks that can propagate from digital inputs to physical behavior. Existing surveys often organize threats by mechanisms such as jailbreaks, prompt injection, backdoors, poisoning, or adversarial examples, but these categories do not consistently identify where an adversary first enters the embodied control loop. We present a trust-boundary-centric survey of foundation-model-powered embodied-agent security. Using a first-compromised-trust-boundary principle, we separate attack surface from attack mechanism and organize the system into five layers and twelve attack surfaces spanning the model supply chain, user instructions, context and memory, physical semantic environments, multimodal perception, world state, internal reasoning, task planning, action interfaces, middleware, multi-agent communication, and execution control. Based on 58 attack records and 61 defense records collected through August 15, 2026, we analyze representative attacks, cross-layer propagation, defense placement, and evaluation practices. Our quantitative analysis shows that attack research is concentrated on multimodal perception and action interfaces, while defenses are especially concentrated on action-level and runtime protection. Context and long-term memory, middleware and networking, world-state integrity, and multi-agent trust remain comparatively underexplored. We conclude with open challenges in state provenance, compositional defenses, long-horizon attack propagation, physical realizability, Byzantine multi-robot behavior, and unified closed-loop evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以信任边界为中心的框架来调研具身智能体中基础模型的安全性问题，将攻击面与攻击机制分离，将系统划分为五层和十二个攻击面，并基于58个攻击记录和61个防御记录进行了定量分析，揭示了攻击研究与防御研究在各攻击面上的分布失衡及待探索的开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 基础模型越来越多地用于具身智能体的感知、推理、规划与动作生成，安全风险可能从数字输入传播到物理行为。现有调研通常按机制（如越狱、提示注入、后门、投毒、对抗样本）组织威胁，但这些类别无法一致地识别攻击者首次进入具身控制回路的入口，缺乏系统性的攻击面组织视角。
AI.method: 提出"首发信任边界"原则（first-compromised-trust-boundary），将攻击面与攻击机制分离；将具身智能体系统组织为五个层次和十二个攻击面，涵盖模型供应链、用户指令、上下文与记忆、物理语义环境、多模态感知、世界状态、内部推理、任务规划、动作接口、中间件、多智能体通信和执行控制；基于截至2026年8月15日收集的58条攻击记录和61条防御记录进行定量分析。
AI.result: 定量分析表明：攻击研究集中在多模态感知和动作接口，防御研究集中在动作层和运行时保护；上下文与长期记忆、中间件与网络、世界状态完整性以及多智能体信任等方向相对研究不足。
AI.conclusion: 指出开放挑战包括：状态溯源（state provenance）、组合式防御、长时域攻击传播、物理可实现性、拜占庭式多机器人行为以及统一的闭环评估。

title: Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework
summary: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. On the chronologically held-out test period, LightGBM attains PR-AUC = 0.0469, capturing 64 laundering cases at precision ~0.89 with 0.51 alerts per 10,000; the fusion stacker reaches PR-AUC = 0.0477 at precision ~0.91 and 0.46 alerts per 10,000, recovering 59 true positives. We map score bands to Rwanda-relevant analyst workflows and STR/SAR escalation, and outline a staged path from synthetic prototyping to real-data validation with the National Bank of Rwanda and FIC. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卢旺达移动货币生态系统中的反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）监控挑战，基于合成数据集SAML-D（950万条交易、17种洗钱类型），开发并评估了一套交易监控框架。在极端类别不平衡（~0.1%）、标签稀缺延迟、调查人员容量受限的现实约束下，构建账户中心行为特征并对比监督、无监督及融合模型。LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469、精确率~0.89、每万笔0.51条告警；融合元学习器达到PR-AUC=0.0477、精确率~0.91、每万笔0.46条告警。论文贡献在于提供了一条治理感知的、面向非洲移动货币监管机构约束的运营级管道和评估协议，而非新算法。
AI.motivation: 移动货币在撒哈拉以南非洲扩展了金融可及性，但也放大了在高频低价值交易生态中的洗钱/恐怖融资风险。卢旺达拥有数百万活跃移动货币用户和超出现有静态规则监控能力的交易规模。现有监控方法在这种极端不平衡、标签稀缺延迟、调查容量受限的运营约束下表现不佳，亟需一个与卢旺达AML/CFT制度对齐的实用监控框架。
AI.method: 使用SAML-D合成数据集（9,504,852条交易，17种洗钱类型），构建账户中心行为特征（滚动速度、净流向方向性、对手方多样性、突发性），基准测试监督分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM）、无监督异常检测器（隔离森林、局部离群因子）、密集自编码器及晚期融合元学习器。采用运营性评估指标：PR-AUC、~90%精确率校准点的召回率、top-K%召回率及每万笔告警数，并在时间上保留的测试集进行验证。
AI.result: LightGBM在保留测试期达到PR-AUC=0.0469，以~0.89精确率捕获64个洗钱案例，每万笔仅产生0.51条告警；融合堆叠器达到PR-AUC=0.0477，精确率~0.91，每万笔0.46条告警，恢复59个真阳性。研究还将评分区间映射到卢旺达相关的分析师工作流和STR/SAR上报流程。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的贡献是运营性的：提出了一条治理感知的监控管道和评估协议，其标定贴合非洲移动货币监管者的约束条件（极端不平衡、标签稀缺延迟、容量受限），并规划了从合成原型到与卢旺达国家银行和FIC进行真实数据验证的分阶段路径。论文明确声明其价值在于运营适配而非算法创新。

title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at scale and the open nature of concept lists due to a lack of consensus. To fill this gap, we develop a multimodal large language model (MLLM) council that, given an image and its CBM explanation, produces an explanation quality score. To ground and validate the council, we first conduct a human study to establish a ground-truth reference for CBM explanation quality: for an image, annotators compare explanations from two of LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, and CBM-Suite and choose the more useful one, or mark them as equally good or equally bad, yielding 2700 judgments over 900 image-comparison items on CUB-200, ImageNet-100, and Places365. Against this human reference, our five-model council, consisting of open-weight MLLMs, recovers over 70% of strict human preference rankings, rising to 83% on items where human annotators unanimously agree. Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality. CBX-Bench thus provides a human-aligned, scalable evaluation of CBM explanations beyond accuracy and isolated qualitative examples. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/meric-karadag/cbx-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CBX-Bench，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评审团的基准测试，用于定量评估概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的解释质量。研究者通过人类研究建立2700个判断的地面真实参考，验证了由5个开放权重MLLM组成的评审团能够恢复超过70%的严格人类偏好排名（在人类一致同意的项目上达到83%），从而提供了一个人类对齐、可扩展的CBM解释质量评估框架。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的核心动机是可解释性，但现有评估仍主要依赖下游分类准确率和孤立的定性示例。由于大规模真实概念注释不可行、概念列表缺乏共识，CBM解释质量缺乏定量度量标准，亟需可靠、可扩展的量化评估方法。
AI.method: 本文提出一个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评审团，该评审团接收图像及其CBM解释并生成解释质量评分。为验证评审团，研究者首先进行人类研究以建立CBM解释质量的地面真实参考：注释者在CUB-200、ImageNet-100和Places365数据集上比较LF-CBM、VLG-CBM和CBM-Suite三个模型的解释对，判断优劣或同等水平，共收集900个图像比较项上的2700个判断。最终评审团由5个开放权重MLLM组成。
AI.result: 五模型MLLM评审团在人类严格偏好排名上恢复了超过70%的一致性，在人类注释者一致同意的项目上达到83%。基于验证的评审团，作者构建了CBX-Bench公共基准和排行榜，允许新CBM作者提交模型解释并获得解释质量的系列级排名。
AI.conclusion: CBX-Bench提供了一种人类对齐、可扩展的CBM解释质量评估方案，超越了仅依赖准确率和孤立定性示例的传统评估方式，填补了CBM解释定量度量的空白。

title: FlexWorm: Primitive-augmented Hybrid Contact-motion Planning for Suction-based Multi-segment Deformable Robots
comment: 9 pages, 12 figures, accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/OQR5Sx5Bwnc
summary: Multi-segment suction-based soft robots are promising for inspection and maintenance in confined or fragile environments, but existing approaches still depend heavily on manually designed gaits and environment-specific motion scripts. This work presents a planning framework for serial multi-segment soft robots with deformable body segments and boundary suction pads. The formulation targets full 3D navigation on complex surfaces and explicitly handles discrete adhesion switching and continuous body deformation under geometric, collision, and quasi-static feasibility constraints, while remaining agnostic to the specific actuation realization used to produce segment deformation. Its core, block-wise IK hybrid search (IKHS), performs best-first search over feasible adhesion transitions while solving inverse kinematics only on induced free blocks. On top of IKHS, primitive-augmented hybrid search (PaHS) uses a learned observation--primitive embedding to retrieve short validated motion segments for fast local proposal, with fallback to standard IKHS branching when retrieval fails. In simulation, the framework consistently outperforms controlled baselines in planning success, transition quality, and efficiency across diverse terrains. PaHS matches IKHS in success rate while substantially reducing planning time. Repeated hardware experiments on a pneumatic multi-segment soft robot further demonstrate executability and online recovery under actuation and adhesion uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向串行多段吸附式软体机器人的规划框架，支持在复杂曲面上实现全3D导航。该框架通过块式逆运动学混合搜索（IKHS）和原语增强混合搜索（PaHS）处理离散吸附切换与连续体形变，在仿真和硬件实验中均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多段吸附式软体机器人在狭小或易碎环境中具有检查和维护潜力，但严重依赖人工设计的步态和特定环境运动脚本，缺乏通用且自主的规划方案。
AI.method: 提出一个规划框架，核心包括：1) 块式逆运动学混合搜索（IKHS），在可行吸附转换上进行最佳优先搜索，仅对诱发的自由块求解逆运动学；2) 原语增强混合搜索（PaHS），利用学习到的观测-原语嵌入检索短验证运动片段以快速生成局部提议，检索失败时回退到IKHS分支；3) 显式处理离散吸附切换与连续体形变，考虑几何、碰撞和准静态可行性约束，且对具体的驱动器实现不可知。
AI.result: 在仿真中，该框架在规划成功率、过渡质量和效率方面一致优于受控基线；PaHS在保持与IKHS相同成功率的同时大幅缩短了规划时间。在气动多段软体机器人上的重复硬件实验证明了其在执行可行性和在线恢复方面的能力，能够应对驱动和吸附不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多段吸附式软体机器人在复杂表面上的自主3D导航提供了高效规划框架，在保持高成功率的同时显著提升规划效率，并已在真实硬件上验证了可执行性与鲁棒性。

title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
comment: 53 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and analysis artifacts: https://github.com/Nixon-H/not-all-attention-is-equal
summary: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through the Transformer and into vision architectures. It reviews fixed and learned sparse attention, linear attention, IO-aware exact algorithms including FlashAttention, and state-space alternatives including Mamba. It also covers induction heads, superposition, and the attention-SSM duality. We further provide a structured narrative review, a benchmark synthesis with cross-study caveats, a five-problem research gap analysis, and a 2015-2026 evolution timeline. We conclude by framing attention research as an expansion of the efficiency-expressiveness-interpretability frontier and identifying future directions including unified efficiency benchmarks, learned routing for hybrid architectures, length generalization, and scalable mechanistic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于注意力机制的综合性综述，从序列到序列、计算机视觉、效率创新和可解释性四个线程系统梳理了注意力机制的发展，提出E-I-I（效率-表达力-可解释性）评分框架对21种方法进行对比，并通过蒙特卡洛分析表明结果支持粗粒度分层比较而非细粒度排序。文章还涵盖了从Bahdanau-Luong对齐到Transformer、FlashAttention、Mamba等架构的演化，并提供了2025-2026年代际时间线及五项研究缺口分析。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制在过去十年推动了机器学习的重大进展，但相关文献庞杂且分散于多个子领域。作者希望通过一篇系统性综述，将注意力机制在序列建模、视觉适配、效率优化和可解释性四个维度上的发展脉络整合起来，并提供统一的评估框架，以帮助研究社区更好地理解这一领域的整体图景和未来方向。
AI.method: 本文采用多种方法论相结合：首先定义效率（efficiency）、表达力（expressiveness）和可解释性（interpretability）三个评估标准，构建EEI评分框架对21种方法进行对比；其次采用确定性蒙特卡洛分析（200,000个样本）检验排序稳定性，并引入秩匹配零模型（rank-matched null model）作为对照；此外还进行了结构化叙事综述、跨研究基准综合、五项研究缺口分析和2015-2026年演化时间线梳理。
AI.result: 在±1分扰动模型下，蒙特卡洛分析显示67-70%的样本中排名变化超过一个位置，秩匹配零模型也呈现出相似的稳定性特征。这表明EEI评分框架下的细粒度排序不可靠，但粗粒度分层（tier-level）比较具有稳健性。综述完整覆盖了从Bahdanau-Luong对齐、Transformer到视觉注意力架构、稀疏/线性注意力、FlashAttention和Mamba等状态空间模型的演进，并系统讨论了归纳头、叠加现象及注意力-SSM对偶性等概念。
AI.conclusion: 注意力研究可被理解为在效率-表达力-可解释性前线上不断扩展的过程。未来研究重点包括：统一的效率基准评测、混合架构的学习路由、长度泛化（length generalization）以及可扩展的机制可解释性（scalable mechanistic interpretability）等方向。

title: ArtLang: Structured Language-to-Kinematics Grounding for Articulated 3D Actuation
summary: Articulated-object reconstructions recover explicit geometry and kinematics, but their parts often remain semantically anonymous and must be controlled through part indices and numerical joint parameters. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are bound to reconstructed parts while allowing uncertain parts to remain unnamed. A typed parser converts a command into a directive graph containing referring expressions, actions, magnitudes, reference frames, and relations. We then solve a global graph-to-graph grounding problem that jointly reasons about semantic, spatial, relational, and kinematic compatibility, with support for null assignments and abstention under ambiguity. Accepted directives are converted into continuous joint targets within the observed motion range and executed through forward kinematics. Experiments on synthetic reconstructions, mesh-based assets, and real captures demonstrate reliable language grounding and continuous articulated control across repeated parts, spatial references, relational commands, and ambiguous instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArtLang框架，实现对可重构铰接式三维资产的开词汇语言控制。该框架将资产表示为语义-运动学铰接图，结合语言特征与图约束运动，通过类型化解析器将命令转换为指令图，并求解全局图到图的接地问题，实现连续关节控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的铰接式物体重建能够恢复精确的几何和运动学信息，但重建出的部件在语义上是匿名的，只能通过部件索引和数值关节参数进行控制，缺乏直观的语言交互能力。
AI.method: ArtLang框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 语义-运动学铰接图表示，将资产表示为带语言特征和图约束运动的图结构；(2) 类型化解析器，将自然语言命令转换为包含指称表达、动作、幅度、参考坐标系和关系的指令图；(3) 全局图到图接地算法，联合推理语义、空间、关系和运动学兼容性，支持空赋值和歧义下的弃权机制。最终将接受的指令转换为观测运动范围内的连续关节目标并通过正向运动学执行。
AI.result: 在合成重建、基于网格的资产和真实捕获数据上的实验表明，ArtLang在重复部件、空间指称、关系命令和歧义指令场景下均实现了可靠的语言接地和连续铰接控制。
AI.conclusion: ArtLang展示了通过语义-运动学图和全局接地推理实现持久可重建铰接资产的开放词汇语言控制的可能性，有效解决了部件语义匿名性和命令歧义性问题。

title: $τ_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to both execute individual skills reliably and sequence them coherently over extended tasks. Most hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) models make each such decision with a single forward pass, leaving no mechanism to allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices. We introduce $τ_0$-VLA, a hierarchical robot foundation model that formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem through world-model-guided test-time computation. At each inference step, the high-level policy uses execution memory to generate a subtask and, when needed, searches over alternatives before committing to its output. A low-level policy then executes the generated subtask across multiple robot embodiments. The policy is trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world data with multimodal co-training. Across in-domain and distribution-shifted settings, allocating additional test-time computation substantially improves next-subtask prediction accuracy, and these gains translate into higher closed-loop success on long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: τ₀-VLA 是一个分层的机器人基础模型，通过世界模型引导的测试时计算（test-time computation）来解决长时程操作任务，在推理时为高难度或关键的子任务决策分配额外计算资源，并通过搜索备选方案来提高长时程任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 大多数分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在每次决策时只进行一次前向传播，没有机制为困难或关键选择分配额外计算资源，而这在长时程机器人操作中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出τ₀-VLA层次化机器人基础模型：(1) 高层策略利用执行记忆生成子任务，并在必要时通过世界模型引导的测试时计算搜索备选方案后再确定输出；(2) 低层策略在多机器人本体验证上执行生成的子任务；(3) 使用40,115小时的异构真实世界数据进行多模态协同训练。
AI.result: 在域内和分布偏移设置下，额外的测试时计算显著提高了下一子任务预测的准确性，这些增益有效转化为长时程机器人操作任务更高的闭环成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高层子任务生成建模为可扩展计算的推理问题，测试时计算分配能够有效提升分层VLA模型在长时程操作任务上的表现，为机器人基础模型提供了新的计算效率与性能权衡维度。

title: High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection
summary: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $ψ_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. We derive the exact population tent shape and localization margin, introduce a seeded shortest-interval algorithm with a padded local recentering step, and prove exact recovery by induction: null recursive segments remain inactive, every undetected change retains a balanced isolating interval, and the shortest active seed contains exactly one change before recentering. A two-way cross-fitted scalar refinement attains $O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ localization in the small-jump regime, matching a Le Cam lower bound on a pure cubic family whose degree-two projection jump is exactly zero. Reproducible experiments at $d\in\{20,50,100,200\}$ and a three-change $d=100$ sequence demonstrate the intended high-dimensional regime without materializing a $(d+1)^3$ tensor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种非参数变点检测方法，通过构造对称三阶Legendre特征张量H_3(X)来捕获密度投影的三阶结构（偏度、非对称交互等），无需直接估计密度。方法在[-1,1]^d上实现密度三阶投影的精确等距编码，并利用三阶多项式混沌的ψ_{2/3}尾部性质获得尖锐浓度结果。通过坐标正交特化，可实现数百维的前缀和计算。算法采用种子最短区间加填充局部重心的策略，证明可精确恢复变点；在小区间跳跃情形下，双向交叉拟合标量细化达到O_P(κ^{-2})的定位精度，匹配Le Cam下界。
AI.motivation: 传统的变点检测方法基于均值和协方差，但许多分布变化仅体现在偏度、非对称交互或其它三阶结构中，对均值和协方差不可见。现有方法无法有效检测这类"隐性"分布变化，特别是在高维场景下。作者希望开发一种非参数方法，能够保留密度三阶以内的全部系数而不需要直接估计密度。
AI.method: 构造对称三阶Legendre特征张量H_3(X)∈Sym^3(R^{d+1})，使得A(f)=E_f H_3(X)是密度三阶投影的精确等距编码。固定张量收缩被建模为三阶多项式混沌，具有ψ_{2/3}尾部；坐标正交特化可将界改进为√log d并实现前缀和算法。提出带填充局部重心步骤的种子最短区间算法，通过归纳法证明精确恢复能力。双向交叉拟合标量细化在小区间跳跃情形下改进定位精度。
AI.result: 理论结果包括：三阶张量编码的等距性质、对应浓度界、精确恢复的归纳证明、以及O_P(κ^{-2})定位上界（匹配Le Cam下界）。在纯三次族上验证，该族二次投影跳跃恰为零，证明方法能检测均值和协方差均不变的变化。实验覆盖d∈{20,50,100,200}及d=100三变点序列，展示了高维适用性且无需物化(d+1)^3大小的张量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功填补了变点检测中三阶结构变化不可检测的空白，通过高维张量特征和精细的概率分析，在高维规模下高效运行而不需显式物化张量，定位精度达到理论最优下界。适用于均值和协方差不变但三阶结构发生变化的应用场景。

title: HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions
summary: Relocalising archival photographs within a contemporary scene model is challenging because historic and modern views can differ in photographic appearance, visible objects, and spatial layout. Therefore, we present HistReNeRF, a framework that estimates the 6-DoF pose of a historic photograph by matching adapted DINOv2 patch features to candidate rays sampled from a contemporary Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) reconstruction. The continuous representation of a NeRF provides a queryable scene interface from which candidate rays can be sampled and matched, enabling domain adaptation between historic photography and contemporary images directly in the feature representation used for localisation. We evaluate embedding-space-based domain adaptation against pixel-space methods on a new cross-temporal dataset comprising 10,545 contemporary street-level images and 230 archival photographs from three European landmarks. Embedding-space adaptation reduces translation and rotation errors by an average of 11% and 16%, respectively, across the three scenes. These results show that neural scene relocalisation provides a natural interface for feature-space adaptation, reducing cross-temporal appearance shift without modifying the query image. Code and dataset at https://github.com/ARTUROLab/HistReNeRF.

AI.tldr: HistReNeRF是一个通过将适配后的DINOv2补丁特征与从当代NeRF重建中采样的候选射线进行匹配，来估计历史照片6自由度位姿的框架，并提出了跨时间数据集用于评估。
AI.motivation: 历史档案照片在当代场景模型中进行重新定位具有挑战性，因为历史与现代视图在摄影外观、可见物体和空间布局上存在显著差异，现有方法难以直接处理这种跨时间的外观偏移。
AI.method: 利用NeRF的连续表示提供可查询的场景接口，从当代NeRF重建中采样候选射线，将适配后的DINOv2 patch特征与候选射线进行特征匹配，直接在用于定位的特征表示中进行嵌入空间域适应，以弥合历史摄影与现代图像之间的域差距。
AI.result: 在包含10,545张当代街道图像和230张来自三个欧洲地标的历史档案照片的新跨时间数据集上，嵌入空间域适应相比像素空间方法在三个场景中平均将平移误差和旋转误差分别降低了11%和16%。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景重定位为特征空间适应提供了自然的接口，无需修改查询图像即可有效减少跨时间外观偏移，验证了基于特征嵌入的域适应方法在历史照片定位中的有效性。

title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.

AI.tldr: BATON提出了一种长时程机器人操作任务的分解式探索与组合方法：以子任务为探索单元、将成本从指数级降为加法级，并通过过渡感知记忆（调用过渡、交接过渡、前瞻过渡）解决子任务间状态传递问题，无需更新参数即在RoboMemArena基准上提升11.6%的任务成功率和14.9%的累积成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要将多个接触丰富的技能串联成多阶段任务。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽能掌握单个技能，但链式执行时错误会累积、超出策略的纠正能力，且一个子任务会悄然制约下一个。现有的"冻结VLA+LLM智能体编排"方案在长时程上存在两大缺陷：(1) 能力来源于测试时的整任务探索，成本随阶段数呈指数增长（T^K），且失败无法定位到具体阶段；(2) 缺乏对过渡状态的表征，VLA原语只有退出条件而无进入条件，导致前一子任务的输出形式无法被后继子任务使用。
AI.method: BATON针对两大缺陷分别提出解决方案。针对(1)，将子任务作为探索单元：每个子任务在廉价的短时程场景中独立探索并将解存入记忆，长时程轨迹由这些解组合而成而非整体发现，使成本从乘法（T^K）变为加法（T*K），且每次失败都能归因到单一阶段。针对(2)，为记忆配备过渡感知机制：子任务内部由验证智能体管控调用过渡（VLA仅在腕部视角确认场景就绪后才被调用）；子任务之间由交接过渡恢复被前驱残留扰动破坏的进入状态，并由前瞻过渡选择后继可继承结果的策略。整个过程中无需更新任何参数。
AI.result: 在长时程基准RoboMemArena上，BATON相比当前最先进方法（SoTA）将任务成功率提升11.6%，累积成功率提升14.9%。
AI.conclusion: BATON验证了"以子任务为单位进行探索+过渡感知记忆"这一范式对长时程机器人操作的有效性：它把指数级探索成本降为线性，并显式建模子任务间的状态转移条件，从而在不更新参数的前提下显著提升长时程链式任务的成功率。

title: Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs
summary: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Norfolk岛一个781人近交人群的群体结构，其中318人是邦蒂号叛变者的后裔。通过立体视网膜眼底照片重建三维视神经乳头（ONH）形态，利用深度神经网络进行自学习分解为层级特征，筛选出最具判别力的特征来区分两个人群，并通过分层聚类分析群体成员构成，为青光眼等ONH相关眼病的遗传风险因子研究奠定表型基础。
AI.motivation: 通过表型（视神经乳头三维形态）而非传统基因型来进行群体结构分析，利用Norfolk岛独特的人群结构（英国与波利尼西亚祖先的混合及奠基者效应），为青光眼等视神经相关眼病的遗传风险因子发现提供新的分析途径。
AI.method: 从立体视网膜眼底照片中通过多尺度立体匹配算法重建三维视神经乳头形态；使用深度神经网络通过自学习将ONH形态分解为层级特征；根据不同层级特征的判别力筛选特征；采用分层交叉验证评估预测准确性；基于选定特征将个体分为k个层级聚类（k=2至7），确定聚类成员比例。
AI.result: 通过选定特征集实现了对两个人群（叛变者后代与非叛变者后代）的有效区分，并成功将个体分组为k个层级聚类以分析群体结构，验证了基于表型图像分析进行群体结构解析的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 基于表型的图像分析方法可以实现人群遗传结构的解析，使遗传力和连锁分析（包括来自英国和波利尼西亚祖先的奠基者效应）成为可能，有望发现青光眼及其他视神经相关眼病的新遗传风险因素。

title: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NumerosityVLM基准，包含10,800张合成图像、六个受控条件，正交操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量，同时逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色。对七个VLM的零样本评估发现，模型架构解释最大比例的性能方差（部分ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件；层级探针表明数量感知信号在视觉编码器早期阶段就线性可分，而模型间性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。
AI.motivation: 现有的计数基准将数量感知与相关视觉因素纠缠在一起，导致当前VLM的数量感知能力（一种在人类婴儿在语言习得前就已出现的认知能力）未被很好地理解。
AI.method: 构建一个认知启发的诊断基准NumerosityVLM，包含10,800张合成图像和六个受控条件，正交操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量，逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色；对七个VLM进行零样本评估，采用多因素分析（partial ω²）和层级探针（layer-wise probing）进行诊断。
AI.result: 模型架构解释了最大的性能方差（部分ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件的影响；数量感知信号在视觉编码器早期阶段就一致地以线性可分离的方式涌现；模型间的性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。
AI.conclusion: VLM的数量感知能力主要受模型架构（尤其是语言模型部分）驱动，而非受视觉输入条件主导；数量信号在视觉编码早期即出现，提示改进语言模型组件可能是提升VLM数量感知能力的关键方向。代码和数据已公开。

title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation
summary:
The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

AI.tldr: 本文解决了基于有向无环图（DAG）的网络化信息聚合问题中的核心开放问题：Kearns等人（2026）给出了沿长度为D的路径的MSE上界O(1/√D)和下界Ω(1/D)，留下了正确的阶数未知。本文构造了一组最坏情况实例，证明MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，从而与上界匹配，完全解决了该开放问题。此外，利用学习预测器结构的对称不变性，分析推广到满足正则条件（包括原点附近的强凸性）的所有凸损失函数，如逻辑损失等，并同时闭合了Bateni等人（2026）中的上下界差距。
AI.motivation: Kearns等人（2026）在网络化信息聚合问题中，对MSE给出了沿D长度路径的上界O(1/√D)和下界Ω(1/D)，两者之间存在√D量级的差距，正确阶数悬而未决。解决这一核心开放问题是本文的主要动机。同时，Bateni等人（2026）中逻辑损失的上下界也存在类似差距，需要统一的框架来广义地处理多种损失函数。
AI.method: 本文通过构造最坏情况的高斯实例族来证明MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)。核心技术在于利用学习预测器结构上的对称不变性，将分析从MSE推广到所有满足正则条件的凸损失函数（包含原点附近强凸性、最优预测器与标签正相关等条件）。通过展示逻辑损失等多个常见损失满足这些条件，统一了不同损失函数下的误差下界分析。
AI.result: （1）构造了最坏情况实例族，证明网络化信息聚合在MSE下的误差下界为Ω(1/√D)，与Kearns等人（2026）的上界O(1/√D)匹配，从而完全解决了该开放问题；（2）将该结果推广到满足正则条件的所有凸损失函数（包括逻辑损失），证明了这些损失下同样存在Ω(1/√D)的ℓ误差下界；（3）该结果同时闭合了Bateni等人（2026）中逻辑损失的上下界差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过构造匹配上下界的实例，完整解决了网络化信息聚合问题中MSE误差的正确阶数这一核心开放问题，并利用结构不变性将结果推广到广泛的一类凸损失函数，实现了通用框架下的统一分析，不仅闭合了本领域的两个悬而未决的差距，还为后续网络化学习研究中误差刻画提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Spatially-Grounded Flow Matching: Structured Source Distributions for Image Generation
summary: Current flow matching models learn to transport the source i.i.d. Gaussian noise into the target distribution of natural images, yet this source distribution carries no notion of spatial structure. Images however are fundamentally local since nearby pixels are strongly correlated. By sampling the noise independently, we hypothesize that models are implicitly encouraged to exploit less noisy neighbors as context during training, partially bypassing the need to properly learn the true local structure of images. The source distribution, in other words, works against the inductive bias of the image domain. To ameliorate this design discrepancy, we propose StructFlow which encodes spatial locality directly into the source by having the pixels within a small region share a common noise component. This structured source produces transport paths that are geometrically aligned with image regions - enabling properties that generic flow matching struggles to provide: fine-grained local editing that naturally respects boundaries, robust structure preservation, and smooth semantic interpolation between images. We show that these benefits also extend to large pre-trained models, demonstrating that StructFlow can even be incorporated through a lightweight post-training phase. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets, in unconditional, class and text-conditioned regimes, using different diffusion transformer architectures confirm that StructFlow not only offers competitive image generation quality, but also significantly improves localized controllable re-synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出StructFlow方法，将空间局部性直接编码到流匹配的源分布中，使局部区域像素共享共同的噪声分量，从而改善图像生成质量并实现细粒度局部编辑、结构保持和语义插值等能力。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配模型从i.i.d.高斯噪声中采样源分布，但该分布缺乏空间结构概念，与图像局部性（邻近像素强相关）的归纳偏置相矛盾。独立采样噪声会隐式鼓励模型利用较干净的邻居作为上下文，部分规避了真正学习图像局部结构的需要。
AI.method: StructFlow将空间局部性编码进源分布，使小区域内像素共享共同噪声分量，从而产生与图像区域几何对齐的传输路径。该方法可应用于无条件、类别条件和文本条件等场景，并支持通过轻量级后训练阶段集成到大预训练模型中。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上、不同扩散Transformer架构下，StructFlow在无条件/类别/文本条件下不仅提供具有竞争力的图像生成质量，还显著改善局部可控的再合成能力，包括精细的局部编辑、稳健的结构保持和语义插值。
AI.conclusion: 通过将空间局部性编码到源分布中，StructFlow解决了流匹配中源分布与图像域归纳偏置之间的不匹配问题，在保持生成质量的同时大幅增强了局部可控性，且可轻量地扩展到预训练大模型。

title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
summary: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究深度网络训练过程中的短期可预测性（short-horizon predictability）作为时间冗余的度量，通过三类互补探针在视觉与语言两个训练场景中揭示：辅助参数（向量型）的动态比主体权重（矩阵型）更简单可预测，且可预测性集中在局部的、时间变化的"口袋"区域，从而将短期可预测性定位为一种回顾式、参数分辨的训练动力学诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 深度网络训练是一个漫长更新轨迹的过程，但相比架构、损失函数和优化器，训练的时间组织结构（temporal organization）尚未被系统刻画。作者希望理解训练轨迹在时间上的冗余性——即近期更新中是否含有关于近未来参数运动的信息，以及这种信息在何处、何时、何种训练条件下出现。
AI.method: 作者提出以短期可预测性衡量时间冗余，组合了三类互补探针家族：（1）位移方向探针；（2）子空间残差探针；（3）基于预测器的探针。同时采用惯例感知（convention-aware）、零校准（null-calibrated）的组级读取方式，应用于CIFAR的多轮视觉训练和公开Pythia预训练检查点。
AI.result: 两类训练体制下均发现：向量型张量（归一化参数和偏置等辅助参数）的短期动态比矩阵型特征变换权重（主体参数）更简单可预测，主体参数的可预测行为集中在局部且随时间变化的口袋区域。探针间及与独立轨迹诊断的一致性表明测量反映内在轨迹结构，而探针差异区分互补的时间组织形式。CIFAR对照实验显示架构和训练配方系统性调节该结构。Pythia-70M案例研究发现一系列与角色、深度和规模相关的事件，包括主体权重ESA跌破随机符号一致水平，以及可预测的qkv口袋在层间的出现与再分配。
AI.conclusion: 短期可预测性可作为一种回顾式、参数分辨的训练动力学诊断工具，揭示了训练轨迹中此前未被系统刻画的时间结构，为理解深度网络学习的动态过程提供了新视角。

title: AlignJEPA: Predictive Vision-Language Alignment for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing (RS) foundation models provide transferable Earth observation representations across sensors, resolutions, and geographies, yet most remain weakly aligned with natural language, limiting natural-language archive search, image-text retrieval, and question-conditioned analysis. We propose AlignJEPA, a JEPA-inspired predictive vision-language alignment framework for remote sensing foundation models. AlignJEPA uses a pretrained AnySat visual encoder and a RemoteCLIP text encoder while training only a lightweight predictive alignment network. Instead of relying on global image--text contrastive alignment alone, the framework predicts remote-sensing text embeddings from masked visual foundation-model tokens. Its mask-aware multi-scale predictive aligner aggregates visible tokens at fine, regional, and global scales, jointly models them with a cross-scale Transformer, and projects the resulting representation into the text space using learned query pooling. Training combines semantic prediction with bidirectional contrastive retrieval. We train and evaluate AlignJEPA on BigEarthNet.txt for natural-language Sentinel retrieval, evaluate cross-dataset adaptation on RSICD, and use RSVQA only as a closed-set representation probe. AlignJEPA provides a parameter-efficient route for aligning Earth observation foundation models with language.

AI.tldr: AlignJEPA是一个面向遥感基础模型的JEPA启发的预测式视觉-语言对齐框架，通过在预训练视觉编码器上仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络，实现遥感文本嵌入预测与双向对比检索，实现参数高效的视觉-语言对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型在传感器、分辨率和地理区域上具有可迁移的地球观测表征，但大多数与自然语言的弱对齐限制了自然语言档案检索、图像-文本检索和基于问题的分析能力。
AI.method: AlignJEPA采用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络。具体包括：基于掩码的视觉基础模型令牌预测遥感文本嵌入；掩码感知的多尺度预测对齐器在细粒度、区域和全局尺度聚合可见令牌，通过跨尺度Transformer联合建模，并使用学习的查询池化将表征投影到文本空间；训练结合语义预测与双向对比检索。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet.txt上进行自然语言Sentinel检索训练与评估，在RSICD上评估跨数据集适应能力，并使用RSVQA作为闭集表征探针。AlignJEPA提供了参数高效的对齐路径。
AI.conclusion: AlignJEPA证明了通过预测式对齐（而非单纯的全局对比对齐）可以参数高效地将地球观测基础模型与语言对齐，并具备跨数据集适应能力。

title: QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
summary: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

AI.tldr: QSMP是一种通过密度引导的时序子序列聚类来发现长时间序列中代表性波形的方法，它创新性地将Quick Shift模式寻找算法与Matrix Profile相似性搜索数据结构相结合，在空间复杂度上优于现有最先进方法，实验证明其在总结和可视化长时间序列方面的价值。
AI.motivation: 在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形具有重要的科学和实践价值，可用于时序数据集的总结、可视化以及分类和预测等下游任务。现有方法在空间复杂度等方面存在不足，需要更高效的方法来发现代表性波形。
AI.method: QSMP通过建立Quick Shift（一种模式寻找算法）与Matrix Profile（一种时序相似性搜索数据结构）之间的新颖联系，将Quick Shift适配到长时间序列中子序列的聚类任务中，从而实现密度引导的聚类。该方法在空间复杂度上优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP能够有效地通过寻找代表性波形来总结和可视化长时间序列，证明其作为一种有价值的工具的有效性。
AI.conclusion: QSMP作为一种基于密度引导聚类的代表性波形发现方法，在空间效率和实际效果上均具有优势，可作为长时间序列总结与可视化的有效工具。

title: GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models. Fine-grained visual evidence, however, remains difficult to preserve and reuse across text-based reasoning steps. To address this limitation, tool-augmented thinking-with-images methods maintain visual access externally by revisiting or manipulating the image, but require predefined tools and additional inference-time processing. As an internal alternative, continuous visual latent reasoning retains intermediate computation in hidden states. However, its prevailing autoregressive construction makes each latent state depend on its predecessors, so later states may repeat information already present in the latent sequence rather than capture complementary visual details. We introduce GLaQ, a grounded latent-query framework that replaces sequential latent rollout with a fixed set of context-conditioned queries grounded in the original visual tokens. The grounded queries are reinjected for answer generation, providing direct and coordinated access to source visual evidence. We train GLaQ with localized-view supervision followed by reinforcement learning under task-level rewards.
