summary: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. We evaluate RRFC across six baselines spanning adversarial, equilibrium, and diffusion-based models and three paired image-to-image translation tasks. Across 18 architecture-task settings, RRFC yields seven Holm-corrected improvements, seven degradations, and four non-significant changes. The gains concentrate on reconstruction-fidelity and identity settings, while five of the seven degradations fall on the single semantic-layout task, where every model declines. These results indicate that feedback-based refinement helps when its objective overlaps with the evaluated property, and that its gains concentrate on the tasks where that overlap holds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RRFC（递归反馈条件细化）框架，通过将模型上一次的预测输出作为辅助通道反馈回输入，使单次生成的图像生成器能够迭代修订自身输出。在6个基线模型、3个配对图像翻译任务、18个架构-任务组合上的实验显示：7项显著提升、7项退化、4项无显著变化。提升集中在重建保真度和身份保持任务，退化集中在语义布局任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件图像生成器是单次（single-shot）映射：一次前向传播即生成最终结果，没有机会自我修正。尽管模型在训练中被优化为一步生成最佳结果，但如果能自适应地迭代修正自身输出，仍有性能提升空间。
AI.method: RRFC的核心是将生成器最近一次的输出预测作为辅助通道，与原输入拼接后反馈回模型作为新的条件输入，从而将单次生成转化为迭代细化过程。该方法保持生成器核心架构不变，仅修改条件输入接口，并根据模型族（对抗式、均衡式、扩散式）相应地调整训练或推理流程，因此可无缝附加到现有生成器上。
AI.result: 在18个架构-任务组合中，RRFC带来7项Holm校正后显著提升、7项显著退化、4项无显著变化。提升集中在重建保真度和身份保持任务，而7项退化中有5项出现在语义布局任务上，该任务上所有模型均表现下降。
AI.conclusion: 反馈式细化在细化目标与评估指标目标一致时有效，其增益集中在目标重叠成立的任务（重建保真、身份保持）上，而在目标不一致的任务（语义布局）上会导致退化，提示RRFC的适用性取决于任务特性。

title: Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles
summary: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the discovered tree structures. Stage~3 solves a single $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression over leaf-region indicators, yielding jointly optimal sparse coefficients. This learning approach ensures that every prediction decomposes into an algebraic sum of named, non-overlapping rule contributions, enabling full auditability by design. Empirical evaluation on twelve clinical-domain binary classification benchmarks using repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that RPTE performs competitively against tuned opaque ensembles and interpretable baselines. RPTE reduces model inspection units by 9$\times$ to 87$\times$ relative to XGBoost and maintains lower audit complexity than EBM on all 12 datasets. RuleFit requires comparable or fewer inspection units on three datasets where its rule count is small, but without source-disjointness guarantees. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/srikumar2050/hugiml-core}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPTE（残差模式树集成），一种三阶段学习框架，通过有界特征预算、源不相交约束和独立系数估计三个原则，使每个预测可分解为命名且不重叠规则的代数求和，从而实现完全可审计性。在12个临床二分类基准上，RPTE与调优的黑盒集成和可解释基线性能相当，模型检查单元比XGBoost减少9~87倍，审计复杂度在全部12个数据集上优于EBM。
AI.motivation: 临床和受监管场景中的预测模型必须既准确又完全可审计。树集成在表格数据上表现优异，但序列提升将结构发现与系数估计耦合，难以实现紧凑的逐预测审计；而可解释替代方案存在局限性：广义加性模型通常限制交互为成对项，事后规则提取器产生重叠规则妨碍紧凑解释。
AI.method: RPTE采用三阶段学习：Stage 1构建有监督符号特征词汇表；Stage 2在源不相交约束下生长浅层树（每个原始变量最多分配一棵树），仅保留发现的树结构；Stage 3在叶区域指示符上求解单一L1正则化逻辑回归，获得联合最优稀疏系数。三个关键原则：有界特征预算、源不相交性、独立系数估计。
AI.result: 在12个临床二分类基准上采用重复分层5折交叉验证，RPTE与调优黑盒集成和可解释基线具有竞争力。RPTE将模型检查单元相对于XGBoost减少9~87倍，且在所有12个数据集上保持比EBM更低的审计复杂度。RuleFit在3个规则数较少的数据集上需要相当或更少的检查单元，但不具备源不相交性保证。
AI.conclusion: RPTE通过将树结构发现与系数估计解耦并施加源不相交约束，在保持预测性能的同时实现了完全可审计性，为临床和监管场景提供了新的可解释建模方案。

title: Bitstream Action Recognition is Byte Modeling
summary: Conventional action recognition typically relies on successful pixel decoding of the bitstream. However, bitstream corruption during storage or transmission may cause severe visual artifacts or even decoding failure, posing a significant challenge to reliable action recognition. Bitstream Action Recognition (BAR) aims to overcome the dependency on decoding and the vulnerability to corruption. In this paper, we propose a novel BAR framework, Bitstream Recognition via Anchoring Corrupted Embeddings (BRACE). BRACE is a dual-branch byte-modeling architecture that treats a corrupted bitstream and its intact counterpart as two byte realizations of the same action. This guides the generation of rich and stable representations for robustness to corruption through Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA). The intact representation serves as a stable anchor, and the corrupted one is aligned to it at the embedding and decision levels under Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS), entirely in representation space and without repairing the bitstream. To address the scarcity of corrupted bitstreams in practice, we introduce the Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS), a four-parameter simulator that reproduces bit-flip and byte-loss errors arising in transmission and storage. Building on RBCS, we construct the first large-scale BAR dataset (BAR-D), which comprises the BAR-Stanford40 and BAR-PPMI subsets and spans diverse corruption types and severity levels. Finally, we build a large benchmark on BAR-D involving 14 action recognition methods from the pixel, compressed, and bitstream domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE has superior robustness to bitstream corruption than all comparison methods. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed RBCS augmentation and IARA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRACE框架，用于比特流动作识别（BAR），通过双分支字节建模架构，将损坏比特流与完整比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现，利用完整锚点对齐损坏嵌入实现鲁棒识别，无需修复比特流。同时提出四参数损坏模拟器RBCS构建首个大规模BAR数据集BAR-D，并建立包含14种方法的基准。
AI.motivation: 传统动作识别依赖比特流的像素解码，但传输或存储过程中的比特流损坏会导致视觉伪影甚至解码失败，严重影响识别的可靠性。本文旨在克服对解码的依赖以及对损坏的脆弱性。
AI.method: BRACE采用双分支字节建模架构，将损坏和完整的比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现。通过Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA)在嵌入层和决策层将损坏表示与完整锚点对齐（全程在表示空间内，无需修复比特流），并结合Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS)抑制不可靠锚点。此外提出Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS)，一个四参数模拟器来复现传输和存储中的比特翻转和字节丢失错误。
AI.result: 构建了包含BAR-Stanford40和BAR-PPMI两个子集、涵盖多种损坏类型和严重程度的首个大规模BAR数据集BAR-D，并在其上建立了涉及14种像素/压缩/比特流域动作识别方法的基准。大量实验表明BRACE在比特流损坏鲁棒性上优于所有对比方法，消融实验验证了RBCS增强和IARA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BRACE通过完整锚点对齐损坏嵌入的方式，在不需要修复比特流的前提下实现了对比特流损坏的高度鲁棒的动作识别，并通过RBCS模拟器和BAR-D数据集填补了该领域的空白。

title: FirstDiff: One-Step Diffusion-Based Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series via Initial Noise Prediction
summary:
Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for multivariate time-series anomaly detection by learning the distribution of normal data through iterative denoising. Existing diffusion-based approaches, however, typically perform anomaly detection after completing the reverse diffusion process, relying primarily on the final reconstructed signal and overlooking informative representations produced during denoising. This design incurs substantial computational cost and limits the use of intermediate diffusion information for anomaly detection.
  In this paper, we propose FirstDiff, a diffusion-based anomaly detection framework based on the observation that the predicted diffusion noise at the initial reverse-diffusion evaluation already contains sufficient information for accurate anomaly detection. FirstDiff models the statistical distribution of predicted diffusion noise under normal behavior using validation data, enabling anomaly inference from a single denoising-network evaluation rather than completing the reverse diffusion trajectory.
  To model complex temporal and inter-sensor dependencies, FirstDiff employs a Diffusion Transformer as the denoising backbone. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that FirstDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing diffusion inference from the full reverse trajectory to a single denoising-network evaluation.

AI.tldr: FirstDiff提出了一种基于扩散模型的多元时间序列异常检测框架，核心发现是反向扩散过程初始评估时预测的扩散噪声已包含足够信息进行异常检测，因此无需完成完整的反向扩散轨迹，仅需一次去噪网络评估即可实现SOTA性能，大幅降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的异常检测方法需要完成整个反向扩散过程后才进行异常检测，仅依赖最终重建信号，忽略了去噪过程中产生的中间表示信息，导致计算成本高昂且未能充分利用扩散中间信息的价值。
AI.method: FirstDiff基于核心观察——初始反向扩散评估时预测的扩散噪声已包含足够异常检测信息。该方法利用验证数据对正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布进行建模，从而只需一次去噪网络评估即可完成异常推断。模型采用Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干网络，以建模复杂的时间与跨传感器依赖关系。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FirstDiff达到了最先进的性能，同时将扩散推理从完整的反向轨迹压缩为单次去噪网络评估，显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: FirstDiff通过利用初始反向扩散评估中的预测噪声进行异常检测，验证了中间扩散信息本身就足以支撑准确的异常识别，在保持SOTA性能的同时实现了推理效率的大幅提升，为扩散模型在时间序列异常检测中的应用提供了更高效的范式。

title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConceptFormer，一种用于视觉文档检索的潜在概念表示学习框架。它通过查询条件化的连续潜在概念来桥接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，无需文本中间表示或原始视觉标注，在多个基准上较最强视觉检索基线和OCR文本检索基线分别提升16.7%和22.1%的平均NDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉文档检索细粒度监督方法主要依赖文本描述或局部视觉区域作为证据代理，但这些信号要么忽略复杂视觉结构，要么提供不完整、不准确的证据表示，难以有效捕捉跨文本、布局、图表等多模态分布的证据。
AI.method: ConceptFormer将查询相关的证据建模为连续、查询条件化的潜在概念，显式桥接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，避免依赖文本中间表示或原始视觉标注。训练时利用强视觉语言模型动态确定潜在概念令牌的数量，并以这些概念作为中间表示来弥合查询与文档之间的语义鸿沟，进而引导嵌入空间的学习。
AI.result: 在多个视觉文档检索基准上，ConceptFormer的平均NDCG@10较最强视觉检索基线和最强OCR文本检索基线分别相对提升16.7%和22.1%。进一步分析表明，潜在概念能有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，使检索器同时捕捉细粒度文本线索和复杂的文档级视觉结构，同时保持强检索对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: ConceptFormer通过潜在概念表示有效解决了现有证据代理监督信号不完整的问题，验证了潜在概念在桥接视觉证据与语义相关性方面的有效性，为视觉文档检索提供了一种无需文本中间表示的新型范式。

title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
comment: 38 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables. Code and weights: https://github.com/raws-labs/tinycast
summary: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. On Chronos-ZS and fev-bench every neural model ahead of it carries at least 28 times its parameters. Because the mixing path is convolutions and matrix multiplications only, it exports to static INT8 and forecasts end to end on an embedded device without per-signal fitting.

AI.tldr: TinyCast是一个仅含146,505个参数的免注意力零样本预测器，利用零参数频谱检测器获取主导周期，将上下文按相位折叠后通过膨胀卷积编码器和分块自回归分位数解码器输出预测分布。它在GIFT-Eval基准上以极小规模定义了size-accuracy前沿，且可在嵌入式设备上以INT8端到端运行。
AI.motivation: 在极小的模型规模下，周期结构值得显式计算而非通过学习获得，从而打破零样本时间序列预测中参数规模与精度之间的权衡。
AI.method: 采用零参数频谱检测器提取主导周期，将上下文按相位折叠（phase folding），结合膨胀卷积编码器与分块自回归（block-autoregressive）分位数解码器建模残差。整个混合路径仅由卷积和矩阵乘法构成，支持INT8静态导出。
AI.result: TinyCast是GIFT-Eval零样本榜单中可确认参数量的最小模型；在概率精度上定义了size-accuracy前沿；在无测试数据泄漏的零样本条目中，是唯一低于1.4M参数且输出预测分布的方法；在Chronos-ZS和fev-bench上，所有优于它的神经模型参数量至少为其28倍。可端到端在嵌入式设备上以INT8运行，无需逐信号拟合。
AI.conclusion: 极小的模型规模加上显式的周期结构计算，可以在零样本概率预测任务上达到竞争性甚至更优的性能，同时具备极高的部署效率。

title: PixelControl: Fine-Grained Condition Fidelity in Text-to-Image Diffusion
comment: The project homepage can be found: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/
summary: Controllable text-to-image diffusion models can often follow the global layout of spatial conditions, yet still violate fine-grained structures such as object boundaries, thin contours, and medium/small conditioned regions. This limitation is especially problematic for VAE-based latent diffusion, where spatial compression can weaken high-frequency and low-area condition signals. We propose PixelControl, a pixel-space controllable diffusion framework for fine-grained condition fidelity. Built on a PixelDiT-style backbone, PixelControl avoids the latent bottleneck and introduces two complementary designs. First, Structure-Aware Control Injection derives a condition structure map and uses it to strengthen injected control residuals around spatially sensitive regions. Second, Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss verifies generated images against condition-derived structures across multiple resolutions, balancing global layout consistency with local boundary and detail accuracy. PixelControl supports depth, segmentation, edge, and their combinations through modality-specific control branches with lightweight gated fusion. Experiments across depth, segmentation, and edge control show that PixelControl improves structural fidelity and visual quality over existing controllable generation methods, with especially strong gains on boundaries and medium/small conditioned regions. The project page can be found at: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/

AI.tldr: PixelControl 是一个基于像素空间（PixelDiT 骨干）的可控图像生成框架，通过结构感知控制注入和多尺度金字塔循环损失，解决了 VAE 潜在扩散模型在细粒度结构（目标边界、薄轮廓、中小区域）控制上的保真度不足问题，在深度、分割和边缘控制任务上取得了显著的结构保真与视觉质量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的可控文本到图像扩散模型虽能遵循全局布局，但在细粒度结构（如目标边界、薄轮廓、中小型条件区域）上常失效。该问题在基于 VAE 的潜在扩散中尤为严重，因为空间压缩会削弱高频和低面积的条件信号。因此需要一种避开潜在瓶颈、专门提升细粒度条件保真度的可控生成框架。
AI.method: 论文提出 PixelControl，一个构建在 PixelDiT 风格骨干上的像素空间可控扩散框架。核心包含两大互补设计：(1) 结构感知控制注入（Structure-Aware Control Injection），推导条件结构图并据此在空间敏感区域增强注入的控制残差；(2) 多尺度金字塔循环损失（Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss），在多个分辨率下将生成图像与条件派生结构进行循环验证，平衡全局布局一致性与局部边界/细节精度。此外还通过模态特异的控制分支配合轻量门控融合，支持深度、分割、边缘及其组合条件。
AI.result: 在深度、分割和边缘控制任务的实验中，PixelControl 相比现有可控生成方法在结构保真度和视觉质量上均取得提升，尤其在目标边界以及中小型条件区域上的增益最为显著。
AI.conclusion: PixelControl 通过像素空间扩散框架、结构感知控制注入和多尺度金字塔循环损失的结合，有效克服了潜在扩散在细粒度条件控制上的瓶颈，为高结构保真的可控图像生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making. However, directly applying existing graph conformal predictors yields inefficient prediction sets due to two recurring properties of fraud data. Fraudulent interactions are often embedded in benign-dominated neighborhoods that dilute calibration signals, while extreme class imbalance leaves scarce labeled-fraud support in the calibration split and leads to overly conservative class-conditional thresholds. To address these issues, we propose ProtoCP, a conformal prediction framework for edge-level fraud detection on temporal graphs. ProtoCP improves calibration efficiency by focusing calibration on fraud-relevant subgraph context and producing more stable nonconformity scores under class imbalance and temporal drift. Specifically, it leverages learned prototypes to suppress benign-dominated noise in the calibration context and introduces a neighborhood-relative scoring mechanism with temporal score diffusion for stable class-conditional calibration. Experiments on four fraud benchmarks (YelpChi, S-FFSD, FTFD, and BankSim) show that ProtoCP achieves the target coverage with consistently smaller prediction sets than state-of-the-art baselines. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Picard1701ent/ProtoCP.git

AI.tldr: 提出ProtoCP框架，一种面向时序交互图上边级欺诈检测的共形预测方法，通过聚焦欺诈相关子图上下文、学习原型抑制良性主导噪声、引入邻域相对评分与时间分数扩散机制，解决类不平衡和时序漂移下的校准低效问题，在四个欺诈基准上达到目标覆盖率且预测集更小。
AI.motivation: 边级欺诈检测中，共形预测虽能提供无分布假设的覆盖率保证，但直接应用现有图共形预测器会产生低效的预测集。原因是欺诈数据的两大特性：欺诈交互常嵌入良性主导的邻域中稀释校准信号；极端类不平衡导致校准集中标记欺诈样本稀缺，产生过于保守的类条件阈值。这些问题限制了风险感知决策的有效性。
AI.method: ProtoCP框架包含两大核心策略：一是利用学习到的原型（prototypes）抑制校准上下文中良性主导的噪声，使校准聚焦于欺诈相关的子图上下文；二是引入邻域相对评分机制并结合时间分数扩散（temporal score diffusion），在类不平衡和时序漂移条件下获得更稳定的类条件校准。
AI.result: 在YelpChi、S-FFSD、FTFD和BankSim四个欺诈基准上的实验表明，ProtoCP在达成目标覆盖率的同时，预测集始终比现有最先进基线更小，即校准效率更高。
AI.conclusion: ProtoCP有效解决了欺诈数据中良性主导邻域和极端类不平衡对图共形预测效率的负面影响，为风险感知的边级欺诈检测提供了更可靠的量化不确定性工具。

title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA
comment: Accepted at ECCV2026. Code: https://github.com/jinhseo/GroundFormer. Project page: https://jinhseo.github.io/groundformer/groundformer.html
summary: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, which conditions video features on question intent before localization via learnable communication tokens that mediate directed visuo-lingual interaction. On top of the question-conditioned features, a factorized MIL cross-attention couples answer selection with temporal evidence under candidate-level supervision, while Gaussian smoothing converts peaked attention into temporally coherent segments. We further introduce a hierarchical multi-modal contrastive loss that aligns video, question, and answer embeddings across a two-pass training pipeline. GroundFormer achieves state-of-the-art grounded VideoQA performance on NExT-GQA and STAR, substantially improving question-discriminative temporal grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GroundFormer，解决Grounded VideoQA中的"问题不变定位"（question-invariant grounding）失败模式——即模型对不同问题预测几乎相同的时间片段。通过可学习通信令牌在定位前将视频特征条件化于问题语义，并借助因子化MIL交叉注意力、高斯平滑和分层多模态对比损失，在NExT-GQA和STAR上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Grounded VideoQA模型存在一个被忽视的严重问题：对同一视频的不同问题，模型往往输出几乎相同的视频片段，即问题不变定位。作者将该问题追溯至两个结构性局限：(i) 模态隔离——视频表示在接收问题语义之前就被固定；(ii) 定位模块内问题注入薄弱。
AI.method: 提出GroundFormer，核心组件包括：(1) 可学习通信令牌（learnable communication tokens）在定位前驱动有方向的视觉-语言交互，使视频特征条件化于问题意图；(2) 因子化MIL交叉注意力（factorized MIL cross-attention）在候选级监督下将答案选择与时间证据耦合；(3) 高斯平滑将峰值注意力转换为时间上连贯的片段；(4) 分层多模态对比损失，在两阶段训练流程中对齐视频、问题和答案嵌入。
AI.result: GroundFormer在NExT-GQA和STAR基准上取得SOTA的Grounded VideoQA性能，显著提升了问题判别性（question-discriminative）的时间定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在定位前注入问题语义而非事后修正，GroundFormer有效缓解了问题不变定位问题，验证了"先问题条件化、后时间定位"这一设计范式的有效性，为VideoQA中的时间定位提供了一种更可解释、问题敏感的解决方案。

title: Learning Stock Trading Policies via Barycenter-Based Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Designing effective trading strategies using reinforcement learning remains challenging due to delayed and noisy rewards, poor exploration, and the difficulty of enforcing explicit risk constraints. In this work, we propose BRaG, a barycenter-based adversarial inverse reinforcement learning framework for stock trading that learns trading behavior from multiple heterogeneous expert strategies. BRaG aggregates expert demonstrations using a performance-weighted Wasserstein barycenter, yielding a stable pseudo-expert representation that captures shared structure across diverse trading styles. This representation is used to pretrain a trading policy via adversarial imitation learning, which alleviates unstable exploration during reinforcement learning. The pretrained policy is subsequently refined using reinforcement learning with true market rewards. To ensure risk-aware decision-making, BRaG incorporates control barrier functions that constrain action execution and regularize policy learning to satisfy drawdown limits. We evaluate the proposed approach on four major global equity markets, including the US, UK, Indian, and Taiwanese indices. Across all the markets, the proposed approach achieves stronger performance than both classical trading rules and recent deep reinforcement learning methods, while exhibiting more stable risk characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出BRaG框架，一种基于重心（barycenter）的对抗逆强化学习方法，通过从多种异构专家策略中学习交易行为，结合控制屏障函数满足回撤约束，在四大全球股票市场取得优于经典交易规则和深度强化学习方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在交易策略设计中面临延迟噪声奖励、探索不充分以及难以施加显式风险约束三大挑战，现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: BRaG框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 使用性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家示范，生成稳定的伪专家表示；(2) 通过对抗模仿学习预训练交易策略，缓解RL过程中的不稳定探索；(3) 使用真实市场奖励进行RL微调，并引入控制屏障函数约束动作执行和策略学习以满足回撤限制。
AI.result: 在美股、英股、印度和台湾四个主要全球股票市场指数上进行评估，BRaG在所有市场中均优于经典交易规则和最新深度强化学习方法，同时表现出更稳定的风险特征。
AI.conclusion: BRaG通过逆强化学习从异构专家策略中提取共享交易结构，结合控制屏障函数实现风险约束，为融合模仿学习与强化学习的交易策略设计提供了有效框架。

title: Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models
summary: We address a fundamental gap in 3D-LLMs: existing models focus on single-object/scene description, struggling with detailed, inter-object comparison. We propose a framework for detailed object-level reasoning across multiple objects with three components: (1) MO3D (Multi-Object in 3D), an instruction dataset requiring fine-grained multi-object comparison; (2) Multi-3DLLM, using a minimal Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT) that models inter-/intra-object relationships while preserving local geometry; (3) Mini-apps, two application-driven benchmarks (Shape Mating, Change Captioning) that probe geometric understanding for practical use. Recent 3D-LLMs and 2D-VLMs perform poorly on these tasks, lacking both comparison-centric design and geometric awareness. In contrast, Multi-3DLLM trained on our mixture data learns geometric reasoning, surpasses all baselines on MO3D, and provides positive transfer to single-object classification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对3D-LLMs缺乏跨物体细粒度比较能力的问题，提出了一个包含MO3D指令数据集、Multi-3DLLM模型（含Patch-Interaction Transformer）及两个应用基准（Shape Mating、Change Captioning）的多物体3D推理框架，实验证明其显著优于现有基线并在单物体分类上产生正迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-LLMs主要聚焦于单物体或单场景描述，无法进行详细的跨物体比较。这构成了3D大语言模型在细粒度物体级推理上的根本性缺口，亟需一个支持多物体间交互感知与几何理解的新框架。
AI.method: 提出三部分组成的框架：(1) MO3D数据集，包含细粒度多物体比较的指令样本；(2) Multi-3DLLM模型，引入最小化Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT)，在保持局部几何信息的同时显式建模物体间/物体内关系；(3) 两个应用驱动的基准（Shape Mating和Change Captioning）用于检验几何理解的实际应用能力。
AI.result: 近期3D-LLMs和2D-VLMs在这些任务上表现不佳，缺乏比较中心设计和几何感知能力。Multi-3DLLM在混合数据上训练后学习到几何推理能力，在MO3D基准上超越所有基线，且对单物体分类任务产生正向迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过比较中心的数据设计和PIT架构建模跨物体关系，Multi-3DLLM能够有效弥补3D-LLM在多物体细粒度推理方面的缺陷，并在泛化到单物体任务时也表现积极，说明多物体比较训练可带来一般性的几何推理能力提升。

title: Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation
summary: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. An exact blockwise decomposition separates a routing term, which changes gates at fixed content, from a dense-like content term. Across seven open-weight checkpoints and two domains, the routing term spans only $1.6\times$ as a fraction of block output, while its residual-stream exposure spans $3.2\times$. Exposure is ordered by the routed block's share of the residual. Scaling the always-on backbone in two confirmatory models moves exposure monotonically; common-mode controls support a mass-and-coherence mechanism rather than denominator dilution alone. Preregistered PubMedQA patches on three models show that the full routing term moves outputs by less than half the natural context effect and is largely reproduced by matched-norm noise, whereas the content term is strongly direction-specific. Scale and merged-expert probes show that the narrow block-level range is not universal, although exposure remains small at the tested boundaries. Router movement alone is therefore not evidence of behavioral influence: measure exposure first, and use a behavioral intervention when the decision matters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）中"相同权重自蒸馏"（same-weight self-distillation）的盲点问题：两次前向传播共享所有权重但路由不同专家。作者通过单步精确块级分解将"路由项"与"内容项"分离，测量路由项对模型输出的影响范围。跨7个开源模型和2个领域，路由项在块输出中仅占1.6倍范围，而在残差流暴露中达3.2倍；路由移动本身并不等同于行为影响，需先测量暴露度，在关键决策时使用行为干预。
AI.motivation: 在MoE模型中，相同的权重可以在不同前向传播中路由到不同专家，这构成same-weight self-distillation（示范条件教师监督仅查询学生）的潜在盲点。现有研究常将路由移动视为行为影响的证据，但缺乏对路由项实际影响范围的精确量化。作者希望区分路由项（改变门控）和内容项（类稠密层），从而揭示路由移动是否真正驱动行为变化。
AI.method: 1）采用单步冻结权重的设定（而非作为完整训练轨迹的代理）；2）提出精确的块级分解，将路由项（固定内容下改变门控）与稠密类内容项分离；3）在7个开源权重模型、2个领域上测量路由项在块输出和残差流暴露中的影响范围；4）通过缩放always-on主干进行确认性实验，验证"质量与相干性"机制；5)使用预先注册的PubMedQA补丁测试、匹配范数噪声对照、扩展专家探针等验证路由项的方向特异性和尺度边界。
AI.result: 路由项在块输出中仅跨越1.6倍范围，但在残差流暴露中达3.2倍；暴露度由路由块在残差中的占比排序决定。两个确认模型中，缩放always-on主干使暴露度单调变化；common-mode对照支持"质量与相干性"机制而非单纯分母稀释。预先注册的PubMedQA测试显示完整路由项移动输出不到自然上下文效应的一半，且大部分可由匹配范数噪声复现；内容项则具强方向特异性。尺度与合并专家探针表明窄块级范围并非普适，但测试边界处暴露度仍小。
AI.conclusion: 路由移动本身不能作为行为影响的证据。应在评估路由效应时先测量暴露度（residual-stream exposure），在需要关键决策时使用行为干预（behavioral intervention）作为最终验证手段。

title: YOLO26-RD: An End-to-End Road Damage Detection Network With Learnable Contrast Enhancement and Edge-Guided Downsampling
summary: Automated pavement-distress detection is commonly framed as a small-object problem, motivating high-resolution P2/4 detection heads and lossless downsampling. We present YOLO26-RD, an end-to-end (NMS-free) detector built on YOLO26 with two lightweight novel modules (LearnableContrast, a 494-parameter differentiable analogue of CLAHE that adapts contrast per tile inside the network, and EdgeSPD, a Sobel-gated space-to-depth downsampler adding only 2 parameters over SPD-Conv), and we subject the design to a data-first audit on a 7,618-image road-survey dataset (alligator crack, linear crack, patching). The audit falsifies the small-object premise: 92% of instances are COCO-large, and linear cracks are extreme-aspect structures (median 10:1) whose difficulty is sensitivity, not localization. Guided by this analysis, we remove the P2 detection level while retaining P2 features in the fusion path, which improves mAP50 by 2.8 points over the full YOLO26-RD model and reduces epoch time by 8%. Trained from scratch at 640x640, our best screening configuration reaches 0.787 mAP50 on the validation split versus a 0.771 project baseline (a stock YOLO26-s of uncontrolled recipe), with the largest per-class gain on the rarest class (patching, 2.6 points over baseline; 9.4 over the unmodified YOLO26-RD control under an identical recipe). A failure-mode decomposition further attributes the residual error of the bottleneck class (crack, approximately 0.74 across all architectures tested) to train/validation distribution shift on crack orientation and length, sub-pixel crack width at 640x640, and label incompleteness, factors no architecture change can address. We argue that for pavement imagery, measurement-driven subtraction outperforms module accretion, and we release our audit protocol alongside the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YOLO26-RD，一种无NMS的端到端路面病害检测器，内置两个轻量模块（LearnableContrast自适应对比度、EdgeSPD Sobel门控下采样器）。通过对7,618张道路图像数据集的"数据优先"审计，作者否定了"小目标"前提（92%实例属COCO-large，裂缝为极端长宽比结构）。据此移除P2检测层但保留P2融合特征，使mAP50提升2.8点、训练时间减少8%。最佳配置在验证集达到0.787 mAP50，并通过失效模式分解将残余误差归因于分布漂移、亚像素宽度与标签不完整等不可通过架构解决的因素，主张"测量驱动的减法优于模块堆叠"。
AI.motivation: 路面病害检测常被当作小目标问题处理，这促使研究者堆叠高分辨率P2/P4检测头和无损下采样模块。作者质疑这一普遍前提，希望通过数据优先的审计来检验其真实性，并避免在错误假设上盲目堆积模块。
AI.method: 基于YOLO26构建NMS-free端到端检测器YOLO26-RD，引入两个轻量模块：LearnableContrast（494参数的可微CLAHE模拟，在tile内自适应对比度）和EdgeSPD（Sobel门控的空洞下采样器，相比SPD-Conv仅增加2个参数）。对7,618张图像的数据集进行小目标前提审计，基于审计结论移除P2检测层（保留P2融合特征）。同时进行失效模式分解，将性能瓶颈归因于特定数据因素。
AI.result: 审计表明92%实例为COCO-large，线性裂缝呈极端长宽比（中位10:1），难度在于敏感性而非定位。移除P2检测层使mAP50较完整YOLO26-RD提升2.8点，训练时间减少8%。最佳筛查配置在验证集达0.787 mAP50，优于0.771的项目基线，最稀有类（patching）增益最大（较基线+2.6点，较未修改YOLO26-RD对照+9.4点）。残差误差被归因于裂缝方向/长度分布漂移、亚像素宽度和标签不完整等架构无法解决的因素。
AI.conclusion: 对于路面影像，基于测量的减法（删减不必要的组件）优于模块堆叠（持续添加新模块）。作者开源了审计协议和模型，主张用数据驱动的分析指导架构决策。

title: CrevasseSeg: A Label-Efficient UAV Crevasse Segmentation Framework
summary: Crevasse mapping from uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery matters for glaciological research and for field safety in glaciated terrain. Yet, pixel-level annotation of glacier surfaces is costly and requires domain experts. We introduce CrevasseSeg, a framework for binary segmentation over the terminus of Borebreen, Svalbard, comprising 1,938 unlabelled UAV orthomosaic tiles for self-supervised/unsupervised fine-tuning, 24 labelled tiles for validation and 176 labelled tiles for testing. Using CrevasseSeg, we benchmark five self-supervised objectives -- BYOL, a Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) objective, Barlow-Twins, VICReg, and a combined BYOL-JSD objective -- across three architectures: O-Net, O-Net++, and a DINOv3-initialised O-Net. Each configuration is evaluated under two frozen-feature readouts that differ only in the form of their decision boundary: a linear probe and a non-linear XGBoost classifier fit only on the 24 labelled validation images. Our central finding is a consistent inversion between the two readouts: DINOv3 features are the weakest under linear probing but the strongest under a non-linear readout. A UMAP analysis of the learned feature space shows that DINOv3 fragments pixels into many small clusters in which the classes are locally interleaved, whereas the convolutional architectures (O-Net and O-Net++) embed them onto a single class-sorted manifold. Satellite-pretrained DINOv3 improves over natural-image initialisation across objectives, and our label-efficient DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD pipeline reaches 75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU, outperforming standard machine learning baselines fit on the same 24 labelled images with the RGB pixel values used as features. We release CrevasseSeg to support label-efficient segmentation research in remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrevasseSeg框架，用于UAV冰川裂缝（crevasse）的二值分割。基于1938张无标注正射影像做自监督微调、24张标注验证、176张标注测试。基准测试5种自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD组合）×3种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net）。核心发现是线性探针与非线性XGBoost读头之间存在一致性的结果反转：DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱，但在非线性读头下最强。卫星预训练的DINOv3优于自然图像初始化，最终管线达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，超越传统机器学习基线。
AI.motivation: 冰川裂缝的像素级标注昂贵且需要领域专家，而UAV影像在冰川学研究和野外安全方面至关重要。作者旨在解决标注稀缺条件下的裂缝分割问题，探索自监督/无监督学习是否能在极少标注（仅24张）下实现有效的分割。
AI.method: 构建CrevasseSeg框架，包含1938张无标注tiles用于自监督微调、24张标注用于验证、176张标注用于测试。基准测试5种自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD）和3种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化O-Net），每种配置在两种冻结特征读头下评估：线性探针和非线性XGBoost分类器（仅在24张验证图上拟合）。此外进行了UMAP特征空间分析和卫星预训练vs自然图像初始化的对比实验。
AI.result: 核心结果是两种读头间的反转：DINOv3在线性探针下最弱但在非线性读头下最强，因DINOv3将像素分解为局部交错的小簇，而卷积架构嵌入到单一类别排序流形上。卫星预训练DINOv3优于自然图像初始化。最佳管线（DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD）达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，超越基于RGB像素值的传统ML基线。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明在极低标注条件下，结合卫星预训练的自监督DINOv3特征配合非线性读头可实现有效的冰川裂缝分割；同时揭示了一个重要现象——线性探针与非线性读头对特征质量的评估可能给出相反结论，提示读头的选择对自监督特征评估至关重要。框架CrevasseSeg已公开，支持遥感领域的标签高效分割研究。

title: Anatomical and Physical Supervision for CT-less PET Attenuation Correction: BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
comment: 6 pages, 1 table. Technical report for the BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge
summary: This report describes our submission to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) 2026 Challenge for CT-less PET attenuation correction through multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis. We build upon a standard nnU-Net architecture and combine anatomical and physical supervision to improve both pseudo-CT quality and downstream PET reconstruction. Anatomical supervision is introduced through a frozen TotalSegmentator feature extractor, anatomy-guided structural constraints and patch sampling, while physical supervision is achieved using a differentiable attenuation correction factor projection loss based on multi-angle attenuation projections. Furthermore, the network is initialized with pretrained weights obtained from training on the SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT dataset. Minimal architectural modifications are applied, while performance improvements are pursued across the nnU-Net pipeline, including preprocessing, plans, and supervision design, among other components. Our final submission demonstrates the effectiveness of combining anatomical supervision, attenuation physics, and efficient nnU-Net scaling for CT-less PET attenuation correction.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了BIC-MAC 2026挑战赛中基于nnU-Net架构的无CT PET衰减校正方法，通过结合解剖监督（冻结的TotalSegmentator特征提取器）与物理监督（可微分的衰减校正因子投影损失），并利用SynthRAD预训练权重初始化，实现了多模态伪CT合成，在无需实质架构改动的情况下提升了伪CT质量和下游PET重建效果。
AI.motivation: CT-less PET衰减校正是核医学影像中的关键问题，传统方法需要CT图像进行衰减校正，但在只有MRI等解剖影像可用的场景下受限。作者旨在通过多模态伪CT合成来克服这一限制，同时利用解剖学信息和物理衰减原理来提升校正精度，避免仅依赖纯生成式方法的局限性。
AI.method: 基于标准nnU-Net架构，引入了三层监督机制：(1) 解剖监督——使用冻结的TotalSegmentator特征提取器施加解剖结构约束，并据此进行patch采样；(2) 物理监督——设计可微分的衰减校正因子投影损失，基于多角度衰减投影施加约束；(3) 迁移学习——使用SynthRAD Challenge的MR-to-CT数据集预训练权重进行初始化。整体仅做最小架构改动，重点优化nnU-Net预处理、训练计划和监督设计。
AI.result: 最终提交展示了结合解剖监督、衰减物理约束与高效nnU-Net扩展对无CT PET衰减校正的有效性，在伪CT质量与下游PET重建性能上均获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 作者验证了一个核心观点：在保持标准nnU-Net架构基本不变的前提下，通过融合解剖学先验知识、物理衰减模型和预训练迁移学习，可以显著提升无CT PET衰减校正的性能，表明监督信号设计与训练策略优化相比架构复杂度同等甚至更为重要。

title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
summary: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a tail property of the distribution its weights induce, which no sample reveals. The per-token cross-entropy risk is hard to estimate because of a topological fact: among the possible states, finite risk and infinite risk each lie arbitrarily close to every instance of the other. Consequently no estimator---not merely the holdout average---is consistent at every state at which the risk is defined. Worse, inconsistent estimation persists under both bounding the expected sequence length and restricting to full-support models; and in that restricted setting the states at which inconsistency occurs are even dense. Two interesting ways out are identified, and neither is free. Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.

AI.tldr: 本文证明语言模型的逐token交叉熵风险（即缩放定律所拟合的量）无法被一致估计。一致性若以数据生成分布和所训练模型对（可能的世界状态）来定义，则由于模型权重诱导分布的尾部性质无法由样本揭示，任何估计器（包括留出法均值）都无法在所有风险有定义的état处收敛。即便限制序列长度有界或限定满支持模型，不一致性依然存在，且在满支持情形下不一致的état甚至稠密。文章给出两条出路：有界上下文窗口配合概率下限，或预先设定阈值仅报告低于阈值的风险，但二者皆有代价。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的评估长期依赖留出法逐token交叉熵风险，缩放定律也正是据此拟合。作者试图检验这一核心评估指标能否被统计一致地估计，揭示其估计困难的根本原因，并探索可行的替代方案。
AI.method: 论文采用对策式（adversarial）的一致估计框架，将"可能的世界状态"定义为数据生成分布与所训练模型的配对。通过拓扑分析证明：在可能状态空间中，有限风险与无限风险的état彼此任意接近，由此任何估计器都无法在所有风险有定义的état上一致收敛。论文进一步在两种受限设定（有界期望序列长度、满支持模型）下考察不一致性的持续与稠密性，并提出两条修正方案。
AI.result: 核心结果为不可能性定理：逐token交叉熵风险不存在一致估计器。该不一致性在有界期望序列长度和满支持模型限制下依然存在，且在满支持情形下不一致état稠密。有界上下文窗口配合概率下限可使风险有限性与数据生成分布的期望序列长度有限性等价，但所需假设本身不可检验；预先设定阈值则恢复一致性但改变了估计目标。
AI.conclusion: 逐token交叉熵风险作为语言模型评估的基石指标存在根本的统计不可估计性。走出困境需从两个方向取舍：要么接受有界上下文加概率下限并承担不可检验假设，要么承认估计目标的修订（仅报告低于预设阈值的风险）。这为语言模型评估方法论提供了新的统计视角。

title: Identifying Confusion Trends in Concept-based XAI for Multi-Label Classification
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in high-risk domains, such as healthcare and autonomous driving, must be not only accurate but also understandable to ensure user trust. In real-world computer vision tasks, these models often operate on complex images containing background noise and are heavily annotated. To make such models explainable, Concept-based Explainable AI (CXAI) methods need to be assessed for their applicability and problem-solving capacity. In this work, we explore CXAI use cases in multi-label classification by training two DNNs, VGG16 and ResNet50, on the 20 most annotated labels in the MS-COCO dataset (Microsoft Common Objects in Context). We apply two CXAI methods, CRP (Concept Relevance Propagation) and CRAFT (Concept Recursive Activation FacTorization), to generate concept-level explanations and investigate the overall evaluations. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) CXAI highlights learning weaknesses in DNNs, (2) higher concept distinctiveness reduces label and concept confusion, and (3) environmental concepts expose dataset-induced biases. Our results demonstrate the potential of CXAI to enhance the understanding of model generalizability and to diagnose bias instigated by the dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文在MS-COCO数据集上训练VGG16和ResNet50进行多标签分类，应用CRP和CRAFT两种概念级可解释AI方法生成概念级解释，发现CXAI能揭示DNN学习弱点、概念区分度可减少标签概念混淆、环境概念暴露数据集偏差，从而提升模型可理解性和泛化性诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 高风险领域（如医疗、自动驾驶）中的DNN模型不仅需要高精度，还需具备可理解性以建立用户信任。真实世界视觉任务中模型常处理含有背景噪声的复杂图像，因此需要评估概念级可解释AI（CXAI）方法在多标签分类场景中的适用性和问题解决能力。
AI.method: 在MS-COCO数据集中选取20个标注最多的标签，分别训练VGG16与ResNet50两个DNN进行多标签分类；应用CRP（概念相关性传播）和CRAFT（概念递归激活分解）两种CXAI方法生成概念级解释，并进行整体评估。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：（1）CXAI能揭示DNN的学习弱点；（2）更高的概念区分度能降低标签与概念之间的混淆；（3）环境概念能暴露数据集引发的偏差。结果表明CXAI在增强模型泛化性理解和诊断数据偏差方面具有潜力。
AI.conclusion: CXAI方法能够有效增强对DNN模型泛化能力的理解，并诊断由数据集引发的偏差，为高风险领域中的可信AI部署提供了可解释性分析支撑。

title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 4 ancillary CSV files
summary: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.

AI.tldr: 本文在有限同构状态空间中探究了隐含状态层面的操作级结构传递问题。在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层上，通过输入特定干预、错误操作对照、范数匹配随机对照及无操作对照等多种对照设计，发现一个预先冻结的候选（transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor）在两次独立验证实验中均通过统计检验（Holm校正p值分别为0.006943和0.007141），重复了全部12个验证效应估计值与置信区间。但结果仅局限于单一提示路线、单一候选、单一模型版本和单一层区间，不支撑跨模型泛化、全家族后端独立性、域泛化或代数不变性等更广泛结论。
AI.motivation: 论文起始即指出，行为准确性、线性可解码性和成功的激活干预并不能单独证明模型从一个符号域到另一个符号域携带了操作级结构。作者希望提出一个更窄、更严格的问题：在有限同构状态空间中，若为每个源输入分别估计两个操作之间的隐含状态差异，将该差异添加到映射后的接收输入上，是否能使模型朝对应的接收答案方向移动。这一设计旨在通过输入特定干预与严格对照来更精确地检验跨域操作结构的存在。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：1）将输入特定干预与错误操作对照、范数匹配随机对照和无操作对照进行比较；2）将候选构建与独立隔离的验证分割分开；3）在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层上进行实验；4）从预设且冻结的家族中选择路线-域-操作候选；5）使用PyVene分割进行验证，并计算交集-并集p值与36家族Holm校正p值；6）随后进行预先指定并冻结的NNsight 0.7.0复现实验，仅测试选定的提示路线，无候选或层重选，复现12个验证效应估计、置信区间及符号翻转p值。
AI.result: PyVene分割中，候选transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor通过验证，交集-并集p值为0.000198，36家族Holm校正p值为0.006943。NNsight 0.7.0实验中，全部12个验证效应估计值、置信区间和确切的符号翻转p值被数值复现，36家族Holm校正p值为0.007141。两次实验在两种不同的干预实现上、同一模型版本和层区间内一致地支持该候选。
AI.conclusion: 结论是该结果严格局限于此一个提示路线和此一个候选，且在两种干预实现、一个模型版本和一个层区间上得到重复验证。作者明确声明，该发现不建立跨模型泛化、全家族后端独立性、域间一般迁移或代数不变性。研究的价值在于提供了一种方法学上严谨的、带严格对照和家族校正的单候选跨域操作结构的证据框架。

title: ES3D: Embedding Semantics into 3D Space for Component-Aware Editing
summary:
Existing 3D editing methods have made notable progress in controllability, yet they remain limited in several important ways. Most approaches rely on text-driven editing, which struggles to express fine-grained visual changes intended by the user. Moreover, many methods require manually supplied 3D masks or introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain untouched. These limitations largely arise from the absence of fine-grained semantic understanding, making it difficult for existing models to retrieve or modify specific 3D components.
  We introduce ES3D, a framework that embeds semantics directly into 3D space, enabling component-aware retrieval and editing of a 3D asset conditioned on multiple local reference images and optional text queries. We first construct a 3D semantic embedding by projecting multi-view semantic features into the voxelized space of the asset. We then perform 3D component retrieval by computing feature similarity between the 3D semantic embedding and the semantic embeddings of image or text queries. For editing, we employ a pretrained 3D generative model with an inpainting mechanism to modify the retrieved components guided by user-provided images while preserving the rest of the asset. Overall, ES3D is a 3D editing framework that retrieves editable regions based on semantic cues and uses multiple images as conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ES3D produces geometrically consistent and semantically coherent edits, enabling robust image-based and text-assisted control for 3D editing.

AI.tldr: ES3D是一个将语义直接嵌入3D空间的编辑框架，通过将多视角语义特征投影到体素化空间构建3D语义嵌入，实现基于多个局部参考图像和可选文本查询的组件感知检索与编辑，利用预训练3D生成模型和修复机制在保持资产其余部分不变的情况下修改检索到的组件。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法存在三大局限：多数方法依赖文本驱动编辑难以表达细粒度的视觉变化；许多方法需要手动提供3D掩码；编辑过程容易引入对未触及区域的非预期改动。这些局限源于缺乏细粒度语义理解，使模型难以检索或修改特定的3D组件。
AI.method: 首先将多视角语义特征投影到资产的体素化空间构建3D语义嵌入；然后通过计算3D语义嵌入与图像或文本查询的语义嵌入之间的特征相似度进行3D组件检索；最后使用带有修复机制的预训练3D生成模型，以用户提供的图像作为条件来修改检索到的组件，同时保留资产的其余部分。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ES3D能够生成几何一致且语义连贯的编辑结果，实现了稳健的基于图像和文本辅助的3D编辑控制。
AI.conclusion: ES3D通过将语义嵌入3D空间，显著提升了3D编辑中细粒度组件理解与检索能力，支持多图像条件驱动的3D编辑，克服了传统文本驱动方法的表达限制，为3D编辑提供了更精准和可控的解决方案。

title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: KOALA是一个直接从WiFi CSI进行人体运动预测的框架，通过将噪声的CSI姿态序列提升到Koopman潜空间，将非线性动力学线性化，从而无需自回归迭代即可实现多时域预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的WiFi CSI人体姿态估计方法将姿态推断视为瞬时回归问题，未建模时间动态，无法实现未来运动预测。而直接用视觉预测方法会导致CSI姿态中已有的估计噪声在自回归展开中逐步步进累积放大。
AI.method: KOALA框架将噪声CSI姿态序列提升到学习的Koopman潜空间，使非线性动力学线性化，通过矩阵-向量乘积实现多时域预测。具体包含：(1) 残差CSI条件算子解决Koopman公式固有的恒等吸引子问题；(2) 锚点-增量预测头消除复制当前姿态的退化捷径；(3) Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL)损失在时序编码器特征空间中联合正则化提升与算子，确保跨预测时域的动力学一致性。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi和WiPose数据集上的实验表明，KOALA在短期和长期预测时域上均实现了稳健一致的表现，大幅超越所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KOALA通过Koopman算子理论将WiFi CSI人体运动预测转化为线性动力学系统问题，有效避免了自回归误差累积，为隐私保护的无线感知人体运动预测提供了一种高效且稳健的解决方案。

title: Beyond Independence: Learning Correlated Views for Variational Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
summary: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) aims to uncover shared cluster structures from data with partially observed views. Although recent imputation-free methods based on variational inference demonstrate robustness to missing views, they commonly rely on a conditional independence assumption across views in the posterior aggregation stage, which fails to capture the inherently structured and potentially correlated nature of multi-view data. In this paper, we propose a variational framework that explicitly goes beyond this assumption by introducing a learnable cross-view correlation structure. Specifically, we explicitly model and learn correlations between views by utilizing the covariance structure of posterior estimation errors during aggregation. To facilitate robust and efficient learning, the correlation matrix is parameterized through a normalized Cholesky decomposition, ensuring positive definiteness and enabling the entire model to be trained jointly through a unified variational objective. Extensive experiments on multiple IMVC benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse missing-view settings while introducing only a negligible number of learnable parameters. These results highlight the effectiveness of adaptive correlation modeling in variational IMVC, demonstrating the need to go beyond the independence assumption in IMVC. The code is available at https://github.com/zmxu196/ACOVA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种超越条件独立性假设的变分不完备多视图聚类（IMVC）框架，通过可学习的跨视图相关性结构来建模视图间关联，利用归一化Cholesky分解参数化相关矩阵，在多个基准上一致优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于变分推断的无填充式IMVC方法在聚合后验时普遍依赖跨视图条件独立性假设，无法捕捉多视图数据中固有的结构化和相关性特征，限制了聚类性能。
AI.method: 提出ACOVA方法：在后验聚合阶段显式建模视图间相关性，利用后验估计误差的协方差结构学习相关矩阵；通过归一化Cholesky分解参数化相关矩阵保证正定性，并统一到变分目标中进行联合训练。
AI.result: 在多个IMVC基准数据集上，该方法在多样化的缺失视图设置中一致优于现有最先进方法，且仅引入极少量可学习参数。
AI.conclusion: 自适应相关建模在变分IMVC中具有显著效果，表明超越条件独立性假设是提升不完备多视图聚类性能的关键方向。

title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
summary: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Adam等优化算法中二阶矩记忆（分母中的平方梯度移动平均）即使在有限方差随机梯度下也会抑制收敛进展。作者指出，二阶矩记忆长度M₂=(1-β₂)^{-1}会导致期望归一化更新量为O(M₂^{-1/2})量级，并进一步将该方向性界转化为同阶的平均驻点下界，证明长二阶矩记忆会减缓优化速度。
AI.motivation: 尽管Adam等自适应优化算法广泛使用，但其分母中平方梯度的移动平均（二阶矩记忆）对优化速度和收敛性能的影响尚未被充分理解。该论文旨在揭示这种记忆机制本身可能带来的收敛速度惩罚。
AI.method: 作者通过构建一个简单的两点查询（two-point oracle）场景进行分析，推导出初始化瞬态后期望归一化更新量的上界为O(M₂^{-1/2})。随后在指定的记忆长度和步长缩放条件下，将该方向性界转换为一类光滑凸问题（具有归一化间隙、光滑性和方差约束）上的平均驻点（average-stationarity）下界，得到相同阶数的结果。
AI.result: 论文证明在有限方差随机梯度条件下，Adam的二阶矩记忆仍会抑制向最优点推进。具体而言，期望归一化更新量为O(M₂^{-1/2})，且对应的平均驻点下界也为此阶数，说明长二阶矩记忆显著拖慢优化收敛。
AI.conclusion: 即使在梯度噪声方差有限的情况下，Adam的长二阶矩记忆也会抑制优化进展，带来O(M₂^{-1/2})量级的收敛速度惩罚，这为理解自适应优化算法的固有局限提供了理论依据。

title: RoofGS: Roofline-Guided End-to-End Acceleration of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel-view synthesis but remains limited on GPUs at high resolutions. Through a stage-wise Roofline characterization, we identify two distinct hardware bottlenecks: global memory traffic dominates the front end, whereas instruction throughput limits rasterization. Guided by this analysis, we develop RoofGS, a rendering framework that applies bottleneck-specific optimizations rather than generic kernel acceleration. For the memory-bound front end, we design a resolution-adaptive quantized depth sorting key that compresses each key to 32 bits. For the compute-bound rasterizer, we introduce a range-aware bit-level fast exponential approximation tailored to the bounded exponent range after opacity culling, with a derived per-pixel error bound. These two core techniques are complemented by additional optimizations (kernel fusion, compact attribute storage, culling, dual-pixel evaluation) that additionally reduce memory traffic and improve instruction-level parallelism. Experiments show that RoofGS achieves a 10.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup over 3DGS at 4K on an RTX 4090, increasing throughput from 61 to 616 FPS, with only a 0.028 dB PSNR loss.

AI.tldr: RoofGS是一个针对3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)渲染框架的硬件瓶颈感知加速框架。通过分阶段Roofline分析识别前端全局内存瓶颈和后端指令吞吐量瓶颈，分别设计了32位自适应量化深度排序键和范围感知的位级快速指数近似，辅以内核融合、紧凑属性存储、裁剪和双像素评估等优化，在RTX 4090上4K分辨率实现10.1倍端到端加速（61→616 FPS），仅损失0.028 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅虽然能实现实时新视角合成，但在高分辨率GPU上仍存在性能瓶颈。现有优化方法通常采用通用内核加速策略，未能针对实际硬件瓶颈进行差异化处理。作者希望通过Roofline模型逐阶段识别真实的硬件限制，从而设计出瓶颈对应的优化方案。
AI.method: 首先使用分阶段Roofline特征分析，识别出前端由全局内存流量主导（内存受限），光栅化由指令吞吐量限制（计算受限）。据此设计两类核心优化：1）内存受限的前端：设计分辨率自适应的量化深度排序键，将每个键压缩至32位；2）计算受限的光栅化器：引入范围感知的位级快速指数近似，利用不透明度剔除后指数范围有界的特性，并推导逐像素误差上界。辅以内核融合、紧凑属性存储、裁剪和双像素评估等补充优化。
AI.result: 在RTX 4090上，4K分辨率下RoofGS相对3DGS实现10.1倍端到端加速，吞吐量从61 FPS提升至616 FPS，PSNR仅损失0.028 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过瓶颈感知的差异化优化而非通用内核加速，可以在几乎不损失渲染质量的前提下大幅提升3DGS在高分辨率下的渲染性能，验证了基于Roofline分析的硬件瓶颈定向优化方法的有效性。

title: Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自监督框架，通过自动发现辅助任务（以一般价值函数形式定义）来支持股票交易的强化学习，利用元梯度机制更新辅助任务定义，在四个主要股指上验证了更鲁棒的学习和更好的交易表现。
AI.motivation: 股票交易中强化学习面临市场非平稳和奖励信号嘈杂的挑战，现有辅助任务通常手工设计，依赖对目标和预测时域的先验假设，难以适应变化的市场环境。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架包含两个网络：主网络学习交易策略和辅助预测，副网络通过学习累积量（cumulants）和折扣因子（discount factors）生成辅助任务定义。辅助任务定义为一般价值函数（GVF），增强状态表示并帮助策略优化。副网络通过元梯度机制更新，考虑任务对交易表现的长期影响并提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在DJI、FTSE、Sensex和TAIEX四个主要股票指数上评估，实验表明自动发现的辅助任务相比现有基线方法带来更鲁棒的学习和更高的交易性能。
AI.conclusion: 自动发现辅助任务的框架能够替代手工设计，在不同市场环境下提供更稳定、更高效的强化学习交易策略，展示了自监督辅助任务在金融强化学习中的潜力。

title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process. In this paradigm, spatial questions are organized into logically constrained and jointly consistent chains, where later questions depend on spatial constraints established in earlier rounds. Following this principle, we instantiate ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric, and ChainSpace-Pipeline, a simulator-based chain-structured supervision generation framework for spatial intelligence training. Experiments show that ChainSpace-Bench exposes chain-level failures that are not captured by isolated question accuracy. Additionally, with a relatively small amount of simulator-generated chained data, models trained by ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best performance among open-source models on ChainSpace-Bench and transfer competitively to multiple external spatial intelligence benchmarks. These results establish ChainSpace as an effective paradigm for more faithful evaluation and more data-efficient learning of spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: ChainSpace 提出了一种链式推理范式，将空间推理组织为状态保持的多轮过程，并配套构建了手动标注的多轮基准 Bench、评估指标以及基于模拟器的链式监督数据生成流水线，在保持数据高效的同时提升了空间智能的评估忠实度和训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法将空间推理视为独立的问答实例，导致模型可以基于捷径进行回答，且缺乏对持续性空间状态理解的监督，无法满足空间智能对物理世界中连贯空间状态保持的需求。
AI.method: 提出 ChainSpace 链式推理范式，将空间问题组织为逻辑约束且联合一致的问题链，后续问题依赖前序轮次建立的空间约束；据此构建手动标注的真实世界多轮基准 ChainSpace-Bench、链感知评估指标（Chain-Aware Metric），以及基于模拟器的链式监督生成框架 ChainSpace-Pipeline 用于空间智能训练。
AI.result: ChainSpace-Bench 能暴露孤立问题准确率无法捕捉的链级失败；仅用相对少量的模拟器生成链式数据，经 ChainSpace-Pipeline 训练的模型在 ChainSpace-Bench 上达到开源模型最佳性能，并在多个外部空间智能基准上具有竞争力的迁移表现。
AI.conclusion: ChainSpace 验证了链式推理范式在空间智能评估的忠实度和训练的数据效率方面的有效性，为空间智能的可靠评估与高效学习提供了可行的新范式。

title: Geometry of Forgetting: Representation Flux in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental obstacle to continual learning, where neural networks lose previously acquired knowledge while learning new tasks. Existing methods primarily mitigate forgetting through parameter regularization or experience replay, while the representation-space dynamics associated with forgetting remain less understood. We investigate latent representation evolution during sequential learning and introduce representation flux, a geometric measure of sample-level representation displacement across training. We show that representation flux is strongly associated with catastrophic forgetting across multiple benchmarks, with temporal analyses indicating that elevated flux can precede subsequent performance degradation. Representation displacement is also associated with confidence degradation, while complementary geometric properties provide additional information about sample-level forgetting. Motivated by these observations, we propose FlowLess-R, a representation-space regularization method that constrains replay representations relative to stored references while allowing continued learning. FlowLess-R is architecture-agnostic and integrates into replay-based methods through a representation-matching term. Experiments on SplitMNIST, SplitFashionMNIST, SplitCIFAR10, and SplitTinyImageNet show improved final average accuracy and reduced forgetting with ER, DER++, and ER-ACE. Our results identify representation flux as an informative geometric marker of forgetting and show that stabilizing latent representations provides a simple strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"表征通量"(representation flux)这一几何度量来量化持续学习中样本在潜在表征空间的位移，发现其与灾难性遗忘强相关且可先于性能退化出现。基于此，提出FlowLess-R表征空间正则化方法，通过约束重放样本的表征与存储参考保持一致，在SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10和SplitTinyImageNet上显著提升了ER、DER++和ER-ACE等重放方法的最终平均精度并降低了遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要通过参数正则化或经验重放缓解灾难性遗忘，但对遗忘过程中表征空间的动态演化缺乏深入理解。作者旨在揭示表征位移与遗忘之间的内在关联，并利用这一几何视角设计更有效的缓解策略。
AI.method: 1）提出表征通量(representation flux)，一种度量样本级表征在训练期间几何位移的指标；2）通过时序分析验证表征通量与遗忘的因果关系（位移可先于性能退化）；3）提出FlowLess-R，一种与架构无关的表征空间正则化方法，在重放方法中加入表征匹配项(repransentation-matching term)，约束重放表征相对于存储参考的稳定性，同时允许模型继续学习新任务。
AI.result: 在SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10和SplitTinyImageNet四个基准上，FlowLess-R分别与ER、DER++和ER-ACE结合后，均提升了最终平均精度并减少了遗忘。实验表明表征通量是遗忘的有效几何标记。
AI.conclusion: 表征通量是识别遗忘的信息性几何指标，稳定潜在表征为缓解灾难性遗忘提供了一种简单而有效的通用策略，且可无缝集成到现有重放方法中。

title: Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers
summary: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation of outdoor LiDAR scans has traditionally relied on handcrafted geometric priors such as density-based clustering, motion cues, or projected 2D detections. In this work, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised point transformer already contains the structural information required to isolate object instances without any handcrafted geometric prior. Using this transformer purely as a feature extractor, we probe its internal representations across the SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Perception datasets. Our analysis yields four core insights: (1) the instance signal concentrates in the attention queries and keys rather than in the values or final output features; (2) output features semantically collapse, merging adjacent same-class objects that the queries and keys keep distinct; (3) this instance signal is bimodal in depth, strongest at the shallowest and deepest encoder stages; and (4) this signal is driven predominantly by the rotary position encoding (RoPE), whose removal collapses its advantage. We put these findings into our method TokenGraph3D, a training-free segmenter that groups points via connected components on a key-similarity graph, using neither density-based clustering nor proximity priors. Under identical prior-free conditions, we substantially outperform output-feature baselines, making the emergent 3D instance structure visible.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨冻结的自监督点云Transformer是否已隐含3D实例分割所需的结构信息，并据此提出无训练的分割方法TokenGraph3D，该方法仅基于注意力键相似性图上的连通分量分组，无需任何手工几何先验，在多个户外LiDAR数据集上显著优于输出特征基线。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督3D实例分割依赖密度聚类、运动线索或2D投影检测等手工几何先验。作者希望探究冻结的自监督点云Transformer内部表示是否已包含足够的实例分离结构信息，从而摆脱对手工先验的依赖。
AI.method: 将冻结的预训练点Transformer作为纯特征提取器，在SemanticKITTI、nuScenes和Waymo数据集上探测其内部表示。通过分析发现实例信号集中在注意力Q/K而非V或最终输出特征中，且该信号受旋转位置编码(RoPE)驱动。据此提出TokenGraph3D：一种无需训练的实例分割器，通过在键相似性图的连通分量上分组点云完成分割。
AI.result: TokenGraph3D在完全无先验条件下显著优于基于输出特征的基线方法，验证了注意力Q/K中蕴含的实例结构信息可用于有效的3D实例分割。此外，研究揭示了四个关键洞察：实例信号在Q/K中集中、输出特征语义坍缩、信号在深度上呈双模态分布、以及RoPE是主要驱动力。
AI.conclusion: 自监督点云Transformer中自然涌现出可为实例分割所利用的结构信息，特别是在注意力查询和键表示中。无需任何手工几何先验，仅通过键相似性连通分量即可实现有效的3D实例分割，这为无监督实例分割开辟了新的范式。

title: TransfHAR: Self-Supervised Wrist Representations for On-Demand Activity Recognition
summary: Fine-grained wrist activity recognition can support applications such as procedural step guidance and context-aware assistance, yet acquiring labeled data for every new task, user, and activity granularity remains a bottleneck. We present TransfHAR, a self-supervised wrist IMU framework for on-demand, fine-grained activity recognition by learning transferable motion priors from global, unlabeled activities. We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.

AI.tldr: TransfHAR是一个基于自监督预训练的腕部IMU活动识别框架，通过从全局无标签的粗粒度活动中学习可迁移的运动先验，实现按需的细粒度活动识别（如手势、操作和程序性活动），仅需少量演示样本即可让用户自定义个性化活动集。
AI.motivation: 细粒度腕部活动识别可支持程序步骤引导和情境感知辅助等应用，但为每个新任务、新用户和新活动粒度获取标注数据仍是瓶颈。现有方法依赖完整标注集，无法高效实现按需、个性化的细粒度识别。
AI.method: TransfHAR采用自监督预训练方式，在粗粒度腕部IMU活动（如坐、走、运动）上学习可迁移的运动结构先验，再将这些先验迁移到预训练中未出现的细粒度活动（如按压、搅拌、挥手）。系统实现为实时智能手表应用，用户可通过少量演示定义和扩展自己的活动集。评估包括三个跨数据集离线实验和一个10人室内研究（每人执行7种新腕部活动，每类5个示例或单次1分钟录音微调）。
AI.result: 在三个跨数据集离线评估中，TransfHAR在平衡准确率上平均超过使用完整标签集且传感器通道相同或更多的全监督基线6.2个百分点。室内研究中，每类5个示例时跨参与者平衡准确率达86.7%；从每类单次1分钟录音更新后达90.4%。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的腕部自监督预训练为按需细粒度活动识别提供了有效基础，证明粗粒度活动中蕴含的运动结构足以迁移至全新的细粒度活动，为少样本、个性化的活动识别提供了可行路径。

title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.

AI.tldr: PWLR是一种基于视觉语言模型的OOD检测方法，通过离线生成区分混淆类别对的局部视觉线索（witness cues），并在推理时结合全局类别分数与成对局部证据进行校准，显著提升近OOD和远OOD检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言OOD检测器利用类别语义、局部提示或LLM生成的概念，但很少将语言用作区分混淆ID类别之间的显式边界证据。特别是当近OOD样本靠近ID类别边界时，现有方法性能不足。
AI.method: PWLR包含三个阶段：(1) 离线阶段，用MLLM描述支持某ID类别优于特定竞争类别的可见局部线索（cue phrases）；(2) 筛选用ID-only数据在冻结的视觉语言骨干下过滤，仅保留可靠的局部验证器；(3) 推理阶段，先保留少量全局可能的类别，再检查这些类别是否被其最相关竞争者的局部证据支持，最后通过校准将成对局部证据与全局类别分数结合。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100远OOD、cleaner/challenging OOD及近OOD基准上，PWLR在多个骨干网络上一致地提升了强视觉语言基线的OOD检测性能。
AI.conclusion: PWLR验证了将语言作为ID类别间显式边界证据的有效性，为近OOD检测提供了一种新的成对局部证据融合框架，且代码将开源。

title: Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes
summary: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种正则化的两阶段生成框架用于合成人口建模：第一阶段通过加入IGP、LDR和CLAP三种正则项增强WGAN-GP在表格数据合成中的可行性、多样性和新颖性；第二阶段使用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型在合成表格档案条件下生成出行时序属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。实验表明正则化模型在可行性和新颖性上分别提升2.1-3.7和6.6-10.0个百分点，F1提升6.3-8.6个百分点；LSTM-Attention在出行链长度分布上表现最佳，Transformer在整体时序F1上更优（90.6%对89.1%）。
AI.motivation: 基于活动的出行需求模型需要真实可信的合成人口作为输入，但从有限的调查数据生成真实人口面临两个主要挑战：小样本导致有效属性组合缺失（采样零值），以及生成模型可能产生不可行的结构零值。此外，真实人口不仅需要静态的社会人口学属性，还需要涵盖顺序性的出行行为（如出行链），现有方法难以同时满足这些需求。
AI.method: 提出正则化的两阶段生成框架。Stage 1使用带梯度惩罚的WGAN（WGAN-GP），增加三种正则化损失项——IGP（改善可行性）、LDR（增强多样性）和CLAP（提升新颖性）——用于表格化人口综合。Stage 2分别使用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型，以合成表格档案为条件，生成出行时序属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。同时引入新颖性和计数感知指标，评估是否以真实比例恢复和生成有效的未见组合。
AI.result: 正则化模型在所有指标上优于基础WGAN-GP：可行性提升2.1-3.7个百分点，新颖性提升6.6-10.0个百分点，F1分数提升6.3-8.6个百分点，且不牺牲可行性。时序属性方面，LSTM-Attention在出行链长度分布匹配上最优，Transformer实现更高的整体时序F1（90.6%对89.1%）。跨阶段验证表明生成的出行状态与出行链之间具有强一致性。
AI.conclusion: 正则化策略有效解决了小样本数据下合成人口生成中的采样零值与结构零值问题，两阶段框架能够同时捕获静态人口属性与顺序性出行行为。研究为活动出行建模提供了更可靠的人口合成方法，并验证了生成模型在兼顾可行性与新颖性方面的可行路径。

title: From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting
summary: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个冻结的中文手写个性化工程项目的全过程。项目从约200张真实手写图片（覆盖197个汉字）出发，最初定位为少样本生成未见字符；在反复尝试基于规范（canonical）的个性化生成路线遭遇结构压力与个性化冲突后，项目转向真实人类字符等价类匹配方案。通过多书写者CASIA候选池，发现用户兼容的现成真实风格样本存在，任务从合成改为逐字匹配与跨书写者组合构成虚拟书写者。最终系统在目标集上197/197有真实人类候选，100字符评估子集全覆盖，稳定性审核均在预定义A类机器代理区域，最终证据支持稳定的实用B级质量，许多输出接近A级。
AI.motivation: 探索个性化中文手写生成时面临的核心矛盾：增大结构约束使输出趋向规范字，而增大个性化则可能破坏身份特征笔画。项目试图寻找一条既能保持书写者个人风格、又能保证字符结构可读性的路径，最终在经历多轮失败后论证了在特定场景下真实人类样本匹配比合成生成更优。
AI.method: （1）从约200张单用户真实手写图片（197个唯一字符）出发，先尝试规范中心的个性化生成路线但反复暴露结构压力与个性化的冲突；（2）项目重置为真实人类字符等价类方案，利用多书写者CASIA候选池寻找用户兼容的真实样本；（3）系统采用真实墨水特征、字符级人群百分位数、top-20候选剪枝以及贪心最困难优先的整行选择策略；（4）通过跨书写者组合构建虚拟书写者，并用60回合稳定性审计进行质量评估。
AI.result: 覆盖目标集中197个用户字符全部找到真实人类候选；100字符评估子集覆盖率100/100；已知字符留出比较中出现一行被判定为与真实用户手写几乎无法区分；60回合稳定性审计均在预定义的A类机器代理区域内，但并非独立人类A级判断。最终证据支持稳定的实用B级质量，许多输出接近A级。
AI.conclusion: 在特定用户案例中，真实人类样本匹配取代了生成方法，证明了生成在该场景下并非必要，且能达到稳定的实用级质量。但项目明确不宣称无限制或普适的手写合成能力，研究结论局限于该特定案例。

title: Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant
summary:
The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory.
  The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MOOSEnger，一个基于MOOSE有限元框架的领域专用AI智能体，并扩展了其本地模型运行的harness，提供从知识检索、仿真验证诊断到持久化记忆学习完整管线。在VTB工程问题及8个类别的200个用例上评估，MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%成功率，MOOSEnger-Gemma4为76.5%，远超无智能体能力的基线模型（GPT-5.2仅5%，Gemma4为0%），证明智能体harness对多物理场仿真建模效率有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 多物理场仿真环境（如MOOSE）的使用需要专业领域知识，对许多领域科学家和工程师构成技术壁垒。本文旨在通过构建AI智能体来降低这一门槛，使非专家也能有效利用MOOSE框架进行多物理场仿真建模。
AI.method: 在INL开发的MOOSEnger基础上，扩展了一个面向本地托管模型的harness，该harness提供完整管线：(1)从MOOSE仓库检索上下文知识；(2)通过与仿真可执行环境的交互来验证和诊断生成的输入；(3)将经验教训提取并存储到持久化记忆中。研究中对比了MOOSEnger-Gemma4与MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2，并设置了无智能体能力的Gemma4和GPT-5.2作为基线，在8个类别的200个用例上评估。
AI.result: MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%的成功率，MOOSEnger-Gemma4达到76.5%，而无智能体能力的基线模型GPT-5.2仅5%、Gemma4为0%。该框架还在NRIC虚拟测试台的工程问题上进行了演示，展示了其在真实多物理场仿真工作流中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 智能体harness的引入极大提升了模型在MOOSE仿真建模任务上的表现，即使使用较小的本地模型（Gemma4），也能通过agentic能力获得远优于大模型无智能体基线的效果。这证明面向特定领域的工具化AI智能体是降低多物理场仿真使用门槛的有效途径。

title: FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams
summary: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations. Extensive experiments show that FlowDance achieves strong performance in both dance motion generation and music-driven dance video synthesis.

AI.tldr: FlowDance是一个音乐驱动的舞蹈视频生成框架，通过并行姿态流和RGB流集成显式运动建模与参考保持的视觉合成，并引入时间步感知的姿态注入和持久身份注入，同时构建了高质量野外舞蹈视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成具有挑战性，需要同时学习音乐到动作的对应关系、保持身份的动画、时间连贯性以及视觉真实的视频生成，这些多方面的联合学习使得该任务难度很高。
AI.method: FlowDance包含三个关键设计：(1) 并行姿态流与RGB流分别处理显式运动建模和参考保持的视觉合成；(2) 时间步感知的姿态注入，在不同去噪步骤中自适应调整结构引导；(3) 持久身份注入，在长视频中保持参考人物外观。此外构建了包含音乐、RGB视频、3D人体运动、相机参数和2D姿态标注的高分辨率野外舞蹈数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明FlowDance在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动舞蹈视频合成两个任务上都取得了优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: FlowDance通过显式运动建模与参考保持视觉合成的集成，为音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成提供了有效框架，同时配套构建的数据集为该领域研究提供了有力支撑。

title: Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive
summary: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于层间Hessian谱信息（特别是顶层特征值）的持续学习正则化策略：在块对角Hessian假设下证明遗忘可分解为各层由顶层特征值加权的项，而对角Fisher权重无法捕获该特征值信息。由此推导出简单策略"强保护早期层、允许深层自由移动"，应用于EWC和SLCA后在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得明显提升。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）使用逐参数的对角Fisher重要性来防止遗忘，但逐层对角Fisher只是真实曲率的弱概括，丢失了对遗忘控制至关重要的顶层特征值信息。对抗性比特翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究显示，这种逐层敏感度在神经网络中可能跨越数量级差异，因此需要一种能捕获Hessian谱信息的正则化方法。
AI.method: 在块对角Hessian假设下（即EWC现有对角假设的层级别类比），作者证明三点结论：(1) 遗忘可分解为各层项之和，每项由该层的顶层Hessian特征值加权；(2) 对角Fisher权重无法恢复该特征值，两个Fisher平均值相同的层，其顶层特征值可能相差高达层宽度倍；(3) 在遗忘水平相同的情况下，均匀正则化导致的新任务性能损失与层条件数成比例增长。基于这些理论推导，提出简单策略：对早期层施加强正则化，允许深层更自由地移动，并将该策略应用于EWC和SLCA。
AI.result: 将基于层间顶层Hessian特征值的正则化策略应用于EWC和SLCA后，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得清晰的改进，验证了理论分析的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析与实验均表明：持续学习中的正则化应关注层的Hessian谱信息（特别是顶层特征值）而非仅依赖对角Fisher；简单有效的实践策略是"保护早期层，放开深层"。这一发现为设计更有效的持续学习正则化方法提供了理论支撑和实用指南。

title: MITE-Net: SWaP-Optimized 4K Video Tiny Target Perception for Embodied Edge SAR
summary: Real-time tiny target perception in high-resolution imagery is critical for embodied Search-and-Rescue (SAR) missions. However, strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints on edge devices like UAVs create a bottleneck: traditional image downsampling causes severe feature loss, while slice-based processing incurs prohibitive latency. To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework encompassing a novel architecture, specialized datasets, and hardware-level benchmarks. First, we propose MITE-Net, a SWaP-optimized cascaded architecture, which couples a bio-inspired, learning-free Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network (TTM-RPN) with a sub-0.14M-parameter R-CNN-like head. Second, to standardize 4K tiny target evaluation, we construct the SAR-Tiny Datasets by relabeling two challenging UAV datasets: SeaDroneSee-Tiny (dynamic maritime scenes, tiny targets predominantly of 64-256 pixels ) and UAVID-Tiny (cluttered urban scenes, extremely tiny targets, less than 64 pixels). Third, we benchmark against state-of-the-art YOLO models on an edge device, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, where MITE-Net directly processes 4K maritime imagery, achieving a 100\% search success rate at 30.33 FPS. Consuming merely 3.19 W (9.51 FPS/W), MITE-Net vastly outperforms YOLO baselines in target recall and energy efficiency.
