Conversely, UAVID-Tiny evaluations expose a compound structural limitation: the learning-free bionic front-end struggles against urban backgrounds, while the ultra-lightweight head lacks representational capacity for complex features. Ultimately, this work delivers an efficient onboard perception paradigm and a rigorous baseline guiding future end-to-end SAR architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MITE-Net框架，结合生物启发、免学习的运动目标区域提案网络(TTM-RPN)与超轻量R-CNN头部（<0.14M参数），在SWaP约束下的边缘设备上实现对4K高分辨率影像中实时微小目标感知；同时构建SAR-Tiny数据集（SeaDroneSee-Tiny与UAVID-Tiny）并完成NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上的硬件级基准测试，在海上场景达到30.33 FPS、3.19W功耗、100%搜索成功率，远超YOLO基线。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备（如无人机）的SWaP（尺寸、重量、功耗）约束与高分辨率影像中实时微小目标感知之间存在根本矛盾：传统图像降采样导致严重特征丢失，而切片式处理带来不可接受的延迟，亟需一种兼顾精度、速度与能效的新型感知框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出MITE-Net级联架构，包含生物启发、免学习的TTM-RPN区域提案网络，以及参数低于0.14M的类R-CNN检测头；2) 构建SAR-Tiny基准数据集，对SeaDroneSee（海上动态场景，目标64-256像素）和UAVID（城市杂乱场景，目标<64像素）进行重新标注；3) 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上进行与YOLO系列模型的硬件级对比基准测试。
AI.result: MITE-Net在4K海上影像上实现100%搜索成功率、30.33 FPS、功耗仅3.19W（9.51 FPS/W），在目标召回率和能效方面大幅优于YOLO基线；但在UAVID-Tiny城市杂乱场景中暴露出复合结构局限：免学习仿生前端难以应对城市背景，超轻量头部对复杂特征的表征能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种高效机载感知范式和严格的基准线，推动了面向未来端到端SAR架构的发展；同时揭示了在复杂城市背景下，纯免学习前端和极轻量化头部的固有局限，为后续研究方向指明路径。

title: Information Geometry of Message Passing
summary: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自然梯度消息传递（NGMP），证明变分推断的自然梯度平稳条件在Forney式因子图上具有边局部形式：在平稳点，某条边的自然参数等于来自两个相邻因子的投影消息之和，每个投影消息是在当前接收边际上的精确置信传播日志消息的自然梯度投影。
AI.motivation: 变分消息传递（VMP）在非共轭因子存在时会在邻居信念下平均因子，丢失了精确消息中接收族能表示的部分。作者希望提出一种更精确、保持局部性的消息传递方案，在不确定持续存在（如部分观测的潜链或参数经连续数据批次过滤）时获得更好的不确定度校准。
AI.method: 从Bethe自由能出发，将选定边的边际约束到指数族。推导自然梯度平稳条件，证明其等价于边参数等于两个投影消息之和。每个投影消息定义为精确BP日志消息在当前接收边际上的自然梯度投影，即其在均值坐标中期望的梯度。该规则完全局部，每条边可携带自己的指数族。
AI.result: 在Poisson平滑、异方差回归和小时级ETTh预测三个实验上验证了NGMP，相比VMP在不确定度校准方面获得主要增益，特别是在非共轭因子的接收边际存在不确定时NGMP更准确。
AI.conclusion: NGMP与VMP在进入非共轭因子的边不确定为零时重合；当不确定持续存在时NGMP更准确，增益主要体现在不确定性校准上，且规则具有局部性，可灵活扩展。

title: CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation and RF-missing conditions

AI.tldr: CardiacMamba是一种基于状态空间建模的RGB-RF融合框架，用于远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）心率监测，通过融合面部光学线索和射频心脏运动线索，在EquiPleth数据集上实现0.96 bpm MAE、3.06 bpm RMSE和0.97皮尔逊相关系数的SOTA性能，并将深浅肤色的MAE差距缩小至0.26 bpm。
AI.motivation: RGB-only的rPPG方法受光照变化、运动伪影和肤色依赖的光学反射影响，缺乏公平性和鲁棒性，需要融合更稳健的多模态信号来克服这些局限。
AI.method: CardiacMamba包含三个核心模块：Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM)用于增强微弱的RF时间变化，双向SSM交互机制用于对齐异构RGB-RF动态，以及Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT)模块用于通道域的频谱精炼。
AI.result: 在EquiPleth数据集上达到0.96 bpm MAE、3.06 bpm RMSE和0.97 Pearson相关性的SOTA性能；深浅肤色MAE差距降至0.26 bpm；在RGB退化和RF缺失条件下保持良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CardiacMamba通过RGB-RF多模态融合和状态空间建模，同时提升了rPPG心率监测的准确性和公平性，为肤色无关、环境鲁棒的生理信号感知提供了有效方案。

title: ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction
comment: Accepted at WellComp 2026, held with UbiComp/ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 4 tables, and 1 figure. To appear in UbiComp Companion '26. ACM DOI: 10.1145/3798063.3841770
summary: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可穿戴压力系统在何时应"展示"预测而非"更改"预测的问题，提出固定标签可靠性路由（Fixed-Label Reliability Routing）框架。在分类器锁定输出应力/非应力标签后，由后置网关（ReliaGate）决定保留并展示该标签或将其标记为不可用（隐去）。ReliaGate将置信度、信号质量/信任、一致性、训练标准化非典型性及训练拟合几何特征等既有线索整合为事后正确性评分。研究在四个可穿戴数据集上采用被试不重叠划分、验证集选择路由、成对保留被试区间及合并/逐被试分析进行评估：WESAD的点估计、UBFC-Phys的主要覆盖/风险区间支持ReliaGate，E4检查结果混合。该框架为研究展示标签错误、输出可用性及跨被试接受输出分布提供操作框架，但不修改标签，也不提供临床或有限样本风险保证。
AI.motivation: 在低风险反思与汇总场景中，仅追求聚合准确率不足，因为"隐去"（withholding）虽可降低错误，却可能让部分用户得不到任何信息。因此需要研究"何时应展示预测而非改变预测"这一核心问题，以在不改动已锁定分类器标签的前提下平衡输出可用性与错误率。
AI.method: 提出固定标签可靠性路由（Fixed-Label Reliability Routing）：锁定分类器输出协议定义的应力/非应力标签后，由后置网关（ReliaGate）决定将该标签原样展示或标记为不可用（withhold）。ReliaGate综合置信度、信号质量/信任、一致性、训练标准化非典型性和训练拟合几何特征等多类既有线索，形成事后正确性评分。评估采用四个可穿戴数据集、被试不重叠划分（subject-disjoint folds）、验证集选择路由、配对保留被试区间，并同时进行合并（pooled）与逐被试（per-subject）分析。
AI.result: WESAD数据集的点估计结果偏向ReliaGate；UBFC-Phys的主要覆盖/风险区间结果偏向ReliaGate；E4数据集的检查结果呈混合。整体表明ReliaGate在多数评测方向上具有优势但并非全面一致。
AI.conclusion: ReliaGate为研究可穿戴压力系统中的展示标签错误、输出可用性以及跨被试的接受输出分布提供了操作框架。它不修改原始标签，也不承诺临床或有限样本风险保证，定位为一种实证性的路由评估方案而非医疗级保障手段。

title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT)框架，通过训练阶段将视觉世界建模内化到多模态大语言模型中，使模型在推理时无需显式生成中间推理图像（Visual CoT），即可直接输出答案，在保持相同推理通路的同时，相比显式Visual CoT将端到端延迟降低5倍以上。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型依赖视觉链式思维（Visual CoT）通过生成中间推理图像来实现对空间、时间和具身环境的推理，但这种像素级生成带来了巨大的推理开销，尤其在前瞻性视频推理场景中问题突出。作者的核心研究问题是如何让模型在训练阶段学会视觉思考，而在推理阶段直接进行推理，无需额外的像素生成。
AI.method: IVT是一种后训练框架，在未标记视频上联合优化文本预测和下一嵌入预测（next-embedding prediction）两个目标。给定部分观测的视频，IVT同时预测未来帧的潜表征和目标任务文本答案，促使模型捕获运动、物体转换、交互和潜在意图。推理时，模型直接生成答案，无需合成或重新编码未来帧。作者在多个维度进行了受控研究，包括目标表征、解码器设计、预测视野、数据混合、训练课程和预测目标。
AI.result: IVT在所有六个评估设置上均优于直接答案微调，同时保持相同推理通路。与显式Visual CoT相比，IVT取得相当或更优的性能，并将平均端到端延迟降低超过5倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式像素空间生成（即Visual CoT）对于有效的前瞻性视频推理可能并非必需。预测性世界建模可以在训练阶段内化，从而产生既更准确又显著更高效的多模态推理模型。

title: Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors
summary: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SimpleCount——一个无需参数拟合的图异常检测基准方法，仅从固定特征池中为每个数据集选择一个标量特征，在六个数据集上与复杂的时序图检测模型（如SLADE）和IsoForest基线进行对比。结果表明SimpleCount在三/六个数据集上匹配或超越SLADE，在所有六个数据集上超越IsoForest，且计算时间比SLADE快23-133倍。论文强调复杂模型带来的收益是数据集依赖的，呼吁所有增益报告都应对照强的一特征基准并报告计算成本。
AI.motivation: 流式/边缘级图异常检测领域的架构日益复杂（从count-min-sketch卡方检验到记忆增强注意力网络），但这些额外复杂结构带来的经验增益从未被系统评估，缺乏强基线对照。
AI.method: 提出SimpleCount基准方法：无参数拟合，从固定特征池（计数、最近发生时间、首次出现指示符、计数衍生变换）中为每个数据集选取一个标量特征。与两个时序图检测模型及拟合完整特征向量的IsoForest对照，在五个公共数据集和一个合成数据集上进行对比，并进行配对统计检验和五种子SLADE评估。
AI.result: SimpleCount在六个数据集中有三个匹配或超过SLADE，在所有六个数据集上超过IsoForest；SLADE比SimpleCount慢23-133倍；在Synth-Triangle和Synth-Quad合成数据上，事件前结构分数以最高0.955的AUC恢复植入信号，而所有评估的检测模型接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 复杂模型的收益具有数据集依赖性，所有声称的增益都应对照强的一特征参考基准并同时报告计算成本进行验证。

title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
summary: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: CLARA是一个基于clip级别的多模态仇恨视频检测框架，将视频建模为细粒度clip序列而非单一实例，通过Mixture-of-Experts编码器、局部-全局对比学习目标以及VLM生成的理由引导机制，在三类仇恨视频数据集上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 随着视频社交平台的快速增长，仇恨视频检测变得日益重要。与文本或静态多模态内容相比，仇恨视频检测尚未被充分探索且更具挑战性，因为仇恨含义往往源于语音、音频和视觉等多种模态线索之间复杂交互，且这些信号通常短暂、隐晦且具有时间依赖性，难以用传统视频级表示捕获。
AI.method: CLARA将视频建模为细粒度clip序列而非单一实例，以更精确地捕获时间上局部的仇恨信号。核心组件包括：(1) Mixture-of-Experts clip编码器用于自适应多模态对齐；(2) 局部-全局片段对比学习目标，联合建模短期线索和长期时间依赖；(3) 通过门控Transformer集成的VLM-derived理由，提供高层级语义引导。
AI.result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的大量实验表明，CLARA始终优于现有最先进方法。消融研究和参数分析进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CLARA验证了clip级别粒度建模在仇恨视频检测中的有效性，证明了精细时间建模、多模态自适应对齐和VLM语义引导相结合能够更好地捕获仇恨视频中短暂、隐晦且时间依赖的仇恨信号。

title: A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps
summary: We study stochastic approximation of fixed points of a non-expansive operator when the oracle samples originate from a continuing Markovian trajectory. A direct block-minibatch implementation of Halpern iteration attains an expected last-iterate residual of order $O(\log N/N)$, but accrues a substantive complexity of $\tilde O(ε^{-5})$ Markovian samples. We therefore introduce a variance-reduced Markovian PAGE-Halpern method whose refresh and same-state difference blocks are analyzed through the Poisson equation. In Hilbert spaces, the cocoercivity of $I-T$ results in an $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. Our main result extends this construction to a general finite-dimensional Banach space. A displacement-level Halpern bound replaces the Hilbert-space potential and yields $\tilde O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity in the original non-expansiveness norm. We also establish a high-probability guarantee with the same leading accuracy dependence by measuring the estimator in an auxiliary smooth norm. Non-smooth sup and block-sup geometries are covered through norm smoothing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当oracle样本来源于连续马尔可夫轨迹时，非扩张算子不动点的随机逼近问题。提出了一种基于方差缩减的马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法，在希尔伯特空间中利用I-T的余强单调性实现O(ε⁻³)样本复杂度，并将该构造推广到一般有限维巴拿赫空间，通过位移级Halpern界在非扩张范数下同样实现Õ(ε⁻³)的样本复杂度，同时建立了具有相同主导精度依赖的高概率保证。
AI.motivation: 现有直接的分块小批量Halpern迭代虽然能达到O(log N/N)的期望最后迭代残差，但其马尔可夫样本复杂度高达Õ(ε⁻⁵)，过于昂贵。作者旨在通过方差缩减技术降低马尔可夫采样下的样本复杂度，并将结果从希尔伯特空间推广到更一般的巴拿赫空间。
AI.method: 提出马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法，包含刷新块（refresh blocks）和同态差分块（same-state difference blocks），通过对泊松方程的分析处理马尔可夫噪声。在希尔伯特空间中利用I-T的余强单调性；在一般有限维巴拿赫空间中，用位移级Halpern界替代希尔伯特空间势函数。通过范数光滑化处理非光滑的sup范数和块sup范数几何。
AI.result: 希尔伯特空间中达到O(ε⁻³)样本复杂度；在一般有限维巴拿赫空间的非扩张范数下达到Õ(ε⁻³)样本复杂度；在辅助光滑范数下建立具有相同主导精度依赖的高概率保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过方差缩减和泊松方程分析，成功将马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法的样本复杂度从Õ(ε⁻⁵)降至Õ(ε⁻³)，并且该结果不仅限于希尔伯特空间，还可扩展到一般有限维巴拿赫空间的各种范数几何。

title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology
summary: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. The models distinguish between adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal lung tissue. YOLO11 achieves the best classification performance, with an accuracy of 98.38%, a five-fold cross-validation accuracy of 98.21 +/- 0.35%, and a macro F1-score of 0.98. For region segmentation, U-Net, ResNet-encoder U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and YOLO11-seg are evaluated using the GlaS gland segmentation benchmark. DeepLabV3+ obtains the highest Intersection over Union of 0.80 and a Dice score of 0.89, while YOLO11-seg achieves a comparable Intersection over Union of 0.79 using approximately 14x fewer parameters. The best-performing classification and segmentation models are subsequently integrated into an end-to-end framework, providing an accurate, computationally efficient, and reproducible baseline for automated histopathological image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个两阶段深度学习框架，用于肺癌组织病理图像的多类组织分类和像素级区域分割。在组织分类阶段，六种模型在39,000张图像（LC25000和LungHist700合并数据集）上区分腺癌、鳞状细胞癌和正常肺组织，YOLO11取得最优分类性能（准确率98.38%，宏F1分数0.98）；在分割阶段，四种模型在GlaS基准上评估，DeepLabV3+获得最高IoU 0.80和Dice 0.89，YOLO11-seg以约14倍更少的参数达到相当的IoU 0.79。最终将最佳分类与分割模型集成为端到端框架，为自动化组织病理图像分析提供准确、计算高效且可复现的基线。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的首要原因，但组织病理学诊断常受观察者间差异和人工阅片工作量大等问题影响。尽管深度学习在计算病理学中展现出潜力，但缺乏将组织分类和区域分割整合到统一分析框架中的综合基准研究。
AI.method: 本研究构建两阶段深度学习框架：第一阶段为多类组织分类，评估六种模型（自定义CNN、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义Vision Transformer和YOLO11）在合并的39,000张图像数据集上区分腺癌、鳞状细胞癌和正常肺组织；第二阶段为区域分割，评估U-Net、ResNet编码器U-Net、DeepLabV3+和YOLO11-seg在GlaS腺体分割基准上的性能。最佳分类与分割模型随后被集成到一个端到端管道中。
AI.result: 分类阶段：YOLO11取得最佳性能，准确率98.38%，五折交叉验证准确率98.21±0.35%，宏F1分数0.98。分割阶段：DeepLabV3+取得最高IoU 0.80和Dice 0.89，YOLO11-seg以约14倍更少的参数达到可比的IoU 0.79。最终端到端框架兼顾了准确性与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段框架为自动化组织病理图像分析提供了一个准确、计算高效且可复现的基线，系统性地比较了各阶段的最先进架构，验证了将分类与分割统一整合的有效性。

title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
summary: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility must enter through an added, checkable hypothesis. We then prove three such obstructions. Depth: for recursive role-binding codes the swap margin obeys an exact law $m(D) = 2b^{-D}$ in the nesting depth D, with a finite-dimension version holding up to one explicitly flagged concentration estimate; the resolvable depth grows only logarithmically in the dimension and is single-digit at CLIP scale, the nesting depth of ordinary language. Objective: architecture-free throttle theorems showing that the contrastive objective's entire reward for binding is bounded by the rate at which training contrasts a caption against its own swap, a rate that vanishes at web scale, and that exactly reversed binding costs only that rate times the mean binding margin; both are verified in simulation. Geometry: a tight smoothness-binding frontier: the closer the two swap-related captions must embed to a shared paraphrase anchor, the smaller the binding margin can be, with an exact constant. Measuring its text-only diagnostic across 18 deployed text encoders, every model sits at roughly 25-35% of its ceiling, and the induced per-item ceiling tracks SugarCrepe's subset difficulty at r = 0.99. Binding failure in deployed dual encoders is thus not a dimension or smoothness limit today, but an incentive and code-structure limit, with a proved depth ceiling that remains once those are fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文从数学上严格刻画了双编码器（如CLIP）在捆绑（binding）任务上失败的必然性与偶然性。在理想编码器框架下证明相关公理可满足，然后给出三个阻碍定理：深度（递归角色绑定码的交换余量随深度指数衰减，CLIP尺度下可分辨深度仅为个位数）、目标（对比学习目标对捆绑的奖励上限受训练中交换样本对比率限制，该比率在web规模下趋零）、几何（交换相关字幕到共享转述锚点的嵌入距离与捆绑余量之间存在紧致前沿）。通过对18个文本编码器的诊断，所有模型仅达到其理论上限的25-35%，证明当前部署的双编码器捆绑失败主要不是维度或平滑度限制，而是激励和代码结构限制。
AI.motivation: 双编码器模型（如CLIP）在图像-文本匹配中通过两个独立单位向量的内积打分，但在需要绑定角色-属性关系的任务上表现接近随机，例如无法区分"红色车和蓝色狗"与"蓝色车和红色狗"。作者希望从数学上解释这种失败是必然的还是偶然的，从而为改进模型提供理论指导。
AI.method: 在Kang等人提出的理想编码器框架内开展工作。首先证明相关公理是可满足的（即不存在内在矛盾），然后通过添加可检验的假设证明三个阻碍定理：(1) 深度阻碍——递归角色绑定码的交换余量满足精确律 m(D)=2b^{-D}，可分辨深度仅随维度对数增长；(2) 目标阻碍——架构无关的节流定理，证明对比学习目标对捆绑的全部奖励受训练中自交换对照率的限制，该比率在web规模下趋零；(3) 几何阻碍——紧致的光滑度-捆绑前沿，交换相关字幕越接近共享转述锚点，捆绑余量越小，具有精确常数。最后用文本诊断法评测18个部署的文本编码器。
AI.result: 验证了两个节流定理的模拟结果；几何前沿具有精确常数；18个部署的文本编码器在文本诊断中均位于其理论上限的约25-35%；逐项上限与SugarCrepe子集难度相关性为r=0.99。深度阻碍定理给出了CLIP尺度下可分辨深度仅为个位数的结论。
AI.conclusion: 当前部署的双编码器的捆绑失败并非维度或平滑度限制，而是激励（incentive）和代码结构（code-structure）限制。即使这些限制得到修复，深度上限仍然存在，即存在一个已证明的深度天花板。

title: BagShift: Measuring How Patch Selection Changes the Evidence Seen by Whole-Slide MIL
summary: Whole-slide multiple-instance learning (MIL) observes only the patches admitted by its selector. Deployment can alter this selector through compute limits, tissue masking, or regional workflows, even when the patch count is unchanged. We introduce BagShift, a paired protocol that changes the selector for the same case while holding its features and predictor fixed, thereby isolating selector response from case mix. With equal 128-patch budgets, sampling across the tissue or concentrating around one coordinate exposes markedly different evidence: on PANDA, the two views reduce quadratic weighted kappa by 1.57 and 17.96 points, respectively (QWK reported on the $\times100$ scale). On CAMELYON16, lesion annotations withheld from model development show that localized views retain tumor in only 10.0\% of micrometastatic observations, and matched exposure does not consistently recover the loss. The same fixed-count stressor produces a much smaller response on external lung subtyping, although differences in relative coverage make cross-task severity descriptive. When repeated localized observations are available, unioning their patches before one nonlinear MIL pass improves PANDA QWK by 7.87 points over averaging regional predictions. Patch count specifies computation, not observed evidence; deployment evaluations should report both what a selector preserves and how repeated observations are aggregated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BagShift协议，用于隔离全切片多实例学习（MIL）中选择器变化对预测的影响。通过固定特征与预测器、仅改变补丁选择策略，实验表明在PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上，相同补丁预算下不同采样策略会产生显著的性能差异，而在外部肺亚型任务上影响较小。重复局部观测时，对补丁求并集再进行非线性MIL处理优于对各区域预测取平均。
AI.motivation: 标准的MIL评估通常假设部署时的选择器与开发时一致，但实际部署中计算资源限制、组织掩膜或区域工作流可能改变选择器，即使补丁数量保持相同，观测到的证据也会不同，导致模型性能不可预测。
AI.method: 提出BagShift配对协议：对同一病例，固定特征与预测器不变，仅改变补丁选择策略（如全组织均匀采样或围绕单一坐标集中采样），以隔离选择器响应对病例混合的影响。并在有重复局部观测时，比较补丁并集后单次非线性MIL处理与区域预测平均两种聚合方式。
AI.result: 在PANDA上，全组织采样与集中采样的视图分别使二次加权Kappa降低1.57和17.96点（×100标度）。在CAMELYON16上，局部视图仅在10.0%的微转移观测中保留肿瘤，且匹配暴露不能一致地恢复损失。外部肺亚型任务对该固定计数压力源的响应较小。聚合方式上，补丁并集后单次非线性MIL比区域预测平均在PANDA上提高7.87个QWK点。
AI.conclusion: 补丁数量只刻画了计算量，而非观测到的证据内容。部署评估应同时报告选择器保留了何种信息以及重复观测如何被聚合，以确保评估能真实反映部署条件下的模型行为。

title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files include figure-reproducibility code and frozen plot-level data
summary: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. Conditional mechanism results then identify a graph-Hodge chronology decomposition, a regular switching class with root-mean-square scale $\sqrt{p}η^{3/2}$ and finite-scale corrections, and an exact Adam moment section whose immediate adaptive field is constant while common future gradients can reveal hidden moment differences. Frozen Transformer--LoRA--AdamW studies with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 support a local action backbone, longer-horizon first-return non-closure, and fresh visible-relative completion with output-range reuse and a low-rank irreducible sector. Stronger claims remain bounded by preregistered negative or mixed results: re-anchored transport is unresolved above its measurement floor; the strict finite-grid Hodge--$3/2$ conjunction is unmet despite prospective contraction; Qwen accessibility is not established in the frozen raw moment chart; and Mistral revelation is future-context dependent rather than bank invariant. Within these support-, scale-, metric-, and context-resolved boundaries, present behavior is not a sufficient statistic for declared future learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"纤维指纹"(fiber fingerprints)来形式化"执行状态在现有行为读写下不可区分、但对未来训练响应不同"的现象，构建了Nerode型最小递归充分表示与预测商函子，在无需光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形假设下给出规范性预测纤维；在有限维Hilbert实现下将响应分解为可见、可见模式复用和不可约新三类扇区，并给出了图Hodge时间序列分解、正则切换类的RMS尺度√p·η^{3/2}及精确Adam矩截面等机理结果。实验（Qwen2.5-7B与Mistral-7B-v0.3的冻结Transformer-LoRA-AdamW）支持局部动作骨干、长时首次返回非闭合与可见相对补全，但多个更强断言（重锚定传输、严格有限网格Hodge-3/2合取、Qwen可达性、Mistral揭示性）受限于预注册的负面或混合结果。
AI.motivation: 核心动机在于揭示并严格刻画学习系统中"状态不可区分但未来学习响应不同"的深层结构。现有理论通常假设状态由当前行为充分刻画，但实践中广泛存在隐状态层面的差异，这些差异无法被可见行为检测，却会影响未来训练动力学。作者希望建立不依赖光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形假设的一般性形式框架，从而理解深度学习系统中这类"隐藏变量"的理论边界与实际表现。
AI.method: 方法包含三层。(1) 理论层：以纤维指纹（受控未来学习响应律）限制在现行为等价类上，用前缀兼容有限探针构造预测商函子，推导Nerode型最小递归充分表示与集合级预测纤维；(2) 机理层：在有限维Hilbert实现下将响应分解为可见、可见模式复用、不可约新三个扇区，引入历史可达性桥，建立图-Hodge时间序列分解、正则切换类RMS尺度√p·η^{3/2}及Adam精确矩截面；(3) 实证层：以Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3在冻结Transformer-LoRA-AdamW设置下进行预注册实验验证。
AI.result: 理论结果表明预测商函子与最小递归充分表示在极弱假设下成立，响应在有限维Hilbert框架下的三分割具有明确语义。图Hodge分解给出了时间序列的规范分层，Adam矩截面揭示"即时自适应场恒定但未来梯度可揭晓隐藏矩差异"的精确现象。实验中观测到局部动作骨干、长时首次返回轨迹的不闭合性以及新鲜的可见相对补全（含输出范围复用与低秩不可约扇区）。但多个强断言未获支持：重锚定传输在测量下限之上无法解决、严格有限网格Hodge-3/2合取未达成、Qwen可达性在冻结原始矩图中未确立、Mistral揭示性依赖未来上下文而非银行不变。
AI.conclusion: 在支持域、尺度、度量与上下文四类边界内可断定：当前可见行为不足以充分统计未来声明的学习表现。该工作确立了一套不依赖几何平滑假设的预测等价类理论，并给出了机理与实验的细粒度边界条件，为后续研究提供了可证伪的框架和预注册的严格基线。

title: CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications
summary: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false negatives. A masked joint decoder provides the complementary local objective by reconstructing hidden visual patches and wireless angular clusters under modality dropout. After pretraining, a differential-rate fine-tuning rule lets a new fusion head adapt quickly while the encoders move slowly. Under a sequence-disjoint DeepSense 6G protocol, adding the soft alignment loss improves a matched linear-probe transfer average from 24.88\% to 29.49\%. Mild fusion fine-tuning reaches 77.38\% Top-1 accuracy on unseen Scenarios 6--8, and optional transductive normalization adaptation reaches 78.69\%. Since the fusion setting uses the contemporaneous 64-beam power vector at inference, these results should be read as representation-transfer diagnostics, not as proactive beam-prediction or reduced-sweeping claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-MAE，一种自监督视觉-无线跨场景表征预训练框架。其核心是软对比对齐损失（soft contrastive alignment loss），通过构建基于波束功率相似度的目标分布来避免将非相同样本错误地视为负样本；配合掩码联合解码器在模态缺失下重建视觉与无线信息。在DeepSense 6G序列不相交协议下，软对齐损失将线性探针迁移平均准确率从24.88%提升至29.49%，融合微调在未见场景6-8上达到77.38%，可选转导归一化后达78.69%。
AI.motivation: 同步相机与无线测量通过不同物理信道观察同一场景，但在视角、交通、光照和传播几何变化时，单一部署中学习的表征无法跨场景迁移。现有方法依赖射线追踪、校准深度或波束标签等额外信息，且传统对比学习仅将同步图像-无线对视为正样本，会导致具有相似方向响应的非相同样本被错误地作为假负样本推开，阻碍跨场景表征泛化。
AI.method: CM-MAE采用两个核心组件：(1) 软对比对齐损失（soft contrastive alignment loss）——不将同步图像-无线对设为唯一正样本，而是从实测波束功率剖面间的相似度构建目标分布，使具有相似方向响应的非相同样本不被强制分离；(2) 掩码联合解码器（masked joint decoder）——在模态缺失条件下重建隐藏视觉块与无线角度簇，提供互补的局部自监督目标。预训练仅使用RGB帧和64波束接收功率向量，无需射线追踪路径、校准深度或波束索引标签。预训练后，采用差分速率微调规则（differential-rate fine-tuning），使新的融合头快速适应而编码器缓慢更新。
AI.result: 在DeepSense 6G序列不相交协议下：加入软对齐损失使匹配的线性探针迁移平均准确率从24.88%提升至29.49%；轻量融合微调在未见场景6-8上达到77.38% Top-1准确率；可选的转导归一化适配（transductive normalization adaptation）进一步将其提升至78.69%。
AI.conclusion: CM-MAE展示了自监督视觉-无线预训练在跨场景表征迁移中的有效性，软对比对齐机制能显著缓解假负样本问题。但作者明确指出，由于融合推理需要使用同时刻的64波束功率向量，这些结果应被理解为表征迁移的诊断指标，而非主动波束预测或减少波束扫描的能力声明。

title: Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning
summary: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. Using the exact anchored derivative-norm characterization of the vector-valued Brownian RKHS, we obtain layerwise bounds for domain-preserving scalar linear maps and anchored diffeomorphic activations; the corresponding factors scale as $|W_l|^{1/2}$ and $\|σ_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$, respectively, and do not involve Sobolev smoothness exponents. Because the Sobolev and Brownian results concern different hypothesis spaces, neither is asserted to dominate the other uniformly. We additionally formulate shared operator learning across tasks, prove a finite-rank representer theorem, derive the exact finite-dimensional problem for squared loss, and establish a target-transfer bound when the learned operator is obtained independently of the target sample. Synthetic and MNIST studies examine stabilized Sobolev-inspired and Brownian-inspired complexity proxies; these empirical proxies are not evaluations of the proved bounds for rank-deficient architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将网络层表示为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间上的Koopman复合算子，为深度多输出函数类建立了算子理论的泛化界。在向量值Sobolev RKHS中推导了可逆和宽度扩展单射架构的Rademacher复杂度界；同时分析了Brownian/Cameron-Martin框架下的逐层界。还提出了跨任务共享算子学习、有限秩表示定理、精确有限维问题及目标迁移界，并通过合成和MNIST实验验证了复杂度代理指标。
AI.motivation: 深度学习多输出架构的泛化界通常难以精确描述深度网络中线性映射与激活函数的联合效应。现有方法往往忽略输出耦合维度或依赖特定有限维结构，缺乏对网络层作为复合算子作用下复杂度传播的算子论分析。作者希望通过引入Koopman算子与向量值RKHS理论，建立更精细、可分离各贡献因子的泛化界，并覆盖Sobolev与Brownian两类不同正则性假设下的深层网络。
AI.method: 将网络层表示为向量值RKHS上的Koopman复合算子；在向量值Sobolev RKHS中推导Rademacher复杂度界，界中分离输出耦合贡献（任务矩阵迹）、层间算子范数、Sobolev符号比、行列式因子及线性映射的限制常数；在Brownian/Cameron-Martin框架下利用锚定导数范数的精确刻画，对域保持标量线性映射和锚定微分同胚激活获得逐层界，其因子分别按|W_l|^{1/2}和||σ'_l||_∞^{1/2}缩放；同时提出跨任务共享算子学习、有限秩表示定理、平方损失下的精确有限维问题及目标迁移界。
AI.result: 获得了Sobolev RKHS下的层间分隔式Rademacher复杂度界，以及Brownian regime下不涉及Sobolev光滑指数的逐层界。证明了有限秩表示定理，推导了平方损失下的精确有限维优化问题，并建立了目标样本独立学习算子时的目标迁移界。合成数据和MNIST实验验证了Sobolev与Brownian启发式的复杂度代理指标（注意这些代理并非对秩亏架构下已证明界的直接评估）。
AI.conclusion: 两种分析框架（Sobolev和Brownian）针对不同的假设空间，均提供了有效但不可互相支配的泛化界。该方法为理解深度网络泛化提供了从算子论视角出发的新工具，涵盖输出耦合、层间映射与非线性激活的联合效应，并给出了跨任务学习的理论支撑。

title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models
comment: Accepted to HCMIW at ECCV 2026 (Oral Presentation). Code and demo: https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface
summary:
Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model. However, obtaining accurate 3D motions from monocular videos is challenging, limiting their real-world applicability. To address this issue, we introduce a plug-and-play 2D Motion Interface that enables 3D-pretrained MoLMs to accept 2D motion inputs without modifying or fine-tuning the original models.
  Experiments on public datasets show that our method achieves performance comparable to 3D motion inputs across multiple MoLMs and outperforms training MoLMs from scratch on 2D motions. We further construct a monocular real-world video motion evaluation dataset and introduce a real-video adapter, demonstrating the usefulness of 2D motions over 3D motions under the evaluated monocular pose-estimation setting. These results suggest that 2D motion provides a practical interface for deploying MoLMs in real-world motion understanding settings. Code is available at https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的2D运动接口，使基于3D运动预训练的运动语言模型（MoLMs）能够直接接受2D运动输入，无需修改或微调原模型，从而解决单目视频中获取准确3D运动困难的现实应用问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的运动语言模型通常依赖对3D运动数据进行token化后输入语言模型进行处理，但从单目视频中准确获取3D运动数据具有很大挑战性，这限制了MoLMs在现实世界中的应用。作者希望克服这一瓶颈，使MoLMs能够在3D数据难以获取的现实场景中依然发挥作用。
AI.method: 提出一个plug-and-play的2D Motion Interface，使得3D预训练的MoLMs无需修改或微调即可接收2D运动输入。此外，作者构建了一个单目真实世界视频运动评估数据集，并引入一个real-video adapter来适配实际单目视频中的2D运动估计。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多个MoLMs上达到了与3D运动输入相当的性能，并且优于直接在2D运动上从头训练MoLMs的效果。在作者构建的单目真实视频评估数据集上，2D运动在单目姿态估计场景下比3D运动更具实用性。
AI.conclusion: 2D运动为MoLMs在现实世界运动理解场景中的部署提供了一种实用的接口方案，能够在3D运动数据难以获取的情况下保持模型性能，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗性K臂老虎机中对遗忘损失序列的二阶路径长度遗憾，证明Bubeck等人[2019]的相同算法经过更精细的分析可达𝒪(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q_{∞,2})))的期望遗憾，匹配下界至对数因子与加法项，并利用自适应重启方案去除了对Q_{∞,2}的已知性需求。
AI.motivation: Bubeck等人[2019]设计了达到一阶路径长度遗憾𝒪(K+√(KQ_{∞,1}))的算法，但留下了在bandit反馈下是否可实现𝒪(poly(K)√(1+Q_{∞,2}))二阶路径长度遗憾的开放问题。本文旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 作者对Bubeck等人[2019]的原始算法进行了更深入、更精细的分析，证明其在已知二阶路径长度Q_{∞,2}时即可达到最优遗憾界。此外，通过设计一个自适应重启方案（其路径长度估计器具有一致有界增量），去除了对Q_{∞,2}的已知性假设。
AI.result: 在已知Q_{∞,2}时，算法达到𝒪(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q_{∞,2)}))期望遗憾；在未知Q_{∞,2}时，通过自适应重启方案也能达到相同量级的遗憾，匹配Ω(√(KQ_{∞,2}))下界（至对数因子与加法项）。
AI.conclusion: 本文肯定地回答了Bubeck等人[2019]留下的开放问题，表明其算法本身就具备达到二阶路径长度遗憾的能力，且该遗憾界在order意义上最优。

title: Spatial Temporal Synergy: Balancing Change and Invariance in Text Driven 3D Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the structural consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches struggle to balance text-responsive "change" and inertial "invariance". They often rely on coarse spatial constraints and rigid uniform time assumptions, leading to spatial motion distortions and the destruction of intrinsic physical rhythms during variable-length editing. To handle these challenges, we propose Change and Invariance Motion Editing (CIME), a unified framework that comprehensively decouples change and invariance into spatial pose and temporal rhythm dimensions. For spatial poses, our method integrates an omni-supervised positive-negative learning mechanism comprising hierarchical retrospective feature supervision, subtle motion preservation, and triplet-based semantic alignment. For temporal rhythms, we introduce the Riemannian Non-uniform Integral Manifold Mapping (RNIMM) module, which achieves high-fidelity reproduction of physical beats in the edited text via kinematics-aware non-uniform timestamps. Extensive experiments on the MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment datasets demonstrate that CIME achieves state-of-the-art performance in editing alignment and structural fidelity, validating the effectiveness of our unified architecture. Our source codes and models have been released at: github.com/ZhenwuShi/CIME.git

AI.tldr: 提出CIME框架，通过将"变化"与"不变性"分别解耦到空间姿态和时间节奏两个维度，结合全监督正负学习机制与黎曼非均匀积分流形映射模块，解决文本驱动人体运动编辑中变化与不变性的平衡问题，在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的人体运动编辑方法难以平衡文本响应的"变化"与原始运动的"不变性"。它们依赖粗粒度的空间约束和刚性均匀时间假设，导致可变长度编辑中出现空间运动畸变和内在物理节奏被破坏的问题。
AI.method: 提出CIME统一框架，将变化与不变性解耦为空间姿态和时间节奏两个维度。空间姿态方面，提出全监督正负学习机制，包含层级回顾特征监督、细微运动保留和基于三元组的语义对齐。时间节奏方面，提出黎曼非均匀积分流形映射（RNIMM）模块，通过运动学感知的非均匀时间戳实现对编辑文本中物理节拍的高保真再现。
AI.result: 在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上的大量实验表明，CIME在编辑对齐度和结构保真度方面达到了最先进的性能，验证了统一架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CIME通过空间与时间两个维度的系统解耦，有效解决了文本驱动运动编辑中"变化"与"不变性"的固有矛盾，为可变长度运动编辑提供了高保真的解决方案。

title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
summary: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出RISEN方法，通过跨模态检索构建"孪生分子"表示并对子结构与文本进行相似度感知对比学习，解决分子-文本对齐中细粒度语义关系被忽视的问题，在基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 以往分子-文本对齐方法通常结合图结构挖掘与对比学习，但忽视了子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致下游任务性能次优。
AI.method: RISEN核心思想是为每个子结构构建潜在孪生分子：基于跨模态检索获取相关文本描述并采样共享相似描述的分子，通过注意力池化聚合得到孪生潜在表示并与原子结构融合；同时衡量子结构与文本间的相似度，以软阈值方式指导跨模态对比学习。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了RISEN相较现有基准方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态检索增强子结构表示并结合相似度感知的软阈值对比学习，RISEN有效提升了分子-文本对齐在下游任务中的性能。

title: Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing for HDR Robot Vision
summary: Achieving reliable single-shot high dynamic range (HDR) imaging under extreme illumination conditions remains a long-standing challenge, yet no comprehensive benchmark exist for evaluating HDR perception in multi-sensor robotic systems. To fill this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset collected via a custom robotic vision platform and an iPhone 13 Pro: 121 real-world scenes spanning modest and ultra-high dynamic range conditions, alongside 20 synthetic video sequences from the CARLA simulator. As a reference pipeline for this dataset, we propose Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing (DMEB), a single-shot HDR method that distributes drastically different exposures across multi-view low-bit-depth cameras and fuses them via depth-guided confidence-aware fusion. Evaluations on our dataset show that DMEB establishes a strong reference point and highlight the promise of this sensor configuration for robust HDR perception in diverse multi-camera and depth sensor system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向多传感器机器人系统的HDR感知基准数据集（包含121个真实场景和20个合成视频序列），并提出了DMEB单次曝光HDR方法，通过多视角低比特深度相机配合深度引导的置信度感知融合实现极端光照下的高动态范围成像。
AI.motivation: 在极端光照条件下实现可靠的单次高动态范围（HDR）成像一直是长期挑战，但现有研究中缺乏针对多传感器机器人系统HDR感知的综合基准评估数据集，这一空白制约了该领域的方法比较与发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模数据集：通过定制的机器人视觉平台和iPhone 13 Pro采集121个涵盖中低与超高动态范围条件的真实场景，并从CARLA模拟器生成20个合成视频序列。2) 提出DMEB（深度引导的多视角曝光包围）参考管线：在多视角低比特深度相机上分配差异化曝光，通过深度引导的置信度感知融合策略实现单次拍摄HDR成像。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上的评估表明，DMEB建立了强有力的参考基准，验证了多相机与深度传感器配置在多样场景下实现稳健HDR感知的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了多传感器机器人HDR感知基准的空白，同时证明了深度引导的多视角曝光包围策略是单次HDR成像的有效技术路径，为该领域后续研究提供了数据和方法参考。

title: Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE
summary: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.

AI.tldr: 提出BRIDGE框架，将模型压缩重新定义为一种建设性的边界搜索问题，通过反向再生长策略（先驱动模型至极稀疏状态暴露崩溃区域，再选择性再生长关键结构）来恢复性能，实验表明该方法在CNN和Transformer上均能有效扩展压缩极限并保持稳定性能。
AI.motivation: 传统基于剪枝的压缩方法在超过一定稀疏度阈值后会遭遇突发的性能崩溃，导致难以确定模型可行的压缩极限。现有前向剪枝方法难以准确预测和恢复处于崩溃边缘的模型。
AI.method: 提出BRIDGE反向再生长框架：首先将模型驱动至极稀疏状态以暴露崩溃区域，然后采用分层再生长策略（包括粗粒度的层选择和细粒度的再生长参数选择）选择性恢复关键结构以重建性能。该方法将压缩问题重构为构建性的边界搜索问题，区别于传统前向剪枝范式。
AI.result: 在CNN和Transformer架构上均能有效恢复处于崩溃边缘的模型，展示出架构无关性。非结构化剪枝场景下性能提升最高达1.49%，结构化剪枝场景下最高达4.77%。
AI.conclusion: 反向再生长策略能有效扩展模型的压缩极限，同时保持稳定的性能表现，为解决模型压缩中的性能崩溃问题提供了新思路。

title: Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the LNCS proceedings of ICONIP 2026
summary: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) suffers from cross-modal discrepancies and limited discriminative capabilities, leading to suboptimal recognition performance. Current approaches exhibit limitations in semantic mining, cross-modal fusion and feature constraints. To tackle these challenges, we propose MDCRNet, a Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network that enhances cross-modal feature learning and discriminative metric learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hierarchical Learning Module (HLM) containing four Hierarchical Decomposed Convolution Attention (HDCA) modules, each equipped with lightweight channel attention and multi-scale spatial perception blocks to capture multi-scale spatial dependencies. Moreover, we develop a Joint Discriminative Metric Loss (JDML) incorporating a novel Granularity Discriminative Loss (GDL) that simultaneously optimizes intra-identity compactness and inter-identity separability across modalities. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets demonstrate that MDCRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-zms/MDCRNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDCRNet，一种用于可见光-红外跨模态行人重识别的多尺度分解卷积细化网络。通过引入层级学习模块（HLM）和联合判别度量损失（JDML），在SYSU-MM01和RegDB两个基准数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: VI-ReID面临跨模态差异和判别能力有限的问题，现有方法在语义挖掘、跨模态融合和特征约束方面存在不足，导致识别性能欠佳。
AI.method: 提出MDCRNet，包含：(1) 层级学习模块（HLM），由四个层级分解卷积注意力（HDCA）模块构成，每个模块配备轻量级通道注意力和多尺度空间感知模块以捕获多尺度空间依赖；(2) 联合判别度量损失（JDML），其中引入新颖的粒度判别损失（GDL），同步优化跨模态的类内紧凑性和类间可分性。
AI.result: 在SYSU-MM01和RegDB两个标准基准数据集上进行了大量实验，MDCRNet在两个基准上均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: MDCRNet通过多尺度分解卷积与判别度量学习的结合，有效增强了跨模态特征学习和判别性度量学习，在可见光-红外行人重识别任务上取得了显著效果。

title: RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: RagGAD是一种基于理性感知的条件高斯混合归一化流的无监督图异常检测框架，通过自适应理性解耦器将节点间关系中的稳定理性与虚假相关分离，并将理性进一步分解为鲁棒和脆弱组分，以建模正常和异常节点的复杂分布，最终将异常识别为结构感知分布空间中的低密度区域。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测方法严重依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假关联，也无法捕捉正常节点的多样性行为，在复杂真实场景中鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: RagGAD框架包含三个核心模块：(1)自适应理性解耦器，用于从节点间关系中解耦稳定理性与虚假相关性；(2)将稳定理性分解为鲁棒与脆弱组分；(3)整合理性-非理性高斯混合建模与鲁棒-脆弱理性混合学习策略，在结构感知分布空间中通过低密度区域识别异常。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RagGAD优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓解虚假同质相关性并接纳正常模式的异质性，RagGAD有效解决了同质性假设带来的鲁棒性问题，实现了更优的图异常检测性能。

title: TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling
summary: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.

AI.tldr: TR-GS是一种基于高斯泼溅（3DGS）的稀疏视角CT体积渲染框架，使用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元，并结合射线置信度模型和置信度引导的三维小波正则化，在合成与真实数据集上优于多数代表性基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高保真三维医学可视化对临床评估和手术规划至关重要，但稀疏视角CT虽然能减少投影需求和辐射暴露，却可能引入结构伪影与重建不确定性。现有基于标准高斯基元的CT方法在稀疏采集下对不可靠观测敏感，因此需要一种更稳健的显式体积表示方法。
AI.method: TR-GS框架包含三个核心创新：(1)用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元，其重尾特性对异常观测更具鲁棒性；(2)引入射线置信度模型，根据局部射线的可观测性动态调节基元的自由度（degrees of freedom）；(3)采用置信度引导的三维小波正则化，在高频细节保留与噪声抑制之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS在大多数评估设置下优于代表性基线方法，在其余情况下仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TR-GS生成的体积表示可用于下游医学多媒体应用，包括基于扩展现实（XR）的视觉化和交互式临床渲染。

title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
summary: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors. We evaluate CoLiG-ICA using resting-state fMRI data from the UCLA-CNP dataset and compare it with conventional constrained ICA in estimating template-linked components, discovering additional free components, improving component independence, and capturing subject-level variability beyond the shared group prior. Compared with MOO-ICAR, CoLiG-ICA showed significantly lower intercomponent spatial dependence, indicating improved subject-level component independence, and significantly reduced motion-related variance in the template-linked components. Additionally, in a schizophrenia-only group analysis, CoLiG-ICA identified three additional resting-state networks beyond the 53 template-linked NeuroMark components: one sensorimotor and two visual networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)算法，在Group ICA 2.0框架下联合估计模板连接、队列特异性和受试者特异性的脑网络。该算法结合ICA空间分解、copula依赖建模和深度学习优化，解决了传统gICA仅能识别群体共享成分、无法捕捉个体间异质性的局限性。在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上验证，CoLiG-ICA相比MOO-ICAR具有更低的网络间空间依赖性和更低的运动相关方差，并在精神分裂症分析中额外发现3个超出NeuroMark模板的网络。
AI.motivation: 传统组独立成分分析(gICA)主要识别受试者间共享的网络成分，这种群体层面的假设限制了对个体特有或亚组特异的脑网络的恢复，降低了对临床神经影像数据中受试者间异质性的敏感性。因此需要一种能够在统一模型中同时估计模板连接、群体特有和个体特有网络的方法。
AI.method: CoLiG-ICA在Group ICA 2.0框架下，将基于ICA的空间分解、基于copula的依赖建模与深度学习优化相结合。该算法将受试者分解链接到共享模板，同时联合估计队列唯一和受试者唯一的源成分，在保持模板约束ICA的一致性和可解释性的同时，允许参考网络之外的自由成分存在。
AI.result: 在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上，与MOO-ICAR相比，CoLiG-ICA的受试者级成分间空间依赖性显著更低（成分独立性更好），模板连接成分的运动相关方差显著减少。在仅精神分裂症患者的群体分析中，CoLiG-ICA在53个模板连接的NeuroMark成分之外识别出3个额外的静息态网络：1个感觉运动网络和2个视觉网络。
AI.conclusion: CoLiG-ICA有效地捕捉了传统群体先验无法表征的个体变异性，在保持模板约束ICA优势的同时，通过发现额外自由成分提升了成分独立性和对个体异质性的敏感性，为临床神经影像中群体-个体层面的脑网络分析提供了更优的解决方案。

title: SafeGesture: Evaluating Fine-Grained Hand Gesture Understanding in Vision-Language Models through Scenario-Conditioned Safety Interpretation
comment: 14 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures. Code and benchmark resources available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/SafeGesture
summary: Open-weight and frontier vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on general image understanding, but their ability to interpret fine-grained hand gestures in safety-critical operational contexts remains largely unexamined. We introduce SafeGesture, a benchmark that evaluates whether a model can infer scenario-appropriate safety actions from hand gestures. It pairs six HaGRID gestures with eight operational scenarios for 4,800 items and evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, InternVL2-8B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and GPT-4o. Results reveal a perception-reasoning decoupling: GPT-4o achieves 98.4% gesture accuracy but 53.3% safety accuracy, while Qwen2.5-VL reaches 84.9% and 39.5%, yielding gaps of 45.0 and 45.4 percentage points. Four of five models rarely or never use the uncertainty label, and failure directions differ substantially across models. Accuracy also obscures label bias: a scenario-majority policy with no visual input reaches 58.3%, above every evaluated model, while only GPT-4o exceeds this prior under macro-F1. Visual input improves safety accuracy by 11.2 to 30.2 percentage points, but providing the ground-truth gesture as text improves performance by only 0.4 to 3.2 points, and no model exceeds 56.2%. These results indicate that the main bottleneck is scenario-conditioned safety reasoning rather than gesture recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeGesture基准，评估视觉语言模型在手势安全场景理解中的能力，发现模型存在感知-推理解耦：即使手势识别准确率高，安全推理准确率也大幅偏低，瓶颈在于场景条件下的安全推理而非手势识别本身。
AI.motivation: 现有开放权重和前缘视觉语言模型在通用图像理解上表现良好，但在安全关键操作情境中解读细粒度手部手势的能力尚未被系统检验。作者旨在填补这一空白，评估模型是否能够从手势中推断出场景适当的安全动作。
AI.method: 构建SafeGesture基准，将六种HaGRID手势与八个操作场景配对形成4,800个测试项，评估五个模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B、InternVL2-8B、Phi-3.5-Vision、GPT-4o），并设置多种对照实验（视觉输入、纯文本手势、无视觉输入的场景多数策略）以分析瓶颈来源。
AI.result: GPT-4o实现98.4%手势准确率但安全准确率仅53.3%，Qwen2.5-VL分别达到84.9%和39.5%，差距分别达45.0和45.4个百分点；四个模型几乎不使用不确定性标签；无视觉输入的场景多数策略达58.3%，超过所有评估模型；视觉输入可提升安全准确率11.2至30.2个百分点，但提供地面真实手势文本仅提升0.4至3.2个百分点，且无模型超过56.2%。
AI.conclusion: 主要瓶颈在于场景条件下的安全推理而非手势识别。即使模型能准确识别手势，也未能有效地将其与场景条件结合进行推理。现有模型的安全推理能力不足以满足安全关键型操作环境的需求。

title: AdROD: HyperNetwork-based Adversarially Robust Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Camera-based object detectors are vulnerable to physical adversarial attacks designed to suppress detections. While adversarial training and input purification offer some protection, they often overfit to specific attack distributions and fail on adaptive adversaries. This paper presents AdROD, an embedded, stochastic ensemble defense software designed for autonomous driving. AdROD employs {\em low-rank HyperNetworks}, which require only 1.6\% of the parameter footprint of standard HyperNetworks, to generate diverse detectors at a per-frame rate, making it impractical for attackers to obtain the deployed detectors in time. To further improve adversarial robustness, AdROD incorporates a novel \emph{functional diversity} mechanism, which couples stochastic weight updates with unique input-space transformations. We design two serving modes of AdROD that strike different trade-offs between robustness and runtime overhead: AdROD-I, a continuous protection mode for maximum resilience that leverages inter-detector disagreement to recover compromised detections, and AdROD-II, an on-demand mode triggered by kinematic discontinuities in object tracking. Through comprehensive evaluation with synthetic benchmarks, physically deployed adversarial patches, and end-to-end safety tests in the OpenCDA co-simulator, AdROD outperforms five baseline defenses and exhibits superior generalizability compared with the evaluated adversarial-training baselines, while maintaining real-time performance for safely stopping the vehicle at a stop sign instrumented with adversarial patches.

AI.tldr: AdROD是一种面向自动驾驶的嵌入式随机集成防御框架，利用低秩HyperNetwork（仅需标准1.6%参数）在每帧生成多样化的检测器，使攻击者难以实时获取部署的模型。其核心创新包括功能多样性机制（随机权重更新配合输入空间变换）和两种服务模式（AdROD-I连续保护和AdROD-II按需触发），在合成基准、物理对抗补丁和OpenCDA端到端安全测试中均优于五种基线防御，并展现出比对抗训练基线更强的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的目标检测器容易受到物理对抗攻击的干扰，导致检测被抑制。现有的对抗训练和输入净化方法往往过拟合特定攻击分布，在自适应攻击者面前失效，亟需一种更具鲁棒性和泛化能力的防御方案。
AI.method: AdROD采用低秩HyperNetwork（仅需标准1.6%的参数）为每帧生成多样化的检测器，形成随机集成防御；引入功能多样性机制，将随机权重更新与独特的输入空间变换耦合；设计了两种服务模式：AdROD-I（连续保护模式，利用检测器间不一致性恢复受损检测，追求最大鲁棒性）和AdROD-II（按需模式，由物体跟踪中的运动学不连续性触发）。
AI.result: 在合成基准、物理部署的对抗补丁和OpenCDA联合仿真器的端到端安全测试中，AdROD优于五种基线防御，相比对抗训练基线展现出更优的泛化能力，同时保持实时性能，能够在装有对抗补丁的停车标志处安全停车。
AI.conclusion: AdROD通过嵌入式的随机集成机制有效应对物理对抗攻击，在鲁棒性、泛化性和实时性之间取得了良好平衡，为自动驾驶场景下的对抗防御提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Representation Is Not Enough: Body-Localized Thermal Evidence for Contactless Stress and Craving Sensing in Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Removing wearables from physiological monitoring also removes their supervision: the signal indicating where and when a stress response occurred. Contactless stress sensing therefore becomes a weakly supervised evidence-localization problem, where a clip-level label must be traced to the body regions and moments that produced it. We address this with FABLE-Therm, a weakly supervised architecture that preserves localized evidence across body regions, time, and encoder-specific representations until the final decision. FABLE-Therm fuses frozen foundation-model encoders at the embedding level, with theory explaining why localized fusion can outperform feature concatenation and prediction averaging. We study this problem in opioid use disorder (OUD), where stress is a major relapse trigger and sustained wearable use can be difficult during early recovery. Using fixed thermal video, FABLE-Therm achieves 0.938 AUROC on held-out participants, and its learned representation transfers to self-reported craving, providing, to our knowledge, the first evidence that craving can be recovered from contactless thermal video. Localized evidence also enables participant-level analysis of deployment failure. We find that improving representation alone is insufficient for equitable deployment: additional data from the underserved group would recover only about half of the cohort gap, while the remainder reflects person-to-person heterogeneity. This modality-agnostic decomposition applies to models with identifiable subpopulations. Together with the first cohort-structured contactless thermal OUD benchmark, our results show that preserving localized evidence supports both accurate sensing and principled analysis of who a model fails and why.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE-Therm，一种弱监督热成像压力感知架构，通过保留跨身体区域、时间及编码器特定表示的局部证据来实现接触式压力传感的溯源定位。在阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）场景中达到0.938 AUROC，并首次证明可恢复接触式热视频中的渴求感信号。同时揭示了仅改进表示不足以实现公平部署，群体差距部分源于人群异质性。
AI.motivation: 移除可穿戴设备进行生理监测时，也失去了其监督信号——即压力反应发生位置和时间的指示。因此接触式压力感知成为一个弱监督的证据定位问题：必须将片段级标签溯源到产生该标签的身体区域和时刻。此外，OUD患者早期康复期难以持续佩戴可穿戴设备，而压力是复发的主要诱因，因此需要接触式且可溯源的监测方案。
AI.method: FABLE-Therm采用弱监督架构，在嵌入层面融合多种冻结的基座模型（foundation model）编码器，而非在特征拼接或预测平均层面融合。理论解释了为何局部融合优于特征拼接和预测平均。架构保留跨身体区域、时间及编码器特定表示的局部证据直到最终决策层，从而实现证据定位。
AI.result: 在固定热视频下，FABLE-Therm在留出参与者上达到0.938 AUROC。其学习到的表示可迁移到自我报告的渴求感（craving），提供了首次从接触式热视频恢复渴求证据。局部证据还支持参与者层面的部署失败分析，发现仅改进表示不足以实现公平部署：从服务不足群体补充数据仅能恢复约一半的群体差距，其余反映个体间异质性。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了第一个群体结构化的接触式热成像OUD基准。结果表明保留局部证据既支持精确感知，也支持对模型失败对象和原因的原则性分析。这种模态无关的分解方法适用于具有可识别亚群体的模型。

title: NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption
summary: Post-hoc Graph Neural Network (GNN) explainers commonly follow a Perturb-Query paradigm, inferring the importance of graph elements based on queried predictions to perturbed inputs. However, such perturbations often introduce substantial distribution shift, undermining the reliability of the queried predictions used to derive explanations. While existing efforts mainly improve perturbed graphs or stabilize model predictions on them, we revisit the perturbation mechanism itself. We show that the widely used Element-wise Masking(EM) suppresses edge-induced messages toward zero, causing deterministic scale contraction that accumulates across message-passing layers, a phenomenon we term Scale Drift. Consequently, prediction changes under EM may conflate information corruption with deviations in propagation scale. As a scale-stable alternative to EM, we introduce Noise Corruption (NC), which perturbs each message through matched-norm random-direction corruption while preserving the expected squared message norm. Building on NC, we propose NICE, a Noise Corruption-based explanation framework, which learns a Stochastic Restoration Boundary (SRB) under NC-induced uncertainty, balancing target-prediction restoration against compactness. Furthermore, Boundary-Integrated Gradient (BIG) converts this boundary into edge attributions by accumulating each edge's contribution to reducing restoration risk along the restoration path. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate stronger explanation performance and model faithfulness while confirming that NC substantially reduces the Scale Drift induced by masking.

AI.tldr: 本文针对事后图神经网络（GNN）解释器中的Perturb-Query范式，指出常用的Element-wise Masking（EM）扰动会导致"Scale Drift"（尺度漂移）问题——即边消息被抑制为零后，在消息传递层间累积确定性尺度收缩，使预测变化混淆了信息破坏与传播尺度偏差。作者提出Noise Corruption（NC）作为尺度稳定的替代方案，并构建了NICE解释框架（含Stochastic Restoration Boundary和Boundary-Integrated Gradient），在多个基准上验证了更强的解释性能与模型忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有事后GNN解释方法基于Perturb-Query范式推断图元素重要性，但扰动会引入显著的分布偏移，损害基于查询预测所得解释的可靠性。已有工作主要从改进扰动图或稳定模型预测入手，作者则重新审视扰动机制本身，发现EM扰动导致Scale Drift问题，亟需一种尺度稳定的扰动方案。
AI.method: （1）理论分析揭示EM的尺度漂移现象；（2）提出Noise Corruption（NC）扰动方法：对每条消息施加匹配范数的随机方向扰动，同时保持期望平方消息范数不变，作为尺度稳定的EM替代；（3）构建NICE框架，在NC引起的随机性下学习Stochastic Restoration Boundary（SRB），平衡目标预测恢复与解释紧凑性；（4）提出Boundary-Integrated Gradient（BIG），沿恢复路径累积每条边对降低恢复风险的贡献，将边界转化为边归因分数。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，NICE相比现有方法取得了更强的解释性能和更高的模型忠实度，同时验证了NC能显著减少EM引起的Scale Drift。
AI.conclusion: 扰动机制本身（而非仅仅扰动图或模型稳定性）是影响事后GNN解释可靠性的关键因素；NC作为尺度稳定的扰动方式，配合SRB与BIG，能有效规避Scale Drift并提升解释质量。

title: TISC: A Text-Driven Image Semantic Communication System for Faithful Reconstruction
summary: Generative image semantic communication converts an image into a text description and then performs text-to-image reconstruction at the receiver via diffusion-based generative models. This paradigm has attracted broad attention due to its extremely low bandwidth cost. However, existing methods still face two critical bottlenecks across image-to-text (I2T) semantic extraction at the transmitter and text-to-image (T2I) semantic reconstruction at the receiver: (i) semantic loss and distortion in I2T, where holistic image descriptions may omit fine-grained object attributes and spatial-position information, causing the generated text to deviate from the original image semantics; and (ii) insufficient semantic faithfulness in T2I, where even with the same semantically faithful text description, different initial noise settings may lead diffusion-based reconstruction to produce images with different levels of semantic consistency with the original image. These issues jointly limit the semantic faithfulness of image reconstruction. To address them, we propose TISC, a text-driven image semantic communication framework tailored for faithful reconstruction. TISC incorporates two key designs: (1) Tree-Structured Attribute Semantic Extraction (TSASE), which decomposes semantic extraction into global scene, background, and object-level attribute descriptions, covering spatial position, shape/pose, color, material, and other physical attributes for each detected object; and (2) an Initial Noise Optimization (INO) mechanism, which selects an initial noise seed at the transmitter according to a comprehensive similarity score that jointly considers visual and semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets show that TSASE improves object-position recovery and semantic description faithfulness, while the INO parameter study supports the adopted configuration for noise selection.

AI.tldr: 提出TISC框架，通过树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE）和初始噪声优化（INO）机制，解决生成式图像语义通信中I2T语义提取损失和T2I语义重建保真度不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像语义通信虽带宽成本极低，但面临两个关键瓶颈：其一，整体性图像描述（I2T）容易丢失细粒度对象属性与空间位置信息，导致生成文本偏离原始图像语义；其二，即使文本语义保真，不同初始噪声设置也会使扩散模型重建出的图像与原始图像语义一致性产生差异，共同限制了图像重建的语义保真度。
AI.method: TISC框架包含两个核心设计：(1) TSASE（树状结构属性语义提取），将语义提取分解为全局场景、背景和对象级属性描述三个层次，覆盖每个检测对象的空间位置、形状/姿态、颜色、材质及其他物理属性；(2) INO（初始噪声优化）机制，在发射端根据联合考虑视觉与语义一致性的综合相似度评分选择合适的初始噪声种子。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，TSASE提升了对象位置恢复能力和语义描述保真度，INO参数研究支持了所采用的噪声选择配置。
AI.conclusion: TISC通过层次化的树状语义提取和噪声种子优化，有效缓解了I2T语义损失与T2I语义不一致问题，提升了生成式图像语义通信中的语义保真重建能力。

title: OceanLight: Efficient Global Ocean Forecasting via Geometry-Adaptive Unstructured Mesh Representation
summary: Reliable global ocean forecasting is critical for climate monitoring, marine navigation, and extreme event early warning. Physics-based ocean forecasting models impose prohibitive computational costs, while existing deep learning approaches predominantly rely on structured-grid architectures, incurring unnecessary computation on masked land cells and enforcing uniform resolution across dynamically heterogeneous ocean regions regardless of local flow complexity. Here we present OceanLight, an efficient global ocean forecasting framework innovatively combining geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh tokenization with a graph neural network (GNN) backbone. OceanLight achieves pointwise forecast accuracy and kinetic energy spectral fidelity exceeding both operational numerical analyses and state-of-the-art AI-based models, while surpassing all AI-based ocean models in geostrophic balance consistency. Furthermore, OceanLight demonstrates reliable mesoscale eddy representation, capturing coherent ocean structures beyond pointwise statistical optimization. These capabilities are delivered with a 62% reduction in GPU memory consumption and 70\% reduction in FLOPs relative to structured-grid baselines. Our unstructured mesh representation establishes a generalizable paradigm for scalable data-driven oceanography.

AI.tldr: OceanLight是一种高效的全球海洋预报框架，创新性地结合了几何自适应非结构化网格令牌化与图神经网络(GNN)主干。它在点级预测精度、动能谱保真度和地转平衡一致性上超越现有数值分析和AI模型，同时减少了62%的GPU内存消耗和70%的FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 传统物理驱动的海洋预报模型计算成本过高，而现有深度学习方法主要依赖结构化网格架构，在掩膜陆地单元上产生不必要的计算，并在动态异质的海洋区域强制使用均匀分辨率，无法适应局部流动复杂性。
AI.method: OceanLight采用几何自适应的非结构化网格进行令牌化（tokenization），将全球海洋划分为分辨率随局部流动复杂度动态变化的网格单元，并以图神经网络作为主干网络进行特征提取和预测。
AI.result: OceanLight在点级预测精度和动能谱保真度上超越操作数值分析和最先进的AI模型，在地转平衡一致性上超越所有AI海洋模型，并能可靠表征中尺度涡旋。同时实现62%的GPU内存缩减和70%的FLOPs削减。
AI.conclusion: 非结构化网格表示建立了可推广的数据驱动海洋学范式，为可扩展的高效海洋预报提供了新路径。

title: Beyond Similarity Matching: Structured Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Referring Segmentation in 3DGS
summary: Open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires a neural model to select Gaussian primitives according to free-form language expressions. Existing 3DGS-based methods usually rely on global text-region similarity, which is weak for queries involving attributes, reference objects, spatial relations, and fine-grained parts. This often causes target-reference confusion, granularity mismatch, part-whole leakage, and relation violations. We propose QAGaussian, a query-adaptive neural reasoning framework for language-guided Gaussian primitive selection. QAGaussian first learns query-conditioned multi-scale Gaussian slots as differentiable candidates whose receptive fields are shaped by the input expression. It then builds a relation-aware slot graph with language-conditioned edge weighting to propagate target-reference, attribute, part-whole, and contextual evidence. A granularity-adaptive router softly combines region-level, object-level, part-level, attribute-aware, and relation-aware mask branches, followed by relation-constrained refinement for spatial, part-whole, attribute, and geometric consistency. QAGaussian is pretrained only on Mosaic3D-5.6M for Gaussian-text alignment and evaluated on independent benchmarks without target-dataset fine-tuning. It achieves 47.2 Avg. mIoU and 63.2 Avg. F1, outperforming the strongest 3DGS referring baseline by 2.7 mIoU points and 2.9 F1 points. It also improves Part-mIoU from 38.6 to 43.4, Rel-mIoU from 44.4 to 50.8, and reduces target-reference confusion from 10.8 to 7.4. These results demonstrate that query-conditioned slot learning, relation-aware graph reasoning, and adaptive routing provide an effective neural modeling strategy for open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3DGS. The code is available at https://github.com/zqeslwyz/QAGaussian.

AI.tldr: QAGaussian是一个面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的开放词汇指代分割框架，通过查询条件多尺度高斯槽、关系感知槽图和粒度自适应路由器来实现语言引导的高斯原语选择，在无需目标数据集微调的情况下达到47.2 Avg. mIoU，超越最强基线2.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS指代分割方法依赖全局文本-区域相似度，在处理包含属性、指代对象、空间关系和细粒度部件的语言查询时表现薄弱，导致目标-指代混淆、粒度不匹配、部分-整体泄漏和关系违背等问题。需要一种查询自适应且能显式建模关系推理的方法来克服这些局限。
AI.method: QAGaussian包含三个核心组件：1）查询条件多尺度高斯槽学习，将可微候选的感知野由输入表达整形；2）关系感知槽图，通过语言条件边权重传播目标-指代、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；3）粒度自适应路由器，软性组合区域级、对象级、部件级、属性感知和关系感知掩码分支，并通过关系约束精修保证空间、部分-整体、属性和几何一致性。该模型仅在Mosaic3D-5.6M上预训练，在独立基准上评估且不做目标数据集微调。
AI.result: QAGaussian在独立基准上取得47.2 Avg. mIoU和63.2 Avg. F1，分别超出最强3DGS指代基线2.7 mIoU和2.9 F1。Part-mIoU从38.6提升至43.4，Rel-mIoU从44.4提升至50.8，目标-指代混淆率从10.8降至7.4。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为开放词汇3DGS指代分割提供了有效的神经建模策略，显著改善了细粒度部件分割、空间关系理解并减少了混淆错误。

title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. As a result, training continues to allocate gradient budget to already-solved objectives instead of focusing on those with greater remaining headroom. We introduce \textbf{Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization} (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This dynamically reallocates optimization effort toward under-optimized objectives while empirically maintaining performance on those that are already well satisfied. We further show that saturation-aware reweighting can reverse the sign of an update, rather than merely rescale its magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-MRPO（饱和感知优势重加权多奖励策略优化）方法，针对基于组相对优势的强化学习在多奖励目标优化中的缺陷：固定权重标量化会导致不同奖励分布的回滚接收相同优势，且所有目标以固定相对权重优化而忽略其饱和程度。SA-MRPO独立标准化每个奖励目标，并根据批次级的饱和估计自适应折扣其贡献，从而将优化资源动态重新分配到欠优化目标上，同时保持已满足目标的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组相对优势的RL方法（如GDPO）在多奖励目标post-training中采用固定加权和进行标量化后再分组标准化，导致两个根本性问题：(1) 具有不同奖励分布的回滚可能获得相同的优势值；(2) 所有目标以固定相对权重优化，不随目标饱和程度调整，导致梯度预算浪费在已解决的目标上。
AI.method: SA-MRPO的核心方法是：对每个奖励目标独立进行标准化（而非先加权求和再标准化），然后根据批次级的目标饱和估计（如当前奖励与最优/目标奖励的接近程度）自适应地折扣每个目标的贡献权重。该方法不仅能缩放更新的幅度，还能在饱和检测到的情况下反转更新的方向（符号反转而非仅幅度缩放）。
AI.result: 在数学推理的2目标和3目标奖励组合中，SA-MRPO在15个基准比较中的12个上优于GDPO的较难正确性目标，在AIME24上最高提升5%。在自适应推理中，SA-MRPO在所有5个基准上提升准确率，平均提升3.8%，AMC23上最高达9.2%。在编码基准上通过率最高提升2.3%。在所有设置中，较容易的目标均保持在已满足的水平附近。
AI.conclusion: SA-MRPO通过饱和感知的优势重加权机制，能够在多奖励强化学习post-training中动态地将优化努力重新分配给尚未充分优化的目标，而不会牺牲已饱和目标的性能。该方法在数学推理、自适应推理和编码等多个领域的基准上均一致性地优于基线方法GDPO，验证了饱和感知重加权策略在提升较难目标性能方面的有效性。

title: Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: Nexus通过整合稀疏架构（MoE前馈层）、线性复杂度注意力（gated DeltaNet）和低比特量化（per-expert低比特训练）来解决扩散/流匹配模型在高分辨率生成和边缘部署中的计算与内存瓶颈，在保持与SDXL、SD3相当生成质量的同时显著提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型在文生图领域取得了显著进展，但高计算量、二次方复杂度和巨大的内存占用严重阻碍了高分辨率图像合成和边缘设备部署，亟需一种在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算与内存开销的方法。
AI.method: Nexus整合三种互补技术：1）MoE（混合专家）前馈层实现稀疏激活的稀疏架构；2）gated DeltaNet注意力机制将复杂度从二次方降为线性；3）per-expert低比特训练实现低比特量化以减少内存占用。三种方法通过联合优化协同工作。
AI.result: 在COCO和LAION数据集上的实验表明，Nexus在实现显著更高的推理效率的同时，生成质量可与SDXL、SD3等主流模型相媲美。
AI.conclusion: Nexus证明了稀疏架构、线性注意力和低比特量化三者联合优化的可行性，能够在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅提升扩散模型的推理效率，为高分辨率生成和边缘部署提供了有效的解决方案。

title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design
summary: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($κ_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $κ^2$ to $κ$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K to 0.55 K. Second, because optimization leaves the training distribution, we propose a self-improving framework: a hotspot trust gate sends flagged placements to a reference solver, and the surrogate incrementally retrains on the refined solutions, keeping an update only when it improves held-out validation error. On a multi-die benchmark, the surrogate-true peak gap on the returned design falls from 1.12 K to 0.11 K, matching a solve-at-every-step optimizer while running $56\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: DeepOHeat-v2通过离散化物理损失（能量形式+矩阵预条件优化器）解决高对比度多die 3D集成电路中不连续电导率和病态条件导致的训练失败问题，并引入基于热点信任门控的自改进框架，使代理模型在全栈优化中保持准确，峰值温度误差从1.12 K降至0.11 K且快56倍。
AI.motivation: 热感知的3D多die集成电路优化需要对大量设计进行代价高昂的热方程求解。虽然DeepOHeat-v1已实现快速且可信的算子学习代理，但它仅适用于低对比度几何。高对比度多die堆叠会破坏它：材料界面处不连续电导率使连续物理损失定义失效，而病态离散化（κ≈6×10⁴）使强形式损失无法通过一阶优化收敛。因此需要新方法同时克服这两个根本性障碍。
AI.method: DeepOHeat-v2提出两项核心创新：（1）在离散化物理损失上训练，天然处理不连续性；采用能量形式将预测空间损失海森矩阵的条件数从κ²降至κ，并用矩阵预条件优化器将平均峰值温度误差从30K以上降至0.55K。（2）由于优化会偏离训练分布，引入自改进框架：热点信任门将标记的放置发送到参考求解器，代理模型在精化解上增量重训练，仅在改进了留出验证误差时才接受更新。
AI.result: 在多die基准测试上，返回设计的代理-真实峰值温度间隙从1.12K降至0.11K，与逐步求解优化器性能相当，同时运行速度快56倍。
AI.conclusion: DeepOHeat-v2成功使基于物理训练的算子学习代理在高对比度多die 3D IC优化中同时保持速度和准确性，突破了此前低对比度几何的限制，为无标签数据的物理驱动代理模型在复杂真实场景中的应用铺平了道路。

title: SUGFW+: An Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting Framework for Cold Start Active Adaptation of SAM in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Cold Start Active Learning (CSAL) is important in improving the performance of a medical image segmentation model with low annotation budget by querying a small subset for annotation from an unlabeled training set. Existing CSAL methods typically rely on inefficient dataset-specific Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to map the unlabeled images into a feature space for sample selection. Recently, the advent of foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offer a promising alternative as the pre-trained model can provide strong generalizable feature embeddings, and allow high performance in downstream tasks after fine-tuning (adaptation). However, how to systematically exploit SAM's inherent embeddings for cold-start sample selection during adaptation with low annotation budget remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an extended SAM-based Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting (SUGFW+) framework for CSAL and adaptation of SAM. Specifically, it leverages the SAM for Patch-level Feature and Uncertainty Calculation (PFUC), and introduces a Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) module that aggregates patch-level embeddings into highly discriminative, uncertainty-aware image-level features. These features are then utilized by a Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) strategy to combine diversity and uncertainty during sample selection. Unlike prior CSAL methods that decouple sample selection from model training, SUGFW+ tightly integrates these two stages via an Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) process of SAM in model training. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that SUGFW+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing CSAL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HiLab-git/SUGFW-plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SUGFW+框架，利用SAM（Segment Anything Model）的预训练嵌入特征用于冷启动主动学习（CSAL）中的医学图像分割模型采样与微调，通过不确定性感知的补丁级特征加权、全局判别表示、聚类与不确定性结合的贪婪选择策略，以及不确定性提示微调过程，在四个公共数据集上取得了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CSAL方法依赖数据集特定的自监督学习（SSL）来映射未标注图像到特征空间，效率低下；尽管SAM等基础模型能提供强泛化能力的预训练嵌入特征，但如何系统地利用SAM的固有嵌入在低标注预算下进行冷启动样本选择与微调适配仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: SUGFW+框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用SAM进行补丁级特征和不确定性计算（PFUC）；(2) 引入补丁级全局判别表示（PGDR）模块，将补丁级嵌入聚合成高判别性、不确定性感知的图像级特征；(3) 采用基于聚类与不确定性的贪婪选择策略（GSCU），同时结合样本多样性和不确定性；此外，通过不确定性提示微调（UPFT）过程将样本选择与模型训练紧密整合，而非将二者解耦。
AI.result: 在四个公共医学图像数据集上的大量实验表明，SUGFW+相对于现有CSAL方法取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SUGFW+成功证明了基础模型SAM的预训练嵌入可以显著提升冷启动主动学习中样本选择的有效性，并且将样本选择与模型微调紧密集成的设计优于传统的解耦式方法。

title: Towards Reasonable Molecular Structure Elucidation from Infrared Spectroscopy with Chemical Feedback
summary: Infrared (IR) spectra provide characteristic signals of molecular structure, which are often interpreted by experts via functional-group identification or library matching, making the process time-consuming and ambiguous.
