Recent machine learning methods have made progress in molecular structure elucidation using molecular formulas and IR spectra. However, these models often infer unreasonable candidate molecular structures, including top-ranked predictions. More specifically, the molecular formula implied by a candidate structure often fails to match the input molecular formula, and the candidate's theoretical IR spectrum is often inconsistent with the observed IR spectrum. To address these issues, we propose Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO), a general and plug-and-play chemical feedback-driven preference optimization framework for molecular structure elucidation. FIRMPO incorporates chemical feedback as preference signals based on exact molecular formula matching and IR spectral consistency to guide reasonable structure predictions. Unlike generic preference optimization methods, FIRMPO is tailored to molecular structure elucidation while remaining model-agnostic, enabling it to be readily integrated with different structure prediction models in this class. This encourages models to prioritize structures that satisfy the chemical feedback, leading to a substantial improvement in the accuracy of top-ranked predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used IR datasets show that FIRMPO significantly improves molecular structure elucidation accuracy over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRMPO（Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization），一个基于化学反馈的即插即用偏好优化框架，用于分子结构解析。该框架利用精确分子式匹配和IR光谱一致性作为化学反馈偏好信号，引导模型生成合理的候选分子结构，显著提升top-ranked预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的分子结构解析模型（使用分子式和IR光谱）往往推断出不合理的候选结构，包括排名第一的预测——具体表现为候选结构隐含的分子式与输入分子式不匹配，以及候选结构的理论IR光谱与实测IR光谱不一致。这导致结构解析过程仍然耗时且模糊，需要一种方法将化学反馈直接嵌入模型优化过程。
AI.method: FIRMPO将化学反馈编码为偏好信号，基于两个关键约束：(1) 精确分子式匹配——候选结构隐含分子式须与输入分子式一致；(2) IR光谱一致性——候选结构的理论IR光谱须与实测光谱吻合。该框架是模型无关（model-agnostic）的即插即用方法，可与不同结构预测模型集成，引导模型优先输出满足化学反馈的结构。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的IR数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FIRMPO能显著提升分子结构解析的准确率，优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FIRMPO作为一种通用且易于集成的化学反馈驱动偏好优化框架，有效解决了机器学习结构解析中候选结构不合理的问题，通过将分子式匹配与IR光谱一致性纳入优化目标，显著提高了top-ranked预测的可靠性，为分子结构解析提供了更精准的解决方案。

title: TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening
summary: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ScoliGait数据集和TokenSTFormer模型，利用步态视频进行青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）的无创筛查，准确率达0.79，超越了传统Vision Transformer方法。
AI.motivation: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）是青少年中常见的脊柱畸形，若不及时治疗会造成严重健康后果。传统筛查方法受限于主观判断、依赖专业知识和可扩展性差，亟需更为客观、可扩展且经济的筛查方案。
AI.method: 构建了包含1,516个步态视频片段及对应X光记录的ScoliGait数据集；提出TokenSTFormer模型，通过将空间和时间语义进行token化来增强特征表示和模型收敛性。
AI.result: TokenSTFormer在关键指标上达到最先进性能，超越vanilla Vision Transformer编码器，准确率达到0.79。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用步态视频中的整体运动特征和基于注意力的模型可用于可扩展、经济高效的AIS筛查，为脊柱侧弯检测的未来临床应用铺平道路。

title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
summary: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal surface a linear probe recovered future-answer identity before behavioural arrival at 0.056159 against uniform chance 0.025, an untrained control of 0.024758 and a population frequency baseline of 0.048309 (p = 0.012987; 16/40 answer classes contributing). Analogous pre-arrival accessibility survived the surface change, reaching 0.1020 against a zero-step control of 0.0460 (p = 0.000999) at the upstream structural position and 0.0618 at the readout comparator (p = 0.004), with 21/40 classes contributing. Finally, the natural attempt to track that accessibility across training was not cleanly evaluable: probe eligibility is defined by behavioural arrival, so the measured population changes with the measurand. Behavioural competence, internal accessibility, and training-time development are distinct observables, and neither behaviour nor decoder accessibility identifies the computation training acquired; causal intervention is the necessary next step.

AI.tldr: 本研究在30M参数递归深度关系推理模型中，区分了行为能力、内部可访问性和训练时间发展三个不同的可观测指标。在符号表面与语言表面上，三跳能力习得的逻辑epoch差距达186.5倍（70 vs 13,055）；在13,055个epoch的漫长训练中，四跳行为从未超过3/40。线性探针在行为到达之前就能恢复未来答案身份（p=0.012987），且此现象在表面变化后依然存在（p=0.000999）。作者认为行为能力和解码器可访问性都不能识别训练所获得的计算，因果干预是必要下一步。
AI.motivation: 行为阈值、最终检查点和隐藏状态解码器读取通常被用来推断能力发展，但这些方法可能识别的是不同的事件。作者旨在系统性地分离和对比这些观测指标，揭示它们之间的不一致性，以更准确地理解能力习得的本质。
AI.method: 使用30M参数的递归深度关系推理器，在封闭的oracle定义世界中进行研究。采用密集行为轨迹、两种训练表面（符号与语言）、预注册的到达前隐藏状态探针、前瞻性可评估性检查、明确的未训练和阴性对照。分离训练时间和推理时间两个轴进行系统对比。
AI.result: 1) 行为层面：三跳能力习得在符号表面需70个逻辑epoch，在语言表面需13,055个，相差186.5倍；之后语言表面四跳能力在8个逻辑epoch内达成。在13,055个epoch的训练中，四跳行为从未超过3/40，最终为0/40。2) 内部测量层面：线性探针在行为到达前即恢复未来答案身份（0.056159 vs 均匀机会0.025，p=0.012987）；在表面变化后仍保持可访问性（0.1020 vs 零步对照0.046，p=0.000999）。3) 训练时间追踪不干净：探针资格由行为到达定义，测量群体随被测量者变化。
AI.conclusion: 行为能力、内部可访问性和训练时间发展是三个截然不同的可观测指标。行为能力和解码器可访问性都不能单独识别训练所获得的计算。要真正理解能力习得机制，必须进行因果干预实验。

title: Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System
summary: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole video frame. The proposed framework utilizes the GCN model to explore hidden representations of feature-correlated groups of pixels. Moreover, the GCN supervises the A2C model, which selects a subgroup to enhance transmission latency, thus supervising the training of UAV actions in A2C. Experimental results show that GCN-assisted A2C reduces video frame transmission latency together with false detection rate in UAV vision systems over other DRL and state-of-the-art models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图卷积神经网络辅助的A2C深度强化学习系统（GCN-Assisted A2C），用于UAV机载视觉系统的低延迟视频传输。该系统通过GCN探索像素特征相关组的隐藏表示，并监督A2C模型选择最优的像素相关子区域进行传输，从而替代整帧视频传输，以降低传输延迟和误检率。
AI.motivation: UAV机载视觉系统广泛应用于禁飞区监控等场景，视频需流式传输至地面服务器供操作员辅助。然而现有视频传输技术的延迟成本较高，严重影响操作员辅助的有效性，亟需降低视频传输延迟的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出GCN-Assisted A2C深度强化学习模型：1）利用GCN探索特征相关像素组的隐藏表示，识别可疑物体的最优像素相关区域；2）将拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降结合，防止收敛不足以及优化过程中的过度/不足惩罚约束违反；3）仅传输帧的子组像素相关区域而非整个视频帧；4）GCN监督A2C模型选择子组以优化传输延迟并训练UAV动作。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GCN-Assisted A2C相比其他DRL模型和最新技术，在UAV视觉系统中同时降低了视频帧传输延迟和误检率。
AI.conclusion: GCN与A2C深度强化学习的结合方案能够有效降低UAV视觉系统的视频传输延迟和误检率，为低延迟UAV视频传输提供了一种可行的新范式。

title: Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation
comment: 133 pages, including appendix; includes figures and tables
summary:
Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages.
  We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. A fixed slot discipline assigns operations by computational role and defines the framework's coverage boundary. The decomposition also yields component-level theoretical insights: under endpoint-local messages and node-local updates, operator support bounds one-layer dependencies, and one-layer global mixing requires a full effective operator row under the stated hypotheses.
  The resulting framework organizes more than 200 architectures in a common design space, enables component-wise comparison and generation of structurally consistent architectures, and connects propagation choices to oversmoothing, oversquashing, heterophily, and expressivity. It further exposes the empirical inverse problem of mapping measurable graph and task properties to validated component choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的图神经网络层方程，通过七个分量（更新域、通道集、传播库、逐通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自我/残差映射、更新映射）将覆盖多种架构的图神经网络进行统一描述，核心因子分解将"信息移动到哪里"（传播库）与"信息移动什么"（消息映射）分离，并覆盖了200多种架构。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络通常通过各家族专属的方程来描述，这些表示方式掩盖了不同家族之间的共享计算和结构差异，导致难以进行跨架构比较、统一分析和设计空间的系统化探索。
AI.method: 提出一个通用层方程，由七个组件构成；关键的因子分解将传播库（信息位置移动编码）与消息映射（信息内容移动编码）分离；通过函数值填充扩展至局部消息传递、注意力、谱滤波、全局通信、关系特定通道、高阶域和几何消息等场景；采用固定的槽位纪律（slot discipline）按计算角色分配操作，并定义框架的覆盖边界。
AI.result: 通过规范层的具体约简和覆盖七个非互斥架构家族的组件分配使统一性显式可检验；推导出组件级理论洞见（在端点局部消息与节点局部更新下，算子支撑集限制单层依赖；单层全局混合需满有效算子行）；框架组织超过200种架构，支持组件级比较与结构一致架构的生成，并连接传播选择与过平滑、过压缩、异质性及表达能力等关键问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为图神经网络提供了统一的设计空间，实现了组件级比较和架构生成，同时揭示了将可观测的图与任务属性映射到已验证组件选择的经验逆问题。

title: The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration
summary: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization. We compare INR-Dense (IDIR), which directly models a dense displacement field using a SIREN-based INR; INR-BSCP (SINR), which predicts B-Spline control points with an INR; D-BSCP, which directly optimizes single-scale B-Spline control points; and MR-D-BSCP, which adds a multiresolution coarse-to-fine scheme. Experiments on inter-subject brain MR registration (OASIS) and intra-subject exhale-to-inhale lung CT registration (DIR-LAB 4DCT) reveal different behavior across deformation regimes. On OASIS, where deformations are moderate but locally complex, D-BSCP matches or slightly outperforms INR-BSCP, suggesting that the B-Spline parameterization accounts for much of INR-BSCP's effectiveness. On DIR-LAB 4DCT, where respiratory motion is larger and more coherent, single-scale B-Spline methods (D-BSCP and INR-BSCP) are less suitable, while INR-Dense and MR-D-BSCP are more effective. Across both tasks, MR-D-BSCP achieves the best performance among the tested continuous parameterizations. These findings highlight that registration accuracy depends strongly on matching the induced deformation prior to the target motion pattern, and support prior-deformation matching as a practical design principle for medical image registration. Our code will be available at https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR.

AI.tldr: 本文对连续可变形图像配准方法进行验证研究，比较了基于B-Spline和基于INR的不同参数化方法在脑部MR和肺部CT配准任务上的表现。研究发现，不同的隐式形变先验对不同运动模式的适用性不同，多分辨率B-Spline方法（MR-D-BSCP）在两类任务中均表现最佳，并提出了"先验-形变匹配"作为医学图像配准的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 可变形图像配准模型通过参数化和优化隐式地编码形变先验，但现有研究缺乏对这些隐式先验如何影响不同配准任务性能的系统性验证。作者希望通过对照实验，理解B-Spline参数化与INR（隐式神经表示）参数化所施加的不同先验（如局部性、平滑性、尺度）对不同形变模式的适配程度，从而为配准方法设计提供指导原则。
AI.method: 该研究设计了四种连续配准方法进行对比验证：(1) INR-Dense (IDIR)，用SIREN-based INR直接建模稠密位移场；(2) INR-BSCP (SINR)，用INR预测B-Spline控制点；(3) D-BSCP，直接优化单尺度B-Spline控制点；(4) MR-D-BSCP，在D-BSCP基础上加入多分辨率粗到细（coarse-to-fine）方案。实验在两个数据集上进行：OASIS（人脑MR，跨受试者配准，形变中等但局部复杂）和DIR-LAB 4DCT（肺CT，呼到吸的受试者内配准，呼吸运动较大且更连贯）。
AI.result: 在OASIS上，D-BSCP与INR-BSCP性能相当或略微更优，表明B-Spline参数化本身是INR-BSCP有效性的主要来源。在DIR-LAB 4DCT上，单尺度B-Spline方法（D-BSCP和INR-BSCP）不适用，而INR-Dense和MR-D-BSCP更有效。在所有测试的连续参数化方法中，MR-D-BSCP在两类任务上均取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 配准精度高度依赖于诱导的形变先验与目标运动模式之间的匹配程度。B-Spline参数化适合中等但局部复杂的形变（如脑配准），而更大的相干运动（如呼吸运动）需要多分辨率方案或INR稠密场方法。作者提出"先验-形变匹配"（prior-deformation matching）作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则，并计划公开代码以支持后续研究。

title: AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. Guided by this structure, we propose AsyTO, an Asymmetric Temporal Operator that factorizes the tensor of per-variable operators into shared but distinct history-reading and future-writing temporal modes with per-variable mode-wise gains, complemented by a low-rank periodic prototype and a cycle-separable factorization of the temporal modes. Each forecast reads only its own variable's history, so parameters and compute grow linearly in the number of variables. Across eleven benchmarks and multiple forecast horizons, AsyTO attains the best lightweight error in 30 of 44 dataset-horizon settings, locating at the accuracy-compute Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AsyTO（非对称时间算子），通过将预测目标从压缩观测序列转向压缩预测算子本身，解决多变量时间序列预测中共享预测器与独立预测器之间的结构性困境。审计发现逐变量的线性历史-未来映射中存在锁相季节项与方向性残差运算法则，据此将逐变量算子张量分解为共享但独立的历史读取与未来写入时间模态，辅以低秩周期原型与循环可分离分解，实现参数和计算随变量数线性增长，并在11个基准、44个数据集-水平设置中的30个取得最优轻量级误差。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测面临结构性两难：共享一个跨变量的时间预测器参数高效，但迫使异构变量通过相同的历史到未来映射；而为每个变量学习独立预测器虽恢复灵活性，其成本随变量数、上下文长度和预测跨度的乘积增长。作者认为一旦压缩对象从观测序列转为预测算子本身，这一困境即可消解。
AI.method: 首先审计标准基准上逐变量线性历史到未来映射，发现锁相季节分量配合紧凑残差算子在多数场景优于密集的相位盲参考，且残差传输具有方向性（非对称历史到未来映射优于滞后不变替代方案）。据此提出AsyTO：将逐变量算子张量分解为共享但独立的历史读取与未来写入时间模态，配以逐变量模式增益、低秩周期原型及循环可分离的时间模态分解。每个预测仅读取自身变量的历史，故参数与计算随变量数线性增长。
AI.result: 在11个基准、多种预测跨度下，AsyTO在44个数据集-跨度设置中的30个达到最佳轻量级误差，并位于精度-计算帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: AsyTO验证了将压缩对象从序列转向预测算子的有效性，在保持线性可扩展性的同时实现轻量级高精度预测，位于精度与计算成本的帕累托最优边界。

title: KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) requires synthesizing videos that are faithful to both reference subjects and text prompts. Existing methods are often hindered by high tuning costs or limited input-level enhancements, struggling to maintain rigid identity consistency during complex, long-sequence actions. To address these limitations, we propose KeyID, a training-free IPVG framework that decouples the synthesis of video dynamics from the injection of identity. Specifically, KeyID comprises two components: (1) Reference-Aware Video Generation, which produces an identity-agnostic video draft aligned with multiple references, and (2) Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing, which integrates the target identity via sparse keyframe correction and subsequent motion interpolation. By shifting from dense frame-level supervision to sparse keyframe-level refinement, KeyID effectively resolves the capacity conflict between prompt adherence and identity fidelity. Crucially, our modular design allows seamless extension to multi-subject references and complex sequential action generation without additional training. KeyID outperforms prior works and is validated by automatic and human evaluations on the official challenge benchmark, ultimately securing the runner-up position in the Track 2 (Sequential Action) of the ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/KeyID.

AI.tldr: KeyID是一个无需训练的IPVG框架，通过将视频动态生成与身份注入解耦，实现了在复杂长序列动作下保持身份一致性，并在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge Track 2中获亚军。
AI.motivation: 现有IPVG方法要么调优成本高，要么输入级增强有限，难以在复杂长序列动作中保持严格的身份一致性，存在提示遵循与身份保真之间的容量冲突。
AI.method: KeyID包含两个组件：(1) 参考感知视频生成，生成与多参考对齐的身份无关视频草稿；(2) 身份保持关键帧编辑，通过稀疏关键帧校正和后续运动插值集成目标身份。整体采用无训练框架，将身份注入从密集帧级监督转为稀疏关键帧级精修。
AI.result: KeyID在官方挑战基准上通过自动化和人工评估超越了先前工作，获得ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge Track 2（Sequential Action）亚军。
AI.conclusion: 通过模块化设计实现无需额外训练即可扩展到多主体参考和复杂顺序动作生成，有效解决了身份一致性与提示遵循之间的容量冲突问题。

title: RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary:
Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors.
  To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms.
  This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K.
  Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures.
  Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RetroMPA，一种分子性质感知的、模型无关的后处理增强模块，通过注入化学知识到逆合成管线中，在不修改模型架构且无需重训练的情况下，在USPTO-50K上平均提升八个逆合成模型的top-1准确率5.50%，在USPTO-Full上平均提升约2.03%，并通过湿实验验证了其实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的深度逆合成模型虽取得了显著进展，但主要依赖从大量数据中自主学习反应模式，缺乏对已建立化学知识（如分子性质）的先验注入，限制了其在化学合理性方面的表现。
AI.method: RetroMPA作为即插即用的、模型无关的化学过滤器，通过构建分子性质感知的潜在嵌入空间，对现有逆合成模型的预测路径进行重新校准和优化。它不独立生成SMILES序列，而是以后处理增强模块的形式集成到已有算法中，无需修改模型架构或进行资源密集的重训练。
AI.result: 在USPTO-50K数据集上，RetroMPA在八个代表性逆合成模型上平均提升top-1准确率5.50%；在USPTO-Full大规模数据集上，对基于模板和无模板架构平均提升约2.03%。湿实验进一步验证了其能发现可行且未报道过的底物组合（Suzuki-Miyaura偶联、Bucherer反应、Friedel-Crafts酰化）。
AI.conclusion: RetroMPA证明了将化学知识作为先验注入逆合成管线的有效性，能够超越纯数据拟合的局限，为现有逆合成模型提供低成本、高通用性的性能增强方案，具有实际实验验证的实用价值。

title: Beyond Clear Skies: Synthetic Seasonal and Weather Variations for Real-World Drone Detection
summary: Reliable drone detection under real-world deployment conditions requires training data that spans the full operational design domain, including adverse weather and seasonal appearance variation. However, acquiring and annotating such data at scale remains highly resource-intensive, as adverse-weather conditions are inherently difficult to control, reproduce, and sample systematically. Existing datasets therefore typically provide only limited coverage of such conditions. Conversely, synthetic data offers a scalable alternative: environmental variation becomes controllable, while modern game-engine-based pipelines provide realistic rendering and automatic annotations. Leveraging this potential, we introduce SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W), an systematic extension of SynDroneVision (SDV) targeting adverse-weather and seasonal domain shifts in urban drone detection. SDV-W comprises 55,187 annotated high-resolution images from three urban environments, rendered across three seasonal configurations and diverse weather conditions, including rain, snow, and fog at multiple severity levels. By preserving SDV's scene and trajectory configuration, SDV-W enables matched clean-adverse comparisons and quantification of condition-specific detector degradation. Across representative YOLO models and real-world datasets, we show that SDV-W improves detector reliability under adverse appearance shifts, reduces missed detections and false alarms, and is most effective as a complement to general-purpose synthetic drone-detection data. SDV-W will be publicly released upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynDroneVision-Weather（SDV-W），一个系统性的合成数据扩展集，用于恶劣天气和季节域下的城市无人机检测，包含55,187张高分辨率标注图像，覆盖3个城市环境、3种季节配置及雨雪雾等多种严重等级天气。实验表明SDV-W能提升检测器在不利外观变化下的可靠性，减少漏检和误报。
AI.motivation: 真实部署条件下的可靠无人机检测需要覆盖完整运行设计域的标注数据，包括恶劣天气和季节外观变化。然而，真实恶劣天气数据的采集和标注高度消耗资源，且难以系统性控制、复现和采样。现有数据集对此类条件的覆盖有限，亟需可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用现代游戏引擎渲染管线，在SynDroneVision基础上系统性扩展构建SDV-W，通过可控的环境参数（3个城市环境、3种季节配置、雨雪雾等多严重等级的恶劣天气）生成高分辨率、自动标注的合成数据。保留SDV原有场景和轨迹配置，以实现干净-恶劣条件下的配对比较，并量化各条件下的检测器性能退化。
AI.result: 在代表性YOLO模型和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SDV-W能提升检测器在不利外观变化下的可靠性，减少漏检和误报，且作为通用合成无人机检测数据的补充时效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据是解决恶劣天气和季节域下无人机检测数据稀缺问题的可扩展有效方案。SDV-W提供了系统性、可配对的恶劣天气训练数据，可作为通用合成数据的有效补充，显著提升检测器在真实不利条件下的可靠性。数据集将在论文被接收后公开发布。

title: Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
summary: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MRieHy框架，融合黎曼几何与超图学习，用于运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）的跨天测试时自适应解码，在私有ECoG和两个公开EEG数据集上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: MI-BCI解码面临跨天可迁移性和在线操作两大挑战。现有超图方法虽可捕捉高阶样本关系提升迁移能力，但忽略了黎曼几何在跨天EEG迁移学习中的优势；两者结合在在线测试时自适应场景下存在空白。
AI.method: MRieHy框架包含四部分：(1) 计算跨天训练数据协方差矩阵的黎曼均值以对齐多日分布；(2) 基于黎曼距离构建协方差矩阵超图，同时基于余弦相似度构建深度特征超图；(3) 通过自适应学习权重融合两个超图，并与标签投影矩阵联合优化；(4) 在线测试时维持先进先出缓冲区，对缓冲数据进行黎曼对齐并利用学习到的超图解码。
AI.result: 在私有四类ECoG数据集和两个公开四类EEG数据集上的大量实验表明，MRieHy相比最先进的基线方法取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MRieHy通过将黎曼几何与多特征超图融合，成功解决了MI-BCI解码中跨天可迁移性与在线操作的双重挑战，验证了该混合方法的有效性与普适性。

title: Picking the Right Image to Classify: Reliable-Input Selection in Teledermatology
summary: Dermatology models face distribution shifts in teledermatology settings, where submitted images differ from the training data in lighting, angle, distance, focus, and framing. These test-time images are ordinary clinical photographs, but some fall outside the model's training conditions, leading the model to often misclassify them due to shifts in acquisition between training and deployment. When multiple images of the same case exist (several photos of one patient or lesion), a natural way to improve accuracy is therefore to select the image the model is most likely to classify correctly. We call this task reliable-input selection. An oracle that, for each case, selects a correctly classified image when one exists raises weighted F1 by about 20 percentage points on average across six dermatology datasets and nine frozen backbones. This oracle is an upper bound that sees the labels, whereas a selector must choose blindly. Capturing this gain in practice is hard. A selector that needs no pretraining data applies to any frozen model, including those whose data is not public. It must judge reliability from quantities the model exposes at inference: its embeddings, their norms, and its confidence. We benchmark four such training-data-free selectors: the embedding norm, the neighborhood consensus among a case's images, the stability of the prediction under small perturbations, and the model's own confidence. No training-data-free selector substantially narrows this oracle gap. The best of them is the model's own confidence, but it recovers only a small part of the gap on the clinical datasets. A small labeled reference set does not help either: the best selector overall, a fusion of confidence and Mahalanobis distance, still leaves most of the gap. To our knowledge, this is the first study to introduce and benchmark reliable input selection, a clinically important, unsolved task.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出并系统评估"可靠输入选择"（reliable-input selection）任务：在远程皮肤科场景下，当同一病例存在多张临床照片时，选择模型最可能正确分类的图像。通过oracle实验表明该任务理论上可提升加权F1约20个百分点，但所有无需训练数据的盲选器（嵌入范数、邻域一致性、扰动稳定性、模型置信度）均无法显著缩小该差距，最佳选择器（置信度与Mahalanobis距离融合）也仅能恢复其中一小部分。
AI.motivation: 远程皮肤科（teledermatology）中，提交的临床照片在光照、角度、距离、对焦和构图等方面与训练数据存在分布偏移，导致皮肤病模型在这些图像上频繁误分类。然而同一病例往往有多张照片，自然想到的做法是挑选模型最可能分类正确的那张。作者首次将该问题形式化为"可靠输入选择"任务，并探究能否利用模型在推理时暴露的信息（嵌入、范数、置信度）来实现盲选。
AI.method: 作者在六个皮肤科数据集和九个冻结骨干网络上开展实验。首先用oracle（能看到标签）为每个病例选出可正确分类的图像作为性能上界，量化了任务的理论增益（加权F1平均提升约20个百分点）。随后基准测试了四种无需训练数据的选择器：嵌入范数（embedding norm）、病例图像间的邻域一致性（neighborhood consensus）、对输入小扰动的预测稳定性、以及模型自身置信度。此外还测试了使用小规模标注参考集的方法，包括置信度与Mahalanobis距离的融合。
AI.result: Oracle上界显示可靠输入选择可平均提升加权F1约20个百分点。但四种无需训练数据的选择器均无法实质性缩小这一oracle差距：其中最佳的是模型自身置信度，但在临床数据集上仅恢复了一小部分差距。引入小规模标注参考集的结构（置信度与Mahalanobis距离融合）虽为整体最佳选择器，但依然遗留大部分差距尚未被填补。
AI.conclusion: 可靠输入选择是临床重要但尚未解决的任务。理论上（oracle）存在巨大的性能提升空间（+20个百分点F1），但现有的训练数据无关选择器无法有效捕捉该增益，即模型自身暴露的信息不足以可靠地判断哪些图像会被正确分类。研究结论表明该问题仍需新的方法思路来解决。

title: REFLEX: Reflexive Equilibrium Fixed-point Learning for Endogenous eXchanges
summary: In over-the-counter corporate bond markets, dealers compete for client trades by quoting bid and ask prices. Tighter quotes attract more business, but also informed customers more likely to trade ahead of adverse price moves, leaving the dealer holding the risk. As dealers increasingly use machine learning to set quotes, they retrain these models on the trades their own quotes attract, creating a feedback loop in which each model reshapes the market that generates its next training data. The question is therefore not only whether a quoting model performs well, but whether the market it creates stays stable as the model learns from it. Existing performative prediction theory gives a sharp stability condition, yet expresses it through abstract properties of the learning objective a trading desk cannot measure before deployment. We introduce REFLEX, a framework that replaces those unobservable quantities with three measurable features of dealer behavior: how strongly trading volume responds to tighter quotes, how sharply the dealer's objective bends around its optimum, and how quickly informed flow increases as spreads narrow. REFLEX combines these into a single retraining modulus, a pre-deployment stability margin estimated from a desk's own quote and execution history that predicts whether repeated retraining will converge or amplify itself. In simulation, predicted and measured stability agree within 8%, and competing dealers increase instability by 1.74x with two and 3.16x with three, as predicted. Where ordinary retraining becomes unstable at modulus 1.21, a structurally anchored correction converges as blind retraining collapses. Calibrated over 36 years of public market data, stability headroom falls roughly 4.4x for investment grade and 4.3x for high yield from calm to crisis regimes. Ultimately, REFLEX turns an abstract convergence theorem into a market-level safety margin.

AI.tldr: REFLEX是一个用于场外公司债券市场经销商报价模型的稳定性评估框架,通过三个可测量的经销商行为特征(成交量对报价松紧的敏感度、目标函数的弯曲程度、知情订单流随价差收窄的增加速度)构建一个"再训练模量",在部署前预测重复再训练是否会收敛或放大失稳。
AI.motivation: 经销商使用机器学习设定报价时,会在自己的报价吸引力产生的交易数据上反复再训练模型,形成反馈回路。现有的绩效预测理论提供了清晰的稳定性条件,但通过无法在部署前测量的学习目标抽象属性来表达,交易台缺乏可操作的预部署稳定性指标。
AI.method: 将不可观测的抽象目标属性替换为三个可测量的经销商行为特征:成交量对更紧报价的响应强度、经销商目标函数在最优值附近的弯曲度、以及价差收窄时知情流增加的速率。这三个特征组合成一个"再训练模量"(retraining modulus),即从交易台自身报价和执行历史中估计的部署前稳定性余量。
AI.result: 模拟中预测稳定性和实测稳定性在8%以内一致;两个竞争者使不稳定性增加1.74倍,三个竞争者增加3.16倍,与预测相符。普通再训练在模量1.21时失效,而结构锚定修正方法在盲目再训练崩溃时仍能收敛。基于36年公开市场数据校准,从平静期到危机期,投资级和高收益债券的稳定余量分别下降约4.4倍和4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX将抽象的收敛定理转化为可操作的市场级安全余量,为经销商在部署机器学习报价模型前提供了可测量的稳定性判断工具,实现了从理论条件到实际部署风险评估的跨越。

title: PCT-Prompt: A Prompt-Guided Transformer Framework for Dense Prediction Tasks in Point Clouds
summary: Standard Transformers have proven effective in point cloud object classification, but their performance in dense prediction tasks within complex scenes is often hindered by weak prior assumptions. To address this challenge, we propose PCT-Prompt, a novel framework that enhances standard Transformers by introducing a prompt-guided feature branch to improve performance in dense prediction tasks. The standard Transformer branch leverages pre-trained models for global feature extraction from point cloud data, serving as the backbone for processing high-level features. Meanwhile, the prompt-guided feature branch consists of two key components: a fine-grained feature extraction block that captures multi-scale geometric features using geometry-sensitive abstraction layer, along with the PnP-3D layer to integrate local context with global regularization. The second component, the prompt-refined feature learning block generates prompt tokens, which are subsequently refined through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce a prompt drop mechanism that progressively removes prompt information across Transformer layers, balancing local details and global consistency. Experimental results on the ShapeNetPart, S3DIS, and DALES datasets demonstrate that PCT-Prompt significantly improves the adaptability of standard Transformers to dense prediction tasks, achieving strong performance in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCT-Prompt框架，通过引入提示引导的特征分支来增强标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务中的性能，在ShapeNetPart、S3DIS和DALES数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在点云物体分类任务中表现优异，但在复杂场景下的密集预测任务中因缺乏先验假设（weak prior assumptions）而性能受限。现有方法未能充分发挥Transformer在密集预测场景中的潜力，因此需要一种新的框架来增强其适应性和表现力。
AI.method: PCT-Prompt框架包含两个分支：(1) 标准Transformer分支，利用预训练模型进行全局特征提取作为骨干网络；(2) 提示引导特征分支，由两个核心组件构成——细粒度特征提取块（采用几何敏感抽象层捕获多尺度几何特征，并结合PnP-3D层整合局部上下文与全局正则化）和提示精炼特征学习块（生成提示token并通过交叉注意力机制进行精炼）。此外，引入提示丢弃（prompt drop）机制，在Transformer层间逐步移除提示信息，以平衡局部细节与全局一致性。
AI.result: 在ShapeNetPart、S3DIS和DALES三个数据集上的实验结果表明，PCT-Prompt显著提升了标准Transformer对密集预测任务的适应性，在真实世界场景中取得了优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: PCT-Prompt通过引入提示引导的辅助特征分支和提示丢弃机制，有效解决了标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务中先验不足的问题，证明了提示学习范式可为Transformer在密集预测领域提供有效的特征增强途径。

title: A Tree-Structured Approach for Phishing Template and Attacker Attribution Analysis
comment: Paper accepted and presented @ eCrime 2026 conference
summary: Phishing remains a persistent and evolving cybersecurity threat, with attack volumes reaching record levels. This growth is driven by the industrialization of phishing through widely available phishing kits and reusable templates, which enable cybercriminals to rapidly generate and deploy large numbers of fraudulent webpages. Although surface-level attributes may differ across these websites, their underlying structures often exhibit significant similarities. However, most existing defenses rely on reactive blocklists or supervised classification models that focus on individual phishing instances, limiting their ability to identify structural reuse and detect coordinated phishing campaigns. To address this limitation, this study investigates whether HTML structure can serve as a robust fingerprint for identifying phishing template reuse. We model webpages as Document Object Model (DOM) trees and extract structural features, optionally enriched with HTML tag-based content information. These representations are then clustered using unsupervised learning methods to group structurally similar webpages. Three clustering algorithms are evaluated and compared, while also analyzing how the depth of the extracted DOM-tree affects cluster formation and overall clustering performance. Finally, cluster quality is also evaluated both quantitatively and qualitatively, including a novel level-wise Jaccard Distance Score and manual inspection supported by visualization tools. Results demonstrate that structural representations of webpages can effectively reveal hidden similarities across phishing sites, enabling the detection of emerging and zero-day templates and supporting the analysis of coordinated phishing threats

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用HTML结构（DOM树）作为指纹来识别钓鱼网站的模板复用，通过无监督聚类方法将结构相似的网页分组，以检测协调性钓鱼攻击和零日模板。
AI.motivation: 钓鱼攻击已达到创纪录水平，其工业化生产（钓鱼工具包和可复用模板）使攻击者能快速生成大量欺诈网页。现有防御依赖反应式黑名单或监督分类模型，仅关注单个钓鱼实例，无法识别结构复用和协调性钓鱼活动。
AI.method: 将网页建模为DOM树并提取结构特征（可选加入基于HTML标签的内容信息），使用三种无监督聚类算法对结构相似的网页进行分组；分析DOM树深度对聚类效果的影响；提出层级Jaccard距离分数（level-wise Jaccard Distance Score）用于定量评估，并结合可视化工具进行定性评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明结构化的网页表示能有效揭示钓鱼站点之间的隐藏相似性，使检测新兴及零日模板成为可能，并支持协调性钓鱼威胁的分析。
AI.conclusion: 基于DOM树结构的特征表示和无监督聚类方法能够作为钓鱼模板复用的鲁棒指纹，克服传统反应式防御的局限，增强对协调性钓鱼攻击的检测和归因能力。

title: GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation
summary: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于基础特征高斯表示的驾驶世界模型，在单一框架内统一了场景理解、语言接地推理、可控4D编辑和多模态生成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型大多聚焦于条件场景生成，缺乏显式3D场景理解、语言接地推理和可控4D编辑能力；且点云、占用栅格或BEV等常见表示难以实现文本信息与底层3D场景结构的细粒度对齐。
AI.method: 1) 基础特征高斯分词器：将Qwen/SigLIP视觉语言特征直接蒸馏到3D高斯原语中，构建紧凑的开放词汇高斯语义场；2) 几何感知高斯适配器：结合重要性感知层级选择与文本条件的Perceiver式交叉注意力，将密集高斯原语聚合为紧凑的世界token；3) 基于KL的高斯-图像分布对齐目标，使高斯世界token与基础图像token对齐；4) 基于对齐的高斯表示支持指令可控的场景编辑，包括天气条件生成和动态车辆操控。
AI.result: 在多个驾驶基准测试上，该方法在场景理解、视觉接地、规划导向推理和可控4D生成任务上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉语言基础特征蒸馏到3D高斯表示中，实现了一个统一的驾驶世界模型框架，能够同时支持理解、推理、编辑和生成，且代码和数据集将公开释放。

title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion
summary: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. Under natural conditions on stalk transportation and global sheaf structure, we establish an index-theoretic comparison criterion showing that one sheaf's harmonic space genuinely contains another's beyond trivial inflation. We illustrate this with a concrete instance and further introduce \textit{GyroSheaf}, a sheaf with curved gyrovector-space stalks, extending the criterion to the non-linear setting via local tangent-space linearization. Experiments across ten models confirm the theoretical criterion: sheaf models violating the criterion collapse despite possessing index jumps, while compliant models maintain depth-stable representations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Sheaf Neural Networks（SNNs）中过平滑问题的现有分析方法提出质疑，指出现有研究仅以调和空间（ker L）的绝对维度作为抗过平滑能力的指标并不可靠，因为某些sheaf配置虽能膨胀核维度但其调和截面仍为常数、无法提升判别力。作者首次引入相对几何方法，在自然条件下建立基于指标理论的比较判据，判定一个sheaf的调和空间是否真正包含另一个sheaf的调和空间（而非仅通过平凡膨胀）。文中以此判据给出具体实例，并提出GyroSheaf（带弯曲陀螺向量空间茎的sheaf），通过局部切空间线性化将该判据推广至非线性情形。在十个模型上的实验证实了理论判据：违反判据的sheaf模型即使存在指标跳跃仍会崩溃，而符合判据的模型能保持深度稳定的表示。
AI.motivation: Sheaf Neural Networks通过sheaf结构替代图拉普拉斯来对抗图卷积网络的过平滑问题。但现有分析以调和空间ker L的绝对维度作为抗过平滑能力指标存在缺陷：某些sheaf配置会膨胀核维度，但其调和截面仍完全恒定，并不增加判别能力。因此需要一个更精确的相对几何判据来真正刻画sheaf的抗过平滑能力。
AI.method: 作者提出首个相对几何方法：在茎平移和整体sheaf结构的自然条件下，建立基于指标理论的比较判据，判定一个sheaf的调和空间是否在本质意义上真包含另一个的调和空间（超越平凡膨胀）。此外引入GyroSheaf，使用弯曲的陀螺向量空间作为茎，通过局部切空间线性化将该判据推广到非线性设置。
AI.result: 在十个模型上进行的实验证实了理论判据：违反判据的sheaf模型尽管存在指标跳跃（index jumps）仍会发生表示崩溃；而符合判据的模型能保持深度稳定的表示。文中还给出了一个具体实例说明该判据的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 调和空间的绝对维度不能可靠衡量sheaf的抗过平滑能力，需要采用相对几何判据。该判据能精确区分sheaf调和空间的本质包含关系，且在非线性的GyroSheaf设置下仍可通过局部线性化保持有效。这一工作为SNNs的架构设计与过平滑分析提供了更严格的理论基础。

title: Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks
summary: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. Comprehensive evaluations across three benchmark HS datasets demonstrate that the higher level HMD layers achieve superior classification accuracy compared to classical learnable tensor baselines, including Tucker, Canonical Polyadic, and Tensor Train decompositions. Furthermore, HMD-1 and HMD-2 achieve a generalization capacity and training stability comparable to standard 2D and 3D-CNNs while requiring significantly fewer feature extractor parameters. These results demonstrate that the HMD framework provides a structurally robust substitute for traditional convolution in multidimensional HS image classification, offering high parameter efficiency and stability throughout the optimization process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为全变差分解（HMD）的新型端到端可微分神经网络层，用于高光谱图像分类的特征提取，能够将独立的单模式变化与合作的高维交互显式分离，在三个基准HS数据集上以更少的参数达到与CNN相当甚至更优的分类精度和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统的高光谱图像分类特征提取方法存在两难困境：刚性张量分解（如Tucker、CP、TT分解）无法捕获复杂的空间-光谱相互依赖关系；而参数高度冗余的卷积神经网络（CNN）计算成本高昂。作者旨在开发一种既能捕获复杂时空光谱交互，又具备高参数效率的结构化特征提取方法。
AI.method: 提出HMD框架，作为一个端到端可微分的神经网络层。该方法通过可学习的矩阵值支撑（matrix valued supports）显式地将独立的单模式（single mode）变化与合作的更高维交互分离。框架包含HMD-0、HMD-1和HMD-2三种近似变体，并与下游分类器通过反向传播联合优化。
AI.result: 在三个基准高光谱数据集上的综合评估表明：高阶HMD层相比经典可学习张量基线（Tucker、CP、Tensor Train分解）获得更高的分类精度；HMD-1和HMD-2在泛化能力和训练稳定性方面与标准2D和3D-CNN相当，但所需的特征提取器参数显著更少。
AI.conclusion: HMD框架为传统卷积在高光谱图像分类中提供了一种结构稳健的替代方案，兼具高参数效率和优化过程稳定性，展现出在多维HS图像分类中的巨大潜力。

title: Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics
summary: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-100K and Procgen demonstrate competitive performance and improved training stability.

AI.tldr: 本文对深度Q-learning训练不稳定性进行了系统性分析，从算子级Bootstrapping偏差、估计器级贪心动作选择的回归噪声敏感性、以及参数动态不平衡三个互补视角展开，识别出奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和特征性的参数尖峰动力学，并提出了受控Bootstrapping、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节三大稳定化原则，在Atari-100K和Procgen上验证了竞争性性能与更优的训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往将DQL训练不稳定归因于过估计偏差或表示学习等孤立因素，缺乏对递归价值估计过程中不同不稳定源如何相互作用的统一理解。
AI.method: 从三个互补视角展开：1) 算子层面分析Bellman Bootstrapping中的偏差；2) 估计器层面分析贪心动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性；3) 参数动态层面分析激进数据复用下的不平衡。据此推导出受控Bootstrapping、集成分位数估计、基于尖峰参数调节三种稳定化原则。
AI.result: 在Atari-100K和Procgen基准上取得竞争性表现，并显著改善了训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对不稳定源的系统性解构与相互作用分析，本文提供了统一的理论框架与可操作的稳定化策略，有效缓解了深度Q-learning在递归价值估计中的训练不稳定问题。

title: SCOUT: Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-Vocabulary Editing of face Recognition Templates
summary: Face recognition templates are compact identity representations, yet they also encode rich semantic information about facial appearance. Prior work has shown that templates can be inverted to images or indirectly manipulated through image-editing pipelines, but direct semantic editing in template space remains largely unexplored. Existing interpretability methods for face recognition often rely on manual neuron inspection or predefined attribute labels, limiting scalability and semantic flexibility. To address this gap, we propose SCOUT (Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates), an end-to-end framework for discovering and directly manipulating semantic concepts in face recognition templates using mechanistic interpretability. SCOUT learns sparse template representations, generates semantic hypotheses for latent features from natural-language descriptions, and validates their stability. The resulting features act as controllable semantic directions for direct editing, avoiding costly edit--re-encode pipelines. Experiments with face recognition models using CNN, ViT, and Swin backbones show that SCOUT discovers interpretable concepts beyond standard attribute labels and enables controllable, identity-aware template manipulation with negligible impact on identity matching. We further show that edited templates can subsequently be decoded with independent inversion models for visualization and evaluation.

AI.tldr: SCOUT是一个端到端框架，利用机械可解释性直接在面部识别模板空间中发现并操控语义概念，无需图像编辑-再编码管线。
AI.motivation: 面部识别模板编码丰富的面部外观语义信息，但先前工作只能将模板逆转为图像或通过图像编辑管线间接操控模板，直接在模板空间进行语义编辑仍未得到充分探索。现有可解释性方法依赖人工神经元检查或预定义属性标签，缺乏可扩展性和语义灵活性。
AI.method: SCOUT包含三个核心步骤：(1) 学习稀疏模板表示；(2) 从自然语言描述生成语义假设来注释潜在特征；(3) 验证特征的稳定性。最终得到的特征作为可控的语义方向，直接在模板空间中进行编辑。
AI.result: 在CNN、ViT和Swin骨干网络的面部识别模型上，SCOUT发现超越标准属性标签的可解释概念，支持可控且保持身份意识的模板操控，对身份匹配影响可忽略不计。编辑后的模板还能通过独立的反演模型解码进行可视化和评估。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT首次实现了开放词汇的面部识别模板直接语义编辑，避免了昂贵的编辑-再编码管线，为面部识别模板的可解释性和可控编辑提供了新的范式。

title: Multi-Granularity Sentiment Integration for LLM-Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict sentiment polarity and intensity from heterogeneous inputs such as text, audio, and vision. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic priors for MSA, effectively incorporating audio and visual signals effectively remains challenging. A key challenge is that audio and visual sentiment cues evolve over different temporal scales, yet many LLM-based methods compress these signals through shallow projection or coarse pooling before fusing them with text, which can weaken cross-modal alignment and erase fine-grained affective information. We propose MGSI, a multi-granularity sentiment integration framework for LLM-based MSA. MGSI first encodes audio and visual streams at short-, medium-, and long-range temporal scales, preserving both local variations and global affective trends. It then refines non-text features through text-guided alignment, and applies polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement to better handle ambiguous and near-neutral samples. The resulting multimodal representation is finally compressed into a small set of pseudo-tokens for efficient conditioning of a frozen LLM. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that MGSI substantially outperforms frozen-LLM baselines and remains competitive with strong multimodal methods. Further ablation and sensitivity analyses support the effectiveness of multi-granularity temporal modeling, text-guided refinement, and adaptive sentiment calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出MGSI框架，通过多粒度时间编码、文本引导对齐和情感感知增强，将音频和视觉信号高效压缩为伪令牌以条件化冻结的LLM，在多模态情感分析中显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based多模态情感分析方法通过浅层投影或粗略池化压缩音频和视觉信号，忽视了这些信号在不同时间尺度上演化的特性，导致跨模态对齐被削弱、细粒度情感信息丢失。
AI.method: MGSI框架包含三部分：(1) 在短、中、长三种时间尺度上编码音频和视觉流，保留局部变化与全局情感趋势；(2) 通过文本引导对齐精炼非文本特征，并应用极性与强度感知增强处理模糊和近中性样本；(3) 将多模态表示压缩为少量伪令牌，用于高效条件化冻结的LLM。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，MGSI大幅超越冻结LLM基线，并与强多模态方法竞争力相当；消融和敏感性分析验证了多粒度时间建模、文本引导精炼和自适应情感校准的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度时间建模与文本引导对齐是提升LLM多模态情感分析性能的关键，MGSI为高效利用冻结LLM进行多模态情感分析提供了有效方案。

title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
summary: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. To support this objective, we construct GroundFake, a dataset designed for grounded explainable detection, with localized bounding-box evidence, human verification based on visual grounding and artifact specificity, corrected reasoning trajectories, and valid/invalid evidence supervision. We further introduce FakeFrontier, an out-of-distribution benchmark built from real images and outputs of 10 recent generators, together with an MLLM-based protocol for evaluating evidence quality and persuasiveness. Experiments on GroundFake, FakeFrontier, and additional out-of-distribution benchmarks show that Defake-o3 improves both detection accuracy and explanation quality, producing more localized, verifiable, and persuasive evidence.

AI.tldr: Defake-o3是一个可解释的AI生成图像检测器，通过交互式视觉搜索和验证器引导的证据对齐，从"推测性解释"转向"可验证证据"，并配套构建了GroundFake数据集和FakeFrontier基准。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型的AIGI检测器虽然能提供自然语言解释，但通常生成推测性的理由——依赖模糊或幻觉性伪影，遗漏最新生成器的细微局部缺陷，且无法提供可视觉验证的证据。
AI.method: Defake-o3包含两个核心机制：(1) 交互式视觉搜索——模型迭代放大可疑区域以检查细粒度细节；(2) 验证器引导的证据对齐——一个基于人类验证标注训练的Evidence Verifier，通过强化学习奖励有依据的证据并惩罚无根据的声称。同时构建GroundFake数据集（含局部边界框证据、人类验证标注、修正的推理轨迹、有效/无效证据监督）和FakeFrontier OOD基准（含真实图像及10个最新生成器的输出，并配MLLM评估协议）。
AI.result: 在GroundFake、FakeFrontier及其他OOD基准上的实验表明，Defake-o3在检测准确性和解释质量上均有提升，生成的证据更加局部化、可验证且具有说服力。
AI.conclusion: Defake-o3通过将检测过程从推测性解释转变为可验证证据，实现了更可靠、更可解释的AIGI检测，为未来可解释检测系统提供了新的方法论和数据基础设施。

title: Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals
summary: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

AI.tldr: 提出LACE（局部增广控制变量评估），一种半监督条件LLM评估估计器，通过局部中心化技巧利用廉价辅助信号（如LLM-judge分数、置信度等）提高条件性能画像的估计效率，同时保证无偏性。
AI.motivation: 聚合精度掩盖了模型在不同条件下的成败差异；从黄金标签估计条件性能画像成本高昂，而低成本辅助信号虽然容易收集但往往有偏或校准不佳，需要一种能利用这些廉价信号进行高效无偏条件评估的方法。
AI.method: LACE的核心是局部中心化：在目标画像区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广的期望为零，因此不会改变被估计量。增广系数仅用于效率提升，本地岭控制变量结合了标注子集的黄金标签残差均值与全量项目池的廉价信号均值。证明了一定条件下无偏性、分组画像的无偏性、中心化线性增广内的局部oracle最优性以及估计系数的一阶自适应性。
AI.result: 推导出的增益公式由总体局部R²决定，刻画了廉价信号在不同画像值上的效率可达性。同时推导了直接配对模型差距和部署加权分数的对应估计器。在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC上进行经验评估。
AI.conclusion: LACE通过局部中心化将廉价但可能有偏的辅助信号转化为无偏且效率提升的条件评估工具，理论保证完善且覆盖多种评估场景，为大规模、细粒度的LLM条件性能估计提供了可行的半监督方案。

title: Seeing Before Answering: Training-Free Visual Layer Profiling for Vision-Language Models
summary: LLaVA-style Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pass visual tokens from a fixed late layer of the vision backbone, typically the penultimate one, to the language model. We first show that this hidden convention is fragile: across 2 VLMs and 7 image and video benchmarks, the default layer is sub-optimal in 13 of 14 model-task pairs, and the best layer shifts with both task and visual backbone. Finding that layer by exhaustive layer-wise inference is prohibitively expensive, and no better fixed default exists. We therefore ask whether layer usefulness can instead be predicted from representation geometry. We study matrix-based entropy, introduced for unimodal layer analysis, which we compute over sample-level visual embeddings as Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE); and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, introduced for encoder-level VLM model selection, which we repurpose as a layer-wise visual--language alignment signal. Transferring these to LLaVA-based models is not obvious a priori: the vision tower is frozen while the multimodal projector is trained, so we profile both sides of the projector. We find that VDE transfers, and GW does not. Computed from 100 unlabeled task samples without downstream inference, pre-projector VDE tracks layer-wise accuracy and its top-ranked layers cover the oracle best layer on every task for the SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video, while giving region-level guidance for the CLIP-based Video-LLaVA. Post-projector profiles show that the projector reshapes visual geometry but does not erase the performance-relevant trend, leaving $\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$ the stronger signal. GW instead flattens after projection and is best read as an alignment diagnostic rather than a selector. VDE thus offers an interpretable, training-free policy that narrows the visual-layer search to a handful of candidates for limited downstream verification.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLaVA类视觉-语言模型默认使用视觉骨干倒数第二层作为视觉token来源的约定是脆弱的——在14个模型-任务组合中有13个默认层并非最优。作者提出用视觉数据集熵（VDE）代替穷举式逐层推理来预测最优层，该方法仅需100个无标注样本，无需下游推理即可有效定位最优层，显著缩小搜索范围。
AI.motivation: LLaVA类VLM固定从视觉骨干的倒数第二层提取视觉token，但作者发现这一默认约定在大多数任务上并非最优，且最优层随任务和视觉骨干而变化。穷举式逐层推理成本过高，且不存在普适的固定默认层，因此需要一种能以低成本预测层有效性的方法。
AI.method: 将矩阵熵（matric-based entropy）迁移为视觉数据集熵（VDE），在样本级的视觉embedding上计算；同时将Grormov-Wasserstein（GW）距离从编码器级模型选择重新用途为逐层的视觉-语言对齐信号。在LLaVA-Video（SigLIP骨干）和Video-LLaVA（CLIP骨干）两个模型上验证，分别从投影器前后两侧对视觉几何进行profiling。
AI.result: VDE成功迁移到LLaVA模型：在SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video上，VDE排名靠前的层覆盖了每个任务的oracle最优层；在CLIP-based Video-LLaVA上提供了区域级指导。而GW在投影后失效，更适合作为对齐诊断工具而非层选择器。投影器会重塑视觉几何但不会抹除与性能相关的趋势，因此投影前的VDE（VDE_pre）是更强的信号。
AI.conclusion: VDE提供了一种可解释的、无需训练的层选择策略，能将视觉层搜索范围缩小到少量候选层，便于有限次数的下游验证，为VLM的视觉层选择提供了低成本且有效的解决方案。

title: Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ECCE Europe 2026
summary: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC. These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比六种电池证据来源（受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹和车队级SOH数据），量化了实验室电池测试与现场工况之间的差距，并提出了基于归一化电流离散度和爬坡率的工况结构指数（DSI）等统一描述指标，证明电池性能指标高度依赖于其生成工况模式。
AI.motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要经验基础，但其运行模式不能直接代表现场工况曲线。此前缺乏系统性量化实验室与现场测试之间差距的研究工具和指标。
AI.method: 比较六种证据来源，结合使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate和基于归一化电流离散度及爬坡的工况结构指数（DSI）进行统一分析。
AI.result: DSI范围从现场源轨迹的0.630和NASA的0.699到牛津的2.936和帝国理工的2.855；使用C-rate从帝国理工/NASA/斯坦福/现代的0.14-0.40到牛津的2.00。80%容量保持区域分别出现在NASA约351个循环、牛津6292个检查点和斯坦福1019个循环。帝国理工在标准循环下保留0.813、驾驶循环老化下保留0.865，现场源中位SOH为0.889。现场运行中位使用强度为137.2 km/天，56.9%的充电在95% SOC或以上结束。
AI.conclusion: 电池性能指标是产生它的工况模式的函数，应用导向的研究应报告明确的工况曲线描述符，以及化学体系、容量和老化指标。

title: CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration
summary: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. When adapted across diverse clinical applications, training fewer than 2.5% of parameters achieved performance comparable to full fine-tuning, enabling research without access to high-performance GPU clusters. Applied to federated learning across hospitals, this approach achieved performance comparable to pooled-data training over internet connections and with consumer-grade hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoM³eT，一个统一的医学视觉基础模型，通过注意力机制建模多维上下文，同时支持病理与影像、稀疏与稠密预测、二维与高维输入，在跨模态多任务基准中优于其他医学基础模型，且仅需微调少于2.5%的参数即可达到接近全量微调的性能，并支持联邦学习场景。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基础模型局限于单一专科（如病理或影像）、单一输出类型（分类或分割），缺乏能够统一处理多模态医学数据、多种预测任务和多维输入的通用基础模型，限制了模型的泛化能力与临床应用范围。
AI.method: CoM³eT采用"共表征多维多任务医学Transformer"架构，核心创新在于通过注意力机制对多维上下文进行建模，从而统一病理与影像两种模态、稀疏（分类/报告生成）与稠密（分割）预测任务，以及二维与三维（更高维）的输入数据。
AI.result: 在覆盖5个断层扫描、4个整体标本、3个二维数据集的公开竞赛中，CoM³eT优于其他医学基础模型，涵盖稀疏预测、稠密预测及报告生成任务。在多样化临床应用中，微调少于2.5%的参数即可达到全量微调相当的性能。在联邦学习中，跨医院的性能可与汇集数据训练相当，且通过普通互联网连接和消费级硬件即可实现。
AI.conclusion: CoM³eT证明了跨专科、跨任务、跨维度的统一医学视觉基础模型的可行性，其参数高效微调特性使无高性能GPU的研究者也能进行相关研究，且天然适配联邦学习，为医疗AI的协作式部署提供了实用路径。

title: Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization
summary: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单点凸优化（one-point bandit convex optimization）在有限反馈跟踪容量（只能跟踪C个待处理反馈，丢弃即永久丢失）下的延迟复杂度问题。通过引入调度器侧条件能量接口，实现了延迟项从O(√(Tσ_max))改进到O(√(E_C d_tot))的未调参学习器；在强凸条件下给出时间成本H_A(d)；并证明即使延迟多重集、总延迟、峰值回积和容量完全相同的两个延迟向量，其极小极大遗憾也可以多项式不同。
AI.motivation: 现有单点bandit凸优化在有限跟踪容量模型下只能达到O(√(Tσ_max))的延迟依赖（σ_max为峰值回积），而无限跟踪条件下可以达到更优的√(d_tot)依赖（总延迟）。作者试图弥合这一差距，探索在容量受限且反馈永久丢失的约束下，延迟复杂度是否能达到更紧的界。
AI.method: 引入调度器侧条件能量接口（scheduler-side conditional-energy interface），将速率自适应与单点扰动过滤分离，并处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重。在相同半clairvoyant预言机和路径式硬容量契约下分析延迟项，并在强凸场景下推导时间成本H_A(d)=Σ_t σ_t/(A+t)。同时构造连续硬系列将跟踪容量转化为零阶查询预算。
AI.result: 延迟项缩放为O(√(E_C d_tot))，仅含显式重启因子E_C；公共常数因子峰界可消除该因子而无需知道d_tot。强凸条件下得到时间成本H_A(d)。关键发现：两个延迟向量即使具有相同的延迟多重集、d_tot、σ_max和容量，极小极大遗憾仍可多项式不同——曲率下时序至关重要。连续硬系列给出容量饥饿的下端点。上界需要C≥ln T+1，且非完整容量minimax刻画。
AI.conclusion: 本文的调度器侧条件能量接口成功将延迟复杂度从O(√(Tσ_max))改进到O(√(E_C d_tot))，揭示了在强凸场景下延迟的时序结构（而非仅聚合统计量）对极小极大遗憾的决定性影响。但该结果在C≥ln T+1条件下成立，且不构成完整的容量极小极大刻画，留有开放问题。

title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
summary: Cross-border e-commerce image translation is essential for global retail, where product images, banners, and detail pages need to be produced in different languages. Existing methods struggle to achieve accurate translation, faithful visual identity preservation, and easy-to-edit outputs, simultaneously. To address these challenges, we introduce TransAnyText, a structured visual code framework that reformulates image text translation as generating renderable HTML patches from source images and target languages. Our framework decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a vision-language model (VLM) handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel-level refinement, followed by deterministic rendering to synthesize the final image. Based on this formulation, we develop a three-stage post-training framework, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) establishes the image-to-code mapping, privilege-gap weighted self-distillation (PWSD) improves the learning of style and layout tokens, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) further optimizes task-level performance. We further introduce TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench, a multilingual dataset and benchmark for e-commerce image translation. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against cascaded pipelines, open-source end-to-end models, and closed-source image editing systems, providing an effective, controllable, and editable solution for cross-border e-commerce image translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TransAnyText，一个结构化视觉代码框架，将跨境电商图像文本翻译重构为从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染的HTML补丁。该框架将语义生成与像素渲染解耦：VLM负责视觉理解、跨语言翻译和结构化视觉生成，扩散模型负责背景修复和像素级细化，最后通过确定性渲染合成最终图像。基于此框架开发了三阶段后训练流程，并构建了TransAnyDataset和TransAnyBench多语言数据集与基准。
AI.motivation: 跨境电商图像翻译对全球零售至关重要，但现有方法难以同时实现准确的翻译、忠实的视觉身份保持和易于编辑的输出。这三个核心需求在现有技术中往往相互冲突，缺乏统一的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出结构化视觉代码框架TransAnyText，将图像文本翻译转化为从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染HTML补丁的任务。框架包含三大模块：VLM负责视觉理解、跨语言翻译和结构化视觉代码生成；扩散模型负责背景修复与像素级细化；确定性渲染完成最终图像合成。训练采用三阶段流程：SFT建立图像到代码的映射，PWSD增强风格和布局Token的学习，RLVR优化任务级性能。
AI.result: 在TransAnyBench基准上与级联流水线、开源端到端模型以及闭源图像编辑系统相比，TransAnyText展现出具有竞争力的性能，同时在可控性、可编辑性和有效性方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: TransAnyText为跨境电商图像翻译提供了一种有效、可控且可编辑的解决方案，通过结构化视觉代码范式的引入，成功化解了翻译准确性、视觉一致性保持和输出可编辑性三者之间的冲突。

title: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
summary: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了协作推理（CI）中稀疏激活的隐私风险，发现稀疏化在降低传输成本的同时，对隐私泄漏的降低远不如预期。关键是，激活值的位置信息本身就构成严重的隐私风险，即使在传输成本和任务效用都很低时，仅凭位置信息也能实现高保真重建和个体重识别。作者建议将位置信息视为敏感传输数据并进行审计。
AI.motivation: 协作推理在边缘设备与服务器之间拆分模型，客户端需传输中间激活值，这带来通信成本和隐私泄漏的双重担忧。近期工作通过激活稀疏化+熵编码降低传输成本，并直觉认为稀疏化也能提升隐私（传输更少的值意味着暴露更少输入信息）。作者想验证这一直觉是否成立。
AI.method: 将稀疏激活分解为"保留的值"和"值所占的位置集合"两个独立成分，分别仅利用每个成分来重建输入，以隔离评估各自的隐私泄漏。实验在自然图像和面部数据集上进行，评估重建质量和个体重识别能力。
AI.result: 稀疏化降低隐私泄漏的程度远小于其降低传输成本的程度；剩余风险主要转移到位置信息上，而先前研究仅将位置视为解码的辅助信息。仅凭位置信息就能实现高保真重建和个体重识别，构成严重的隐私威胁，且该泄漏在传输成本和任务效用都很低时依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏激活的位置信息应被视为敏感传输数据，在协作推理中需要被仔细审计和防护，而非仅当作解码辅助信息处理。

title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
summary: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DGCM-AVS，一个同时建模音频、视觉和深度信息的三模态框架，通过深度感知动态调制器改善相邻物体分离，并利用深度引导渐进融合实现跨模态对齐，在AVSS数据集上相比SOTA方法在M_J和M_F上分别提升10.2%和8.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有音视分割（AVS）方法大多未显式建模几何线索（如相对距离和遮挡），限制了跨模态对齐的鲁棒性。受人类感知中空间结构与音视证据自然整合的启发，作者提出将估计深度作为空间结构线索引入AVS。
AI.method: 提出三模态框架DGCM-AVS，包含两个核心组件：(1) Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator，利用深度信息改善相邻物体的特征分离并保持物体内部特征一致性；(2) Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion，以深度作为中间桥梁，逐步将音频线索与视觉特征对齐。
AI.result: 在AVSS数据集上，与最先进方法相比，DGCM-AVS在M_J指标上获得10.2%的相对提升，在M_F指标上获得8.7%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明深度是AVS中一个有前景但尚未充分探索的模态，该工作可能鼓励该方向的进一步研究。

title: Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Power and Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
summary: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可再生能源占比提升背景下电力系统对快速灵活资源的需求，通过实验测量和建模，研究了一台55 kW/79 kWh电池储能系统（BESS）和一台由三个2.4 kW单元组成的电解槽（Power-to-X）的真实硬件特性（如爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度），并将这些实测特性嵌入基于价格的优化框架中，利用2022-2025年丹麦电力市场和辅助服务市场的真实数据评估其多市场参与的收益。结果表明，BESS和电解槽在多市场参与下的日均优化利润分别为1,749.27丹麦克朗和289.46丹麦克朗，强调了将实验性能纳入多市场、多年参与评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源份额增加，电力系统需要快速响应的灵活资源来维持稳定性。电力市场和辅助服务产品的扩张为跨多种服务叠加收入创造了机会。然而，大多数研究忽略了实际硬件行为（如爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度），导致市场参与策略的评估不够准确，因此需要将真实硬件特性纳入研究。
AI.method: 本研究通过实验对55 kW/79 kWh的BESS和由三个2.4 kW单元组成的电解槽进行测量，识别关键硬件特性（爬坡限制、效率、设定点跟踪精度等）。将这些实测特性嵌入价格驱动的优化框架中，利用2022至2025年丹麦电力市场和辅助服务市场的真实数据，对设备参与多市场（电力市场+辅助服务市场）的收益进行优化计算。
AI.result: BESS多市场参与日均优化利润为1,749.27丹麦克朗，电解槽为289.46丹麦克朗。研究展示了BESS和PTX系统在多市场参与中的可行商业模式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过将实验测得的硬件真实性能纳入多市场、多年参与的优化评估中，证明了对BESS和PTX电解槽参与丹麦电力及辅助服务市场进行准确评估的必要性，突出了实验性能数据在评估多市场参与价值中的关键作用。

title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
summary: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PosterText，一个统一实现电商海报生成与编辑的模型，将文本补丁作为原子单元，覆盖生成、添加、删除、修改四种操作，并通过四阶段课程训练（文本渲染预训练、指令跟随、强化学习偏好对齐、空间引导自蒸馏）实现灵活精确的编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有电商海报生成方法要么只做端到端生成，要么遵循多阶段设计流程，缺乏对已有海报进行灵活精确编辑的能力，因此需要统一生成与编辑的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出Text Patch Generation and Editing统一任务公式，以文本补丁为原子单元，涵盖海报生成、补丁添加、补丁删除、补丁修改四种操作及可选的参考引导风格控制。模型PosterText采用四阶段课程训练：文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、强化学习偏好对齐、空间引导自蒸馏执行细化。同时构建了带补丁级标注的大规模数据集和综合评测基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PosterText在生成和编辑任务上均达到与现有方法相竞争的性能，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PosterText通过统一的文本补丁原子操作公式和四阶段课程学习，成功实现了电商海报的生成与编辑统一，为自动化海报设计提供了有效方案。

title: The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning
summary: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的监督式解耦表示学习框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束相结合，揭示内在权衡：强制潜在独立性或一一对应的潜在-协变量依赖会以潜在-协变量对齐为代价。各解耦模式存在闭式变换，可后验应用于CLIP、DINOv2、ViT等预训练模型，并融入因子分析（iFA）概率模型，在模拟和多组学真实数据上实现可控的结构化潜在表示。
AI.motivation: 无监督解耦学习方法仅追求潜在维度独立性，无法保证维度与语义协变量对齐；监督方法在协变量相关时无法同时实现一一对应的潜在-协变量对齐和潜在独立性。需要一个能统一两者并明确其权衡关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建统一监督框架，将维度-协变量依赖约束与潜在结构约束耦合；通过理论分析证明存在固有权衡，证明各解耦模式按对齐强度排序，并为每种模式推导潜在空间的闭式变换；将这些变换后验应用于预训练模型表征，并融入带协变量信息的因子分析（iFA）概率模型。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，后验对齐和iFA均能实现结构化潜在表示的可控性；CLIP、DINOv2和ViT等预训练模型的表征通过闭式变换得以重新对齐。
AI.conclusion: 证明了监督式解耦中潜在一一对应性与独立性与对齐强度之间不可兼得的理论关系，并提供了可落地的闭式变换工具，使预训练模型表征和概率因子模型都能获得可控的结构化表示。

title: Cross-View Urban Sensing: Mapping Subjective Streetscape Perception via AlphaEarth Embeddings and Urban Context
summary: Residents' perception of the urban streetscape is an important factor in public health, active mobility, and social wellbeing. Street view imagery (SVI) has emerged as a widely used data source for assessing these perceptual qualities, yet its uneven coverage and irregular updating limit large-scale measurement. Here, we present CVLNet, a Cross-View Learning Network that predicts street-level perception from AlphaEarth embeddings and multi-source urban contextual data without requiring SVI at inference. CVLNet applies per-task adaptive gating to jointly model five perceptual dimensions, using labels from the pretrained SVI-Percept model as ground truth. The proposed method is evaluated across four Southeast Asian cities: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, and Manila. CVLNet achieves a median road-segment-level Adjusted $R^{2}$ of 0.76 and consistently outperforms the baseline models, with gains ranging from 5.9--11.3% across the five perceptual dimensions. Ablation experiments show that AlphaEarth features and urban contextual features contribute complementary information. We further produce citywide road-level streetscape perception maps for five subjective perceptual dimensions across all four cities, extending perception estimation from the 13--31% of the road network directly covered by available SVI to the complete road network of each city. Integrating these maps with WorldPop gridded population data, we quantify exposure inequality across population-density, demographic, and land-use groups using the Deficit Palma Ratio. These results demonstrate that remote sensing can serve as a scalable alternative to SVI for citywide streetscape perception mapping, enabling a more comprehensive assessment of urban environmental inequality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CVLNet（跨视角学习网络），利用AlphaEarth嵌入和多源城市上下文数据在推理时不依赖街景图像（SVI）即可预测街道层级感知质量。CVLNet通过每任务自适应门控联合建模五个感知维度，在四个东南亚城市（新加坡、吉隆坡、雅加达、马尼拉）评估中达到0.76的中位道路段级Adjusted R²，优于基线模型5.9-11.3%。研究将感知估计从SVI直接覆盖的13-31%道路网络扩展到完整路网，并整合WorldPop人口数据量化暴露不平等（Deficit Palma Ratio），证明遥感可作为SVI的可扩展替代方案。
AI.motivation: 居民对城市街道景观的感知是公共健康、主动出行和社会福祉的重要影响因素。街景图像（SVI）虽被广泛用于感知质量评估，但其覆盖不均和更新不规律限制了大规模测量，因此需要一种无需SVI即可进行城市级街道感知制图的可扩展方法。
AI.method: 提出CVLNet（Cross-View Learning Network），从AlphaEarth嵌入和多种城市上下文数据预测街道级感知，推理时无需SVI。CVLNet采用每任务自适应门控（per-task adaptive gating）联合建模五个感知维度，以预训练SVI-Percept模型的标签作为指导，实现从遥感跨视角学习到街道感知的映射。
AI.result: 在四个东南亚城市评估中，CVLNet达到0.76的中位道路段级Adjusted R²，五个感知维度上优于基线5.9-11.3%。消融实验表明AlphaEarth特征与城市上下文特征互补。模型将感知估计从SVI覆盖的13-31%路网扩展到各城市完整路网，并结合人口数据量化了暴露不平等（Deficit Palma Ratio）。
AI.conclusion: 遥感可作为SVI的可扩展替代方案用于城市级街道景观感知制图，使更全面的城市环境不平等评估成为可能，为大规模城市感知研究提供了新路径。

title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria.
