Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.

AI.tldr: 提出SAUL（Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning）框架，将机器遗忘形式化为带明确满足准则的约束最小化问题，通过增广拉格朗日控制器自适应调节遗忘压力，并结合锐度感知更新与双优化器设计，在TOFU、WMDP、MUSE基准上实现更优的遗忘-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型中的机器遗忘面临核心矛盾：既要擦除目标知识，又要保持模型的通用效用。以往的遗忘方法通常将期望的遗忘程度隐式编码在优化目标中，缺乏对"遗忘多少"的显式控制，导致难以在遗忘与效用保持之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: SAUL将遗忘形式化为带约束的最小化问题，遵循"忘记足够多，但不多于必要"的原则：1) 将遗忘定义为具有预设满足准则的显式约束；2) 增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反程度自适应调节遗忘侧压力，当准则持续满足时可自动关闭遗忘侧更新；3) 对保留和遗忘两个目标均采用锐度感知更新，配合保持角色分离状态的双优化器设计，稳定遗忘动力学过程。
AI.result: 在TOFU、WMDP、MUSE三个基准上，SAUL在各自基准特定的遗忘准则下，相比代表性的基于锐度和扰动的基线方法表现出更优的遗忘-效用权衡。此外，在TOFU上将增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用模块应用于代表性基线，能够提升其遗忘后的效用，验证了显式遗忘控制的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: SAUL通过将遗忘约束显式化并采用增广拉格朗日机制自适应控制遗忘力度，有效缓解了遗忘与效用保持之间的权衡难题。实验证明其遗忘效果好于现有方法，且其控制器组件具有通用性，可移植到其他基线方法上提升性能，展示出实际部署价值。

title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-OPD方法，通过轨迹级别的潜在空间蒸馏增强On-Policy Distillation，解决视频推理中仅输出级别监督无法约束推理潜在表征的问题，在六个视频推理基准上优于仅输出级别的OPD。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在视频推理中计算成本高昂，促使研究者将其推理能力转移到更小更高效的模型上。虽然On-Policy Distillation通过匹配输出token分布提供了解决方案，但视频推理依赖跨多帧的证据积累，仅输出级别的监督无法直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表征。
AI.method: 提出Latent-OPD，在OPD基础上增加轨迹级别的潜在蒸馏。具体包括：(1) 聚焦于每条轨迹末端位置，该处隐藏状态能有效总结累积的视觉证据和推理上下文；(2) 引入渐进式教师前瞻策略，将学生中后层与教师越来越深的层对齐。
AI.result: 在六个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD一致优于仅输出级别的OPD。改进在帧数有限、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的任务中尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: Latent-OPD被证明是一种高效有效的帧高效视频推理方法，通过潜在层面的蒸馏弥补了输出级别监督的不足，显著增强了学生模型的视频推理能力。

title: Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs
summary: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KNNG-CS，一种基于K近邻图的轻量级核心集选择方法。它利用局部邻域结构估计数据项重要性，无需维护二次距离矩阵，仅需线性边数存储。在四个真实数据集上，KNNG-CS在保持与CRAIG等梯度近似方法相当准确率的同时，选择时间降低2.3-41.2倍，峰值内存降至基线的0.3%-7.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度近似核心集选择方法（如CRAIG及其聚类变体）虽能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段依赖密集的成对距离矩阵或大型item-cluster绑定矩阵，在大规模数据集上产生高昂的时间和内存开销，亟需一种轻量级的替代方案。
AI.method: KNNG-CS基于K近邻图（KNN graph）构建轻量级核心集选择框架。通过利用局部邻域结构估计每个数据项的重要性，并以贪心策略选择代表性节点，避免维护二次距离矩阵，存储复杂度仅与图的边数呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，KNNG-CS在准确率上与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相当，同时将选择时间减少2.3-41.2倍，峰值内存降低至基线方法的0.3%-7.5%。
AI.conclusion: KNNG-CS证明了基于K近邻图的方法能够在保持核心集选择精度的前提下大幅降低计算和存储开销，为大规模数据集上的高效核心集选择提供了可行的轻量级解决方案。

title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding demands direct responses from the causally observed prefix of an unfolding video. Existing systems add inference-time memory, retrieval, and compression, yet a training-free sliding-window baseline already matches them. We therefore fix a memory-free recent-window protocol and ask how far post-training alone can go. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fits this regime poorly, encouraging long ``think-then-answer'' generations, while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level teacher supervision on student trajectories but is stable only when both models train in thinking mode. These observations lead to \textsc{StreamOPD}, a recipe combining verifiable streaming-video data, thinking-mode OPD, and instruct-mode deployment. It raises StreamingBench from $77.9\%$ to $83.9\%$---within $0.3$ points of the 9B teacher---and improves OVO-Bench excluding its hallucination-detection subtask (HLD) by $9.1$ points under unchanged inference. As a teacher-privilege extension, \emph{Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)} aggregates cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios into a group-relative response score that reweights OPD. It reaches $71.9\%$ on OVO-Bench (excluding HLD) and $64.9\%$ on Video-MME, and is the only variant that stays above the base model on all four benchmarks. Replacing the teacher with a frozen copy of the student's initial policy---on-policy self-distillation---retains most of these gains and lifts HLD to $57.0\%$, above both the untrained student and the 9B teacher, so abstention loss is not intrinsic to the recipe. We provide a transparent and reproducible reference for open-source streaming-video research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StreamOPD，一种用于流式视频理解的后训练配方，结合可验证的流式视频数据、思考模式下的on-policy蒸馏和指令模式部署，在StreamingBench上从77.9%提升到83.9%，逼近9B教师模型；并提出教师特权扩展Spatio-Temporal CueGate（ST-CueGate）和on-policy自蒸馏变体，在多个基准上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解要求在视频因果展开的前缀上直接给出响应。现有系统通过推理时的记忆、检索和压缩来提升性能，但作者发现一个无需训练的滑动窗口基线已经能与这些方法匹敌。因此作者固定一个无记忆的近期窗口协议，探究仅依靠后训练能将性能推进多远，旨在提供一个透明且可复现的开源流式视频研究参考。
AI.method: 作者提出StreamOPD配方：首先基于可验证的流式视频数据构建训练集，采用思考模式（thinking mode）下的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）提供密集的token级教师监督，最终以指令模式（instruct mode）部署。同时提出教师特权扩展Spatio-Temporal CueGate（ST-CueGate），通过聚合有无线索场景下教师似然比生成组相对响应分数来重加权OPD；此外还探索了用冻结的学生初始策略副本替代教师的on-policy自蒸馏变体。
AI.result: StreamOPD在StreamingBench上从77.9%提升至83.9%，仅比9B教师低0.3个百分点；在OVO-Bench（排除幻觉检测子任务）上提升9.1个百分点。ST-CueGate在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）上达到71.9%，在Video-MME上达到64.9%，是唯一在所有四个基准上均保持高于基线的变体。on-policy自蒸馏保留大部分收益并将HLD提升至57.0%，超过未训练学生和9B教师。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明在固定无记忆近期窗口协议下，纯后训练（特别是思考模式下的on-policy蒸馏）就能让流式视频理解性能逼近教师模型；通过教师似然的组相对重加权和自蒸馏变体，可以进一步提升性能且不牺牲所有基准；弃权损失并非流式视频蒸馏配方的固有问题，为开源流式视频研究提供了透明可复现的参考。

title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
comment: Methodology and evaluation framework for Foresight-England. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are not currently available. On behalf of the CVD-COVID-UK/COVID-IMPACT Consortium
summary: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Foresight-England (Foresight-E)，这是首个国家级规模的电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，专为COVID-19研究而开发。该模型为2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器，在NHS英格兰安全数据环境中从零训练，使用约6100万人的纵向去标识化EHR数据（含初级/次级医疗、死亡登记和COVID-19数据）。由于NHS英格兰暂停了数据访问，量化结果暂不可用，论文改为分享其标记化、架构、训练、推理和评估策略，作为方法论模板和人口规模EHR基础模型构建挑战的案例研究。
AI.motivation: 应对COVID-19大流行的直接和间接影响，需要能够建模大规模人群层面健康轨迹的生成式基础模型。现有EHR模型规模有限，且缺乏国家级、覆盖多种数据源并保留临床粒度的解决方案。作者旨在构建首个国家级EHR基础模型，以零样本方式建模患者时间线，评估大流行的直接与间接效应。
AI.method: Foresight-E是一个2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器，在NHS英格兰安全数据环境中从零训练。使用约6100万人的去标识化纵向EHR数据（90%训练、10%评估），覆盖2018年11月至2022年12月。模型自回归地建模患者时间线，预测给定既往病史后的下一个医疗事件。标记化方案保留ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT的临床粒度，联合表示绝对和相对时间。推理时零样本运行，可预测约4万代码词汇表中的任意概念，无需任务特定训练。评估框架涵盖30天COVID-19住院和死亡率，含人口学因素和疫苗接种状态的亚组分析，并在2023年（训练期后）未见过数据上测试泛化能力，与Logistic回归和XGBoost基准比较。
AI.result: 由于NHS英格兰暂停了Foresight-E项目的数据访问，定量结果目前不可用。论文转而提供了方法论框架，包括标记化策略、架构设计、训练方案、推理机制和评估框架，作为在真实世界国家安全数据环境中构建人口规模EHR基础模型的方法论模板和案例研究。
AI.conclusion: Foresight-E展示了在国家级安全数据环境中构建人口规模EHR基础模型的技术可行性与架构方案，但其经验也揭示了此类项目面临的数据治理、访问权限和监管挑战。该研究为未来大规模临床基础模型的开发提供了重要的方法论参考，同时强调了在真实临床环境中部署此类模型所需的制度与合规考量。

title: LaGSplat: Inferring Physics-Governed Interactive Simulation from Monocular Video Using Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Project page with interactive demo: https://louenpottier.github.io/lagsplat.html
summary: We present LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting), a framework that infers interactive, physics-governed dynamics from one or a few monocular videos. At inference it lets a user push on the filmed object, rigid or deformable, with an external force that was never measured, annotated, or seen during training. This is possible because a low-dimensional latent state $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ plays two roles at once: it is the generalised coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder. The inductive bias of this decoder, whose primitives are explicit points $μ_i(\mathbf{q})$ that move with the object, is what lets a force $f$ applied in the image pull back into a latent generalised force $J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$ and enter the equations of motion, which pixel-space (CNN) or neural-field (NeRF) decoders cannot do. We validate LaGSplat on test cases of increasing difficulty, from rigid to deformable and from autonomous to forced real systems, combining monocular video and sensor measurements. We further demonstrate interactive use: forces of arbitrary magnitude and direction can be applied to the reconstructed object at any time, its response rendered in real time, in 2D or 3D. Assuming a dissipative Euler-Lagrange equation over a few generalised coordinates trades generality for a bounded, plausible response to unseen forces, where an unconstrained predictor diverges.

AI.tldr: LaGSplat是一个从单目视频推断物理驱动的交互式动力学框架，通过将低维潜状态同时作为耗散拉格朗日方程广义坐标和高斯溅射解码器条件变量，实现在推理时对未见物体施加强制并实时渲染响应。
AI.motivation: 现有的从视频学习动态的方法（如CNN像素空间或NeRF神经场解码器）无法将施加在图像上的外力回溯到运动方程中，因为其表示不具备显式的物体跟随点结构。作者希望实现一个从单目视频中学习、推理时可交互施力且响应物理合理的动态模型。
AI.method: 提出LaGSplat框架：1）低维潜状态q同时充当学习到的耗散拉格朗日系统的广义坐标和高斯溅射解码器的条件变量；2）高斯溅射解码器使用随物体移动的显式点primitives $\mu_i(\mathbf{q})$，其归纳偏置允许图像空间施加的力f通过雅可比$J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$拉回为潜空间广义力并进入运动方程；3）假设耗散Euler-Lagrange方程，在少量广义坐标上做约束，以泛化性换取对未见力有界且合理的响应。
AI.result: 在从刚体到可变形、从自主运动到受迫真实系统的递增难度测试用例上验证了LaGSplat，结合单目视频和传感器测量；演示了交互使用：可在任意时刻对重建物体施加任意大小和方向的力，响应可在2D或3D中实时渲染。
AI.conclusion: 基于耗散Euler-Lagrange方程在少量广义坐标上的假设，LaGSplat牺牲了一部分泛化性，换来了对未见外力有界且合理的响应，而不受约束的预测器在此场景下会发散。

title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
summary: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCALE方法，通过标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离对齐来校准端到端学习的LeWM潜表征的几何结构，使其获得类似DINO-WM的有利性质（主成分保留更多状态信息），从而显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测世界模型通过在表示空间中对预测的终端嵌入与目标嵌入打分来进行规划。两种获得非坍缩表征的主流策略——预训练特征空间（DINO-WM）和端到端学习带反坍缩正则化（LeWM+SIGReg）——在不同任务上表现出互补优势。关键问题是：DINO-WM的主成分保留更多状态信息，而欧氏规划成本由高方差方向主导，这导致规划质量对表征几何结构敏感。因此需要一种方法让端到端学习的表征也具备这一有利几何性质。
AI.method: SCALE通过一个轻量级的训练时正则化项，将成对采样的潜变量距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离相关联，从而诱导LeWM表征获得类似DINO-WM的几何性质（即主成分保留更多状态信息），同时不替换LeWM已学习的编码器。
AI.result: 在五个任务、三种规划求解器和五种计算预算下，SCALE在每一个任务-求解器组合上都优于LeWM基线。对比实验表明，仅做潜变量到状态的回归（latent-to-state regression）虽然在可解码性上达到或超过SCALE，但未能改变潜变量-状态的距离对齐，规划增益也不一致，说明单纯保留状态信息不足以提升规划质量。
AI.conclusion: 规划质量不仅取决于任务相关信息是否存在于表征中，还取决于该信息是否塑造了规划器所消费的表征几何结构。SCALE通过单一轻量级训练时正则化（无规划额外开销）有效改善了端到端世界模型的规划性能，验证了这一核心论断。

title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface. Existing approaches often rely on resource-intensive conditioning, using either heavyweight branches or costly source concatenation. Is there any efficient way to model editing intent? Thus, we introduce GRNEdit, a lightweight two-stage framework. GRN inspires our approach by encoding visual semantics through combinations of bits. Through task-specific fine-tuning, we take this representation further and recast editing semantics as local retain-or-flip decisions over individual bits. Source information is consequently modeled as coordinate-wise evidence supporting the observed binary states, while the GRN backbone remains responsible for resolving their global composition into coherent generative semantics. In Stage I, a compact encoder translates discrete source codes into continuous evidence signals, which GRN assimilates throughout binary refinement. Inspired by null-prompt training for classifier-free guidance, we further assign the null condition an editing-specific meaning: an empty instruction denotes no edit and is supervised through source reconstruction. This identity pathway not only implicitly strengthens evidence utilization and content preservation in Stage I, but also produces a source-preserving state in the same representation space as the edited state. Stage II can therefore directly compare each edited state with its source-preserving counterpart and use their discrepancy to revise unresolved target-bit decisions. Trained on only 0.6M pairs with less than 3\% conditioning parameters, GRNEdit-2B and GRNEdit-8B achieve scores of 4.03 and 4.18 on OpenVE-Bench. The 2B model outperforms multiple 14B open-source editors, while the 8B model performs on par with leading open-source editors.

AI.tldr: GRNEdit是一个轻量级两阶段视频编辑框架，受GRN（通过比特组合编码视觉语义）启发，将编辑语义建模为局部比特的保留或翻转决策。其GRN主干负责全局组合，并通过身份路径（空指令表示不编辑）实现源保留状态与编辑状态的直接对比。仅用0.6M训练对和不到3%的条件参数，GRNEdit-2B和8B分别在OpenVE-Bench上达到4.03和4.18分，2B模型超越多个14B开源编辑器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于指令的通用视频编辑方法通常依赖资源密集的条件建模（如重型分支或昂贵的源拼接），缺乏高效的编辑意图建模方式。作者旨在探索一种轻量级的条件注入方案，以降低计算和参数开销。
AI.method: GRNEdit采用两阶段框架：(1) Stage I中，一个紧凑编码器将离散源编码翻译为连续证据信号，GRN主干通过二进制精炼过程融合这些证据；(2) 受null-prompt训练启发，将空指令赋予编辑特定含义——表示不编辑并监督源重建，形成身份路径。该身份路径使源保留状态与编辑状态处于同一表示空间，Stage II直接比较二者差异以修正未解决的目标比特决策。整体采用任务特定微调，仅需极少条件参数。
AI.result: 仅使用0.6M训练对和不到3%的条件参数，GRNEdit-2B在OpenVE-Bench上达到4.03分，超越多个14B开源编辑器；GRNEdit-8B达到4.18分，与领先开源编辑器性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过对GRN的比特级语义表征进行任务特定微调，以及引入编辑特定的身份路径（null条件=源保留），GRNEdit证明了高效轻量级条件注入可以替代资源密集分支，在显著降低参数开销的同时达到与更大规模模型相当乃至更优的视频编辑性能。

title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
summary:
This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

AI.tldr: Prior Labs发布了关系学习的α版本开源软件套件，包含RelArena-α（统一的基准评估框架）、TabPFN-Rel（目前在RelArena-α上排名第一的关系学习模型）和RPI（模型无关的关系预测接口），旨在加速关系学习研究并推动真实世界应用。
AI.motivation: 关系学习领域涌现了大量数据集和任务，但社区缺乏可靠、可复现的方法比较基准；同时希望促进开放科学和社区协作，推动关系学习方法在研究和工业界的实际应用。
AI.method: 发布三个开源组件：1) RelArena-α，基于RelBench v1的统一基准框架，标准化数据加载、评估协议、调参机制和自定义调参系统支持（借鉴TabArena）；2) TabPFN-Rel，专为TabPFN-3构建的关系学习模型，在RDBLearn基础上进行关键改进；3) RPI，开源、模型无关的关系预测接口，方便研究者和从业者在新数据库上定义问题并应用任何RelArena-α中的模型。
AI.result: TabPFN-Rel目前在RelArena-α上排名第一，其表现进一步证明了将关系数据库展平为单表的方法在真实世界任务上仍可与传统关系架构相竞争。软件以α版本发布，面向研究者和早期采用者。
AI.conclusion: Prior Labs致力于通过开源和社区协作持续推动关系学习领域的发展，计划根据社区反馈进一步开发这些工具，使其成为加速关系学习社区进步和实现真实世界影响的催化剂。

title: Unlocking Motion in Expressions: Temporal Calibration for Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment referred objects at the pixel level in video sequences based on natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically introduce motion information within a unified cross-modal temporal modeling framework, where language cues are used for target localization and segmentation. However, the dependency of expressions on motion semantics is not explicitly modeled, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the use of motion information according to different semantic requirements. To address these issues, we propose an Expression-driven Motion Calibration (EMC) framework for RVOS that explicitly unlocks and leverages the motion semantics within expressions. The proposed method extracts interpretable motion control signals from expressions via a Motion Signal Processing (MSP) module, and employs a Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) module to adjust the contribution of motion cues during temporal decision making. In addition, a Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) module is introduced to build expression-relevant temporal stages, providing a compact temporal candidate space for motion calibration. Through extensive evaluation on six standard benchmarks, including Ref-YouTubeVOS, Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS (valid/valid$^u$), A2D-Sentences, and JHMDB-Sentences, the superiority of our method is validated. We will release the code on https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC.

AI.tldr: 提出一个表达式驱动的运动校准（EMC）框架用于视频指代分割（RVOS），通过显式提取表达式中蕴含的运动语义信号，并自适应调节运动信息的贡献，在六个标准基准上验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有RVOS方法通常在统一的跨模态时序建模框架中隐式引入运动信息，但未显式建模语言描述对运动语义的依赖性，难以根据不同的语义需求自适应地调整运动信息的运用。
AI.method: 提出三个核心模块：(1) Motion Signal Processing (MSP) 模块从表达式中提取可解释的运动控制信号；(2) Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) 模块在时序决策过程中调节运动线索的贡献；(3) Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) 模块构建与表达式相关的时序阶段，提供紧凑的时序候选空间用于运动校准。
AI.result: 在Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS（valid/valid^u）、A2D-Sentences和JHMDB-Sentences六个标准基准上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模表达式中的运动语义并自适应校准运动信息贡献，EMC框架有效提升了RVOS性能，并计划开源代码。

title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
summary: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统，将在一台设备上学习到的击键动力学特征迁移适配至另一台设备，并结合有限的目标设备训练数据训练二元分类器，在BBMAS数据集上达到14.2%的等错误率，超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 击键动力学作为一种行为生物特征在单设备认证中表现良好，但跨设备场景下由于设备形态差异（如手机与平板）导致打字模式分布漂移，使在一台设备上学到的动力学无法直接用于另一台设备的认证。亟需解决跨设备环境下的用户认证问题。
AI.method: 提出基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统。首先将源设备上学到的击键动力学迁移适配至目标设备，然后将适配后的数据与目标设备上有限的训练数据相结合，用于鲁棒地训练二元分类器。此外，使用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕捉判别性动力学特征。
AI.result: 在BBMAS数据集上的实验表明，该系统在跨设备场景下达到14.2%的等错误率（EER），超越了现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过归纳迁移学习结合扩展特征集，能够有效缓解跨设备场景下的分布漂移问题，实现可靠且优于现有方法的跨设备击键动力学用户认证。

title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
summary: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.

AI.tldr: 提出了SIGMA-Lane，一种针对视频车道线检测中遮挡导致的状态污染问题的解决方案。该方法通过在状态空间模型(SSM)的写入和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，结合结构空间检索(SSR)从对齐的历史先验中恢复缺失车道结构，在VIL-100和OpenLane-V数据集上实现了更好的时间稳定性和有竞争力的精度。
AI.motivation: 视频车道线检测需要在帧间保持预测稳定，但严重的车辆遮挡会破坏时间线索。流式循环模型中，被污染的观测值可能进入隐藏状态，导致错误在后续帧中持续传播。现有的遮挡感知优化方法通常仅将障碍物掩码作为辅助输入，无法直接保护状态更新路径。该工作将这一问题正式化为SSM时间建模中的状态污染问题。
AI.method: 提出SIGMA-Lane，其核心是在SSM的写入路径和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，从而控制当前观测如何进入时间记忆以及在时间传播后如何融合回来。在坐标一致的仿射对齐之后，模型结合两条互补路径：(1) SSM一致的双重门控用于时间滤波；(2) 结构空间检索(SSR)用于从对齐的历史先验中恢复缺失的车道结构。
AI.result: 在VIL-100和OpenLane-V数据集上的实验表明，在重度遮挡场景下时间稳定性得到提升，同时F1分数和mIoU指标具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SIGMA-Lane通过遮挡感知门控直接保护SSM状态更新路径，有效缓解了状态污染问题，证明了在SSM框架下从模型内部机制层面处理遮挡鲁棒性的可行性，并取得了具有竞争性的车道线检测性能。

title: Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning
summary: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAILS（Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping），一个轻量级的后预训练模块，通过固定任务锚点作为持久参考，在表征层面直接纠正输入特征以解决跨任务预测的歧义问题，可无缝集成到多种持续学习方法中，仅需极少参数开销即可提升分类和任务推断性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型为持续学习提供稳定表征，但适应单个任务并不能保证对所有已学任务的可靠推理。由于任务边界常是人为且语义纠缠的，即使有强大的PTM特征，来自未知任务的输入仍可能产生歧义，跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: TAILS是一个轻量级后PTM模块，通过解耦步骤优化。它使用固定的任务锚点作为累积知识的持久参考，将每个样本的特征表征相对于这些锚点进行解释，随后跨任务组合相关证据形成潜记忆（latent recall）。TAILS直接用潜记忆在预测前纠正特征表征，而非选择任务特定路径或调整分类器输出，从而在表征层面解决跨任务歧义，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。
AI.result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上进行的大量实验表明，TAILS能够以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本提升分类性能和任务推断性能。
AI.conclusion: TAILS验证了在表征层面解决跨任务歧义的有效性：通过在预测前直接修正特征而非依赖任务路径选择或分类器调整，可以在不改变现有模型架构的前提下显著提升持续学习中的跨任务推理可靠性。

title: Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection for Natural Scenes
summary: To date, all natural scene skeleton detection follows the paradigm of taking RGB images as the sole input; despite notable progress, methods under this paradigm suffer significant performance degradation on complex-content images. We observe that depth images are inherently insensitive to color and texture, and can provide clear regional contours and inter-region spatial relationships, which naturally alleviates the difficulty of skeleton detection in complex scenarios. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出以深度图像为主导模态、RGB图像为辅助模态的自然场景骨骼检测新范式，并提出了相应的DDSkel模型。该模型采用非对称编码器结构（RGB分支参数仅为深度分支的12%），以36%的可训练参数在所有方法中于最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的自然场景骨骼检测均以RGB图像作为唯一输入，但在复杂内容图像上性能显著下降。作者观察到深度图像对颜色和纹理不敏感，能提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系，有助于缓解复杂场景下骨骼检测的困难，因此提出以深度为主模态的新范式。
AI.method: 提出DDSkel模型：采用非对称编码器设计将RGB信息融合进深度特征，其中RGB模态分支的参数仅为深度模态分支的12%，整体结构简洁，无复杂设计。
AI.result: DDSkel仅使用当前最佳方法36%的可训练参数，在最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上超越了所有现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度图像作为主导模态、RGB作为辅助模态的骨骼检测范式是可行且有效的，能够在显著减少参数量的同时提升复杂场景下的检测性能。

title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
summary: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了OceanDepths，这是首个开放、全球尺度、AI-ready的海洋再网格化数据集，将卫星遥感海表数据（SST、SSS、SSH）与EN4现场观测的次表层温盐剖面配对，并辅以GLORYS12再分析数据。数据集覆盖2000-2024年，分辨率0.1°×0.1°、周时间步长，包含超过950万个配对剖面并插值到50个标准化深度层，旨在支持次表层状态重建、预测等AI方法研究。
AI.motivation: 全球海洋占地球表面70%以上，但观测严重不足。现有资源要么是模型重建的网格化产品而非真实观测，要么仅覆盖单一变量或海盆，要么分辨率不足以捕捉中尺度动力学。缺乏将卫星海表和原位深度剖面配对的高分辨率、AI-ready标准格式数据集。
AI.method: 将卫星L4产品（SST、SSS、SSH）与EN4次表层温盐剖面进行空间配对，插值到50个标准化深度层，并匹配合GLORYS12再分析数据以支持对比或多阶段学习。数据集覆盖全球2000-2024年，0.1°×0.1°空间分辨率、周时间分辨率，提供可配置的全球等尺寸空间patch划分系统。
AI.result: 构建了包含超过950万个配对剖面的全球数据集，具有4D多变量结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度和极稀疏的次表层观测特性（每个深度层仅约0.01%覆盖率），并以简单基线模型的次表层状态重建作为示例任务展示了其作为挑战性测试平台的可行性。
AI.conclusion: OceanDepths作为首个观测驱动的全球AI-ready海洋数据集，为次表层状态重建、基于观测的预测方法开发及其他相关任务提供了极具挑战性的测试平台，弥补了海洋观测数据AI就绪化的空白。

title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation
summary: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学影像分割中实例级病灶检测与体素级重叠度量不匹配的问题，提出Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP)方案，通过按病例预测病灶负荷调整组件尺寸阈值来提升Lesion-F1。在ISLES'26基准上，VCAP将Lesion-F1提升0.032，约为任何架构改进效果的6倍。同时提出的Viola2Plus架构虽然未改变小病灶Dice，却将小病灶检测率提升3.7%，揭示仅靠体素重叠度量会遗漏真实效果。5折交叉验证下，两架构集成后处理方案在训练集上达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614。
AI.motivation: 实例级病灶检测在医学图像分割中日益重要，但大多数流程仍仅为体素重叠而训练和后处理。尤其对小病灶而言，近失预测（重叠充分但略低于实例匹配阈值）与完全漏检得分相同，这种不匹配问题最为突出。作者希望弥合体素级度量与实例级检测目标之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP)方案，根据每个病例的预测病灶负荷动态调整组件尺寸阈值，而非使用固定阈值。此外设计了面向小病灶分割的分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus，并采用两架构集成的后处理策略。
AI.result: VCAP在无偏交叉折叠估计中将Lesion-F1提升0.032，约为任何架构变更效果的6倍。Viola2Plus虽未改变小病灶Dice，但将小病灶检测率提升3.7%。5折交叉验证下，后处理的两架构集成达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614，优于未处理单模型基线的0.644和0.573。
AI.conclusion: 后处理环节在弥合体素重叠度量与实例级检测目标之间的差距上远比架构设计更为关键。仅依赖体素重叠指标会产生误导性结论，可能遗漏对实例级检测有实质影响的改进。自适应后处理应成为实例级病灶检测流程中不可或缺的组成部分。

title: Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints
summary:
We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多子集路由（MSR）框架，一种新的在线路由算法，学习者维持一个多项分布路由策略而非确定性专家子集，每轮采样M个专家，奖励取决于路由子集中表现最佳者，并通过结合在线镜像下降与Blackwell可逼近性提出OMD-Approachability算法，证明达到O(1/√T)的遗憾与约束违例。
AI.motivation: 现有组合赌博机或子集选择方法针对确定性子集且假设加性奖励，无法捕捉跨专属模型路由场景中奖励仅取决于路由子集中最优专家的结构；此外，实际应用需要满足长期双向操作约束，现有方法无法处理此类带约束的在线路由问题。
AI.method: 提出MSR框架，将路由策略参数化为K个专家上的多项分布，每轮从中i.i.d.采样M个专家形成路由子集。算法层面提出OMD-Approachability，将在线镜像下降（OMD）与Blackwell可逼近性（Approachability）相结合，在仅观察到获胜者奖励的bandit反馈下，同时优化奖励并满足长期双向操作约束。
AI.result: 理论上证明OMD-Approachability在奖励和约束违例两方面均达到O(1/√T)的遗憾界；并在真实世界众包数据集上进行实证验证，证明了框架和算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为以最优专家奖励为导向的随机子集路由问题提供了首个在线学习框架，填补了标准组合赌博机方法无法覆盖的空白，同时为带长期双向约束的实际路由应用提供了理论保证与实证支持。

title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
summary: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用合成数据增强方法（GAN和DDPM）解决乌克兰战争导致的农田受损卫星图像分类中标注数据稀缺和不平衡的问题。通过类条件生成模型生成额外样本用于训练增强，评估显示DDPM平衡增强配置将准确率从84%提升至88%，平衡准确率从67%提升至81%，宏F1从65%提升至78%，少数类召回率从41%提升至69%，证明了合成卫星图像在数据稀缺的地理空间应用中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 监测乌克兰战争对农田的破坏对粮食安全、环境稳定性和战后恢复至关重要，但基于卫星图像的计算机视觉系统开发受限于标注图像稀缺，尤其是受损农田的标注数据不足，迫切需要解决有限和不平衡训练数据下的分类问题。
AI.method: 训练类条件生成对抗网络（GAN）和去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）在真实卫星图像上，生成额外的炸弹破坏和未破坏农田样本用于训练增强；使用Vision Transformer作为分类器，在多种真实与合成数据混合配置下评估各生成方法的实用性，所有下游评估均在纯真实测试集上进行。
AI.result: 最佳配置为基于平衡DDPM增强，将准确率从84%提升至88%，平衡准确率从67%提升至81%，宏F1从65%提升至78%，少数类（未破坏类）召回率从41%提升至69%。
AI.conclusion: 合成卫星图像增强在数据匮乏的战区地理空间应用中具有显著潜力，DDPM相较于GAN在少数类样本增强上表现更优，为数据稀缺条件下的战争影响监测提供了可行方案。

title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
summary: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FETERS，一个面向少样本场景的早期时间序列分类(ETSC)框架。它通过类间留一法在支持集上选择数据集级停止比例，并使用基于惩罚的奖励函数管理准确率-及时性权衡，避免训练额外的停止模块。同时结合Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos表征进行分类。在69个公开数据集上的实验表明，FETERS在5-shot设置下达到SOTA性能，在38个数据集上获得最佳HM，并在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ETSC方法大多依赖充足的标注训练数据，这在标注受限的实际应用中不切实际。在有限监督下，训练额外的样本级停止模块和提取有效分类特征都面临挑战，因此需要一种能够在少样本条件下进行早期时间序列分类的方法。
AI.method: FETERS框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 通过支持集上的类别级留一法(LOO)评估来选择数据集级的停止比例，并采用基于惩罚的奖励函数来管理准确率与及时性之间的权衡，从而避免训练样本级停止模块；(2) 将Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos时间序列基础模型表征相结合用于分类。
AI.result: 在涵盖14个领域的69个公开数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FETERS在5-shot设置下取得SOTA性能，平均调和均值(HM)最高，且在38个数据集上取得最佳HM，在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法。在full-shot设置下FETERS同样保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FETERS通过数据集级停止策略替代样本级停止模块、结合Rocket特征与Chronos表征，有效解决了少样本ETSC中的挑战，在准确率与及时性的权衡管理中展现出有效性，适用范围从少样本到全监督场景。

title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
summary: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Routed Tensor Adapters (SRTA)，一种紧凑的多域视觉适配框架。SRTA将每个输入投影到低秩空间，利用可学习的域矩阵计算路由权重，并据此混合共享Tucker核的切片，生成样本特定的适配矩阵，无需外部门控网络。通过渐进式深度加权路由目标强化通路学习，在五个异构多域视觉分类基准上，以远少于MoE风格PEFT对照模型的参数（如4域设置2.77M vs MoLoRA的9.52M）达到相当或略优的平均精度。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉表示需要能跨异构领域自适应，但标准低秩适配器对所有输入使用固定子空间，在面对风格、背景和语义上下文差异很大的领域时受限。MoE式适配器虽能通过多专家通路提升专业化，但常依赖外部路由器和大型专家库，增加了参数量并使路由与适配分离。因此需要一种紧凑、无外部门控且能实现领域感知特化的适配框架。
AI.method: SRTA将每个输入投影到低秩空间，从该表示中通过可学习的域矩阵计算路由权重，然后利用这些权重混合共享Tucker核的切片，生成样本特定的适配矩阵。该方法无需外部门控网络，允许共享视觉因子被复用，同时支持领域感知特化。此外，引入渐进式深度加权路由目标，跨适配器层监督路由决策以强化通路学习。
AI.result: 在五个异构多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA相比MoE风格PEFT基线取得相当或略强的平均精度，同时使用显著更少的可训练参数。在rank为64时，4域设置下仅用2.77M参数（MoLoRA为9.52M），6域设置下用3.00M参数（MoLoRA为14.31M），展现了优秀的精度-参数权衡。
AI.conclusion: SRTA提供了一种有效的精度-参数权衡方案，用于将视觉基础模型适配为通用的多域表示，在不依赖外部路由和大型专家库的前提下实现了紧凑且领域感知的自适应。

title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
summary: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"完全可塑性"（total plasticity）作为终身学习的公理：模型任何部分（包括结构）都不应被冻结。由此推导出一种"可生长的软模型"治理体系——通过结构算子（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、循环、注意力头）的代数运算实现模型持续增长，每个算子在应用时精确、有预算、可审计，且采用与否完全由留出"现实门"（reality gate）决定，统一对待参数与结构变化。系统由生产级LLM端到端操作，实验证明治理式增长能在长时间任务序列上保持学习能力，并以前注册方式完整报告了失败案例。
AI.motivation: 当前神经系统的标准范式是"先训练后部署"，在这一模式下模型被冻结两次：一是训练结束，二是拓扑结构本身从一开始就不是自由变量。作者以"完全可塑性"为公理反其道而行，认为长寿命模型面临非平稳流式数据时，其稳定性应来自治理而非僵化，容量应随需求变化，因此需要一种面向结构演化的治理机制。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个"可生长的软模型"：定义结构算子的代数（宽度扩展、层级增加、组合、输入接口变化、循环生长、注意力头增加），每个操作在应用时精确、有预算、可审计；结构变更与参数变更一样，采用与否统一由一个留出的"现实门"（held-out reality gate）裁定。整个系统从零实现，由生产级LLM端到端操作其工厂接口（factory surface）。评估采用前注册（pre-registered）的实验程序，在标准持续学习基准上测试，并将失败案例以同等显著性报告。
AI.result: 实验表明：在测量的场景中，新容量的边际价值在采用前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理必须采用事后（ex-post）形式。治理式增长在标准持续学习基准的长任务序列上保持了继续学习的能力。前注册实验同时报告了正面与负面结果，形成了一张完整的结果图谱。
AI.conclusion: 从公理出发可推出两个结构性结论：第一，终身变化下的稳定性变成了生命周期的可审计属性（audit property）；第二，随需求而变的结构消除了固定拓扑对后续能力设置的隐性上限（即容量下限约束处）。第三个结论由测量得出：增长治理在实用上必须采取事后形式。作者强调贡献在于完整的结果图谱——包括正面和负面发现。

title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
summary: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合流匹配（joint flow matching）方法，通过双时间步（dual-timestep）公式同时建模细胞潜变量与药物浓度，实现基于剂量的单细胞形态变换与浓度估计，支持连续剂量控制并泛化到未见剂量。
AI.motivation: 现有的细胞扰动预测方法存在两个局限：一是将扰动建模为分布到分布的映射，缺乏对浓度的显式处理；二是将浓度视为离散类别标签，无法实现连续的剂量控制。这促使作者引入可同时建模细胞潜变量与浓度的框架，以实现剂量条件化的连续单细胞形态变换。
AI.method: 提出一种联合流匹配方法，通过双时间步公式同时建模细胞潜变量（cell latents）和药物浓度（drug concentration）。利用流匹配的可逆性（invertibility）实现剂量条件化的单细胞形态变换（dose-conditioned single-cell morphing）。联合公式在潜空间中诱导出单调的剂量-响应几何结构（monotonic dose-response geometry），并支持从细胞形态进行浓度估计。
AI.result: 在两种化合物上相比代表性基线方法，在逐浓度（per-concentration）指标上取得具有竞争力或更优的结果；同时展示了模型可以泛化到训练中未见过的剂量（unseen dose held out during training）。此外，该方法还提供了离散分类方法在结构上无法实现的能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合流匹配方法通过同时建模细胞潜变量与药物浓度，实现了连续剂量控制下的单细胞形态预测，优于或匹敌现有基线，并具备浓度估计和未见剂量泛化等离散方法不具备的额外能力。

title: TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH
summary: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时间序列预测中的组合算法选择与超参数优化（TS-CASH）问题，提出了TRACE-CASH——一种结合分组Actor-Critic候选生成与固定规则的混合序贯优化器，并在41个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种基线方法对比，TRACE-CASH在MASE和WQL上取得最低平均秩。
AI.motivation: CASH问题在时间序列预测场景下更为复杂，涉及时序选择、时间顺序验证和昂贵评估成本；然而目前缺乏在统一TS-CASH评估协议下对异构搜索方法的受控对比研究。
AI.method: TRACE-CASH是一种任务局部混合序贯优化器，由模型Actor提出初始预测模型，三个条件Actor分别生成时间、架构和训练动作，并由模型特定解码器构建最终配置。同时结合固定规则用于模型覆盖、验证引导的利用以及停滞后的探索。
AI.result: 在41个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种替代方法（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标和语言模型辅助搜索）对比，TRACE-CASH在MASE和WQL上均取得最低平均秩，且在预定义的完整窗口和晚期窗口也具有最低的窗口平均测试MASE秩。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明完整的TRACE-CASH流程在所评估的方法中具有竞争力。

title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
comment: To appear at GCPR 2026 (oral paper). Project page: https://visinf.github.io/cefito
summary: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CEFITO方法，将程序规划建模为任务约束优化问题，通过学习动作条件表示空间并排除不相关动作，在两个基准上达到SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 现有程序规划方法（前馈神经网络或扩散模型）直接预测动作序列，将所有动作视为等可能，无法强制执行任务特定的逻辑约束（即某些动作在该上下文中不可能或无关），导致规划不合理。
AI.method: CEFITO分为两步：(1) 学习一个预测器来构建动作条件表示空间（action-conditioned representation space）；(2) 将程序规划重构成任务约束优化问题，在推理时显式地推理动作空间，通过省略不相关动作来求解最优动作序列。
AI.result: CEFITO在两个已建立的程序规划基准上取得了最先进的准确率（state-of-the-art accuracy）。
AI.conclusion: 通过对动作空间进行显式推理并在推理时排除不相关动作，将程序规划问题重新公式化为约束优化能够有效提升规划性能，优于现有直接预测动作序列的方法。

title: Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG)，通过共享高斯几何与高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）解耦空间结构与光谱衰减变化，在50个投影视图下实现稀疏视角光谱CT重建的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角光谱CT重建需要同时处理角度欠采样和光谱耦合两个挑战，现有方法通常需要独立优化各通道的几何结构，未充分利用光谱间的共享空间结构信息，缺乏连续的光谱维度表示能力。
AI.method: 提出4D-SG框架：1）从全光谱结构投影中学习共享的高斯几何参数；2）设计GSC-Net预测每个高斯的原始密度变换，将空间结构因子与光谱衰减变化因子分离；3）通过该因子化解耦建立从离散光谱测量到连续4D表示的映射，支持未观测光谱通道的查询。
AI.result: 在6个数据集（含合成、模拟投影和真实投影）50视图下取得最佳平均性能。相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56dB提升至36.61dB，SSIM从0.909提升至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。
AI.conclusion: 4D-SG通过共享结构-光谱密度解耦的因子化设计，有效避免了各通道独立几何优化，在稀疏视角光谱CT重建上显著优于现有高斯基线方法，验证了连续4D高斯表示在该任务中的有效性。

title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
comment: Project page: https://shapsider.github.io/PertMind/ Code: https://github.com/shapsider/PertMind Model: https://huggingface.co/tzcfly/PertMind
summary: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PertMind，利用细胞扰动图谱作为强化学习环境，将基因响应作为可计算奖励来训练生物推理模型，在无需任务特化微调的情况下实现了跨多类生物任务的迁移推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型具备描述生物机制的能力，但可扩展的后训练仍依赖昂贵且需要人工整理的生推理轨迹。现有方法缺乏可规模化、自动化的训练信号来源。
AI.method: PertMind将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境：以基因响应作为可计算的奖励信号，采用可信轨迹的监督初始化，结合基因、通路和格式层面的强化信号进行训练。仅以正向扰动-响应预测作为训练任务。
AI.result: 在未见细胞情境中改善了响应推断，保留了通用语言能力；无需任务特定后训练即可迁移至反向扰动识别、双重扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释等任务；生成的生物特征在跨尺度下游任务中支持了有竞争力的基因、细胞和供体表征。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持如下假设：对实验端点进行强化可以集中并利用预训练模型中已有的可复用生物策略。扰动驱动的强化学习为将不断扩展的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理的训练环境提供了可扩展路径。

title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

AI.tldr: SG-NCA是首个基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的手术视频场景图生成框架，通过NCA多类分割和轻量关系预测器实现在无风扇边缘设备上的部署，参数数量比现有方法少55倍，性能与基线相当。
AI.motivation: 现有手术场景图生成方法依赖参数庞大的深度学习模型，在手术室部署面临硬件占用大、卫生约束（需要无风扇设备）、延迟和数据隐私等问题，亟需轻量化方案。
AI.method: SG-NCA结合NCA多类分割（用于高效的目标检测和特征提取）与轻量级关系预测器，是首个基于NCA的场景图生成方法，也是首个能够学习结构化表示的NCA框架。在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上进行评估，并在无风扇边缘设备上部署。
AI.result: 在两类手术视频数据集上，SG-NCA达到了与既有基线相当的性能，同时参数数量减少55倍，并成功部署于无风扇边缘设备，支持下游应用如手术视频字幕生成。
AI.conclusion: SG-NCA证明了NCA在手术场景图生成中的可行性，为经济实惠、隐私保护且适用于手术室的术中场景理解提供了新途径，具有部署到无风扇设备的实际优势。

title: Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN
comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), ICML 2026
summary: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.

AI.tldr: Localized TabICLv2通过仅为每个测试点检索k个最近邻训练样本（基于模型Stage 2行表示空间的相似度），在不改变架构的前提下降低了全上下文表格ICL的推理成本，并通过额外的Stage 2/3微调保持98.64%的准确率，同时实现2.18倍批量推理加速和约249倍单查询推理加速。
AI.motivation: 全上下文表格数据上下文学习（TabICL）的注意力成本随训练上下文规模增长而增加，限制了其在大规模数据集上的高效处理能力。现有最佳模型TabICLv2虽然在分类任务上表现优异，但其推理成本成为实际应用的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Localized TabICLv2方法：1）在Stage 2行表示空间中计算相似度，为每个测试点仅检索k个最近邻训练邻居，替代使用完整训练上下文；2）无需任何架构改动；3）通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调来提升准确率保留程度。
AI.result: 在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部化模型保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%准确率；批量推理场景下实现中位数2.18倍加速；单查询服务场景下达到约249倍中位数加速。
AI.conclusion: 局部检索策略能够在几乎不损失准确率的前提下显著降低表格ICL的推理开销，特别是在单查询服务场景中收益巨大，为表格基础模型的大规模部署提供了可行路径。

title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RISE框架，涵盖路侧序列的度量3D跟踪和结构化视觉语言推理。在度量跟踪方面，采用图像纯方法结合SAM3视频身份与标定引导的掩码一致性实现多视角身份关联，无需LiDAR或任务特定3D训练即可恢复持久3D轨迹，在20个人工审核片段中达到66.9 MOTA。在视觉语言推理方面，构建了RISE-VQA数据集（含33,910个QA对、557个片段、16个交叉路口、61个路侧视角）及RISE-Bench基准，实验表明域适应和时间上下文带来收益，但空间定位、未来定位和交互推理仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 路侧感知对于智能交通和自动驾驶至关重要，但现有方法面临两大挑战：一是度量3D跟踪通常依赖LiDAR或任务特定的3D训练数据，难以在不同路口泛化；二是缺乏针对路侧场景的、基于结构化视觉语言推理的评测基准，难以评估模型在真实路口环境中的理解和预测能力。
AI.method: RISE框架包含两部分：(1)度量3D跟踪：图像纯方法结合SAM3视频身份与标定引导的掩码一致性进行多视角身份关联，利用标定条件化几何实现在不同标定多摄像头路口直接实例化，无需布局特定重新训练；(2)视觉语言推理：通过人工审核的MLLM流程挖掘高价值片段，利用受限全上下文Oracle构建带有bbox锚定的预测性QA（不向被测模型暴露未来证据），构建RISE-VQA数据集和路侧保持（intersection-held-out）的RISE-Bench基准，采用确定性任务特定指标评测语义选择、坐标、未来框和交互集。
AI.result: 在20个人工审核的多路口片段上，生成的3D轨迹达到66.9 MOTA（多视角评测范围内）。RISE-VQA包含33,910个QA对，覆盖557个片段、16个路口和61个路侧视角。实验表明域适应和时间上下文普遍带来性能提升，但空间定位、未来位置预测和交互推理仍是持续性挑战。
AI.conclusion: RISE提供了首个连接度量3D跟踪与结构化视觉语言推理的路侧框架，展示了无LiDAR、无任务特定3D训练即可在跨路口泛化的可行性，同时通过RISE-VQA/RISE-Bench揭示了当前模型在空间接地、未来定位和交互推理方面的显著不足，为路侧智能感知与推理研究指明了改进方向。

title: Reference-free logged energy-oracle recovery for neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems: conforming Riesz reconstruction and archive-level selection
summary: Neural PDE training yields a finite checkpoint archive, yet its logged energy errors are inaccessible without the exact solution, while loss-based selection does not necessarily recover the logged energy oracle. For admissible neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems, we introduce a reference-free selection rule based on minimizing a computable conforming Riesz monitor. The exact residual-energy identity and conforming projection make the monitor an unconditional lower bound converging monotonically to each logged energy error under nested conforming refinement; under saturation, hierarchical enrichment yields a computable upper estimate and hence a lower-upper bracket. A key finding is that archive selection is order-sensitive: unresolved checkpoint-dependent components can reverse the oracle-non-oracle ranking at finite resolution, so checkpointwise recovery alone is insufficient. For finite archives, we prove uniform recovery, yielding convergence to the logged-oracle error and, without saturation, logged-oracle selection at sufficiently fine auxiliary resolution. Under saturation, the bracket gives a computable near-oracle bound and certifies unique logged-oracle selection upon interval separation. We also bound logging-resolution loss and certify oracle inclusion over prescribed comparison trajectories. The resulting criterion replaces inaccessible exact-error minimization by computable, training-independent post-training selection on the intrinsic energy-error scale, requiring only the computed candidates and the variational problem. Experiments on diffusion and elasticity, including a non-manufactured perforated plate, demonstrate energy-scale calibration, oracle-level selection, and modest post-processing cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对神经网络求解对称强制变分问题时，无法直接获取精确解导致能量误差不可得的问题，提出了一种无需参考解（reference-free）的模型选择准则——共形Riesz监控器（conforming Riesz monitor）。该准则通过最小化一个可计算的监控量，为存档中的网络候选解提供能量误差的上下界括号（bracket），并在饱和（saturation）条件下实现近乎oracle级别的选择性能。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE训练产生的检查点存档（checkpoint archive）中记录了能量误差日志，但该误差在缺乏精确解时无法获取；而基于损失函数的选择并不能保证恢复日志中的能量oracle。因此需要一个仅依赖计算候选解和变分问题本身、无需精确解即可在能量误差尺度上进行模型选择的准则。
AI.method: 引入可计算的共形Riesz监控器作为选择准则。利用精确残差-能量恒等式与共形投影性质，使监控器成为无条件下界，并在嵌套共形细化下单调收敛至各日志能量误差。在饱和条件下，通过分层富集（hierarchical enrichment）构造可计算上界估计，形成上下界括号。针对有限存档证明一致恢复性，并分析存档选择对顺序敏感性（order-sensitive）问题。
AI.result: 证明了有限存档下的一致恢复性，使得选择结果收敛到日志oracle误差；在无饱和时可实现日志oracle选择；在饱和时括号给出可计算的近oracle界，并在区间分离时保证唯一日志oracle选择的认证。扩散与弹性实验（含非人造多孔板）表明该准则具备能量尺度校准、oracle级选择能力及较低的后期处理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将不可得的精确误差最小化替换为可计算的、与训练无关的后期选择准则，直接在固有能量误差尺度上工作，仅需计算候选解与变分问题本身。并揭示了存档选择对顺序敏感这一关键发现，说明仅靠检查点级恢复是不够的。

title: Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to IEEE APGARSS 2026
summary: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Code-as-City框架，将单张俯视图的城市布局提取转化为约束代码生成任务。通过多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的三次有序扫描，结合图像和五类语义先验，恢复道路、土地覆盖区域与关系、建筑，并经确定性归一化生成城市图和受限布局程序。执行程序可生成可渲染的3D城市布局及正交语义投影，支持像素级比较与编辑操作同步再生成。在CityLayout-100数据集的100个场景上，mIoU达41.1%，gIoU达48.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感系统输出检测框、语义掩码或矢量边界，虽能定位类别并支持图像平面评分，但不构成可执行布局——缺乏对象身份、类型化关系、拓扑结构及再生规则。因此需要一种能将视觉观测转化为可检验、可编辑的城市代码的方法。
AI.method: 该方法包含：(1) 图像模型生成对齐的五类语义布局先验；(2) 三次有序的MLLM传递，分别利用图像与先验恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及关系、建筑；(3) 确定性归一化将累积记录转换为城市图和受限布局程序；(4) 执行程序生成可渲染的3D城市布局与正交语义投影（共享几何）。
AI.result: 在CityLayout-100数据集的100个场景上，完整框架获得41.1%平均交并比（mIoU）和48.3%全局交并比（gIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果定量证明了视觉观测可被翻译为可检查、可编辑且具有平面与3D耦合输出的城市代码，为遥感城市理解提供了新的范式。

title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
summary:
AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).
  This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.

AI.tldr: Pallas是一个主动式KV缓存迁移框架，通过在手前预测目标基站并提前准备推理状态（历史前缀本地重建+动态后缀流式传输），同时进行源码端推理和令牌投递，大幅缩短服务中断时间并降低令牌间延迟。
AI.motivation: AI-RAN将LLM服务部署在移动用户附近，但蜂窝切换会导致活动请求与其推理状态分离：用户连接到目标基站，而庞大的KV缓存仍保留在源基站。若在源端保留推理可维持服务连续性但显著增加令牌间延迟（ITL）；若在目标端恢复状态则需切换后才进行KV缓存传输或重计算，直接延长服务中断时间（SIT）。现有方案无法同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: Pallas采用主动式KV缓存迁移：(1) 在切换触发时刻将token序列划分为稳定的历史前缀和动态演化的后缀；(2) 目标端通过本地prefill重建前缀，源端并行流式传输后缀生成的KV块；(3) 切换时目标端将两部分组装为最新的KV缓存并本地恢复解码，仅未完成的准备工作贡献于SIT；(4) 在线调度器基于移动性预测和运行时遥测选择预取窗口（即决定切换前多早开始准备）。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和100-500 Mbps的gNB间链路上，基于vLLM的原型相比目标端恢复方法平均将SIT降低2.28-89.68倍；相比源端转发方案平均将ITL降低16.0%-50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Pallas通过主动式KV缓存预迁移有效地在服务连续性与服务局部性之间取得平衡，显著降低了服务中断时间和令牌间延迟，为AI-RAN场景下的移动LLM服务提供了高性能的切换解决方案。

title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation
summary: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge. Existing deep generative methods suffer from two forms of brittleness: representation brittleness, caused by padding noise and feature contamination in the latent space, and generation brittleness, stemming from sequential error propagation and a train-inference mismatch due to non-differentiable validity enforcement. We propose HiFi-BRep, a novel framework that addresses these limitations through two synergistic contributions. First, a topology-aware encoder constructs a high-fidelity latent representation by eliminating padding via learnable queries and preventing feature contamination with topology-guided attention. Second, a single-stage decoder jointly predicts geometry and topology in parallel, embedding core manifold constraints as a differentiable learning objective. This design ensures mutual guidance between geometry and topology while avoiding cascaded errors. Extensive experiments show that HiFi-BRep significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both structural validity and geometric fidelity, providing a robust solution for high-quality B-Rep synthesis. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep.

AI.tldr: HiFi-BRep是一个针对计算机辅助设计中的边界表示(B-Rep)生成的深度学习框架，通过拓扑感知编码器和单阶段解码器分别解决表示脆弱性和生成脆弱性，在结构有效性和几何保真度上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: B-Rep生成是计算机辅助设计的基本任务，但直接合成高保真且结构有效的B-Rep仍具挑战。现有深度生成方法存在两种形式的脆弱性：一是由padding噪声和潜空间特征污染引起的表示脆弱性；二是由序列误差传播和非可微有效性约束导致的训练-推理不匹配所引发的生成脆弱性。
AI.method: HiFi-BRep框架包含两个协同贡献：(1) 拓扑感知编码器，通过可学习查询消除padding，并通过拓扑引导注意力防止特征污染，构建高保真潜表示；(2) 单阶段解码器，并行联合预测几何与拓扑，将核心流形约束嵌入为可微学习目标，实现几何与拓扑的相互引导并避免级联误差。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HiFi-BRep在结构有效性和几何保真度两方面均显著优于最先进方法，为高质量B-Rep合成提供了稳健的解决方案。代码和模型已公开。
AI.conclusion: HiFi-BRep通过消除padding噪声、防止特征污染以及采用可微流形约束的单阶段并行解码，有效解决了B-Rep生成中的表示脆弱性和生成脆弱性问题，成为高质量B-Rep合成领域的稳健方案。

title: Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems
summary: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. Power systems constitute an unusually rich benchmark setting for GML, as they combine hard physical constraints, multi-scale dynamics, safety-critical requirements, and scarce labeled data within a single, well-defined domain. Conversely, power systems can benefit from utilizing GML to complement classical solvers, as GML provide scalable, topology-aware approximations with promising generalization and computational efficiency. We identify open challenges, including limited real-world deployment and the need for interpretable models in safety-critical settings. Despite the rapidly growing number of publications, standardized benchmarks and open datasets remain scarce, leaving many results difficult to reproduce and undermining the long-term scientific credibility of the field. We further derive a structured requirements catalog for ML-ready power grid benchmarks, intended to guide future dataset development and improve reproducibility across studies. We call on the community to prioritize dedicated benchmark studies and the release of open datasets and models.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了近800篇图机器学习（GML）与电力系统交叉领域的论文，覆盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全六个方向，并提出了一套面向ML就绪电力系统基准的结构化需求目录，呼吁社区优先开发开放基准和数据集以提升可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统因可再生能源集成、去中心化和多时间尺度实时决策需求而日趋复杂，传统基于模型的方法虽然准确但运算速度无法满足运行需求。ML作为更快速的数据驱动替代方案应运而生，而图机器学习能将电网拓扑依赖作为归纳偏置，为电力系统运行提供自然框架。然而该领域缺乏标准化基准和开放数据集，导致结果难以复现，影响领域长期科学可信度。
AI.method: 对近800篇GML与电力系统交叉的论文进行系统性综述，覆盖六大应用方向：预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全。作者将电力系统定位为GML的富基准测试环境（具备硬物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键需求和稀缺标注数据），同时提出一个结构化的ML就绪电网基准需求目录，旨在指导未来数据集开发和提升跨研究的可复现性。
AI.result: GML为电力系统提供可扩展、拓扑感知的近似方法，具有良好的泛化能力和计算效率，能作为经典求解器的补充。但该领域存在开放挑战：实际部署有限、安全关键场景下可解释模型需求迫切、标准化基准和开放数据集稀缺，许多结果难以复现。
AI.conclusion: 电力系统与GML互为裨益：电力系统为GML提供了兼顾硬约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性与稀缺标签的丰富基准场景；GML则为电力系统提供了可扩展且拓扑感知的近似计算手段。领域需要优先推进基准研究、开放数据集和模型的发布，以巩固其长期科学可信度。

title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
comment: Accepted at ECCVW 2026, 14 pages, 4 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/AzharSindhi/RapidLiDAR
summary: LiDAR scene completion is a key component of 3D perception in autonomous driving, where the scene must be completed in real time to be usable in downstream tasks. Existing approaches typically follow an initialize-and-refine paradigm, in which a coarse initialization of the scene is first constructed, then refined into complete 3D geometry. Generative models are slower because they iteratively refine random Gaussian noise into the scene, while non-generative methods perturb the partial scene with a fixed noise scale, which limits coverage of large gaps and occluded regions and requires manual recalibration for each new sensor configuration. We present RapidLiDAR, a LiDAR scene completion method that treats the initialization itself as a learned, data-driven component. We propose an adaptive initialization module that predicts a spatially varying displacement for each partial input point, expanding the partial observations into a coarse scene initialization adapted to the local geometry, without requiring manual noise tuning. To refine this coarse initialization into a complete and coherent scene, we additionally propose a multi-scale reconstruction module that further refines point positions by querying multi-scale 3D voxel and 2D BEV feature maps constructed from the input scan. By replacing point-neighborhood operators such as farthest point sampling and $k$-nearest neighbor search with voxel- and BEV-based feature extraction, our architecture is faster and can handle different input resolutions by design. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 show that our method achieves completion performance on par with the state of the art while completing a full scene in 0.1 seconds, which is 2.3 times faster than the fastest prior method. This matches the 10 Hz acquisition rate of typical automotive LiDAR sensors, taking a step toward real-time LiDAR scene completion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RapidLiDAR，一种面向自动驾驶场景的实时LiDAR场景补全方法。与现有initialize-and-refine范式不同，该方法将初始化本身作为可学习的数据驱动组件，通过自适应初始化模块预测每个输入点的空间变化位移来生成粗场景初始化，无需手动噪声调优；再通过多尺度重建模块利用3D体素和2D BEV特征图细化点位置。实验表明在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-360上取得与SOTA相当的补全性能，同时以0.1秒完成全场景补全，比最快现有方法快2.3倍，满足10Hz车载LiDAR采集率。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR场景补全方法存在两个主要问题：生成式模型通过迭代细化随机高斯噪声，速度较慢；非生成式方法使用固定噪声尺度扰动部分场景，难以覆盖大间隙和遮挡区域，且需针对每种新传感器配置手动重新校准噪声参数。因此需要一种无需手动调参、能适应不同传感器配置的实时场景补全方法。
AI.method: RapidLiDAR包含两个核心模块：(1) 自适应初始化模块：预测每个局部输入点对应的空间变化位移，将部分观测扩展为适应局部几何的粗场景初始化，替代固定噪声尺度扰动；(2) 多尺度重建模块：通过查询3D体素和2D BEV特征图来细化粗初始化的点位置。架构上用体素和BEV特征提取替代最远点采样和k近邻搜索等点邻域操作，提升了速度并天然支持不同输入分辨率。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-360数据集上，RapidLiDAR的补全性能与最先进方法相当，同时补全整个场景仅需0.1秒，比最快现有方法快2.3倍，达到10Hz的典型车载LiDAR采集率。
AI.conclusion: RapidLiDAR通过将初始化作为可学习组件，并采用体素/BEV特征提取替代耗时点邻域算子，在保持SOTA性能的同时实现了实时LiDAR场景补全，向真实自动驾驶场景中的实时3D感知迈出了重要一步。

title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval
summary: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus.
