We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模智能体在结构化工具有效搜索中的"检索门"问题，发现同一检索器在不同来源切片上会发生性能塌缩（source-style collapse），并提出基于TF-IDF指纹的源感知路由方法ToolScout作为路由守卫，显著提升了覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 大规模智能体越来越依赖检索来获取外部能力，但在结构化工具和API场景中，检索层即使语料库固定也可能静默失败。现有工作忽视了检索器在不同来源切片上的性能差异，缺乏对此类失败模式的诊断和缓解手段。
AI.method: 1) 识别并定义source-style collapse失败模式：在同一benchmark的不同来源切片上，微调过的检索器表现崩溃性下降；2) 提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为检测检索器易失败来源风格的低成本信号，优于语义或长度代理指标；3) 提出ToolScout源感知路由方法，利用TF-IDF信号作为路由守卫，在混合查询流上实现动态路由。
AI.result: 在4,996条混合查询流上，TF-IDF路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%；跨5个塌缩来源上，仅20个匹配样例即可将覆盖率加权的全局top-1代理从1.3%提升至53.9%。当工具被重新渲染为可执行技能卡片时，失败和路由行为依然存在，排除了原始API schema格式作为唯一原因。
AI.conclusion: 检索门在结构化工具场景中存在可度量且可诊断的源风格塌缩问题，TF-IDF指纹提供了廉价有效的检测信号，ToolScout路由方法能显著缓解这一问题，且该现象不仅限于原始API格式，对可执行技能卡片同样适用。

title: MLLM-Guided Semantic Correction for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models and Transformer architectures have led to significant progress in text-to-video generation. However, these models often suffer from semantic errors such as missing objects, incorrect attributes, or mismatched actions. Although some semantic correction methods perform optimization before sampling or refinement after sampling, how to detect and correct semantic deviations during the video generation process remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a training-free, interpretable mid-generation correction framework that integrates multimodal large language model (MLLM) feedback directly into the diffusion sampling loop. Our framework achieves diffusion trajectory correction by injecting semantic evaluation signals during video synthesis, enabling the model to optimize the generated content through continuous self-reflection. We propose two key modules: a Semantic Assessment Supervisor that generates intermediate preview frames for semantic evaluations and deviation diagnostics, and a Semantic Modification Assistant that corrects semantic drift during inference via a controllable latent trajectory intervention. Our method improves semantic alignment, visual fidelity, and temporal consistency without modifying model parameters. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个训练免费、可解释的中间生成修正框架，通过将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）反馈直接集成到扩散采样循环中，在视频生成过程中实时检测并修正语义偏差，从而提升语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在文生视频任务中常出现语义错误（如缺失物体、属性错误、动作不匹配）。虽然已有方法在采样前进行优化或在采样后进行精炼，但在视频生成过程中实时检测和修正语义偏差的问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出一个训练免费、可解释的生成中间修正框架，包含两个关键模块：(1) 语义评估监督器（Semantic Assessment Supervisor），生成中间预览帧进行语义评估和偏差诊断；(2) 语义修改助手（Semantic Modification Assistant），通过可控潜在轨迹干预在推理过程中修正语义漂移。框架将MLLM反馈直接注入扩散采样循环，实现扩散轨迹修正。
AI.result: 在多个基准上进行了大量实验验证，该方法无需修改模型参数即可显著提升语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该训练免费的中间生成修正框架为文生视频中的语义纠错提供了一种新范式，通过将MLLM语义反馈集成到采样循环中实现连续自反思优化，在不改动模型参数的情况下有效缓解语义偏差问题。

title: One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing
comment: 3 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Design study: results are from four public corpora; measured silicon power and on-body capture are out of scope and deferred to follow-on hardware work
summary: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种腕戴式连续手部传感前端设计研究，该前端将MEMS惯性测量单元与60 GHz FMCW雷达配对，通过单一片上残差生成器统一实现分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU路由选择以及基于创新的EKF测量重新加权。该前端仅占用14.4 KB程序存储和278 B状态，在Ambitiq Apollo4 Blue Plus类边缘MCU上每帧运行110K次乘加操作。在四个公开数据集上达到检测概率0.72/0.80（1%虚警率），实现47%的分类器调用能量削减（90%手势检测召回率），并相比自适应卡尔曼基线将姿态跟踪RMSE降低4.6倍。
AI.motivation: 手势界面和运动症状监测需要始终开启的腕戴式手部传感前端，该前端必须适配纽扣电池功耗预算，同时将MEMS IMU与60 GHz FMCW雷达配对以在遮挡和人体漂移条件下保持鲁棒性。现有方案难以在超低功耗约束下同时实现可靠的感知和多模态融合。
AI.method: 提出一种腕带前端设计研究，核心创新是让三类功能——分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU之间的路由选择、基于创新的EKF测量重新加权——共享一个片上残差生成器。该共享生成器运行在Ambitiq Apollo4 Blue Plus类边缘MCU上，以极小的存储和计算开销实现统一的多模态感知处理。
AI.result: 在IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW雷达、EAT-Radar四个公开数据集上，前端在1%虚警率下达到检测概率P_D=0.72/0.80；在90%手势检测召回率下实现47%分类器调用能量削减；在测量偏差漂移下，相比带R膨胀的自适应卡尔曼基线，姿态跟踪RMSE降低4.6倍。片上功耗硅测和人体佩戴实测留待后续硬件工作。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了通过共享残差生成器在同一MCU上统一多种传感处理功能的概念可行性，在极小存储和计算开销下同时改善检测概率、分类器能量调用和抗漂移姿态跟踪性能。本文贡献为设计研究层面，硬件实现验证留待后续。

title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
comment: Paper accepted at 3rd HCV workshop at ECCV 2026. 12 pages main text, 16 pages supp
summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了三个通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类在目标导向视觉搜索（COCO-Search18）中的眼动扫描路径。在人类匹配的中央凹视觉输入条件下，模型在目标存在性判断和获取效率上达到或超过人类水平，但其注视过程与人类显著不同：模型产生低熵、大幅值、高度自一致的扫描路径。这表明MLLM采用单通道、非序列架构，与人类的串行搜索机制存在本质差异，而现有的答案对齐和显著性指标无法捕捉这一过程层面的差距。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉搜索是序列化的，需要中央凹逐点落位形成扫描路径。作者希望探究多模态大语言模型在相同中央凹输入条件下是否以与人类相似的方式进行搜索，这既关系到MLLM能否作为人类视觉的模型，也关系到注意力对齐分数的有效性。
AI.method: 在COCO-Search18数据集上，将三个通用MLLM与人类眼动扫描路径进行逐注视点对比。每个模型被逐注视点驱动通过与人类匹配的中央凹视图，并从三个独立维度评估：目标存在性决策、到达目标的高效性、以及注视过程本身。
AI.result: 三个维度出现分离：在决策和目标获取上，模型达到或超过人类表现（目标检测接近天花板水平，且比人类更快在首次扫视中到达目标）；但注视过程不符合人类特征——所有模型都表现出低熵、大幅值、高度自一致的扫描路径，模型自身的一致性远超两个人类之间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 匹配视网膜输入只能再现人类"看哪里"的空间结果，但无法再现人类"如何看"的时间过程。模型采用单通道、非序列的搜索架构，而非人类受视敏度限制的序列化搜索。不存在任何退化设置能同时恢复人类式搜索和人类式成功率。这一差距位于过程轴上，是答案对齐和显著性指标无法测量的，因此这些指标不能作为人类视觉的认证依据。

title: Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics
summary: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PCA-DMD，一种基于算子理论的框架，用于高分辨率多通道 LFP 神经记录的重建。它将记录分割为重叠窗口，投影到紧凑 PCA 空间，在潜空间中学习线性 Koopman 演化，并通过逆投影和重叠相加聚合重建连续信号。在多种数据集上超越经典 DMD 等方法，展现出优异的零样本跨主体泛化能力和计算可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 长时程神经记录（尤其是局部场电位 LFP）的重建具有挑战性，因为 LFP 是高分率、多通道、瞬态且跨主体变异性大的信号。现有的 DMD 类方法在处理此类高维、长时间序列时面临精度和可扩展性瓶颈，需要一种兼具解释性、泛化性和计算效率的框架。
AI.method: PCA-DMD 框架包含四个步骤：(1) 将 LFP 记录分割为重叠窗口；(2) 将窗口投影到紧凑的 PCA 潜空间以降低维度；(3) 在潜空间中学习线性 Koopman 算子演化以捕捉潜在动态；(4) 通过逆投影和重叠相加（overlap-add）聚合重建连续信号。这一流程结合了 PCA 的降维优势和 Koopman 算子理论对非线性动力学的线性化描述能力。
AI.result: 在 200,000 样本的海马体记录上，PCA-DMD 优于 Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD 和 HODMD，达到 KLD=0.0761 和 HD=0.0847。在 300,000 样本的全配对跨主体零样本泛化中，相关系数为 0.9504-0.9800。外部验证在 93 通道 Allen Neuropixels 记录上取得通道平均相关 0.7427。从 400,000 到 900,000 样本的可扩展性分析显示平均相关稳定在约 0.965-0.968。Koopman 谱分析显示主导特征值集中在单位圆附近。
AI.conclusion: PCA-DMD 提供了一个可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的框架，用于重建高维神经动态。它在大规模数据上的稳定表现、跨主体的零样本泛化能力以及对外部数据集的验证，表明其具有广泛的实用价值，可用于神经科学中长时程高维记录的准确重建与分析。

title: FLEET: Token-Based Feature Extraction for Event Camera-based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Event cameras generate asynchronous, high-frequency data streams offering spatially sparse information at lower latency than traditional cameras.In principle, these properties should be ideal for the design of control policies.However, reinforcement learning research in this field remains limited as existing approaches fail to fully exploit the sensor's properties.CNN-based methods negate the sensors benefits by aggregating events into sparse grids. This couples compute cost to sensor resolution and blurs the temporal information. Meanwhile, existing generative baselines rely on the availability of trajectory data to pretrain the model. We propose FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization), a feature extractor that processes event sequences directly. Leveraging random Fourier features and cross-attention, our architecture compresses variable streams into fixed-size latent representations. This decouples inference cost of the feature extractor's backbone from the sensor's resolution, enabling end-to-end learning without auxiliary losses. We validate FLEET on a new, high-throughput benchmark. The results demonstrate that our sequence-based approach surpasses SOTA performance and exhibits superior robustness to variations in observation frequencies.

AI.tldr: 提出FLEET，一种基于序列直接处理事件流的特征提取器，利用随机傅里叶特征和交叉注意力将可变长度事件流压缩为固定大小的潜在表示，解耦推理成本与传感器分辨率，无需辅助损失即可端到端学习，并在新基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有异步、高频、低延迟和空间稀疏等理想特性，但现有的强化学习算法未能充分发挥其优势：CNN方法将事件聚合为稀疏网格，导致计算成本与传感器分辨率耦合且模糊了时间信息；现有的生成式基线依赖轨迹数据预训练模型。因此需要一种能直接处理事件序列、充分利用事件相机特性的特征提取方法。
AI.method: FLEET架构包含两个关键组件：1) 随机傅里叶特征将事件流映射到高维特征空间，捕捉时序模式；2) 交叉注意力机制将可变长度的事件序列压缩为固定大小的潜在表示。整个架构以端到端方式学习，无需辅助损失函数，推理时骨干网络的计算成本与传感器分辨率解耦。
AI.result: 在一个新的高吞吐基准上验证了FLEET，实验结果表明该基于序列的方法在性能上超越了SOTA方法，并且对观测频率的变化表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FLEET证明了直接处理事件序列（而非聚合事件）的可行性，在保持高效推理的同时实现了更优的性能和更强的鲁棒性，为事件相机驱动的强化学习提供了新的研究范式。

title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
summary: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种生成式高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，能够捕获观测特定的污染（outliers）并自适应缓解其影响，利用变分广义期望最大化算法学习潜变量和模型参数，在合成与真实数据集上展现出与鲁棒GPR基线相当或更优的预测精度，且保持三次方计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯过程回归基于高斯观测似然，对异常值（outliers）高度敏感，异常值会严重扭曲模型的学习与预测结果，导致模型精度下降。
AI.method: 提出一种生成式GPR模型，建模观测特定的污染（observation-specific contamination）以自适应缓解异常值影响；采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized EM）算法对潜变量和GPR模型参数进行联合学习。
AI.result: 在多种污染设置下的合成与真实数据集实验中，该方法在预测精度上与鲁棒GPR基线相当，且在多个场景中表现更优；同时保持了与对比GPR方法相同的三次方（cubic）计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的生成式鲁棒GPR方法在保持标准GPR计算复杂度的前提下，有效应对异常值污染，为鲁棒高斯过程回归提供了一种竞争性方案。

title: Automatic Cephalometric Landmark Localization on CBCT-Derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs for Skeletal Malocclusion Classification
comment: Accepted for presentation at the ODIN 2026 Workshop, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Manual cephalometric landmark annotation is important for craniofacial assessment but is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce CephViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for automated 2D lateral cephalometric landmark localization, and evaluate its use in downstream skeletal malocclusion classification. CephViT was trained and benchmarked on a public lateral cephalogram dataset, achieving a mean radial error of 1.28 +/- 1.42 mm and a successful detection rate of 92.0% at 3.0 mm. Because the private evaluation cohort consisted of 3D CBCT scans, lateral cephalogram-like digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated from each volume and used as 2D inputs to the landmark localization model. Landmark coordinates were normalized into a common coordinate frame, and skeletal malocclusion classification was performed using landmarks shared between the reference and DRR-based pipelines. Classification performance using DRR-localized landmarks was comparable to that obtained using manually annotated reference landmarks, with accuracies of 70.0% and 68.3%, respectively. These results support the feasibility of automated cephalometric analysis on CBCT-derived DRRs for skeletal malocclusion assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CephViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的模型，用于自动化2D侧位头影测量标志点定位，并在下游骨骼性错颌分类中评估其性能。模型在公开数据集上平均径向误差为1.28±1.42 mm，3.0 mm阈值下成功检测率为92.0%。在CBCT生成DRR图像上的分类准确率（70.0%）与手动标注参考标志点的准确率（68.3%）相当。
AI.motivation: 手动头影测量标志点标注是颅面评估的重要环节，但工作量大且难以规模化，需要开发自动化方法以提高效率和可扩展性。
AI.method: CephViT采用Vision Transformer架构进行2D侧位头影标志点定位。对于3D CBCT评估队列，从每个体数据生成类似侧位头影的数字化重建射线片（DRR）作为2D输入；将标志点坐标归一化到共同坐标系，并仅使用参考与DRR流水线共享的标志点进行骨骼性错颌分类。
AI.result: 在公开侧位头影数据集上，CephViT平均径向误差为1.28±1.42 mm，3.0 mm阈值成功检测率为92.0%。基于DRR定位标志点的分类准确率为70.0%，与基于手动标注参考标志点的68.3%相当。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在CBCT衍生的DRR图像上实现自动化头影测量分析用于骨骼性错颌评估是可行的，其分类性能可与手动标注方法相媲美。

title: Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning
summary: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种名为Hoeffding自适应分裂树（Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees）的决策树模型，用于数据流分类的集成学习。该模型结合了Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略（促进集成多样性）与自适应分裂机制（通过变化检测算法识别性能退化并确定分裂点），解决了自适应分裂树作为集成基学习器时多样性不足的问题。实验证明该模型在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应方面均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自适应分裂决策树作为集成基学习器存在局限性，变化检测器往往无法在集成中促进足够的多样性。而标准Hoeffding树的周期性分裂机制虽然能促进多样性，但缺乏适应性。因此需要一种融合两者优势的新模型。
AI.method: 提出两种Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees模型，将Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略（保障集成多样性）与自适应分裂机制（利用变化检测算法检测性能下降并触发分裂）相结合，作为集成学习的基础学习器。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees在集成性能上有所提升，并在全面的评估中（包括基准比较、计算成本分析及概念漂移适应）取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的Hoeffding自适应分裂树有效解决了自适应分裂树作为集成基学习器时多样性不足的问题，通过融合周期性与自适应分裂策略，在数据流分类中实现了更优的集成性能和概念漂移适应能力。

title: Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution
summary: Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target. We introduce GalerkinFlow, an equation-agnostic framework that turns each coarse--fine pair into supervision along an entire reconstruction path. At a random sample of intermediate states on the reconstruction path, the model predicts the coarse-to-fine residual velocity and uses coarse-anchor point to define a pseudo-endpoint. We show that the reconstruction loss of this pseudo-endpoint is exactly related to the intermediate velocity loss through a known time-dependent weight. Consequently, every intermediate state contributes supervision toward the same fine target, rather than serving only as an internal step toward an endpoint loss. Because intermediate states already reveal part of the missing fine-scale structure, we additionally supervise the coarse endpoint used during one-step inference. A finite-difference objective further constrains local spatial variation. GalerkinFlow combines convolutional features with scale-conditioned Galerkin operator mixing and requires no governing equation or physical metadata. It achieves the lowest raw-space errors among the evaluated equation-agnostic baselines on Navier--Stokes and Darcy Flow, while remaining competitive on DIV2K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GalerkinFlow，一个与方程无关的超分辨率框架。它不只在最终高分辨率输出上监督，而是在整个重建路径上提供监督：在中间状态随机采样点预测粗到细的残差速度，并用粗锚点定义伪端点。该框架借助有限差分目标约束局部空间变化，结合卷积特征与尺度条件Galerkin算子混合，无需控制方程或物理元数据。在Navier-Stokes和Darcy Flow上取得最低原始空间误差，在DIV2K上也具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 大多数超分辨率模型只在最终高分辨率输出上进行监督，缺少对预测从下采样观测到精细目标之间演化过程的控制。这种单一的端点监督方式限制了模型对中间重建过程的约束能力。
AI.method: 作者提出GalerkinFlow框架：(1) 在重建路径上随机采样中间状态，让模型预测粗到细的残差速度，并通过粗锚点定义伪端点；(2) 证明了伪端点的重建损失与中间速度损失通过已知时间相关权重精确关联，使每个中间状态都直接对同一精细目标产生监督；(3) 额外监督单步推理中使用的粗端点（因为中间状态已揭示部分缺失的细节结构）；(4) 引入有限差分目标约束局部空间变化；(5) 将卷积特征与尺度条件Galerkin算子混合，框架无需控制方程或物理元数据。
AI.result: GalerkinFlow在Navier-Stokes和Darcy Flow上取得了所评估的与方程无关基线中最低的原始空间误差，在DIV2K上表现与现有方法相当。
AI.conclusion: GalerkinFlow证明了沿着整个重建路径提供监督、而非仅监督最终输出的超分辨率训练策略是有效的，在物理科学与自然图像超分辨率任务上均取得优异表现。

title: UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures
summary: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniTAC，一种单一的可在通用（任务无关）与任务专用之间灵活切换的学习图像编解码器，无需在运行时重新训练。通过将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量（例如从下游模型的梯度归因中提取），并以低开销边信息注入编码器和解码器，UniTAC在单一模型下同时达到接近任务专用编解码器的精度和优于通用编解码器的性能。
AI.motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶车辆和机器人）需要在严格的带宽、延迟和能量约束下及时交换高维感知信号。由于下游决策任务随时间演变，任务专用的编解码器缺乏灵活性，而针对每个任务重新训练在实际部署中不可行。因此需要一种既能覆盖通用到任务专用操作、又无需重新训练的单一编解码方案。
AI.method: UniTAC将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量（可从任意下游模型的梯度归因获得），作为低开销边信息同时条件化编码器和解码器。该方法在大量随机化的向量族上以加权重建失真为目标进行一次训练，保持固定骨干网络和单一可人类查看的重建。作者分析了加权率失真问题，刻画了对角加权失真何时任务一致以及权重与任务灵敏度的关系，并据此设计了基于Vision Transformer（ViT）的编解码器，通过token级条件化自然实现这一权重驱动的编码。
AI.result: 在本地化任务中，以0.034 bpp压缩率，单一UniTAC模型达到91.4%的准确率，仅比任务专用编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，且明显高于通用编解码器（76.9%）。
AI.conclusion: UniTAC验证了通过运行时注入重要性向量即可在同一模型内实现从通用到任务专用的平滑转换，无需重新训练，在任务变化场景下同时保持了高任务精度和低比特率压缩效率。

title: SQuad: Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) spend most of their compute inside the Self-Attention operation, whose cost grows quadratically, $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$, with the number of latent tokens $n$. For the task of video generation, the token count is large, so this term dominates runtime and memory, and thereby caps the resolution and duration we can generate. Linear $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and low-rank $\mathcal{O}(nk)$ surrogates of Self-Attention trade the full softmax $QK^T$ for cheaper kernels, but rarely recover the original's expressivity, leaving a stubborn quality gap. Motivated by this, we propose SQuad, a Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation framework that achieves a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n\sqrt{n})$ in the resulting distilled Attention, naturally balancing the efficiency v/s expressivity trade-off. Instead of training our own Video DiT from scratch, which is prohibitively expensive, we fit a pretrained full softmax Self-Attention DiT into our proposed SQuad-Attention one by distilling the former in two stages: Flow-Matching Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by improved Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) which additionally makes the sampling more efficient. On the Wan~2.2 5B text-to-video model, SQuAD matches the quadratic teacher on VBench ($83.20$ v/s $83.08$) while cutting the per-step per-block attention FLOPs by $\sim$$67\times$ and attention latency by $\sim$$11\times$, and end-to-end DiT latency by 2$\times$, all while also generating a video in only $6$ Neural Functional Evaluations (NFEs) instead of the default $100$.

AI.tldr: 提出SQuad框架，通过蒸馏将预训练的视频DiT模型中的二次复杂度Self-Attention替换为亚二次复杂度（O(n√n)）的注意力机制，在Wan 2.2 5B文本到视频模型上匹配教师模型性能的同时，将注意力FLOPs降低约67倍，注意力延迟降低约11倍，端到端DiT延迟降低2倍，并将采样步数从100步减少到6步。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中Self-Attention的O(n²)复杂度随着token数量的增加主导了计算和内存开销，限制了可生成的视频分辨率和时长。现有的线性O(n)和低秩O(nk)注意力变体虽降低了复杂度，但难以恢复原始全softmax注意力的表达能力，存在显著的质量差距。
AI.method: 提出SQuad（Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation）框架，将预训练的全softmax Self-Attention视频DiT蒸馏为SQuad-Attention架构，实现O(n√n)的复杂度。蒸馏过程分为两个阶段：首先进行Flow-Matching监督微调（SFT），然后采用改进的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD2）进一步加速采样。
AI.result: 在Wan 2.2 5B文本到视频模型上，SQuad在VBench评分上匹配二次复杂度教师模型（83.20 vs 83.08），同时将每步每块的注意力FLOPs降低约67倍，注意力延迟降低约11倍，端到端DiT延迟降低2倍，并且仅需6个NFE即可生成视频（默认需要100步）。
AI.conclusion: SQuad通过蒸馏技术在效率和表达能力之间取得了自然的平衡，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅降低了视频DiT的计算复杂度和推理延迟，同时显著减少了采样步数。

title: Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors
summary:
Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.
  Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.

AI.tldr: 提出第一个基于学习的方法L2UL（Learning-to-UnLearn），将机器遗忘函数U的设计从手工构建转变为从分布视角学习，以实现简单高效的模型遗忘，在数据密集型场景下性能与重训练相当且效率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘方法依赖人工设计复杂的遗忘函数U，当面对大规模训练数据时计算成本高昂，复杂结构成为性能瓶颈。需要一种更简单高效、模型无关的遗忘方法。
AI.method: 受Learning to Optimize启发，提出L2UL（Learning-to-UnLearn），这是第一个基于学习的模型无关方法。核心思路是从手工设计U转向从分布视角学习遗忘行为，通过学习获得简单高效的遗忘函数U。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，L2UL在准确率上与重训练方法相当，同时展现出显著的效率优势，尤其在数据密集型场景下表现突出。此外，在更大规模的ResNet模型上验证了方法的性能和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: L2UL通过将遗忘函数U的设计范式从手工构造转变为学习获得，成功在保持与重训练相当的准确率的同时大幅提升效率，为大规模机器学习模型提供了一种实用且可扩展的遗忘解决方案。

title: Ultra: Unsupervised Cross-Task Optimization for Reliable Restoration Segmentation Collaboration under Adverse Weather
summary: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Adverse Weather Semantic Segmentation (UDA-ASS) aims to transfer semantic knowledge from labeled normal-weather images to unlabeled adverse environments. Existing approaches implicitly assume that restoration and segmentation provide mutually beneficial guidance. However, under severe degradation and without target-domain supervision, the validity of cross-task optimization directions becomes fundamentally unidentifiable, leading to hallucination-driven error propagation. In this work, we propose a novel Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework (Ultra), which reframes cross-task interaction as direction selection under uncertainty and causal effect estimation, enabling reliable collaboration through candidate direction generation and intervention-based filtering. In detail, we propose CTDN and CMIL. The former exploits complementary visual structures and semantic information to generate candidate optimization directions and performs cooperative direction selection between restoration and segmentation. The latter reformulates cross-task information transfer from correlation-based propagation into causal effect assessment, suppressing hallucination propagation. Extensive experiments on three widely used UDA-ASS benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Beyond segmentation, our framework achieves better unsupervised restoration results than existing UDA-ASS restoration methods and generalizes to unsupervised restoration and object detection collaboration tasks. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra.

AI.tldr: 提出Ultra框架，通过候选方向生成与干预式因果效应过滤来重定义跨任务交互，解决恶劣天气下无监督域自适应语义分割中恢复与分割任务间的幻觉驱动错误传播问题，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有UDA-ASS方法隐式假设恢复和分割能相互提供有益引导，但在严重退化且缺乏目标域监督时，跨任务优化方向的有效性无法被识别，导致幻觉驱动的错误传播。
AI.method: 提出Ultra统一框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) CTDN利用互补视觉结构与语义信息生成候选优化方向，并在恢复与分割间进行协作方向选择；(2) CMIL将跨任务信息传递从基于相关性的传播重构为因果效应评估，抑制幻觉传播。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的UDA-ASS基准上取得SOTA语义分割性能；分割之外，无监督恢复效果优于现有UDA-ASS恢复方法，并能泛化到无监督恢复与目标检测协作任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将跨任务交互建模为不确定性下的方向选择与因果效应估计，Ultra实现了可靠协作，有效解决幻觉传播问题，并在分割、恢复及检测协作任务上全面验证了框架的优越性与泛化能力。

title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了伦理决策头（EDH）框架，将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号，通过深度强化学习（PPO）训练自动驾驶车辆在碰撞情境中学习道德对齐的驾驶行为。研究发现功利主义与康德主义两种规范框架的可学习性存在不对称性：康德主义条件作为管线控制确认训练稳定，而功利主义智能体学到的是人类评分者实际偏好的自我牺牲行为，而非理论上宣称的伤亡最小化，揭示了RLHF学习的是人类实际践行的伦理而非哲学家定义的伦理。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆（AV）达到L4和L5级别操作能力，其车载决策系统不仅要处理安全关键的移动控制，还要承担随之而来的道德权重。当前缺乏将伦理推理系统性地编码进自动驾驶强化学习框架的方法，需要一个可学习、可评估的伦理决策机制。
AI.method: 提出了伦理决策头（EDH）框架：将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号；实例化两种规范框架（功利主义最小化伤亡、康德主义强制维持行驶路线）；使用PPO训练；采用从200个碰撞临近场景成对人类偏好标注中学到的Bradley-Terry奖励模型。
AI.result: 结果显示两种规范伦理框架在人类监督下的可学习性呈现不对称性。康德主义条件退化为恒定预测任务，作为管线控制确认训练稳定性；功利主义智能体学到的是人类评分者偏好的自我牺牲行为而非伤亡最小化，且模型忠实学习了这种偏好。
AI.conclusion: 人类在理论上规定的伦理与实践中所奖励的行为之间存在显著分歧。RLHF并不学习哲学家定义的伦理学，而是学习人类实际践行的伦理，这暗示基于人类反馈的强化学习在伦理对齐方面存在根本性的局限。

title: Towards Zero-Shot Domain Generalization for ID Cards Presentation Attack Detection
summary:
Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) for national ID cards is limited by the lack of publicly available genuine samples, making it difficult for systems to generalize across countries. This paper introduces two main innovations: (1) a Prototypical Network head using an EfficientNet-V2-b0 backbone that requires only four genuine samples per class to create reliable prototypes; and (2) an episodic training regime that keeps PAD classes fixed while varying the card domain, allowing the network to learn universal attack cues.
  Evaluated on a large multi-country dataset and the public DLC-2021 benchmark, this method achieves an average Equal Error Rate of around 9\%, outperforming conventional softmax and CLIP zero-shot baselines even with data from a single source country. This approach provides accurate, privacy-preserving PAD while minimizing data collection, facilitating scalable cross-jurisdictional remote onboarding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对国家身份证件呈现攻击检测（PAD）的方法，利用原型网络（Prototypical Network）头加上EfficientNet-V2-b0骨干网络，仅需每类4张真实样本来构建可靠原型，并采用元学习的episodic训练策略（固定攻击类别而变换证件域）来学习通用的攻击线索。在多国数据集和DLC-2021基准上，平均等错误率（EER）约为9%，优于softmax和CLIP零样本基线，即使仅使用单一国家的数据也能获得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 国家身份证件的呈现攻击检测受限于缺乏公开的真实样本数据，导致系统难以跨国家泛化。现有方法依赖大量真实样本进行训练，而隐私保护和数据采集成本使得获取多国真实证件样本极其困难，这成为PAD系统规模化部署的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: (1) 设计一种原型网络头部结构，基于EfficientNet-V2-b0骨干网络，每类仅需四个真实样本即可为攻击类别构建可靠的原型表示；(2) 提出episodic训练机制，在训练过程中保持PAD攻击类别固定，同时变换证件文档域（国家/地区），使网络学习与特定证件域无关的通用攻击线索，提升跨域泛化能力。
AI.result: 在大型多国数据集和公开的DLC-2021基准上评估，该方法取得了约9%的平均等错误率（EER），优于传统的softmax分类器和CLIP零样本基线；即便仅使用单一来源国家的数据进行训练也能达到这一性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是首个将PAD类固定而变换文档域的训练策略，能够在极少量真实样本条件下实现准确且隐私保护的呈现攻击检测，显著降低数据采集成本，促进了跨司法辖区远程开户等场景中PAD系统的规模化部署。

title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补策略来提升基于价值函数的大语言模型强化学习性能：一是特权价值函数（PVF），在无偏策略目标下注入任务相关的token级信号；二是TETHER基线，根据价值函数准确度自适应地在组相对基线与价值基线之间插值。在多个推理任务上，两种策略均稳定优于标准价值函数基线，并与均值基线GRPO相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM强化学习算法主要在方差缩减策略上有所区别。基于分组的GRPO等组相对方法虽能降低梯度方差，但仅提供序列级信用分配，且受限于慢速rollout造成吞吐量下降和off-policy偏差。学习价值函数理论上可同时解决这两个问题（提供token级优势且无需大组），但由于工程复杂性和无批评者方法的实践成功，难以证明其纳入RL流程的必要性。
AI.method: 论文提出两个互补策略：1) 特权价值函数（PVF），通过优雅的机制注入额外的任务相关token级信号而不引入策略目标偏差；2) TETHER，一种自适应基线方法，根据价值函数的准确度在组相对基线与价值基线之间动态插值。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上，PVF和TETHER两种策略均一致性地优于标准价值函数基线，并与均值基线GRPO相比具有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过PVF提供特权信息注入和TETHER实现自适应基线插值，基于价值函数的RL方法可以有效克服其相对于无批评者方法的劣势，达到甚至超越主流GRPO方法的表现，为价值函数RL在LLM训练中的应用提供了有力支持。

title: GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration
summary: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.

AI.tldr: GeoPose是一个种群训练的框架，用于将术中双平面DSA快速准确地配准到术前CTA（3D-to-2D配准）。它通过在学习的规范框架中估计C臂位姿，并通过投影空间校准和变换组合将其转移到未见过的CTA原生框架中，无需患者特异性适应或显式体积间预配准。在80个DSA观测上，无优化版本达到mPCD 5.8mm/0.4s，25次优化迭代后进一步改善至4.6mm/0.58，显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 术中双平面DSA到术前CTA的3D-to-2D配准（即C臂位姿估计）要求快速且准确，但现有基于优化的方法对初始化敏感且需要数百次迭代，而基于学习的方法通常依赖患者特异性训练，限制了临床泛化能力。
AI.method: GeoPose采用种群级训练的框架：首先在学习的规范坐标系中估计C臂位姿，然后通过投影空间校准和变换组合将该位姿转移到未见过的CTA原生坐标系中；随后可选地使用低预算的图像驱动优化（残差网络细化，最多25次迭代）进一步提升精度。整个过程无需患者特异性适配，也无需显式的体积间预配准。
AI.result: 在来自20位留出患者的80个DSA观测上，无优化的GeoPose达到颈动脉mPCD 5.8mm和clDice 0.45，优于最佳基线（14.5mm、0.28），仅需0.15秒；经25次优化迭代后达到mPCD 4.6mm和clDice 0.58，约2秒完成，而相同预算下原生初始化的优化仅达到14.6mm和0.15。
AI.conclusion: GeoPose在固定种群级权重下实现了快速的保持原生坐标系配准，提供了下游双平面3D血管重建所需的几何对应关系，为临床术中导航提供了一种无需患者特异性训练的实用方案。

title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
summary: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHIVE，一个智能体流水线，用于自动发现并解释LLM在自然场景中的意外行为，通过反事实提示编辑来评估解释的质量（即可反事实模拟性），并发现现有可解释性技术无法提升模型行为预测能力，但用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型可提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大量AI研究致力于解释模型行为（如语言模型可解释性和思维链忠实性），但缺乏对"好的解释"的明确定义和系统评估框架。作者认为一个好的解释应当能够帮助预测模型在相关反事实输入上的行为。
AI.method: 提出CHIVE（Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits），一个智能体化流水线，包括：(1) 在自然数据中发现意外的模型行为；(2) 通过反事实提示编辑生成解释假设；(3) 用反事实证据支持/反驳这些假设。生成的解释被用于两个方向：评估常见可解释性技术对行为预测能力的提升，以及生成训练数据来训练模型预测反事实实验结果。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 现有的常见LLM可解释性技术均未能提升智能体预测反事实模型行为的能力；(2) 利用CHIVE生成的反事实实验数据训练模型，能够泛化到多种分布外场景。
AI.conclusion: CHIVE能够自动发现自然发生的LLM行为的解释，为评估和改进可解释性方法提供了新框架。同时，反事实模拟性作为一个新的解释质量标准，对现有可解释性技术提出了挑战，而基于CHIVE数据的训练方法展示了良好的泛化潜力。

title: Interactive Whole Slide Images for RL-based Tumour Segmentation
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis remains computationally challenging due to the extremely large spatial resolution of slides and the sparse distribution of tumour regions. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for sequential tumour segmentation directly on WSIs. Instead of treating the slide as a predefined collection of candidate patches, we formulate the WSI itself as a hierarchical multi-resolution environment through which an agent navigates using movement, zooming, and tumour selection actions. The agent jointly processes local observations and a global thumbnail representation within an actor-critic architecture trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO). Experiments on pulmonary adenocarcinoma WSIs demonstrate the feasibility of direct sequential tumour segmentation on full slides, achieving comparable coarse segmentation quality relative to patch-based approaches operating at similar magnification levels, while reducing inference time to a few seconds per slide. We further analyse the impact of environment design and action-space granularity. Our results suggest that modelling WSIs as interactive environments provides a promising direction for RL-based computational pathology

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种端到端强化学习框架，直接在整张全切片图像（WSI）上进行序贯肿瘤分割。将WSI建模为分层多分辨率环境，智能体通过移动、缩放和肿瘤选择动作进行导航，在actor-critic架构下使用PPO训练。在肺腺癌WSI上实验验证，分割质量与基于补丁的方法相当，但推理时间降至每张几秒。
AI.motivation: WSI分析面临两个核心挑战：极高的空间分辨率和肿瘤区域稀疏分布。现有基于补丁的方法需要预先将切片划分为候选补丁集合，计算开销大且效率低，缺乏直接在整张切片上进行高效分割的端到端方法。
AI.method: 将WSI构建为分层多分辨率环境，智能体通过移动、缩放和肿瘤选择三类动作进行序贯导航；采用actor-critic架构联合处理局部观测与全局缩略图表示，并使用近端策略优化（PPO）进行训练，实现端到端的直接肿瘤分割。
AI.result: 在肺腺癌WSI上的实验表明，该方法在相似放大倍数下达到与基于补丁方法相当的粗粒度分割质量，同时将推理时间缩短至每张切片仅需数秒。
AI.conclusion: 将WSI建模为交互式环境为基于强化学习的计算病理学提供了有前景的方向；环境设计和动作空间粒度对性能有重要影响。

title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
summary: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.

AI.tldr: 本文为Adam优化器建立了原理性基础：证明了Adam存在依赖问题与batch-size的相变收敛性，揭示了Transformer中Hessian趋向近块对角结构使Adam的预条件器有效的机理，并据此提出内存减半的Adam-mini优化器。
AI.motivation: Adam作为现代LLM训练的默认优化器，虽然在实践中表现优异，但缺乏严格的理论基础，其收敛/发散行为存在争议，且为何在Transformer上显著优于SGD的原因尚未被理解。作者希望为Adam建立原理性的理论框架，并以此指导新优化器的设计。
AI.method: 1) 通过理论分析重新审视Adam的收敛-发散争论，证明存在依赖于问题的相变，当选择合适且依赖batch-size的超参数时Adam收敛，而在小β2条件下可能发散；2) 分析Transformer训练中Hessian矩阵的结构演化，发现其趋向近块对角形式且存在强块异质性，证明该结构使Adam的对角预条件器有效，并基于随机矩阵理论给出该结构来源于大矩阵变量连续相乘的严格分析；3) 基于上述见解设计Adam-mini优化器。
AI.result: 证明了Adam存在与问题相关的相变现象和batch-size依赖的超参收敛条件；揭示了Transformer中Hessian结构的近块对角化演化及其来源；基于此提出Adam-mini，在保持性能的同时将内存占用减少50%。此外，研究还揭示了矩阵非凸问题中的新局部结构，并有助于理解改进Muon等新优化器。
AI.conclusion: Adam的性能优势源于Transformer中Hessian矩阵特有的近块对角结构，这一发现为Adam提供了坚实的理论根基，并催生了高效的Adam-mini优化器。研究成果超越了Adam本身，对矩阵非凸优化问题的理解以及新一代优化器的设计均具有更广泛的意义。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts
summary: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了16个冻结的地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）在4个分类和5个分割数据集上的表现，发现当前仅以平均精度排名来评估模型的协议过于狭隘。在数据分布偏移（污染）下，所有编码器性能退化且排名变化；EO预训练模型在干净数据上并不优于ImageNet预训练模型，且在偏移下更易过度自信。CKA分析揭示其表征刚性是根因。温度缩放和深度集成无法纠正退化，高斯过程探针虽能减轻严重云污染下的ECE但牺牲了干净数据的校准。作者主张评估应覆盖多种条件和指标。
AI.motivation: 当前地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）的选择和排名仅依据标准基准条件下的平均精度，而实际部署于关键EO应用时还需考虑模型校准（置信度与正确性的一致性）。这种单一维度的评估协议过于狭窄，无法全面反映模型在真实场景中的表现。
AI.method: 研究采用16个冻结编码器，在4个分类和5个分割数据集上，沿两个正交应力轴（污染强度与污染类型）进行系统评估，涵盖干净精度、干净校准、移位下的稳定性等多维度指标；运用CKA分析表征嵌入的空间位移与信息保持；并对比温度缩放、深度集成和高斯过程探针三种不确定性量化（UQ）方法，同时进行基于置信度的选择性预测实验。
AI.result: 所有编码器随污染增强而退化且排名发生变化；EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净精度和校准上无显著差异，且EO预训练在移位下并无更多稳定性，反而在每一级污染、每一类污染族中漂移至更严重的过度自信。CKA表明EO预训练嵌入在污染下移动更少但丢失同样多的任务信息且保持过度自信。温度缩放和深度集成无法抑制退化，高斯过程探针在严重云污染下将ECE减半但在干净数据上使其增至三倍。基于置信度的选择性预测无法规避自信的错误预测。
AI.conclusion: 仅以平均精度排名的评估协议不足以支撑GeoFMs在关键EO任务中的部署，应综合多种条件（如各类污染）和多维指标（精度、校准、稳定性等）进行评估，以更全面地衡量模型进展并弥合与真实部署场景的差距。

title: Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures
summary: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文广义化了Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE)框架，使其从仅支持欧几里得潜在空间的限制中解放出来，扩展到非欧几里得原型架构（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），为每种几何变体推导了适配的界计算算法或映射方法，并在完整训练的图像分类器上验证了子集最小形式解释的计算，首次实现了跨架构的严格可解释性比较。
AI.motivation: 现有ALE框架严格局限于欧几里得潜在空间，而现代最先进的架构越来越多地依赖非欧几里得表示（如球面度量、高斯密度、维度投影），导致当前形式化解释方法与其不兼容，存在关键空白。
AI.method: 将ALE框架广义化以支持非欧几里得原型架构；针对每种几何变体，系统性地推导两种路径：要么将架构映射到已有的界计算上，要么构造新颖的、架构特定的边界算法；在完整训练的图像分类器上计算子集最小形式解释进行验证。
AI.result: 通过将多种非欧几里得模型统一到单一形式框架下，成功计算了子集最小形式解释，并首次实现了对它们可解释性的严格跨架构比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了ALE框架在非欧几里得空间上的空白，建立了统一的形式化解释框架，使得不同几何结构的原型网络能够在同一标准下进行可解释性评估。

title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
summary: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了多模态有害模因检测任务，除判定有害性外还要求细粒度目标识别（目标类别、目标实体、文本提及和视觉区域）。引入统一数据集Meme3W和严格指标JRA，发现现有模型在JRA上表现差，提出HarmTrace框架（含实体感知SFT和CTPO优化）显著缩小差距，JRA从17.58%提升至52.51%。
AI.motivation: 现有有害模因检测仅关注图像-文本有害性分类，模型可能正确预测有害性但错误识别攻击目标及其支撑证据，无法提供细粒度和可解释的检测结果。需要将任务扩展为细粒度目标识别，以更全面地理解模因中的攻击信息。
AI.method: 1) 提出Meme3W数据集，统一多个公开有害模因数据集并为有害实例提供人工验证注释（目标类别、目标实体、文本提及、视觉区域）；2) 提出Joint Record Accuracy (JRA)严格记录级评估指标，要求有害性标签与所有目标识别字段同时正确；3) 提出HarmTrace框架，包含两个核心组件：实体感知监督微调（entity-aware SFT）增强目标实体监督，以及条件目标识别策略优化（CTPO）解耦有害性与目标识别优势，仅对有害示例的标签正确响应进行目标识别优化，并使用虚拟正锚点（VPA）进行优势归一化。
AI.result: 在多个代表性多模态大语言模型上验证，原始模型在有害性准确率与JRA之间存在显著差距。HarmTrace在所有评估骨干上同时提升了JRA和有害性准确率，其中Qwen3-VL-8B骨干的JRA从17.58%提升到52.51%。
AI.conclusion: HarmTrace通过锚定校准的解耦优化框架有效弥合了有害性检测与目标识别之间的差距，证明了在有害模因检测中同时实现准确的有害性判定和细粒度目标识别的可行性。

title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEOFlagBench基准（3200个网页、400个查询、4个领域、8种GEO优化器家族），系统评估现有GEO检测方法，并提出Intervention-Paired Training (IPT)方法将F1从0.862提升至0.944、最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883。作者还开发了GEO门控Agent审计系统，并在1000个真实用户查询中估计整体GEO流行率为8.90%，2026年修改的页面中达16.36%。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎优化（GEO）使内容被优化后获得与其权威性或相关性不成比例的可见性，甚至让虚假信息看起来有充分依据。与传统搜索不同，生成式搜索将信息合成为直接答案而非展示竞争性来源，加剧了来源溯源和权威性评估的风险，但目前缺乏系统性的GEO检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建GEOFlagBench基准，包含3200个网页、400个查询、4个领域和8种GEO优化器家族；2) 系统评估现有GEO检测方法；3) 提出Intervention-Paired Training (IPT)，通过监督检测器对GEO干预和非GEO AI润色的响应来训练；4) 开发GEO门控Agent系统审计检测页面的来源层级（Source Tier）和引用URL的可验证性；5) 在1000个真实用户查询上部署完整流水线。
AI.result: 最强基线整体F1达0.880，但方法层面和作者身份条件评估显示显著弱点及对作者身份捷径的潜在依赖；IPT在ModernBERT上将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；在10,095个可用页面中，整体GEO流行率为8.90%，2026年修改的页面中达到16.36%。
AI.conclusion: 本文为真实搜索生态中系统性检测、审计和量化GEO建立了基础，验证了IPT方法在提升检测鲁棒性方面的有效性，并揭示了GEO在真实世界搜索场景中的流行程度。

title: DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/dyagbobli/VisionOps-Trainer
summary: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRAFE（域鲁棒非对称融合集成）方法，通过组合独立训练的LW-DETR和RF-DETR检测器，实现跨城市细粒度交通目标检测。方法采用两阶段训练策略（先在多样公开交通数据集上预训练并进行伪标签扩展与人工标注精炼，再在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上进行符合挑战规则的微调），推理时结合锚点约束类一致性匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准及互补假设恢复等机制。在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上达到0.4022 mAP，排名第六（共25队），较初步集成方案提升0.0553 mAP。
AI.motivation: 深度学习目标检测器是智能交通系统的基础，但实现细粒度车辆识别与跨城市域泛化的统一仍具挑战性，现有方法难以同时兼顾这两方面性能。
AI.method: DRAFE采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段在多个公开交通数据集上进行预训练，结合伪标签扩展和人工参与标注精炼，构建包含6,049张图像和203,619个标注的精选语料库；第二阶段在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上进行符合挑战规则的微调。推理阶段采用锚点约束的类一致性匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复四种融合策略，整合LW-DETR与RF-DETR两种异构检测器的输出。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上，DRAFE达到0.4022 mAP，在25个参赛队伍中排名第六，相比相同基准条件下的初步集成方案提升了0.0553 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合互补性检测器架构与精心设计的集成/融合策略，DRAFE有效平衡了细粒度车辆识别精度与跨城市域泛化能力，验证了非对称检测器融合在多源交通场景下的有效性。

title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
summary: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaliBench，一个在物理可解释的离散空间中校准视频世界模型随机概率的基准，基于闭合形式的参考分布（二项、伯努利、均匀、偏斜轮盘）精确检验模型的aleatoric不确定性，并分解为可评分性（scorability）与校准度（calibration）两个正交维度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准要么对单次生成评分，要么在整个数据集上粗略比较分布（如FID），无法细粒度地测试特定物理现象（如骰子、纸牌、双叉掷球）的aleatoric不确定性。需要一个在物理可解释离散空间中直接度量与已知参考分布距离的方法。
AI.method: CaliBench将输出评分到物理可解释的离散空间（如bin索引、骰子面、花色、颜色），而非FID的隐式特征空间。设计了参考分布已知闭合形式的场景（binomial Galton board、Bernoulli fork、均匀骰子/牌/彩票、偏斜欧式轮盘颜色），采用精确校准检验，将性能分解为两个正交轴：scorability（可得分生成的占比）与calibration（样本与参考分布的总变差距离），用卡方检验评估显著性，并引入mnTV指标。
AI.result: 对9个场景和6个图像到视频模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super）每模型32次生成进行测试。发现模型一致地将概率质量集中在少数几个结果上而非复现参考分布；大多数场景-模型组合显著失调，极端情况下完全坍缩到单一结果（如Veo 3.1在骰子上）。轮盘场景中生成常使球位置模糊，导致多个模型scorability低。性能随场景而异，没有模型能在全部9个场景中占优。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频世界模型不能忠实反映物理现象的随机分布，存在系统性概率坍缩问题。CaliBench作为校准度精确检验基准，其方法学局限为卡方检验以校准为原假设只能证明失调，且N=32每格仅能检验较大偏差。研究释放了协议与mnTV指标以支持新模型对比。

title: Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples
comment: Accepted at AI4MFDD (AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection) Workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种针对基于自编码器重建误差的AI生成图像检测器的新型对抗攻击方法。通过构造人眼不可察觉的对抗样本，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使伪造图像被错误分类为真实图像。实验表明该方法能显著降低检测性能，且对抗样本可跨检测器迁移，揭示了重建型检测器的固有脆弱性。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像的高质量和普及性对可靠检测方法提出了迫切需求。重建型检测器作为一种透明且无需训练的检测方法备受关注，但因其与经典分类器方法截然不同的工作机理，其对抗鲁棒性几乎无人研究，存在知识空白。
AI.method: 提出两种针对自编码器重建误差检测器的对抗攻击方法：通过构造人眼不可察觉的对抗扰动，人为增加原始图像与重建图像之间的误差距离，使假图像被误判为真实图像。实验覆盖三个最先进生成器和三个检测器，并验证了对抗样本在经历真实世界降质后的鲁棒性及跨检测器的可迁移性。
AI.result: 实验表明所提出的对抗攻击能显著降低重建型检测器的检测性能，即使攻击图像经过真实世界的额外降质处理依然有效。关键发现是对抗样本能够天然地跨检测器迁移，因为不同检测器共享相同的工作原理。
AI.conclusion: 重建型检测器存在固有且共通的脆弱性：它们依赖的重建误差原理使其容易受到针对性对抗攻击，且这种脆弱性在不同检测器之间可迁移，暗示需要重新审视此类检测器的安全性设计。

title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
summary: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.

AI.tldr: 本文针对船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测模型验证中普遍存在的时间泄漏问题，提出采用时间感知评估方法（TSCV和BTSCV）替代传统的随机训练-测试划分。以加拿大海岸警卫队船舶Sir Wilfrid Laurier为案例，基于约388万条1Hz稳态记录，对六种回归模型和一个物理基线模型进行时间感知调参和评估。
AI.motivation: 过去二十年虽开发了大量数据驱动的船舶燃油模型，但大多数研究的验证方式存在关键缺陷：使用随机训练-测试划分来评估高频时间序列数据会导致时间泄漏，产生过于乐观的结果，无法反映真实部署条件。作者旨在揭示并弥补这一验证实践空白。
AI.method: 采用时间感知评估框架，具体使用Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV)和Blocked TSCV (BTSCV)两种方案。以CCGS Sir Wilfrid Laurier船舶为案例，在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置下对六种回归模型及一个物理基线模型进行调参，并在共同的时间顺序留出集上进行评估，数据规模约为388万条1Hz稳态记录。
AI.result: 通过时间感知的验证方案揭示了传统随机划分评估可能产生的乐观偏差，展示了不同时间感知交叉验证策略对模型选择和性能评估的影响，为SFC预测模型的可靠评估提供了实证依据。
AI.conclusion: SFC预测研究应采用时间感知的验证方法（如TSCV/BTSCV）替代随机划分，以确保模型性能评估反映真实部署场景，避免时间泄漏导致的过于乐观结论，从而为船舶运营优化和排放估计提供可靠支持。

title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出增量记忆激活范式（Proteus机制），通过渐进式扩展记忆容量而非使用静态记忆，缓解早期token占用过多自由度导致的记忆污染问题，在多个SOTA记忆模型中一致提升长上下文建模和推理性能。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制对长序列具有二次成本，引发了基于记忆的压缩模型的研究。但现有记忆模型在整个序列中暴露静态记忆：早期token没有压缩压力，占用过多自由度，污染记忆状态，留给后续上下文的容量不足，并且增加存储和新内容之间的干扰。
AI.method: 提出增量记忆激活（incremental memory activation）新范式，即随上下文增长逐步扩展记忆的有效容量。通过早期瓶颈强制模型更有效压缩历史，同时随时间解锁新容量减少干扰并改善后续上下文的保留。实例化为Proteus机制，可无额外成本集成到广泛的神经记忆架构中。
AI.result: 将Proteus应用于SWLA、Comba、Titans和Hope-Attention等SOTA模型，在标准语言建模、推理、长上下文检索和理解任务上均观察到一致改进，且增益在更长上下文长度下持续增长。
AI.conclusion: 静态记忆是次优的，调度有效容量是一种简单且广泛适用的序列建模工具。

title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Supplementary material appended after the references. v2: adds a per-image vs global scaling ablation, expands the methods, and corrects several figures and captions
summary: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). We then pretrained a 2D masked autoencoder (MAE-2D) on 139,000 unlabeled spectral images. Linear probing, which freezes the encoder and trains only a multilayer perceptron head, reached $R^2 = 0.646$ and exceeded every 1D self-supervised counterpart, including the fine-tuned MAE-1D ($R^2 = 0.641$). Under cross-dataset evaluation all models lost most of their accuracy and none beat the 1D baseline significantly. To identify which wavelengths drive each prediction, we applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM and unfolded band importance back to the spectral axis. Protein ($r = 0.45$) and leaf water ($r = 0.33$) agreed with sensitivities simulated by the PROSAIL radiative-transfer model, while carotenoids ($r = 0.06$) and leaf area index ($r = -0.11$) did not, showing that the model reads established leaf chemistry for traits with sharp absorption features. The representational advantage of 2D spectral images, rather than architectural complexity or ImageNet pretraining, drives the gain over 1D approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了将高光谱反射率光谱从一维序列转换为二维图像表示是否能够改善基于CNN的多性状预测。在GreenHyperSpectra数据集上比较了九种变换方法，发现最简单的直接Reshape变换在从头训练时表现最佳（R²=0.684），比一维基线提升了0.097。进一步利用139,000个无标记光谱图像预训练二维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D），线性探测达到R²=0.646，超过了所有一维自监督方法。交叉数据集评估中所有模型性能大幅下降。通过Integrated Gradients和Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析，发现蛋白质和叶片含水量预测与PROSAIL辐射传输模型模拟的敏感性一致，而类胡萝卜素和叶面积指数则不一致。研究表明二维光谱图像的表示优势（而非架构复杂性或ImageNet预训练）驱动了对一维方法的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法将高光谱光谱作为一维序列处理，限制了模型捕捉波段间长程依赖关系的能力。作者质疑将一维光谱转换为二维图像表示是否能够改善多性状预测性能，以突破当前一维CNN方法的状态最优基线。
AI.method: 使用EfficientNet-B0作为主干网络，在GreenHyperSpectra数据集（7,897条标记光谱，8个性状，400-2450 nm）上比较九种光谱到图像的变换方法，并与已发表的一维CNN结果对比。随后在139,000条无标记光谱图像上预训练二维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D），采用线性探测评估。可解释性方面使用Integrated Gradients和Grad-CAM将波段重要性映射回光谱轴，并与PROSAIL辐射传输模型模拟进行比较。
AI.result: 最简单的直接Reshape将光谱重塑为2D网格的变换在从头训练中表现最佳（R²=0.684±0.001），较一维基线（R²=0.587）提升了0.097。MAE-2D预训练+线性探测达到R²=0.646，超过所有一维自监督方法（包括微调后的MAE-1D，R²=0.641）。交叉数据集评估中所有模型均大幅丧失精度，未能显著超越一维基线。蛋白质（r=0.45）和叶片含水量（r=0.33）的预测与PROSAIL模拟的敏感性一致，而类胡萝卜素（r=0.06）和LAI（r=-0.11）不一致。
AI.conclusion: 二维光谱图像表示对一维方法的主要增益来源于表示形式本身而非架构复杂度或ImageNet预训练。对于具有锐利吸收特征（如蛋白质和水分）的性状，模型能够学习到与植物化学理论一致的波长重要性模式；而对于类胡萝卜素和LAI等性状，模型解释性较差，需要进一步改进。

title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
summary:
Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability.
  To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释且数据高效的深度神经网络（DNN）框架，用于基于轨迹的循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）表型分类。针对轨迹数据稀缺的问题，开发了Subsequence (SubSeq) 定向增强策略，从局部轨迹片段中学习；同时利用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控器件物理区域。实验表明SubSeq显著提升分类精度，且可解释性分析证实局部轨迹片段蕴含丰富的生物物理信息。
AI.motivation: CTC表型的准确分类对评估转移潜能至关重要。无标记微流控器件通过流体力学障碍将CTC的生物物理特征（尺寸、变形性）转换为运动学轨迹，但控制这些轨迹的高度非线性流固耦合使得从轨迹反推细胞表型的逆问题在解析上难以处理。虽然DNN可解决此逆问题，但受限于轨迹数据稀缺和缺乏物理可解释性两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出可解释且数据高效的DNN框架：(1) SubSeq增强策略——在训练过程中随机提取信息丰富的局部轨迹子序列，促进模型从局部模式中学习；(2) 应用Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM)识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征及微流控器件的物理区域；(3) 将微流控几何视为细胞力学特性的物理编码器。
AI.result: 实验结果显示SubSeq在分类精度上优于基准方法和现有增强方法。可解释性分析表明局部轨迹片段包含与准确分类相关的充分生物物理信息，为SubSeq策略的有效性提供了理论依据，同时揭示了全长轨迹的冗余性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅提升了CTC分类的数据利用效率和精度，还通过可解释性分析揭示了轨迹分类的物理原理，为未来诊断器件的设计提供了机制层面的见解。

title: Concept-based explanation of gene expression prediction from H&E images
summary: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have enabled accurate prediction of spatial transcriptomics (ST) from routine H&E images. However, existing explainability methods for vision transformer (ViT)-based models are largely limited to local heatmaps and do not reveal how morphological concepts contribute to ST predictions. Here, we introduce an explainable framework that combines relevance propagation and concept discovery to link transcriptional programs to tissue morphology. We developed a ViT-based framework for virtual ST from H&E images that combines ViT-aware layer-wise relevance propagation with relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder-based concept discovery. This approach provides both local explanations and global insights into the morphological patterns associated with transcriptional programs. We applied the framework to colorectal cancer ST data from the HEST-1k cohort and evaluated its generalizability in TCGA COAD. Our architecture accurately predicts clinically relevant ST signatures and accompanying molecular phenotypes. Measured and predicted gene expression profiles reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity of the colorectal cancer subtypes iCMS2 and iCMS3 across a large number of samples. Spatially resolved and aggregated iCMS classification achieve weighted F1 scores of 0.872 and 0.819 (0.770 in TCGA COAD), respectively, and both stratify patient outcome. Beyond prediction, our framework establishes a relevance-based concept atlas linking molecular phenotypes to histopathological representations. Comparison of activation- with relevance-derived concepts demonstrates that relevances provide a more direct link between tissue morphology and downstream predictions. We establish a general strategy for concept-based explanation of spatial prediction, and our framework is readily applicable to a broad range of ViT-based pathology models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释框架，结合ViT感知的层间相关性传播（LRP）与松弛原型TopK稀疏自编码器（SAE）概念发现，将转录程序与组织形态学联系起来，用于从H&E图像预测空间转录组。在结直肠癌HEST-1k和TCGA COAD数据上验证，iCMS2/iCMS3分类加权F1分别达0.872和0.819（TCGA COAD为0.770），并建立基于相关性的概念图谱，提供局部解释和全局形态学洞察。
AI.motivation: 现有病理学基础模型虽能准确从H&E图像预测空间转录组，但基于ViT模型的可解释性方法主要局限于局部热图，无法揭示形态学概念如何贡献于ST预测，缺乏从局部到全局的可解释桥梁。
AI.method: 提出一个结合ViT感知的层间相关性传播（layer-wise relevance propagation）与松弛原型TopK稀疏自编码器（relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder）概念发现的深度学习框架。该框架能够同时提供局部解释（相关性传播）和全局洞察（概念发现），用于从H&E图像进行虚拟空间转录组预测。
AI.result: 框架在结直肠癌HEST-1k数据上准确预测临床相关ST特征及伴随分子表型。iCMS2和iCMS3分类在空间分辨和聚合层面分别达到0.872和0.819的加权F1分数（TCGA COAD外部验证为0.770），且均能对患者预后进行分层。验证了相关性派生概念比激活派生概念更直接地连接组织形态学与下游预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于概念的空间预测解释通用策略，证明相关性传播比激活分析更能直接揭示形态学与分子表型之间的联系，框架可广泛应用到各类基于ViT的病理学模型，为病理AI的可解释性提供了从热图到概念层面的升级。

title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"解析先验学习"框架，在有限仿真预算下重用低成本解析模型来提高侧支共鸣器高频仿真预测的数据效率，实验表明解析校正和先验蒸馏两种路径均显著优于直接学习。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真虽然能提供精确的侧支共鸣器预测，但生成大规模仿真数据集成本高昂；纯数据驱动的代理模型在仿真标注数据稀缺时可能不可靠，因此需要引入低成本解析模型来提高数据效率。
AI.method: 提出两种互补路径：(1) 解析残差校正——在推理时保留解析模型作为显式基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析到仿真的残差；(2) 解析先验蒸馏——先从大量低成本解析评估中蒸馏解析映射作为学习先验，再用有限的仿真数据校准。在矩形侧支Helmholtz共鸣器上，使用86个仿真标注几何和8,998个非重叠解析几何进行评估，比较SVR和MLP在两种框架下的表现。
AI.result: 解析模型MAE为1.333 Hz；直接SVR为3.375 Hz，残差SVR降至0.426 Hz；直接MLP为1.109 Hz，解析先验预训练在冻结先验残差适应下降至0.556 Hz，全模型微调降至0.371 Hz。在20到70个训练样例预算下，两条解析路径均一致提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 解析先验信息能在仿真数据稀缺时显著提升高保真预测精度，显式校正与先验蒸馏分别满足不同的部署需求，互为补充。

title: How Sampling Strategy Affects Imbalance Mitigation in LiDAR Segmentation: A Study of Structured vs. Random Point-Based Architectures
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Class imbalance in LiDAR point clouds poses challenges for semantic segmentation in autonomous navigation and urban mapping. While 2D vision has numerous mitigation techniques, their effectiveness in 3D remains unclear. We benchmark six reweighting schemes and five imbalance-aware losses across three datasets (DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D) using two architectures (KPConv, RandLA-Net). Inverse-frequency weighting degrades performance by up to 12% compared to uniform weighting, with catastrophic failures in minority classes. Uniform weighting performs within 2% of complex losses for structured sampling (KPConv) but benefits less for random sampling (RandLA-Net, up to 4.6% gap). Loss landscape analysis reveals a complex interplay: for structured sampling, imbalance ratio determines landscape geometry on real LiDAR data but decouples from it on synthetic data; for random sampling, landscapes show high sensitivity to dataset geometry regardless of imbalance ratio. For the two evaluated point-based architectures, these results suggest that the interaction between sampling strategy (structured vs. random), imbalance severity, and data acquisition characteristics shapes which mitigation approaches are effective.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了六种重加权策略和五种不平衡感知损失函数在三种LiDAR点云数据集（DALES、S3DIS、STPLS3D）和两种架构（KPConv、RandLA-Net）上的语义分割性能，发现逆频率加权相比均匀加权性能最多下降12%，而均匀加权在结构化采样架构下与复杂损失表现接近（差距在2%以内），但在随机采样架构下差距可达4.6%。损失景观分析进一步揭示采样策略、不平衡程度与数据获取特征之间的复杂交互作用共同决定了缓解方案的有效性。
AI.motivation: LiDAR点云中的类别不平衡问题对自动驾驶和城市场景感知的语义分割构成重大挑战。虽然2D视觉领域已有大量不平衡缓解技术，但这些方法在3D点云场景中的有效性尚未被系统验证，缺乏针对3D数据特性的基准研究。
AI.method: 本文构建了系统的基准评测框架：（1）对比六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失函数；（2）覆盖三个多样化数据集（真实LiDAR数据DALES、室内S3DIS、合成数据STPLS3D）；（3）评估两种代表性点云架构——结构化采样（KPConv）和随机采样（RandLA-Net）；（4）通过损失景观分析揭示不平衡率与数据集几何特征对优化空间的深层影响。
AI.result: 逆频率加权比均匀加权性能下降最多12%，尤其在少数类上出现灾难性失败；均匀加权在KPConv上几乎媲美复杂损失（差距≤2%），但在RandLA-Net上差距可达4.6%。损失景观显示：结构化采样下不平衡率主导真实数据的几何形状但与合成数据解耦；随机采样下损失景观对数据集几何高度敏感而不受不平衡率影响。
AI.conclusion: 对于所评估的两种基于点的架构，采样策略（结构化vs随机）、不平衡严重程度以及数据获取特性三者之间的交互作用决定了何种缓解方法最有效。这提示研究者需根据具体架构和数据特征选择合适的不平衡处理方法，而非盲目套用2D领域的成功经验。

title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning.
