We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QVIRL，一种基于Q值的变分逆强化学习方法，通过从专家行为中学习最优Q值的变分分布来恢复奖励函数的后验分布，在可扩展性与不确定性量化之间取得平衡，并在多个任务（包括网格世界、Lunar Lander、Highway环境及两个ATARI游戏）中展现了优越的表现，且首次实现了从原始像素观测进行贝叶斯逆强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 开发安全且有益的AI系统需要智能体能够学习和遵循人类偏好，但手工指定这些偏好通常不可行。逆强化学习通过从专家行为中推断偏好（表示为奖励函数）来解决此问题，然而现有方法难以同时兼顾可扩展性与不确定性量化，后者对安全关键应用和主动学习至关重要。
AI.method: QVIRL是一种新颖的贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，其核心思想是通过主要学习最优Q值的变分分布来恢复奖励的后验分布，而非直接对奖励函数进行变分推断。这种方法在保留贝叶斯框架的不确定性量化能力的同时，避免了传统贝叶斯IRL在计算上的瓶颈，从而实现了可扩展性。
AI.result: QVIRL在多个基准任务（包括网格世界、Lunar Lander、Highway环境和两个ATARI游戏）上的学徒学习表现优异，适用于静态专家数据和主动学习两种场景，并首次实现了基于原始像素观测的贝叶斯IRL训练。
AI.conclusion: QVIRL证明了通过学习Q值的变分分布来推断奖励后验是一种有效策略，实现了贝叶斯IRL中可扩展性与不确定性量化的统一，为安全关键的AI应用提供了可靠的基础，并拓展了贝叶斯IRL在像素级高维观测场景下的适用性。

title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
summary: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

AI.tldr: 提出RS-UFFM，一种基于统一流与特征记忆库的遥感半监督语义分割方法，通过集成外部视觉基础模型的统一训练流来生成低偏置伪标签，并结合动态更新的特征记忆库来缩小有标签与无标签数据间的特征差异，在遥感数据集上取得优于SOTA的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的半监督语义分割方法将有标签和无标签数据独立训练，导致有标签数据占主导地位，严重恶化伪标签质量，进而影响整体分割性能。
AI.method: UFFM包含两个核心创新：(1) 统一流（UF）：一种新的训练流程，将外部视觉基础模型（VFM）与遥感域教师模型结合以生成低偏置伪标签，并在统一的训练目标下联合优化有标签和伪标签数据；(2) 特征记忆库（FMB）：一种新颖的记忆模块，在训练过程中动态更新类别特定的特征，并通过类别特征对齐来减小有标签与无标签数据之间的特征差异。
AI.result: 在遥感数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于现有SOTA半监督语义分割方法，并验证了其在弥合有标签与无标签数据之间的优化和特征表示差距方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一流与特征记忆库的联合设计能够有效缓解有标签数据主导的问题，提升伪标签质量，为遥感半监督语义分割提供了一种新的高效解决方案。

title: AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably.
  On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery.
  Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了AnchorScore（基于CLIP零样本准确率的逐类代理指标）作为多模态大语言模型（MLLM）注释难度的事前诊断工具。在13个类别的课堂行为数据上，AnchorScore与MLLM逐类准确率显著相关（rho=0.769, p=0.002），在Stanford40 Actions上得到复现（rho=0.817），并衍生出混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略（最高节省44%成本、提升23个百分点）等实用应用。
AI.motivation: MLLM逐类注释准确率差异巨大（12%-98%），但评估成本极高（一个27B MLLM评估5,416张图需14小时，而CLIP仅需3分钟）。需要一种低成本的事前信号来预测哪些类别MLLM最可能注释失败，从而将昂贵的评估资源集中在最需要的类别上。
AI.method: 基于先前研究引入的AnchorProxy概念（逐类零样本CLIP准确率），本文将其全帧版本系统化为AnchorScore，作为MLLM注释难度的先验诊断指标。通过SCB5（13类、6个MLLM）和Stanford40 Actions进行验证，并与DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP、MLLM自述不确定性等替代预测器比较，同时进行跨模型共识控制和跨域衰减分析。
AI.result: AnchorScore在SCB5上与MLLM逐类准确率显著相关（rho=0.769, p=0.002），替代预测器均无显著相关；在Stanford40 Actions上复现（rho=0.817, p<0.001）。关联强度在活动识别数据上最强，在医学和卫星图像上减弱。实际应用包括：混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略（较纯CLIP提升23个百分点、节省44% MLLM成本）、提示消歧、审核优先级预测。
AI.conclusion: AnchorScore不估算MLLM的精确准确率，而是提供低成本的可排序信号，将昂贵的MLLM评估引导至信息量最大的类别。它主要捕捉共享的类别难度因子而非CLIP特有信号，是部署MLLM自动注释系统时一个实用的先验诊断工具。

title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
summary: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.

AI.tldr: MIRROR是一个研究原型，通过链式结构将多标签分类器、Grad-CAM定位器和报告生成器分离，确保语言层无法看到像素，从而防止生成模型未经证实就添加发现。系统支持三种影像模态（胸片、脑MRI、头CT），在ChestMNIST上达到macro AUROC 0.729，但揭示了不平衡数据下聚合指标（如Brier分数）会掩盖"什么都不做的模型"的问题，并展示了报告会陈述系统从未测量的量（如心胸比）。
AI.motivation: 放射科医生在阅读模型输出时面临两个问题：模型只返回数字而无理由，且将数字转成可读文本的系统可能悄悄加入模型从未做出的断言。作者构建MIRROR来分离这些失败，确保报告的可审计性。
AI.method: MIRROR采用三阶段流水线：1) 多标签分类器输出概率；2) Grad-CAM定位器将每个阳性发现映射到命名解剖区域；3) 报告写入器接收标签、概率和区域，但绝不接收图像，从而从架构上杜绝语言模型凭空捏造发现。一个统一注册表管理分类法、解剖结构和措辞，使新增模态只需修改数据而非代码。
AI.result: 在ChestMNIST上，模型达到macro AUROC 0.729，所有14个标签均优于随机排名，精确度是随机排序器的1.6至6.8倍。但在默认0.5阈值下，11个标签不产生任何阳性预测。Brier分数0.045与忽略图像的基线预测器的0.047几乎相同，揭示了区分能力真实但决策不可靠的矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 在放射学常见的不平衡数据下，聚合指标会美化"什么都不做"的模型，必须在"什么都不做"的基线地板之上报告这些指标。MIRROR通过架构性分离保证发现可审计，但句子框架仍是普通生成文本，可能会陈述系统从未测量的量（如心胸比），因此可审计性与语言真实性需要区分对待。

title: PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PersonaShot，这是首个面向多镜头视频生成中叙事连续性的人物中心基准，包含约1000个多镜头片段和16项指标，涵盖物理连续性、情感动态和镜头语法，并采用从大型多模态教师蒸馏出的、与专家人类判断对齐的专用轻量级评估器进行系统性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估人物外观或单镜头质量，无法衡量跨镜头切换时物理与情感状态的连贯性；同时缺乏针对不同指标（物理连续性、面部动态、镜头关系）所需的视觉、时序和关系性证据的特异性评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含约1000个多镜头片段和16项指标的Narrative Continuity Benchmark，在三个时间层级（镜头内状态、跨镜头转换、序列级轨迹）评估人物连贯性；2) 从大型多模态教师模型中蒸馏推理能力，生成与专家人类判断对齐的、基于视觉/时序/关系证据的专用轻量级评估器；3) 对SOTA模型进行系统性评估并揭示其能力画像。
AI.result: 评估显示各SOTA模型具有不同的能力画像，感知质量与跨镜头叙事连续性之间存在明显差距；即便是视觉上引人注目的视频也常常出现物理状态重置、情感突变和镜头关系断裂。人类研究进一步验证了评估器与专家判断的高度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 物理状态重置、情感突变和镜头关系断裂是当前视频生成模型在叙事连续性上的系统性缺陷，需要从感知质量评价转向叙事连贯性评价；PersonaShot及其专用评估器为该方向提供了可行的基准与工具。

title: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
summary: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CytoFormer，一个细胞基础模型，通过在配对的空间转录组学和H&E组织学图像上训练，实现了直接从常规H&E切片中识别细胞类型。模型在16个器官的1540万个细胞上训练，达到了0.85的准确率和0.78的宏F1，且其表征可迁移、标签高效，优于现有病理学基础模型。
AI.motivation: 直接从常规H&E组织学图像中识别细胞类型可以在规模上实现单细胞分析，但现有方法依赖病理学家的手动标注，这种标注方式缓慢、昂贵，且对许多细胞类型不可靠。作者转而使用分子信息（成像空间转录组学）来监督形态学，因为分子身份和形态可以在同一物理细胞上同时观测到，从而规避手动标注的瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者收集了81个配对的Xenium空间转录组学切片，覆盖16个器官，通过聚类、标记基因注释、人工审查和质量控制来获得每细胞的分子标签，映射到各器官常见的23种细胞类型，得到1540万个带有配对H&E图像补丁的细胞。在此基础上训练CytoFormer，一个具有多任务、按器官分类头的细胞基础模型。
AI.result: 在空间上留出的组织上，CytoFormer在16个器官中达到0.85的准确率和0.78的宏F1，预测可重现整个留出切片的组织结构。其表征可迁移：冻结编码器后，线性头在四个专家标注基准上优于6个病理学基础模型，包括预训练中未涉及的器官和细胞类型。在交互式主动学习场景下，CytoFormer的嵌入比现有病理学基础模型显著更标签高效。
AI.conclusion: CytoFormer将配对H&E与空间转录组学转化为一种可重用、标签高效的常规组织学细胞级分析表征，为大规模单细胞分析提供了新的范式。

title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
summary: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenRouter，这是首个面向智能体图像生成（agentic image generation）的统一工作流路由框架。通过将多样化智能体流水线标准化为GenCanvas（一组基础原语与可执行模板），GenRouter能够根据用户查询的复杂度自适应地将提示路由到最优工作流，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持甚至提升视觉对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 随着文本到图像（T2I）生成模型的快速发展，基础像素合成问题已得到解决，研究焦点转向满足日益复杂的用户需求。现有的智能体图像生成工作流虽然引入了外部知识检索和迭代推理等高级能力，但大多以孤立的、固定"一刀切"拓扑结构运行，导致严重的计算失配（compute-mismatch）问题——简单查询也被迫经过计算密集的流水线。旨在消除这种效率瓶颈。
AI.method: GenRouter包含三个核心组成部分：(1) GenCanvas：将多样化的智能体流水线标准化为一组通用的基础原语和可执行模板，建立统一的工作流表示空间；(2) 自适应路由机制：在GenCanvas统一空间上，通过三条策略将异构提示路由到最优工作流，即需求分析（demand profiling）、经验匹配（experience matching）和帕累托过滤（Pareto filtering）；(3) 自我进化机制：系统通过累积经验持续自我演化，实现强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.result: 在多个多样化基准上的广泛实验表明，GenRouter在实现优越视觉对齐的同时，相比重型静态流水线，执行成本降低超过95%，延迟降低65%。此外，系统的自我进化机制使其能够持续优化，进一步提升性能并将计算开销减半。
AI.conclusion: GenRouter通过统一工作流路由框架有效解决了智能体图像生成中的计算失配问题，在视觉质量与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，并具备零样本泛化与持续自我进化的能力，为该领域提供了新的研究范式。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
summary:
Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
  We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods.
  Medium-far- and far-OOD samples are detected reliably, whereas near-OOD samples and external normal data from unseen institutions expose method-specific differences. The 3D reconstruction-based approach best balances detection performance (AUROC: 0.936) and generalization to unseen institutions. The projection-based method with positional encoding achieves the highest overall detection performance (AUROC: 0.954). Both hybrid methods exhibit critical failure modes, confirming that methods validated for one modality or anatomy may not generalize without domain-specific adaptation. Implants and mastectomies remain an open challenge for all methods. Our results establish a foundation and practical guidance on scalable unsupervised QA in medical AI pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将无监督异常检测（AD）和分布外检测（OOD）用作多中心动态增强乳腺MRI的自动化数据集质量保证（QA）机制。作者构建了一个包含17种真实QA相关异常类型、6个公开数据集的受控基准测试，提出基于人类视觉感知的放射影像异常分类法，并评估了四种方法。结果显示3D重建方法在检测性能（AUROC 0.936）与跨机构泛化间取得最佳平衡，投影方法配合位置编码达到最高检测性能（AUROC 0.954），但混合方法存在关键失败模式，且植入物和乳房切除术对所有方法仍是挑战。
AI.motivation: 数据损坏、不一致或异常会威胁医疗AI的安全性和可靠性。尽管监管层日益重视高风险医疗AI的数据集质量保证，但可扩展的自动化检测方法仍不成熟。本文旨在填补这一空白，为多中心医疗影像数据提供系统化的无监督QA检测方案。
AI.method: 构建包含17种真实QA相关异常类型（协议违规、处理错误、错误解剖区域）的受控AD基准测试，基于人类视觉感知提出放射影像异常分类法，实现细粒度AD失败模式分析。基准包含近/中远/远OOD样本、分布内和外部正常数据。评估四种方法：基于投影的方法（扩展领域特定特征提取器和新颖位置编码）、基于重建的方法（扩展到全3D体积并增强训练目标）、以及两种未修改的混合OOD检测方法。
AI.result: 中远和远OOD样本被可靠检测；近OOD样本和来自未见机构的正常数据暴露了方法间的差异。3D重建方法在检测性能（AUROC 0.936）和跨机构泛化之间最佳平衡。投影方法结合位置编码达到最高检测性能（AUROC 0.954）。两种混合方法均表现出关键失败模式，证实针对单一模态或解剖部位验证的方法在无领域适配情况下的泛化局限。植入物和乳房切除术对所有方法仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为医疗AI流水线中可扩展的无监督QA建立了基础和实践指导，表明领域特化方法优于未适配的混合方法，并为多中心医学影像数据集的自动化质量保障提供了一套评估框架和基准资源。

title: VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples
summary: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉上下文编辑（Visual In-context Editing）新范式，将视频编辑从纯文本指令扩展到多模态视觉引导（单图、图像对、视频对），并构建了首个大规模数据集VicEdit-400K（含10种任务类型、40万高质量样本），同时提出统一框架VicEdit，通过模态自适应语义蒸馏和双上下文注入实现视觉与文本指令的协同编辑，在VicEditBench上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于指令的视频编辑方法依赖单模态文本指令，难以准确传达细粒度纹理和复杂动态信息，存在感知鸿沟（perceptual gap）。为弥补这一差距，需要引入多模态视觉引导来增强编辑的精确性和可控性。
AI.method: 1）提出视觉上下文编辑新范式，支持单图、图像对和视频对三种视觉参考类型；2）构建自动流水线生成VicEdit-400K数据集，覆盖10种任务类型，并通过多维度过滤保证视觉保真度和语义一致性；3）设计VicEdit统一框架，包含Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation（从异构视觉参考中自适应提取模态特定语义token）和Dual-Context Injection（将语义token与文本指令协同注入生成过程）。
AI.result: 在VicEditBench上的大量实验表明，VicEdit在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑两类任务上均达到最先进（SOTA）性能，验证了视觉上下文学习作为视频编辑的强大可控范式。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上下文编辑是一种更强大且可控的视频编辑范式，通过融合多模态视觉引导与文本指令，能够有效弥补文本指令在表达细粒度细节上的不足，为视频编辑提供了新的研究方向和实用框架。

title: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
summary: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCSR-Monitor，一种针对手术分割网络的部署时失效监控框架，将模型置信度与可观测的形状、时间一致性和图像质量线索相结合，无需模型内部信息或部署时的真值标签，即可检测在采集退化下即使高置信度仍失败的分割预测。
AI.motivation: 手术分割网络在采集退化下可能静默失败——预测掩码错误但模型置信度仍然很高。现有的部署时监控器主要依赖不确定性估计，因此无法捕捉这类高置信度失败，需要超越置信度的互补可观测信号。
AI.method: TCSR-Monitor是一种事后失效监控框架，将置信度与可观测的形状、时间一致性和图像质量线索相结合。它封装冻结的分割模型，不需要模型内部结构，部署时无需真值。同时引入验证协议以评估分布偏移下警报的可信度，并使用Mondrian共形校准在退化严重程度间平衡漏报率。
AI.result: 在EndoVis 2017上留一损坏类型评估中，TCSR-Monitor能泛化到未见过的采集退化，显著优于基于置信度的基线。环形性控制确认其预测的是分割失败而非仅检测损坏图像。但单个全局阈值在中度损坏下对多达40%的正确分割帧产生误报。零样本迁移到SAM2表现出特征可移植性，但熵在两种评估阈值下均优于迁移后的监控器。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的采集退化监控受益于超越置信度本身的互补可观测信号，但误报率高和跨模型迁移能力有限仍是需要解决的显著挑战。

title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
summary: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

AI.tldr: BinRVR是一个RAW视频复原的二值化框架，通过减少约96%的计算量和参数量，仅牺牲约4%的性能，实现高效的低层视觉处理。该框架包含二值化信息交互模块（BIIM）用于统一建模时空信息，以及分布感知二值化卷积（DAB-Conv）利用全精度激活统计来缓解量化误差，并支持多比特量化以实现精度-效率的灵活权衡。
AI.motivation: RAW视频复原是高质量低层感知的基础，但现有的二值化神经网络虽能实现轻量级部署，却无法有效建模视频场景中的时间连贯性和激活值分布，导致在视频任务中效果受限。因此需要一种既能保持计算效率又能处理时空信息的二值化视频复原方法。
AI.method: 提出BinRVR框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM)，以统一且高效的方式联合建模空间和时间信息；(2) Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv)，利用全精度激活的统计信息来缓解量化误差。框架还支持多比特量化，以适配不同硬件约束下的精度-效率权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明BinRVR在RAW视频复原任务（包括低光增强、去噪、去模糊和超分辨率）中，与最先进的二值化方法相比取得了具有竞争力的性能。在减少约96%计算量和参数量的同时，仅产生约4%的性能降级。此外，该方法的潜力还扩展到了下游视频应用，包括目标检测和单目深度估计。
AI.conclusion: BinRVR验证了二值化神经网络在RAW视频复原任务中的可行性，通过针对性的时空建模与分布感知量化策略，在极端压缩计算资源的同时保持了令人满意的复原质量，并为下游视频视觉应用提供了高效基础。

title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE-Bench基准，通过形式化四个原子算子（Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose）将多参考图像生成任务表示为组合公式，并用约1600个测试用例（1-8个算子槽位）构建基准，实现了按能力评分和递归失败定位的诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态多参考图像生成基准按预定义任务类型组织，不适合组合性设置，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控且缺乏诊断价值。需要一种面向能力（capability-oriented）的评测框架来系统性评估模型。
AI.method: 形式化四个原子算子：Anchor(f)、Disentangle(g)、Apply(⊕)、Compose(C)，将任意多参考提示表示为组合公式，用算子槽位数量量化结构复杂度。构建TRACE-Bench，包含约1600个评测案例（槽位1-8）、631个公式模板和约4000张参考图像。公式结构驱动算子对齐的评估协议（按能力评分）和诊断树分析（递归失败定位）。
AI.result: 评估9个领先模型发现传统整体评分看不见的洞察：主要瓶颈在于解耦（g）和属性绑定（⊕）而非场景级组合（C），即便最好模型在属性保真度上仅得0.74分。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-Bench通过能力导向的运算符分解提供了更强诊断价值的评估方案，揭示了多参考图像生成模型的真实瓶颈所在，为后续模型改进指明方向。

title: Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach
summary: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免标定的单目视频车辆测速框架，利用36关键点车辆模板和逐帧更新的单应矩阵，无需道路特征、相机标定或参考物即可估计车速。在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上验证，warped光流法MAE分别为15.0%和9.7%，经10%裁剪后改善至11.7%和7.6%，支持低成本车载设备实现公民参与的交通执法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计方法通常依赖道路特征、相机标定或参考对象，限制了其在不同场景下的泛化能力和实际部署可行性。本文旨在解决这些局限，提出一种无需标定的、可广泛适用的车辆测速框架，以支持低成本、便携式设备的车速执法应用。
AI.method: 框架包括三个核心组件：1）基于YOLO的36关键点车辆检测模块，在多样数据集上训练；2）逐帧更新的单应矩阵用于将2D位移映射到度量空间；3）两种速度估计策略对比——纯关键点跟踪和warped光流法（结合密集空间聚合）。速度通过单应矩阵将像素位移投影到公制空间进行计算。
AI.result: 在400多个视频片段（覆盖30-100 mph）上验证。warped光流法在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed上MAE分别为15.0%和9.7%，±20%误差内准确率为77.9%和93.1%。经10%裁剪去除边缘离群点后，MAE改善至11.7%和7.6%，±20%内准确率提升至85.3%和95.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该免标定框架有效解决了现有视觉测速方法的局限性，在多种路况和视角下实现可靠的速度估计。其无需标定、支持便携式设备的特性为行车记录仪和智能手机等低成本设备实现车速执法提供了可能，支持公民参与型的交通安全执法计划。

title: Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models
summary: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了八种基于Classifier-Free Guidance（CFG）概念的训练免费推理时质量增强方法，在两种开源的rectified-flow transformer模型上、使用固定的每模型协议和三个组合对齐基准进行测试。结果表明没有方法能在各项指标上持续优于CFG；APG虽获得若干名义最佳分数，但其增益多在评估不确定性范围内；注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上仅有孤立增益，在FLUX.2上更常出现退化，CFG仍是具有竞争力的低成本基线。
AI.motivation: 许多基于CFG概念的训练免费质量增强方法最初是在较老的U-Net扩散模型上提出的，并用仅评估图像质量、不考虑组合对齐或图像与文本提示间语义对应关系的指标验证。作者质疑这些方法迁移到现代rectified-flow transformer架构后的实际有效性。
AI.method: 在两种开源的rectified-flow transformer（SD3.5 Medium和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base）上，采用固定的每模型评估协议，对八种方法进行重新评估，并使用三个组合对齐基准来衡量图像质量、组合对齐以及图像与文本提示的语义对应关系。
AI.result: 没有任何方法能在所有测量标准上持续优于CFG。APG获得了若干名义上最佳分数，但增益通常处于估计的评估不确定性范围内。注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上产生孤立增益，在FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base上则更频繁地出现性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 结论是当前这些CFG衍生方法在现代rectified-flow transformer上并未带来可靠的组合对齐增益，CFG仍是一个竞争性的低成本基线，提示社区需重新审视这类方法在新架构下的适用性与评估方式。

title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种两阶段白盒模型反转攻击方法，将模型反转问题重构为轨迹引导任务。第一阶段预训练通用Flow Matching模型作为人脸流形先验，第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器（PGS）在采样过程中注入时间依赖的目标特定梯度，将生成流从随机噪声引导至目标类别的高密度区域。在CelebA数据集的身份不相交跨评估设置下，SFMI在ArcFace目标模型上取得ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型反转攻击方法通常依赖间接引导或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化至目标面部图像，导致攻击成功率不稳定、生成图像视觉保真度受限。
AI.method: SFMI采用两阶段白盒攻击框架：(1) 学习通用Flow Matching先验——预训练一个无条件的Flow Matching生成模型，对人类面部流形进行建模作为稳健先验；(2) 渐进式引导调度器（PGS）——在采样过程中通过目标模型反向传播获得中间生成状态的梯度，逐步将时间相关的自适应引导信号注入向量场，从而将生成流从随机噪声引导到目标类别的高密度区域。
AI.result: 在CelebA数据集的身份不相交跨评估设置下，对ArcFace目标模型取得ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874的成绩；在多个目标模型上的广泛实验表明，SFMI在白盒协议下达到与现有方法竞争的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: SFMI通过将模型反转重新定义为轨迹引导任务，利用Flow Matching先验与渐进式梯度引导的结合，有效解决了传统MIA方法中生成轨迹不稳定和引导不足的问题，在攻击成功率和视觉保真度两方面均实现了竞争性的SOTA表现。

title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
summary: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

AI.tldr: PixRestore是一个无需VAE的像素空间Diffusion Transformer（DiT）统一图像恢复（UIR）模型，完全从头训练，直接在patchified像素上进行流匹配，保留了细粒度细节。通过LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度预测层特征可靠性，融合可靠层特征作为密集条件，并对不可靠层施加强HQ特征监督。仅约50M参数和单步推理即可在保真度、感知质量和鲁棒性上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有UIR方法大多采用预训练的文本到图像（T2I）潜空间扩散模型，但存在两个核心问题：（1）T2I模型中的VAE可能丢弃对恢复任务敏感的细节；（2）开放式合成先验可能引入内容不一致的伪影。因此需要一种保留细节且与任务一致的统一恢复框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出PixRestore——一个无VAE的像素空间DiT，扩散骨干完全从头训练，不依赖T2I预训练；2) 在patchified像素上直接进行流匹配（flow matching），兼顾细节保真与token序列可控性；3) 利用LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度预测每层特征的可靠性：可靠层的特征融合作为密集条件输入，不可靠层施加强HQ特征监督以促进退化去除；4) 在大规模多样化场景与退化语料上训练，并用基于DINO的对抗目标微调为单步生成器。
AI.result: 在公开基准和真实世界测试集上，仅约50M参数和单步推理，PixRestore在保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性上均优于竞品UIR模型，且效率远高于对手；更大的PixRestore变体可进一步提升性能，验证了像素空间设计的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PixRestore证明了无需T2I预训练和VAE的像素空间DiT设计可以同时实现高效的统一图像恢复和高保真结果，且具备良好的可扩展性。该工作提供了代码和精选基准以供后续研究。

title: Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化"密集同类属性错绑"（DSCAM）问题，即大视觉语言模型在拥挤场景中把属性错误地分配给同类的其他实例。作者构建了InstaBind-Lite基准，包含524张图像、529组同类实体、1773个框选实例，设计了四个互补的问题层级，共产生9580个可确定性评估的问题。通过源实例标注将"无依据生成"与"识别失败"区分出"属性从其他可见实体复制"的错误类型，并引入绑定专项指标。实验显示开源模型平均错绑率19.84%、API模型7.55%，且约80%的转移来源于相邻实例，定位与实例优先干预仅对部分模型有效。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在拥挤场景下能将物体和属性分别识别正确，却会把属性错配给同类的错误实例。通用VQA准确率将其判为错误，而物体幻觉指标又可能认为物体和属性都有图像支撑，二者都无法揭示这种属性转移现象。这一盲区亟需形式化定义与可控评测。
AI.method: 首先正式定义DSCAM问题，设计InstaBind-Lite受控基准：524张图像含529组3-6个同类实体的有序邻居，1773个框选实例，颜色类可区分的属性，四个互补问题层级；采用源实例标注将错绑与其他错误类型分离；提出绑定专项指标量化转移频率、相邻性、序数距离及干预效应。
AI.result: 五个开源模型平均错绑率19.84%，两个商业/API模型平均7.55%，这些错误被聚合准确率所掩盖；可识别的转移中82%左右来自相邻实例；定位和实例优先干预对部分模型有帮助但非普适方案。
AI.conclusion: InstaBind-Lite将以往无差别的错误答案转化为可溯源到失败类别的系统，检验了传统基准无法判定的可靠性维度：模型不仅要知道"看到了什么"，还要知道"每个属性归哪个实例所有"。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids
summary: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督的细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，基于粗到细路由金字塔（routing pyramid）将像素与稀疏潜在源关联，同时生成实例掩码和细胞形态编码，在多种成像模态下达到竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 传统细胞实例分割与分类依赖监督学习和人工标注，且将实例分割与细胞表征视为两个独立阶段，缺乏无需标注的端到端统一解决方案。
AI.method: 利用粗到细路由金字塔重建图像，将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源关联；像素与潜在源的关联产生实例掩码，潜在源本身编码细胞形态信息，实现分割与表征的统一。
AI.result: 在多种细胞形态和成像模态下，实例分割性能具有竞争力；在扰动条件下可对细胞表型进行生成式建模。
AI.conclusion: 该无监督方法证明分割与形态表征可共享同一潜在空间，提供了一种无需标注的通用细胞分析范式，代码与模型权重已开源。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
summary: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConceptEdit框架，通过建立包含1000多个细粒度编辑概念的层级分类学、构建ConceptEdit-12M大规模数据集（1200万高质量编辑对）、采用密集监督训练策略以及提供ConceptEdit-Bench评估套件，解决了现有图像编辑框架中概念粒度关注不足和训练效率低下的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑框架沿袭文本到图像扩散模型的训练范式，但在扩展到图像编辑时存在两个固有差异：一是对编辑概念粒度的关注不足，二是稀疏监督信号导致的训练效率低下。这两个问题限制了图像编辑模型的性能和训练效率。
AI.method: 1) 建立包含超过1000个细粒度编辑概念的层级分类学（taxonomy）；2) 通过改进的合成框架构建ConceptEdit-12M大规模数据集，包含1200万高质量编辑对，有效纠正生成数据的分布塌缩并保证数据保真度；3) 提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单一图像对中，提供更丰富的学习信号；4) 提出ConceptEdit-Bench粒度评估套件，用于诊断模型在真实场景中的能力。
AI.result: 训练结果表明所提出的密集监督训练策略显著超越了先前的工作，大幅提升了训练效率和整体模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据驱动的库构建方法纠正数据分布塌缩问题，结合密集监督策略提升训练效率，ConceptEdit框架在图像编辑任务上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能，并提供了细粒度的诊断评估工具。

title: Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Part of this research was submitted to the international conference European Molecular Imaging Meeting 2026
summary:
Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RONALD的支气管血管束分割管道，用于低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）图像中的肺结节检测辅助。该方法通过预处理（肺、肺叶、纵隔分割）后进行单独的血管和支气管树分割，显著提高了结节保留率，在DLCS和Pomeranian两个数据集上分别达到100%和99.92%的结节保留率，有助于早期肺癌筛查。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球致死率最高的癌症，往往因诊断过晚而失去治疗机会。早期筛查是有效治疗的关键，但患者数量增长与放射科医生数量有限之间的矛盾导致诊断等待时间延长。此外，极早期肺癌中结节常与支气管血管束相连或被其供血，受邻近血管和气道壁影响导致结节可见性降低，因此需要针对支气管血管束进行任务特异性的分割与去除，以提高结节检测效率和肺癌筛查的诊断潜力。
AI.method: 提出的RONALD管道分为以下阶段：（1）预处理阶段，包括肺、肺叶和纵隔分割；（2）在肺实质内分别进行血管分割和支气管树分割；（3）输出血管和支气管的二元掩膜。方法在DLCS（Duke Lung Cancer Screening）数据集和Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: RONALD管道成功在低剂量计算机断层扫描中分割出支气管血管束，并相比其他分割方法显著提高了结节保留率：在DLCS数据集中从93.98%和90.36%提升至100%，在Pomeranian数据集中从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%。
AI.conclusion: 该分割结果能够改善极早期肺癌中的肺结节检测，有助于提升肺癌筛查的诊断潜力。

title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
summary: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarnessEval-W，一个智能体化的世界模型评估管线，将LLM生态中的harness范式引入世界模型基准测试。它通过上下文理解、子问题分解、专用子智能体推理和父智能体验证，生成可检查的推理链证据树，在330个评估案例上覆盖18个世界模型，其判断与人类偏好高度一致并提供细粒度诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅提供单一标量分数，缺乏可验证的推理链来证明分数合理性。对于世界模型而言，判断rollout中物理、因果和世界状态是否正确演化至关重要，但当前指标都是暴力计算，没有可检查的推理过程。人类能自然发现这些违规，但没有自动化基准具备此能力。
AI.method: 采用智能体化评估管线：主智能体(context-aware)解释每个评估案例的上下文，将评估问题分解为可测量的子问题，并生成各具相关上下文和诊断工具的专用子智能体来推理各自子问题；父智能体验证收集到的证据并综合最终结论。层级式工作流将每次评估转化为透明的证据树，完整推理链支撑最终判决。
AI.result: 在18个代表性世界模型、330个评估案例上验证，HarnessEval-W的判断与人类偏好高度一致，同时提供可验证的细粒度诊断结论，可检查每个生成rollout的具体问题。
AI.conclusion: HarnessEval-W将harness范式成功引入世界模型基准测试，使评估从单纯分数变为具有完整可验证推理链的证据树。该管线已开源为实时基准，邀请社区贡献新技能和评估案例以伴随世界模型共同演化。

title: SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

AI.tldr: SplatGuide通过复用单个3DGS重建场景来整合像素渲染、逐高斯可见性投票和重建token三种信号，实现了无姿态新视角合成的最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将feed-forward 3DGS重建与多视图扩散结合时，最多只利用重建中的一种信号（像素渲染或学习特征），忽略了逐高斯可见性信息。这种信息断连导致可渲染几何、可见性线索和学习特征未被充分利用，阻碍了无姿态新视角合成质量的提升。
AI.method: SplatGuide从单一3DGS场景中提取三种互补信号：(1) 渲染图像提供像素对齐的几何条件；(2) 逐高斯源视角索引渲染为目标视角投票图，用于遮挡感知的参考视图选择；(3) 重建token通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。所有三种信号均来自同一次重建前向传播。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples和Mip-NeRF 360四个数据集上均达到无姿态新视角合成的最先进性能。在RealEstate10K上，使用中等数量输入视图时超越了使用真实姿态的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SplatGuide证明了3DGS重建的全部信息（渲染、可见性、特征）可以协同用于扩散模型条件化，消除信息断连后显著提升无姿态新视角合成质量，甚至超越有姿态基线的表现。

title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
comment: Z-Image-Pixel & Empirical Insight of Training Pixel-Space Diffusion Models
summary: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究像素空间扩散模型的实用训练配方。通过实证发现直接大规模像素空间预训练收敛远慢于潜空间，因此提出"潜空间到像素空间"（latent-to-pixel）策略：先在潜空间高效获取生成先验，再在后训练阶段迁移到像素空间。系统研究迁移过程中的关键设计选择（权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构、噪声调度），提出实用配方使像素空间模型在匹配或超越潜空间模型性能的同时，实现3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽受关注，但现有研究多局限于小规模或类条件设置，缺乏能在大规模条件下媲美甚至超越潜空间模型的实用训练配方。作者旨在填补这一空白，通过系统实证研究找到可扩展的像素空间训练方案。
AI.method: 提出latent-to-pixel训练策略：先在高效率的潜空间进行大规模预训练获取生成先验，然后通过后训练迁移至像素空间。系统研究了迁移阶段的关键设计维度，包括权重初始化方式、训练数据组成、预测目标选择、解码器架构设计以及噪声调度策略，通过实证评估确定最优配方组合。
AI.result: 所提出的像素空间模型在性能上与潜空间对应模型匹配或超越，同时带来3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过latent-to-pixel策略和精心设计的后训练配方，像素空间扩散模型可以成为潜空间模型在精度和推理效率上的可行替代方案，为大规模像素空间生成研究提供了重要的实证指导和实用指南。
